I had an incredible dining experience at Nawrish! This Somali restaurant truly knows how to treat its guests. The service was outstanding from start to finish. I loved that they provide complimentary soup and salad to start, it was such a welcoming touch. The food itself was absolutely to die for; every dish was packed with flavor. Don't leave without trying the spiced tea, it’s delicious and perfectly brewed. Overall, everything was 10/10 and very affordable.
I highly recommend it!

recently visited Nawrish on Commercial Road, and it left a strong impression. From the moment you step in, the place feels welcoming, with simple décor, clean tables, and staff who are genuinely attentive. The vibe isn’t flashy, but it’s comfortable and unpretentious, which actually suits the restaurant’s style perfectly.

The food is the real highlight. I tried the lamb shank, and it was cooked to perfection, tender, juicy, and packed with flavor. The spices were well-balanced, giving it depth without overwhelming the meat. The chicken and rice dish was equally impressive. The chicken was moist and flavorful, paired with rice that had a subtle, aromatic seasoning. It’s the kind of homey, satisfying meal that makes you feel like you’re getting a real taste of something authentic.

One thing that stood out was the chili sauce. It had just the right kick, spicy enough to excite your taste buds but not so fiery that it overpowers the dish. It complemented the lamb and chicken perfectly, adding an extra layer of flavor without stealing the show.

Portions are generous, and the prices are reasonable for the quality. Whether you’re popping in for a quick bite or a full meal, Nawrish delivers. For anyone on Commercial Road looking for hearty, well-prepared food with a little spice, this place is a solid choice. I’ll definitely be coming back.

A solid Somali spot with a good selection of tasty food. We went for the XL platter which came with the lamb shank, chicken and beef steak.

Not quite as good as Al kahf if I’m honest but at a slightly lower price point so can’t complain. Would come again

Food is great , one of the better Somalian restaurants in the area for sure. Only thing let it down was service. If you sit downstairs just be sure to let them know as we were forgotten about and had to chase our food.

The food was really tasty with generous quantities. The service was great and the staff was very kind.
I will definitely go back.

name: Humble Grape Liverpool Street - Wine Bar & Restaurant

reviews.text:
Taken here by locals that love this restaurant and now so do I. Creative menu that matches the delicious dishes. Was impressed with the staff that were very good at their jobs, and everyone seemed genuinely appreciative of your being a patron. Will be back.
Pricing reasonable and good wine selection.

A really unique location for wine lovers AND food lovers!
They have a wide selection of wine and their expert sommelier will help you make the best choice.
Then they have a menu with plenty of options to cater all diets and perfect to share.

A hidden gem in the middle of the centre.

I stopped by Humble Grape near Liverpool Street to kill a couple of hours on a weekday afternoon. The place was open but pretty quiet when I arrived, so I asked if it was okay to use my laptop before settling in. The staff were really nice about it and let me sit in the corner to get some work done.

Things started to pick up around 5 to 5.30pm when the office crowd began to roll in, and that was my cue to wrap up. It is not the most budget friendly spot, I paid £16.09 for a glass of white wine including service, but it was a great glass and it did the job perfectly.

All in all, a lovely calm space to chill for a bit in the afternoon before it turns into a lively post-work wine bar.
Great service. Loved sitting in the window seat and watching the world go by. Lovely wine and focaccia. I liked the selection you can have by the glass.

Went for the wine tasting and ended up staying for a few more glasses afterwards. The place itself is lovely, and the staff are so welcoming, so definitely a great spot for a relaxed evening in a charming location. The only thing I’d note is that the wine selection could be a bit more impressive.

I stayed in London for a week for work near this restaurant. Honestly, I didn’t have the best opinion of Turkish restaurants before, but this place completely changed it.
The service is excellent. I only had to mention once that I don’t eat raw onions, and the waitress Antonella remembered every time and always brought everything without onions- even the salad on the house. She is so kind!
The salad is served here with pomegranate juice- absolutely delicious!
The staff are very pleasant. The male waiter who served me today was also very attentive. He brought for me a house tea.
The food is just amazing. Everything I tried was incredibly tasty. The Adana kebab especially touched me- it reminded me of home.
And I love that they end the meal with homemade tea- also very tasty and aromatic.
I already know I’m going to miss this place when I leave.
Thank you for your hard work and the wonderful atmosphere. I highly recommend it!

Went there as a group for dinner on a Sunday, lovely atmosphere as we have a long table in the basement (9 people).  Food was excellent and the service was perfect. Jasmin looked after use for the night and we will definitely come back again!

Everything was perfect from start to finish. The food, the atmosphere, and the service were all excellent. I would especially like to thank Antonella — she was incredibly welcoming, kind, and attentive, and truly made us feel comfortable. Her positive energy added so much to our experience. Highly recommended, and we will definitely be back.

The atmosphere at Efes really stands out with warm lighting, tidy interiors, and a welcoming energy that instantly puts you at ease. The team here clearly takes pride in what they do. Every visit feels consistent with friendly greetings, quick seating, and attentive service throughout.

You can tell there is real care in how everything is prepared and presented, whether it is the lamb, chicken, or shish options that seem to be favorites among regulars. There is a certain balance and attention to detail in what arrives at the table that says a lot about the people behind it. Nothing ever feels rushed, and timing always seems right.

Another thing worth mentioning is the overall atmosphere. It is upbeat but still relaxed enough to enjoy a proper conversation. Even when it is busy, and it usually is, the staff keeps things moving smoothly without losing that personal touch. They manage to make a crowded evening feel calm and organized, which says a lot about their professionalism.

Efes also has a strong sense of hospitality, from small gestures to how the staff checks in just enough to make sure everything is right. Whether you are stopping by for a quick meet up or a longer evening with friends, it is a place that leaves a good impression every single time.

I’ve been to Efes so many times on different occasions! It’s perfect for any group size - you can easily find tables for larger groups (though it’s best to book in advance).

The food is delicious, well-prepared, and full of flavour, with generous portions - some main dishes are even great for sharing. They also serve a portion of bread and salad as a complimentary starter.

The staff are always friendly and welcoming, and they always do their best to accommodate you.

name: City Spice - Voted Best Indian Restaurant on Brick Lane

reviews.text: Mo was honestly the best host we’ve ever had! From the moment we walked in, he made us feel so welcome and comfortable. His attention to detail and genuine care for every guest was incredible — constantly checking that everything was perfect, giving great recommendations, and making sure our experience was flawless from start to finish. The service was friendly, warm, and professional throughout. You can really tell he takes pride in his work and loves what he does. Mo truly went above and beyond to make our evening special — thank you for such amazing hospitality, we’ll definitely be coming back because of him!

Exceptional service can transform a simple meal into a memorable experience, and this was certainly the case during my visit to City Spice, thanks to Mo’s outstanding service. From the moment I entered the restaurant, Mo’s professionalism, warmth, and genuine enthusiasm set the tone for an evening that went far beyond expectations. His approach to customer service exemplified how attentiveness and passion can elevate a dining experience.
Upon arrival, Mo greeted guests with a friendly smile and an unmistakable sense of confidence. Rather than offering a routine welcome, he made an immediate effort to ensure everyone felt comfortable and valued. His communication was clear and engaging, striking a perfect balance between professionalism and friendliness. This first impression established trust and made it clear that customer satisfaction was his top priority.
One of the most impressive aspects of Mo’s service was his deep knowledge of the menu. He explained dishes in detail, confidently answering questions about ingredients, spice levels, and preparation methods. For those unfamiliar with certain items, Mo offered thoughtful recommendations tailored to individual preferences, ensuring that each guest felt confident in their choices. His ability to personalise suggestions demonstrated not only expertise but also a genuine interest in providing the best possible experience.
Throughout the meal, Mo’s attentiveness remained consistent. He checked in at appropriate moments, ensuring that everything was to our satisfaction without ever being intrusive. Drinks were refilled promptly, plates were cleared efficiently, and any additional requests were met with enthusiasm rather than obligation. His calm and composed demeanour, even during busy periods, highlighted his strong work ethic and ability to manage pressure with ease.
What truly set Mo apart, however, was his passion for hospitality. His interactions felt sincere rather than rehearsed, creating a welcoming atmosphere that encouraged guests to relax and enjoy their time at City Spice. Small gestures—such as remembering preferences or sharing brief insights about the dishes—made the experience feel personal and thoughtful. These details, while seemingly minor, had a significant impact on the overall enjoyment of the evening.
In conclusion, Mo’s amazing service at City Spice exemplifies the highest standard of customer care. His professionalism, menu knowledge, attentiveness, and genuine warmth combined to create an exceptional dining experience. Mo did not simply serve food; he enhanced the atmosphere of the restaurant and left a lasting positive impression. His dedication to excellence reflects positively on City Spice as a whole and serves as a reminder of how outstanding service can turn an ordinary meal into an unforgettable experience.

Tourist trap! Small portions, dry chicken, and curt waiters.

Told us to give the place 5 stars instead of getting us a check, explains why rating is so inflated. Also offered and charged us for sparkling water when we just wanted regular water. Just clarify the cost when they offer you anything! 🤷🏻‍♂️

Every restaurant on this street has an award so just know the food is “fine” and a bit overpriced

Dining here for lunch was such a delightful experience. Arafat and his crew took good care of us. My friend and I ordered the lamp chops, lemon rice, garlic naan, and pepper lamb and mushroom, and all of the dishes were top notch! I’d definitely recommend.
Most certainly the best Indian food I’ve ever had! The place was very clean and had a large selection of dishes. The garlic naans were to die for, a must to try.

Good restaurant and buzzing on a Tuesday evening. The veg dhansak was lovely, nicely spiced. For my friends, the lamb dish was really good but the chicken dish was a bit dry, hence the 4 stars. Shah made us feel very welcome.

Not a bad place to have a curry on brick lane, the atmosphere is great and the service efficient and friendly.

The curries tasted decent but lacked anything special to set it apart. The naan was fresh and hot and my favourite dish was the paneer which was Smokey and flavourful

You know when you walk in and within about thirty seconds you can tell whether it’s going to be a faff or a proper treat? This was the second one. We got settled quickly, the place had a nice buzz without being too loud, and it just felt easy. No awkward waiting around, no long pauses where everyone starts checking their phone and pretending they aren’t hungry.

The service was properly speedy, but in the best way — attentive without hovering. Drinks turned up quickly (and yes, Cobra was very much on the table), and it set the tone straight away: relaxed, looked-after, let’s-enjoy-this kind of vibe.

Then the food arrived… and that was it. The sort of food where the first bite makes you do that little nod at the table like, “Right. We’re in safe hands here.” Everything tasted fresh, full of flavour, and clearly cooked with care. Not just “nice for a curry” nice — genuinely delicious. The kind of meal where conversation keeps pausing because people are too busy eating, then you get the happy little comments mid-mouthful: “This is unreal.” “Try this.” “Go on, have some of mine.”

And the big win? Every guest was happy. That’s the thing that matters most, isn’t it — different tastes, different spice levels, different expectations… and somehow everyone left satisfied. No complaints, no polite “yeah it was alright,” just proper contentment. Full plates cleared, smiles all round, and that warm, slightly smug feeling of having chosen well.

So, if you’re after a curry house that gets the basics right — delicious food, quick service, and an atmosphere that makes it feel like a proper night out — this place is an easy recommendation. We’ll definitely be back.

Ok curry - nothing particularly stood out in terms of flavours or freshness but nothing was bad either.
The staff were friendly but it felt very busy because we were sat in the window, and the men touting for customers were very loud and coming in/out of the shop a lot.
I've been told every curry house on Brick Lane is similar quality.

As usual the best service at Bengal village! The staff always go above and beyond to ensure we have a 10/10 visit! Myself and my mum and son visit for every special occasion plus the random days we fancy good authentic food. We appreciate all the staff and Shah ensured today me and my mum had the best birthday! Thank you again and see you guys soon 💖

Fantastic vegan/vegetarian food and amazing and quick service. The staff, especially Payal, were all extremely attentive and very quick to help with anything we needed. I am not vegan or vegetarian but the chicken tikka masala was fantastic and the sauce was absolutely amazing. Very good value for money too. It is a very quiet restaurant with almost no other customers (when we came at 8:30). Lovely restaurant, highly recommended

This was my first time with Indian food. I stopped by this restaurant which was just across the hotel we stayed in. Payal gave me recommendations about the food to choose. I definitely enjoyed the meal as well as the cosy athosphere of the place. In addition to that I love the energy Payal radiated. Thanks for the lovely experience.

Me and my partner came to get butter chicken which is my favourite Indian dish.

There’s plenty of Indian restaurants in the area but this one is by far the best.

The chicken was super delicious and I didn’t even realise it’s not actual chicken but soya! You could choose the level of spice of the dish too. We also ordered garlic naan and mango lassi, both very tasty.

The service was amazing, our waitress Payal was lovely and made sure we were taken care of the whole time.

I’d definitely recommend this place and will be coming back!

We had dinner here last night and absolutely loved it! It was only our second time trying Indian cuisine, and it did not disappoint. The aloo paratha and the vegan chicken tikka masala were both outstanding, and the service was truly impeccable.  A bit pricey but good.

We had such a lovely experience here. The food was honestly amazing - full of flavour and beautifully presented.
The service was just as good. Binjal looked after us so well, so warm and attentive throughout the evening and made us feel really special.
I had booked the table for our wedding anniversary and Binjal kindly surprised us with a sweet on the house, which was such a thoughtful touch. It truly made our night extra special. Can’t wait to come back!

We had a great experience at this Pakistani restaurant. We for 21:30 and were served immediately, which already set the tone for a smooth evening. One thing I genuinely appreciated was the big bottle of water a full litre and a half. Most places bring you a tiny bottle and call it a day, so this felt like a small but thoughtful gesture.

The menu is extensive and full of tempting options. Portions aren’t huge, which actually works well because you can order a variety of dishes and try more things. I’d strongly recommend the pani puri and lamb which is fresh, punchy, and absolutely delicious and the grilled meats, which were beautifully cooked and full of flavour.

We did have a minor issue with a cold draft inside the restaurant, but after moving to another table it was completely resolved. The staff were kind and attentive throughout, and the service was quick without feeling rushed. The food tasted fresh and vibrant, and the complimentary dessert at the end was a lovely touch.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Absolutely outstanding experience from start to finish.

From the moment we walked in, the staff were incredibly warm, welcoming, and attentive. The service was genuinely thoughtful — they took the time to explain the menu, gave us excellent recommendations, and made sure we were comfortable throughout the evening without ever being overbearing.

The food was phenomenal — easily some of the best Pakistani cuisine I’ve had. Every dish was packed with flavour, beautifully cooked, and clearly made with care and authenticity. You can really tell the kitchen takes pride in what they serve.

What really sets this place apart, though, is the hospitality. The team made us feel like guests rather than customers, which elevated the whole experience. We left full, happy, and already planning our next visit.

Highly recommend to anyone looking for incredible Pakistani food paired with outstanding service.

It is a great place to eat authentic halal Pakistani food. Chicken Madrasi was the best among chicken biryani and sheesh kebab which we tried. Sheesh kebabs were a bit dry and really spicy so remember to mention if you don't eat much spices. Other than that everything was great. We were served very well by Mr. Ghufran :).

Absolutely loved the food! The Chicken 65 paired with Rumali Roti was a standout—flavorful, tender, and perfectly spiced. The Haleem was rich and comforting, and those ginger chunks added a delightful kick. My friend tried the Chana Masala with Lacha Paratha and was genuinely impressed—even though he rarely enjoys much food outside, he truly loved this meal. Hats off to the chef…. A big shoutout to Ruhaan and Murtuza for their exceptional service! They were warm, attentive, and made our dining experience truly memorable. Their friendly demeanour and thoughtful gestures added a personal touch that made us feel genuinely welcomed.
What a lovely resturant, the grills and somosa chat was amazing. The curries and biriani was definitely very tasty, lovely customer service. Karak chai was 10/10. We will definitely be back again!

name: Best Mangal Bar & Restaurant
address: 107-109 Great Eastern St, London EC2A 3JD, UK

reviews.text:
We had a great experience visiting this restaurant today after the gym, it was the perfect place to refuel with some quality protein.

A special mention to our waiter, Alexey, who was very friendly and left a wonderful impression with his attentive service.

We ordered the Grilled Halloumi, Sigara Börek, Chicken Shish, and Mix Shish. All the meat was incredibly tender and juicy, it literally melted in the mouth. The dishes came with plenty of fresh vegetables and delicious sauces, with the garlic sauce being our absolute favorite.

We’re very happy with our visit and will definitely be coming back again!

very tasty grill and nice service. We had mixed grill and chicken shish. Both were very nice and with the choice of either rice or bulgur. A separate portion of salad was also very tasty. Borek was very generously filled with cheese. The only thing I'd wish is they gave more meat with each main and the halloumi wasn't so squeaky.

I'm gonna keep it simple. If these guys aren't in paradise, after I shuffle this mortal coil, then I guess I'm gonna have to keep reincarnating until they pop up a shop beyond the pearly gates. If Manna was this good, then some people would have never left the desert. Anything less than 5 stars is blasphemy.

One of my favorite lunch restaurants in the city! Quality food, fresh and delicious. All portions are quite big and not a chance you'll feel hungry after, while prices are fair and reasonable. As take away they are amazing, as value of money is great. Notice that in rush hour the place is full, but as the service is fast (and amazingly friendly) you'll not wait much to sit down or wait for your dish.
Enjoy :)
Friendly service, affordable and delicious halal food! We went there for iftar and they gave us free dates. No additional service charge added to your bill which is a good sign.

A nice restaurant with good quality food but nothing spectacular but would still recommend. Was visiting nearby and this place was recommended by a local. We had some starters that were all very nice (sorry forgot what we ordered) and mains such  as lamb bhuna, chicken kadai, lamb masala with plain rice and pilao (this was exceptional). £91 for four people, 4 starters and mains is a very reasonable price. Went at 5 pm on a Sunday so wasn't busy. Staff were attentive and perhaps need to advise on the size of the starters as they could have been shared by two. I would recommend and return as a good quality meal.

Second time visiting and always left satisfied. Namon Sana and Afrin were very accommodating. Service with a smile. Will definitely be back! Thanks again guys for making our experience a great one once again.

Food was so good we had extras to take home 😋

The spices were masterfully blended—garam masala, cumin, and coriander adding depth without overwhelming the palate.
Samosas arrived crisp and golden, filled with spiced potatoes and peas that burst with flavor in every bite.
Dal makhani simmered slowly to creamy perfection, with lentils enriched by butter and a hint of smokiness.
Tandoori chicken was marinated overnight, yielding juicy, smoky meat with a vibrant red hue and yogurt tang.
10.  Chutneys—mint, tamarind, and mango—provided bright, zesty contrasts to the richer

Highly recommended must try
Staff was kind and gentle asking all the times in need  for staff absolutely brilliant ❤️

Great find in Whitechapel for a quick, tasty meal at good prices and good portions.  I was dining alone 7 opted for the mixed grill, chips and naan.  All were nice, hot and tasty.  Service was quick and the staff were friendly.  Some of the decor like the wallpaper is worn, peeling or been stuck back on with tape so the place could do with some investment on it's maintenance, as it did seem to be busy, so getting it spruced up can only attract more people.
Food was nice. Sevice by Afreen was excellent. It was our 2nd visit in last 10 days. We will be back soon . And try your Indian food .

What a lovely surprise Okko was. My friends and I were looking for a space to accommodate us with no booking; and am I glad they found a spot for us.
We had lots of bites to share; it was plenty of food to divide between 3 people. Everything tasted fresh and delicious. I am thoroughly impressed in particular by the salmon nigiri - it was the best I’d ever had.
I also want to praise the service; we had the sweetest waitress. She was attentive, served us with a big smile, and made us feel at home.
Highly recommend if you’re looking for a low-key, cosy japanese restaurant. Super experience.

I visited Okko in Broadway Market with my whole family, and we were honestly blown away. The service was excellent from start to finish — so friendly, attentive, and welcoming. The food was absolutely incredible, beautifully presented, and really well-priced for the quality. We had a mix of young kids and older kids with us, and every single one of them loved the food (a miracle in itself!). The atmosphere is relaxed but vibrant, and it felt like such a treat. We’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend!

Came here for a birthday meal with around 10 people, they did a good job at accommodating that number of people within the space. The food was excellent, exceptional even. A real wide variety so potentially look at the menu before going. The real let down was the vibe. They told us to be quiet at one point, also took away some of our drinks while still drinking. Very quickly turned from good vibes to, get these people out of here.

TLDR: great place to eat with great food. Not the choice for as the group.

Already planning our next visit! I’m a coeliac and this is one of the best gluten-free dining experiences I’ve had. The choice of food is just incredible, and everything I ate was sublime. The hamachi jalapeño sushi was gorgeous, as was the cold char siu chicken. The stand out dish for me was miso buta kakuni - perfectly tender pork belly in miso with a lovely jammy egg. My non-coeliac partner had chicken katsu with curry sauce, and he said the chicken was the best he’s ever had. We also shared the truffle fries which were 10/10.

Service was fantastic - very friendly and attentive. Food came out promptly which was great as we were starving! I cannot wait to come back for a gluten free katsu!
£95 for two cocktails, two sharers, rice, sushi, katsu, fries, and service. Really good value and the portion sizes are very generous.

Poor Service - Avoid This Place
Went twice, same awful experience both times. They seat you at “reservation” tables without telling you upfront, then rush you to finish your food the moment it arrives. Asked if the table was reserved the second time - waitress said no, then did the exact same thing again.
You can’t enjoy a meal when staff are hovering over you demanding you hurry up after you’ve already ordered and paid.
There are non-reservation tables available - use them or tell customers upfront about time limits.
Won’t be back. Plenty of other places that actually want your business.
1/5 stars

name: Arepa & Co Venezuelan Restaurant - Bethnal Green

reviews.text:
The food is delicious! 😋

We went just after 1pm to have light lunch and it wasn’t busy, but popular with mums and families with babies in buggies.

Lots of high chairs are available as you can see in the photos.

The toilets were clean. The mirror was too high for my height that I could only see the top of my head in the mirror.

They hire out the mezzanine or the whole space for private parties.

The decorations and vibes are pretty good! 👍

Came here for brunch on a Saturday. Found it easy to get a seat and service was friendly; the waiter was happy to share more details and recommendations about dishes on the menu.

Food and drinks were tasty and I found my dish filling. The restaurant itself felt cosy, had a good selection of background music, and we did not feel rushed during our meal or after we’d finished. Would happily come back.

We went to Arepa & Co and had such an amazing experience, it was our first time trying Venezuelan cuisine, and we loved it so much we went back two days in a row! We started with the Palm Salad, which was fresh and flavorful with grilled palm hearts, cherry tomatoes, shallots, capers, and lettuce. For our main dishes, we tried the Arepa Pabellón, filled with shredded beef, black beans, ripe plantains, and cheddar cheese, and the Pabellón Reina, a rice bowl with chicken, mayo and avocado mix, black beans, fried plantains, and cheese. The flavors in both dishes were incredible, especially the fried plantains, they were absolutely amazing! The restaurant also had tons of gluten-free options, which was perfect for my mum. Overall, it was a wonderful introduction to Venezuelan cuisine, and we can’t recommend it enough.

An absolutely outstanding discovery. I didn't know quite what to expect but what a place, and what food!

I'm vegetarian and was a little nervous as to my options but there were plenty and the staff were more than happy to advise and recommend items.

The portions were huge and indeed the only problem is that you feel so full up that you don't want dinner later on 😄

Well worth making a reservation for free as it gets super busy but  it's worth it. This was one of the tastiest meals I've had in a long time in a restaurant.

Thoroughly recommended!!

I had a wonderful afternoon at Arepa & Co, sharing a special event with my family. We attended a VR experience where we got to see our country, and both before and after the show we enjoyed some fantastic food and drinks.
We started with a few cocktails, including a Diplomatico that was the perfect way to begin. The tequeños with sauce and the arepitas con nata were absolutely delicious. We then followed up with cachapas, empanaditas, and a refreshing passion fruit juice — all bursting with authentic, incredible flavors. Every dish was full of taste and felt like a true celebration of Venezuelan cuisine.
The restaurant is always lively and busy, so I recommend booking a table in advance. While the service could be a little quicker, the staff are friendly and the food more than makes up for it.
Overall, a fantastic experience that I’d highly recommend for anyone wanting to enjoy great food in a vibrant atmosphere.

I’ve visited Mudmee a few times now, but sadly, it seems to be a case of diminishing returns. The quality of both the food and service has noticeably declined with each visit.

This time, the non-veg platter was disappointingly oily, and while the Pad Thai actually tasted good, it was served completely cold—which really ruined the dish. The biggest issue, however, is the layout. They have stuffed so many tables and chairs into the space that you can barely get in or out. The tables are tiny; once you have three plates down, you’re playing Tetris just to find a spot for your drink. I really wanted to keep liking this spot, but it’s getting harder to justify coming back.

We were looking for thai food to eat near liverpool street station, and found this restaurant just few minutes walk from the station. We waited for half an hour as it was dinner time so this is understandable. The food are amazing (and spicy!) as I believed this restaurant is run by thai people, and i believe it is authentic as I can hear some thai people coming in to have meals here. Overall really good foods, just really spicy if you have low pain tolerance lol

First time in London, went to this restaurant for dinner as it was close to our accommodation.

We ordered Green Thai curry with 2 portions of sticky rice and Pai Thai noodles with chicken. Service time was super quick. Food was tasty, specially the green Thai curry.
The Pad Thai noodles, however was a bit too oily and also the portion size could be better, it was quite less.

Total bill was 30 pounds.

The place is a bit small, we had our baby and stroller with us, it was a bit tight to fit in the stroller around the table. But otherwise okay, overall satisfactory experience (mainly for the food).

Great food, especially the Thai green chicken curry and coconut rice. Portion sizes were very good, and there was more than enough. The service was great. They found us a table late on a Friday evening with no reservation. Would visit again

Such a home-y Thao restaurant! We’ve been to this restaurant quite a phew times and the food and service is always amazing 💕 definitely recommend for an authentic taste. The uncle was so sweet and even gifted me a little Thai herbal inhaler 🥹🥹😭 my faves are sweet corn cake, Tom yum soup and pad Thai

name: Sagardi
address: Cordy House, 95 Curtain Rd, London EC2A 3BS, UK

reviews.text: Takes cash. Very friendly knowledgeable staff. Very tasty perfectly cooked steak.high quality meat. Tasty sides too (i recommend the wedges and chard gratin).  Extensive wine list. Great ambience. If you sit at the bar its not too loud and you can watch the masterchef at work grilling those big fat doorstep steaks.  Will definitely visit again.

Positives the wedges and Swiss chard gratin were amazing. Steak was really good but for what we paid for it seriously and ridiculously overpriced. I understand the unique selling point of the dairy cows but I’ve paid less in a Michelin restaurant for more food. Wine wasn’t great we asked for full bodied and got light. Service was good but not amazing. Atmosphere was good but not amazing. Basically for what we paid for it all I was expecting a lot more and feel we did not get value for money and wouldn’t recommend it unless you want to walk away feeling like you got scammed. Harsh I know but it’s honestly how we felt.

Where have you been all my life?! Best steaks in London right here. But not just the steaks, every thing they produce from starters through to mains and desserts is absolute perfection. Perfection is not cheap, but very happy to pay to feel like San Sebastian is actually in London. Service was lovely. Thanks so much! Dreaming of the next time!

I saw a reel on IG calling this the best steak in London so thought we should pay a visit while visiting. I’m from Texas so steak and bbq are staple foods here and I enjoy trying out different steak houses when traveling overseas. I tried the tasting menu which was a 5 course meal. The first course was basque sausage and was delicious, probably my favorite part of the meal. The next two dishes were fish based - a cod omelette which was good but very runny/liquidy so texture wise my son did not enjoy it and the second was pan fried codfish. We had two pieces and one of them was overcooked so a bit rubbery/hard to chew but the other was good. The txuleton steak was ok. It wasn’t bad but it wasn’t good either.  We were never asked how we’d like our steak cooked and while we do prefer medium rare, it was just ok. The videos I saw on social media show it heavily salted but we barely tasted it, the ones where we did have salt tasted better.  I’d give it a 7/10 relative to its price.  It wasn’t an expensive steak so I wasn’t expecting top tier quality but it was just average.  Finally for dessert they were out of the cheese so we got cheesecake instead and that was fine as well, just not my style as it wasn’t sweet and much softer than NY cheesecake, more like a custard.  I’d consider this maybe an average quality steakhouse not a specialty one but they have a very extensive wine selection so I think for evening drinks, this would be a great place to go.

Sagardi must be a well kept secret in Shoreditch and we made the discovery on our morning walk. The food was amazing as was the selection of wines. Their beef is a specialty. It was a quiet Saturday evening after Christmas, so the restaurant was only about 1/4 full. The only negative was being seated at the back of the restaurant next to a stack of boxes. I asked for a better table and was seated one row up. It appeared that the female waitress was a little inexperienced.

We celebrated a birthday here and had a wonderful time.

TAM was incredibly friendly and helpful, serving us with genuine enthusiasm that made the experience even more special.

The food was absolutely delicious, and cooking our own BBQ was such a fun and memorable experience.

A great place to eat, drink, and have a fabulous time here at Yori. Highly recommended!

As Korean bbqs go, nothing to complain about, not a huge variety of meats and veg for bbq to choose from though. The number of other Korean dishes is pretty limited as well competed to other Korean restaurants. What they do serve though was decent.

Ordered the pork goon mandu and haemool kimchi jeon. the jeon was really tasty, had some nice bits of seafood in there and good flavour from the kimchi as well but was very oily. was also pretty disappointed with the goon mandu, small serving size and pretty tasteless. in general felt it was quite expensive for what was served. Friendly service

Yori in Shoreditch is one of those places that quietly becomes a favourite after just one visit. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere strikes a perfect balance between relaxed and buzzy — modern without feeling cold, and lively without being overwhelming. It’s the kind of restaurant that works just as well for a casual midweek dinner as it does for a long, indulgent catch-up with friends.

The food is genuinely excellent. Everything we ordered was beautifully presented and packed with flavour, with that comforting, authentic Korean depth that’s hard to fake. The meats were perfectly cooked and incredibly tender, the marinades were rich without being overpowering, and the side dishes were fresh, vibrant, and clearly made with care. You can really tell that quality ingredients and attention to detail are at the heart of what Yori does. Portions were generous too — satisfying without feeling heavy — which is always appreciated.

What truly elevated the experience, though, was the service. A huge thank you to Tam, who looked after us so well throughout the evening. Tam was friendly, attentive, and incredibly knowledgeable, taking the time to explain dishes, offer recommendations, and make sure everything was just right without ever feeling intrusive. That kind of service makes such a difference and genuinely adds to the overall enjoyment of the meal.

Overall, Yori Shoreditch delivers on every front: great food, a warm atmosphere, and standout service. It’s a restaurant that feels dependable but still special — somewhere you’d happily return to again and again. Highly recommended, and a big thanks again to Tam for making the evening such a great one.

Went here for lunch on my sister’s birthday today and had such a lovely experience! The food was really tasty, but what stood out most was the service. Natasha especially was so warm, friendly, and attentive the whole time. She helped us with a few customizations and made sure we had everything we needed. You can just feel her positive energy! Her service alone was 10/10.

There was also another South Asian male staff member who was super polite and quick whenever we asked for anything. Really appreciated that.

The rice was a little undercooked, but honestly, everything else made up for it. Overall, such a nice vibe and great team. Would definitely come back!

name: Mint Leaf London
address: Bank, 12 Angel Ct, London EC2R 7HB, UK

reviews.text:
Very nice ambiance, impeccable service and succulent food. We celebrated a birthday here with family and we had an absolutely wonderful time at Mint Leaf, London.

Aloo Tikki Chaat, Paneer Tikka & Chicken Tikka were the best starters we have had. The mojitos and lassi were delicious to go with the starters.

For mains we had Bhindi, Koftas, Daal Bukhara & Lamb Nihari. Their garlic naan and butter naan were crunchy, buttery and delicious.

Thanks to the staff for very attentive and impeccable service.

Had an incredible first visit to Mint Leaf and was truly impressed. The food is authentic, flavorful, and absolutely delicious. The chaat starters were amazing, and although the veg seekh kebab wasn’t our favorite, the main course more than made up for it — the jackfruit kofta was outstanding and the dal makhani was very good, paired perfectly with coriander and butter naan. The food we ordered was too much for two of us but we managed to finish almost everything as it was quite delicious.
The ambience is pleasant, we were seated immediately without a reservation, and the staff was friendly and accommodating. Overall a 10/10 experience.
highly recommended!

Mint Leaf London was such a great surprise in the heart of the City. The space feels grand and modern, with a polished atmosphere that still keeps the warmth of traditional Indian dining. Great portions, thoughtful presentation, and a lovely setting for dinner or even a special occasion. Would definitely return.
Loved the place. Great location, food was nice and it’s handy for business meetings, events, team get togethers, client dinners. Of course that have a great bar too and plenty of cocktails I believe!
Lovely food and great atmosphere. Only critic is when we complained about the naans being cold the waiter got defensive and didn’t apologise. It’s a shame really as food ambiance was lovely

I tried the Centic Special, and it was outstanding. A perfect mix of meat and chicken with a gentle spice, rich sauce, and yoghurt on top. It arrived piping hot and packed with flavour. The staff were friendly and helpful, and the ambience was warm and elegant. A great choice if you want something different from the usual Turkish grill.

• Centic Special was full of flavour
• Served hot with a great balance of spice and yoghurt
• Friendly staff and relaxed ambience

The service was excellent! The lamb was cooked perfectly, tender and flavorful. My wife had the spicy chicken kefte and it was delicious and spicy. If you are in the mood for Turkish food and hospitality, visit Fora!

5 stars all round. Generous portions. Chicken shish was well cooked and full of flavour. Much better than the other three-letter Turkish spots nearby. Only downside: the hummus tasted shop-bought, freshly made would lift it. Slightly pricey for lunch but fair for dinner.

Clean place with friendly staff and nicely presented dishes. The food was tasty and fresh, nothing too fancy, but perfect for a relaxed dinner. We enjoyed the halloumi, chicken shish, and vine leaves. Would happily come back for a casual meal.
Decent service and atmosphere, some of the dishes were good but the kababs were overcooked

Fantastic Italian food! They have a really nice little display they show you with samples of the pasta selection. The highlight was the blue cheese gnocchi with walnuts. We had to sample the pizza too! Incredible. We went on a Saturday night and it was not too busy. This place should be 5/5 stars. I would have liked to have a beer on tap but from the bottle is also fine sometimes. The staff were knowledgeable and tentative. Tipping is separate to your bill so you can bring cash or tip direct to your waiter on a monzo link.

Saponara in London is a truly special little gem that has the remarkable power to transport you straight to Italy the moment you step inside. From the irresistible aroma of freshly baked pizzas and simmering sauces to the warmth and charm of the people who work there, every detail captures the spirit of authentic Italian dining. The laughter that fills the room mingles with the clinking of glasses and the hum of conversation, creating an atmosphere that feels as joyful and genuine as a family gathering in a small Italian town. Every bite—from the perfectly cooked pasta to the wood-fired pizza—is a celebration of flavour, simplicity, and tradition. Saponara isn’t just a restaurant; it’s an experience, a little piece of Italy nestled in the heart of London, where every visit feels superb, delicious, and deeply enjoyable.

Came here with a group last night and it was incredible. Such a lovely vibe and amazing food. Really reasonably priced. Pasta menu comes in the form of a plate of dried pasta, which was so fun. We had a group of 8 + a baby/pram and they were so helpful and welcoming. 10/10 will be back.

A true hidden Italian gem!

Loved how the menu comes with a selection of different pasta types and sauces, the presentations was amazing!

Had a mix of starters and mains all were delicious and great portion sizes. My favourite was the tortellini with beef ragu *chefs kiss*

We were served by Julia who gave us some great recommendations and was happy to answer our questions.

The atmosphere was chilled yet buzzing, tables full and conversations flowing I’d defo recommend to book in advance.

When you walk in, you're greeted with walls of wine and Italian goods. Hanging above you is an Italian flag and a Ferrari flag, and in front of you are tables packing the room with one TV hanging on the back wall of an Italian broadcast. This is essentially an Italian restaurant plucked off the street of any major Italian city and transported to London. And the food? Matches the vibe. The antipasti and pasta dishes are incredible, but make sure you stay for tiramisu - something pretty unique and entirely delicious. Fantastic service, as well.

Went there as a large group for a mates birthday. The food was amazing but the service was slow and some of the dishes took ages to come out. Maybe it was just a busy night! Would go there again one day. Cheers

I came here by chance, feeling absolutely exhausted after a long day... I ordered the Pho soup and jasmine tea – and it was exactly what I needed! The soup was full of flavor, warm and comforting, with lots of fresh herbs and greens – it truly lifted me up 💛 I also had a juicy, fresh orange for a refreshing finish – just perfect.

It's a very cozy place with a super friendly staff – I felt really welcomed and taken care of.
I highly recommend this spot – the food, atmosphere, and service were all amazing. I’ll definitely be coming back! 😊

i sat down at mien tay expecting great food and those expectations were still surpassed. me and my dad came in here starving and i haven't needed to eat for two days - it is very filling, the portion sizes are of incredible value.. you have been warned! the service was..how to say.. Minimal.... by which i mean very straight to the point, you're here for a delicious meal not for small talk with your waiter. had to call staff over rather than them coming to us but we didn't mind. starters were as good as we had heard, my dish (ginger duck + rice) was wonderful, flavourful, and hearty. it seems there is a lot of love going into this cooking.

This is your spot for great authentic Vietnamese food. The food is really amazing and most of the visitors are asian what for me is a great sign. The place isn't the most romantic but if you want to impress with food give this a go.

Real disappointment.

We have been coming here for years and came here to eat on a Sunday.

The Banh Xeo was stale and tasteless - like it had been prepared the day before and filling microwaved.

The other meals (chow mein, curry, and something else unmemorable) were also not great.. bad flavours, not fresh... especially considering how much time it took to have everything served.

Parts of the meal were forgotten and plenty of items were not available. 😕

Service was so so so much worse than anything we'd previously had here... this used to be 5 stars but if I could give 0 this time, I would.

I didn't mind paying the prices previously as the food used to be worth it.. now, it's really not worth the price tag.

name: Fenchurch Restaurant
address: 1, Level 37, Sky Garden Walk, London EC3M 8AF, UK

reviews.text: Very dark, came for view, no view. Requires resevation. Would have been a 5 if the restaurant was closer to the edge for views. It is in the middle of the building. Food was tasty for a decent price. Portions decent, staff able to mix and match sometimes instead requiring a starter and main per person. Thankfully 3 appetizers plus a main seemed to be ok.

The visit and the tasting menu was incredible! I will definitely suggest to come not only to enjoy the views, the terrace and the service, but also it’s super worthy. We arrived on time and for the ones that selects the tasting there’s a specific room dedicated to that, that provides more intimacy. The portions and the variety of the plates were super curated, I couldn’t finish my dessert so on that you can imagine that you will eat a lot. The team serves us on a super professional and friendly way. My favorites the ceviche, the grilled fish and the dessert.

I visited with my girlfriends, and at first I was a bit confused by the menu. But everything was excellent. I recommend the tartare and the cod with orzo. I was pleased with the simple bread and butter, it's always a good idea. The cocktails are very mediocre, it's better to choose wine. But the place itself is worth visiting; I had a view of west London and the real St Paul's Cathedral.

Love that Saturday brunch.

Food was excellent. Refined but spiced and generous. The Crab Rigatoni was incredible, it got better and better as I ate it. Venison was gorgeous if maybe a touch too sweet for me. Desserts were not on par, but I recommend the soufflé. In the website, it says that all tables have a great view; that is not true. However it felt very peaceful and enjoyable regardless, as there aren’t many tables. A wonderful moment!

We were made to feel welcome from start to finish.  The staff were warm and friendly.  The service impeccable.  Kerth’s tasting food menu was deliciously tantalising with your taste buds.   Definitely will be back and hopefully try the plated menu.  Well done to the staffing team you are a credit to Sky Gardens.

name: Flat Earth Pizzas - Restaurant Bethnal Green
address: 288 Cambridge Heath Rd, Cambridge Heath, London E2 9DA, UK

reviews.text:
I've avoided going here despite passing by frequently and the 4.8 rating on Google because it's vegetarian/vegan but looks like I've been missing out!
The 2 pizzas that we got were fantastic. The burrata pizza was really nice and creamy and the KFM Korean-style oyster mushroom pizza had amazing flavours never before experienced on a pizza!
Would definitely come here again in the future when I'm in the neighbourhood.
Also came around 1900 on a Saturday and just walked in without a reservation.

We visited Flat Earth Pizzeria because we were really drawn to the sustainable concept and the great reviews. We were especially impressed by how many vegan options were available.

My vegan pizza was outstanding. Possibly the best vegan pizza I have ever had in a restaurant. Whatever the vegan mozzarella was made of, it was absolutely amazing. Truly unbelievably delicious. 🍕 🍕 🍕

My partner’s non vegan pizza was also incredibly tasty. We would definitely come back if we visit London again. Simply fantastic. Keep up the great work.

Great desserts especially their autumnal apple and rhubarb crumble paired perfectly with their fab coffees. Also, they're in the top 10 sustainable businesses in London, as well as best pizzas list in London - Rich is a pro!!!

Coupled with lovely warm hospitality from Sarah, Rich and Annabel @flatearthpizzas . 💚🤗

Sustainable businesses | Autumnal desserts | Best pizzas in London

#FlatEarthPizza #bethnalgreen

Me and a friend popped here randomly after a visit to the Viktor Wynd museum and we did not regret it.

We shared a mushroom garlic pizza because it was huge. The quality of dough was so good and had a nice bit to it. I liked that the pizza base didn't get all mushy and hard to eat when it's all sloppy (FYI, I eat pizza with my hands so I need to be able to hold it properly🌝). We also didn't feel heavy or gross after eating it which I normally do with pizza. We were so hungry we forgot to take pics of the pizza and salad.

The cesar gem lettuce salad was so simple and tasty. There was toasted croutons on top which added texture and gave it more crunch.

And OMG the apple crumble with vanilla once cream was a dream - I could have eaten another portion if I didn't have to wake up early for gym & work 😭

The atmosphere was super chilled and relaxing. It wasn't too busy (which was nice because it wasn't loud) but we did go on a Tuesday evening. The staff were really welcoming and lovely hosts too so thank you❤️ I will be back again!

We ordered the Kimchi and KFM. The dough is really good. The toppings are definitely unusual and interesting, however they didn’t live up to the more traditional flavors. Still, I think I would have it again.

Home-like, comforting food at very affordable prices most meals are around £5–7, and the £3 payesh for dessert is absolutely delicious! Two of my favourites are the chicken deal and beef deal, which come with rice, chicken or beef, and dal hearty, tasty, and great value. I come here almost every week, and it has become one of my favourite spots for lunch and dinner in Whitechapel. The staff are always friendly, and the service is great. Highly recommended for anyone looking for tasty, homely meals at a good price.

Alhambra restuarant offers a cozy Bangladeshi and Indian dining experience.
Cuisine: Bangladeshi, Indian, Asian, and Cafe's style dishes dominate the menu. popular items include Kachchi biryani, fish vuna, jhal Muriel, piayaju,and a variety of curries and kebabs.
Alhambra described as h ok melt and relaxed, ideal for casual lunches or dinners. The interior is modest but welcoming.

We stopped in around 9:40 PM and enjoyed a good late evening supper in the relaxed atmosphere. Really friendly, gracious folks run this little restaurant. Their lamb curry — with rice, cucumber salad, dahl (lentil soup), and a bottle of water — was fresh and delicious. Price was affordable (£16 for two) and the meal was thoroughly filling. Given the chance I'd absolutely eat here again. Their curry is gluten free / made without wheat — "just spices" according to them.

I needed a quick lunch while my son was staying in the hospital so I went to this restaurant. They recommended the Kachhi Biriyani. It was absolutely delicious, full of flavour. It came with mutton and egg, and a bowl of daal on the side. There’s some crispy onions in the biriyani as well, making it specially tasty. Highly recommend!

We had iftar platter there. We reached there after maghrib prayer and they had almost finished serving Iftar, yet they didn’t say no to us and they cordially managed to serve us Iftar. We paid £10 for one Iftar platter. The girl that served us was very friendly and professional. The manager / owner and other staff were good people.
(The attached pictures are not exactly the of their iftar platter, rather, it’s the one that we’re served.)

Visited after Friday Jummah prayer a few weeks ago and the restaurant was packed very quickly and I could understand why having eaten here now. The waiter was very attentive and welcoming. There is seating downstairs as well as ladies only dining area. A warm and cosy setting. Ordered the Mandi platter for two. The food was delicious and full of flavour. The lamb shank fell off the bone and was so tender. The chicken was succulent with crispy skin. The bisbas (green) sauce complimented the dish and I loved it! It was hot and spicy. It added another dimension of flavour to the dish. Would highly recommend to everyone wishing to try Somali food at a reasonable price to come to this restaurant.

Food good but terrible service.
Shocking toilets.

I've been hearing about how this was the best Somalian restaurant in London so thought I'd try it.

My friend and I went in around 1pm on a Sunday so place wasn't really that busy.
At first we were given a a table right next to the door which was annoying as a cold breeze came in every time the door was opened.
I asked the waitress if we could sit downstairs and she said no it was full.

I then went to the toilet downstairs and saw it was almost empty.

The toilets were disgusting. They were all blocked with a mixture of urine and toilet paper.

I then went upstairs and told my friend it was empty downstairs so we got our stuff and moved downstairs which was a big mistake as the Men's toilets door was constantly open and you could smell the odours throughout the downstairs seating area.

We ordered our food and realised it was taking ages. About 45 minutes later I asked the waitress where our food was and she said it was taking long because we ordered salmon and they cook it fresh.

Our food came out eventually about 1 hour later although we almost finished our platter and the waiter brought out another ground beef dish which they apparently forgot to put on the platter.

The food was very good so I can't fault that. But the other factors I mentioned made it an unpleasant experience.
I won't be going back in a hurry

Oh boy, talk about a hidden gem! After an extremely long day, we stumbled upon Al-Kahf looking for a last-minute meal late at night. Even in the late hours, the place was packed with people—which is always a good sign.
Despite the crowd, the service was good. There was a bit of a wait for a table, but I promise you it is worth it. The food was really good, fresh, and exactly what we needed. If you’re in London and need a spot that delivers on flavor even late at night, this is it.

Delicious food. We ordered the meat feast for two. Could’ve fed four easily. Beef was delicious and possibly had some liver. I do not like liver, but loved this. So tender and flavoursome. Chicken was delicious, fall apart tender, and smoky. Vegetables added some balance to the richness. Lamb shank was insane. The thing disintegrated. Couldn’t believe it. Rice was delicious. Loved the raisins and cabbage. Everything had this lovely subtle smokiness to it. Green sauce was excellent.

Service was quick and friendly. It was busy when we came but we got our food in around five minutes!!! Nice spot. Homely vibes. Worth the hype.

Too much food for one meal, so we asked for some containers and took some home. 10/10

I visited Al-Kahaf Restaurant yesterday for dinner. While the food was delicious and enjoyable, but the overall service experience was disappointing.

We ordered a platter for five people, with some drinks and it took around 40 minutes to receive our food. The wait time itself wasn’t an issue, but the service after that was problematic. Even after the food arrived, we had to wait an additional 10 minutes to get plates, despite informing the staff about it when placing the order. On top of that, it took another 10 minutes to receive the sauce, and only after repeatedly asking for it. The staff seemed uninterested and not attentive to customer needs.

The food quality is great, but the customer service needs significant improvement to match it.

name: La Tagliata Italian Kitchen
address: 11 Sandy's Row Spitalfields Liverpool, street, Middlesex St, London E1 7HW, UK

reviews.text:
We came here for a work dinner and ended up having a genuinely lovely evening. We started with a dry meat and cheese board and a burrata that was fresh and creamy. For the mains, we tried a few different dishes: the rigatoni with saffron, the linguine with crab, and the highlight of the night—the traditional Sardinian fregola with seafood. That one really stood out. We shared a mixed grill for the secondo and finished with a classic tiramisu.

As good as the food was, the atmosphere is what really makes the place special. The room feels cosy and warm, with an understated elegance that makes you want to settle in. We loved the paintings, the furniture, and the shelves full of books—it gives the restaurant a personality rather than just a décor theme. Even the table setup felt thoughtful and refined.

The prices are slightly higher than your average restaurant, but it genuinely feels justified. The quality of the food, the wine selection, the presentation, and the overall atmosphere make it worth it.

A place you’d happily return to for a relaxed but refined evening.

After trying several Italian restaurants near Liverpool Street, La Tagliata stands out. Charming and intimate rooms. The food feels genuinely authentic, not just modern Italian branding. The beef fillet tagliata was cooked perfectly; and the slow-cooked ragu had a real depth of flavour.
What makes areal difference is the atmosphere. Calm, elegant and professional. You can actually enjoy your conversation without noise or chaos or feeling rushed. A proper Italian dining experience in the city. Not the cheapest option around but definitely one of the best. Bravo team!

Came here quite late on a rainy day. Staff were very friendly and patient with our wet jackets, service was great, food fantastic and environment very peaceful. We had a pasta each, they were of high quality. Would definitely revisit in the future!

Delicious restaurant! The pumpkin ravioli with Gorgonzola were amazing, full of flavour. The lamb was tender and cooked to perfection. Tiramisu the best! The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, the staff were friendly, and there was a nice selection of wines. I really recommend this place!

You can really taste the authenticity here. The linguine alla bottarga were delicious and the sardinian touches on the menu make it feel special. High-quality ingredients, fresh pasta and proper Italian cooking. One of the best Italian restaurants in the Liverpool/Spitalfields area

name: Desi Lounge - Indian Restaurant Tower Hamlets - Events space hire East London
address: 464 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E2 0EA, UK

reviews.text:
We started with the poppadoms, which came with three delicious sauces and freshly sliced onions – 10/10, full of flavour and the perfect way to begin the meal. For our mains, we ordered the Tawa for 3, which was excellent. The lamb chops were tender, the meats were packed with flavour, and the portion was generous. The passion fruit mojito was refreshing and paired perfectly with the food.

Service was fantastic. We were greeted by the owner, Zakariya, who was very friendly and attentive, making sure we were well looked after. The whole venue was spotless, including the toilets, and the décor gave the restaurant a modern and welcoming feel.

Overall, it was a brilliant experience. This time I went with friends, but I’ll definitely be returning with my family. The food, service, and atmosphere were all top-notch, and it’s great that they accept both card and cash payments. Highly recommended!

Had a wonderful Iftar at Desi Lounge today. The food was absolutely amazing and the Iftari selection was full of flavour and beautifully prepared. Everything we tried was delicious and it really had that authentic Bangladeshi, homely taste that reminds you of proper traditional South Asian cooking.

We were a large group, and despite that, everything was perfectly organised. The food was served right on time for Iftar with no delays, and the service was smooth, prompt and very well managed.

The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, making it a perfect place to break your fast with friends and family during Ramadan.

Desi Lounge is truly a hidden gem in the heart of Bethnal Green, East London and definitely a must-try spot if you enjoy authentic Bangladeshi food with that real homely flavour.

They also have great space for hosting events, with both upstairs and downstairs areas available, making it a great venue for private parties, special occasions, or even small wedding events. They even facilitate a dedicated area for prayer, where guests can comfortably pray in congregation, which is very thoughtful especially during Ramadan.

Highly recommended!

I recently hosted my Nephews Nasta party at Desi Lounge. The food was amazing spices cooked to perfection by acclaimed chef Hamidur Rahman we especially loved the bengali chicken roast which got everyone talking about. Muhit and Shaju were serving and were so attentive and willing to help they continued to ask if we needed anything which everyone appreciated. We were so impressed by Desi Lounge and staff I would highly recommend Desi Lounge for any event either big or small with a 300 person capacity they can cater for most of your special occasions with a fantastic decor. We will be definitely booking again for our next Event.
Many Thanks to everyone at Desi Lounge

Exceptional Food and Service – Recommended 🤙
We have held two family gatherings at Deshi Lounge in the space of just a few weeks, and both experiences were absolutely flawless.
It is rare to find a place that can consistently deliver high-quality food and service for large groups, but Deshi Lounge nails it every time. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, making it the perfect spot for family celebrations.

We went there as a large group, and the food was excellent. We pre-ordered everything, and the mixed starters were flavorful with generous portions. They also offer a £23 set meal, which we chose—it included lamb korai, chicken jalfrezi, dhal,two types of rice, dessert, and drinks. It was definitely worth it for a big group.

The staff were very friendly, and the place was spotless throughout. The toilets were clean and up to a good standard, and the décor was modern and stylish. I’d highly recommend this place—it’s worth a visit. The only drawback was parking, but we managed by using the side roads.

name: Bengal Tiger London- Indian Restaurant, Old Street, Shoreditch.

reviews.text:
11/10, amazing service & easily the best egg fried rice I’ve ever had! I’m still thinking about it!!

I walk past this restaurant every day and decided to stop by tonight for dinner — wow! I ordered the butter chicken, garlic naan, tandoori chicken, and egg fried rice. Every dish came out piping hot and tasted amazing. This was a GREAT meal!

Service from Shaz & the team was fantastic. Very attentive and kind, and made some great food recommendations. I will 100% be back!

Came here for my birthday. Food was very good very authentic and flavourful. Portions are decent and decor is nice. This is more of a place for friends or colleagues after work rather than a family. Families can go but I felt other customers were loud and using bad language after a long day at work. They should have a kids meal but I don’t think this is a kid’s environment. Would recommend, good food good location for adults.

Fresh, tasty Indian food with great service. Also great value for London

If you prefer post show food to pre, I greatly recommend coming here after a show at the Barbican. It’s so hard to find anywhere in London to sit down and eat after show time.

We were so grateful to find the Bengal open and be welcomed so warmly despite the late hour

We saw great reviews of the place and decided to try it out after days of Scottish food.  The drinks were tasty, had excellent presentation, and were filled to the rim.  Evey dish, from the garlic naan, special fried rice, Green Tikka, Saag Paneer, Butter Chicken, Vegetable Samosa to Chicken Biryani, was savory, hot, and absolutely delicious.  The staff was very friendly and courteous.  Overall, we are happy to have eaten here on our first night in London.

An amazing Indian restaurant. We visited with a group of friends on a Sunday lunchtime and it was quiet, but can imagine it gets extremely busy.

The food was so very, very tasty, not greasy or oily as sometimes can be the case. Staff were helpful, respectful and happy to answer questions.

Definitely recommended!

name: Arepa & Co Venezuelan Restaurant - Haggerston
address: 58A De Beauvoir Cres, London N1 5TZ, UK

reviews.text:
Went here for a late lunch and really enjoyed it.
The food was very tasty - we got buñuelos, tequeños and then some of the bowls to share and everything was really good.
Not to mention the tres leches cake, which was delicious.

The service was very friendly and the guy who served us made the experience even better.

Also, the location is very pleasant with the view on the canal.

Highly recommended if you are looking for something different to try.

As we were walkin by the canal, we run into yhis gem. Venezuela's arepas at its very best. We have the Pabellon del campo arepas and Toston Avocado. Absolutely delicious. Coffee quality second to none. Great service. If you want a treat go for it

Delicious little event as well in lunch spot. had the arepa and caca and the two top flavors and the caca definitely easier to handle. you don't have to use your hands and very balanced and has a crisp and also good flavors and the arena is more meaty but both are excellent. would recommend and affordable

The authentic food experience from Venezuela. My kids love the black beens and I enjoyed the diversity in flavours.
Good service
Good music

Yum. Good food, great service. Thanks!

Breakfast reina was spectacular. You certainly won’t leave hungry, I was so full. A bit pricey but you are so full so it’s worth it.

Made a reservation here for the first time and we could not have chosen better.  Staff were very welcoming and attentive.  Very clean and tidy restaurant.  The lamb chop starter was devine.  Fresh made poppadoms were still warm.   The mains were just as good all washed down with Kingfisher and Cobra.  Would I recommend - in a heartbeat.  Would I return... certainly will do.  Thank you guys!

The food was absolutely amazing
Service was spot on and the only reason thermosphere was 4/5 was it was quiet.
I had lamb shank for main while my wife had fish curry - lamb shank in a Bangladeshi restaurant - wow, so tender it fell off the bone!!
All food recommended by the waiter and all in all good value for money and we both left happy and contented. 😀
Note for the price we had popadoms, starters, mains with rice, nann bread and a couple of cobras each 😉

Frequently ranked as Central London’s  best Indian restaurant. It offers a tasting-menu experience, very polished, with creative interpretations of Indian flavours. If you want Indian elevated to an art form, this is it. Elegant, slightly more subtle & sophisticated flavour profile. Credentials goes to Arif, Ash , Cam D  & Muhib for their hospitality.

And also a very spacious venue for Asian weddings and corporate parties .

The food was absolutely delicious! Service was also quick & personal. Really recommend for an Indian in the city.

We had the Korma & also the passanda - 10/10.

Very humble service by Mr Ash.  Good food and drink suggestion handles the customising request very accurately .

Must try Egg buna curry. Thanks to chef for perfect level of spice
Naan is  very soft and well cooked.
Puri is also good to try.. crispy would have been best.
Can avoid ordering pani puri and other chat items tastes just fine .. quatity could be better even for the platter items in the starters.
They take extra cover charge of 12.5£
Ambiance is nice.

name: Soju Korean Restaurant
address: Soju, 282 Cambridge Heath Rd, London E2 9DA, UK

reviews.text: Awesome food, lovely staff, fast service and terrific atmosphere. Place is clean, service is top class. Highly recommended.

Stumbled across this place whilst searching for Korean restaurants for my daughters birthday. We came here lovely small restaurant everyone of the staff were very friendly and this made us feel very welcome. The food portion sizes were very good. My favourite thing that we had were the amazing honey garlic sticky wings. The crunch, size, taste amazing. This was my first time and not my last thank you team for amazing service.

Website states it is open on Sunday. It is not. Wasted 15 minute walk from Bethnal Green. Three of the other tables in flat earth pizza next door were people who had meant to go to soju. Well done guys.

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
Fantastic Korean Food & Great Vibes!
Soju Korean Restaurant offers delicious, authentic dishes with bold flavors and generous portions. The staff are friendly, the atmosphere is warm, and the Korean BBQ and soju selection are top-notch. Highly recommend for anyone craving quality Korean cuisine!
Unsure if permanently closed or just has the incorrect hours for a Monday on Google. Walked here at 8:30pm and it had the shutters down even though Google hours stated it was open

We went to Behind for a special occasion, and honestly, it delivered exactly what I hoped it would, and then some. It’s Michelin starred, but it doesn’t feel stiff or intimidating, which I really appreciated.

The fish focused tasting menu was genuinely spectacular. Every course felt thoughtful and confident, clean flavours, beautifully cooked, nothing trying too hard to show off. You can tell this is a kitchen that knows exactly what it’s doing. It’s absolutely worthy of its star, no question. Credit where it’s due to Chef Andy Beynon, the cooking here feels calm, assured, and very intentional.

I really liked the open kitchen setup. There’s a nice energy in the room, you can see the team working, but it never feels chaotic or distracting. It actually adds to the experience and makes the whole place feel more alive.

We did the wine pairing and I’m glad we did. The selections were spot on, and the sommelier explained each wine in a way that was clear and engaging without being pretentious or overbearing. It flowed naturally with the meal and elevated the whole experience.

Overall, this is a great spot for a date or an anniversary. Refined but relaxed, special without being stuffy. One of those meals you leave feeling quietly impressed rather than overwhelmed, and that, to me, is exactly what a great restaurant should do.

This place is a complete gem. Delicious, creative, and inspiring menu (loved the “prawn toast”, but every dish was incredible! Exquisite service (every dish is presented by one of the very knowledgeable chefs). It’s super friendly and feels classy but relaxed. The wine pairings were perfect and the ambience is great. Thoroughly recommended if you love seafood and great food! Looking forward to seeing their ongoing success and achievements. A new fave!

The most incredible experience at Behind!!!
Our favourite meal out we’ve ever had!
All the food was delicious, such depth of flavours and beautiful presentation.
The atmosphere was calm yet still lots to see with the chefs cooking away/interacting with all the diners. We felt very welcome!
I would recommend this restaurant over and over again ☺️

We had an unforgettable evening at Behind restaurant. Chef Andy and his incredible team delivered a truly exceptional experience. Every dish was a piece of art with a very unique taste. the unique one-table, open kitchen concept was great too.

Came here for solo birthday lunch and it exceeded my high expectations ✨ The food, service and atmosphere were all great. Each dish is served and explained by the chefs and prepared in front of you. The wine paring perfectly complimented each dish. 10/10 would recommend to anyone who loves fish/seafood

Beautiful meal in an excellent restaurant. The food comes in very generous portions, and is exquisitely cooked to the highest standards. Service is second to none, the friendly and attentive staff look after patrons very well. Warm and well-lit restaurant, toilets are clean and fresh, attention to customers is superb. The food is pricey, but you get every penny's worth in quality, quantity, and service. Best Chinese restaurant in London!

The lunch menu here offers decent meals at an affordable price. I had the duck noodle soup and was very satisfied with the taste and quantity. It’s a good place for a quick meal at a restaurant that isn’t overly busy.

I'm really glad I stumbled upon this place by chance! I tried one dish, and it was absolutely delicious and very affordable. It’s a full-service restaurant, with great options for a good price, my dish was less than 10 pounds (8.50 on the menu). Compared to other places, like self-service spots or chain restaurants where prices can be around 11-12 pounds, this place offers a really good value. The restaurant itself isn’t anything fancy, but it’s clean, and the bathroom was well-maintained.  The service was simple and friendly. Highly recommended!

Had lunch here today with my friend. We enjoyed the fact we could speak to each other without shouting. Tables were nicely spaced out, the whole place was clear, bright and airy.

Usually at Chinese restaurants they pounce on you and ask for your drinks order before you can sit down. They hurry you up and come across a little rude. But at this restaurant all the staff were pleasant, friendly and allowed us to take our time.

The food was good, the portions were generous and very reasonably priced. We had a lovely lunch at this pleasant restaurant and will make sure we return the next time we're in the area.

This restaurant is really amazing. The ambience is homely, the food is superb and the service is so warm and attentive. The waitress fang is also very friendly and goes above an beyond to delivery outstanding customer service. This is my go two place for after work and recommend everyone try.

I’ve had breakfast at Cafe Cecilia at least 4 times and now lunch twice. It is undoubtedly one of the best restaurants in London. I will never stop singing the praises of the waiting staff and chefs. A MUST visit for anyone looking for an unforgettable meal.

Nice ambience in local Havk du hangout with greta proximity to the canal and Broadway market.

All dishes of nice quality, perhaps a little bit steeply priced, but service is really friendly and welcoming.

A great neighbourhood restaurant to return to.

- Value for money? Somewhat
- Worth a detour? No
- Best for (occasion)? A local night out
- Would I go back? Yes

One of the best food we had in London. That mackerel was something different (I thought I hate mackerel before trying at yours), that cabbage.. everytng was amazing. Worth every minute of the delay we had in Central Line. Also thank you to the reception team who were very kind and helpful to send the menu to us via e-mail so that we don’t miss the kitchen. Thank you! Can’t wait to come again!!!

Experience the best of BT cotton in Kahror Pacca! Local farmers' hard work and genetic engineering have revolutionized cotton production. Visit to see high-quality cotton and impressive yields! 🌟"

Since you asked for 300 words, I assume you'd like me to elaborate. Here's a longer version:

"Kahror Pacca is a hub for BT cotton production, thanks to the tireless efforts of local farmers and advancements in genetic engineering. The region's cotton is renowned for its exceptional quality and impressive yields. If you're interested in witnessing the impact of innovative farming practices, Kahror Pacca is a must-visit destination. The BT cotton fields are a testament to the power of technology and hard work, making it a fascinating experience for anyone interested in agriculture.

Pretty good food. Went for breakfast which I don't think is where they shine. Would love to return for lunch or dinner! Food was simple, toast was definitely well fired. Would've loved to see some more traditional Irish food than toast, porridge, or kippers. Nice enough though. Highly recommend reserving a table but it's more reliable to phone than book online.

We started eating here regularly from when my 15 year old and his best mate were in nursery school round the corner, and I'd take them for 'brown toast and chips' every Monday. Never looked back. Everywhere else we eat we wait to see if 'The Premises Standard' has been met! Good food, good price, nice atmosphere and exemplary staff. Long live the Premises.

Stumbled upon this cozy restaurant. Big menu with a big list of a bunch of yummy things. The service and staff were amazing and extremely knowledgeable about allergies as we also had a celiac in our group. The sourdough was gorgeous and the ambience such a vibe! Also try the grapefruit juice!
