One of the best cafe in london. We are coming here for 15 years and never been disappointed. Ozy is the best and deserved a pay rise. One love.  French family

What a wonderful place totally enchanting the memorabilia on the wall and the warm welcome by the front of house lady. This place has everything you could need for a breakfast lunch or dinner. The food was outstanding. Will definitely be back.

What a lovely little gem of a café! The food was absolutely amazing — every dish felt homemade with love and full of flavour. You can tell that real care goes into everything that comes out of the kitchen.

The coffee was equally fantastic — rich, smooth, and perfectly balanced, easily one of the best I’ve had in a long time.

But what made the visit truly special was the hostess. She was so warm, welcoming, and genuinely kind — the sort of person who makes you feel instantly at home. Her hospitality turned our meal into such a heartwarming experience.

A beautiful place with a beautiful soul behind it. We absolutely loved our visit and can’t wait to come back! ❤️

name: The Brush East London Grand Café
address: 84-86 Great Eastern St, London EC2A 3JL, UK

reviews.text: Had a birthday dinner here and the food was amazing. Had a bit of a mishap with the menu choice on the reservation but the staff sorted out everything perfectly. Was pleased with the ambience in the restaurant. I found the restaurant through Google and was taking a gamble and it paid off nicely. Definitely going to come again especially for the steak

Not my first visit, and it wont be certainly the last one! I am a big fan of Burrata at this restaurant, and my second option always tends to be the Brush Burger, but Joanna showed me all the new options on the menu, and suggested me to try the Club Sandwich, and it really meets everything that I expected on a delicious dinner evening with friends, but the attention to detail and the fact that it was suggested according to my past visits shows the service of excellence! The hardwork of this team goes above and beyond, a BIG thank you!

We had a wonderful experience at The Brush East London. The food was delicious and the atmosphere was great, but what really made our visit special was the exceptional service from Giuseppe.

Giuseppe was incredibly knowledgeable and helped guide us through the menu with great recommendations. Thanks to him, we enjoyed two chicken salads with anchovies, an excellent avocado toast, a delicious tiramisu for dessert, and a fantastic wine that he personally suggested. He even offered me the chance to taste the wine before ordering it, which I really appreciated.

Everything we ate was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully prepared. Giuseppe’s attention, kindness, and professionalism truly elevated the whole experience.

We had been looking forward to visiting this beautiful restaurant for some time, and visiting on a whim for Sunday lunch was the best decision we made today!

The service, ambience, coffee and especially the food were all superb.  Our roast beef rpast was without question the best in this part of London, possibly the best I've had that I can remember in the city.

Every element is cooked and seasoned to perfection, the gravy was knockout, the veg was firm but cooked through, beef lip-smacking, and the potatoes were out of this world! So flavourful with either goose fat or butter, just sumptuous.

Oh, and unlike so many other restaurants when serving beef, their knives were EXACTLY what you should be given to get through your grub with ease.

We shall be returning!

I had a great brunch experience in the Brush last weekend. The food was delicious & really good portion sizes. I’ve ordered from the 2-course brunch menu and the waitress allowed me to switch to a mocktail without issues. The ribs with macaroni were super tender and the basque cheesecake was on point.
It was simply perfect. Order anything in the menu and you will taste delicious food. It’s been 5 years since last time I came here and glad glad glad they maintain good service and food.

I would literally eat here everyday if I could.
Friendly and accommodating staff, dog friendly which is always a huge bonus, really nice atmosphere and good vibes. The food is bloody incredible, I literally have dreams about the courgette flower, the tortilla was great, and generally a really good selection of veggie options, which is actually a pleasant surprise for a tapas place! It’s a little pricey but worth it in my opinion!

came here because i was craving a spanish (croquettes) and randomly found this place, i was pleasantly surprised! the food was super yummy and service was great! food came very promptly and the waiters were very attentive. would definitely recommend coming here.

My third time here!
As Spanish person who is always   looking for nice Spanish food I found this place last year and always came back for arroz negro! Everything I have had is very tasty .
Thank you very much all the time for the service and tasty food , specially to Efe who took care of us. Great way of spending last day of the year. See you in 2026!!!

The staff at El Ganso was so kind and accommodating for my birthday dinner. We were 11 total and had the tasting menu, which was such a great option for us. Because of different dietary needs, they were able to swap out some of options for the folks at our table. The food was tasty, and the portions were generous! We were able to get refills on any of the tapas we wanted.
my first time . Oh my me . incredible Every bite and taste just got better. Def returning, Ill try evening menu next time . This burger goes into No.1 spot

Very good meaty Sunday feast in Hoxton! We had the Mixed Grill Feast* (£30 per person). Serving a huge plate of grilled beef sirloin, lamb leg and pork loin chops - comes with sides of Greek salad, Hummus, Roasted Beetroot Labneh, toasted bread and chips.

The cuts of meat were decent, portion size was huge (especially for the grilled feast). The bread was very good! Service was good. Great taste, decently priced and very worth it. Would definitely come back for the grill feast, and would highly recommend!

*Unlimited Brunch Feast until 6PM (Saturday and Sunday)

Impromptu pop in for a Sunday evening meal, and we immensely enjoyed our shared our palatable prawn savoury starter,  my magnificent medium steak with skin on chips, delectable carrots and my wife's delicious fall off the bone duck on a luscious lentil base.
More food than I could handle so I got to takeaway to enjoy 2moro. It had more flavour than any other restaurant on Hoxton street.

It is all duty to drop in and enjoy the engaging conversation, serene service and delectable infusions of this 20 plus years Hoxton favourite.

We went as a group of 5 on a Saturday afternoon that lasted until the evening. Nobody left hungry or disappointed!

The food is generous, unfussy & tasty, the service is gentle & unhurried, and it’s a lovely place to catch up with friends.

We all loved it & I wish this was my local!

What an absolute delight of a meal! Our visit to Hoxton for the Mixed Grill Feast at £30 per person was an incredible experience. The substantial platter boasted grilled beef sirloin, lamb leg, and pork loin chops, accompanied by Greek salad, Hummus, Roasted Beetroot Labneh, toasted bread, and baked potatoes, evoking a sense of home.

The experience was truly worth it. I'm keen on returning for the grill feast and would enthusiastically recommend it. The staff's warmth and friendliness added to the enjoyment. And remember, don't overlook the Unlimited Brunch Feast available until 6 PM on Saturdays and Sundays!

It's been the most wonderful place we have encountered so far in London. The food is delicious, the service is impeccable, and coffee and juices are very yummy! We loved everything about this place!
We've tried shakshuka and full English breakfast - all excellent. Recommend!
This place was such a nice surprise! The halloumi wrap is amazing and I like the coffee. The staff are super-nice and welcoming. Not very busy, which is perfect for a cold & wet Saturday morning.

Delicious brekkies, coffees and cakes. Everything was cooked to perfection - the mushroom wasn’t too soggy, bread was crispy, tomato skins peeled off nicely, eggs were right side of runny, sausages were crispy. The chocolate beetroot avocado cake was moist and more-ish. Staff were friendly and very efficient. Will definitely come back again!
Cosy little brunch spot offering delicious breakfast and wide range of hot drinks (yummy matcha latte) & other sandwiches. Extremely nice staff, kind and attentive.
Absolutely love this place! I went there two days in a roll. The food is delicious and the service is good too. Highly recommended!

I met up with a few friends on a Saturday evening and we ended up spending most of the day around Towa Hamlets East, London.

Janna Cafe is tucked away quite discreetly literally just a few doors down from the East London Mosque so if you blink, you might miss it. That said, once you know where it is, it’s a convenient little spot.

When we arrived, it wasn’t particularly busy, which was a pleasant surprise for a Saturday night. There was no real waiting time, and the menu was already on the table, making ordering quick and straightforward (always appreciated when hunger is creeping in).

We ordered the lentil soup, hummus topped with lamb, and a large platter to share, along with bottled water and a mango drink from the fridge.

A quick note on the mango drink, It was very thick consistently so throughout the bottle.

While it was still enjoyable, I personally felt a fizzy drink might have been a better choice. Consider this a friendly heads-up rather than a complaint.

The lentil soup, however, was the clear star of the evening. It was rich, comforting, and unanimously enjoyed by all of us. Arguably more than the main course itself. Definitely a must-have.

The main platter consisted of rice, lamb shank, and a piece of chicken on the side. Portion sizes were extremely generous, so arriving hungry is highly recommended.

Despite our best efforts, we couldn’t finish it—proof that Janna Café does not believe in small servings.

Overall, the food was good, the atmosphere relaxed, and the portions impressively hearty. I would happily visit again, if only for another bowl of that lentil soup (and perhaps a fizzy drink next time).

Janna Cafe
Round the corner from East London Mosque, we walked into Janna Cafe mid-Taraweeh time (8 rak’ah gang… just kidding, zero rak’ah 😅). Squad of six and ready to eat.

We were greeted warmly by our Somali brother and quickly set our sights on the platter. The original plan was the full spread: lamb shanks, quarter chicken, and beef suqaar on a bed of rice. Unfortunately, the beef had sold out at iftar, and the salmon was gone too. After a little friendly negotiation, the brother kindly offered us an extra lamb shank instead — a nice gesture that we appreciated.

Food arrived after about 15–20 minutes. I had also ordered the lamb soup, which came slightly after the platter. It was warming and lightly spiced with a deep, lamb-forward flavour — though there were no actual pieces of lamb in it. I’m guessing that’s just how it’s served.
The platter looked great — just like the social media photos. Presentation-wise, no complaints. They also added sombusa, likely to make up for the missing beef, which again was a thoughtful touch.

Now onto the taste.

The meats were tender and soft, especially the lamb shank, but overall everything leaned slightly under-seasoned for my liking. That seemed to be the general theme of the platter. The sombusa were decent, though they tasted like they had been reheated in the microwave as the pastry was a bit soggy. The filling could have done with a little more seasoning too.

The bisbas (green sauce) was spot on — fresh and properly spicy. The red sauce, however, didn’t have much flavour.

One downside was the temperature. The food arrived lukewarm, and unfortunately our cutlery didn’t come until about 10 minutes later, which meant the platter got even colder (the metal tray doesn’t help with heat retention). Serving the cutlery and sauces before the main food would definitely improve the experience.

We considered ordering extra protein, but at £9 for a quarter chicken (essentially a leg), it felt a bit steep.
That said, when the bill came to around £13.50 each after splitting between six, it worked out to be great value for the portion size — and portions are generous.

Service was a little slow, but considering it was Ramadan and they’d likely been fasting and working all day, it’s understandable. One small awkward moment was when a friend asked for a takeaway container for a small amount of leftovers — the staff member didn’t seem too pleased because the container was large. We would’ve happily paid for it if that was the concern, but it did feel slightly unnecessary.

Overall, it was a pleasant experience with generous portions and good value. With hotter food, slightly stronger seasoning, and smoother service flow, this place could easily step up a level.

Insha’Allah next time it’ll be a 10/10.
For now: 3.5/5

It's a West African casual dining place in Whitechapel. The entrance is located a few meters away from the back of the East London Mosque. We popped in after going to the cinema (Curzon) nearby. We opted for the meat platter for 2 as it was recommended. The food was amazing, especially the lamb, which was juicy and tender at the same time. our platter also had beef cubes on it which was also good but i preferred the lamb. The dish itself is not spicy at all so it has mild flavours, cooked with peppers, onions and their one herb blend but not spicy. The spice, if you want some, comes from the 2 side sauces the medium heat red one (slightly peppery and maybe has come cayenne in there) and the green sauce which is the real spicy one (i assume green chillies or similar) and the good news is you can use both sauces as much or as little as you like. For me it added depth to the dish. I also enjoyed the Guava juice. The dish is very big so we hardly finished 1/3 between the 2 of us, and ended up taking home the rest. Good food, nice spot for a quick and tasty halal meat lunch or dinner.

Somali Food is one of my favorite cuisines and I've been wanting to try out @_jannacafe for ages.

Finally made the trip down and it didn't disappoint.

For starters you can't miss the Somali fries. Didn't know what to expect but they were hella tasty.

For the mains the platter did exactly what we wanted - meat heaven with spicy bisbas and flavourful rice.

As for dessert, oreo milk cake was meh but you gotta try their date cake - oh so good!

That's another solid Somali spot option added 💯

I’ve never had cuisine from this area of the world and omg best first time I think I could have. The sauces are so good and flavorful. l wanted to try allll the cake options! visit if you’re in the neighborhood or at the Wombats Hostel. Was much needed after traveling all day to get to the hostel

A really great place to play chess on Tuesday evenings in a fun social environment! It does get very busy so you need to arrive early or bide your time to get a table. The atmosphere is really fun and everyone is super friendly, it’s quite casual and there are a variety of levels of players from beginners to experts.

Eclectic place, it’s a cafe / restaurant in the day and a bar at night, I like modern retro industrial style, food is good, rapid service and friendly staff. Good location in the heart of brick lane market area.

Delicious breakfast with an amazing vibe. Staff were friendly and food came out really quick! We came early on a Sunday.
Only hiccup was that the coffee and tea were a bit watery.
fun chill spot. they have great coffee and fun events at night throughout the week like chess night and “bring your own vinyl” night

Perfect spot for everything! Great food, amazing decorations and lovely staff. Loved the vibe and the variety they offer, being a café in the daytime and a bar at nighttime, even bringing dj's in! Super place and 100% recommend it!

The Pho was absolutely amazing!! 😍🍜

I brought a friend to Song Que Cafe as he was preparing for a trip to Vietnam and wanted a taste of the cuisine beforehand, and this spot definitely delivered.

We ordered a great spread: the pho with combo beef (rare steak, flank, tendon, tripe) was easily the highlight, deep, rich broth with beautifully balanced flavours that felt authentic and comforting. The banh xeo (crispy pancake with prawns and chicken) was golden, light, and packed with flavour, pairing well with the fresh herbs and dipping sauce. We also had the mì xao bo (beef stir-fried noodles), which were well-seasoned and satisfying, and the gà nướng (lemongrass chicken), which was juicy, aromatic, and perfectly cooked.

The vibe inside was busy but relaxed, and the service was fast and friendly. Food arrived quickly, and the staff were attentive throughout.

The only slightly awkward part was at the entrance, each time we entered, we were asked where we were going. Not sure if it was for security or just routine, but it felt a bit overbearing, especially when I had to pop out briefly to move the car and was questioned again right after needing to attend a phonecall.

Still, the food speaks for itself. If you're after bold, classic Vietnamese flavours in London, Song Que remains one of the best spots.

Went there early on a Saturday just as they opened and the place filled up quickly. Certainly is a popular place based on its deserved reputation for good quality Vietnamese fare. Portions are generous and food is quite possibly the best of its kind in London. A must-have is the beef pho with all the different cuts (even the tripe). My partner had the spicy bun noodles and it was perfectly spicy and a little sour (just as it should be). Our waiter was friendly and efficient. Chap who initially showed us in wasn’t so…

The food is very good and we didn’t have to wait long. In my personal taste, the Stewed Caramelised Fish was a little salty but everything else was delicious. The iced coffee was also good. The staff were friendly and service was excellent. It’s a place I will definitely come back. I had a great Vietnamese meal today.

This Bun Thit Nuong is such a refreshing bowl of delicate noodles and perfectly grilled pork. The chargrilled pork is very tasty,  tender and savoury… I can say delicious and delicious in every mouthful…I love pickled vegetables and their nuoc cham. Service is super friendly and helpful. This is probably the best Vietnamese on Kingsland..

The service is good. We were sat on the same table as these two ladies who were very loud though which made it hard to enjoy our experience here. Waiters were super nice and food didn’t take too long. Had the pho with chicken and beef - it was lacking in flavour, chicken and meat had no taste also quite dry … even with the addition of sriracha it just felt like a bowl of hot water with noodles; as opposed to a flavourful warm broth . Tried the spring rolls which were crunchy and very tasty, ordered more but the second batch was oilier than expected. Everything on the menu does look tasty, would probably not get the pho again though. Pho - £16
Spring rolls - £8

The Spanish tapas were excellent and everything we ordered was full of flavour. We started with the cheese and charcuterie board, which had a great selection of cured meats and cheeses. The burrata was fresh and delicious, and the beef with pumpkin mousse was a standout dish – beautifully balanced and very tasty. The ox cheeks were also fantastic, tender and rich. Overall, everything we tried was really good. A great spot if you enjoy high-quality tapas. Plus dog friendly

What a birthday treat! We visited La Farola for my husband’s birthday lunch, and it was spectacular. Don’t let the "small plates" tag fool you, we left absolutely rolling out the door!
The Padron peppers were a generous, salty delight to start, and those Jamon croquettes? I could eat them all day, every week. You'll definitely be craving more. For the mains, the ox cheek and the bavette with chimichurri were cooked to perfection, and the octopus with chips was a total highlight. Honestly, even the potatoes were "whammy"; there wasn't a single item we didn't love.
Also, don't sleep on the mocktails! The elderflower mocktail was my personal favourite. 10/10 experience, I need to go back... immediately! :)  Service was super friendly, and Chiara was a superstar!

Went with my girlfriend and her family for lunch. The atmosphere was very cozy and nice. Good for lunch with gf parents. The restaurant serves mainly tapas and has very good drinks and wine.

We shared some tapas that were absolutely excellent, I highly recommend the tortilla with chorizo, the anchovies, the burrata, the octopus, and the oxtail.

I’ve lived one year in Madrid and I can confirm that this food feels like authentic Spanish tapas!

Really enjoyed the cauliflower, ox cheek and prawns. Bacalao was rather salty though but they very nicely waived the charge for this. Other than the bacalao, rate this as one of the better tapas restaurants I’ve been to.

Came with my family for lunch. Very cute decorations and the dishes were perfect. The elder bloom cocktail was good. Very cozy way to spend an afternoon. Very conducive to good conversation and satisfying meal. I lived in Spain and this was good tapas really. We got ox tail, octopus, anchovies, gambas and burrata and beet salad. The tortilla with chorizo was really good.

It is rare in London to have a place where music is not blasting at you while you try to hold a conversation over a dinner. This is a rare place where you can enjoy a meal with friends without shouting at each other. Even on a Friday evening, it was pretty calm. It is even more surprising considering the prominent location right next to the market. The venue is a mix of a restaurant and pub sections. The food is really good (we tested the whole range), in a classic British pub manner. The service was great as well, friendly, helpful. And the interior is super stylish a well. Great experience.

We chose this restaurant for our annual old friends’ Christmas dinner - which is now in its 20th year! Last year we had been disappointed by our dinner in a local pub, so we were delighted to have such a marvellous experience at the Market Coffee House and Bar. It was an awesome Christmas dinner - plentiful helpings of roast potatoes, sprouts and roast veggies to accompany delicious turkey / beef. The generous deserts, cheese boards and wine were all perfect. The atmosphere was festive and the staff were very friendly and helpful. It was such a lovely afternoon / evening that we want to book again next year. Thank you for making our annual dinner so special!

Tucked just around the corner from the hustle of Liverpool Street, The Coffee Market House & Bar is a real hidden gem. The vibe is super cozy – think rustic charm with a warm, welcoming feel that makes you want to linger a little longer.
The staff are friendly and on the ball, and the food? Delicious, fresh, and surprisingly well-priced for central London. Whether you’re grabbing a quick bite, chilling with a coffee, or catching up over brunch, it’s got you covered.
Perfect for when you need a breather from the chaos – a little pocket of calm in the city that never stops.

We had an absolutely gorgeous meal tonight.  The staff were friendly & efficient and the food was superb - we had the catch of the day (plaice) and the mushroom cassoulet.  We shared the sticky toffee pudding which was amazing - and more than enough for two.  We will definitely go back the next time we are in London.

Asks the delightful question, what if a coffee shop was also a cozy pub, or vice versa?

Come in a Saturday to hear Paul on the piano. Buy a pack of cards for a few quid; play at a small, dark wooden table under candlelight. A welcome respite from rain, bustle, bleak skies – the sundry caprices of winter in London.

name: Le Café du Marché
address: 22 Charterhouse Square, Barbican, London EC1M 6DX, UK

reviews.text:
Food was excellent! We had pork escalopes and smoked fish for the main course - absolutely delicious.
The atmosphere in the restaurant was overall so cosy: candlelight, live music, and a very welcoming vibe.

Wow! We hired the private upstairs room for our wedding dinner and we're so glad we did. It was beautiful, well organised, and the food was insane! The staff had always been really communicative with us, always helpful and we felt very relaxed with them. We had 40 guests, which was a perfect size. Very glad we chose this place for our wedding. Would highly recommend.

The atmosphere of this restaurant was incredible and a real gem. There is entertainment each evening with piano and cello or some variation. it has an intimate and very special ambience.  The food is what I would expect from a high end French cuisine. The friut tart was delicieux.  The presentation of the food was very elegant.  Would highly recommend although it was a bit pricey at 130 pounds for a two course meal with one wine each. If you’re looking for something special it was worth it.

The atmosphere is ideal for a date night, with candlelight, live piano, and cosy spaces that make the large restaurant feel intimate. Service is excellent, and the food is outstanding. An excellent choice for couples or small groups..

This place is my all time favourite restaurant in London.
You cant beat it! The atmosphere is perfect, with a pianist playing whist you eat at candlelit tables. Such great value, and the staff are amazing.
Oh, the wine list and cheese board are unreal also!

name: Hometown Cafe
address: 57 Mile End Rd, Bethnal Green, London E1 4TT, UK

reviews.text:
My wife wanted to go there after watching so many tiktok videos. So i took her there. Dont know where to start. The place is dirty needs  a big clean.

It dont cost anything to say hello or how are you or even when leaving thank you would be nice. Didn't get a single word from the staff. Who was a little kid mind you.

The food looks amazing just beautiful but man it was pure tasteless. The smash patty inside Brioche loaf was bad, no taste. My wife had few bites thats it. As you see on every review the  mac & cheese was dry as Sahara desert, and am not exgeration and you will read on every review. The wings was dipped in sweet chilli sauce.

When we got there there was 8/10 people inside eating but they were all 15 year kids so again soon as you can imagine the atmosphere.

Its not the shop fault for tasteless food ,I blame all the stupid lying bloggers and I fluencers. Who gets paid for lying.

Would I go back there again, definitely would not. Would I recommend it to anyone, absolutely not.

They know we are deaf and they welcomed us so warmly. Very nice and kind people. Foods are bang! Great food and very tasty! The portion sizes are generous and everything was well-cooked. Service was friendly and quick. Atmosphere could be improved a bit to make it feel more welcoming, but overall a solid place to eat.

Hometown Cafe never misses tbh. I’ve been a few times now and each visit has been great. I’ve tried a range of their boxes and have tried chopped cheese, chopped chicken, loaded fries (easily my fave - the portion is massive), and the mac and cheese, which hits the right balance. The rice box has a nice Somali kick that sets it apart. Wings are flavoursome and it’s not too much it’s just right. Their mango lassi is refreshing, and the milk cakes are just the right level of sweet. The staff are always friendly, welcoming, and keep things professional, which makes customers return. The menu has loads to choose from it’s giving diversity, and I’ll be back for the Philly steak for next time. Not even exaggerating yall - run there.

After the reviews had to give it a try and was NOT disappointed at all! Food was ready in 5-6min after ordering, full of flavour and good portion sizes. 10/10 will defo be going back and prices are very reasonable too

So I did my full review on my TikTok: @st3phnation
If you want to check it out and I can say this food is absolutely delicious, I got the munch box which had a phillysteak style sandwich which was my favourite part of my meal, seasoned fries, bbq style like juicy wings and also seasoned mac and cheese. The food came swiftly on time and good service here .
Also I had a fruit punch drink that was nice as well. I would definitely recommend this food place :)

They accommodated us on a Saturday night at 9:30pm. The place is small so we were lucky to get a spot without reservation.
The food was delicious and presented nicely, portion were enough.
The service of Tunu and his team was outstanding, super friendly and helpful in recommendations or answering our questions.
My only comment was the noise. It was impossible to talk due to a large group very noisy, this impacted the experience a bit as the place is small.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Excellent Dining Experience at Cafe Tiffin

Cafe Tiffin truly delivers an outstanding Indian dining experience. The food was beautifully presented and packed with rich, authentic flavors. The mixed grill was perfectly cooked—juicy, smoky, and well-seasoned—while the curries were creamy, aromatic, and deeply satisfying. The naan was fresh, soft, and ideal for scooping up every last bit of sauce.

Wonderful restaurant with great flavors and a passionate owner. We went with his recommendation of the chef’s special, a chicken roast he said he typically eats with family or friends around the holidays, along with the samosa chaat, lamb biryani, the roti, and the poppadoms. All very tasty with great ingredients, will be back!
Amazing food, elegantly made. The rogan lamb and the massala tea were spectacular! Really friendly and professional service.

Very disappointing experience despite all the good reviews we found this restaurant very poor we had :

Popadoms which were very fresh and a reasonable pickle tray

Meat platter which was ok although the lamb was very poor chewy and unappetising and overall a very small portion

Vegetable platter which was ok ish but the samosa was your standard frozen fayre again a tiny portion size

Chicken Kahri which was the special and despite being on the bone was very dry and not particularly flavoursome

Chilli garlic chicken this was very nice a huge portion of real chicken not processed pieces great flavour

Garlic naan which was at best average to be honest

All in all not a great experience so a ratings triumph but the reality was somewhat different, the staff were very attentive without being intrusive and the dining room is nicely decorated.

It was an okay experience here but I can't say it was good. No problem with the staff or customer service they were all lovely but the food wasn't it. Croquettes tasted really dry and it only made it nearly good with the sauce next to the croquette, however the chicken was really nice. Just dont think the blue cheese dressing was a good fit for the chicken.

I was recommended this spot by a friend and I've just had a wonderful lunch here. The burger is DELICIOUS and I couldn't recommend it enough. They offered me some hot sauce with my meal which I later found out was home made by the owner!  It was amazing! What a touch! Really lovely staff, quick service and very nice vibe. (p.s. they sell the hot sauce in house...I bought two bottles)

I had a coffee on the patio and the staff we had was not very friendly at all. It felt like he was annoyed that we were asking for service. He was inpatient with us when we took a second to respond to what we wanted. He got us to pay right when he brought us the drinks which was totally fine. We asked to each get our own bills and he was visibly annoyed to do so. I got my bill and the total was written and there was a line that added an OPTIONAL service charge. The menu had stated that the tip was discretionary. Given the level of service I decided to give a 10% tip , which I still think is generous given the service I received, instead of the 20% it suggested on the bill given the attitude we got from the waiter. I gave him the money. Then the server came back and forced me to pay the full discretionary tip which I thought was soooo unprofessional and rude. When it said it was optional to pay that amount! I would never return here or recommend anyone to do the same. I also say him sternly telling other people off for moving the patio chairs to be in the sun. The whole situation just put me off. There are plenty of other places around and I would suggest going to any  other cute cafe.

A staple of the community. Market Cafe is one of those places that truly gets everything right. The service is consistently top tier — warm, attentive and genuinely welcoming.

I’m always a little hesitant now that we’re travelling with our four-month-old baba into social settings. Not all London restaurants are accommodating when it comes to little ones, but these guys get it right every single time. The demographic of the cafe is a testament to that.

People meeting parents. People on dates. People with babies. Girls’ lunches that have started with their first Prosecco. It’s all here at Market Cafe. They cater to the community in a way that feels genuinely unique — and uniquely Hackney.

The menu is varied, the quality of the food is outstanding, and the price point is incredibly reasonable for the area. And if you’re into a boozy brunch, their cocktails are delicious.

The atmosphere is relaxed and inviting, making it a true neighbourhood favourite and a key part of Broadway Market and London Fields. Couldn’t recommend it more.

Horrible attitude from staff, this place is everything wrong with what Hackney has become. No sense of community, respect or kindness. So many better places in the area, spend your ££ at other (cheaper) venues w better vibes, better food & no 20% service charge for horrible service lol
Nice and clean . good Customer service 10/10, coffee and panini test is very good . 100% come back again . recommend

If you haven't tried this place, you must! Their rainbow cake is the best cake around! I visit Brick Lane a couple of times a year, and every day I have to come in and grab a slice!

I arrived today and of course took a slice back to the hotel. I've now just been back for 2 more slices and will be back tomorrow before I leave.

The cake not only looks pretty, but it tastes amazing. Soft and moist cake with delicious sweet buttercream. Plus each slice is literally the same size as my hand.

My only wish is that they did a loyalty card where you get a stamp for each purchase!

The lovely ladies behind the counter are so friendly and welcoming.

♡
Nice place and tasty dessert. Customer service was 10/10. Recommended.
Cake Was delicious. They got variety of desserts. Definitely recommended for some good desserts

My sister and I visited for an English breakfast. Initially we thought let’s give a small business some support even though we could’ve gone Grounded. We came away shell shocked at how bad the food was for £12.50 per person and a missing item from the menu too. The woman who served us was lovely so it’s not her fault that the place doesn’t even have any ketchup to serve with a classic English brekky. She really tried her best with what she had. So this is no reflection on her customer service. But to wait for undercooked food and eggs fried on an old pan isn’t acceptable at that price too. I didn’t want to write a bad review but I just hope this is taken as feedback to improve their menu and quality of food served too.

I wish I took a picture of the food but I was so hungry I just about managed to swallow some of it and then we just silently left the rest because we were so shocked and couldn’t stomach the rest.

To improve their food I think they need to visit other cafes and see how and what they’re serving for the same price. For now and the near future we will have to stay away.

Got to have dinner here tonight with a friend.
The food is nice, nothing to write home about, but honestly not bad.
However… the staff was very blasé and uninterested. After waiting for a “while” (much longer than any other restaurant I’ve been to, and I’ve had my large share of dining out), we had to keep calling someone to come and take our orders. After we ordered, tap water came to the table and the waitress giving us the water spilled quite a bit on my leg, didn’t even apologise. It’s not particularly warm anymore (ha), but I didn’t appreciate it either way. After we ate, we kept looking for, again, anyone who’d come to give us the bill and, again, it was a long wait. I don’t know if the staff was eager to just finish work (two young girls) and leave, but it didn’t feel professional.

I have been coming to Hanoi Cafe for years - whenever I am in the area, I choose this place every time!  I love the family and woman who runs the restaurant, she is wonderful! The food is great and the staff are lovely and accommodating.  I feel welcome every time - thank you for all the wonderful food you make and for the warm atmosphere you welcome your customers with, it's like eating at home :)

Do not eat here. It was absolutely terrible and overpriced. First, they didn’t bring me what I ordered, and when the food finally arrived, it was awful. I only had a couple of bites, yet when we got home, we ended up with food poisoning
soooo tasty!! i got the tofu bun bowl and they did not skimp on the tofu (rare). the veg dumplings were also tasty and the pho got good reviews also. would return to try some bahn mi!!

Banging salad, I always rate a place where staff are nice to walkins before you even order and how good simple dishes are - and on both counts this place gets top marks for me. I was in a mad rush to eat something Light quickly - they made several good suggestions. I settled on the spicy beef salad and it was absolutely delicious so fresh & just the right amount of spice really good size, good amount of beef. Very chill music playing in the background some nice incense burning, I’m definitely going back their menu looks amazing.and they allow dogs 🐶 xx

name: Dulce Coffee
address: 86 Whitechapel High St, London E1 7QX, UK

reviews.text:
We went to Dulce and the experience was excellent from start to finish. The food is very generous and absolutely delicious.
The service was impeccable. The waitress was lovely, very attentive and professional. She came to check on us during the meal and also after we finished, to make sure everything was okay and to see if we needed anything. That level of care really makes a difference.
The place is spacious, with plenty of seating downstairs, and they also have a separate room, which is very convenient.
Everything was perfect, and we had a great time. Highly recommended!

A colleague and I stopped here for breakfast on a weekday. We both had the City Breakfast with a cup of coffee and tea respectively. The food was great, and so was the service. There were a good few groups of people seated in the restaurant and people were coming and going with take-aways. I would certainly come back again when in the area.

The food was amazing, one of the best shakshukas I've ever had. The pancakes were fluffy and delicious, the cream on the side pairs very well with it.
Staff was also very nice and the food came out super quick!

Pancakes were that ones that you buy from the supermarket, not cooked ones by the cafe. The same with beans. Price is absolutely a rip off for what you get , the only thing that was cooked were scrambled eggs and they were mediocre. For tea it was just a half of the cup with hot water and tea bag had the cheapest taste. Would not recommend at all.

What a lovely place. Super friendly and an amazing vegan breakfast. They’ve been here over 20 years - locals popping in to say hello, tourists and business people. All enjoying the food and good vibes.

Highly recommended 🙂

name: Polo Bar - 24 Hour Great British Cafe

reviews.text:
Visited on Sunday, 08th February 2026, at 1630. First time visit and very quiet at this time. We were meeting another family member coming in from Essex, whilst we came from West London, so the cafe was convenient as well as offering a fun birthday experience on a Sunday in this part of town, which is pretty quiet and closed off normally. Small cafe spread over 3 floors. We were directed to the ground-floor seating area, but the seating on the two upper floors is nicer.

Good menu focusing on British staples and being open 24 hours a day, there were only a few items not available at all times. Quick service and the food was excellent, finished off by a very good value and fun birthday quadruple pancake & red velvet cake combo, which was presented with a round of Happy Birthday from the staff too.

£100 for 4 of us inc automatically added service charge of 10%, as it should be, rather than the higher percentage added by other establishments recently. I would happily return if in the area, though I probably wouldn't bother booking.

What a great place! Located just opposite Liverpool street station, I was greeted by several different members of the staff. Escorted to my table to be seated. Then I noticed just how cool the interior decorating was! 10/10 for the designer!!
My waitress was lovely! I ordered a Bacon sandwich and a tea. The sandwich was awesome and they surprised me with a pot of tea so I managed to get 2 cups of tea out of the pot😁All for under £8 in  central London!! Excellent value.
When venturing upstairs to the WC I realized this isn’t a small place ( as it appears) It’s like a Tardis! 3 floors of seating I did not expect. Don’t waste your money on the station meal deals. Go and try this place. You won’t regret it 😁

Food was good and gf/df options available upon request. Service with a smile from our server, didnt get her name, but very pleasant. Price on par with area. The letdown in this place was the toilets, it was done in an old Victorian type way which would have been good but underneath the hand dryer is filthy, really dirty so it really detracted from the open pipe work and butler sinks

This was our very first british breakfast right after my girlfriend and I arrived in London. The place is typical and cozy, with a calm and welcoming atmosphere.
I had the traditional English breakfast, while my girlfriend chose pancakes and coffee. The food was very good and the portions were generous.
The owner was kind, friendly, and made us feel completely at ease.
Absolutely recommended, we will definitely come back next time we’re in London!

We ordered a full English breakfast and pancakes with fruit. This English breakfast was exactly what I was looking for, the pancakes were also nice but not really warm. We were expecting them to be warm, maybe with all the cream and other toppings they already cool down before being served?

A very good restaurant and my go to place for weekend breakfast. Everything is fresh, which really shows in the taste and quality. It’s run by Bangali uncles and that adds a lot of character and warmth to the place. They also serve Bangladeshi breakfast, done properly and authentically. I really like their cha. Highly recommended!!

I stopped by this shop to grab something quick to break my fast, and I was really touched by the kindness of the person there. Not only did they serve me delicious food, but they also added a few extra items — some sana, shingara, a bottle of water, and even a hot beverage! Such a thoughtful gesture that truly made my day. The food was tasty, but the generosity and warmth of the staff made the experience even better. Highly recommend this place!

I’m a regular customer at Café Lime. They serve authentic Bangladeshi and Italian food with very friendly service. The menu offers a wide variety of items. I often come here for their special Karak Chai and Deshi snacks. Highly recommended if you want to try delicious Deshi food!

An Indian/British cafe.

I'd recommend going for the deshi nasta (an Indian dish) for something very tasty and different to the full English, which they also sell (it was ok). I wouldn't recommend the tea if you are after the usual English tea as this it is much sweeter here.
Today my husband brought 2 vapa pitha but both of them were extremely rotten!!! This is really saddening and disappointing!!!! I want my money back !!!!

We had breakfast here on the first day of our London trip and absolutely loved it! Naturally, we had to come back a few days later. I highly recommend the Eggs Benedict, Çılbır, and the Turkish breakfast—they were all delicious. The staff were incredibly kind. Thank you for everything! 🌸💕

The food was so good! The staff are so lovely ! There were some halal options, you just need to ask the staff. We had the Mediterranean breakfast and the morning turkey breakfast. Love that you have options of sweet and savoury breakfast! And it comes with a good variety. We just walked around and found this cute little place close to Islington for lunch. The food is also decently price - cheap for a central London brunch spot and it actually tastes good and fills you up. Found our new fav little hideaway cafe ! They have the cutest decor around!

Absolutely amazing! The breakfast was outstanding – every little detail was carefully thought out. The quality, flavor, and presentation were simply perfect, and the prices are unbeatable.
I’ve traveled a lot around the world, but I’ve never had such a delicious and lovingly prepared breakfast for this kind of price.
A special shout-out to the waitress, who was incredibly kind, attentive, and genuinely sweet – especially with children. She treats them with such warmth and even gives them a lovely little surprise that makes the experience even more special.
I can highly recommend this place – it’s the perfect way to start your day!

This place  honestly saved our mornings while we were in London. Great breakfast spot with lots of options. The food is really tasty, the staff are super nice, and the place is clean and welcoming. Would definitely recommend.

The food looks out of the world, but the best part is tastes even better. The staff is very warm and courteous. Loved the vibe! Def going to visit again and recommend it to my friends! Keep up the good work! ✌️

name: Astro Cafe & Brunch
address: 383 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E2 0AN, UK

reviews.text: Came here with my family of 5. We were warmly greeted at the door by Elif (who I believe is the owner), seated immediately at a perfectly-sized table, and given just the right amount of time to get settled & review the menu before ordering our drinks and food. The coffee was divine and delivered to us so fast. Our food was fresh, hot, delicious, and BEAUTIFULLY presented. Elif was the most hospitable hostess - kind, friendly, funny, helpful, and a hospitality professional of the highest caliber. The space was clean, cozy, well-lit, and modern. Elif’s brother, Erkan, is her business partner and the amazing chef behind the food. We watched them both warmly interact with each customer, treated everyone like family. At the very end of our experience, Elif provided us with a bag of complimentary pastries just to say thank you! 😩🥹♥️🙏🏼 Overall, I cannot recommend this place enough. PLEASE make your way here and enjoy yourself! You will not regret it.

I was just walking by and saw this place, so I decided to step in with no real plan — maybe just grab a quick coffee

Then a very kind and friendly lady welcomed me (I wish I remembered her name!). We talked for a moment, and she suggested their American breakfast. Funny thing is, earlier this morning I had already been thinking about having an American breakfast… I just didn’t know it would be here

So I thought, why not?

And honestly, it turned out to be the best American breakfast I’ve ever had in my life. Everything was fresh, delicious, and the atmosphere was great. The service made the whole experience even better

Definitely a place worth stopping by. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Lovely spot, the breakfasts are excellent, hearty and tasty, there’s something for everyone. They kindly allowed me to swap eggs for avocado 🙏Great coffee too. Cosy and welcoming and happy attentive service. The owner clearly loves what she does and should be rightfully proud. Also the kitchen and loos were spotless!

Very, very, very good breakfast. Very friendly, family run Restaurant. Everything was freshly prepared, kitchen is in full view and you can see that the staff is really engaged. Everything is super clean and prepared with lots of love. The salad which accompanied the eggs Benedikt was also excellent. Crisp, clean and with a very tasty dressing. Overall, a very good experience we will recommend and definitely come again. Thank you.

Elif and her brother own and operate a clean and quaint cafe that offers an experience as warm and filling as the meal! It was an absolute pleasure getting to know the family business. We’d be regulars if we were local!

Quite an underwhelming meal — the pumpkin soup lacked flavour and it was the spice overshadowed the natural subtle, sweet taste of the pumpkin itself.
The Bolognese was so sweet that it was weird. The service and atmosphere was okay, but the meal wasn’t great .

One of the worst meals I had in a very long time at a Hackney price. A carrot chicken soup that was extremely oily flavor less topped with some 1 week old (the minimun) croutons that almost broke my tooth (literally). Impossible to chew. Asked for a long black they brought me a white americano. Brunch finishes at 1 for some reason even though they are serving bacon and eggs and then you are forced to a lunch restaurant type menu. Such a cool location in such a special spot i would rip the whole frizzante apart and make a new cafe there and serve some decent food and coffees. Prices not cheap either. Underwhelming. Felt I had to share. Sorry x

My son and I visited the farm and then stopped over for lunch after an afternoon in the rain.One couldn't imagine this obscure spot in the heart of London. For lunch we had pumpkin soup and for pudding, caramalised apple cake. The business is family run and the staff are friendly, attentive and helped with a phone charger when my battery was running out. It was busy but not so much as to put you off. The restaurant has plenty of character - walls are adorned with used pans as decor, and evocative art. The music complemented the calm atmosphere. We also bought the bread, which one of the members of the staff told us was a family recipe which was  passed down for generations.
The food is decent and it’s next to the Hackney City Farm. They are kids and pets friendly too.
Lovely place next to the Hackney City Farm. Very friendly staff and delicious italian food. I have really enjoyed mushroom and truffle risotto.

We had our post civil ceremony meal here and we couldn’t have been more happier with the choice we made. From start to finish, the service provided was incredible. Booking was so easy despite us being a large group and the team even prepared a customised menu that worked with our dietary requirements, which made it perfect. Everyone enjoyed. Great cosy atmosphere, good vibes and service and lastly.. amazing food!! I recommend this place if you’re having your ceremony at islington town hall!

Truly very pleasant experience.
The food was delish, freshly made, crispy pizza crust, salad was delish.
Arancini - loaded with cheese. Mushroom very very good!
Dessert  definitely worth trying.
Seevice very attentive and warm..
Overall very good experience,  wojld come back again.

We have come here for a group get together before Christmas every year for at least 5 years and have always had an amazing time, food is fab and staff are so friendly and helpful. Only comment for improvement is the lasagna and associated pot pasta meals are a bit too hot to eat. Really good place to visit for a super dinner!

Lovely Italian restaurant with great service and decent tasting food. Only critique with food on the night was the steak, which didn't come with any type of sauce and had to ask for peppercorn sauce to be made which took about 15mins to arrive and steak was cold by then. Staff should ask if sauce is needed as a minimum cause it literally is just steak and chips. Other than that the entertainment on the night was great, they had a live band playing some old classics. Their Xmas menu was a decent price for what u get, with a nice selection to choose from, of course there is a supplement added for the steak.  Overall would recommend this place for some good food, service and entertainment.

La Divina in Islington is a true family-run gem, known for its warm hospitality and inviting atmosphere.
Step inside and you’ll feel instantly transported from London’s cold streets to a cozy Italian village 🇮🇹✨
Both the hot and cold appetisers stand out, full of flavour and beautifully done, and the pasta dishes are especially memorable — comforting, well-balanced, and clearly made with care.
A perfect spot for relaxed evenings, shared plates, and unhurried conversations.

name: Chef Restaurant
address: 273 Kingsland Rd, Whitmore Estate, London E2 8AS, UK

reviews.text:
Excellent Turkish cuisine, don’t let the understated looking exterior put you off.

The food is delicious and generous in portion. I had the mixed grill. All of it was cooked to perfection (not overcooked) and delicious.

Great value relative to portion size. Service was fast & efficient.

We had Mediterranean breakfast and it was very delicious. Highly recommend.
I then have their homemade baklava (mum made the night before) was absolute delight.
Would love to go there again when around.

This has been the second time I went to the Chef Restaurant.

My TLDR rating is: Really tasty kebab, great salad and amazing bread with fair prices and a friendly atmosphere.

Now to get a bit more in depth:

I ordered the kebab plate (large) for 12£ as well as the Sucuk from the hot starters menu for 6£.

What you get with what is marked on the pictures.

The Meat on the Kebab plate is awesome. Perfectly seasoned, crispy but not dry at all. The salad is fresh, the blue cabbage was really crunchy and fresh. Everything on the salad plate was lightly seasoned. With the kebab plate I was asked what kind of sauces I want. I can definitely recommend the homemade garlic sauce! Only nitpick with the kebab plate is, that the fries were not or only really lightly salted. Not a big deal as I just grabbed a salt shaker and salted them myself to my liking. I’d say the value for the kebab plate is great. Definitely not holding back on the meat which I really appreciate.

Regarding the Sucuk, you get really nice grilled Sucuk with the star of the show here being the homemade flatbread they have. Which is the most tasty thing. Although the value is not half as good as the kebab plate, the bread you get with the Sucuk is definitely is worth it!

All in all I’d recommend and also would come again!

I thought this place was a cafe but they had a whole selection of Mediterranean meals and all tastes so good. They were very accommodating. The meals a very good portion and reasonable price. It’s a hidden gem. However, the bathroom could do more cleaning and some heating on. Nevertheless I would definitely go again.

Went for dinner on my friend's recommendation, so glad we came here, we ordered the chicken wings, the best I've had in London, it also comes with salad and meze, all were delicious. I also had the baklava and rice pudding with Turkish tea, they were so fresh and delicious. On top of that price is reasonable and the staff are so welcoming. I would definitely recommend this hidden gem and as a neighbour I will be coming here regularly.

Such a lovely spot at Shoreditch! ☕✨ I really enjoyed my time here. The coffee was delicious and perfectly made, and the breakfast was fresh, tasty, and very satisfying. You can tell they really care about quality.
I also loved the concept and overall vibe of the place — it feels cozy and thoughtfully designed. Even the menu design is super stylish and adds to the whole experience.
Definitely a place I’d come back to and highly recommend!

I came to this place with a friend at around lunchtime on a Saturday. The place is not big, rather cosy, and most tables were occupied during the time we were there, but not crazy crowded. My friend had a savoury breakfast and I had sweet pancakes with fruit and ice-cream. It's not super fancy food, but everything looked great with decent portions. I really enjoyed my pancakes and would definitely go back to have them again. They were soft and almost crispy outside, and the combination with the fruit, ice cream and syrup made it very tasty. We also had a coffee and it was a great coffee for my taste, on the sweet side rather than bitter or acidic. We paid around 20 pound each, which is pretty good for London and we liked everything. I would recommend and go back to this place.

My favourite breakfast spot in Shoreditch. The main dishes also looked great, but since I went in the morning, I had the chance to try their breakfast — absolutely worth it.

If you’re ever around Old Street, I’d definitely recommend stopping by. I enjoyed a lovely breakfast while soaking in the warm atmosphere inside and the view outside. I had the halloumi, avocado and roasted vegetables on sourdough, and it was absolutely delicious, highly recommend.

I also really liked the overall vibe of the café and the background music — it all added to the experience. The staff were attentive and the service was excellent, thank you! I’ll definitely be back.

Me and my bestie entered this restaurant randomly because the outside Menu had a lot of different options of food .
It was a pleasant surprise. The food came by so quickly and it was soooo delicious
10/10 one of my favourite cafe now
Thank you guys for the hospitality and wonderful, all the best !

We had arrived early for an event nearby so stopped by for a coffee. Wow, great service, great atmosphere, great coffee at very reasonable price, including Turkish coffee which was perfect intense hit I needed. Cappuccino artistic as by the name of the cafe. Great tableware too. Food looked incredible, was sorry we didn't get to try it.

name: Savoy Cafe & Kitchen
address: 11 Great Eastern St, London EC2A 3EJ, UK

reviews.text:
An absolutely outstanding experience from start to finish. Every detail reflected care, craft, and genuine hospitality. The food quality was exceptional—beautifully presented, thoughtfully balanced, and so satisfying that we truly enjoyed every last bite.

The drinks alone set the tone: vibrant berry smoothies, fresh-squeezed orange juice, and a delightful selection of teas that felt both comforting and refined. Each sip was as intentional as the plates themselves.

What truly elevates this place, though, is the atmosphere. It carries a charming local soul while welcoming a worldly mix of travelers, creating a warm, relaxed energy that feels rare in a busy city. It’s the kind of spot that offers refuge from the streets of London—a place to slow down, reset, and genuinely enjoy the moment.

Outstanding service, exceptional food, and a welcoming, authentic vibe. This is not just a meal—it’s an experience worth seeking out and returning to.

Savoy Cafe & Kitchen is such a fantastic place! I absolutely loved the creative idea of serving breakfast with a dessert placed right in the middle of the plate. It’s such a unique and delightful touch that makes the whole experience feel special. The food was outstanding, beautifully presented, and full of flavor. The coffee was exceptional as well: rich, smooth, and perfectly made. I also really appreciate that all the meat served is halal, which makes it even more welcoming. Overall, an amazing experience with great food and wonderful attention to detail. I can’t wait to come back!
Lovely little place for breakfast! I had the blue dragon smoothie and shakshuka and both were delightful! Love the staff, friendly folks too!
This breakfast was amazing! Enjoyed every bite of it. Super fresh and tasty! Unfortunately we don’t live in London, otherwise it would be our favorite early morning spot.
Cute spot with gorgeous pastries and great coffee. Got a fry up and was probably the best presentation I’ve seen. A lot of detail in the food preparation too. Highly recommend!

We made a booking for a group of 12 of us. Despite our group size the restaurant accommodated us very comfortably and the service was excellent. Our food and drinks arrived in a timely manner. The meals were great and no complaints at all. Some of our group have already rebooked to go again in the new year. Will certainly go again.

We went to Gallipoli as a group of six on Christmas Day, and it was such a lovely experience from start to finish. The staff were incredibly welcoming, friendly, and genuinely sweet, they made us feel at home straight away.

We ordered İskender, Ali Nazik, köfte, lamb shish, and a selection of mezes. Everything was absolutely delicious, and the quality of the meat really stood out – perfectly cooked, flavourful, and clearly very fresh. Every dish we tried was spot on.

What made the experience even more special was the thoughtful Christmas touch: they gave us a Christmas gift and a card, which was such a kind and unexpected gesture.

Amazing food, wonderful service, and a truly warm atmosphere. We all left very happy and will definitely be coming back. Highly recommended!

My second time at Gallipoli, for a table of 3 we ordered the Chicken and Lamb Guvec which is served with rice. Both were really good, I especially liked the lamb. The third main was the Beyti Kebap, which is pieces of kofta in a wrap served with lots of yogurt, it was very rich so for sides we had both a Mixed salad and the Potato Salad.

It's a large and very busy restaurant  which is great for large groups and often noisy at peak times.

There's a buzzing atmosphere and the walls are walls filled with posters of Turkish movie stars.

Came on a late August afternoon, weather was great and it was really nice to eat out in the open air. The food was amazing, well worth the price and the portion sizes were perfect too. The lady who served our table was lovely! Very good access, not far from the tube and across the road from the bus. Would definitely recommend!

Gallipoli deserves a 5.0 review. They accommodated us so well when we had our baby shower and our little one’s 1st birthday party as well. They are super baby friendly and all the staffs are amazing! We will definitely come more! Also the food is super delicious! I love all their mezes and kebabs. Highly recommend to everyone who wants authentic experience of Turkish food and culture in London.

I visited Baristas Lounge in Whitechapel for lunch and had their Chicken & Avocado Salad along with a Mango Mojito, paid £14.90. The food was fresh, colourful, and genuinely delicious — the crispy chicken paired perfectly with the creamy avocado.

The café has a vibey, cosy atmosphere, and the staff were friendly and helpful, which made the experience even better. It’s a great spot to sit, relax, and enjoy a good meal. They serve halal food.

Prices are a little on the expensive side, but the quality of the food and the ambience make it worth it.

Definitely worth a visit if you're around Whitechapel!

The food itself was great! I ordered the Madam French Toast and loved that it came with egg and bacon. The price was very reasonable compared to other brunch places in the area :) I’ve been here three times now and would definitely come back!

We stayed at the Hyatt Place next door, and frequented Baristas Lounge during our visit. We were always greeted promptly and warmly. The coffee was the best we had while in London, and the food was excellent and always came out quickly! You can tell these guys really care about taking care of people and providing a good experience! We will definitely go back the next time we are in London!

First time coming to this shop and I had a great experience. Tariq provided exceptional service and was very friendly throughout. He had great knowledge and recommended some of the best drinks, which were spot on. I’d definitely recommend the iced matcha latte (with oat milk and vanilla syrup) and the cookies and cream milkshake. Made my first visit a great one, I’ll be back!

This little cafe has a great atmosphere with good music. They were really accommodating to gluten free. The first morning I had a classic English then turkey bacon and egg sandwich the second morning.

name: Cafe Leads
address: 1A E Mount St, London E1 1BA, UK

reviews.text:
Really good value for the money. We stop here before take our train to Heathrow airport, just next Whitechapel station.
My chicken was lovely, with salad and chips, my husband jacket potatoes. A tea and a coffee for £20.
The service is good as the  waitress is superb and friendly. Fresh food cook in the moment!

Pleasantly surprised by the quality and price of a Full English clsoe to central London and next to a busy train station and hospital.

I was the first person in the morning to order and they were polite, fast and friendly.

The breakfast itself was hot, fresh and exactly what you'd expect, although I'll say the bacon is European style rather than British.

Approximately 8 quid for a jacket potato with 'salad', was basically tasteless lettuce soggy in water. I think i ran into a tiny sliced cucumber and a shredded tomato piece somewhere. And 10 quid for a pretentious veggie breakfast with brown avocado. You're having a bubble mate...

P.s this was delivered to me for dinner to hospital as an inpatient 😖😭

£10 for a generous full English breakfast is a bargain anywhere in London. Good portions , great location and very friendly staff / atmosphere. Would certainly reccomend if you are around and looking for breakfast.

Great service, I genuinely regret not leaving a tip.

Next time I go, I'm gonna go back for the grilled chicken, it's sensational

I stopped by this lovely cafe for a quick Sunday brunch recently. It’s a cosy space — a little small but very comfortable — and when I got there around noon, it was bustling with people (seems to be popular with the locals). Fortunately I was able to snag a table that had just opened up, as I was dining by myself that day.

I ordered the eggs benedict with bacon for my meal, and it was amazing! Bacon was juicy and crispy without being too dry or oily (and came in a healthy portion), and the eggs were perfectly cooked to a nice runny-ness. The side salad was a nice, lighter touch that complemented the heavier/creamier hollandaise sauce and bacon. Portion size was sooo large, too — I could barely finish.

I also had a hot chocolate, which was yummy. It had a nice depth to it and warmed me up, without the chocolate being too heavy or artificial/sickly sweet.

It was a nice surprise that they didn’t add the ubiquitous 12.5% service charge :)

Service was so warm and friendly, and I had a wonderful experience throughout. I’d love to come back to try their classic English breakfast (seems to be one of their specialities).

Very cosy little cafe that serves alot of different types of breakfast. I got the full English breakfast and it was delicious! The portions are generous as well and I was full for so long after. They dont add in the optional service charges so what you see in the menu price is what youll pay. This i really appreciated. There were alot of locals there as well.

I went for a weekend breakfast with my family during my stay in London after seeing their rating on Google. Their full English breakfast isn't trying to win any awards, and it's quietly average. Instead, it's a reliable, comforting and satisfying plate of food that does exactly what it sets out to do: fill you up and set you right for the day.
My personal favourite was the Mediterranean omelette, which was worth trying for its fresh and filling ingredients.
The ambiance was nicely done, though the space was very congested. Service could be better.

After seeing Nora Cafe on Google maps, I thought I'd give it a try, and i wasn't disappointed.
I had the full English and it was really yummy. A great sized portion, very tasty, and a good price too. The cafe was cosy , and the service was very good.
The toilet was lovely and clean.

Woke up hungry at 6am on a Saturday, and not in the mood for hotel breakfast again. Found Nora Cafe just 2 mins walk, only place open. Pleasant surprise! Had the Haloumi and sucuk (beef sausage). So good. Staff were super friendly too.

An outstanding brunch experience!
From the moment we arrived, the staff made us feel genuinely welcome with their warm and friendly service. The pancakes were perfectly fresh, the beef burger was bursting with flavour and the coffee was rich and smooth. The Full English Breakfast was cooked to perfection. Every detail was thoughtfully done. Highly recommended!

I was walking in the area for quite a while and wanted somewhere to chill, chat and drink hot chocolate. The staff convinced me that he makes the best hot chocolate in bethnal green and I have to admit, it was good 😊
This place has a mixture of items you can buy from hot drinks, salads and mains.
If you're in the area and want to kick back and relax then come to this wonderful place.

Great cafe-style eatery with a very chill atmosphere.
Route offers a menu with a health-centric POV, including many plant based options.
This restaurant makes for an ideal relaxed bite to eat while catching up with a friend or even to simply have a coffee and pastry.

I come here for my morning tea’s and a croissant (currently working locally). The gentleman behind the counter (I’m assuming who is the owner) is very polite and greets everyone, whether they are a regular or not. On my first visit, a homeless man came and asked if he could get something to eat. To his surprise, the gentleman gave him something to eat out of good will. I’m not saying it’s a service they provide, but it was very nice to see people like that are still around. They treat everyone with the upmost respect.

As we walked passed the cafe, the very fresh and interesting looking salads and cakes caught our eyes. We couldn’t resist buying some. We chose 5 different salads and 3 cakes. They were all so tasty.
I was particularly impressed with their beet root and avocado chocolate cake. It was surprisingly moist.

name: RASTRO CAFÉ
address: 475 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E2 9QH, UK

reviews.text: Great coffee! Friendly staff. Use estate dairy which is always a plus in my books. Makes their own pumpkin spice blend for pumpkin spice lattes. Recommend !!

I got a latte from rastro which I found to be very pleasant and the coffee was not overwhelmingly bitter which was lovely but Ethan’s slightly overpriced. The service was lovely they seemed very nice and the cafe itself is very cute on a sunny day to people watch. The cakes selection seems very intriguing I would definitely go back to try that and it’s also a convenient walk from the train station!!. Overall would definitely recommend 👍👍

A beautiful cafe next to Bethnal Green Station. Don't be fooled by its unassuming exterior because they do make excellent foccacia and sourdough. I am very picky about my coffee and always ask *and support) artisan coffee. Therefore on my visit I did ask if they serve artisan coffee and my heart sank a bit, when they asked me what that meant. Nevertheless, I gave in to my craving and thought I'd risk it as long as they didn't say it was some kind of Italian chain brand.
And I must say, I did not regret it!! The coffee was excellent.
The cafe was clean and tastefully decorated and a clear favourite of coffee lovers.
The staff are friendly and go the extra mile to make customers happy! I had left my bag and totally forgotten about it, when the barista came running up behind me down the street to hand over my bag!
Coffee is good. Sandwiches disappointing for price. Used to be better with focaccia now only ciabatta.

THEY DID NOT MAKE FRESH ESPRESSO FOR OUR COFFEE! Pleasant couple of lads that run it, there was nothing wrong with the service. We ordered two ice lattes. Expected to hear the sounds of their expensive La Marzoco machine at work but NO - they took out a refrigerated flask clearly full of PRE-BREWED espresso and poured shots of that into the milk! Iced lattes ready in 15 seconds, just like that.

As you'd expect, coffee taste was full of that oxidised, stale flavour you get from cold brews and the like. DO NOT come here expecting freshly brewed espresso. No idea why the reviews are as good as they are - or maybe they pick customers who look none the wiser and think they can shuttle out shots from these pre-made batches to forego the hassle of making fresh (like any other self-respecting coffee shop would?).

No explanation, not even a crowd of people that might have warranted the pre-make. Should've called it out as soon as I saw it but was too stunned at the time - but the taste confirms it.

Do not recommend!

I go there specially for the frog legs, they are sensational! Rest of the food is good also and there's very little waiting time. Staff is very nice.

UPDATE: Went back there to try the Soft Shell Crab. Was fantastic! Also i took a portion of Vermicelli with pork, that pork is sensational! Very diverse menu. I strongly recommend the restaurant.

Wonderful food - we went authentic Vietnamese, but there's also Chinese and Thai dishes. Pancake (pork and prawn) was incredible, as were the spring rolls - much better than average. Waiters were friendly and helpful, but spread too thin - more than 2 people would be better for Friday night

Casual and spacious Vietnamese restaurant, similar to a canteen.
Overall, the portions are generous, the menu extensive and reasonably priced. Alcohol can be brought in.
All dishes are very tasty. You will not be disappointed. Easy to visit on your own because the staff are friendly but you may want to bring a group to try out the different dishes!

Amazing Vietnamese food in London.

Our food was absolutely delicious. For a starter, two meals and two drinks we paid just over £30, which is incredible for London.

Apart from that, the food was so delicious, definitely the best Vietnamese dishes we've had in London. The service was friendly.

100% will be coming back.

Back to our favourite Vietnamese restaurant Tay Do for another super lunch and always enjoy a warm welcome from the owner and staff. Food and service are always on point as well allowing customers to bring their own drinks in too. Thank you and see you again very soon.

Such a lovely spot! The atmosphere at Ladybug’s Coffee is amazing – feels just like home. The hospitality is top-notch, and the staff are so welcoming. The space is super clean and quiet, which makes it perfect for relaxing or working. Plus, the music is always on point. Highly recommend visiting if you’re in the area! Plus, as a pet lover, it’s awesome that they’re so pet-friendly

Came around 11am and it was quiet. Gradually got more busy as we ate. Service was very quick and the lady who runs the cafe was lovely. We both ordered the House Special, on sourdough toast. Lovely runny egg, excellent mushrooms and avocado with zingy, sweet pomegranate. Lovely brunch and the sweet treats were good too. If in the area, would happily revisit.

Came to try their French toast - where is it?

This cafe has something they call ‘banana French toast’ made with banana bread.

Where is the French toast part? It’s just banana bread with typical English French toast toppings.

Don’t get me wrong, it tastes fine. Even good. Just don’t call it French toast cuz it’s not.

Such a lovely little café! The food was so delicious, the coffee perfect, and the atmosphere so cozy, it even had a bit of a Twilight vibe. The owner was incredibly kind. Highly recommend! Dankeschön! :)

A wonderful women-run gem in Hoxton! The atmosphere is warm, intimate and full of charm. You can really feel the love and care that goes into every plate and every cup. The coffee was rich and perfectly made. A beautifully run café with heart, highly recommend!

name: E Pellicci 🇮🇹
address: 332 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E2 0AG, UK

reviews.text:
Had breakfast at E Pellucis this morning and it absolutely delivered. The food was really well done – simple, classic, and properly satisfying. Everything tasted fresh and cooked just right.

The portion size is huge as well – you definitely won’t be leaving hungry. Great value for what you get.

If you’re after a proper, hearty breakfast, this place is a solid choice. Would happily go back.

Had the best time at E.Pillicci!!! Came on a trip from Canada and heard this place was not to miss!! It lived up to the hype! The staff was amazing and the atmosphere made you feel right at home!! The food was great!! Defiantly recommend getting the fresh pesto and the full English breakfast!!!

Good Italian cafe and restaurant.  Loved their pesto. Just amazing. Breakfast too is great. Please do note they take only cash. But they were very loving and allowed me to cash out from the cash machine nearby. Seats are limited and for sound sensitive people it may be a bit loud.  Nonetheless , you truly would love the communal feeling of Italy.

I was lucky enough to experience E Pellicci's famous full breakfast. It was a Monday morning so no queues. All the staff were lovely and happily chatted to myself & everyone else in the restaurant.
The food was delivered quickly,  was hot and tasty,as was the mug of tea.
I'll happily return to this legendary spot

This place made my heart warm and my stomach happy! The food was delicious. The pesto is the best I ever had in my life. We went our first day there by  luck. Every bite I had it was a dose of serotonin, pure happiness. So we had to come back for our last day, and they were remembering us, the lady that served us even gave us a piece of nutela cake. The feeling you get once you get in is like when you go to your family home. A truly amazing experience. Worth the wait. If we go to London again its gonna be the first place we'll revisit!!

Nice, warm, and cozy. The food is delicious, with great portions.

We were 4 adults and a baby and went for brunch on a Saturday. The staff were super friendly and welcoming.

I had the pleasure of enjoying an English breakfast here, and it was absolutely delicious. Not only was the food full of flavor, but it was also beautifully presented. The portions were generous and everything tasted fresh and well-prepared. On top of that, the service was outstanding — the staff was very kind, attentive, and welcoming. All in all, a wonderful experience that I would highly recommend!
Delicious food, great service and good atmosphere. We really enjoyed breakfast here. The only thing is when you sit in the middle, there is little bit less space. I recommend this place.
Fantastic and delicious food. Food portion was larger than normal. Great, atmosphere and quick service.

A cozy café tucked away in the backstreets of Liverpool Street.
The food was lovely, and the staff were incredibly kind and welcoming.
Thank you for giving us such a wonderful memory!

Super flavorful Bangladeshi food! we were asked vegetarian or meat and then we were brought a gorgeous thali of four different curries all of which were delicious! Next time I’ll make sure to get both veggie and meat. Everything was fantastic!
