If you like Bangladeshi food, this place is a must try. It’s super budget friendly and has also got lots of authentic options. I just tried some of the lentil fritters and they were 8 pcs for £1 with I felt was a good deal!

I live in Los Angeles but come to England frequently for family visits.   Cafe Grill is my go to place for Bengali Food in London after being told about it by foodie friend in 2021. The food is delicious and the kind that would be found mainly in Bengali homes. I have turned on many of my London friends and family to this gem of a place. Love all the staff who work there, they are so kind and special.

Found hair in my food, when we told the staff they weren't bothered.

Parathas were rock hard, they were the frozen ones that are reheated.

No prices either, so make sure to ask how much each dish is, they charge different prices all the time, make sure to ask the price of each dish as otherwise they'll charge you what they want.

Well what can I say, we decided to go eat at a certain restaurant on brick lane, after driving around and around for a while trying to find parking finally found it and walked the distance to the restaurant, found out it was more or less like a anything goes, just to get the customers in (alcohol flowing) so decided not to eat there. After walking the cobbles of brick lane, find out that there was only a handful of restaurants that don't sell alcohol or allow alcohol to be bought into the premises. So with the lack of choice we decided to eat here.

Ordered the following
Non veg thaali
Chicken Jalfrezi
Beef curry
Chicken Biryani
Rice
Paranta

Non veg thaali and chicken jalfrezi were alright in taste wise but the the beef curry was tasteless, lacked flavour and the beef was hard. The biryani was another disappointment, It seemed like it was atleast a day or two old as the rice was more or less stuck together in bunches and the taste wasn't there.

i’ve been coming here for the past few years as a tradition and it’s been declining ever since. The portion sizes has gotten smaller, they don’t open on time and most of the things on the menu are never available. will not be coming here again. this tradition ends here. 🫩🥀🥀🥀🥀🥀
Tried the special white cookie dough and it was a bit overpowering with the white chocolate sauce and taste, but still decent overall. A good spot if you’re craving something sweet and indulgent.

I had a very disappointing experience at Creams Whitechapel. The service was extremely slow, and several items that were supposed to be included in my desserts were missing. I ordered over five desserts, and none of them came with the ice cream that was clearly meant to be included. Staff didn’t inform us about any missing items, and despite the inconvenience and incomplete order, no discount or compensation was offered. Overall, the service, communication, and attention to detail were very poor. Definitely not the experience I expected.

Hygiene is very poor, they make your food with their bare hands and wipe their hands on the same dirty cloth.

I’m trying to call them to let them know that this has happened, since this isn’t the first time they’ve flopped so badly, they do not answer.

I spent over £60 and got the worst service.

I don’t recommend this place.

This place is awful. Avoid!!
The staff are grumpy and rude.
The seats are all destroyed, and the only good seats had the rubbish from last customer's, which was there for ages as when we left, it still wasn't cleaned.
The decor is disgusting. (Dirty mirrors, ice cream on the backs of the seating)
The toilet is terrible. They have used tape to fix the (still broken) buttons.
Overpriced.

The ice cream was average, like expected. I didn't leave happy, but at least my belly left happy.

AVOID.

I gave one star and that’s me being generous, we made an order of 6 desserts which. All of the desserts were missing the toppings listed in the menu and also the ice cream. The staff are slow and never use gloves. This is not the first time this has occurred

name: Kybelle Cafe
address: 62 Great Eastern St, London EC2A 3QR, UK

reviews.text:
So we headed here as had read good things about it. Little wait but the staff were really lovely about it which is really nice.

The coffee is delicious.

I had the eggs Benedict and I thought it was just okay…the dumpling/muffin that it was on was super dry despite all the sauce.

The flavors for the food were good but it wasn’t the best nor the worst I have had.

My friend had the croissant style breakfast and didn’t really enjoy it either.

There’s a nice vibe in here for sure and the staff are great. The toilet is great. But just wasn’t sold on the food unfortunately.

Visited this café with my girlfriend and was genuinely impressed. I ordered the Mediterranean breakfast and it was outstanding. For the price and the location, it’s honestly fantastic value. Properly good food without the pretence.

The atmosphere is what stayed with me. There’s napkin art on the wall, which sounds small but actually adds a creative, personal touch. It makes the place feel alive.

And then the playlist… easily one of the best mixes I’ve heard in a café. Classics from the 70s through the 2000s, all mood-lifting, no dead air.

The only addition to the atmosphere…. Would be to turn down the lights a light. 😊

I’m adding a picture with this review because it deserves to be seen. Great food, great coffee, and a vibe that makes you want to come back.

It was our first time in London, and the breakfast options here were so many that I wanted to try them all ☺️ We chose two different dishes, and both were amazing and super delicious 😋😋😋
The cappuccino and the peacock cake were also fantastic 🍰
Moreover, the staff were incredibly kind and friendly - especially Lidia and Maria. Thank you for your wonderful hospitality 🫶🏻
I will definitely come back the next time I’m in London 🥰

lovely cafe with a great atmosphere! food is very very good; fresh, hot and presented well. Lidia was our server working hard whilst it was very busy, she was really friendly too! would definitely return here! 🫶🏼💌

I had Egg Benedict. The eggs were great, bread was tasty. Bacons were cooked very well. Only thing I didn’t like was hollandaise sauce. It wasn’t tasty! Don’t forget that the service charge will add on your bill when you order/pay at the counter

Tay Do serves some of the most authentic and flavorful Vietnamese food around. The bun thit nuong, banh xeo, bun cha, pho and Hai Nam Chicken Rice are all top-notch. The staff are incredibly friendly and attentive, and the owner’s passion shines through in both the food and the warm, welcoming atmosphere. A true hidden gem — we’ll definitely be back!

The food is cheap and banging
1️⃣bun rieu
soup base is sour and slightly sweet, the crab meatball is even bigger than my spoon😂crazy!!!
And it is packed with flavour and super juicy
Staff are friendly and always smiling
2️⃣Summer rolls(Pork and Prawns)
Authentic and yummy
Dipping sauce - I can’t taste any peanut in it , it is like only hoisin sauce

Honestly, it tastes like something straight out of a Vietnamese home kitchen.
Definitely coming back!

We were curious about this place as it's been advertised on social media a lot, but it was a disappointment. Food looked better than it tasted. Very plain and tastless Pho, same as the traditional Vietnamese soup we ordered. Service could be a bit nicer too, not very welcoming...

a Loyal customer，but treated with clear discrimination and disrespect！

I have been coming to this restaurant regularly for a long time, easily more than ten times. To be honest, the service has never been good, but I accepted it because it is extremely close to my home and the prices are cheap. The food is average, nothing special, but convenient and affordable, so I kept coming back.

Usually the service is poor but tolerable. I have noticed clear differences in how Asian customers, Black customers, foreign white customers and local British customers are treated. There is one older gentleman who is always polite and kind, and he is honestly the only reason I still return.

However, my last visit was deeply upsetting.

There were plenty of empty tables, yet the older woman who I believe is the owner insisted I sit by the door where someone had hung their coat on the chair. I explained at least three times, but she ignored me and spoke in a very unpleasant, commanding tone. Eventually she moved us to another table without any apology.

We have supported this restaurant many times, sometimes spending up to £80 in one visit, and even recommended it to friends. I do not understand how regular customers can be treated this way.

From the moment we sat down, we were rushed constantly. During a 40 minute visit, we were asked to leave and had our plates taken away at least five times, even though we were still eating. Finally, the same woman came over and said “I need this table.” No “please”, no “sorry”, no smile, no thank you. Just rude and dismissive.

We were eating for around 30 minutes, which is completely normal. If we had stayed an unreasonable amount of time, I would understand. But being pressured and rushed like this was extremely uncomfortable, especially when the nearby table of three local white customers was being chatted with and treated warmly. As an Asian customer, this felt like clear discrimination.

I grew up in an Asian family in Dublin. My parents always taught me to treat everyone with the same respect, regardless of race, background or status. They worked their way up in professional fields such as law and accounting by being fair, honest and respectful to every client. That is how we earned our place in this society, and that is why I was able to study for a Master’s and now a PhD.

Seeing someone from the same background behave with such unfairness and bias towards others is honestly heartbreaking.

This experience was disappointing and upsetting. I will still return if the kind older gentleman is working, but if that woman is there, I will turn around and leave. I will also no longer recommend this restaurant to friends.

Respect costs nothing, but it makes all the difference.

as a local this is where we go as group and is our food spot. The food, the portion, the people, the interior just makes you feel like you’re eating home cooked food in grandparents kitchen with friends. Good for the soul. Highly recommend !

We dropped in for the first time on Christmas Eve for breakfast and this place is a must. The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming. There’s plenty of seating for large and small groups, but the space is small. The food is so fresh and the coffee was excellent. What I loved most was the personal service and you can actually have a conversation without having to shout over blaring Christmas music🎄 Loved the decor with chandeliers and mid century touches too!

I had a great time at Franze & Evans! The place is lovely and the food is excellent : fresh, tasty, and well cooked, with plenty of options for everyone. The only downside was that we waited about 30 minutes for our food (probably just a one-off) but it didn’t take away from the overall experience. I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend it!

I had a pretty mixed experience at Franze & Evans.

I came in on a quiet Wednesday morning for a full breakfast and a coffee, plus a juice, and stayed for around two hours doing some work. During that time it was very quiet. As it got closer to lunchtime it picked up a bit, which I completely understand, but there were still empty tables and no queue.

Out of respect for taking up a table, I went up to order a second coffee and a snack while waiting for my next appointment. Instead of taking the order, I was told that they needed the tables for lunch and was asked to go to the cafe across the road. That was honestly pretty surprising, especially given I was actively trying to order more and spend more money.

Earlier, I’d also seen what appeared to be the manager or owner speak quite abruptly to another table about ordering drinks when they asked for water, which set a slightly tense tone. I completely respect that it’s a business and people shouldn’t sit around without ordering, that’s fair. But in this case, I had ordered well and was trying to order again.

The food itself was genuinely great and the coffee was good too. I can see this being a solid spot for a quick breakfast or lunch, but it’s definitely not somewhere I’d recommend if you’re hoping to relax or spend a bit of time there. Clearer communication or a simple time limit policy would have made this feel much less awkward.

Lovely food, but the experience felt unnecessarily uncomfortable, especially on a weekday.
I visit this lovely cafe almost every weekend. They offer tasty brunches and staff always give a warm welcome. I love salad and homemade lemonade. The best one in London!
Ambience and service is exactly where you want it to be, class.  Friendly bubbly staff - Nicola and irresistible food - want something arty and mouthwatering - this is your place.

HOKO was delicious and a great stop. I especially loved the LTO iced tea with oat milk foam. Genuinely so good and a standout drink for me.

The food overall was very good, though some dishes do lean a bit rich, so it’s something to keep in mind depending on what you order. Service was quick and the staff were accommodating, which made it an easy and enjoyable stop.

The space itself has a lively, energetic feel and almost feels like being inside an actual food market rather than a traditional sit-down restaurant. A fun, casual spot with great drinks and solid food, especially if you’re looking for something fast but flavorful.

I can’t stop thinking about how good this place was. Pork belly was so perfectly sweet and savory, cooked to perfection and not super fatty. I got it on the bagel and it was insanely good. My partner got the pork belly on rice with the fried egg and was also perfection. We also got the chicken wings which were delicious. And last but not least the Hong Kong French toast was the most perfect thing I’ve ever put in my mouth. I can’t stop thinking about it. It was piping hot and fresh. Also the food came in less than 5 minutes. The atmosphere is very busy and fast, sorta in and out type of place not really much of a sit down place. No table service just order at the screen and get your food delivered to you in a few minutes. It’s the perfect place to get a fast bite to eat. Prices are super fair as well and you will not leave hungry that’s for sure. Wow I love this place so much! Definitely coming back.

I wasn’t blown away by the food here unfortunately, I expected more from reading the reviews. The tofu steak with rice was good but not anything special, the spring onion sweet soy sauce helped give it flavour. The Hong Kong milk tea was fine and probably the best thing I had was the HK French toast but I love French toast in general. Also have to mention that my food was just left on the side until I asked about it which meant that everything arrived colder than normal. I don’t like complaining but i feel like the service could’ve been better. Hopefully this was just a one off bad experience :( Still worth checking out for the great decor and aesthetic of the place.

All round well-deserved 5 stars 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟
Surprised at the small entrance to see how atmospheric and large the dining room at the back was. If you’ve seen any Wong Kar-Wai films, that’s the vibe- just like the Goldfinch Café. Beautiful venue for a breakfast- we also tried the Yuenyeung  tea (鴛鴦), a mix of coffee and Hong Kong-style milk tea with condensed milk which was delicious. Everyone there was so friendly, service was easy and everything arrived in really good time. The perfect experience. To note and thanks go to our waiter Berry who made us feel so welcome and showed us and explained various dishes as they came out. Definitely going back soon for a Hoko Hong Kong breakfast. Thank you all for such a lovely time 🙏🏼

Honestly was very impressed with this spot, as someone who frequents Hong Kong yearly I always get the blues and cravings for cafe food whenever I’m back in the uk for too long.

Firstly the interior and aesthetics are sooo clean, it depicts an olden day Hong Kong diner with the staff uniform matching the same theme too. Though there are queues lining up from opening throughout the day it seems to get progress pretty smoothly.

The variety is not too big not too small so you can tell there are obvious signature dishes on the menu, I personally really like the fried squid tentacles as they were very rich in umami and crispy with the soy sauce chicken wings which are like the ones I had at home when I was younger.

The portions are surprisingly also quite big and filling which is great with a side when dining with others, I personally preferred the cha siu over the pork chop as the pork chop was quite filling. Noodles were great and the egg was perfectly silky.

Price wise obviously is more expensive than cha chaan tengs in Hong Kong but definitely worth the experience the nostalgia and taste of Hong Kong in London for a decent price point. They also have their in house homemade Hong Kong milk teas!

Would definitely go again!!

name: De Vine
address: 19 Vine st next, under railway bridge, to, 2 America Square, London EC3N 2PX, UK

reviews.text:
At first sight, you don’t even realize where you’re stepping into. This hidden spot just a short walk from Tower Hill truly deserves much more attention.

From the moment you arrive, the overall service and atmosphere stand out. Even if you’re sitting at a table alone, you never feel lonely - there’s a warm, welcoming energy that makes you feel comfortable and taken care of. The staff are attentive, professional, and genuinely kind.

The price - quality ratio is excellent, and the level of service is impressively high. I’m genuinely delighted with my experience.

Hands down one of the best breakfasts I’ve had in a long time. Every single item was cooked perfectly and clearly made with care. The eggs were spot on, the bacon was rich and meaty, the sausage was full of flavour, and the beans were just right. The crispy potatoes were golden and seasoned beautifully, and the toast was warm and fresh. Even the mushrooms and tomato were done properly, not overlooked like they often are.

The portion size was generous without being sloppy, and everything worked together exactly how a proper breakfast should. Comforting, filling, and incredibly satisfying. If you’re after a classic, high-quality breakfast that leaves you happy and full, this is it. Would absolutely come back again.

Absolutely the perfect spot for breakfast and lunch! I first came here two years ago and knew I had to return. Everything was just as amazing as I remembered. The service is truly outstanding, and the food is incredibly delicious. Highly recommended!

In London, most restaurant ratings range between 3.8 and 4.5. Whenever I find a place rated 4.5+, I make sure to read the reviews very carefully. I’ve seen many “VIP” or high-end restaurants that can barely maintain a 4.5 rating.
This place, however, has 4,932 reviews and a perfect 5-star average. That immediately caught my attention, and I decided to come here for breakfast all the way from NYC.
From the moment I walked in, I couldn’t stop smiling. The owner is incredibly friendly, constantly attentive, and presents everything beautifully. We truly loved the breakfast! Wishing you continued success!

Great little hidden gem. Food was spot on, big portions, and very good prices. Had the full English (swapping the mushrooms for hashbrowns) and it was amazing. This was my breakfast on day 1 and it’s going to be hard to not come here every morning. Absolutely recommend

I ate Bun Cha here and it loved it. I think Vietnamese food is fresh and satisfying, this reminded me of that. There was not a lot of flavour in, say, the noodles but, I generally liked that because we shouldn't always need a lot of sweet or salty flavour. I have given a lower rating on atmosphere because it was so cold in the store I couldn't feel relaxed as I'd have liked. Also, I'd have like some music in the background to listen to. I'd definitely recommend the food 😋
Really solid Vietnamese food. The rare beef Pho is super fresh and the spring rolls are delicious. Definitely my new go-to spot.

I was so happy to find this little cofeeshop/ restaurant.
Their pho is really good and the team are really nice and efficient !
I was alone and it didn't  bother them , they treat me nicely.
I will come back again ~
Delicious banh mi… some of the best I’ve had in London! Restaurant kind of cramped and can take a while during the lunchtime rush but definitely worth it!
Small place, but great food and fair prices. The food also came out quick. Had the pho and I drank every drop.

Why not treat yourself to breakfast here? With comfortable, luxurious surroundings and impeccable service from Gaëlle and colleagues, I doubt whether you will be disappointed. The breakfast was fantastic, flavoursome, cooked to perfection, and not at all greasy. I do love a cooked London breakfast, and this was superb. The staff were happy to accommodate my modifications since I suffer from a mild egg allergy. The setting is spacious, peaceful, and unrushed, with pleasant ambient music. Breakfast is served until 12, so there is no rush. The toilets were spotlessly clean, as was the entire environment. Another venue that will inevitably feature on my regular list!

We went for breakfast.  There wasn’t a lot of variety on the menu, so we both ordered the Eggs Benedict and Orange juice. And it was a delicious meal. We also purchased a muffin and a croissant to go.
The atmosphere is beautiful and nice and quiet. The server was great!

What a phenomenal breakfast!!! This place is so cozy and has amazing, friendly service. The food was incredible, both taste-wise and presentation-wise. The Corvo Breakfast was honestly one of the best breakfasts I have ever had. I highly recommend you pop in for coffee and a bite. We will be back very soon.

Breakfast was good.  Atmosphere was also good.  It was a clean restaurant just down the block from the Tower of London.  I got there when no one else was there.  I got my food pretty quickly but they then proceeded to not check on me after the food was received.  The waiter who helped me was then working the register.  I sat there for 1.5 hrs and they were starting to get busy.  I was there alone, so it’s not like I needed time to chitchat.  I flagged down another waiter for my ticket.  He proceeded to continue helping other tables, so I went to the front to pay.  I still left a tip, but the exit was so poor I regret giving anything.

Wanted a brunch before our walking tour and pleased we came here as very prompt and delicious. I had avocado and mushroom on toast, which was spot on and he had croissant both with coffees.  In and out within 25 min.  Toilets are a bit of a hike downstairs

name: Luca Dsq.
address: 17 Devonshire Row, Liverpool St, London EC2M 4SQ, UK

reviews.text: A cosy and pleasant atmosphere, with friendly staff who pay attention to every detail, making you feel great about being there. However, what is truly special is the food. The authentic menu clearly reflects the chef's experiences and adventures, combining ingredients from all over the world to create dishes that are true explosions of flavour—not something you can find just anywhere. The care taken with the presentation also makes the whole experience unforgettable. Every bite will leave you speechless. I will keep coming back and can't wait to be surprised by next season's menu. Definitely one of my favourite restaurants in London.

Every time my family and I travel, we’re lucky enough to be served by Tina and she never fails to impress. She’s warm, professional, and genuinely attentive, making us feel welcome from the moment we board. What stands out most is how well she knows her job she is

knowledgeable about the food and service, always ready with helpful recommendations, and remembers our preferences without us even asking. Her combination of expertise, efficiency, and personal care turns a simple journey into an enjoyable experience. Tina is a credit to her team and a big reason we always look forward to experience here.

Had dinner with work colleagues.
I would say it's ok. The food wasn't bad but it was a mixed bag, the steak was good but had an interesting butter in it and nothing encouraging me to return. The risotto looked more like soup but tasted ok. The pasta was a relatively small portion.

The staff were friendly, the atmosphere pleasant and inviting, and the wine good.

Don't regret going, but equally not eager to return.

Stopped by for lunch on a Saturday. The place had a cozy, cute vibe and the service was solid. The food looked great and sounded interesting, but unfortunately, it didn’t quite hit the mark taste-wise for its price point (this is a personal opinion obviously). Out of what we had, the arancini were the best choice as well fried.

What a hidden gem, only minutes away from Liverpool Street. With a gorgeous atmosphere, amazing food and fantastic service, what's not to love?!

The manager was very helpful in pointing out gluten free options on the menu, and everything was amazing from start to finish. We tried the burrata, the falafel and charred sweet potato to start, all of which were packed full of flavour and spices. The smells themselves were enough on their own to make me hungry! I then had the pea and mint risotto, worried that I wouldn't like it because I'm not a huge fan of mint.... it was absolutely stunning though! Fantastic flavours and just the right amount of food as well.

Would highly recommend a visit here if you're in the area!

Delightfully surprising - British food well done with rare attention to detail and care. Date loaf was a great mix of temperatures and textures (crunchy edges). Lamb was very comforting backed by a buttery sauce against the liquorice flavour of fennel. The tartare sauce with the devilled sprats was fresh - dill with some crunchy sour vegetables. I don’t know if we just chose well or if every dish is done at such high quality. Will come again to find out.

Lovely hidden away hidden location. The staff are friendly. Had a good time checking out this place with my partner. Felt like a special place. The fish was slightly more salty than it needed to be but otherwise fine. Good when you want a break from my usual eating-out food made up of fish and chips, pizza, burgers, Chinese food and curries

Returning again for a nice meal when I had some time to kill. A great spot to sit and grab a tasty meal in the shoreditch area.

Great and helpful service, the heated patio was cozy and bustling. Food was excellent. I had the sea bass; nothing like a nicely cooked fresh fish filet with that crisp.

Lovely place, great food, great atmosphere. The tuna was delicious so the mushrooms plate. The apple crumble was good, although I think it needs more custard. I need to come back and try the mains as they look good! I was very excited about trying this place because of the hype, however I was expecting a bit more.

Meaning to try this place for years but could never find a spot to reserve. Came for lunch on a beautiful winter day to enjoy a beautiful and relaxed atmosphere. Food was simple but the pairings were original, you could taste the great quality of the ingredients, one of the best turbot I’ve ever tried. Only downside was the service where at times we couldn’t get the attention of the staff or there was some miscommunication when we asked for recommendations. Overall nice.

I found this place quite nice overall. The food was tasty and well-prepared, though it was a bit frustrating that my order was initially forgotten, and I had to remind them about 2-3 times. Still, once it arrived, it was enjoyable though would've preferred not to eat alone.

Had a mushroom omelette, with chips and salad, and it was absolutely delicious. The omelette had plenty of mushrooms, and the portion of chips, was very generous. The salad was plentiful, and absolutely gorgeous. The prices are very reasonable also.
I would definitely recommend this cafe. Try it, you’ll be glad you did..
Such an amazing place for breakfast! I came here five days in a row for their Turkish breakfast and sujuk yumurta — everything was perfect. The staff are super friendly and make you feel good!

This place is a no-frills, no-nonsense greasy spoon in the best possible way. The kind of spot where the coffee is always hot, the grill is always on, and nobody’s pretending it’s anything other than comfort food done right.

The menu sticks to the hits—eggs, bacon, hash browns, burgers, melts—and everything comes out fast, filling, and exactly how you want it. My breakfast was cooked perfectly: crispy on the edges, generous portions, and seasoned like someone actually tasted it. The bacon had a proper crunch, the eggs were spot-on, and the toast showed up already buttered (a small detail, but it matters).

Service is friendly in that easy, familiar way—efficient, chatty if you want it, and happy to keep your coffee topped off. You get the sense a lot of regulars eat here, which is always a good sign.

Is it fancy? Absolutely not. Is it honest, satisfying, and worth every penny? 100%. If you’re craving real English breakfast without the gimmicks, this place delivers. Come hungry, leave happy, and don’t overthink it.

As a complete stranger to London, I happened upon this lovely cafe on a busy street corner in Islington near Moorfields Eye Hospital 's private wing. From massive breakfasts for £12, mixed grill (£16.50) to homemade 'Sucuklu Yumurta' (Pan fried eggs and Turkish sausage), they really do offer an eclectic selection. I opted for the very tasty cheese on toast (£6.50) and an excellent cappuccino (£3.50). I thought the prices extremely reasonable for London. Nice clean loos and free WiFi.  A great find!

name: Arches Cafe
address: 202 Three Colts Ln, Bethnal Green, London E2 6JN, UK

reviews.text:
Amazing place! I had the English breakfast and it was delicious to say the least. This place fully lives up to all the good reviews. I would come again, if i wouldn't go back home in a couple of days.
The server was very friendly.

A proper British caff! Tucked away, as the name would suggest, in the Arches of the overground bridge just a short walk from Bethnal Green station. The food was excellent and easy to order as you’d hope. The service was warm and friendly, I believe it’s a family business, which is always great to see too. I enjoyed the old school 4 seater tables and the brickwork interior is a nice touch, but the thing that really makes the places charm is the quiet rumble of the trains passing overhead! I will definitely be back, and bringing friends.
Lovely British breakfast and friendly service. You can hear the train pass by.

Kind service in a place with great atmosphere under the railtracks. Food was really good, but not outstanding. Chips could be a bit crunchier, green peas could be more moised or steamed. But those are details, after all we were really satisfied with a great breakfast experience. 5*

Wonderful place. Clean and quiet. The food is extremely delicious. As close to home cooking as possible. The staff is kind and courteous. You don't have to wait more than 10 minutes for your order. The chef is a professional in his field. Special thanks to Hana, who with her attitude makes us feel wanted and special. I highly recommend it.

Just had the ‘milionaires’ crepe served to me at 4:30 am by this amazing guy, Hussain. The crepe is tasty and Hussain didn’t delay the service. made and served the crepe super quick.

thanks

I’ve visited this establishment multiple times and generally have had positive experiences, except when interacting with one particular staff member who works during the evenings.

On several occasions, I’ve noticed that she’s often on her phone and doesn’t acknowledge customers when they arrive. During my most recent visit, there was an issue regarding hygiene practices. When my sister politely asked her to wear gloves while preparing her crepe, the staff member declined, stating that she had already washed her hands and my sister replied that she hadn’t see this happen. This led to a brief exchange, and when I calmly asked her to please wear the gloves, she responded by accusing me of having an attitude (I believe this was a micro aggression as I did not once raise my voice at her) . Despite my repeated requests for her to simply complete our order, she continued to argue and appeared to handle our food carelessly, resulting in a burnt crepe (photos attached) and my thick milkshake being the consistency of juice genuinely.

Additionally, when I asked for a cup holder for my drinks, I had to repeat my request multiple times before she acknowledged it. I also requested her name for reference, but she ignored me.

I genuinely enjoy coming to this location, but this repeated negative experience with one staff member is disappointing. I hope management can address this to improve future visits.

The staff here are quite rude, particularly the middle-aged man wearing glasses. He never smiles and treats customers very poorly. His behaviour makes the whole experience uncomfortable.
I do not recommend this place

Just order cookie dough on Uber eats. The cookie dough was cold and the bottom was raw so they just covered it with melted chocolate hoping that we would not see it. It tasted horrible and quality was very bad. It was supposed to come with fresh cream ice cream however, they gave me the gelato ice cream instead. Ive had this same thing in other branches and it’s been so much better. Will never order from here again. It deserves a 0 stars.

One of the worst place for order online.. they don’t really care about the time u receive your food.. it’s always long waiting time..
Not recommended

name: The Munch
address: 148 Shoreditch High St, London E1 6JE, UK

reviews.text:
Fantastic takeaway experience from The Munch in Shoreditch! We ordered the chicken doner and lamb doner box, and both were absolutely delicious flavourful, generous portions, and perfectly cooked. Everything was fresh and packed really well, making it just as enjoyable at home as dining in.

A big shout-out to Majid, who handled our order with great care. He was friendly, efficient, and made the pickup smooth and easy.

If you’re craving top-quality doner in Shoreditch, The Munch is unbeatable. Highly recommended!

The most tasty kebab in Shoreditch!

Went in last week after feeling hungry after a concert & it was so good I had to order it in today.

Yet again I’m amazed by the quality & flavour! Lovely staff when you go in & fast delivery - win win!

This place was across the street from our hotel (One Hundred Shoreditch) and it did not disappoint. Greeted with a friendly staff and a warm smile by all. The lamb doner kebab was delicious and the cheesy fries were a great add. Def check this spot out if you’re in the area!
Really enjoyed the food here, platter was nice and had a good variety. Friendly staff and nice seating area upstairs. Definitely recommend!

I really enjoyed my lunch stop at The Munch. My lamb doner wrap was fresh and extremely tasty, and it came out quickly. The place was spotless, and the staff were fun and helpful. A solid choice whether you want to sit down for a quick meal or take it to go — note, there's additional seating upstairs.
Delicious food and excellent customer service, I tried Birria tacos & Thunderclap cheeseburger.. amazing
smashed Burger was absolutely delicious with crisp and juicy inside, Also Birria Tacos with consommé dipping..OMG

I tried steak on Fries,  perfectly cooked, very tender and juicy🤤.
Vanilla cheesecake milkshake from here is the best of Best!👌
Best Birria Tacos & philly cheese steak,  Highly recommend!!
Very good

The food here is the best Chinese food you'll have in UK by faaarrr!!! I'm not being bias, please give a thumbs up to this comment once you agree. The food is 10/10 and the service is impeccable too. They're very responsive and acknowledge notes when placing an order which is a massive plus nowadays. The staff go out their way to accommodate your requests and will ensure you are fully satisfied. I've ordered 4 times from here (each order min £65) and have tried EVERYTHING they have to offer and I swear, hand on heart, everything was beyond perfect EVERY SINGLE TIME. I eat out a lot, and since discovering Smokin Wok I haven't had Chinese anywhere else. A little something if I may....it was my daughters 18th, they got her a card and a gift, they gave free drinks and crackers and extra food. They didn't have to, but they did. Surely you all can appreciate how special that made her feel. It was fully unexpected but so so appreciated. And a personal opinion, go for medium spice, its the most perfect balance of heat and flavour. I can't fault these guys on anything. You can pre order for collection and even pay upon arrival. Their portions are tremendous and prices are incredible considering what you pay for. I haven't got pictures of all my orders from previous but I will attach what I can find on my phone. Overall.... OUTSTANDING FANTASTIC AMAZING. Double thumbs up. For everyone reading this comment, please give them a go and see how much you agree....and if you do, then please like and share this to spread the love and awareness, these guys fully deserve it. May Smokin Wok prosper and you all be blessed abundantly.

Jalal.

AMAZING PORTION for the price!! I ordered from them through deliveroo and because there was no option to mention I didn’t want egg in my chow mein I called them and asked them to remove it. My food came nicely packaged and without egg :) so nice of them! The food is super tasty too!! I’d recommend 100%🥰🥰🥰

This is a lovely Chinese take away! We ordered the chicken balls which came in a big portion with an amazing taste, for so little money! We also ordered one rice main and one noodle main and the beef Szechuan and everything was so flavourful and delicious. The portions are very good so we will be finishing this off for dinner tomorrow! The staff was lovely and as it was our first purchase we received a free canned drink of our choice! LOVE !

Absolute favourite takeaway restaurant in Whitechapel. Staff are so friendly, happy to give recommendations and very attentive. The portions are amazing value, the noodle dishes are my favourite for their flavour and size. You can see them making all food freshly, and the wait times are minimal. Brilliant chinese, could not recommend enough.
Great service, really nice people and great food. They even gave me a free drink of my choice for being a first-time customer. Would definitely recommend!
Very large portions and great for group dining. We couldn’t finish the food even with 7–8 people. The poon choi 盆菜was well worth it and needs to be pre-ordered during Chinese New Year！

In extremis, we gave this restaurant another chance after a poor experience last spring. Mistake. The food was woefully under flavoured and the fresh ingredients were destroyed by unskilled treatment. The vegetables in sweet and sour sauce tasted like dishwater and the sauce was so diluted that it had no taste. We had to fish them out of the coloured water to eat them. Zero crunch was detected.
The squid was the worst crime though. I have never eaten old boots but I imagine they are similar to the piece of fresh squid that had been defiled by persons unknown.
The basic ingredients are great. The chef should be drummed out of the kitchen. Immediately. For the sake of the business.
One small shred of comfort; the prawn crackers were fine.

Absolutely great chinese food!
Vast selection of items, and all that you would want to to eat! They have hot pot options too! Great service and loved the food! Lots of veggie friendly options!

This place is serving authentic Chinese food. The food is full of flavours. The restaurant is run by a sweet Chinese couple. They are very nice and humble and always checks on you. Very good place must visit if you love Chinese food. 🍜🥘🍲🍤🥟

So welcoming, warm and beautiful food made with a lot of care! Incredible experience. Since the moment we came into the restaurant and everyone made their greetings, to the quality of the food.  I highly recommend this place, it made us feel so especial in every aspect.
Definitely will come back.

We had amazing Chinese take out last night at Kung Food! We found this spot on Google Maps and decided to give it a try. We wanted to give a shout out to the young Cantonese cashier that helped us with our order! She was extremely nice, personable, and gave us amazing recommendations for what we should order.

The portion sizes are generous. Credit cards are not accepted at the cash register (cash accepted). However, you can scan a QR code at the wall and order with credit card on their website for a 10% discount.

We spend roughly 20-30 £ for 4 people, which is below 10 £ per person and we were quite full!

Best I’ve had in years and years!
Great food and portions with decent big slices of meat and nice veggies, taste and sauce excellent and no problem if like me you ask for extra chilli!
The price is great value, I went back for early dinner 3 days in a row!
Keep up the great work guys!
Happy ®️ich

As a very experienced (50+ years old) member Chinese Takeaways, this is a bit of a find.

Forget the “airs & graces”, this is a great takeaway.

I’ve returned a couple of times and the food is nice, cooked in front of you and just want you need.

Thanks Kung Foo, don’t change a thing.

Utterly appalling. This place serves the kind of buffet food you’d expect at a bad office party—cheap, bland, and downright revolting. The lunch buffet was basically a mountain of rice with three sad “toppings” grudgingly slapped on like they were rationing flavour. The quality? Abysmal. I’ve had better meals from a petrol station sandwich shelf. Staff were as rude as the food was tasteless, and frankly, I’m amazed this place hasn’t gone under with so many far superior options around Liverpool Street. Do yourself a favour: steer clear.

Kung Food is a combining fast food convenience with a good level of authenticity and delicious flavors.Portion sizes at Kung Food are generous, meaning you'll definitely leave with a full belly and possibly some leftovers. The prices are very reasonable, considering the quality and portion size. Highly recommend!

name: FANZY Pizza & Burger
address: 13 White Church Ln, London E1 7QR, UK

reviews.text: The pizza was absolutely delicious — thin, crispy crust with fresh, flavorful toppings that tasted straight out of Italy. You can tell they use quality ingredients, especially the mozzarella and tomato sauce. The staff were friendly and attentive, making the whole meal even more enjoyable. The restaurant has a cozy, welcoming vibe — perfect for a casual dinner or date night. I’ll definitely be coming back to try more of their menu. Highly recommend for anyone who loves real Italian pizza

I recently tried FANZY Pizza and Burger and absolutely loved it. You can really taste the fresh, high-quality ingredients, and the pizzas cooked in their stone oven are perfectly crispy yet light. I ordered the Margherita and vegetable pizza, and both were simple, authentic, and delicious, just like pizza in Italy, which makes sense since the team is Italian.

The staff were super friendly and welcoming, which made the experience even better. I can’t wait to go back to try their burgers. If you’re after real Italian-style pizza, FANZY Pizza and Burger is definitely worth a visit! 🍕🇮🇹

Guys, you don't need to travel all the way to Italy to have pizza, just come to Fanzy and you are sorted. This is so far the best pizza I had in London for quality and consistency. 5 consecutive order between myself and my sister never been disappointed.

I’ve lived in Italy for quite some time and the pizzas from here are spot on- crispy base, fluffy crust and great ingredients.

Excellent price for the area and they also give student discount :)

Staff are extremely friendly, attentive and passionate about their craft. I’d highly recommend!

The owner has spent nearly 20 years in Italy and has learnt how to make excellent pizza. This tastes exactly like the ones I had in Italy, it was 10/10. We only ordered two at first but was so good that we ended up ordering a third one. The place is small, quiet and accommodating. Staff is very kind and can recommend things from the menu. It is also fully halal.

We went today and ordered our dinner. Their food deals are great. They have good offer on collection of good options from fried to grilled chicken. Their service was great and the people are friendly. We ordered for takeaway. We waited roughly 10-15 minutes due to the grill chicken.

One of the most delicious grill chicken we had tasted. We have ordered from them a number of times and the flavour is always spot on. Would surely recommend.

If you’re a foodie like me, you’ll definitely love this please! The menu has a fantastic selection of dishes and we loved everything we tried. The fried chicken was really crispy their wings was delicious and the burger and doner kabab are fresh and well seasoned. I really loved their “Chicken Tikka Biryani” they added desi tadka dal with this which was very tasty!😋
The most important thing i loved about “Wings Of East” is their customer service. The stuff was attentive,friendly and caring, Specially the owner of the restaurant Mr Ziaur Rahman who was incredibly friendly, welcoming everyone with a smile and a great conversation like you’re the part of the family, his service was impeccable and fast from start to finish👌🥰
Environment was clean and made me feel fresh and price was reasonable!

Highly recommend to anyone who loves Good food with care!👌

Best kebab place ever I was recommended by a cousin to visit this place as I used to go next door and I’m glad I visited wings of east really friendly staff and the meat and chicken is so juicy they are not stingy when it comes to give pot of sauces always giving extra I now go there once a week
The quality of the food was exceptional, and the flavors exceeded my expectations! Overall, it was an outstanding experience that left me craving more.

Excellent Food and Service!

We recently tried Wings of East Freshly Made in London and were thoroughly impressed! The whole chicken was perfectly seasoned and tender, with just the right amount of flavor in every bite. The fish fingers were crispy on the outside, soft and flaky on the inside—absolutely delicious!

The quality of the food was outstanding, and the service was friendly and efficient. It’s clear they take pride in delivering fresh and tasty meals. We will definitely be coming back for more. Highly recommend for anyone looking for great, freshly made dishes!

American in London. Had a craving like nobody’s business for a burger. Gave this place a shot to scratch the itch. Dang happy I did. Ended up trying four different burgers. All four hit the mark. Sweet and spicy was truly sweet and spicy. Blimey was the spicy deliciousness I’ve been craving since leaving the states. Chicken sando was moist with a crunchy exterior. Mushroom burger made vegetarian look easy. Price was right. Portions were fair. Service was friendly.

Staying in tower hill, decided to try this place. On approach, we could have turned away (it's situated in a back alley) there was someone waiting for their order who directed us. After ordering she said she had been there 3times in 2days it was the best smash burger in London, SHE WAS NOT WRONG! This was the BEST burger I have EVER tasted, So juicy with amazing flavour!! Also the price was very reasonable! Definitely a must if your in this area. You will not be disappointed!

Really tasty smash burger joint tucked away in an unassuming alleyway. You get a Burger, fries, sauce and a soda for around 12 pounds.

They offer a variety (think like 7 each) burgers and sauces to choose from. Preparing the meal only takes them about 10 minutes. Burgers are juicy and fries crisp.

It's likely the best burger I've had. Ordered the tower and didn't regret it. The ordering process is a bit awkward. It's just a single red door you need to knock on. Some photos show some signs on the door, but when I was there, it was just a plain red door. Then the menu was on the inside of the door, and with the person there waiting for me to choose, I felt a bit rushed and didn't look over the menu as much as I would want.

All that said, absolutely amazing taste. Cost me basically as much as a  McDonalds meal but is 1000x better. Would keep coming back if I lived near.

*Edited update for fairness*

I walked from the hotel and there is no dine in, so I brought it back to my father for his dinner.

I ordered the classic cheeseburger for my father. The hamburger comes with a "hamburger sauce" that is mildly spicy, and he can't handle even mild spicy. That is not the shop's fault I thought it tasted good.
My Nachos were very nice, which is rare for the UK.

name: Rack & Bite Smokehouse and Grill, Shoreditch
address: 36 Great Eastern St, London EC2A 3ES, UK

reviews.text:
Absolutely top-tier burgers.
Rack & Bite seriously knows what they’re doing. The burgers are juicy, perfectly cooked, and full of flavour, with great textures and seasoning that really stand out. The fries are crispy, well-seasoned, and addictive — exactly how they should be.
On top of that, the customer service is 10/10. Friendly, welcoming, and genuinely attentive, which makes the whole experience even better. You feel looked after from the moment you order.
If you care about quality burgers, great fries, and excellent service, Rack & Bite is the place. Highly recommend.
Great little place with good food and service but it's only got 12 seats. great value for the money. the slow cooker ribs and burgers were excellent. Grilled chicken very tasty too

I recently visited Rack & Bite Smokehouse in Shoreditch with a group of friends. One member of our party cannot have any spice, onions, or pepper, so we ordered the lemon chicken. While the rice did contain onions and the seasoning was still a little too spicy for them, the chicken itself was absolutely delicious and cooked to perfection. The corn was also excellent and complemented the meal very well.

The service was fast, friendly, and efficient, which made the experience smooth and enjoyable. We chose takeaway and everything was well prepared and ready promptly. The location is very convenient and easy to walk to, which added to the overall positive experience.

Although the food was not the perfect match for dietary restrictions for one person, the quality of the food and the attentive service stood out. I would be happy to recommend Rack& Bite Smokehouse for anyone seeking flavorful food in a great Shoreditch location.
Visiting from the U.S and found this place randomly. They were about to close but insisted we could stay to try the food. I got the chicken wrap and was 10/10!!!! Service was awesome too.

This place has been open for just over nine months and it’s situated on the Great Eastern street opposite the American Car Wash. it’s a beautiful little place really well decorated and a great design, you almost know the food is going to taste great before you even start eating.

They serve grilled chicken, veggie options Beef and Ribs it’s obvious that someone really cares about this outlet it feels lovely even down to the furniture, take a look at the chairs, lovely details in the quality. But the most important thing is the quality of the food I ordered I was amazing, honestly great taste and well cooked. The presentation was top class. My spend was just over £12:00 and it was worth every penny.

I was offered a portion of rice to try and even that was amazing. The fries were well fried and tasted fresh. While i was in there eating the staff kept continuously cleaning which made me feel well assured. They sell soft drinks in glass bottles which give you an idea of the quality of this perfect little eatery. I really enjoyed the food and would give it a 10 out of 10. The staff were polite and friendly this was a great discovery.

Nearest underground is either Liverpool Street or old street or 135 bus, 78 bus junction of curtain road and great eastern Street. Love ❤️ this place.

Polite and friendly staff but the food isn't as good as expected. I bought 2 meals for nearly £17 which is expensive compared to other good PFC shops. The wings were hard to bite and the single cheese burger did not really impress me. The doner Kebab was nice at least which is why giving them a 3 star. But I felt that they were little stingy with their potions. Overall ok. The Chilli Can be improved as it was too salty and too much food colour.

Great looking and tasting food. Fresh succulent spicy fried chicken wings with crisp french fries. Condiments available at the table. Many places don't seem to have pepper - they did.
Try their naga flavoured wings, donor, etc for a great spicy kick.
Updated modern styled atmosphere to justify the prices.
Floor is regularly mopped but makes it quite slippery - almost slipped twice once as I collected the food from the counter and at the end of the meal when I went to wash my fingers.
I'd suggest serving the customers when the floor is wet.
It was a wonderl walking in after such a long time.

I went to WPC with my wives and family today . I had Shatkora Doner and my family had mix like wingz and burgers. I cant explain how wonderful food it was and how taste all of them . The Customer service was impressive. Specially the young gentleman name Imran i think . He was really good . He looked after us till end . However the all service and food was amazing. Great experience. Thanks all ppl pf WPC.

I am not one to usually leave a bad review but I have to say quite disappointed with this place.

The food was very hot but it was clear that the chips had been cooked before and were just refried, the burger was nice but not amazing. Portion size was good.

The staff were great and the food service was very quick. I have to be honest though the place was dirty, there were flies everywhere dead and live ones and the toilets were filthy.

The food was ok but I won't be coming here again.
Believe me or not, they’re the best fried chicken shop in Whitechapel. I go there once a week. The food and the behaviour of every staff member is excellent. You should definitely try it!

Stumbled across this place after a long journey. Was very hungry and ordered the half piri piri chicken with rice, salad and drink. It was delicious! Really tasty chicken grilled perfectly and served with a medium hot sauce. Looks small in the photo but it was actually really big. The staff were lovely too and offered me a lollipop on my way out. Would definitely go again.

I visited with my family. The staff was so kind!!!! We ordered curry, grilled chicken, and chicken doner with Naan. My mum loved the naan. The portion and the price is great :)) Definitely visit again 🥰

This guy is incredible! We came, asked for a charger first, then for wi-fi. He agreed on both. Then we ordered lamb doner. It came on a big plate with a drink. How do you think, how much it was, £7 — an absolute bargain. Definitely best service, best prices.

Best biryani I have had and the grilled chicken is also insane. Huge portions, home-cooked, and full of flavour. Also super friendly staff who opened up for us and gave us great recommendations and drinks on the house. Thank you so much, we will be back!

Tasty food and affordable prices.
Small shop but has plenty of seating .
The naga wings and doner is really good

name: Jack The Chipper
address: 96 Whitechapel High St, London E1 7RA, UK

reviews.text: From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was great and the staff were friendly, let me tell you, Ali either needs a bonus, a pay rise or a promotion! He was very attentive, welcoming, knowledgeable and made us feel like home. Another staff (sorry I forgot to ask for his name, he was at the bar) He was very friendly and attentive too, served with smile and confidence. But out main server, Ali, he greeted every guests / customers with the same friendliness and enthusiasm from the moment we stepped in till we left. Ordered lasagne, haddock, halloumi and cheesecake, food was very delicious. Will definitely come back and recommend to our friends!

Amazing… the table was silent apart from mmmm and wows. The fish was the best we have ever had, stayed hot and crispy throughout the meal. The tartar sauce was delicious. Every thing was halal which was a pleasant surprise for traditional fish and chip shop full of English heritage. The desserts were stunning the ice cream was like nothing I have ever tasted. The owner was such a lovely man and engaged with all my children. We had a lovely conversation, by the time we had walked to our car we had already told two family members this place was a MUST! Thank you for your hospitality. We will be back soon for sure  ( we were too hungry to take photos of the fish & chips 🤣)

This place was *so* fun. The staff was absolutely amazing. Super nice, joked around with us, got us our food promptly, etc. I felt like I was hanging out with friends.
They have so many fish options here, too! We got several, plus a few other things, plus dessert. It was all delicious.
Also, as weird as it may sound, check out their bathroom. The toilet seat was a hoot. 😅

Always the best in town! And best part is it's 100% halal! Awesome service... when ever I visit London i have always been coming here. Nothing has changed... they have maintained the quality! Mr. Roman was soo kind and sweet. Awesome service indeed!! We are happy to see that Ms Kitty remembered us. She also was very helpful

We had an amazing meal at Jack the Chipper in London. We ordered the fish and chips and it was absolutely delicious. The atmosphere was really nice and welcoming, and to make it even better, the owner came to greet us and was super kind. Highly recommend if you’re in the area!
Para los españoles: buen sitio, muy recomendado!
I've been ordering from here for a long time, and they are always very polite on the phone, delivery is always fast, and the food is piping hot and tasty. Definitely the best pizza place in the area.
Great pizza. Has been here more than 10 times. Never disappointed. Will visit soon with friends and family

THE best pizza I've ever tasted. I don't know what they put in that stuff. But it's magical. The decadent amounts of cheese, the generous toppings, the rich sauce and the best part, the perfectly crispy/fluffy base. Omg.
Barbican Express Pizza Shop exceeded expectations with their hot chicken 12-inch pizza. and potatoes wages It was delicious and definitely worth trying for late night craving thank you 🙏

We love their seafood pizza. Not many pizza places offer one and do it well. The base is cooked nice and crisp and the toppings generous. They have a good range of menu options at reasonable prices. The staff are friendly, polite and they deliver well. Recommend.

Amazing experience from start to finish. The food was absolutely delicious with authentic Lebanese flavors, and you can really tell that high-quality, fresh ingredients are used. Everything was perfectly seasoned and cooked.
The staff were extremely friendly, professional, and attentive, which made the whole experience even better.
The place is clean, comfortable, and has a great atmosphere.
Highly recommended for anyone who loves Arabic and Lebanese food. Definitely worth a visit ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Incredibly delicious marinated chicken and lamb!
One of the best places in London, they marinate meat using their own recipe and have an incredibly juicy and rich flavor 😋🍖

Food was very tasty,  reasonably priced , staff for kind and friendly & atmosphere was very welcoming.
For dine in- you need to go early or have patience to wait since it is a small place.
We had chicken and lamb shawarma, but veggie options were good too.
If I'm in the area i would go there again and try falafal shawarma
Higly recommend if you're up for Lebanese food.
SO GOOD, come here. I had the lamb wrap and I was so impressed. Ask for the sauces, please. Open late, perfect place.
Food very fresh. Delicious falafel and succulent meat just how I like it.

I’ve been to SMOKESTAK and I have to say, the food was absolutely amazing!

Everything we ordered was cooked to perfection – full of flavour, beautifully presented, and clearly made with high-quality ingredients. The meat was incredibly tender and rich in smoky flavour, and every dish we tried was delicious from start to finish.

The atmosphere was great as well – warm, lively, and welcoming. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed throughout our visit.

Overall, it was a fantastic dining experience. I would highly recommend this place to anyone who loves great food and a great atmosphere. I’ll definitely be coming back

Absolutely amazing place!
We could only book for 6:15 as later was full so we expected it to be quiet! How wrong! The place was buzzing with a fabulous atmosphere!
Our waiter was the best ever! He explained everything to us, gave us recommendations and was so passionate about the food, drink and his job. Can’t praise him enough! In fact we were very happy to pay the service charge! (Something we rarely do unless it’s over and above)
All our dishes were absolutely gorgeous. Incredible taste and flavours.
The cocktails too were delicious.
I was treated to a raspberry sorbet as it was my birthday and it is the best sorbet I have ever tasted!
Highly recommend and will definitely be back.
Our waiter also recommended the Cocktail Trading Co round the corner for afterwards and that too was fabulous!

Had a very enjoyable dining experience at Smokestak.

Would definitely recommend the tacos and brisket! The tacos were especially delicious!! We also ordered the ox cheek and beef rib. I wasn't a fan (personal preference) but my boyfriend loved them! The sticky date pudding was also really good!

The cocktails were also really nice and well balanced. Would recommend trying the Chilli back shots 😂

Andrea was our main server and she was wonderful! So friendly and approachable. Thank you for a great guest experience! The other staff members were also very nice and attentive too.

The restaurant is dark with small tables that are close to each other. Not a problem for me but could be an issue for some

Been hoping to try this restaurant, and I would say the wood-roasted bone marrow is definitely the highlight of the meal. It was cooked to perfection and paired well with the sourdough, which was a great start. However, I can’t say the same for the main course – the beef rib was slightly too chewy compared to the pork belly, and the sticky barbecue sauce became a bit too rich towards the end of the meal. That said, my friend and I really enjoyed the chips.

The service was attentive and friendly, and the atmosphere of the restaurant was lively. However, I felt the tables are quite close together, and the music made it quite hard to hear what my friend was saying. Probably it was just not our thing but I could see the restaurant was packed from start.

Amazing BBQ! Cool, dimly lit atmosphere with German electronic beats, serving the city's best barbecue. We had beautiful, tender brisket and a huge beef rib. Crispy ox cheeks for starters is a must. My mouth is still watering just thinking about it. Highly recommended!

name: Spicy Grill 'n' Fried Bethnal Green
address: 278 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E2 0AG, UK

reviews.text: It was alright. Ordered a large chicken donner with chips and a lamb one too. A grilled wings meal and a spicy wings meal. Total was around £25 which i believe is a decent price for 4 meals. All the food was hot except the spicy wings. The chips were good, the spicy wings tasted nice but just werent warm enough. The grilled wings were small but we were served with extra so i suppose that makes up for it. Both the donners tasted fresh and were served with fresh salad. The tables and seats were clean but the actual shop itself can look better and more cleaner to provide a more comfortable eatting setting. We were served with our food pretty fast too. Overall I would say I would probably choose to eat elsewhere because I didnt feel comfortable given the atmosphere but the food was good.

Not an ideal place for burger and chips honestly. I ordered a King sized burger but got a smaller one than the ½ pounder, the food was good but can be better. The sauce was not enough, some were even empty bottles in the counter. Atmosphete could be better too, not enough management in sitting areas. Service could be faster.

Ordered 5 piece BBQ wings and chips for £4.95.
Regular Wings and chips costs £4.00

WHAT A JOKE, it’s just NORMAL WINGS WITH BBQ SAUCE ADDED ONTO THEM 😂
Literally went there for starters, if I wasn’t having a main meal after this I would’ve thrown a fuss and asked for a refund.

Also bins haven’t been emptied and there was rubbish on the table.

The food quality was acceptable, but not exceptional.  The pricing, however, did not align with the value offered.  I found the overall cost to be excessive.  Therefore, I would not recommend this establishment for budget-conscious diners.  More reasonable prices would significantly improve the dining experience.

Shop looks very dirty, hygiene is questionable. The chicken burger was cooked in the same fryer as the fries instead of a pressure cooker, the burger and wings tasted so bland that even the chilli sauce was mediocre and basic.

High price with low taste. Chicken burger tasted like it was a quid.

Staff were excellent and even offered free refills.  They had their windows open during the heatwave which was nice and had the shades up for customers enjoying Al Fresco dining.

Food was disappointing for the price you pay. Lack of salt in both the burger patties and tenders. We ordered extra hot tenders which had no kick whatsoever because of the lack of salt likely.

Fries were salted and crispy. Not worth the price if the food is presented this way.

I ordered a single chicken burger, fries and oreo milkshake, bill was £20 but with 50% off came to £10 plus £2.50 service charge. I visited at 8:30pm on a Tuesday and my food came within 10mins, maybe I was lucky having read other people's reviews of long waiting times.

Milkshake was great, huge portion quite standard flavour but still very enjoyable. Fries were cooked well and arrived piping hot. My chicken burger was mild spice and my first bite was just incredible, I was so amazed by the flavour and juciness of the chicken. Very well balanced with the pickles. Immediately started thinking that this burger has gone straight to my number 1 spot in London lol. However as I started eating it more and more, it got less and less exciting and by the end quite frankly too salty and left my tongue feeling icky.

Overall, still very happy with my meal and service was on point, the lady at the bar was very attentive. The place is very loud. I will be visiting again to try the jumbo wings and tenders.

Paid a visit to Louie's to try their chicken wings and we were not disappointed!

Louie's is situated part of Red Dog Saloon and effectively the same restaurant.  Which wasn't a bad thing as they shared the same menu and we were able to order and enjoy the slow cooker BBQ meats on top of the fried chicken.  Happy days!

We really enjoyed the fried chicken and the BBQ meats were nicely marinated although we expected more of a fall-off-the-bone meat experience.

A nice atmosphere with some classic tunes playing in the background.

Ordered via Deliveroo during lockdown to support local businesses. The jumbo 6 piece wings is definitely worth it for the price. The chicken was not as spicy as I would have liked and not crispy by the time it was delivered (nothing an air fryer couldn't fix). The chicken burger wasn't too dry (prob cause thigh piece) and went well with the coleslaw. Def needs extra chilli sauce though. Not worth getting the fry sauce, make your own spicy mayo at home instead.

Food tasted good but man the portion sizes are a joke. Ordered chicken and waffles and it came with 3 tiny and I mean tiny chicken tenders which didn’t even cover half the waffle. I should have asked why it didn’t look like their Instagram pics.. but still can’t believe they served me this with a straight face. After paying more than 30 quid for 2 meals I was really disappointed to be leaving still hungry. This place could easily have been 10/10 if they weren’t so stingy.

Fantastic experience all around! We called ahead to see if we’d need to queue before being seated and they added a reservation for us for the time we’d be able to arrive. Once we got there, it was busy but the atmosphere was very pleasant and warm. We were seated quickly and everyone took great care of us. The salad was bright and flavorful and we split a few pastas and each was delicious. Our family favorite was the classic red sauce pasta with burrata! We also ordered the seasonal panettone which was fresh and fantastic. Although they were busy, they were very attentive and everything came out quickly. We won’t be coming back to London any time soon, but this would definitely be at the top of our list of places to come to again. Had a great night!

Solid spot for fresh pasta. The pasta tastes genuinely handmade, cooked perfectly, and full of flavour. The menu is simple and well judged, portions are generous, and it’s just an easy, reliable place when you want good comfort food without any fuss.

The best pasta place in London, Yummy... Can't wait to come back!
The food and atmosphere were fantastic, Friendly staff, amazing food. Anything you choose from the menu is amazing. I do recommend👍🏻

Love the place, nice food and nice people. Lived around so i visit here often, my best time is sitting at the bar, watching the chefs cooking pasta, which is really satisfying.
My favorite number one is truffled cacio e pepe, go and definitely check it out, you won’t regret.

Incredible bolognese in a comfortably intimate setting. I went in solo and sat at the bar, ordered, and ate within 30 min. There were groups ranging from 1 (me) to 6, but it looks like they can accommodate more if planned ahead.

Lovely joint, tucked away from the hustle and busy streets of London. I fancied a Donner wrap with chips and coke. Simple.

The reviews looked strong, and this one is another.

Quick service, seating available inside. Clean friendly.
🔥 Mixed Doner perfection! Juicy lamb + tender chicken, fresh salad, and sauces that balance fire 🌶️ and cool 🧄 in every bite. Truly dinner done right.👌👌👌

Chicken Run Outlet is one of the best restaurant option especially for students from Northumbria and Coventry. Its prime location makes it incredibly convenient for a quick and satisfying meal between classes or after a long day of studying. The prices are very reasonable, making it an excellent option for students on a budget.

The food itself is delicious, with a wide variety of options that cater to different tastes. The fact that they offer halal food is a major plus for many, ensuring everyone can enjoy a meal here without any concerns.

The outlet is clean and well-maintained, providing a quiet and comfortable atmosphere. Whether you're grabbing a quick bite or sitting down with friends, Chicken Run Outlet offers a pleasant dining experience. It's a fantastic spot for students looking for tasty, affordable food in a peaceful environment.

Lamb Donar with Naan
Chicken Donar Chick and chips
Wings, Chick amd chips with Drinks
Cheese Burger

Highly recommended!
Very tasty well cooked balanced hotwings, chilli sauce was banging. Lamb doner with chips spicy one mouthwatering taste definitely go back again.

Avoid at all costs! I live local and gave this takeaway many chances. The chips isnt cooked well. It's hard. This is for the last 7 times I ordered. Never again. My family also think the same. Also very overpriced. Doner kebab for 9 pounds and you can get better and cheaper one for half the price in Al Iqwan in Canon Street.
I ordered 20 hot wings for £7.99. The taste was great, freshly fried and served hot and delicious. The staff were polite, but the shop has limited seating.

I discovered this establishment while visiting Whitechapel, it exceeded my expectations. The chicken wings were delicious, we had both fried and grilled, all at very reasonable prices, offering outstanding value. The employees are really nice, and the atmosphere is pristine, with ample seating. Certainly a destination worth exploring!

The food wasn’t bad - the wings tasted slightly old and were dry however it wasn’t that bad. Everything was good apart from the man taking the order - I asked to eat in with someone else with me and we ordered 2 meals and a kids meal to take home as well as 6 wings. They ended up giving all the food in a takeaway box which was quickly rectified, however they charged me extra for the 6 wings and gave a chips and drink (which wasn’t necessary) and also messed up the kids meal by giving cold wings instead of a normal kids meal burger. Not too sure what was hard about taking an order.

Good option when you walk around Whitechapel and you are keen for a late snack. Well done spice chicken and tasty potatoes in an informal location, good to unplug your brain and fill your stomach. They forgot ketchup and mayo in my take-away bag and fries without sauces are like flowers without petals.

Found this place on Google maps, reviews looked good so I had to come, yeah it's a good place. Food is yummy, made to order and good quality but prices are also very good, so great value for money. Staff freindly here, clean, good seating.

Great breakfast spot. The English breakfast was absolutely delicious. The coffee and hot chocolate were smooth and delicious.
The staff were nice.
A bit line up around 10-12 but great in other times.
Will definitely be back.

Went for breakfast and had a really nice French toast and omelette. Such great place. We had a slight issue with our order as we had to wait a long time, but the waitress was super sweet and we got a discount which really made us feel valued as customers.

The place was good overall, but I wasn’t completely wowed and felt it might be a bit more hype than expected. That said, the food was genuinely great and arrived super hot, which made a good impression. The atmosphere felt more like a cozy café than a full sit-down restaurant, but it was still enjoyable. I would still give it a full five stars.

Good food, but we were made to wait outside in the freezing cold before being seated as apparently we had to wait for our whole party to arrive. This place is cosy but it’s quite small inside so you might have to queue up to be seated during busy hours. Sausage breakfast was really nice, although my hash brown was almost burnt, and the quality of the sausage could be better.

Couldn’t find it at first in the morning.All gated up and sealed until the roll up doors came up revealing a rustic nice vibe breakfast spot. We wanted to try our first English breakfast. The group had the regular breakfast honestly forgot the name, but I had the omelette which was a folded with tomatoes, and spinach on the bottom which made it a delightfully good. I thought it was overcooked on the eggs, but I went with it. I’m unsure if normal , but overall was delicious. Please comment if this was how it is?Just see the pics. As always, post wherever your palate takes you. You never know until u know.

Alhamdulillah, what we ordered for dinner was great 👍. We had a set meal, Chicken Doner with Chips and a soft drink.

The chicken was tender, juicy and tasty 😋. The chips were crispy as well. Overall, everything was good 👍👏.

However, the dining area is quite limited, so it may not be very suitable for families with kids or larger groups. That said, the atmosphere was still comfortable and quiet while we were dining.

The staff were kind and friendly, and the service was fantastic 👏

Picture yourself post tarawih. Belly rumbling after standing for almost three hours. Where do you go to quell your hunger pangs?

None other than the OG, HFC opposite East London Mosque.

Is the food the best? Probably not. Is it fine dining? No. But there’s a nostalgia about this place. The pockmarked seats, the glaring ambience, uncle working hard in the back.

And that’s why you just keep coming back. Solid fried chicken and chips at it’s best.

Mix doner wrap meal £4.95 only!
I loved it, tasty food ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Friendly staff, nice atmosphere. Keep it going
