Charged 9.99 pounds for a chicken burger with chips, while the menu said it's 8.99 pounds.
The food is just average.
This price is way too expensive.
The waiting time is more than 15 minutes even no other prior customers.
The order got a mistake. I ordered a 12 inch pizza with chips. However I received a 9 inch instead. So am owed some money. Kind regards Ricky
RAW FOOD POISONED ME WITH EXPIRED FOOD DO NOT GET FROM HERE HEALTH CONCERNS
Good pizza and friendly stuff. Love your pizza😍

When you find yourself navigating the bustling, sensory-rich streets of Shadwell, specifically around the iconic Watney Market, you aren't looking for Michelin stars or white tablecloths. You are looking for soul, seasoning, and a meal that can stand up to the grit and energy of East London. Fried & Grilled East End (located at 91 Watney St) is a spot that understands this assignment perfectly. After several visits spanning from quick lunch breaks to those much-needed post-midnight cravings, I’ve finally gathered enough "research" to give this local gem the 5-star review it deserves.
​The Atmosphere: Authentic East End
​The first thing you notice about Fried & Grilled is that it isn’t trying to be a "concept" restaurant. It’s a clean, vibrant, and honest fast-food eatery that acts as a community hub. Following its recent refurbishment, the space feels significantly more modern and inviting than your average chicken shop. There is a sense of order behind the counter that reflects in the food. It’s the kind of place where the staff recognize the regulars, and the air is heavy with the mouth-watering scent of peri-peri spices and sizzling grills.
​The Food: Where "Fried" Meets "Grilled"
​The menu is a clever balancing act. Usually, a shop excels at one and fails at the other, but here, the duality is their strength.
​The Grilled Selection: Their Whole Grilled Chicken is, in my opinion, the star of the show. Unlike the dry, stringy birds you find at many high-street chains, the chicken here remains incredibly succulent. You can tell it has been marinated properly—the flavor goes all the way to the bone. When paired with their Garlic Naan (which is surprisingly soft and fresh, likely thanks to their tandoor), it’s a top-tier meal for under £15.
​The Fried Classics: If you're leaning into the "Fried" side of the name, the Hot Wings are non-negotiable. They have that perfect "crunch" factor without being overly oily.
​The Sides: Don't sleep on the Steak Chips. They are thick-cut, fluffy on the inside, and hold up well if you’re taking them to go. Also, a special shoutout to their Special Blend Chilli Sauce. It has a kick that lingers just long enough to keep you coming back for more without ruining your palate.
​Service and Value
​In a city where a mediocre burger meal can easily set you back £15, Fried & Grilled is a breath of fresh air for your wallet. The Cheese Burger Meal or the Lamb Doner Meal are priced incredibly competitively, making it a go-to for students and local workers alike.
​What truly elevates the experience to five stars, however, is the consistency. In the fast-food world, consistency is the hardest thing to achieve. Whether I visit at 2:00 PM or 11:00 PM, the fries are hot, the chicken is seasoned, and the staff—despite the high volume of orders—are professional and efficient.
​Final Verdict
​Fried & Grilled East End is more than just a convenience; it’s a testament to the high standards of East London’s independent food scene. It’s reliable, affordable, and—most importantly—delicious. If you are in E1 and want a meal that hits the spot every single time, skip the big chains and head straight to Watney Street.
​Rating: 5/5 Stars

I love this place, but the service I received today was absolutely rubbish. There were four staff members: two standing around talking to each other, one hidden in the back, and the only one actually serving had a completely foul attitude. He looked stressed and overwhelmed, trying to take orders while also handling the fryer, but that’s no excuse for his behaviour.

He took a telephone order from someone he clearly struggled with English and started swearing about the customer as soon as he hung up. Completely unacceptable.

I honestly wanted to walk out, but my family loves the wings here, so I decided to tolerate it this time. If any manager is reading this — you seriously need to deal with this staff member (tall guy, goatee, dark skin). This kind of behaviour will drive customers away and damage your business.

Today: Sunday 7th December 2025 @14.15

Everyone else here is usually nice, which makes today’s experience even more disappointing.

I ordered 30 wings, asked him to give me the soft ones from the back. He responded they all just come up now. When I got home they were very old, hard and some of them won't even get away being pidgen wings. Really disappointed.

Thank you for the terrible service and food. I guess your success is way over your head now so no longer care! I wish you very best, I or anyone i know will no longer be coming to you for food

Food is OK for a PFC.
Staff on the other hand. Rude and don't even wash their hands. Went to get wings, tried to give me old stuff then, when I asked for sauce they don't have any. One colleague then gave it. The other then moans shouldn't have given it in bangla. Little did he know I can speak it too. Avoid at all cost!

I am a regular at Fried & Grilled, I would definitely recommend this place to all. A variety of different meals on the menu so im sure you’ll find something that tickles your tastebuds.

The service on most days is excellent, on busy days service can be slower than usual (as expected). Nevertheless, quality of the food is always on point, they never get it wrong.

Located in the heart of Shadwell near the DLR station and overground.

So much better than my expectation. Really enjoyed the food. Fresh, tasty and full of flavour. I was not expecting this good. Lamb doner is good and the grill chicken was absolutely top class. Soft, tender and juicy and great flavour. Only downside is to improve the indoor sitting a little more, maybe keep the sitting area little more clean. It was not a an Amazing atmosphere but overall good.

What a hidden gem on the Brick Lane! The Sweet and Sour Deep-Fried Pork Strips were absolutely amazing! Super crispy and very rich in flavor. The Vegetable Trio was also quite nice, the aubergine, potato, and peppers all tasted soft and flavorful - perfect dish to go with rice. Will definitely come back again for sure.
Authentic north east Chinese food. Great amount amazing taste. Excellent value for the money.

Randomly visited a few weeks ago after feeling pestered by all the Indian establishments on brick Lane. Very interesting menu, not a lot i recognised when it comes to the average Chinese restaurant, but it seemed very authentic, so I was excited to try.

I ordered what I could recognise, and I was pleasantly surprised when the food arrived! It was freshly cooked and full of flavour! The ham fried rice was a delightful surprise to my taste buds, and the smashed cucumber was refreshing. The two pork dishes were succulent, and the ribs were so tender it fell off the bone.

The service wasn't fussy, was left alone, and had to seek attention to get the bill. But it was friendly and welcoming. It's not the fanciest looking place, but it adds to the charm of the place. The food is top notch, so I highly recommend 👌🏿 😋

This establishment offers tasty, authentic Chinese cuisine. The fried sweet and sour pork was excellent - it remained crunchy even with all the sauce. The authentic, spicy dry pot was equally excellent, but ensure you can handle all the chilies before ordering. Also highly recommended are the scallion pancakes. They are not overly greasy or breaded.

BEWARE - this establishment does not take credit cards. Cash or bank transfer only.

Absolutely love this place!! We ordered 4 dishes in total and every single one of them is soooo good and authentic: dry fried potato, sweet and sour fried pork, seafood soup and fried green bean. You can find all kinds of flavors you want in here (spicy, sweet&sour, savory, etc). The interior design is also very nice. And the location is near brick lane so that’s another plus!

We ended up here by chance. We had to change trains at Liverpool Street and had some time to spare, so we decided to stop by.

The fries are excellent — crispy on the outside, yet still juicy inside. The Hot Buffalo Sandwich is very tasty as well. The staff on site were very friendly and helpful.

A great find while passing through!

Today I came here eating a Slim Chicken and the server Ashley was very generous and attentive. I asked for ketchup at the counter, but I didn't ask for it when the food arrived, and then he remembered to get the ketchup. He is always smiling and attentive when taking orders, and he always does everything well and very quickly. It’s very hard find someone like him, really really thanks!

Really good experience at Slim Chickens Shoreditch, mainly because of Ashley. Super friendly, helpful, and just made the whole visit easy and pleasant. Took the time to make sure everything was right and had a great attitude the whole time.

I had a great experience at Slim Chickens. The food was fresh, hot, and full of flavor. The chicken was crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, and the sauces were really tasty. The restaurant was clean and the staff were friendly and helpful. Service was quick and the atmosphere was nice for relaxing and enjoying a meal. I would definitely recommend Slim Chickens to anyone who loves good quality chicken. I’ll be coming back again!
Absolutely love slims chicken. Never had a bad meal! The lotus milkshake omg. I love that you can go in order on the touch panel, pick up a number and get table service.

name: Delhi & Co.
address: 132 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E2 6DG, UK

reviews.text: Probably the best Indian restaurant in London. Go with more starters as they're all shareable and different. We had the choke bhattura which wasn't oily and the chole was perfectly cooked. The chaats are excellent and the butter chicken was so tasty. Get the paratha as well as this is ideal for a curry.

This place is a hidden gem! I ordered veg tandoori momo and chicken biryani. It exceeded my expectations! It was so flavourful and the biryani was aromatic. But the momo is quite spicy(not complaining😊). Honestly one of the best Indian restaurants I’ve been to so far! I like the plates and the cups given on the table too! The atmosphere and decor is really nice. The service is good too. Price is good too! But I forgot to ask for a stamp on embargo😢I will be returning back so is it okay to get a stamp for this visit too?

If you’re craving authentic Indian food, not the typical “Brit Indian” style — Delhi & Co. is the real deal. Every dish bursts with the kind of flavor you only find back home in India.

The Soya Chaap was unbelievably good, tender, smoky, and coated in a rich, creamy marinade that hits all the right notes. The Tandoori Momos were another winner, perfectly grilled and served with a punchy chutney.

We also tried the Kung Pao Chicken and Kung Pao Momos, both full of bold Indo-Chinese flavors with crunchy nuts and a perfect sweet-spicy balance. And the Chole Bhature? Pure comfort, soft, fluffy bhature with rich, spiced chole that tasted just like Delhi street food.

Everything came beautifully presented, and the service was warm and welcoming. Delhi & Co. has nailed that authentic North Indian vibe, no watered-down flavors, just genuine, delicious food.

If you miss real Indian food, this place will make you feel right at home.

recently visited Delhi & Co and overall had a mixed experience.

The environment was lovely — warm, traditional, and inviting, which really added to the dining experience. I’d give the ambiance a solid 5/5.

When it came to the food, some dishes stood out positively while others were disappointing. The momos were good, especially the tandoori ones, and the golgappa was fresh and enjoyable. The luchi was also quite good.we also ordered fish fry which is best I loved it.

However, the papri chaat was far too salty, and the chole bhatura was a real letdown — the dal had a noticeable smell that was unpleasant. I returned the papri chaat, and while they kindly replaced it, the overall taste still didn’t win me over.

For customer service, I’d rate 3/5. The staff handled the food return politely, but one lady in particular seemed quite moody, which affected the experience for me personally.

Ratings:
•	Food: 3/5
•	Environment: 5/5
•	Customer Service: 3/5

Despite the few disappointing dishes, I enjoyed my time there and will return to try other items on the menu — hopefully with a better balance in flavors next time.

Nitin was friendly and helpful recommending food, everything was hot and spicy - black daal and shahi paneer a little on the heavy side. Would recommend the Chicken Tandoori Momos and the mixed Lassi.

It's fine! I'd be surprised if this place lasts once the hype dies down. It's not the best Detroit style pizza I've had in London, and at the price point it really should be. I tried a couple of different pizzas - the basic 'red stripe' cheese was the better one, as the topped pizzas weren't well balanced (too salty by far). Staff were fine, it's a small place to atmosphere is a bit more like a takeaway.

In a very long time this was probably one of the better pizzas. I've had the ranch sauce so fresh. The staff were really friendly. The place is small but quaint.
If you're looking for a great pizza place in London, I would definitely recommend coming here very briefly. This is only one pizza, but I'm looking forward to coming back and trying more variations. Please give this a go if you're in london or live here

Amazing Pizza, Worth the Premium Price!
The pizza here is great, with lots of excellent options. The bread/crust is truly amazing—it's a different style that's a welcome change. Be warned, though, the food is incredibly filling; finishing a large one is a serious challenge! We ordered two pizzas between us, a trio of dips, and a root beer.
The trio of dips is a must-try. The ranch dip is the best I've ever tasted, and the hot sauce was fresh and delicious. On the downside, the root beer wasn't great (tasted a bit like medicine to me, but that's a personal preference!).
Service was very quick and efficient, though quite transactional—lacking a bit of rapport or attentiveness/personality.
The pizzas are on the expensive side at £12–£16 each, but this is definitely a premium slice and worth the value. My only other suggestion would be to offer a wider variety of soft drink options, as there weren't many to choose from.
I've been planning to visit for a long time, and I can confirm: it was absolutely worth the trip!

one of the best pizzas i’ve ever had, great sauce! if you are coming as a pair, a regular pizza is more than enough with 2 large slices each. only downside is that the shop is a little small. highly recommended!

Came here bcos of the Jolly YouTube video. Highly recommend trying out a slice. I’m normally a consumer of thin slices, but even though the Detroit Pizza is thick, the dough is super soft, making it an enjoyable experience. If you try a single slice, you can only choose Pepperoni or Cheese. All other toppings require a minimum of 4 slices.

name: Dhaba Kitchen
address: Unit B, 161 Brick Ln, London E1 6SB, UK

reviews.text: Extremely good food! Some of the best curry and rice (especially fried rice!) I've had in a long time. Don't be fooled by the exterior, I loved this place and would definitely consider coming again!
MashaAllah scrumptious food and friendly atmosphere. Excellent customer service from Apurva. It's halal as well
Absolutely fantastic indian restaurant. Chicken curry and tandoori were both delicious, highly recommend!

If I could genuinely rate this a -1000 I would! I ordered takeaway from here last night for the first time and I woke up with terrible FOOD POISONING from their BUTTER MILK CHICKEN  because their food was not prepared correctly!

I love my butter milk chicken but this place IS NOT GOOD!!!!! CLEARLY no food hygiene safety standards!!!! Gave me attitude.  🫸🏼🥘 🗑️

We were recommend this place through a mutual friend and when I say I made the right choice!!!!

Trust me I really did. The food is absolutely amazing. I received it ahead of time and the food was piping hot.

We ordered a chicken tikka biryani medium spice for the kids and they loved it. And for us we ordered a very spicy prawn biryani and that was delicious the spices and flavours were on point.
We also ordered a mixed grill which was also very nice the meat was very juicy and the chicken tikka had a slight heat to it which was quite nice very flavoursome. As side for the biryani we ordered saag aloo and Chana masala.

Definitely recommend this place give it a try and trust me you will keep coming back for more.

Thank you to the chef and all at dhaba kitchen.

This shop is 10/10. Amazing service, the gentleman that served me was so lovely and kind. Very good price for the portion size and it is absolutely delicious. A hidden gem in N1. He even gave me a loyalty card and I will defo return. Thank you so much for the amazing food and service!!

Everything beautiful but don't order pizza it's a disaster the kebab is the best chips the best in London chicken is nice but it's beautiful the food but sometimes you don't get fresh had a shish and burger but burger is a burger stick the kebab on the grill the best or chicken. And desert is nice like when I get it fresh not all the time

Some places feed you, this place restores your faith in food. The chicken doner and lamb are next-level tender, packed with flavour, and clearly made by people who know (and deeply respect) good food. Every bite is a small, edible mic drop. And the service? Effortlessly friendly, fast without rushing you, and somehow they manage to make you feel like a regular even if it’s your first time. Zero complaints. Just really, really good vibes and even better food.
Popped in late for a kebab. We had the lamb and the chicken shish wraps. Both were very tasty!

Specially salad top of kebab was the difference then other and absolutely delicious.
And friendly customer service. Love to come back again

One of the best Vietnamese spots in London!! Service was excellent and I got seated immediately. The bahn mi with tofu and aubergine curry was excellent quality and just what I needed on a gloomy day! A must must must visit if you’re in the area!

This is a tiny cafe style restaurant which possibly caters more to delivery orders than eat-ins. We booked a table due to its high rating plus we wanted to try Asian cuisine in the area. The pho served was good & to our expectation. The chicken dish, however, was more quantity to quality we were looking for. All in all, we feel the amount of meat & fresh ingredients have exceeded our expectations. With its relatively modest prices, no wonder the restaurant has commanded such high rating. But the chicken dish was a little disappointing in terms of taste & authenticity, possibly served to appease the local market. Service was also a bit lacking & definitely nothing to speak of in terms of atmosphere. But having said all that, it’s a great little place to have a quick bowl of pho & small plates.
Very good value! Tasty food at great prices. Huge portions. We had the monkfish curry, which was yummy.

Very cute place,
The broth was the best I’ve ever tasted and I’ve been so many around England, would definitely come again!
Wonderful food and experience. Got spicy bu hue and my husband got pho ga. Slurped it down.

Had a super great time here with my boyfriend on a lunch date. Staff are super friendly and attentive! Michelle was our waitress and made us feel very welcome. Franco manco is always a pizza place favourite for me

"I recently took part in the Franco Manca 'Map a Run' promotion, and my experience at this branch was fantastic! After finishing my run, I headed to the shop where the manager, Viktorija, was incredibly welcoming. She was so enthusiastic, congratulated me on the run, and even helped me pick out the perfect pizza. She went above and beyond by personally bringing the pizza out to me while I waited outside. I’m so happy with the service—I highly recommend this branch!"

We did our three-year-old’s pizza making birthday party at Franco Manca and Victoria was absolutely phenomenal. She helped 12 kids make pizzas while handling everything else that was needed with her lovely colleagues. They were endlessly patient through all the chaos.
The parties take place in the back room of the restaurant - it’s a great space for a dozen young children and adults - so it’s nice and private.

Distracted staff talking in the back rather than taking orders/ serving ; took us 45 minutes just to order drinks ! Pizzas were quick once we were able to order. Wish the Amatriciana had a bit more sauce as it was on the dry side, but otherwise good.

I had a great experience at Franco Manca in Broadway Market, largely thanks to Ayat’s excellent service. From the moment we were seated, Ayat was friendly, attentive, and made us feel genuinely welcome. She was knowledgeable about the menu, happy to answer questions, and checked in at just the right moments without being intrusive. Her warm and professional attitude really enhanced the overall experience and made the visit even more enjoyable. Outstanding service like this truly makes a difference — thank you, Ayat!

Ordered from here one night through uber eats so can’t really rate the atmosphere.

Some places can be can be disappointing if you haven’t tried them before but not Butchies. I was amazed how good the food was and absolutely loved every single bite of my cheesy rider.

Butchies is definitely my go place for chicken burgers now. Amazing.

Actually forgot to take picture of the food because i demolished it but here’s picture of the delivery bag and empty burger box.

I had higher expectations, but Butchies didn't feel a whole lot different to a standard chicken stop. I doubled up on the meat, and the burger fell apart as soon as I picked it up.
The service was fine. Not rude by any means. They were definitely understaffed. You need more than just two people on at lunch time. The atmosphere was bright and clinical.
Overall, the fact that I travelled two busses to get here, and spent nearly £20 on a meal, left me somewhat disappointed.

Great chicken burgers and wings. Fries are good too. The real MVP for me was the gravy sauce tho, definitely upped the deliciousness factor, goes with everything. Highly recommend.

They've got some seating upstairs, clean, functional, not the most atmospheric.
Came for lunch ! Nice and tasty ! Def recommend !! Stuff really nice, kind and patient

I was searching for the best fried chicken spots in London and that’s when Louies and Butchies Shoreditch popped up. Unfortunately, since it is Tuesday, Louies was closed so I had to choose Butchies. Order a cheesy rider meal, wings and 2 dips.
The burger was average in size and taste. It was not at all hot which clearly shows that it wasn’t made to order. The fries though was nice and crispy. The wings were also not hot and it was really greasy. It wasn’t honestly a great experience. Wouldn’t recommend anyone to try it.

Me and my partner visited this weekend and had an absolutely fantastic experience. The food was fresh, beautifully presented, and full of flavour. The service was equally impressive x friendly, attentive, and professional throughout. My partner plans to bring his work friends that’s how much he enjoyed the food. I only have a picture of my meal before we drenched it in the sauce unfortunately but 10/10. Our valentines was perfect.

While I was there, I actually witnessed staff handle a difficult situation with a difficult customer. They remained polite and professional even when they themselves weren’t wrong and it wasn’t easy. This really stood out to me. When the member of staff left I heard the customer and her son plan to leave false negative reviews and while I don’t usually leave reviews I feel this one was needed.

It’s clear this team values fairness and good service. I’ll definitely be returning and would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for great food and a welcoming atmosphere
The food is as amazing! Everything tasted fresh and our host was soo friendly and really helped us choose what to have. The sauce was amazing and the atmosphere was great. 10 out of 10

Delicious Takeaway Experience!
It was my first time trying a seafood boil and I my first try was Soulful Seafood, and I had the best experience ever! I ordered it for takeaway, and everything was still hot, fresh, and full of flavor when I got home. The seasoning was amazing, and the seafood was cooked perfectly. The packaging was neat and well done too. You can really taste the love in the food! I’ll definitely be ordering again — highly recommend!

Absolutely unreal experience at Soulful Seafood. The sauce is honestly addictive; rich, flavourful and perfectly balanced. The seafood was fresh, juicy and seasoned properly, not bland at all. The whole vibe of the place feels warm and welcoming, and you can tell real care goes into the food. Definitely one of the best seafood boil spots in London. I’ll 100% be back.

I was genuinely impressed with both the food and the customer service at Soulful Seafood. From the moment I ordered, the staff were friendly, professional, and really welcoming. They made the whole experience smooth and enjoyable.

The food was absolutely delicious – fresh, flavourful, and well seasoned. Everything was cooked perfectly and the portions were generous. You can really taste the quality and care that goes into their seafood boils.

I’ll definitely be ordering again and recommending them to friends. Great vibes, great service, and even better food!

A fantastic spot for authentic Chinese rice noodles. I ordered the dry-mixed noodles with a side of Roast Duck.
• The Food: The roast duck was the highlight—perfectly crispy skin with succulent, flavorful meat underneath. The sweet-savory glaze complemented the duck beautifully. The rice noodles were chewy and well-seasoned with minced pork, peanuts, and pickled beans.
• The Experience: Fast service and easy QR code ordering. The complimentary clear soup was a thoughtful addition to balance the meal.
• Verdict: If you’re looking for high-quality comfort food that hits the spot, this is it. The portion size for the roast duck was very reasonable for the price.
Definitely coming back to try other toppings!

After a long workday, this is exactly the kind of place I crave.

I went to Chew Fun mainly for their Hunan rice noodles (which are already a comfort food for me), but this time I tried their upgraded duck snacks — the plum duck and satay duck.

The duck skin was noticeably crispier, and the meat was juicy and flavorful. Speaking of the noodles — whether you go for soup or dry mix, they’re packed with flavor. The broth is rich and warming, and the dry version is coated in a fragrant, spicy sauce. Perfect after a stressful day.

Also, no service charge, which is always appreciated in London. Friendly service, relaxed vibe, and genuinely satisfying food.

Definitely a solid spot if you’re looking for something comforting and full of flavor.

Had a great meal at Chew Fun. We ordered the double beef pho (shin & flank), which was rich, umami-packed and deeply comforting — full of flavour without being overpowering. The succulent fried chicken was a real highlight: perfectly crispy on the outside and juicy inside. Casual atmosphere, satisfying portions and food that really hits the spot. Would happily come back.

Chew Fun has been my go-to rice noodle spot in London for years. The signature triple beef noodle is a must-try – rich broth, generous portions, and addictive chilli. The seasonal lamb noodle soup is deeply comforting with no gamey taste at all. Crispy chicken and desserts are great too. No service charge, pet-friendly, and always warm and welcoming. A true hidden gem in East London that feels like home. 🍜💛

Really enjoyed my meal here. The rice noodles were comforting, the broth was flavourful, and the tofu skin came in super big pieces—very satisfying. Staff were friendly and the service felt warm. Simple, tasty, and worth coming back for.

Pasta Nostra is my favorite Italian restaurant in London. I used to live close by and found out about this place by pure luck! I’ve been in London for 5 years now and can say that this is genuinely better than anything I’ve seen on Tiktok or other viral platforms.
I recommend this place over and over. The king prawn pasta and truffle mushroom is absolutely to die for.
Service is always great and the price is so fair and affordable for central London.
Spritz are also £10 (Feb 2026)!

If I could give it 20 stars I would. Everything was perfect: great Italian food, amazing wine selection, good sized portions, friendly staff, clean, and the atmosphere was just magical. I absolutely loved the truffle arancini, but everything else was just as fabulous. Great value for money. If you’re looking for good Italian food in London, this is the place.

Expensive! But damn if that wasn't the best pasta I've had in a long time! Amazing gluten free and vegan options. The menu was printed wrong but the chef tailored a dish to be vegan which was AMAZING. Honestly one of the best pasta dishes I've ever had and I've eaten a lot of pasta. The server was fabulous too. Cozy vibes. Great experience.

The best pasta in London! The burrata, tiramisu, and pavlova are absolutely delicious. The staff are super friendly and make you feel at home. Special thanks to the manager, Salvatore — so kind and helpful. Can’t wait to come back!

Great italian restaurant with hood service.  There is a small selection of really great pasta.. We had the focaccia and amazing burrata to start and the Ragu was incredible too. Cacio Pepe paired with Orange Wine really worked .. meal finished of with faultless Tiramisu and espresso. Will definetaly come back !

We just popped by to try out
Some of their food

They were so welcoming
& Generous with the portions.

We were pleasantly surprised
By the variety of items available

We enjoyed their pizzas,
Savoury filled croissants,
Overloaded baguette
& A decadent mixed salad bowl.

Everything was delicious
& We will remember to
Ask the specific names
Next time we visit

If you have never tried them
We would recommend that
You do.

They have very friendly staff
& Will be happy to answer
Any questions that you have

Please support them
As much as possible

Many thanks to everyone at
Circle & Slice.

-✨

There’s no way anyone can walk past the cake’s display here and not want some! Some really yummy bakes here - gorgeous chocolate cake, brownies and cannolis. Super friendly staff with amazing service. I can’t wait to go back to try and pizza and salads because they just looked divine!

We popped in recently for a coffee and cake, enroute to the Royal London Hospital.

We were warmly greeted. Ordered at the counter and took a seat. Comfy seats but the tables were very close to each other. Once ready, we collected our coffee and pastry from the counter. There was no table service, as such.

The coffee was hot but very mild in taste ( not much coffee for a cappuccino) and it was served in a non insulated glass. Like a traditional milkshake glass. Very odd and hard to hold until it cooled a little. We weren't sure why they dont just serve hot drinks in a mug or cup & saucer?

We had the lemon cake. It looked delicious, as did the large selection of sweet and savoury offerings on view. Cakes, pastries, salads etc..However, the cake had very little lemon flavour.  I couldn't eat it and believe me, I never leave cake! Really disappointed.

Not the cafes fault but we class it as part of our 'experience'.
We had a 'local' couple sitting next to us who were eating like they were starving and he was constantly coughing, without covering his mouth. They left the cafe at a similar time to us and we caught them throwing litter on the pavement, right beside an empty bin ! I picked them up on this and she then put the rubbish in the bin. Disgusting behaviour. By the state of the street outside, that looks like typical behaviour for people in this area.

There are so many good cafes along this road, ones which we prefer. Unfortunately, we wont return here again but thank you, anyway.

We tried the diavola pizza. It was freshly made and tasted amazing. The staff were efficient and really friendly. They also had plenty of savoury and sweet options. Would definitely go back for breakfast and brunch. All items on the menu are halal.

What a cracking wee place. The decor inside is not what you expect from the outside. Loved the colours, the lights, the books... Decent menu with reasonable prices. Half chicken was tasty, as we're the chips. Burger was good, if you don't like a touch of pink in your burger then this place isn't for you. Staff friendly.
Only negative only 1 toilet for a fair few seats.

Didn’t even know the place existed, but I’m glad it does.

Pretty confident this is the best pizza spot in London. Nucky is the individual making it, says it’s fresh and it tasted like it.

I just wish more people knew about this place, definitely bringing my friends over.

Went with my husband for dinner and the owner was extremely welcoming and greeted us. The chef was friendly too. We sat at our table and ordered some sides and pizzas. Quality of food was amazing and loved the flavours. The dare devil pizza is definitely worth trying! Prices are very reasonable too (see menu attached).
This place serves great pizza and is quick for takeaway. Homemade with love from the lovely gentleman.
I went once in person and the pizza was delicious. Felt homemade and didnt feel greasy at all. Was so good had to order again!
Extremely nice and kind stuffs. The food here also super good and the shop is very clean.

I would never go back to this Chinese restaurant. The food was too spicy, and I couldn't eat it. It wasn't marked as spicy in the menu, and I forgot to mention I don't want spicy food. The staff seemed busy, so I didn't say anything, and she didn't ask me either. How can food be this spicy?

Favourite Chinese hands down.

Every time I order, the food arrives hot, fresh, and delicious. Supachef nails consistency, portions, flavour, price and delivery speed - it’s rare to find a place this reliable. Cannot recommend this place enough.

Special shout out cause they even delivered a free calendar with our last order. They go above and beyond for their returning customers.

Found a hair in my food twice from here the first time I let it slide although this should not happen it sometimes does but to find a hair n another order is absolutely vile. Avoid!!! Will not be using again £40 order in the bin!!

Absolute Disgrace. Used Just Eat for this company. Ordered online. Paid through PayPal. Card charged. No order. Then try to get through to "Live Chat" only to be told by a damn ROBOT "I can only help with orders in the last 24 hours" Had that been some people I know they would have used that last bit of money and have had to starve that night thank to just eat taking money for something they're not providing. Utter Disgrace. And can you contact them ? Don't even try. Which ones the thief ?

Beware! This restaurant clearly doesn’t care about customers or their allergies. I asked for no mushrooms and still got food full of mushrooms. My curry was 80% uncooked rice, the food arrived barely warm, and I waited over an hour—only to be told it hadn’t even been cooked yet. Totally unacceptable.

name: Pizza Pilgrims Shoreditch
address: 136 Shoreditch High St, London E1 6JE, UK

reviews.text: Had a great time here! The pizza was delicious and went perfectly with a pint. Our server, Giorgia, was super friendly and provided amazing service. We didn’t have a candle, but she kindly prepared one for my birthday cake. Really appreciated the hospitality! 12/10 pizza place 👍🏻

Had a great time at Pizza
Pilgrims! Big shoutout to
Elisa, the system
manager, for keeping
everything running
smoothly, and to Cem,
our waiter, who was super
friendly and attentive.
Also compliments to the
chef Antonio and Andrei
the pizza was delicious
and clearly made with

Lovely atmosphere, great service, and amazing food. Will definitely be back! A presto

Absolutely fantastic! The pizza was bursting with flavor and the service was impeccable - very quick. Georgia, Eliza and Fra were super helpful with the recommendation, very friendly. Can’t wait to return! 10/10 recommended

Amazing pizza, including one GF base pizza.

The carefully sourced ingredients and flavours used are exceptional.

Even though it was a busy Saturday night, the service great, we weren’t rushed and the manager took time to talk with us and have a joke.

Personal preference would be fewer tables so that dining can be a little more private.

Will try out other PP joints in Brighton and Manchester too.

11/10 would recommend this! Great vibes, fun music and absolutely banger food! Their spicy pineapple margarita was to die for! The staff was really nice and sweet, especially Elisa! Had a great time! :)

PS: apologies for the very amateurish click of the food! I was dying to dig in! xD

Super lovely staff—she was working alone but handled everything quickly and professionally! The chicken breast was crispy and juicy, and the fries were perfectly crunchy. I got the meal deal with cheese flavour—so tasty and great value. Totally recommend this Taiwanese chicken spot!

Finally tried Jichickens Chinatown and now I understand the hype. The queue was long but absolutely worth it. The volcanic cheesy chicken was insanely crispy, juicy, and packed with flavour. I also tried the crispy chicken breast, popcorn chicken, king prawns, and karaage — everything was fresh, crunchy, and delicious.

The lychee black tea with tapioca balls was really refreshing and paired well with the food, although the regular black tea wasn’t my favourite.

They have multiple branches across London and I’d definitely recommend giving it a visit if you love Taiwanese-style fried chicken.

Follow @nellysworldoftaste on Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube for the full food review!
The best fried chicken shop in Leeds, the fried vegetables are yummy as well! Strongly recommended!

Fantastic crispy fried chicken, well seasoned and bursting with flavour. The fried lotus root chips are unique and very tasty. Amazed to see chicken gizzards here on the menu, if you can get past the chewy texture they are worth trying.
Can get very busy in here, order inside & stand outside waiting & trying to hear your number being called. Definitely my favourite fried chicken, it's so crispy 😋

Ji Chicken's All-Time Favourite Chicken Popcorn are a delight! 🍗 Crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, each bite bursts with flavor. Perfectly seasoned and addictive, they’re an ideal snack or meal. A must-try for fried chicken lovers! 🌟

name: Silver Star Cambridgeheath
address: 489 Cambridge Heath Rd, Bethnal Green, London E2 9BU, UK

reviews.text:
£7.50 for this amount of pork??? Crazy, I could barely fit it all in a bowl. And look at the sear on the skin!!
Staff working there are also always friendly and they've got some wicked fish in their tank.

Best Chinese takeout joint in the area!

Rubbish food
Expected much more since there are barely any chinese spots in the area.
Gives stomach aches

Whatever you do guys , DO NOT EAT FROM HERE!  I have had dioreah for the past 3 days I have never had food poisoning so bad , I went in to the restaurant to buy , it’s not like it was delivered , and the food was stale the prawns were stale the sweet and sour chicken was stale all of it was TERRIBLE it tasted like plastic I can’t believe that they tried to tell me they were the best Chinese food in the area , DO NOT EAT FROM HERE!
20.05.2025

Ordered at 6.30pm, food finally arrived at 8.50pm. Called the restaurant twice and on both occasions was told the driver was on his way.
The food was cold, greasy and it appeared it had been thrown together in a hurry.
It's such a shame because we have used the restaurant before and have always been satisfied.
But at £55 for cold, greasy and rubbery food, we will most certainly NEVER use this restaurant again!!!
Shocking service!!

I have been a customer of the Silver Star for 24 years. Tonight, yet again, its shut for some reason that goes against running a financially viable business, what seems to be an unprofessional filming. The establishment/family have obviously become arrogant with their customers, so they deserve to be out of business.
Good bye - I will never order anything from you again.

Ordered a few times from here.  Last night ordered a take away and food was awful & inedible !! Called to complain and was told to complain to uber!! Never again. Disappointed in their service. Posted pics of pale prawns, over soya sauced rice,  apparently the prawns aren’t cooked in the rice … they’re placed on top… absolutely tasteless…..undercooked chicken balls & vegetable spring rolls, and  dry ribs as lid wasn’t on properly and honey spilled out everywhere.

Unbelievable, I guess quality and risk management aren’t part of their business plans. Ordered chicken chow mein that came out tasteless and plain. Chicken soup that was clearly microwaved; the rest was completely tasteless but I guess I should have figured it out since it took them 2minutes to make the food. No hospitality or reality check or actual capacity to deliver. They are clearly counting on the main road appeal to make up their sales, to say no efforts is made on the food whatsoever or anywhere else. Never to go back, the reviews actually speak for themselves should have checked before going.

The food was COMPLETELY bland and tasteless and basically just microwaved.
If I could leave 0 stars I would.
Me and my partner ordered at the shop and once we got home and tried the food it was literally inedible, luckily we live close by so just went back to the shop and got the money refunded as we weren’t just gonna let it slide. (Not received the money back yet)
There was no apology or reaction from the man behind the counter whatsoever.
Terrible food,terrible service.

I had a very disappointing and unsafe experience with this takeaway. I ordered prawns but received nothing but flour – not a single prawn in the dish. The rest of the food was inedible and made me feel unwell. When I called to complain and request a refund, the customer service was extremely poor and unhelpful. I would strongly advise others not to order from here. I need to have this restaurant takeaway. They need to be reported to trading standards for health and safety reasons.I don't understand why this hasn't been reported.Or they've not been shut down. How are these reports identified by the right department?

I have to give a star, but I would have given 0 out of 5

Boyfriend has moved to the area, so we decided to try our local last week. We got the classic lemon chicken and noodles with a 1/4 duck to share, and it was absolutely lovely! With the level of business they had on the evening, we were thoroughly impressed with the service and hand-on-heart were only sat in there for about 10 minutes waiting for our food. It was an overall pleasant experience and we will be coming back for absolute sure. The girl working behind the till (on her own, no less!) was so friendly, efficient and made our evening. Kudos to her, will be coming back so hope I can solidify my status as a regular!

I have been ordering from this place for as long as I can remember I’ve lived in this area for over 18 years. The restaurant has gone downhill. The food is become terrible. I’d placed £17 orders tonight and it was just awful. I tried to call them and let them know that there’s a problem with my sweet-and-sour chicken Hong Kong style. It was hard. It was tough. The chicken was overcooked and dry and the most day it often was a replacement one, but I’ve completely been put off by this food. The mushrooms stirfried mushroom the mushroom tasted off and had a really bad taste to it. I’ve literally just not eaten it and not been able to eat it. I expected a full refund, but if they’re not choosing to do that, I’m gonna ask my bank to refund me. The money for £17 is far from what I was expected and below average I will not be ordering any longer from this place.

Hi I was going order but I read the reviews and it put me off. I have ordered before and it was very good, I even referred my work colleagues there. Its been 5 months so I supposed they have dropped off Shape.

Do yourself a favour and avoid.  No point spending money with a business only to be left feeling disappointed, disrespected and verbally abused.  Speechless for this “Cash only” establishment.  This review is around service not the food.  Didn’t eat it.

This use to be best Chinese…. Don’t know what’s happened but it’s now discussing food comes cold and greasy delivery takes for ever so that’s why food cold and soggy as left far to long in back bike if that busy employee more drivers instead of making customers wait and deliver there food in a un edible state and most likely would food poisoning especially rice as it carries a lot bacteria when left..and definitely need learn customer services skills as you wouldn’t be able have a business if it wasn’t for your customers  so certainly  Shouldn’t be rude when your running your business into the ground also need change your oil and food taste of old oil won’t be ordering again and if anyone else thinking of I wouldn’t if I was you

I ordered phoenix special fried rice and what I got was meat on top of boiled rice,
I’ve had this before and it was nothing like this

name: Chun Easy Thai
address: 89 Whitechapel High St, London E1 7RA, UK

reviews.text: This is located in the White Hart pub. I was hungover and craving Thai and it hit the spot. I got the prawn pad thai takeaway and it had a generous serving of prawns and had good flavour and reasonably priced at £10.95. They also give peanuts and chilli on the side. Service was relatively quick too.

We accidentally ended up in this pub with friends. As a lover of exotic food, I was very happy. The Thai shrimp were delicious! There were some other dishes whose names I didn't remember, but I still remember the taste. And I will definitely come here again!
The best thai restaurant in the area hidden inside a traditional english pub. 5* star food, very traditional food and quick service all at the back of a local pub. Fair prices too, highly recommended

This pad Thai taste just like the one I had in Thailand, quite a big portion for the price
Prawn are not the best, £11 pad Thai get what I paid for
If you need some Thai food, this is the place!! The food was soooo good and the kitchen staff were so friendly. 10/10 recommend ❤

I always love getting the spicy doner from here. It’s properly spicy and hits the spot every single time. Very consistent and always on point. The food is fantastic, and the boss is always friendly and welcoming. Seating is available too, though it can get quite busy at times.

One of the worst pfc in east London omg the grilled wings the serve from the packets from local shop the add red sauce they give to show the make it but they don’t this is disgrace. The hot wing are nasty aswel had to trow it away the chips is cooked in a old oil you can smell it plz don’t waste ur money on here you might aswel have pot noodles instead

Very wide section/variety of food offered from peri peri, Indian dishes, fried chicken, burgers, kebabs and doners.

- Lamb Doner Meal - The doner was spicy and succulent, very tasty. Chips were fresh and to a good standard. A well priced meal which definitely will fill you up.

- Chicken Tikka Burger Meal - The burger was tasty and nice. Burger was made on a grill and charcoaled. Chips were fresh and to a good standard.

- Wings - Disappointing, would not order again. Tasted weird, the breading of the wings weren’t that bad, the chicken however.

I stopped by Royal PFC in Whitechapel the other night, craving some late-night comfort food. The smell of fried chicken and spicy wings hit me before I even stepped inside, and I knew I was in for something good. The menu looked promising—burgers, wraps, wings, all the classics—and the prices were fair too.

I ordered a Zinger Burger Meal and some peri fries, expecting a quick bite. But that’s where the story slowed down… a lot. What was supposed to be a fast-food stop turned into a mini waiting marathon. People were coming in, placing orders, and still waiting around like it was a bus stop during rush hour.

When my food finally arrived—20 minutes later—it was hot, crispy, and actually really tasty. The chicken had that perfect crunch, and the spicy mayo hit just right. It’s clear they put care into the food, just not into the timing.

Overall, Royal PFC Whitechapel serves solid food that’s worth the wait… if you’ve got the patience. Three stars—great flavor, but service slower than a buffering YouTube video.

Love the location of this shop, right opposite whitechapel station yet in the hustle and bustle of the hospital etc.
The chicken doner is delicious as well as the bread which isnt the usual pitta bread that they buy from somewhere.
Inconsistent service because its friendly on weekdays compared to weekends.
Cucumber slices had frost bite on the weekend.

Came here with my mum and we couldn't resist popping in – the shop was too tempting! We're so glad we did! The lamb doner wrap was 🔥 – fresh, full of flavour, and a generous portion. As a bit of a food snob, I can say it was top-notch 😋. Definitely coming back for more, Insha'Allah! 🥰 Might even try ordering online next time for the whole family. We look forward to trying other things on the menu.

Absolutely horrendous, total scam!

We ordered from Woody Pizza via Uber Eats and were completely misled. We ordered a margherita deep pan pizza with mozzarella sticks, what arrived was shocking. Instead of pizza, we received what can only be described as greasy garlic bread with a bit of awful cheese melted on top, and mozzarella sticks that looked (and tasted) like they’d been frozen for six months, then lazily defrosted and fried. Nothing about the order matched the description or photo.

Worse still, when we Googled “Woody Pizza 63 Essex Road” to complain, it redirected us to Islington Kebab which was clearly the same place, but under a different name. It seems they’re using the “Woody Pizza” alias to rack up better reviews and mislead customers. Absolutely disgraceful and deeply disappointing.

Avoid at all costs,  this is a scam. Check the real address and reviews before ordering. What we received was inedible and an outright con.
This place is totally awesome! Hussein is the best too! Always piles in the food so you really get your moneys worth. I went there 3 nights in a row while in London!

Nothing to complain about
Food was delicious fresh service was friendly and compared to what we would of spent in the pub amazing value.
Kofte was amazing
Happily come back

Food very tasty, but service was pretty grim as our order got forgotten (there was no one else in the shop). Tiny place to stand in. Salads look pretty sad, and it was only 10pm.

Up to you if you go I guess. Maybe you’ll have a better time and luck with the guys service up da meats

Tanvir was absolutely amazing, he was so gentle and kind. This food was very very authentic, I felt like I was back at home and I haven’t had authentic food in a while. Absolutely delish, found my new favorite spot. Bengali food in London has not hit this good before and I’ve been here about 3 years now. I super recommend this place!!

I’ve tried Bengali food before, so it wasn’t completely unfamiliar but this was my first time exploring different variations of bharta and they were all outstanding. Their fuchka is to die for.
The service and atmosphere were equally wonderful. Highly recommend. 🇧🇩❤️

If I could give this place 10 stars, I honestly would ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Kolapata is hands down one of the best Bangladeshi restaurants I’ve eaten at in London. The flavours genuinely took me straight back to Sylhet and Srimangal — rich, comforting, and full of that proper home-style taste.

Everything tasted fresh and cooked with real care. You can tell this is food made by people who truly understand Bangladeshi cuisine.

Must-try dishes:
• Roast chicken — perfectly spiced, juicy, and full of flavour
• Karachi biryani — fragrant, bold, and cooked exactly how it should be

On top of the amazing food, the service is outstanding — warm, welcoming, and always with a genuine smile. It really adds to the whole experience.

If you’re looking for authentic Bangladeshi food that tastes like home, this is the place. I’m already planning my next visit.

I had a fantastic experience at Kolapata Restaurant.The food is really good fresh, flavorful, and full of authentic taste. Every dish felt like it was made with care, and the portions were generous as well. Highly recommended .
After 15 years I came to visit London and tried Bangladeshi food in famous Kalapata restaurant. The food and atmosphere is the same as it was. Hospitality of staffs are amazing. Nostalgic! 🫡❤️🇧🇩

I'm honestly in shock. I chose to give this pizza place a try after seeing all the good reviews. Went there and got the prosciutto Funghi which actually had ham and mushroom pizza. I am sorry to say, but that was the most offputing pizza i have ever had in my life. None of the ingredients felt fresh. I literally had to pick up all the ham and set it aside just to be able to eat the rest of the pizza. The mushrooms were also quite stale and not even sure what cheese was that. Sorry for the owner as he was nice and he served us fast. But i will surely not order from there again.

We found the number on google maps and called to order a big pizza to collect while on our evening walk. The man working there was super friendly and easy going, and had the pizza ready and took a payment when we arrived 10 minutes later. The pizza itself was loaded with toppings (we ordered the Italiano) and had a perfect amount of cheese and lovely thin (but not super thin) base. It’s made on a Pizza-Hut style oven, so not traditional, but is the best takeaway pizza and service  you will get in Shoreditch - surpassing any of the chains. This will definitely be somewhere we will frequent. The sauces would hit differently if they were homemade, but no matter. The wings (spicy, not bbq) were also so nicely cooked and well seasoned.

What a great find! Had a super friendly chat while waiting for my pizza, which was so delicious I ate it all on my way home. Generous on ingredients (Mexicana Hot here), delicious on taste. Very good value for money and such nice people too. Will be my go to pizza place in the neighborhood 🍕🍕😋
PS. Forgot to add the cheeeeeese, literally stretching like spaghetti, so yummy 🤤

Honestly, the pizza was incredible. Super fresh, full of flavour, and you can really taste the quality of the ingredients. It didn’t feel rushed or mass-produced at all, just properly made pizza done right. The manager was also great, really friendly, welcoming. Between the amazing pizza and the great service, this is definitely somewhere I’ll keep coming back to. 🍕

This is hands down the best pizza ever! We live locally and absolutely devour this pizza any time we order it. The owner is so friendly and generous, he puts lots of care into his pizzas, they’re the definition of made with love and you can really taste it!! So many delicious toppings and the stuffed crust is amazing. The base stays crunchy and solid, which is impressive for how many ingredients are loaded on top. Highly recommend

Ate here a couple weeks back and kept meaning to write a review because I really enjoyed myself. Food tasted great and felt like good value. I was the only person in Sushi Co. the Sunday I visited but the two staff members were really friendly and accommodating. If I’m ever that way again I’ll definitely go back. Great stuff!

"Absolutely delicious! 🍣 We ordered a variety of rolls and sashimi, and every single bite was 10/10. You can really tell they use high-quality ingredients. The staff was friendly and attentive, ensuring we had everything we needed. Can’t wait to come back!"

I tried the Spices Salmon Crunch at The Sushi Co and it was amazing! The salmon was fresh and flavorful, with just the right amount of spice. The crunch added a perfect texture that made every bite enjoyable. Presentation was great too, and it felt really satisfying without being too heavy. Definitely something I’d order again!

Worst staff at your store please teach you colleague  name called Krishna! Please check the below attached pictures I told him customer name ( Sarah ) he gave wrong bag with name ( Paula ) when I explained him and showed the order again he started abusing please check your cameras and teach how to answer and respect someone! And am attaching the pictures of the order if you get any complaint from customer you staff is responsible for that.
Date 13/11
Time 12.46 to 12.50 in between
Really good food! Sadiq and Nitish were really nice in explaining the menu items! Great work guys. If I come back, it would be for them two.

name: Ruby House London
address: 260 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E2 0AA, UK

reviews.text: I don’t understand how this place has such a low score!! I got the dinner box with plain chow main, beef in red bean sauce and sweet and sour chicken balls, and it was all delicious. You get good quality for a great price. This will now be my regular takeaway option for sure.

One person dinner set is quite good especially for its amount and portion size! The sweet and sour chicken is good, could be softer but good price! Beef black bean sauce is great, tender beef! Ribs portion more than described! Will revisit! :))
Always order from here! Have amazing deals. Always get monk chicken Hong Kong style!!

my local hero chinese.

ruby house has delivered for me time and time again. the staple dishes are all there, but it's the meat-free specials that make ruby house so special!

under most of their dishes you have the option for: chicken, prawn, veg - but then also mock duck and mock chicken!

i love the mock duck - which i get salt and chilli style.

the order pictured is:
chilli salt mock duck
chilli salt chips
plain chow mein
barbecue sauce

super friendly staff & cash only if you're paying at the store!

Food wasn’t as great as normal. Can see was not looking not fresh as before, bit too soft. Never normally have, An issue with this place but unfortunately the quality was a bit low today. Very sad to be honest. As I use to get great food from this place. Pork was old.

name: Joy PO Hackney
address: 73 Mare St, Cambridge Heath Rd, London E8 4RG, UK

reviews.text: I was food poisoned from this place! I knew something was off with it but I was so hungry I continue to eat it and now I have green diarrhoea and bad belly pains for 3days now :( the pork ribs was dry and when I bit into it you can see it wasn’t fresh as it had that grey hard stale colour , the rice was old and the prawns was dry and chewy , I should of threw it away instantly but I didn’t and now I’m suffering from it :( just to note I have always brought my Chinese from here but never again!!

Order was delivered extremely quickly which is always a bit of a red flag. The food was awful, all of it was tasteless and dry, it looked as though it had been sat around for days. The highlight was probably some mediocre prawn crackers. I'd recommend avoiding at all costs.

Resturant is TAKE AWAY & CASH ONLY - just a heads up!

Lovely lil gem, Joy Po is our go to Chinese and is the best around imo

Shop is always clean/staff are always hygeinc when I visit on top of good customer service and great food.

You can call ahead and place your order if you don't want to wait in line.

Thank you to all staff at Joy Po who always provides us with an amazing meal and a smile! : )

I used to buy from this restaurant and quite enjoyed their food, but Joy Po's Food Standards Agency hygiene rating has dropped from 3, which isn't great, down to 2 out of 5, so until their rating improves, I cannot buy from this restaurant....
Had Chinese from there last night really enjoyed it dish’s was great and great price

name: Hoxton Best Kebab
address: St Leonards Mews, 241 Hoxton St, London N1 5LG, UK

reviews.text:
In March, I went to this Kebab shop (after the flower market), having passed it earlier.

I don't often have kebabs, but the lunchtime offers on window posters caught my attention, and to the point - for what I paid, the value was superb! I had this fries & lamb kebab mix, with jalapeños to lettuce, cucumber, etc, and altogether (with sauces), I still had plenty left. The fries were hot and crispy, while the kebab meat was succulent and fully of flavour. For what I paid (just over £5), the dish was tied well together, and the shop's now also known by the name the 'Greedy Cow'.

I was recommended to come here to have their Lahmacun, and it didn't disappoint. Tasty and reasonably priced and easy to eat on the go - cest bon! Can't comment on any other parts of the menu but I would have the Lahmacun's again
The perfectly named Hoxton best kebab is indeed hoxton’s best kebab, my go to for the last year, great service and particularly recommend the lahmacun with mix doner
Nice kebab but a bit over priced for what you get, especially in this location but nevertheless, nice.
Had a delicious lahmacun with doner in a wrap. Cost £9 and very good size. £4 for a straight lahmacun without doner meat. Definitely recommend it. No seats so takeaway or stand and eat.

name: New Surma Tandoori
address: 269 New N Rd, London N1 7AA, UK

reviews.text:
Great food, fast delivery, very reasonable price,
Ordered dinner for my family from here and everyone absolutely loved it, one of the best Indian takeaways in north London. All the dishes were full of flavour and the portion sizes were great, highly recommend

One of the best Indian takeaways I’ve been to in London, great portion size for the price, highly recommend the chicken korai, very unique flavour. Fast service and very friendly staff, highly recommend

I’m writing an honest review.  The chicken tandoori is excellent but too salty.  The food is very good but it appears overcooked and mushy for some dishes, like the Biryani’s vegetable curry.

Just a note to say some dishes are too salty and so difficult to eat.  It’s better to be under-salted than over-salted.  The service is excellent and food is made with kindness but too salty.  This review is for food that is delivered.  I hope this helps.

Update  - Found hair in the food.  Sorry but won’t be ordering again.
I went yesterday,I had best Indian food I got paneer Tikka , Chicken curry and naan food was top notch ,taste like authentic Indian food ,service was great.Huglg recommended place.
The food is nice enough but in the two times i have been i have both times been given something different to what i ordered.

name: Fennec & Parsley
address: Hoxton Shoreditch restaurant, 108 Hoxton St, London N1 6SH, UK

reviews.text: The best falafel and lamb wrap I’ve had in London. I first discovered it a few years ago, the shop doesn’t catch your attention from the outside but I’m so happy I went in. I’ve had several options, juices, smoothies, plates. It never disappoints. The falafel is so crispy and moist at the same time it’s truly the best. The portions are incredibly generous for the price, I can’t wait to visit again.

The place was cozy, stuff is kind and helpful. Mutabal dip is good too. But the wrap…
It was big, a lot of sous, vegetables, sounds good right? one big BUT: meat really wasn’t fresh and moreover it was so stringy and extremely unchewable! (Usually this part of meat used in making mince not for peaces)
Maybe next time I’ll try falafel
Delicious lentil soup. The falafel in the wrap was average, but I enjoyed that the salad was a lot of pickled vegetables. Good price.
One of the best falafels wraps I’ve had in London! Lovely pickled jalapeño and hummus. Service was really friendly.
The kibbeh and sambouseh were standard, but I quite liked the hummus and the chicken. I’ll definitely come back to try a main and reassess.

name: Black Bear Burger - Shoreditch
address: Unit 61, Boxpark, 10 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E1 6GY, UK

reviews.text: Very good burger. We got there at opening time and were alone for the most part. The food came quick and was well worth their good reviews. I can't say what it will be like when its busy. Had a bacon cheeseburger first time around. Next was their award winning Miso burger. The blue cheese sauce is very nice with a thick consistency.

Ok guys hear me out. This is the best burger i’ve had in my life, hands down. So juicy, so tasty, a real burst of flavors. I had the Double Miso Bacon Burger and from the very first bite it was clear why it’s an award winning burger. Fries were excellent as well!
Don’t skip this place cause it’s pure magic

Quite expensive for the size of burgers.
They are nice and tasty and juicy but it cost nearly £46 for 2 x Miso burgers, 2 x garlic parmesan fries and 2 x drinks. Not a massive choice either.

The burgers at Hanbao in Birmingham or Patty Freaks in Lichfield are twice the size, also more choice of loaded fries and burgers.

Phenomenal burger worth all the hype.
The burger was moist and juicy, and the sauce was absolutely delicious.
Upstairs, there are tables, so plenty of places to sit. Highly recommended!
It’s just a shame the burger is small otherwise, I’d give it 5 stars.

Phenomenal burger. Worth all the hype. burger was moist and juicy; sauce was dee-lish. (if one teeny teeny complaint - woulda been best-of-all-time if it had pickles in it!). Upstairs boxpark - so plenty of places to sit. RECOMMEND.

Enjoyed my meal here. I had the Ramadan special consisting of the Mexican Beef Burger, chips, drink, Jelapeno Cheese poppers and 6 churros for £13. Really enjoyed although I felt the burger wasn’t very big. The service was great with the staff member recommending items in detail. The place is extremely clean inside.

Clean, aesthetic and simple atmosphere. You can instantly tell even when they serve you and how the food looks it’s so simplistic and beautiful. It’s an eye candy. And the food is absolutely delicious. Super friendly customer service and they’re very happy to see you coming back because you enjoy the food so much. Halal and absolutely worth it.  Reasonable prices, not too cheap like KFC or McDonalds that you question the quality and profit, but not too expensive you will walk out of the door empty handed. Just right.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (5/5)

Was visiting London and drove past this place the other day — decided to give it a try today, and I’m glad I did!

I had the Beef Habanero Jam burger and it was on point — perfect if you like your burger with a bit of a kick. The loaded fries were also spot on, but what really stood out to me were the fries themselves. They tasted amazing — definitely high-quality, not the cheap kind you sometimes get elsewhere.

Overall, a solid 9/10. Would definitely come back!
Very nice chicken burger. Very accommodating when we showed up in a group of 8 even if the place is somewhat small. If we are in the area again we will be back
Very busy burger shop , there is not enough seating capacity, service was good food was fantastic price is little bit expensive then others shop, there is very difficult to find parking

Was looking for a new place for dinner tonight. Found this place and it is amazing. Had fresh prawn summer rolls with sweet sauce, golden spring rolls (packed with prawn and pork filling), chicken pho, beef pho with tendon meatballs, Mama's chicken thighs with rice and homemade passion fruit lemonade (we asked for extra sweet). Simply gobsmackingly excellent. All came as big generous portions, fresh, delicious, well balanced, authentically tasty and so satisfying in all ways foodwise. The place was warm and welcoming on a cold night out, bright, clean and the tables well spaced out, not cramp at all.  Service was fast, helpful and friendly from the lovely young lady, who is the daughter of the 2 owners/chefs (one from Hanoi and one from Saigon). The food is authentically a flavourful and well balanced mixture of the specialities from their hometowns. The tables had all the condiments and all the cutlery needed/expected. The atmosphere is nostalgically of an old fashioned South East Asian coffee shop cafe or kopitiam, with the smell of sturdy proper wood furniture and a wall decorated with Vietnamese art nouveau posters, with an antique phone on one wall too. It made us feel so comfortably at home with the whole place. Everything about this place met and then exceeded expectations. It was so worthwhile to try this place which will now be our regular Vietnamese place to eat in London. Totally recommend this place.

We came on a Wednesday afternoon and even though it looked pretty quiet and unassuming from the outside, this little place turned out to be brilliant.

The food was absolutely delicious and really filling. The value for money is amazing, you'd be hard-pressed to find anything better this close to the centre.

Our banh mi was perfectly crispy with loads of flavour. As for the pho, it's easily the best we've had in London. The broth was rich and fragrant, just how it should be.

This place totally deserves its 4.9-star rating. Definitely worth a visit!

LGBTQ FRIENDLY Restaurant! The best vietnamese in london! i don't think I've tried any better meal for such a price. What an amazing find. The staff is so nice here. Lgbtq friendly as well the waiter throughout my dining experience here, the waiter did use the pronouns of my choice which I'm so happy about. The waiter Hugh helped us with choosing the meals. We had salt and pepper prawns and pho beef brisket.

Been wanting to try this place since it's a little closer to me than my usual pho place down the road. First impressions, it smells a little funny when you step in. Honestly, smells bit like toilet but it also gives off a very homey family run vibe.

Ordered the betel wrapped beef which I was a little concerned about because the inside was slightly rare but I was completely fine. For my main, I had the pho with rare beef. This was good. Generous meat and noodle portions. More than my usual place which was great. But I think the broth didn't cut it for me. It's unable to replicate that rich buttery taste that my usual pho place down the road. Sad as I really wanted to like it so I'd have more options.

Another good thing about this place is they have lots of sauces and pickled garlic at each table. I can't have my pho without pickled garlic. Saw some reviews about the cleanliness/hygiene and honestly it was fine. Very clean cutlery. No issues at all. The restaurants staff were very polite and attentive.

Already miss this place! Had delicious and hot pho and mamas chicken and it was so yummy, comforting. Perfect for a cold London day! Cannot wait to go back! The portions sizes were too big and inexpensive

Never been more disappointed!
Came here cos of a TikTok review
What a mistake that was

Dragon wings 🍗 - ⭐️⭐️⭐️ Literally REGULAR WINGS lightly coated in a naga chilli sauce you find in PFC shops but it was the best of the bunch. Still tasted STALE.

BBQ wings 🍗 - ⭐️⭐️ Regular wings covered in CHEAP TANGY BQQ SAUCE. Had to scrape it off! TANGINESS was so OVERWHELMING couldn’t finished the last wing. Wasn’t fresh tasted STALE.

Double cheeseburger 🍔 - ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ The burger itself was ok with adequate topping but the patty lacked salt so became BLAND.

Mexican Smash Burger 🍔 - ⭐️⭐️ Meat inside tasted WATERY and UNDERCOOKED. There was a sharp pickle sauce added which did not complement the burger. Had to remove jalapeños

Fries 🍟 - ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Regular fries tasted as they should not too greasy.

Drinks 🧃- ⭐️⭐️⭐️ Not much of a selection and NO SUGAR FREE options.

Price 💵 - ⭐️⭐️ A complete RIP OFF: 5 flavoured wings for £5 but 10 regular wings for £4.50. Was better off getting the regular wings as they tasted better. Spent £25 altogether was NOT WORTH PRICE TAG.

Customer Service 💁 - ⭐️⭐️⭐️ Staff looked DEFLATED. Not much conversation and didn’t understand what the person who was taking our order was saying. Staff were NOT ATTENTIVE. Had to collect the food from the counter.

Atmosphere ⛲️ - ⭐️⭐️⭐️ Seating was ok but they left the door open which let the cold breeze come in

Toilet/Wash facilities 🚻 - None

Supreme? Just another hyped up place on social media. This just felt like a fried chicken shop trying to expand its menu but food is not on par. Not returning for the flavoured wings again but the regular fried wings were ok
Food was tasty. Service was excellent and quick. Would definitely go again!

I recently visited Supreme, and I have to say, it was an absolute delight! The roulette wings were out of this world — the flavors were bold and unique, unlike anything I’ve had before. I’ve been to plenty of places for wings, but nothing compares to the taste and freshness of these. They really stand out, and the seasoning was spot-on!

But the real surprise was the doner kebab. It was absolutely excellent! The flavors were incredible, and what impressed me most was how fresh and clean it tasted. There was no oily or greasy feeling, just pure, delicious goodness. It was the kind of doner kebab that makes you want to keep coming back for more.

On top of that, the service was fast and friendly. Everything came out quickly, and the staff made sure I was well taken care of. If you’re in the area, this place is definitely worth a visit. The combination of great food and top-notch service makes Supreme a standout!

I went to Supreme Wings and really liked it! I was really hungry so that’s what I ordered: Half Boneless Chicken, Halloumi Fries and a Cheeseburger. Everything was crispy, juicy and full of flavour.

The staff were kind and my food was ready quickly. The place was clean and had a nice vibe.

You get a good amount of food for the price and everything tasted fresh. I’ll definitely come back again!

I had a fantastic experience at Supreme. The food was fresh, flavorful, and served quickly — the wings, burgers, and doner were all delicious. The staff were friendly and welcoming, and the restaurant was clean and comfortable. For the price, the portion sizes and quality are excellent.

If you’re in Brick Lane and want tasty fast food, this place is definitely worth a visit!

name: Monster Burger BBQ & Grill House London

reviews.text:
I see the hype.
Good food at good prices.
Ordered a rump steak (the only steak they do) medium-rare.
Yes I’ve had better steaks but obviously the better cuts cost more.
This steak was decent for the price, slightly chewy and they smother it with mushroom sauce. Don’t think they offer any other sauces as I wasn’t asked this when ordering.

Service was okay-ish, we came in and saw a table free but then was told there was people waiting before us and had to go to the counter to get seated, we then was seated at the table we first saw.
Other than that the staff were attentive and friendly

The atmosphere was decent but this place is as soon as you finish eating they would want you to leave as this place is busy

I would recommend this place and would go again

Went to Monster Burger Whitechapel with a few friends and had a really good experience overall. I had the steak with fries, another friend had the same, and our other friend ordered the BBQ ribs. We also tried the strawberry mojitos and they were honestly really nice and refreshing.

The food itself was great, everything came out hot, tasty and satisfying. It’s definitely a good spot to go with friends when you just want proper comfort food and a chill hangout.

Only downside is that the place is quite small and very busy. They don’t take reservations so we had to queue for around 15–20 minutes to get a table. Because it’s so compact and there’s a constant flow of people coming in and out, hygiene is decent but not spotless, understandable considering how packed it gets.

On the plus side, it was easy to find and once seated the experience was enjoyable. Overall a good time, good food and worth the visit, just be ready to wait a bit during peak hours.

Went to try it as I heard good review on it. The reason why I gave food 4 star is because the brisket loaded fries were slightly sweeter than I would’ve liked. And when I asked them about it, they said the meat is ready made so that’s how it comes.
The steak and chips were really nice. Came with good amount of salad, drizzled with mushroom sauce 😋 Make sure to order medium rare if you want it tender. Service was 10/10. Went around 11pm, the place was quite busy so we had to wait around 10-15 mins to be seated. Big downside is the menu is written in red, with black background and there’s no pics. I did tell one of the workers that the menu could do with upgrading. Too much to read!
Toilet was ok, the bin was full, almost overflowing. Would definitely recommend this place.

We ate here not knowing what to expect but we were pleasantly surprised.

Monster burger - The beef was well cooked, nice and juicy. Everything in the burger was on point and was complimented well by the House Naga sauce.

Rump Steak N Chips - This was very nice. The portion sizes were generous. The salad was tasty too.

BBQ Ribs - This was my favourite. It was nice and tender meat cooked beautifully.

I would definitely recommend Monster Burger.

Had the brisket loaded fries, chicken wings and the monster burger! It was delicious 😋 and I can understand why it's so busy.

Flavours is on point and just want to go back for more and try out more things on their menu! I need to explore more of their food.

I'm so happy I found this place within minutes walk from east london mosque. Will DEFINITELY be back, and highly recommend to all!

Dishoom definitely lives up to the hype. We were a group of five and didn’t have a reservation, but we were able to join the line and got a table in about 45 minutes. The best part was that they offer complimentary drinks while you wait, which made the experience much more enjoyable.

The food was absolutely delicious and worth the wait. My favourites were the lamb biryani and the lamb chops — both were incredibly flavourful and perfectly cooked.

Top tier. The food was incredible, the service was excellent - friendly, informed, and prompt. One of our group members had a unique allergy (onions) and the staff worked diligently to highlight the menu items she could eat.

All around phenomenal time. Highly recommend for locals and travelers alike. As mentioned by a previous reviewer, the staff are also happy and seem to enjoy their job which elevates the experience in my book.

Would recommend: New Keema Pau, Lamb Biryani, Garlic Naan, Murgh Malai, and Raita

Visited the Shoreditch franchise today and it was nothing but the best! The staff is unbelievably friendly yet professional. Can’t expect this in heart of London anywhere nowadays. Sat in the Veranda section which is outside the main wing of the restaurant and the ambience is next level. Comfy sofas with low table or choices of high table as per own choice.
