Food is excellent and service is prompt. Kids friendly and wheelchair accessible. Would definitely recommend Serene who is the host ( supervisor ) who plays an inevitable part in running the busy operation so smoothly.

1 hour wait at 5:30PM on a December Friday. Excellent Indian food in a cozy and eclectic setting. You sit in cushy armchairs as you share saucy dishes across a coffee table. Such a fun place to eat among good company. We ordered the fried okra, black daal, ruby chicken, mattar paneer, lamb chops, an order of rice and multiple orders of garlic naan. They were all do delicious and full of flavours and spices. I would happily order them all over again.

Lovely and very knowledgeable staff. A very large menu to choose from with a lot of detail both for food and drinks. The interior has such a great vibe. You can tell a lot of attention and effort went into creating the atmosphere. All staff were super lovely and the manager came around to each table which was a lovely attentive touch. The food itself was great. It was my first time eating at dishoom and I was far from disappointed. Each dish was full of flavour. However, I found the naan to be a bit lacking. I've had better naan from local curry shops. Definitely not bad but not the best naan I've had, which is the reason for the 4 stars on food. The desserts were great, highly recommend the rice pudding! Will definitely come again.

Cute pan-asian style restaurant with nice decor and some good food options.

The Crispy Tofu and Aubergine were delicious. The fried chicken bao was also great. The Pork Katsu Yaki and Pork Belly Bao were quite dry though - so will probably avoid those specific pork dishes in future.

It was okay value when discounted through The Fork app (50%)... But I probably wouldn't pay full price.

Absolutely delicious food, great atmosphere and friendly staff. I choose here for my husband’s birthday treat and it did not disappoint. Food prepared fresh in front of you and wonderful flavours. Lovely cocktails too!
The food was so nice Mr. Irfan very helpful person. Every dishes are amazing thank you so much for Türk the good food and very lovely restaurant.
My friend and I came after work and it was superb! We took the recommendation of 4 plates each (& then shared) and it was plenty. Very attentive service, delicious food and a cosy environment.

Really nice selection of dishes. Each one we had was cooked well, and really nicely flavoured.
The real let down was the service. Not attentive, hard to get anyone to help with ordering more drinks, getting the bill etc. Never cleared our empty plates at all during the meal.
The table next to us was also complaining about the service so it must be a bigger problem.
There was enough people working so I think they need more training.

This is such a lovely gem that’s so easy to miss because it’s tiny. With just a handful of tables to fill, it feels family style and so welcoming. Somehow all the food is completely  vegan but if you’re not veggie or vegan you won’t even notice. They have both regular veggie options as well as meat replacements and they both are so good. Would have loved the kimchi pancakes to be a little thicker but that’s honestly the only negative I can think of. Everything else was fabulous.

This tiny vegan Korean restaurant near Liverpool Street statio, serving up the tastiest dishes and friendliest service!

I tried the fat roll kimbap where the texture of the vegan sausage was so alike to meat!
The crispy tofu bibimbap was delicious! Packed with veggies and a generous portion of rice, you could easily share between two.

The owner is very sweet and has a great sense of humour — will be back soon

Where do I start ? This place is amazing!!! It’s a gem for sure, the place is very cozy.

The menu has a lot of options (it was hard to decide). Our favourite was the ‘Beef’ bulgogi, the meat replacement was very tender and the sauce was delicious.

The service is exceptional! Nichelle extremely professional, attentive and emphatic. She even held our baby for us to be able to eat in peace with no stress. Thank you Nichelle you are so kind, can’t wait to be back to visit and eat the tasty Korean food. ❤️❤️❤️

This restaurant is tucked away in a very unassuming part of the City, you wouldn't notice it unless you knew it were there. But inside it was very cosy and homely. Service was friendly and welcoming and it was very clean. I had a lovely tofu bibimbap, sushi and pancake, all cooked perfectly cooked and well-priced. This place shows how Korean food can definitely be vegan and delicious!

Flavourful vegan Korean food with friendly service! Everything was delicious and cooked perfectly - the highlights for me were the fried chicken, bulgogi rice and japchae. The restaurant had a cozy homely vibe - it is quite a small restaurant, so you may have to wait for a table but it is worth it.

name: Adana Turkish with Fusion®
address: 267 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E2 6AH, UK

reviews.text:
Honestly I don’t know why we didn’t come here a week ago for my 20th anniversary! First time eating here and the food, the atmosphere and the customer service is amazing. My son and I really enjoyed our time here. We even got Turkish tea!
InshaAllah definitely will be coming again.

Ordered a mix platter for one, which was really good and flavoursome! The portion side was adequate, although there's no consistency as I ended up with very small sized chops compared to the others which were on the larger side.. I understand that's 'meat' but there's ways if making it more consistent. Small area at the back for payer space or private dining.
Overall, I'd definitely go there again

I visted this restaurant yesterday and had a very nice time. I ordered the lamb beyti; the portion was great and the food itself was tasty - my only complaint would be that the dish was listed under "yoghurt dishes" but was not served with any yoghurt (like I've had with the dish in other restaurants). The atmosphere was nice and the complementary bread was delicious. I would recommend this restaurant to anyone who enjoys nice grilled Turkish food.

Turkish food with a fusion twist! Adana has always been on point with their food, it’s been an option to come back to regularly and have always been fair on price. From the fresh bread, condiments (their fusion spicy sauce is amazing) and their good pricing and portion, can’t fault it. The half chicken meal is awesome, Adana burger and chips is tasty. Today we ordered the platter 2 for £45, comes with 2 drinks, salad and hummus, your standard Turkish platter. The platter itself comes with chops, ribs, wings, Adana, chicken and lamb cubes and shawarma, served with white and bulgar rice. Food is 10/10, customer service is great!

Everything about the Hungry Mouths Platter… amazing. The wings succulent, the chops juicy, lamb Kofte was moist and flavourful.  Every thing was 10/10. Maybe might need to go again so see if it weren’t a fluke. Just writing this review is making my mouth water. Honestly for the amount of food provided and cooked under 30 minutes is truly impressive and for it to taste great. Quite expensive though, between 4 people but worth it. Service was great and friendly.

I had a really nice chicken shawarma platter here, the shwarma was fresh and tasty, as was the salad and dips. The restaurant is clean and artistic. This place is a gem, I will be back and recommending to others.

The man who served us (I believe he is the owner), was very welcoming and kind, he looked after us. Bless him, a beautiful soul. We were even given complimentary sweets.

I went to this restaurant yesterday afternoon. I ordered a chicken shawarma wrap, and a lamb shawarma wrap. The restaurant owner surprised me by serving me a ‘mix shawarma’. Essentially a shawarma wrap with both lamb and chicken meat. I thought it wasn’t going to be enough. I’m happy to report that not only was the food was really delicious but it was very fulfilling. I didn’t need two shawarmas after all. The one was more than enough.

Best shawarma I’ve ever tried in London by a long shot. Very flavourful. The meat was delicious and halal. The staff were super friendly. Awesome ambience considering the surrounding area of Brick Lane. I can’t recommend this restaurant highly enough. Awesome, awesome food.
الله يوفقكم
😇👍
Had a fantastic chicken shawarma platter and it didn't not disappoint. Lovely service, a very pleasant and calming vibe inside. I'll be back x

I would like to share my experience at this restaurant, which was truly outstanding and worth mentioning.

I travelled from quite a distance (around an hour and a half), and the visit was absolutely worth it.

The food was exceptionally delicious, clearly prepared with care, and everything was very clean and well presented.

The service was excellent, and the staff were professional, welcoming, and courteous.

Overall, I highly recommend this restaurant and would gladly visit again.
Delicious food, friendly staff and authentic interior make this place a great spot for Middle Eastern cuisine lovers.

Delicious complex make sure you go around and see everything!

It's nice to get there in the morning when they open and all the pasties are fresh...
Around lunchtime the savory area more buzzy with fresh pasta and pizza and salad and afternoon people's coming for after work drinks and dinner

Upstairs you got planty of amazing ingredients that suit home cooking and gifts!

Eataly is a cool place to spend a day at.
Big highlight are the ice creams that reminds me of the time spent in Italy.
I can’t really rank the food as I only tried it once like 2 years ago and I remember what quite pricey and not the best.
This place has a nice vibe.
It’s definitely worth visiting.
It’s so many options for dessert, chocolates, biscuits, pastas, wine and many many more.

Chef Dimitris Christou is a master of his craft. Our pizza class today was expertly organised, engaging, extremely informative and fun! Olive oil, tomatoes, herbs, flours, yeast - great ingredients, great discussion. I’d have loved to stay all day discussing processes and ingredients with Chef. We made our own pizza dough from scratch then completed the pizzas on proved dough (we were to take home our made dough for proofing - bonus pizza at home!). The tomato sauce was infused with slow cooked, melt in the mouth garlic and top quality oregano. We chose our own toppings and minutes later relaxed with our beautifully cooked pizzas. The dough was exceptional.
I returned home with my dough and a lot more knowledge. I thoroughly recommend🏆🍕

Italy taste in the heart of London! The menu has exactly what Italy has best: pizza/pasta and red wine!
Pizza is freshly baked and their own home pasta are simply delicious.
Eataly has even his own brands to be bought in their shop which has a plethora of choices such as pastas, olive oil, gourmet salami and cheese!
A must go if you like italian cuisine!

Chef Dimitrios Christou’s pizza class was amazing! We made our own pizza dough from kneading to opening it (the best part), created our own sauce and added toppings, and the final result was delicious. His knowledge of Italian food history is incredible, and the class felt like a comedy show. Fun, engaging, and full of great cooking tips. Highly recommended! 🍕

Came to have our anniversary dinner here. The food, service and atmosphere was beyond my expectations. Everything was neat and clean. Shehnaj was really helpful with a beautiful smile on her face. She served us really well. Looking forward to visit here again soon. 5 star rating

Went there for our wedding Anniversary on 14th February. It was an amazing experience.As starter we tried hummus with lamb.its was fabulous. For mains we tried there lamb shank and iskender both were mouthwatering. If you you like turkish food i would recommend you to try this. Their service behaviour and ambiance was good and Our attended shehnaz was amazing. ❤️❤️
Best Hummus! Chicken Shish was perfection! You must try when in London. Ohhh Porn Star Martini was Epic! Sorry started dessert before pic, it was delicious!!!Great central location!

This is a lovely place. I was just visiting London and looking for somewhere to enjoy a hearty meal, and I’m so glad I found it. The service was excellent, the food was delicious, and the prices were very fair. I’ll definitely be coming back and becoming a regular here.

The food was great. The staff was friendly and we i didn't have to wait long for my order. On the recommendation of the kind waitress, I tried the chocolate cake, which was also very good. This restaurant has a cozy atmosphere and high quality. Highly Recommend

I’ve been here several times before because it’s one of my friend’s favourite restaurants, and since my brother was visiting, I wanted to bring him along. I had originally booked for 9:00 pm, but after walking for hours we arrived at 8:00 pm, thankfully, they were happy to seat us earlier with no issues.

We were welcomed with papadum served alongside two sauces (one yogurt‑based and the other slightly spicier) plus some vegetables as starters. Tap water was readily available on the table.

We ordered the mutton tikka, which I can’t recommend enough, the flavour and texture were fantastic. For mains, we had the Karahi king prawn and the aloo meat (potato and lamb) curry. Both dishes were delicious and very filling. We also had pilau rice and one of my favourite items on the menu: the Peshwari naan (coconut).

Everything was excellent, the food arrived quickly, and the staff were very friendly. Highly recommended if you’re in Whitechapel.

One of the best proper curry houses in London, with authentic flavours in a busy and popular environment.

Bring your own booze, or don’t have any, there are soft drink options which accompany the meal nicely.

The lamb chops and garlic naan are outstanding, and all the curry dishes are great.

Sometimes a little wait if you don’t have a reservation but it’s easy to see why as it’s always packed, across 3 floors. At lunchtime it can be a bit quieter, eg Sunday afternoon.

Is a great evening out with a group, the atmosphere is energetic and the food arrives quickly after ordering, and doesn’t disappoint.

Fair prices, consistent quality and a fun visit.

A great experience here. The atmosphere is lively, and it was completely packed. I would definitely book in advance - even this doesn’t guarantee you a table, it just pushes you to the front of the queue! The food itself was absolutely delicious - so flavoursome, and so much of it. The meat biryani (the house special on a Friday night) was unreal.
The service was attentive and friendly, and the prices were fair, especially for London. I’d highly recommend this restaurant - thank you very much

Tayyabs never fails to impress. I tried the fish curry this time and it was honestly to die for—perfectly spiced and so fresh. It even comes with a complimentary salad which is a nice touch. Just a heads up: this place is a powerhouse. Even on a Tuesday at 4:00 PM, it was already buzzing and very busy, so plan accordingly. Highly recommend!

One of my all-time favourite places for Punjabi food.

I always go straight for the tandoori lamb chops. They arrive sizzling from the tandoor with deep char, spice, and incredible flavour. I love the dry lamb or mutton curry and the saag paneer alongside it, with a fresh garlic and coriander naan to mop everything up.

The place is always buzzing. I like that you can see the kitchen working flat out and the food still comes quickly despite how busy it is.

It’s only a few minutes walk from Aldgate East tube. There’s no alcohol licence, but they will put a bottle opener on the table and there’s a good selection of chilled beers a few doors down to bring with you.

Big flavours, serious char, and the smell of spice in the air that happily follows me home.

Absolutely disgusting lunch today! Had a take away salmon sushi set and the salmon was just the offcuts. Chewy and inedible! The sort of thing I'd serve to my cat. And at £9.95, outrageous....ended up in the bin

*edit - I ordered the sushi set with the spicy salmon on top….ive added a pic, as you can see the salmon was inedible! Only ate the rice as was starving.

We ordered sushi once a week from this place. We loved it. I had to do a review because it can be one of the best sushi takeaways in Central and is not super expensive.

I love the chicken bites, and we have tried all the special sushi. One of my favourites is the mango one. I love it!

I haven’t been to the restaurant, but I would love to, as the food is top-notch.

I love the spicy edamame, but it has sauce in it and is not the normal chilly that you find in most of the restaurants.

If you had the opportunity to order takeout, please do; you will not regret it. I’ll update you on the restaurant and service when I’m there. Hopefully, next month.

I’ll recommend all the sushi dishes and, of course, the chicken bites!

My go to sushi place, (they offer discounts at night).
Anywayyy, wonderful service from Claudio. The shop was a vibe (he was sucha diva 🙇‍♀️✨), he's also quite approachable. Thank you!!

First time buy sushi from LOH japandi kitchen. Lovely staff at 9pm~ on mon 23/02/2026. So fresh and soft rice! I buy again and try to other hot foods too.
Thank you so much 👏👏👏👍

Interesting concept, well executed. The sushi boxes feature some imaginative flavour combinations and are always fresh. It’s with visiting earlier in the day for the widest selection, as the most popular boxes do sell out!
I’ve never ordered from the hot counter but combination meals are available here too, with a good selection of dishes to choose from. They also sell assorted Japanese snacks (like Hi-Chew) at the till, which are worth trying!

We had the Iftar set menu, really nice experience to try a bit of everything. My favourite was the slider burger (would’ve been nicer if they gave more than one as it’s very small). The soup was my least favourites as well as the cheese part of the course. The roast could’ve had a lot more gravy as it was really lacking it. The dessert was nice though. It’s great they have a prayer space. Overall nice experience.

We visited today for the iftar tasting menu with five courses and what a delightful experience it was.

We booked in advance and I am glad we did as it was fully booked.

We were greeted with dates and a sweet starter to break fast and there is a spacious prayer room in the basement to perform prayers. Mashallah tabarakAllah, for that alone I pray this establishment continues to see success.

The food itself was creative, surprising,and full of flavour. The lentil soup as a cappacuino shot was well received, and the lamb shank croquette, wagyu burger, and the roast were standouts. The cheddar and Quince dish was flavoursome, but I do feel it could be replaced with a maybe more out of the box dish. It is a pleasant palate cleanser, but maybe something more crisp and refreshing could work.

The lattes were very good and so we do look forward to visiting again for brunches and dinners.

The staff were incredibly attentive, welcoming, and friendly - it was quite clear that the full team enjoys the work and what they do and that reflected well in both the quality of service and the operational excellence they displayed.

We would recommend this place many times over.

We chose **Meli-Melo in Brick Lane** to celebrate my wife’s birthday, and it couldn’t have been a better choice. From the moment we arrived, the atmosphere felt warm, stylish, and perfect for a special occasion. The staff were attentive without being overbearing and made the evening feel relaxed and enjoyable.

The food was honestly **10/10**. We started with beautifully presented drinks — fresh, vibrant mocktails packed with flavour, including a refreshing mint and citrus drink and a rich strawberry-based mocktail that tasted as good as it looked. Perfect way to start the meal.

For food, everything was spot on. One of the highlights was the **loaded platter**, generously topped with sauces and fresh ingredients — indulgent, full of flavour, and great for sharing. We also had a comforting, rich **crispy potato-style dish topped with finely grated cheese**, which was incredibly moreish.

The mains were outstanding. The **roast-style meat dishes** were cooked to perfection — tender, juicy, and full of depth, served with beautifully roasted potatoes, vegetables, Yorkshire pudding, and rich gravy. Presentation was elegant, and every element on the plate worked perfectly together.

Overall, the quality of the food, the attention to detail, and the atmosphere made it a memorable evening. My wife absolutely loved it, which says everything. If you’re looking for a place in Brick Lane for a celebration or just an exceptional meal, **Meli-Melo is a must**. Highly recommended.

We went for the iftar dinner. Each of the courses were exquisite and were definitely a welcome treat. They were also presented beautifully and had good portion sizes. The staff were friendly, attentive and had fantastic service despite the busy iftar crowd. Everything was organised so well. I will definitely be going again to try some of the other items on their menu.

I recently visited Meli Melo on Brick Lane for their Sunday roast, and the whole experience was exceptional from beginning to end.

The roast itself was absolutely fantastic - perfectly cooked meat, crisp-yet-tender vegetables and a rich, flavourful gravy that tied everything together beautifully. Every element tasted thoughtfully prepared, and it was clear the kitchen takes real pride in their food.

When it came to dessert, we genuinely couldn’t decide… so we ordered a variety of them, and I’m so glad we did! Each one was incredible in its own way - beautifully plated, full of flavour and clearly made with top-quality ingredients. Whether you prefer something indulgent, fruity, or lighter, there’s a dessert here that will completely win you over.

The atmosphere at Meli Melo is just as impressive as the food. The staff are warm, attentive and genuinely passionate about what they do. The cosy, vibrant setting makes it the perfect spot for a relaxed Sunday meal or a special treat.

Overall, Meli Melo delivered one of the best Sunday dining experiences I’ve had in London. Delicious food, amazing desserts, lovely people - highly recommended and I’ll definitely be returning!

After a long day shopping in Whitechapel, Gram Bangla was exactly where we needed to be.

This was something we’d been meaning to do for a long time, but it just took a while to get everyone together. I remember coming here years ago with my mum when I was younger — a distant memory — but today we returned as a family, and I was genuinely looking forward to it.

I’d heard so much about their Khalabuna, so that was non-negotiable on the order list.

From the moment the doors opened, the ambience and cleanliness stood out straight away. We’re quite particular about hygiene, and you can immediately tell when a place takes pride in this. Sadly, there are places where that’s questionable — but this wasn’t one of them at all. It felt clean, calm, and well kept.

The sister serving us was warm and welcoming and seated us at the large table at the back. Soon after, a spread appeared in front of us that looked incredible. We ordered meat curry, chicken roast, Khalabuna, and a spinach-and-beans dish that was a little unusual — but in a really good way.

What really caught my attention was how the food was served: straight from the cooker in the small metal pans with handles, still sizzling, alongside a huge plate of rice. And then there were the clay plates — something I’d never seen before — which added a beautiful, traditional touch.

The food arrived quickly, and we tucked in straight away.

The halal bunna really did hit the spot. The way it looked, the way it smelt — everything was just right. Rich, deep flavour, comforting, and exactly how it should be. The family absolutely loved the chicken roast too. It wasn’t dry at all, lightly coated with masala on top, really flavourful, with a subtle hint of coconut coming through.

My son completely gobbled up the meat curry with aloo. We shared all the dishes between us, family-style, and honestly, loved every bit of it.

I’ll admit — I’m one of those Bengalis who doesn’t eat fish. Unfortunately, I had a childhood incident with fish, and ever since then I’ve just been completely put off. That said, my wife tried the dry fish bhorta and said it was amazing — full of flavour and done exactly how it should be.

This didn’t feel like typical restaurant food. It felt proper. Homemade. The kind of food you’d expect in a Bangladeshi household, cooked with care rather than shortcuts.

By the time we finished, we were completely full — and I was already thinking about the drive home.
Alhamdulillah, the experience was perfectly topped off with a cup of proper deshi chai.

We all walked out with full stomachs and smiles on our faces.

If you’re looking for genuine, homemade-style Bangladeshi food, this is absolutely the place to be.

A massive thank you to the sister who served us — warm, welcoming, and attentive throughout.
And a massive thank you to the Gram Bangla team for creating such an amazing space and experience.

Our first Bangladeshi cuisine and we're very happy. Delicious and authentic. There are many vegetarian options too. Rather spicy too which we love so much.
There are few photos on the front door showing King Charles & Queen Camilla have visited this restaurant.

I had lunch at Gram Bangla and it was an absolutely delightful experience. The food was incredibly delicious and full of authentic Bangladeshi flavours — it truly reminded me of home-cooked meals, just like my mother’s cooking. Every dish tasted fresh, well-balanced, and comforting. We felt fully satisfied after our meal and can confidently say this is one of the best Bangladeshi restaurants we’ve tried in the city. This taste will stay on my tongue for at least the next six months — that’s how memorable it was. We’ll definitely be coming back again soon!

The food was delicious (two fish dishes and one chicken with mild spice) and the service were excellent. Starting with the owner welcoming us to our table and explaining to us what we can expect being it was our first time dining at a Bangladesh restaurant. To try before committing to ordering the dishes which was a great idea because after some tasting, it was too spicy hot. 10/10!

Authentic Bangladeshi food that transports you there. The bhorta platter offers a variety of bhortas to try from. I loved the vegetarian ones. The beef shatkora was brilliant. Absolutely melt in your mouth beef and a flavour that is distinct and shows you the magic of spices.

name: Bleecker Burger Spitalfields
address: B, Lamb St, London E1 6EA, UK

reviews.text:
Bleecker Burger in Spitalfields is always advertised as having the best burger, so expectations are high. Honestly, the double cheeseburger really lives up to that claim. The meat is super juicy, full of flavor and cooked perfectly, and the cheese just works so well with it.

The fries also deserve a mention, they are very succesful in my opinion, crispy on the outside and soft inside, not just an afterthought like in many places.

As you can probably see from the photo, I only remembered to take a picture after I already started eating the burger. That alone says a lot about how good it was. I was too focused on enjoying it to think about photos first.

Overall, if you come here because of the “best burger” advertising, you probably wont be dissapointed. Definitely one of the tastiest burgers I’ve had in London, and worth the hype.

After revisiting bleecker I can say its really good, for london looking for a no frills burger that is classic is harder than you might think. But bleecker does do it well. And its what you would expect, no overcomplication, simple and tasty

I'm not normally one for milkshakes but  the salted pretzel one (add malt) is qctually really nice, not sickly sweet，  a nice density and great flavour.

Spitalfields market at times is full of some gems and some tourist traps but I'm glad there's a bleecker to fall back on here.

A spiritual experience. I’m from the US & every time I visit London, I make sure to enjoy the original Bleecker Burger in Old Spitalfields Market. It’s my first day for a 2 week visit & the bacon double cheeseburger was my first meal (I savoured it bite by bite for 20 minutes: it was heavenly). Bleecker will also be my last meal in London with a couple more visits sprinkled in between. Thank you thank you thank you! 💖🍔🥰

If you want a good quality basic burger this is the place to go. We had the cheeseburger and it is very basic, but the ingredients were good quality and made really well. I wish there would be some pickles or other additions to it but this is just my personal preference. The workers were friendly and we did not need to wait long for our order.

Exceptional burger served from a hatch in Spitalfields market. It’s simple in the face of it, a bun, a bit of cheese and a burger, cooked medium. And when you first take a bite you think… yes, it’s a burger. But then as you continue to chomp into it the depth of flavour builds… and builds… such that when you’ve finished you’ve got this ridiculously gorgeous rich beefy flavour in your mouth… which lasts for ages. It’s a weird sort of special beef burger phenomenon they’ve managed to conjure up here and it’s recommended to try it.
Very good tasty burgers ! Clean ! Fries are excellent ! The lemon drink is very refreshing and a go with the Burgers and fries

I had the best experience at Shake Shack in Central London!
As a vegetarian, I wasn’t sure what to order, but a staff member named Prem was incredibly kind during busy hours and was helpful. He patiently guided me and suggested the mushroom burger, which turned out to be absolutely delicious easily one of the best burgers I’ve ever had! 🍔

The place also has great views and a welcoming atmosphere, making it a perfect spot to relax and enjoy good food. Thank you Prem, for your wonderful service .
Shroom burger was delicious, as usual. The place was not crowded, plenty of space to sit and the waiting time a few minutes only.

Had the smoke shack and chicken bites with 50/50.

The smoke shack lacked its signature taste - borderline bland. Disappointed.

The chicken bites were fresh but not crispy and hence was hard to eat due to it dropping out it it’s shell. Taste not too bad.

Fifty fifty was decent.

Overall not great but also not bad.

The smoke shack needs to be looked at - the taste is not on par with elsewhere in the world.

The worst and most expensive Shake Shack I’ve ever been to. And I’ve eaten this restaurant in many different countries including at least 10 locations in the United States.
They gave me a side of fries that literally came from three different batches. One of them is so old it’s dark brown color and the other fries are two different colors. Burger was undercooked. Extremely red inside, I don’t mind a medium burger but this was raw.
And if that wasn’t bad enough, why is this a cashless establishment? I’ve never been to a Shake shack that doesn’t accept cash. Crazy!

name: The Salad Project - Spitalfields
address: London Fruit Exchange, Brushfield St, London E1 6AG, UK

reviews.text: This was a really good find! The salads were delicious, service was phenomenal and portions were massive (which makes it worth the price). We went for the build your own salad option and we could pick between various kinds of greens, rice or chickpeas, lots of different toppings, proteins and condiments. Would definitely recommend!

Don’t get me wrong this is an amazing salad however I am giving three stars based on the way they deteriorated. First they placed their amazing grains by cheaper rice and now they stopped chopping up their meat? Was really surprised to see whole meat chunks in my salad. It’s very unfortunate that by gaining more fame they made their product cheaper and worse

I love this place so much. Whenever I happen to be in London via Bricklane I love popping over to Spitafield Market for Fresh Juices and immediately right outside The Salad Project.

I’ve only been here twice but its my favorite place to get a custom made fresh raw green salad. It’s super nice to have someplace completely healthy and raw. I love to pick  ingredients that look the most fresh which usually starts with romain lettuce and spinach. Then I get all the freshest veggies they have as an a compliment to my salad.

The team here is very helpful and very nice. They always ask me before shaking my bowl after we’re done building & creating together. Which I forgo. They ask to shake to mix up for you which I prefer to mix my bowl myself.

I like that they squeeze fresh lemon juice on my salad for me and if I want dressing usually the tahini dressing is the one I’m gonna get on the side. Its absolutely delicious.

Its also such a great portion size I eat half and then eat half later if at all.

This place is modern & clean with lots of great energy in it. I always look forward to a day out in the city and popping by here. I can hardly wait to pop in soon again.

My new favourite salad spot. The salad was honestly a 10/10. It cost me £13.95 to make my own, the salad bowl itself was very big.
Customer service was 10/10, the man serving me was lovely and told me about which ones are halal or not - really appreciate that. Will definitely go back, I can’t wait.
UGH best salad spot by far!! Lots of toppings to choose from. BIG portions. Chicken is tenderrr and veggies are fresh. shoutout to Sebastian and sabir for the kind service

Easily the best burger in London. They have been awarded 2nd best burger in the world, and the cheapest burger is 9.95 while the most expensive is only 15.15, no idea why people will call that expensive while you get normal burger that is nothing for £14 in a christmas market.
The burger itself is one of the best burger i have had, the bun is soft, serving with delicious cheese melted with the patties, and the meat itself is served as medium, full of flavour, grill to perfection, you can taste the juice with every single bite.
The only downside might be the paper takeaway box? That might downgrade the burger a little bit?
But this is absolutely the best burger i have ever had.

Today I had one of the best burgers I've ever eaten. The flavour, the texture, the freshness... everything was perfect. I ordered the bacon double and house chips. The chips were also great, with the ideal amount of crunchiness. Serina (I hope I'm not misspelling her name) and the rest of the team were amazing.
I first tried it in 2017 at Old Spitalfields Market. Since then, whenever I'm in London, I visit to eat one of the best burgers in the world!

Great burgers today.

We took single cheeseburger and single bacon cheeseburger and with bacon it was better one.

I like more house fries than angry house fries. But need to try everything on this short menu.

We have searched for over 5 years and enjoyed our very first burger patty ever eaten in the UK, that was cooked to a medium rare perfection! A true no frills burger, served with a huge smile by the chef who just knew what we meant when we said medium-rare please.
Highly recommended!
Wishing you great success Bleecker Burger!
Warm regards
CatSteven

It was a really late night of june and me and my friends we came across this restaurant. The food is really tasty. I came from Italy where the love of food is mixed with love of products, real freshness of products, real love of dishes. They make all their dishes freshly with italian ingredients. Yesterday was my third time at “la cucina”. I really like their food.
A true hidden gem on Brick Lane! Nestled between Indian restaurants, this spot serves top-notch, yummy authentic pizza, exceptional customer service and great prices. Highly recommend!

Super lovely little restaurant, perfect for families that have a lot of needs. Very accommodating and service with a smile. Pizza was DELICIOUS, nice thin crust from stone oven. Will definitely come again!
Lovely place in a buzzing area. Excellent service and delicious food. A treat after a busy day. Highly recommend it if you like real food :)

On vacation and found an unexpected gem in Shoreditch. Alam Rasel has opened a great pizza place here. Don’t pass it up if you’re in the area! He took such good care of us even though we got the pizzas to go. The “Hot American” was so good!

Went to Needoo in East London and we ordered the mix grill, some biryani, and a few curries. The food was fresh, tasty, and full of flavour — exactly what you want from a place like this.

They were quite busy when we went, but even with the rush, the service and overall quality were still very good. You can tell they know what they’re doing and keep things consistent.

Definitely a solid spot if you’re around the East London Mosque area and craving good Pakistani/Indian food. I’d happily go back.

I recently visited Needoo Grill in Whitechapel and had a fantastic experience overall. We started with the Mango Lassi, which was refreshingly sweet and smooth, perfect to complement the spicier dishes. For mains, we ordered the Mixed Grill, Karahi Ghost (Lamb), and a Butter Naan.

The Mixed Grill was impressive. The chicken, lamb, and kebabs were well-marinated, cooked perfectly, and packed with flavor. Each bite had a nice char from the grill without being dry, making it one of the highlights of our meal. The Karahi Ghost was rich and aromatic, with tender lamb pieces simmered in a perfectly spiced sauce. The flavors were deep and it paired wonderfully with the buttery, soft Butter Naan, ideal for soaking up the sauce.

The service was friendly and attentive and the restaurant has a lively, welcoming atmosphere. The portion sizes are generous, making it excellent value for money. The location is convenient and it’s a great spot for family dinners or casual outings with friends.

Overall, Needoo Grill delivers on taste, presentation, and quality. While the Mango Lassi could be a bit thicker, the mains more than make up for it. I highly recommend this place for anyone craving authentic Punjabi or Pakistani grill dishes. I’ll definitely be coming back to try more from their menu.
must try the lamb chops and the nihari! Biryani was average, shami kebab was v tasty but softer than expected. Service much better than at Tayyabs, can't believe we've not been here sooner!

DO NOT BE TRICKED BY THE VISUALS!!!!! Ordered Mix Grill and extra portion of lamb chops with naans which came 5 minutes after we just ordered. I had my suspicions but I wanted to give them a try. Food came so spiced it felt like I was eating just chilli’s on its own and I eat spicy on daily basis. The flavour wasn’t bad but all those spices was just to cover the fact the MEAT WAS OLD!!!!!!!!!!! This was the toughest grill meat I’ve ever ate!! The lamb chops and chicken was a total joke and cold in the middle! After paying the bill of £50 I’ve spoken to the chef. The chef himself admitted the meat was not fresh and was already prepared and cooked and left in the fridge. Then taken out and rubbed with extra creamy spice mix and thrown back on the grill just to be served to the customers! That’s a FOOD HAZARD!! It was a total joke and ended up having severe food poisoning feeling sick 10 minutes after eating their food!!! The chef then told me “next time you come, call us ahead if you want fresh food and we will make it” like are you serious?? I am never coming back and I wish someone had warned me about this place!!!! SUCH A DISGRACE

We had an amazing experience at Needo’s and the food did not disappoint. For starters, we ordered kebabs and samosas – both were fresh, full of flavour, and set the tone for the meal perfectly. The crispy samosas paired with the tender, spiced kebabs were a great beginning.

For mains, we went with the Dry Lamb Bhuna and Daal. The lamb was beautifully cooked, rich with spices, and packed with flavour, while the daal was comforting and hearty – exactly what you’d want alongside a meat dish.

The real star of the evening, however, was the Lamb Chops. Perfectly marinated, juicy, and grilled to perfection, they were without a doubt the highlight of the entire meal – smoky, tender, and bursting with flavour. Easily the best item we tried, and highly recommended to anyone visiting.

The service was warm and welcoming, and the sizzling platters added to the lively dining experience. Overall, Needo’s delivered on both taste and atmosphere – a must-visit for anyone craving authentic, flavourful South Asian food.

The food was very good. I ordered a lamb biryani which is hard to find in the states. No free tap water seems a European thing. I just flew in from Portugal and it was same over there. It’s a culture shock for Americans…I know.

My waiter (AJ) was very attentive and the owner was super nice as well. The kitchen seemed clean (they are displaying it proudly) and cooks looked professional. I am quite sure you don’t find that in other Indian restaurants (anywhere in the world).

I didn’t want to go the Indian restaurants on the Brick Lane because they were full of tourists (on Saturday night), and seemed a bit overpriced. It turned out it was a wise decision I made.

Give it a try. You won’t be disappointed. I saw a few regular customers came in for dinner with their wife or girlfriend. That means they trust it. So do you. The only downside is the restaurant is not on the Brick Lane but that means it is a hidden gem!

I went to this Indian restaurant yesterday with two friends, on the recommendation of a friend who used to go there often when she lived in London and she was absolutely right: it’s so good!
The owner is kind, welcoming, and really knows his stuff. He suggested what to order based on our tastes and what we were in the mood for, and everything turned out perfect.
We had chicken and vegetable curry (the chicken was super tender and flavorful), delicious samosas, and really good garlic naan and prata. Service was quick and friendly.
The place is small but cozy, and the atmosphere is so warm and inviting. We were really happy with everything. Highly recommend! 🙌

We had a lovely time. The food was really good and the service even better! It’s located on a side street to a long street of restaurants where people are standing outside trying to pull you in. This place wasn’t like that at all, and we’re happy we chose the hidden gem over one of the places on the busy street. Highly recommend!

4.0

Quite good Bengali restaurant. Better than some of the other ones in Brick Lane. Unfortunately plenty of them harass you on the streets. This one seems a bit more humble. They offer a decent menu. The main dishes were all quite good. The starter plate was a little disappointing in comparison, but still okay.

Kebab Wrap, Aloo Shami, Ceena Shatkora, Chicken Beecii, Chana Masala (side), Tandoori Chicken (medium) with Chapati, Lamb Biriyani, Mango Lassi + Halwa Puri.

Every single thing was absolutely delicious.
If someone never tries this… they actually can’t feel what this food really is.

Special shout outs:

Tandoori Chicken → next level. smoky, juicy, proper flavour.

Halwa Puri → very new style + surprisingly perfect balance.

Chicken Beecii → amazing. unique profile I haven’t seen anywhere else.

Lamb Biriyani → just WOW. 👌

And also… the staff here are extremely friendly + helpful.
The restaurant is peaceful, clean and visually attractive — which makes the whole experience even more enjoyable.

People think they’ve had Desi food before…
but this is the type of place that proves you actually haven’t until you’ve eaten at this level.

It is wonderful venues and the staff was very helpful. atmosphere a bit quite, so if your looking for peaceful place near tower of london ona friday night. Has great gluten-free options / variants. However you need to ask the staff, think they should re print menu to show this, or have a special menu / virtual menu. Had the fish and chips and chicken risotto, both where delicious! the fish was big and not over cooked. chips where spot on, slightly crispy with a fluffy in side. Risotto (gulten free) was very flavorful. All in all was good. the big BUT is the price. $70 2x mains and 2x drinks is very "city of London" so dont be shocked. Oh and they add 10% tip on bill, which I get (poeple are cheap) but dont like not having the option to set my tip amount, and it be predetermined.

Yesterday we had a lovely lunch at Natural Kitchen, just next to DoubleTree by Hilton London – Tower of London. The location is perfect and the atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming.

The food was fresh, tasty, and nicely presented. Service was friendly and quick, which made the experience even better. It’s a great spot for a casual lunch in the Tower Hill area.

Our server Maria was absolutely impeccable—so friendly, attentive, and engaging. She made our experience wonderful. And also the Romanian bartender super nice as well!
We’ll definitely be coming back!

Just an amazing haven of peace and good healthy food. We came here for breakfast/brunch and loved it so much that we came back the next day. Everything is very high quality, tasty and healthy. Our waitress Mariana was lovely and they welcomed the dog too (inside and outside) and gave him a water bowl.
Will keep this place in mind for the next time I’m in the area!

Sensational. Spent £54. 2 fresh smoothies, main, and dessert. I’m really pleased for the quality of the food.

Got green juice and refresher. Tasty.

Harissa chicken. Juicy, fresh vegetables, healthy, delicious.

Brownie with vanilla ice cream dessert was really good also.

Lokesh was serving me, he was amazing. Gave me the best recommendations and was very attentive and polite.

Came here with some girlfriends last night and we were all deeply impressed. Every dish was superb. Creative, delicious, seasonal - we were suspicious of the "sexy tofu" but hot damn it is. None of us are vegetarian and I can honestly say that there wasn't a single plate where it even crossed my mind that it was 'missing' meat. The only disappointment was that we couldn't try the whole menu in one sitting. Run, don't walk, this place is going to get super busy.
The new Holy Carrot is beautifully done and the menu is once again just as brilliant. The burrata was perfect, as was the artichoke schnitzel and we loved the tiramisu! Highly recommend
Really, really good food and utterly charming staff (go Tito!). Several dishes to single out, but let's just say that I could eat a bath full of that lemon posset and come back for more....

Amazing food, great staff, lovely linen & atmosphere !
It’s the first vegetarian restaurant I’ve been to that has an excellent gourmet menu. which is ambitious & has delicious sensory combinations. The chef’s philosophy & passion towards his food shines through.

It’s a shame that a vegan restaurant has now incorporated dairy and eggs, when in the portobello branch they do a spectacular job of creating amazing food without these ingredients. Even if they felt the need to put those ingredients on their menu it would be nice to see a vegan option for those items too. You can create a delicious vegan butter/tiramisu/ even burrata or a vegan ricotta if you try… I don’t want to give a bad review to this new great restaurant I just find it a shame that they felt this was what they had to do to get more people to come.

name: Bistro Freddie
address: Bistro Freddie, 74 Luke St, Greater, London EC2A 4PY, UK

reviews.text: Incredible food, great service! would recommend to sit at the bar and watch all the food get made. We had the steak tartare, flatbread with mussels, steak with bone marrow sauce, cod, artichokes and the sticky toffee pudding. Honestly cannot pick a favourite. All of the dishes were impeccable.

The atmosphere, the freshness of the food, Bistro Freddie is perfect for a chique yet laid-back dinner or a date night. The flat iron steak was perfectly cooked medium-rare and still had all the juice. I recommend their bone marrow butter sauce to go with it. The crisp fries and salad perfectly accompanied the meal, and I loved their French wine selection as well. Pass the mousse and get the sticky toffee pudding as dessert to share.

Absolutely incredible experience at Bistro Freddie!

From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere is just perfect — vibrant yet relaxed, with that effortlessly cool bistro charm that makes you want to stay for hours. The service is exceptional; every detail is looked after with care and genuine attentiveness.

The food? Outstanding. Every dish was beautifully executed, but the real star of the show has to be the pork and the gougère — both absolutely unforgettable. Perfectly balanced flavours, incredible textures, and the kind of cooking that makes you stop mid-conversation just to savour the bite.

Bistro Freddie nails it on every level. Can’t wait to go back!

Highly recommended!!
We had beef tartare one of the best I ate, a sourdough pizza base with mussels on it cooked with butter and garlic was incredible !
The salad was delicious too !
The service was amazing everyone is so friendly and it’s a cool vibes

This is a lovely little informal bistro tucked away on a quiet street. This is not a restaurant with overbearing service or a place to expect a big fanfare on arrival, instead be chuffed with yourself that you have discovered a bastion of great craft in both the cooking and sourcing of ingredients. On a Saturday (11/10/25) lunchtime we were given a lovely table for two plus our small dog in a sunny window. My partner chose chicken parfait and I had wild mushroom flatbread to start both extremely tasty, the flat bread was comforting but not overfilling. We followed this with an aged sirloin, delicious with that proper beef dripping flavour and a pork chop with hazelnut praline and quince mustard, cooked to perfection, top quality meat. We ordered steamed carrots and a portion of fries, the carrots were top notch. Followed this with chocolate crèmeux (shared) and two glasses of luscious dessert wine, exquisite. You could come here and have a very reasonably priced lunch or spend a bit more on wine for a treat or really push the boat out, up to you. We got there at 12:45 and the room filled up steadily with a lovely talkative atmosphere. We were celebrating recent medical diagnosis (good) and this is a life affirming place. Thank you all N + A

Chez Elles is a very quaint, cozy and romantic venue out of Brick Lane. Really love the decor and attention to detail.
The service was friendly and correct, they even offered us to provide to try two reds they were testing for the restaurant.
Food came quite quickly and it was a pleasant atmosphere.
Having said that, I found it extremely pricey for what it was.
25 pounds for mussels and fries?
1kgs mussels will cost 6 pounds at a good fishmonger, and potatoes how much? Yet the portion I got was ridiculously small for the price.
Snails were tasteless.
Souffle wasn't bad but not wow.
Again, I found the food very average for the price.

You don’t usually think of French food when you think of Brick Lane, but this cosy little spot really stands out. For starters we had garlic butter snails, and French onion soup - the snails were ultra garlicky and the sturdy bread was perfect for mopping up the residual butter. The French onion soup was better than what I had in Paris, sweet and caramelised, the velvety broth had a deep beefy flavour, with a nice creaminess from the comte - this was super decadent and tasty.

The steak was cooked beautifully to a perfect medium rare, but those frites were the secret star of the dish - crispy (even after 15 mins) and not at all greasy. It was served with a mustardy leafy salad which helped cut through the richness. Really good quality and value steak frites  - L’entrecote who?

Ended on a pistachio Creme brûlée which was lovely also, a nice nuttiness from the pistachio which just lingered in the background. Next time we’ll try the tarte tatin if it’s on the menu!

Service is warm and efficient, lovely people working here.

This is a small cosy and intimate restaurant. Pink and red candles and heart-shaped mirrors. Very good if you are dialling with a partner but if you are dining with a group of people or just a friend could leave you feeling a little bit like a gooseberry. The food that is offered on the menu is cooked very well and you can tell they use very good ingredients very good quality all round. There is not a huge selection of meals on the menu compared to other French restaurants that I've been but this is probably more authentic and what they served was very good. There's enough here for everyone maybe not so much vegetarians but there are a couple of options. The music in the background was very good not too loud but nice.I had the souffle and my friend had escargots and steak tartare and as if that wasn't enough a cheese souffle! There were a selection of desserts and they seem quite nice. The service was very efficient and fast and everything was served super duper hot. Thank you I would definitely like to return here

Lovely traditional French restaurant. Superb all round.
The chocolate mousse for dessert was the best I have ever tasted.
Great value for money for the quality.
I look forward to coming back.
The food was excellent, with very good quality products. The service was spectacular, super attentive, and the place is very cute. I would definitely come back.

We had a dinner party facilitated by David’s amazing team (Vy, Julio, and their amazing chef) The first time we solicited professionals for an elevated experience and unsure if the costs would merit.

Suffice to say, we were BLOWN away by Bistrotheques food, service and exceptional vision. They curated an entire *experience*, from canapés, to drinks to mains and dessert. Every guest left with glowing reviews.

If you’re looking for a premium experience then I recommend these fine people heartily. It’s worth an investment if you truly want something memorable.

Faultless service and a chic open kitchen bistro ambience. The highlights of our meal were definitely the steak tartare and the ginger sticky toffee pudding (that caramel sauce was insane). The burger was a bit overcooked and a bit of a letdown. Pleasantly surprised to find a chilled red by the glass.

The food here is lovely, a carefully curated menu that is executed perfectly! Everything we had was fresh and tasted amazing - please bring back the leek fondue pie as we couldn’t try it and I had so been looking forward to it. The service was absolutely lovely as well, everyone was very friendly and attentive - also the cocktails were fab and came out insanely fast! Only one thing I’d change, a bit of music would have made the atmosphere even better. But overall can’t wait to come back!!

We’ve been going to Bistrotheque for years and it’s become a real favourite of ours. It’s the place we bring friends and family, celebrate birthdays, and where we’ve spent New Year’s Day six years in a row. The food never disappoints, the service is consistently welcoming, and it somehow manages to feel both special and relaxed every time. We honestly couldn’t recommend it enough.

Everything we tried was great and interesting. Their staff were incredibly friendly as well. I’d recommend coming with a bigger group so you can try more from their menu, but their atmosphere is also great for couples. Will definitely come again!

Came in with my mum and I ordered the Nutella pancakes and she ordered a smash burger. We were both left thoroughly impressed by not only the food but the warm, inviting atmosphere and excellent customer service. The burger and house made sauces were delicious. The fruit that came with my Nutella pancakes is locally sourced and organic which is amazing and rare to see! The lattes we ordered were also excellent, and came with beautiful latte art. Overall I can confidently recommend for any occasion and person, as the menu is extensive and all menu items are freshly prepared and come plated beautifully.

Absolutely fantastic! Could not be happier with my meal or the service. I have never been so happy to eat, beautifully presented, fresh and amazing quality and delicious. Will 100% be back! (Update, I’ve now been 3 times)

Great new eatery in Hoxton Market tried it out on a friends recommendation and wasn't disappointed friendly welcoming staff nice decor and an extensive food selection for all day eating.
I tried the Calamari for starters which was cooked perfectly and then on the Chefs advice I tried the Chefs signature Burger which came with curly fries and a coleslaw and was delicious.
All in all a real nice late lunch and I cant wait to go back and work my way through the menu.
Keep up the great work team.

Stopped by Breeze Bistro and Lounge today and it was such a lovely find. Great coffee, delicious food and really reasonable prices. The staff were genuinely friendly and welcoming, the interior is bright and inviting, and it’s got a really nice vibe. Such a lovely addition to the area. We’ll definitely be back.

The evening at Breeze was wonderful! The food was excellent and cooked with a lot of passion. The atmosphere is cosy and inviting. You can sit outside or inside. Both the chef and the staff were extremely friendly and attentive.
The price was also more than fair for such delicious food.
Definitely worth a visit! We'll be back and will try the breakfast too! Thank you very much! :)

name: Galvin Bistrot & Bar
address: Entrance on 35, Bishops Square, Spital Square, London E1 6DY, UK

reviews.text: Came here to eat with my friend, the food was spectacular, the waiters as well as the chefs came to the table asking how the food was. The service felt very intimate and homely. Will come back again. Thank you for the lovely meal. The food was honest and spot on.

EXCEPTIONAL!!!! A MUST TRY!!!!

I came here to try the Chefs Sunday set lunch menu.  The service by Luminita and Mark was outstanding, they made me feel welcome from the moment I stepped in to the restaurant. They regularly came up to me and asked me about the food and if I would like anything else and made me feel right at home..I really enjoyed Marks way of putting the cutleries on my table and the sense of humour of Luminita

The first course I opted for was the burrata with balsamic and freshly grated truffle, the burrata was soft and milky, the texture was silky smooth and the burrata was seasoned extremely well.

The second course I went for was the spiced baby chicken which was served with roasted potatoes, mushroom,  gravy and seasonal veg,  the food was served on a very clean and warm plate,  the chicken was cooked to perfection at the right temperature 🌡 and the food was adequately seasoned although taste is subjective,  I still cracked some salt and pepper on the Roasted seasonal veg. The waiter kindly offered me sauces and the mustard too was delicious.

For the final course. I had the Apple Tarte Tatin, I was at a loss for words when I tried it out for the first time.  The honey,  paired with creme fraiche and the flaky texture of the pastry all of it balanced out the sweetness of the wonderfully caramelised Apples. Truly a delight to my senses.

I will definitely be coming back to try the A la Carte. And hopefully bring in more friends to support this independent business.  They truly are champions of higher welfare and seasonal ingredients led cooking..

Thank you very much for your hospitality

Mixed experience.  Might have scored higher if it weren't for the fact that it was quite pricey for tiny portions, and the bad attitude of the servers when we reported problems, mostly of an organizational nature, with the mains.

My starter of cured sea bream from the raw section of the menu was excellent.  Sauce of ponzo diluted with cold tomato consomme was perfectly balanced.  I loved the unidentified green leaves that dressed fish.  They had a flavour that complimented seafood beautifully.  Portion  was very modest.  My companion was happy with his two little items from the bites section of the menu.  Sardine pincho was very fresh and vegetale, and he liked the mushroom and truffle arancini.  I tried a bite of both and personally found the arancini stodgy.

There was some confusion because my companion originally wanted a pizzetta as main, despite  the waitress warning him that the portion was small.  He became wary after seeing the very dainty portion sizes of the starters.  An order of vegetarian pasta was added to his order before arrival of the pizzetta, which apparently confused the kitchen regarding delivery sequence for the remaining food.

The pizzetta with taleggio and prosciutto was indeed tiny and served cold.  In that respect my companion was happy he had augmented his order with warm pasta.  The pizzetta  bite I tried tasted mostly of parma ham, so serving cold made sense, but calling it a pizzetta instead of cold ham on toast was misleading.

My main order of the signature burger and creamed spinach both arrived tepid.  The spinach was seriously under seasoned and bland.  Burger was tasty despite being lukewarm at best.  My companion's pumpkin and and Vacherin pasta was the worst dish of the night.  Cold, overcooked and sickly sweet.  I think the flavour profile would have been vastly improved by a sprinkle of fried capers to add a pop of contrast to the sweetness.  I sampled a bite and could discern cheesiness but not Vacherin in particular.

When asked about our food we short listed some of our problems with tepid food as well as with the pumpkin pasta.  We were surprised that serving staff, instead agreeing to report the problems to the kitchen, got defensive.  Our waitress explained that there were lights to keep the dishes warm.  We had seen the salamanders positioned way too high on the pass to be effective, given how long our orders waited there.  A manager came to explain that pumpkin is indeed sweet so we shouldn't be surprised by sweetness of the vegetarian pasta.

We won't  be back.  The cheapest bottle of red was incidentally £42.  It's an elegant room.

We had a great meal here and left quite full. The burger was amazing but I'd recommend anything on the menu. They have a Sunday roast two courses for £33 which is very price competitive for the area. The restaurant is intimate and beautiful. Also the house wine was tasty.

Phenomenal food and service from Thames (chef), Sasha(? Waitress) and another lovely waitress in blue shirt. What a meal!!

Will be back for many more. Great stuff.

Came for Valentines day, absolutely incredible food - not a single dish from the 3 course menu was a miss! (me and my partner had 3 different dishes so all 6 were incredible). The atmosphere was cosy but not dark and gloomy, and the service was top notch. Would highly recommend for anyone looking for high quality food in London at a generally reasonable price! (p.s. the creme brulee was to die for).

🇫🇷 Stepping into La Petite Auberge on Upper Street in Islington felt like a lovely escape to a classic, unpretentious slice of France. Given some of the reviews I'd read online, what I experienced bore no resemblance to those complaints – I genuinely didn't recognise the same restaurant!

My meal began with the stuffed mushrooms, and they were exactly what you hope for from a traditional French starter: rich, earthy, and perfectly seasoned. It set a wonderful tone for the main event: moules provençale. The mussels were fresh, plump, and swimming in a wonderfully aromatic broth of tomato, garlic, and herbs. I greedily sopped up every last drop with the crusty bread.

The drinks list deserves a mention, too. The wine list is extensive, offering a fantastic range for every budget and taste. Not wanting to overthink it, I opted for the house white, and it was truly excellent—crisp, refreshing, and an ideal partner for the seafood.

The ambiance is cozy and intimate, and the service was attentive yet relaxed. This is a place that clearly takes pride in classic French cuisine and providing a genuinely warm dining experience. Forget the harsh online critics; if you're looking for honest, delicious food and a welcoming atmosphere in Islington, La Petite Auberge is a true gem

Excellent restaurant, we went here at La Petite Auberge with my dear husband for Valentine's Day and we just genuinely enjoyed ourselves and each other with delicious drinks, excellent food and those pancakes 🥞 for dessert were amazing and I warmly recommend this place.
Yours Sincerely,
Louise Gerdes
Professional online advertisements 💯💫

We went here as a party of 10 and received excellent service and food. I hadn’t been here for many years and was very impressed with the food- soo tasty, generous portions, well presented and very good value for money. Definitely a place I will be returning to and highly recommending. Food was all excellent - Steak was outstanding!!

What a brilliant find!! The star dish was definitely my duck main, where there was a sweet potatoe pure! However, everything we ate was just incredible. We had the artichoke heart starter and chicken soup starter. You can tell they used all fresh ingredients and did EVERYTHING from scratch. Finishing off with incredible crème brûlée and apple and very crumble. Not one dud dish, I am very impressed. The service was perfect too with the waiters checking on you the right amount and the wait of food was perfect between each course. Highly recommend!!!

name: Noisy Oyster seafood bistro
address: 2, Nicholls Clarke Yard, London E1 6SH, UK

reviews.text:
Loved the atmosphere and the food was really enjoyable. I highly recommend the mockfish skewer and the onglet — the sauce was delicious. The wine recommended by the staff was excellent, and we enjoyed it so much that we ended up buying a bottle after having a couple of glasses.

The only downside was the Valentine’s Day booking policy. After making a dinner reservation, we were told we had to choose a set course menu or cancel the booking, which felt a bit limiting. Because of this, we changed our reservation to lunch instead. It would be great to have more flexible options next time.

A fabulous recent addition to the Shoreditch food scene.  The stark industrial decor is cool and elegant and the music is funky.  A great atmosphere, but the high ceilings mean that it’s still easy to talk.

The food is fresh and vibrant, and all of the staff are super friendly.  Great wine list too, but the cocktails are the stars of the show.  This could be a new favourite.

The food was amazing.  My bluefin tina steak was perfectly cooked and the sauce was heavenly.  The staff was nice and professional but not eagerly trying to please you.  The lighting was great for taking food pics but too dark everywhere else.  Toilet decoration is questionable.

Incredible energy and even better oysters snd caviar! This place buzzes with a fantastic, lively atmosphere—the happy sound of people enjoying themselves. The oysters were fresh, briny perfection, and every seafood dish we tried was outstanding. Even steak was good, what normally do not expect from the seafood place. if you want world-class seafood with unforgettable London vibes, this is a must-visit. I loved it!

Tiktok recommended this place to me, and it did not disappoint in the slightest. Where do I even begin? The oysters were exceptionally fresh, with a clean, briny finish that lingered beautifully. As an ikura fan, the red caviar toast was absolute heaven. Being a big lover of sashimi, the crudo trio was a must-try and delivered on every level.

We also ordered the crab orecchiette and tater tots, which were surprisingly filling given the portion sizes and thoroughly satisfying. The soft-serve caviar paired with savoury churros was outstanding and genuinely memorable, a combination that still stays in my mind.

The service was excellent throughout, attentive and welcoming, and the interior design was equally impressive: modern, sleek, and clean, with a striking metal aesthetic. From start to finish, everything about this place was exceptional.

I cannot wait to return and try more of the menu, especially the bluefin tuna tartare and the dressed oysters on my next visit to London.

Drawn in by the great reviews - on google there was a strong smell of fish when we entered which was a bit disconcerting.  Also the menu felt like a strange mix - burgers, curries, pizzas, sandwiches - I always think that’s a bad sign it makes me wonder how good these items maybe and if we wouldn’t be better off going to a burger place for burgers etc.  My partner is a vegetarian - they had vegan or nothing for this population - the main Mediterranean vegan dish was a strudel on a cauliflower steak….  Which made me eye roll in sympathy…. Cauliflower steak….  Anyway we were starving so my partner ordered the cs and absolutely loved the dish.  It even looked appetising to me - the cauliflower looked well caramelised with a pastry parcel on top a fresh looking sauce drizzle and roasted vine tomatoes.  He said it was delicious!  Didn’t let me try any…. I’m on a diet and had a salad with extra chicken which was as exciting as it could be.  The staff were friendly, polite and professional.  We would recommend coming here based on our experience.

Excellent food, the vegan choice is not vast but surprisingly tasty. Try the Harvest & heart, you’ll appreciate it!
Also the fish&chips was abundant and tasty, I would prefer it served with a thinner fried layer and thinner chips but that’s just my taste.
The most appreciated part of our lunch was the kindness and cosy attention we got from the serving team. We felt more than welcome since the very first moment. Service was also fast, which is a great plus for a quick lunch :)
Thank you, keep it up!

We are from Texas and stopped in for a hardy, traditional English meal. We were not disappointed! I ordered the curry and my fiancé ordered the fish and chips. The curry was warm and creamy with the most tender chicken, and I have never seen such a big piece of haddock. The meal, the atmosphere and the service we received from Faruque, were fabulous! He was attentive, kind, and made us feel very welcome. I'd highly recommend!

Beautiful place!  Great experience for London first timers!  Experiencing fish and fat chips!  Food was awesome, my mom enjoyed her first meal in London for her 70th bday!  Thanks so much Lucky!  Mom's love it!

The food was delicious and the penne arrabbiata had just the right amount of spice.
They also asked about allergies right away, which can be very helpful for people with dietary restrictions. The atmosphere was very pleasant and modern. Kayhan's service was excellent. Highly recommended all round :)

name: Melody Brunch & Bistro
address: 483 Cambridge Heath Rd, London E2 9BU, UK

reviews.text:
I recently visited Melody Brunch & Bristo, and it was such a lovely experience! From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere felt warm, welcoming, and beautifully set up.

The food was absolutely delicious. Every dish was presented so nicely and tasted just as good as it looked. The flavors were fresh, well-balanced, and clearly made with care. Whether you're going for something sweet or savory, there are great options to choose from.

Thank you Irem and your family for your wonderful service!!!

Mamma’s Brunch – The Trio (twice a month, regulars!)
Three friends have been brunching every other week for a few years, trying different spots across East London. About six months ago, we discovered this place—and we haven’t been anywhere else since.
The vibe is super chilled and cozy. Zaynab and Hasan are amazing: incredibly friendly, welcoming, and they often treat us to free cheesecake, which is always a win.
We’ve tried almost all the breakfast items and every single one has been delicious. The Turkish dishes are especially authentic and full of flavour.
My go-to dish is the chicken and waffles—the chicken is cooked to perfection and the waffles are spot on.
For drinks, I highly recommend the pistachio latte and the Spanish latte.
Overall: fantastic service, a warm and inviting atmosphere, and consistently delicious food. A true brunch favourite.
My favourite breakfast spot. The best food and service and such a lovely family owned restaurant. Can’t wait to return already. Recommend the Mediterranean breakfast and the French toast!

Absolutely incredible brunch!! Everything was so delicious and really generous portions ! Staff are super friendly and even bought out some cake for my brothers bday on the house! This place should have a queue that goes all the way down the street.

Amazing food, great service, family friendly atmosphere, a must visit if in the area. Not at all near where we are staying, but we were in the area and the menu looked amazing. It absolutely did not disappoint! So glad we stopped in! My girls loved the food as well, which you can't argue with. My wife and I (dishes pictured) have had many similar dishes, but these were truly spiced to perfection. Feels very "home made." The service is very laid back, in the best way possible. Kid friendly and accommodating. Worth the visit if you can make it. It's no wonder it had a nearly 5 star rating. Happy to contribute to it!

The food was delicious! We tried the lemongrass & coconut cream curry and the slow-braised claypot which both had their own unique flavours. The iced Vietnamese coffee was also a highlight - we had to order it twice. Highly recommend visiting this restaurant

Amazing food. Their salad collection is amazing- full of flavour and unique Asian flavours! Do also try their pancakes which are out of thos world! Service was fast and toilets were very clean.
They also serve freshly squeezed juices.
Highly recommended.

Really good Bún thịt nướng and extra char on the pork belly
Quiet around 6pm on a Tuesday and went for a a solo dinner - good ambiance and environment

Another nice meal. Thank you.

I like this spot. Always good food but do know that sometimes if it says “grilled” fish it was pan fried. But the food is always nice

Delicious Vietnamese food! Lots of vegan items on the menu (main menu and lunch menu), as well as most things being gluten-free (they use NGF to indicate where things are not gluten-free). Salt and pepper crispy tofu, and tofu sizzling lemongrass dishes were particularly phenomenal

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Absolutely Wonderful Experience at Bistrot Walluc

!Bistrot Walluc is a hidden gem in London! The atmosphere is warm, intimate, and full of character — the kind of place that instantly makes you feel welcome. The Italian food was absolutely delicious, fresh, and full of authentic flavour. Every dish was beautifully presented and tasted like it came straight from Italy.

The live music really sets the mood — soulful, vibrant, and perfectly balanced with the cozy vibe of the restaurant. It made the evening feel special and lively without being overwhelming.

The staff were friendly, attentive, and clearly passionate about what they do. You can tell they care about giving guests a memorable experience.

Overall, it’s the perfect spot for a romantic dinner, a night out with friends, or anyone who just loves great food and music. Highly recommended — can’t wait to come back!

Greetings from the Germans who were here on December 5, 2025.
We had a very enjoyable time and laughed a lot at everyone's comedic contributions. The atmosphere was very friendly, even though we only met for that one evening and only happened to be in the area that night and stumbled upon this supposed fondue restaurant.
We want to thank everyone and wish you all the best!

I recently visited this hidden bistro and was pleasantly surprised. The atmosphere feels cozy and authentic, making it a perfect spot to relax. The staff were absolutely amazing—friendly, attentive, and genuinely passionate about what they do. Their hospitality made the experience even more memorable. The food was delicious, beautifully presented, and full of flavor. A real gem worth discovering!

Such a unique little spot! We first came craving fondue — the place was dim, filled with real vintage stuff (not “decor,” just genuine old things). At first it felt odd since we were the only ones there, but the charm slowly kicked in. The comedy show that night was very underground (a bit cringy 😅), and the fondue wasn’t hot enough with just candle heat — but it was so affordable that we came back anyway.

The second visit was wonderful — no comedy, perfectly melted fondue, cozy vibe. One of my friends loved the hippie, unpolished atmosphere. Third time, we came on a Friday again by mistake, had to wait during the comedy, but later ended up chatting with the owner, Luca — a genuine, funny, and passionate guy trying to bring something real to London’s dining scene.

Suggestions:
– Share the comedy schedule more clearly (online or at the door) so people can plan around it.
– Add stronger heating for the fondue — the candle heat isn’t quite enough. Maybe try a gel or spirit burner (like in Swiss fondue sets) or an electric pot to keep it smooth longer.
– Improve insulation — the wooden door lets in quite a bit of cold air.
– Maybe play soft background music when it’s quiet; it would make it warmer and livelier.

The comedy isn’t high-end, but that’s exactly the point — it’s free, raw, and gives underground artists a space to perform in one of the world’s most expensive cities. I love that spirit. You can feel this place is built on passion, not pretension. I honestly want to support it and hope more people discover it. ❤️

Went on wednesday, messaged them on their instagram , they are booking only, great style, bohemian chic with a lot of stuff and interesting items, jazz  music background and french pop,cheese fondue of course which was very good compared to  the one we had in france in megeve, just much cheaper lol. the owner made some magic tricks for my gf and I, great fun.

name: Clara's Wine & Bistro
address: 17 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E1 6LA, UK

reviews.text: I might return to try the wines but overall the food was fairly average especially given the price point and the overall experience. The service was also slow, particularly at the start as we were left waiting for menus and water, it took a while to place our order, and the staff were generally quite inattentive. Between the two of us, we shared the sourdough and butter (good), ham croquettes (really tasty), burrata with mortadella and pesto (fine), gnocchi with pancetta and kale (too salty), pork sausages with lentils (a simple dish that wasn’t executed well) and the Jerusalem artichoke with beans (the flavour and texture didn’t appeal to me at all).

Very cute spot in Shoreditch with great atmosphere and nice selection of dishes and wine. Perfect for a date or a night catch up with your girls. Portion sizes is small so I would recommend more than 2 plates per person, the croquettes were very good but you pay 9£ for 2 small croquettes which is outrageous, but ok!
The service is basic. Wine was always brought to the table after the dishes arrived. The table was always full with empty plates when the next dish arrived. Overall is a nice spot, but great room for improvement!

Amazing new spot! We were there last night for dinner, and cannot recommend it enough. Every dish was absolutely delicious, definitely don’t miss the Roscoff onions, ox heart and the chocolate torte (omg divine!!!!). Huge selection of wines.
