Food came out really quickly and staff were super lovely and knowledgeable.

What a spot. Went for dinner. The concept, vibe, food, service - they smashed it in every area. We were downing their amazing white skin-on wine, every dish we had was delicious, the service was amazing. The Gildas are 🤌✨️, the grilled ox heart was cooked in a way I hadnt had it before and it was INCREDIBLE, the oysters were fresh, the pumpkin, cavalo nero & feta pie was insanely good (and im not one to care much for vegetarian dishes). PLEASE do not even dare leave without trying the Chocolate Torte for dessert if it's on the menu. Will remember it forever. Glad this place opened up.
impeccable experience. Food absolutely bangs with a brilliant reasonably priced wine list, gorgeous atmosphere, generous portion sizes. What a wonderful addition to this corner of Shoreditch.

Visited through a first table booking and you can never be disappointed with the aussie chain!
Food was great - served immediately once ready and was fresh and tasty.
Service from staff was great, not too intrusive but on hand should you need anything.
Once the restaurant side had closed they offered us to another table to stay for longer on the other side where the atmosphere was super buzzy and lively and a completely different look and feel so great to get the best of both worlds. Have visited a few of the other 'green' branches and none of them have disappointed at all!

Delicious healthy breakfast and very friendly, attentive and quick service by our waitress Janet. Smashed avocado with excellent scrambled eggs on tasty black charcoal sourdough bread was a new discovery. The blueberry pancakes with fresh berries were fabulous. The fancy bacon roll was really good. The green detox juice didn’t convince us as much as the rest. Cool stylish atmosphere. Prices a little higher than elsewhere but when quality of food and service and the atmosphere are taken into account, they are okay.

I had an amazing experience during my visit! The food was absolutely delicious — fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. Every dish exceeded my expectations.

The service was just as impressive. Jannat , Alejandra and Alejandro went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect. They were warm, attentive, and incredibly professional, making the entire visit feel special.

I highly recommend this place if you’re looking for excellent food and outstanding service. I’ll definitely be coming back!

Gorgeous decor, phenomenal service, delicious food. Special shout out to Will who was absolutely fantastic as our waiter. Food was delicious - definitely recommend the fried chicken, the yellow fin tuna crudo and the fillet steak skewer. The parmesan custard choux buns were UNREAL.

We had such a lovely time here for my friend’s birthday! We went for the bottomless dinner and it was such great value, the Australian BBQ and desserts were delicious, and the portions were so generous we couldn’t even finish everything. The cocktail fountain and endless Prosecco made it even better! Our waiter Will was fantastic, super friendly and attentive, which really added to the experience.
They even surprised my friend with an extra dessert, a Biscoff cheesecake with a sparkler on top, which was such a thoughtful and fun touch! We had the best time and would definitely come back!

name: The Cardinal Bar & Kitchen
address: Ground Floor, 9 Aldgate High St, London EC3N 1AH, UK

reviews.text:
The Cardinal Bar & Kitchen, located inside Hotel Saint in Aldgate, London, offers a modern dining experience that blends international flavours with refined presentation. My recent visit there was excellent from start to finish.

We began with the Chicken Momos, soft and juicy steamed dumplings filled with chicken and served with crispy chilli oil. They were light yet full of flavour, setting the tone for what was to come. The Salmon Tataki followed, featuring thinly sliced salmon with avocado, jalapeño, trout eggs, ponzu, radish, and lime. The combination of textures and flavours was spot on, with the ponzu and lime bringing a refreshing tang that complemented the rich salmon. This dish was beautifully balanced and fresh.

Then came the Korean Fried Chicken Wings, coated in a sticky Korean sauce and topped with sesame seeds, chilli, spring onions, and a touch of lime. This was easily the best starter of the evening. The wings were crisp on the outside and tender inside, with just the right level of heat. The sauce had depth and flavour without being overwhelming. It was clear the kitchen had mastered this dish.

For the mains, my friend ordered the dry-aged 8-oz sirloin steak with miso butter, fries, and peppercorn sauce. The steak was cooked perfectly and had a rich, savoury taste enhanced by the miso butter. The peppercorn sauce added a nice kick, and the fries were crisp and golden. A well-executed classic.

I had the Tandoori Lamb Chops with crushed potatoes, watercress, and pickled onions. The chops were tender, juicy, and perfectly seasoned. The tandoori marinade gave them a lovely smoky edge, and the crushed potatoes paired well with the tangy pickled onions. Every bite was satisfying, and the presentation was clean and elegant. We also shared Truffle Fries with Parmesan and Chives, which were indulgent and full of flavour. The truffle aroma was strong but balanced by the sharpness of the Parmesan.

Dessert was the perfect way to end the meal. My friend went for the Sticky Toffee Pudding with toffee sauce and vanilla ice cream. It was soft, warm, and rich, with the sauce providing a comforting sweetness. I chose the Pistachio Cheesecake, which was outstanding. The orange blossom cheesecake was creamy and fragrant, while the pistachio and white chocolate sauce added richness. The crispy kunafa pastry on top provided a satisfying crunch. This dessert was divine and one of the best I’ve had recently.

Service throughout the evening was excellent. The staff were attentive, friendly, and well-informed about the menu. Jill stood out for his great recommendations and engaging approach, making sure we had a pleasant experience. Every dish arrived at the right pace, allowing time to enjoy each course without feeling rushed.

The ambience at The Cardinal Bar & Kitchen is relaxed yet stylish. The interior is modern, with a comfortable layout that suits both casual gatherings and special occasions. The atmosphere feels welcoming, making it an ideal spot for meeting up with friends or enjoying a date night.

Overall, The Cardinal Bar & Kitchen impressed with its quality food, professional service, and inviting setting. The menu offers a thoughtful mix of Asian-inspired dishes and modern European favourites, all executed with care. Each dish felt well-conceived, from the bold Korean wings to the refined pistachio cheesecake.

If you’re in Aldgate, this restaurant is worth a visit. Whether for a casual dinner, drinks with friends, or a more intimate evening, The Cardinal Bar & Kitchen delivers on all fronts. Highly recommended.

Halal options available

I honestly don’t leave reviews often unless I love a place, this one I love. Andrei and Prince are fantastic. The atmosphere is calming, very nice. Service is top notch and the restaurant is very clean.  I was with my mom and we had a great time. Prices are wonderful. Food was served HOT, highly recommended going here for a fabulous night out. Vibe is just right, great date spot. Salmon dish is excellent. Recommend for those that have a wide pallet, chef’s kiss 💋

Absolutely amazing night and dinner. The food was packed with flavor and beautifully prepared, every dish felt like a treat. The service was warm, attentive, and made us feel right at home. On top of that, the atmosphere was fun and inviting, making the whole experience so enjoyable. Definitely a spot I’d recommend to anyone looking for great food and a great time! Special thanks to Jill and Vitto for their service, happiness, and recommendations.

I was disappointed with the experience for my Christmas Day lunch. On my arrival on time, my table wasn't ready and I was asked to wait.  I asked if I should wait in the foyer and was told to sit at the bar for a drink. £18 later for one drink and eventually my table was ready. The tables are far too close together with no privacy between tables and it doesn't make for a pleasant eating experience. The food was lovely but service far too rushed. I had three courses and a coffee within 75 minutes which I think is too fast and not enjoyable. Service was passable but there was no wow factor. Little things were missed like not having cutlery on the table for courses and not topping up the water.  I was a solo traveller and felt I was a hindrance in the restaurant and I ultimately won't be back.

If you're craving a well-prepared, classic steak in a great pub atmosphere, The Cardinal delivers consistently. Don't expect dry-aged specialty cuts, but do expect a thoroughly enjoyable and satisfying plate. Thanks to Sandeep for the great service.

We needed a table for 8 following our son's graduation at the Barbican Centre. I had seen The Old Fountain online and the menu looked good. They were able to accommodate us, probably as it was early evening on a Monday. We had a great time and were looked after very well by the friendly staff. We started with a load of delicious Momos. Everyone enjoyed their food, which ranged from different burgers, to fish and chips, and an amazingly tasty curry in a pot with mashed potato (it was spectacular!!!).
We were sat near to the kitchen and were able to compliment the chef personally! The wine was lovely and there was a great selection of ales, beers and ciders. We definitely want to return.

Stopped by for a quick drink. First visit. Nice enough place, old pub feel and vibe. Nice choice of drinks at usual London prices. Service was friendly. Sadly the glasses looked like the glass wash machine needs a change of detergent or rinse aid because they were very cloudy, the photo of the glasses on the back bar just about shows this. Overall a nice place.

We had our Christmas do at Old Fountain as it's one of our favourite pubs and it was such a brilliant and well-organised evening. Alex and the team were incredibly accommodating with our big group and made us feel well looked after all night. Thanks to all the team, couldn't recommend it enough.
Class beer selection, food was amazing (incredible Nepalese cooking way better than your standard pub stuff) and a really unpretentious atmosphere.

Went in for “just one pint” and somehow left three hours later than planned emotionally invested in the pub dog and made two new pals Dave and Sally.

The food was wicked, the beer selection is solid, and I love that it’s dog friendly, seeing a few happy pups around somehow makes the whole place feel even more like a proper local. A super friendly gaff.
The pints was spot on, cold, crisp, and poured with the kind of care usually reserved for newborns babies.

Also worth mentioning that the atmosphere / music choice was great,  not to forget the darts board and the cool rooftop seating area! Defo the kind of place where you come in for one and end up staying far longer than planned ( like I did )

Would absolutely return.
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

The best Sunday roast I ever had!
I had a pork belly and it was absolutely amazing! Yorkshire, veges, chutney , pork it was delicious!
The place looked a bit random at first, but we went upstairs to sit on the rooftop terrace and it was a great atmosphere, staff friendly and attentive and the food amazing, so would definitely recommend it for sure.

First time here to celebrate a birthday and meet close friends. The atmosphere was great with amazing vibes and a life band to keep us all happy.vthe staff gave us enough time to order food and drink with plenty of options. I had my favourite dirty gin martini and for someone that is very picky it was done to perfection.  They have a list of allergens in their meals so I settled for succulent perfectly cooked grilled salmon with broccoli and baby potatoes what a treat. Overall well worth the 10-15min walk from Liverpool Street station with very competitive prices. Definitely worth visiting again.

We had such a great lunch at Blues Kitchen Shoreditch! The food was absolutely delicious, wasn't too loud, was nice and warm, and the service was amazing. Really nice vibes all around. We’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend if you’re in Shoreditch at lunchtime.

Natalie was great - really friendly, lovely, and easy to chat to. She even tempted us into to getting dessert. Really appreciated the attentive service. She definitely made the lunch even better!

Perfect place for dinner and live music with your friends. Food was lovely and portions were amazing for the price!! We are stuffed 🤤 Kai our waiter was lovely and very attentive service was on point! Definitely coming back :)

Awsome venue with really amazing staff who look like they genuinely love coming to work! Superb service from everyone and food drinks on par... Great place if you are in a group as very large and accommodating but still has cosy feel!

Absolutely amazing😍
The vibe is awesome, very beautiful decor. Staff is incredibly friendly (especially bandana guy) and the food is great.
The buffalo chicken wings give a punch of a flavour. The chicken burger was delicious and the smoked pork belly was huge! 🤤 Shout out to the mac&cheese, incredibly creamy and perfectly cooked.
Would love to come here again ♥️♥️

name: Well & Bucket
address: 143 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E2 7DG, UK

reviews.text: Walked in at noon for Sunday Roast and was fortunate to get a table for 4 without a reservation. The meal was huge and tasty and extremely filling with lots of variety but our cuts of meat were inconsistent across the group - pork was juicy for some and dry for others for example.

Low review is for the food. Buffalo wings were inedible, coated with starch giving it the same texture as a stone, chicken was drier than the Sahara Desert. Staff were kind enough to offer a replacement and explained it was part of a new menu. I got the calamari as a replacement however, it seemed like the squid must have been on a diet as most of the pieces were the size of a hula hoop crisp with the thickness of a penny. At that point I didn’t want to bother the bar staff to complain. Please review your menu items and check the quality regularly. Bar staff were incredibly kind and the pub itself has a good atmosphere.
Aliya was wonderful! She was a great and accommodated us incredibly. The chicken, the cauliflower cheese and the halloumi were the standout dishes

We had a fantastic experience from start to finish. The food was absolutely delicious, and although we weren’t able to get a seat straight away, the team went out of their way to find us a table, which we really appreciated.
There was a small delay with the food, but we were kindly offered a complimentary drink, which was a lovely gesture. Honestly, between the great atmosphere and our company, it never felt like a long wait at all.
A special mention has to go to our waitress Leah, she was absolutely fabulous. Friendly, attentive, and genuinely welcoming, she really made our visit extra special. We’ll definitely be back!

Went for lunch and the oysters were fresh and delicious, as was my spicy margarita. However, the minute steak was very tough and hadn't been rested long enough so was bloody on the plate. The wooden floors also mean it gets extremely noisy as it fills up.

My boyfriend and I love this place! It’s one of the places we always come back to for any special occasion. The service is above and beyond. Everytime we come our requests are catered to the best of their abilities!
The waiters and waitresses and all so lovely, and give such a warm welcome. We always give a special shout out to Alice, who is genuinely so lovely and always gives the personal touch! We always highly recommend the electric diner to anyone who is looking for a nice restaurant to celebrate at.

On our most recent visit before Christmas, we was given such a warm welcome. The staff are always making sure everything is to your standard. Managers are always present if you would like a chat, in our case it’s always to commend the staff, they really do make your experience!

The food as a whole is never a disappointment! We’ve tried a lot of the menu now, and everytime is just gets better!

We have already for our next visit booked in, and we really can not wait for our return. The electric bar and diner is definitely a hit if you’re booking for a relaxed but also chic meal.

What an amazing experience. Was fortunate to come with a friend tonight and both of us were blown away with the Michelin BBQ platter. Out of this world. The short Rib was melt in the mouth absolutely the star of the show. Can't find fault.

The service was also spectacular with a really personal touch. Highly recommend a visit for the Michelin BBQ as it's only on for a month.

We were lucky enough to catch Interstellar’s pop-up at The Ned, and it was hands down the best tray of authentic Texan BBQ we’ve had in London — Michelin star well deserved. The short rib was the standout: softer than butter and somehow even better than the brisket. The sausages were next-level too (and I know my sausages 😉) — the recipe’s still a mystery, as Harry wasn’t giving anything away.

Harry looked after us brilliantly. He somehow knew exactly which cocktail to recommend (almost by telepathy) and was genuinely knowledgeable about how the food was prepared in Hackney and transported in throughout the day, happily sharing details in a way that made the whole experience more engaging. He was friendly, professional, and brought a great energy to the table — the kind of service that really adds to the meal.

All in all, a fantastic lunch, and we’ll be looking out for Interstellar again when they’re back in London.

I'd never heard of the Ned before today. I think it's a hotel in a building that was once a bank. On the ground floor there are multiple restaurants including a sushi restaurant. We went to Electric Bar and Diner. The food is American diner but definitely not American fast food prices. We had the double cheeseburger and fries. The burgers were just okay. As a simple burger with just bun, patty, cheese and pickle, everything has to be top notch as you're relying on the simple flavours to shine. This did not. The bun was quite dry and cold and the meat was just mediocre. And for £22 it just isn't worth it. The service was great and the place its in is worth a look with what looked like a great bar on one side and a live singer and band playing. Other than this. I wouldn't have a burger here. Maybe the sushi is better in the restaurant on the opposite side of the room?

Situated in the lobby of The Ned hotel, can get pretty noisy in the evening. Nice atmosphere and the staff were very friendly and attentive. We had the lobster roll and cobb salad. The lobster roll was big in size, but it didn't have very much lobster in it which was a bit disappointing. The flavours and freshness was nice though.

🚇 Old Street
🍺 £7.40 Brixton Pale Ale.

The Fox sits among the gentrified old warehouses and new builds in the backstreets of Shoreditch, East London. The nearest Tube is Old Street.

The pub was built in 1833, when this part of London was an industrious furniture-making hub, and it served as a watering hole for local craftsmen.

The pub is spread over three floors: the main bar is on the ground floor; the first floor has a second bar/function room with an outdoor roof terrace; and there is also a private Karaoke Den.

The main bar is traditionally decorated with a tiled servery along the back wall. It’s a good-sized bar with plenty of traditional seating, contemporary lighting and large etched arched windows. The upstairs bar has a classy Victorian feel, with a cosy roof terrace just to the left. Attractive features include the fox portrait on the back bar and the detailed tiling.

The beer selection is solid, offering a good range of keg beers, three cask ales and a bottle shop with various bottles and cans of craft brews. I opted for a Brixton Pale Ale; my pint hit the spot, though the price was a bit punchy. Food is Asian-inspired dishes including Bao buns, gyoza, wings and sides, the reviews are favourable.

I arrived bang on opening at 12pm on a mild Saturday in October. I was first through the door, so the pub was chilled with an easy-going soundtrack in the background. After a good mooch around, I settled in to enjoy my pint and the welcoming surroundings. Service was excellent: two team members were on duty, both friendly and chatty.

Walking the quieter backstreets of Shoreditch is atmospheric, and stumbling across this classy corner pub only adds to it. I very much enjoyed my visit and loved the traditional feel. The pub gets busy during the week with post-work drinkers, so a good time to visit if you like it buzzy. It’s closed on Sundays, so for a relaxed pint away from the humdrum of Shoreditch, I recommend a Saturday visit. Excellent beers, top grub, friendly staff—well worth a stop.

Follow @thefoxshoreditch for updates.

📅 11th October 2025

If you want to see all my pub reviews in one place, head to @londonpubmap on Instagram or Facebook. 🍻

Google maps tells me that the previous time I visited was almost exactly 7 years ago, in 2019. It's changed out of all recognition since then. I did prefer the old version, but at least it's still a pub and you can get a good beer there. Nice crowd, but not too crowded on a Saturday evening.

Was in Shoreditch for the day, when I popped in here for some food - pizza was yum.com! The gal behind the bar was such a sweetheart too, let me play guitar and serenade her as was pretty empty - think her name was Alicia? Quirky star makeup and great attitude, pours a good Guiness!

Nice pub which was close to where we were staying in Shoreditch, so had to visit! We didn't try the food, however there was lots of choice on the menu, but we just stopped for a drink. The staff were lovely, and the pub was decorated really nicely. The music was also good.
However, the prices were quite expensive for two drinks, we paid just over £20 for a gin & lemonade, and a pint. But, it may have been worth it for the singing cans🎶

Booked the karaoke room. Spacious, large selection of songs, they have a QR code to order to the room so you don't have to go up and downstairs to the bar. Staff were lovely and helpful. Very nice spot.

As a lover of desi food, I went in with high expectations.

Kricket’s decor and service wowed me at first - their wait staff went out of the way to explain each and every dish on the menu and share their best sellers and top recommendations.

Everything on the menu looked appetizing so it was tough to pick (which only means I’m going again soon).

We good the keralan fried chicken, the samphire pakoras, the mangalorian gassi (chicken) curry, a masala naan, paratha and masala chai! Maybe it was the choice of our order but overall I felt like our food was quite oily. Besides that I thought the curry and samphire pakoras were quite good. Although it seems to be a best seller i would stray away from the fried chicken (maybe cause I generally don’t like it). The chai and paratha was my favorite part of the entire meal!

I do really wanna go back to try their take on nihari.

Kricket Shoreditch nailed it. We sat at the bar overlooking the kitchen, and watching the chefs work added so much to the night. The staff provided cool, funky service that made us feel right at home. As for the food: the small plates are a must. The fried chicken was a standout, and the prawns, cod, and chicken curry were all packed with flavor. A truly memorable meal!

We visited Kricket Shoreditch with a group of five and chose the £49 tasting menu. The menu concept is appealing and there is a very good selection of alcoholic drinks, which is a real plus. The atmosphere is lively and very “hip Shoreditch” — busy, with music on the louder side, so conversation can be slightly difficult, but that’s clearly part of the concept.

The starters were genuinely excellent and easily the highlight of the meal. Unfortunately, the main courses did not live up to that standard. Flavours felt inconsistent, and the dishes didn’t complement each other as well. Portions are also quite small, and each guest keeps the same small plate throughout the meal, which isn’t ideal for a longer tasting menu.

One practical issue with the sharing concept: the dishes are served in bowls for the table, and everyone serves themselves from them. However, there is no dedicated serving cutlery, so each person has to use their own fork, spoon, or knife in the shared bowls. This feels awkward and unnecessarily intimate, especially in a business or professional setting. Simple serving cutlery in each dish would solve this easily.

Overall, I’m between a 3 and a 4 out of 5. Strong starters, good drinks, and a popular atmosphere — but the main courses and some practical details hold it back from matching the very high ratings

I went here with a couple of friends and most of whom are meat eaters. I personally am a vegetarian for my vegetarian meal I ordered a sweet potato curry main as well as a masala naan and a bhel to start with. The bhel was the good dish between the sweet potato however, most of the food lacked any spice and was very sweet. I had to ask for an extra side of coriander chili paste to make my bhel spicy which cost me extra. This reminds me much off dishoom which is not really Indian food and indeed it's very westernised. The ambience was great for a date, however, I wasn't able to read the menu and there was no table lighting that would allow me to do so. Service was great otherwise and the waiters were very helpful. Overall, not the biggest fan of the food and I wouldn't be returning sadly.

I had a wonderful dining experience at this lovely restaurant. The staff were attentive and friendly, making us feel right at home. The food and cocktails were exceptional, each dish was bursting with flavors that cater to every palate while still preserving its authenticity!

If you’re attending a VFS appointment nearby and want the closest place to wait while your family is for appointment, this is the place. However bear in mind that they dont open doors until 11:00am. Nice and clean floor with good staff. Not sure about food as I didn’t order nothing. Just a pint. Prices are competitive with Fosters pint for £6.25.

I have walked past this pub on countless occasions and today I finally went in. The exterior is not inviting but once inside things improve. It has a lot of wood panelling but the numerous windows give a lot of light. They had four cask ales and a somewhat limited whisky selection. I chose a double Buffalo Trace bourbon at just over £11, about par for the area. The service was good, quite friendly. I liked this pub, don't let the exterior put you off, inside it's really nice.

A great spot near Liverpool Street. The atmosphere is lively with a classic British pub vibe. I enjoyed the wide selection of drinks, and the staff were friendly and efficient. It’s a solid place to unwind, especially if you’re in the area for work or travel. Would definitely stop by again.

Fantastic place with a great atmosphere and genuinely welcoming staff. Whether you’re stopping by for beers and ciders at very competitive prices or staying at the hostel upstairs and need directions or recommendations, they’ve got you covered. In my case, it was both!
Huge thanks to Stan, Josh, Laurent, and Telia for making it such an awesome weekend. Highly recommended

Wow what a wee treasure found in our day trip to see footie.
Lovely selection beers and drink and best coffee I've had since hitting London.
Service great. Lovely friendly pub that ticks all the boxes.

name: Old Red Cow
address: 71 Long Ln, Barbican, London EC1A 9EJ, UK

reviews.text:
Had a very enjoyable Steak and Ale Pie washed down with a bottle of Red Wine.
My partner went for a veggie Cauliflower Pie.

Both were excellent, as was the service.

It's a small pub across the road from Farringdon Station.  We ate in the upstairs bar.

Came here for a Sunday roast dinner and a pint. We arrived before 5:30 and they had run out of the chicken and lamb, so we ended up getting the beef and mushroom Wellington. The portion of food was great, and it really hit the spot. Service was fantastic!

Old Red Cow is a lovely pub tucked away on a quiet street not far from St. Paul’s Cathedral.

We stopped by for some good beer and dinner — and we weren’t disappointed!

The crowd seemed mostly local, with people chatting in pairs, which gave the place a warm and cozy vibe. It was pleasantly quiet and perfect for conversation. There’s a great selection of draft beers on tap, and the shepherd’s pie was delicious and tasted truly authentic.

Friendly staff and great atmosphere — definitely recommend this spot! 🍺
Had a really tasty steak and ale pie with mash and gravy. Fun atmosphere and the staff is friendly

Just love this pub! Hours walk from Marylebone and we will be doing this most weeks. Staff are outstanding, food especially the Sunday lunch probably the best pub Sunday lunch in London. Everyone genuinely cares......and its an independent. Get your arse down here but book its tiny!

Beautiful decorated and large bar in the city, with art deco features everywhere and some old parts of an old vault still on show.
Large venue, with a busy atmosphere.  Drinks can take a while to get from the various bars, but not too long to wait.
We didnt eat here, but the food being served looked good.  Drinks are very nicely presented.
Well worth a visit if in the city, to see a unique bar and to sample a great atmosphere.
Fabulous place to eat and drink, the jazz singer was amazing. The food choices were amazing.

Beautiful, posh bar and restaurant with live music. We had a great time and it had a lovely atmosphere. We also appreciated the fact that it wasn't too crowded. Despite being a walk in they were able to accommodate us very quickly with no waiting time. The food was exceptional and delicious. I would totally recommend this bar and restaurant.

Great vibe, live music, and tasty cocktails—perfect for a casual drink. There are lots of different restaurants under one roof, though we didn’t dine here ourselves. Definitely worth a visit, as the interior is a visual treat. The staff is super friendly and professional too!
Very cool building although the vibe is a bit like a train station, with lots of people coming and going through. The cocktails are extremely expensive and small
We came on Christmas Eve for lunch when everything else was closed. The fried chicken is amazing. Overall a very nice cosy pub.

A very nice pub in a very central location, inside a 19th century market, the Leandenhall. Beatiful period inyeriors. Calm atmosphere (on a January monday...). Very nice service. Asside the ale and a fine selection of international beers also as to offer a generous sellection of wines. If on the Mquare Mile looking for a drink in a tipical pub it is a good find!

I honestly can’t rate The New Moon Pub in Monument highly enough. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was warm, welcoming, and genuinely friendly. But the real standout was the customer service from Tito.
Tito went above and beyond and delivered the highest level of customer service I’ve experienced in a long time. I was looked after like a king, with such care, attention, and warmth that it completely elevated the whole visit. Nothing felt rushed or forced, just authentic hospitality from someone who clearly loves what they do.
The entire team is incredibly friendly and makes you feel instantly at home. If you’re looking for a pub with great vibes, excellent service, and staff who truly care about their customers, this is the place. I’ll definitely be back.
Highly recommended. 🍻

I came here with about 36 other people for a private event in which our entrees and desserts were ordered ahead of time. I really enjoyed the food and the warm atmosphere. The sea bass was perfectly cooked and crisp as well as the vegetables accompanied by them were great. The sticky toffee pudding was delicious but, very sweet. I would recommend coming here!
Perfect place for tourists. The staff helpfull and when you dont have any knowladge about beer you will get all what you want.

name: The Light Bar & Dining
address: 233 Shoreditch High St, London E1 6PJ, UK

reviews.text:
We booked the Loft at The Light Bar this weekend to host our wedding drinks and couldn’t be happier with the top tier service we received!
Great communications and explanation throughout. Excellent food & bar service and very grateful for the little extra mile they went on countless details of hosting a wedding party night for 90 approx people.
They provided ample amount of the amenities needed, kept me updated throughout a smooth running night. Fantastic staff and service. Thanks team!

I was there once and I liked the experience! We were 3 girls, ended up at The Light Bar on a Friday evening. We ordered cocktails and I loved mine! The service was good, the staff is nice and the space is spacious. I do think that it might be also a good venue for celebrations or events. There was a live DJ playing and he really nailed it. Although it is a bit loudy, I really liked the place and you can still find a place to chill and hear each other somewhere upstairs. Recommended!

The Light Bar hosted my VIP Dinner for women in my professional network in London. From the moment of booking, the staff were so helpful and communication and planning was spot on. We did a group set menu and the food was spectacular, so delicious and very generous servings with wonderful fresh, rich flavours. They kindly catered to dietary requirements and the service was impeccable - they really took care of us and we were all super impressed. They accommodated us moving to an outdoor table given it was such a beautiful balmy June evening and it was truly magical to relax and connect. Would absolutely recommend it for any corporate or personal event - it was an amazing venue.

Along with cocktails, the group set menu was absolutely spectacular starting with burrata and peppers, salmon fennel citrus salad, trout and crème fraiche, flatbreads both plain and topped with olive and tomato, and crispy chickpea hummus. Next came shared mains - delicious hispy cabbage on ratatouille, basil pesto baked orzo with rocket and Parmesan, and a baby chicken with gravy and greens. And of course we squeezed in the mountain of crispy churros with chocolate pots because dessert obviously goes into another tube.

I was truly blown away by the fresh flavour-packed dishes, perfect location, and wonderful service. I’m still dreaming of that heavenly trout dip…

I’m very disappointed with my recent visit. There were many empty tables available, yet we were refused a Sunday roast because we were seated in the bar area, which staff said was only for “nibbles.”

I was told I could order something small like fries, but not a full meal. This made very little sense given that the dining area clearly had space. It felt unnecessarily restrictive and not very customer-friendly.

If there are empty tables, customers should be able to order from the full menu or at least be offered the option to move to a dining table. The current setup is confusing and frustrating, and it really affected our experience.

I hope this can be reviewed so future customers aren’t turned away in the same way.

the burger is decent but not really really good. the menu got limited choices. service is alright but it took a while to get a pint from them. dj music is a bit too loud at dinner time. dont really know the positioning of this restaurant / bar. it is below average if you consider it as a restaurant. it is ok if you treat it as a bar. probably not visit again in the near future.

name: Bread Street Kitchen & Bar - St Paul's
address: First Floor One, 10 New Change, London EC4M 9AJ, UK

reviews.text:
Went on Sunday night in a party of two without reservation. There were only few tables. The decoration was cool.
The food wasn’t exceptional or great. It was simply just acceptable. The aged dry roast beef was kind hard to chew probably because I asked for “well done” instead of “medium rare”
The fish and chips were just ok and we barely ate. It was greasy but not crispy or tasty.
The desserts were good but a bit too sweet. The atmosphere was modern and we could talk without shouting
The service was acceptable though not as fast as it should be

What a restaurant! We’ve wanted to eat here for some time and it didn’t disappoint. The service was incredible, super friendly and warming. The food was some of the best we’ve had! The Tuna Steak special was my personal favourite! It was my
Wife’s birthday and they brought some ice cream and a chocolate happy birthday on a plate which was a lovely touch! Cannot recommend enough! Pricey though so be prepared lol!!

After all these years I finally got to try the famous beef wellington but not from his actual Michelin starred restaurant, but at least from one of his restaurant chains. Honestly, the crust and pastry were really good, but the beef itself was disappointingly rubbery. A bit of a letdown. Luckily the wine we paired it with was lovely and saved the mood. It came out to about £120 for two for the wellington, plus another £70 for the wine.

The vibe was great on a tuesday night. It was 70-80% packed, loud but you can still talk with your table mates. Service was excellent 👌

The spacious dining area and uniquely themed decor left a deep impression on me.

The spacecraft capsule near the entrance was particularly striking, it even serves as a private dining space for four!

We ordered the Wellington steak, which requires a 45-minute wait, and it was overall well-executed. The beef was cooked to perfection—tender and juicy despite the cut having minimal fat. The mushroom paste infused with black truffle wrapped around the meat was incredibly fragrant, while the outermost layer of puff pastry was delightfully crispy. That said, considering the price point, I felt it lacked a certain "wow" factor to make it truly exceptional.

The service was generally attentive and professional throughout the meal.

My partner and I attended the Sunday roast set menu here. Now don't get me wrong it was bloody lovely especially for the how inexpensive it was to what we thought it could cost however the only one tiny criticism I have was the roast potatoes were bland..... everything else on the roast and the desserts were sublime!! We opted for two courses and my gosh it filled us up. It was a real experience.
The decor was beautiful and rustic yet clean and comfortable ❤️
The staff were so kind, considerate, knowledgeable and nothing but pure professionals. 👏🏼👏🏼

Pleasant restaurant in a very convenient location. The food was delicious, reasonably priced, but the service was not very good. The restaurant wasn't busy on the evening we visited, so diners were well spread. This created a relaxing atmosphere, but it was hard to get the attention of staff because they always seemed to be far away or didn't pay much attention.

Good food and friendly service, but expensive (although being downtown London, what isn't).  I had the SIRLOIN STEAK TACOS which were fine, and the beer was cold.  The menu was quite large and since there were 5 of us, everyone found something to their liking.

The Folly is a BEAUTIFUL place. I have been there for a coffee only but will definitely go back for a full meal. The interior design is just stunning and the atmosphere very cosy. And it’s very big, they have a lot of tables and space. Highly recommended!

One of the most beautiful venue in London.
Great atmosphere, outstanding cure of details.
My wife was amazed by the Ladies Toilets and the chocolate treats.
Superb service, good food.

Highly recommended.

Very nice atmosphere, had a super fun time with friends. However I will have to say the service was a bit slow even when the restaurant was near empty. I understand that on the 2nd January people may be tired but it did take 2 full hours to get through 2 courses. The only slow thing about the service was the ordering process though but the chefs were rapid at least so the wait was shortened a bit but it was still quite long altogether. The food was adequately priced for some meals, however many of the portions in clouding the roast salmon were rather small and it left me slightly hungry. Most portions were okay but even so mine was essentially a child's meal which was a bit odd. The taste was marvellous especially the brownie but I cant rate it higher than a 4 because of the portions. Would recommend but take into account the portions sizes. You may be able to see the sizes before ordering in the open kitchen at the back. Lavatory was nice and well kept.

name: The Crown and Shuttle
address: 226 Shoreditch High St, London E1 6PJ, UK

reviews.text: It’s a pub so my friend suggested there because she likes beer. It offers a good selection of beers. I am not the beer person but she likes it! It is at a very central location in Shoteditch High Street and so packed on weekends. I went there on a Saturday evening and it was so crowded. The atmosphere is nice, mostly young people’s destionation and staff is nice. You cannot really talk and hear each other if you want a chilled evening but I suggest for a pub experience!

I hired the upstairs private venue for my 30th birthday party and it was absolutely perfect! The staff and manager were super helpful in answering my questions, hosting and cleaning up after the party. Guests said the food was of high quality and absolutely delicious too! Would definitely recommend hiring the venue for a party!! The only minus was that there was no sound coming from the TV though it had worked previously, and we briefly had some issues with the sound system but that was fixed soon after. Thanks for making it a great party!

Bit of an odd introduction to the pub at 6pm on a Tuesday when we were asked by the bouncer to open our bags to prove we weren’t smuggling alcohol into the pub (not something men in their 40’s typically do on a Tuesday after work). But once inside it’s quite a decent pub, nice atmosphere, and a good outdoor area at the back.

Must be the only pub in London that is NOT DOG FRIENDLY. Which has changed recently, staff are also oddly blunt and unhelpful and perform bag checks upon entry… yes for a pub.

I was told ‘it’s too busy’ for dogs, when clearly not. (My dog is also a miniature breed). I was also told “it’s illegal to have dogs in a pub as they don’t have insurance” - ridiculous.

Used to be a good spot, seems like the place think a bit too much of themselves now.

Ended up in a ‘bar’ the other side of the road and they were completely welcoming. No longer good place for a drink, go elsewhere there’s plenty of good options nearby.

We were in the private function room and Juliette was behind the bar - she was so lovely and her service was perfect. She advised us on which burger to order and we had a lovely chat! Would definitely recommend for anyone having a function.

I had a wonderful experience at Found. The food was absolutely delicious, with very generous portions and truly beautiful presentation. Every dish looked as good as it tasted. The service was excellent – our server Linta was attentive, friendly, and made the whole evening feel effortless. The restaurant itself is stunning, a hidden little gem with a lovely atmosphere. Everything was spot on from start to finish. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great meal in a beautiful setting.
Came here for brunch today, such a lovely hotel. Food was absolutely delicious (Full English) service from Rafael was amazing, made us feel very welcome. Would highly recommend

Nice Place and very warm welcome from the Staff.
Special thanks to Cristina.
Afternoon tea was good but the small dessert needs to be improved in terms of taste.

I can't praise these guys enough! Excellent service by Alex,Silvio,Dorian and Vishal! They made my friend's birthday dinner very special and really appreciated them singing her the happy birthday song! Very very kind of them! We had a 3 meal course and every dish was better than the other! We'll definitely be going back!

Wow. Wonderful experience was had today. One of the best Afternoon teas I have had. Celebrated today for my friend’s birthday and we always celebrate with an afternoon tea so we’ve had many. And this was in the top 5. It wasn’t busy so we were left to eat and chat and didn’t feel rushed.  Wonderful food, fresh and tasty. Clean and comfortable environment. And please say a massive thank you to Cristina. What a lovely woman. She was so accommodating and helpful. Always had a smile on her face. I purchased the tea via Virgin experience days and it was great. It came with prosecco. Tasty fresh food, warm scones, selection of sandwiches were great. Cakes were delicious. And to top it off my friend also got a Happy Birthday cake. Thank you so much. We had a great day and I will be back 😀

name: White Hart - Whitechapel
address: 1 Mile End Rd, Bethnal Green, London E1 4TP, UK

reviews.text: BEST SERVICE AND FOOD IN LONDON! The bartender Al was very kind. I highly recommend stopping in for a pint or the chicken bacon burger.

Thank you so much for hosting our post-wedding celebration! It turned out exactly how I imagined—cozy, chill, and beautifully grounded without being over the top. The venue was simply perfect for us.
A special thank you to Natasha, who was incredibly responsive every time I emailed or enquired about something. She even printed our guests’ names along with their menu choices, which was so thoughtful and such a huge help—one less job for me! 😂 Since our wedding was very DIY, having such a smooth and stress-free booking process with The White Hart made a big difference.
The audio and screen system were very user-friendly (honestly, a game changer!), and the long-haired gentleman from the staff was extremely helpful, patient, and tech-savvy, making everything run even more smoothly.
The table setup, seating, and Christmas decorations were all beautiful. Christmas is my favourite season, so the atmosphere felt perfect and even matched our wedding theme. The food was amazing as well—I especially loved the slow-cooked beef, I could’ve had more! 🤭😂
After the formal celebration, we had such a fun time having the whole floor to ourselves. The bar staff were very chill and accommodating despite how loud we were! I had booked the place until 16:30, but the staff kindly allowed us to stay later, which I really appreciated. It meant our guests could enjoy themselves fully without feeling rushed.
Booking The White Hart for our reception was one of the best decisions we made. I highly recommend it—the function room, private toilet, private bar, and the audio and screen system truly complete any event. Thank you so much to all the staff who were there that day. I didn’t get everyone’s names, but I really appreciate everything you did for us.
Very large and great  pub in Whitechapel. Went here for Sunday roast and couldn’t complain.

Went for breakfast/brunch, it was a light but filling meal. You can choose to order and pay from your phone (or at the bar), so it’s perfect if you’re introverted n don’t want too much interaction. But also perf, if you don’t care LOL. But then again, the servers were very nice n pleasant so I wasn’t trippin. But the food was very good so I was def happy choosing this place as our meal for that morning :)

We entered today on a quiet Monday  lunch time, we had aimed to go to The Blind Beggar Pub which didn’t open till 3pm, it didn’t look nearly as nice as The White Hart which was twinkly lights and welcoming decor.
A regular Pepsi max cost £3.20, we didn’t order food. Music was chill, seemed like a nice establishment.
The lady who served us was friendly and it was nice to see a chap cleaning the tables, windows etc and keeping the place looking spic and span. Good job.

name: Bar Douro City
address: Unit 3, 1 Finsbury Ave, London EC2M 2PF, UK

reviews.text:
I like Bar Douro but food was a little uneven on our last visit.  Lovely atmosphere with the blue and white tiled mural.  Tables a good distance apart, so quite quiet.  Red house wine was a reasonable £32 a bottle.  We ordered a few dishes to share.

Our pestico of smoked sausage croquette was delicious.  Very smokey, and a lovely flakey texture with a tiny dot of mayo and not at all greasy despite being deep fried.  The second to arrive was bacalhau a bras.  It is my favourite salt cod dish but the fish was a little too sturdy for my taste.  I prefer it when it is soft and falling apart.  Flavour balance with sliced olives was good.  Texture of the fried matchstick potatoes was excellent.

Prawns were unfortunately a disappointment.  It was great that they were peeled but the heads left on.  The sauce was strangely bitter but I couldn't identify the cause.  Too much brandy?   Garlic that caught and burnt?  A shrimp that didn't get properly de-veined?  When a waitress asked if I wanted bread to mop up the sauce I told her I didn't actually like the bitterness of the sauce.  It was good that everyone in the kitchen did taste the sauce on my plate and agreed that it was bitter.  The waiter kindly removed it from the bill, and the cook by way of apology brought us two nata tarts wrapped in tin foil to take home.  Very gracious.

The rice with wild mushroom was tasty.  However, my companion who is a stickler about food temperature complained that it was not served hot enough.

Our last course of bavette steak ordered medium rare was excellent.  Very tender, so expertly cooked and cut against the grain.  Accompanying mustard was slightly sweet with the addition of fortified wine.  Garnished with fried matchstick potatoes.

I've enjoyed Bar Douro in the past, so will return.  Hopefully food will be up to their usual standard.

We managed to get in nice and early before our booking. The staff were mainly friendly and welcoming. We had the tasting menu and we did very much enjoy it. The only thing we weren't a fan of were the peppercorns on the steak dish because they were far too strong and didn't really work. Otherwise lovely no issues.
We did think the portions were on the smaller side but not too bad for a small plates restraunt.
Service was efficient and dishes came out nice and quick.
When we came to pay with a few alcoholic drinks the bill sat around £115 before service, which we did think was expensive for what we had but if you have the cash it's worth a visit.

Great authentic Portuguese dishes served in the city.
Was a bit pricier than expected, but a treat especially if you haven't tried their unique flavours and twists.
Recommend to book in advance otherwise expect to be seated at the counter or outside!

This cute little restaurant serves some pretty tasty dishes.

Particularly enjoyed the mackerel salad, garlic prawns, salted cod hash and the black pig dishes. These were the stand out dishes of the evening.

Great table service as well from the male Asian waiter (sorry we didn't manage to find out this name). He was great with his knowledge of the menu and spot on with his recommendations.

The bar douro had a great atmosphere and service was very helpful and fast. The menu had good options and the food was tasty. The portions were a bit smaller than what I was expecting but I left full and satisfied. It was good but not the best value for money.

name: Players Social - Spitalfields Bar, Restaurant and Games

reviews.text: Average food (I tried the wings and fries) and wasn't blown away. However excellent service and really easy to get a spot on one of the games. Without having booked in advance, we were lucky to get a slot for darts, and I enjoyed it so much. All staff were really friendly and helpful. I will be coming back here for sure to try out the shuffle board!

Nice place to play some games in the city - the darts was £10 per person, which is pretty good value all things considered. Some of the darts were a bit damaged and the board didn’t always register your hit, which isn’t a problem for casual players, but probably annoying if you’re taking it seriously!

TOP TIP: Make sure you tell the staff when you want a go on the 10 second timer or your score won’t count and no free drinks for you!

Staff are great, drinks are ok but the food is quite poor. Not the worst, but not nearly good enough for a sports bar. The burger was kinda dry. You can kinda see how the outside looks on this photo you know when you go to a party - and the sliders are made hours beforehand and the bun and burger are both dried up? It was a bit better than that.

It's definitely not meant as an insult but as sheer honesty if you'd put a McDonalds cheeseburger on that plate i'd probably have been happier.

We had an amazing time here, the cocktails were amazing and the vibes unmatched. The food was delicious and the games were fun. Our server Jade was so lovely, she was informative and remembered our requirements well. The service was excellent and staff were attentive. We will definitely be back and we would recommend this place.

We had an amazing experience, and a big part of that was thanks to our waiter, Samantha. From the moment we arrived, she was warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. She knew the menu inside out, gave great recommendations, and made sure everything was perfect without ever being intrusive. Her professionalism and positive attitude really elevated the whole evening. It’s rare to come across service that feels this personal and effortless. Truly top-tier hospitality, thank you, Samantha, for making our visit memorable!

We had the roast brill and duck parfait with salad — both were absolutely delicious. The balance of flavors was perfect, the execution flawless. This is exactly what a great neighbourhood restaurant should be: honest food, impeccably made, nothing unnecessary. Highly recommend.

My partner and I had our wedding reception at Marksman and I can’t recommend it enough for a private event! Jessy and the whole team went above and beyond to make this day so special for us and our 60 guests. We had incredible service, amazing food and drinks and flexibility in accommodating all our needs. Everyone had a wonderful time. Thank you!!

This is the Marksman, a classy venue, even down to the script used for the signage.

The white and green paint job stands it out yet more, as does the small roof terrace with its parasols and cupola.

A large white glazed free hanging lamp adds to a very definite upmarket appearance.

It wasn't always so though. If you search google images hard enough you'll find the same pub with heavy blue signage. The paint job was white all over, but in need of a pressure wash and there was a huge advert board on the side. As time passed the curve of the outside upper floor wall received a mural of a long ago battle, no doubt giving rise to the pub's name.

Even older pictures show a brick facade with pillars and Vesy's Brewery emblazoned across the front.

Others show the pub was selling Everards and Godsons beers, and the older windows seem to have been replaced by upvc.

The year 1865 is carved into the pub's frontage, it's seen so much change since then. Was there a golden era here I wonder?

Indoors the current iteration of the pub is understated, traditional and altogether pleasant. There's still a curtain around the door, most of the chairs match and there's wood panelling throughout.

The beers are good with Lost and Grounded, Kernel, Five Points, Deya and Lucky Saint on offer. Prices range from £6 to £7.75.

All in, a lovely pub with some real history over the years. I bet the drinking style, punters and the conversation have changed over time as much as the appearance. I'd love to have visited for a bev in those earlier days.
Very good shared plates in a locley atmosphere! The upstairs had very different vibe to the downstairs through interior design. Overall, lovely location with excellent food! Would visit again.

I rarely link pub food with good food, but Marksman Hackney delivered a solid night. The curried lamb bun was the standout, and the chicken pie nailed comfort whist the rib was average and dessert felt ready for an upgrade. The cosy pub vibe and warm crowd made it a great place to linger with friends.

Myself and a friend came here after work on Friday 8th Nov 2024. We work very close by I didn’t even know it existed.
From the outside it looks closed, (perhaps more lighting is needed or a light up sign) however walking in we were greeted by the wonderful Abi, he seated us with a nice table in the back of the restaurant.

Rocky, and Gbo as well as Abi were very accommodating.

We pre ordered as we were short on time,

We ordered
For starters

Chicken wings and Halloumi cheese sticks 10/10

Mains
Loaded chicken fries and beef burgers
11/10
Yep that’s right 11 out of the 10 the Loaded fries alone were so delicious

My friend ordered a Wakanda cocktail and I opted for a Coke as I don’t drink alcohol.

We
ended the evening with apple crumble and custard for me and ice cream for my friend.

The place was nice and clean, the staff Abi Rocky and GBo were all friendly smily and went above and beyond for us.

We can not wait to come back
The toilets were very clean as well as the bar area and main restaurant
The music was good they even had football playing in the background ( as a Man U fan I was impressed haha)

See you all soon
Kels ❤️🎉

Food and drinks were decent. The service wasn’t the best, but it’s a new establishment so some issues are expected. The only downside to our evening was we felt incredibly rushed the whole time. The shisha was 10/10, it was smooth and not overly sweet (pretty sure it was peach&guava).
Such a nice vibe! Food was great, cocktails were amazing! Definitely be coming back here. Shamilah gave us the best service!

Firstly, made a booking, when I arrived on time they were still setting the restaurant up. They should be up and running for customers to come through. The prices could be more affordable to match the service and quality of the food. Lamb chops were nice. The decor and music were a good vibe. Customer service could’ve been better. We were constantly rushed out as our reservation time was nearly up but this was half an hour before which was strange. Service could’ve been more efficient and friendlier. Prices are too high for a lounge like this
Food & cocktails were excellent 👌🏾 Highly recommend the lamb chops, and the sticky toffee pudding was divine 😋 Lovely to meet the owner and head chef.

name: Dirty Martini - Cocktail Bar in Bishopsgate

reviews.text:
We attended the bottomless brunch to celebrate a friend’s birthday on a Saturday evening and had a great experience overall. Our server, Rachel, was excellent—super attentive and really made the night for us. She always made sure our drinks were topped up, so we definitely felt we got great value from the bottomless brunch.

The gluten-free food options could have been a bit more varied, but aside from that everything was fantastic. The DJ’s music was amazing and had something for everyone, which really added to the atmosphere. I’d definitely recommend visiting on a Saturday night!

Amazing atmosphere, the owner was super welcoming and even informed us that he wouldn’t charge full price since happy hour was about to start (5-9), we got there at like 4:30. Music was bumping and the layout is open,  although we got here early and didn’t get to experience it, probably great for dancing. Drinks were amazing, tasty, and had a good amount of alcohol. Service staff were also very nice as well! 10/10 recommend!

We went for bottomless brunch and honestly such a great time! The drink options were PERFECT. Oh the service was 10/10. We had such a good experience and Badal was so patient with us! He’s such a good waiter, which isn’t easy with 3 drunk girls. But he was kind and nice to us.

The food is good, the chicken burger and shrimp probably the best out of it all. Could be better with more meat options.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Had an amazing Sunday bottomless brunch here with friends and it was perfect from start to finish. The cocktails were the star of the show – the Pornstar Martini and berry cocktails were both delicious and kept flowing. The brunch menu had plenty of choice, and the vegan options were surprisingly tasty and excellent value for money.

The vibe is beautiful – stylish but relaxed, with a fun atmosphere that’s ideal for groups. Staff were friendly, attentive, and made sure our table was well looked after.

If you’re looking for the best bottomless brunch in Liverpool Street London , this place is a must-visit. Great cocktails, delicious food, and amazing staff – one of the top brunch spots in [City Name] for sure. Highly recommend!

The atmosphere was great as soon as we walked in, good music and people were up dancing and singing. Our table wasn't ready for when we arrived as the group sat there were previously told they'd have to move for the next booking but they hadn't. The staff quickly tidied and cleaned the table and area while we sat on some seats next to it. The drinks service was really quick and our waiter kept coming back to make sure we were topped up with drinks. The food was delicious however one person in the group said the portion sizes of the birdcages sharers weren't big enough as that was our dinner. The DJ had us up dancing the night away with some throwback songs. Thanks for a great night, the bride to be really enjoyed herself!

name: BOXPARK Shoreditch
address: 2-10 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E1 6GY, UK

reviews.text: I love the atmosphere here, haven't tried a lot of food here but it has a wide variety and I would be looking to try more as the few o tried wasn't all impressive. This place is so many things at one with a wide range of retailers and dance floors it's a place you can spend a long time in without realising it. Also, the bars are amazing and music is so good. Nice vibes

I used to walk past this place all the time but never actually went in. Recently, though, I went with some friends for an R&B night, and we all had a great time. It had a cool vibe, pretty decor, and different variety of restaurants/vendors to choose from.

Nestled beneath the elevated tracks at Shoreditch High Street station, Boxpark Shoreditch offers a vibrant, centrally-located hub of food and drink in East London. With an industrial-chic aesthetic—shipping-container units stacked across two levels—it’s stylish without being stuffy.  ￼

Food lovers will find a diverse palette of delicious options. Whether you’re craving a hearty burger or vegan-friendly Mexican street food, the variety is impressive: Italian pasta, Jamaican jerk, Japanese-style sushi and fusion stands all sit side-by-side.  ￼ The open-air dining level features communal bench tables where you can mix and match dishes from several vendors—a relaxed way to explore new flavours.  ￼

Beyond the food, Boxpark’s central location makes it extremely convenient. Just a five-minute walk from London Liverpool Street station and directly adjacent to Shoreditch High Street Overground, you’re well placed for a meal, drink or catch-up session before heading elsewhere in the city.  ￼

In short: Boxpark Shoreditch is a lively, taste-rich destination with something for everyone—ideal for enjoying varied, delicious food in a buzzing, centrally accessible spot.

I didn't really like the layout of this Boxpark, especially compared to the other ones in London.

It has a long row of individual shops on the outside of the building, which all have their own indoor seating area inside. As a result, some are really busy with no places to sit, whereas others are completely empty.

The indoor first floor has a large open plan, seating area, and a few food outlets inside.  Personally, I would have preferred to see more food places in this section, rather than having lots of individual shops outside, in a long row.

The building was pretty clean and well maintained, as were the toilets. Overall, it was okay, but I probably wouldn't visit this Boxpark again.

We went there for the Europa Cup final between Spurs and Man Utd and the atmosphere was electric. I might be biased of course because it was 95% Spurs supporters, however the banter was great. The staff were amazing, the bar was never too full regardless of the situation, and they put on a great music event afterwards for those who really wanted to celebrate, and oh boy did we want to celebrate. I mean it’s been 17 years. Great bar, would go there in a second again to watch another final. Let’s just hope it’s not so long to wait next time.

name: City Social
address: Tower 42, 25 Old Broad St, London EC2N 1HQ, UK

reviews.text:
Had the Christmas Menu with my colleagues . A Friend recommended this to me.
Team was helpful in getting place names set-up and having orders ready for the differing dietary needs.

The starter and main were lovely (Pate,Ribeye), the wine was great. Desert (Mont-blanc) was below average not bad ,wouldn't get it again.

Went during Christmas time around 2pm , was quite empty easy to hear everyone. Caught the sunset !

The entrance looked a little suspicious at first glance haha ,Wasn't sure where we were at first but the view makes up for it.

Service was polite aswell.

Overall ,Would go again and try other things.
I had wonderful company so naturally had an amazing time 😊✨️ - Thankyou!

If you're looking for a great view of the City and top-tier service, this is the place. The staff went above and beyond to make our visit pleasant. The food was ok, though not the highlight of the night. Still, the overall experience was excellent and I would recommend it for a special occasion or a nice view of the city.

My wife and I went to City Social for an anniversary drink. The views were amazing, the staff were very helpful, professional and attentive. We will definitely be going again, and maybe next time having something to eat. I’d recommend anyone to try it, and you don’t have to spend a fortune. Just a couple of drinks while taking in the fantastic views of the city.

We celebrated NYE at City Social on 31.12.2025 with a 5-course menu. While the food was very good, the experience was overall disappointing due to the services quality.

First, we arrived right at 9.30pm our booking time and were told to wait for 10-15min as the table was not ready. We sat at the bar and ordered a gin and tonic, which took also 15min to prepare. We sat down at our table around 9.50pm.

When we started the menu, there was a long wait between each of the course. We waited at least 30min between our first and second course! That means by 10.30pm we were still waiting for the second course.

It was a very stressful experience as when we called the restaurant before the evening, they told us all the dinners would finish before midnight and then they would move everyone to the bar area before midnight.

This clearly did not work as at 11.50pm, we just finished our 4th course and hadn’t had dessert yet. I was stressed about not finishing the menu before midnight. Eventually we had to leave the table to go the bar area for the midnight countdown and go back to the table for the dessert after 12am, all because the services had been extremely slow.

In addition to the slowness, the waiters and the waitresses kept forgetting about our requests. We asked someone for the drinks menu - they said yes and they disappeared. We had to ask someone else again. This happened at least 3 times throughout the night.

We understand NYE was an extremely busy time but we had been in other similar upscale restaurants in previous years for NYE celebration and had not experienced such poor quality of services and it was genuinely surprising.

I also want to point out the evening was very expensive. The 5-course menu alone was £250pp. On top of that we ordered drinks so our bills came down to £700+ for the night. The service charge alone was £100 so it’s incredible how little you got for what you pay. The service quality really did not match the price tag. I almost wanted to decline to pay for the service charge but ultimately still paid as I felt it was NYE and still appreciated all the staff’s work.

I don’t know if the service is better on usual days, but based on the NYE experience I would not recommend City Social for anyone who wants to have a fun NYE evening. There are many better places to go in London that charge you for much less.

Hidden gem of Tower 42, near the Liverpool Street station. Professional service, stunning views and delicious food. It is a bit pricey but this place really delivers and is totally worth it. We have enjoyed our Christmas dinner here a lot!

name: 1920 Bar
address: 19-20 Great Sutton St, London EC1V 0DR, UK

reviews.text:
I took my dad this past weekend (23 Jan) as part of a fly by trip to the Capital and we were both really impressed.

The lovely lady on FOH (whose name I have completely forgotten and didn’t have time to thank as it got busy quick!) was really friendly and even offered to move us downstairs when things got a bit busier - we were all played out but it was a lovely gesture.

The food was also delicious, we had a classic dog each and shared some fries. The portions were more than enough.

Overall, a really lovely atmosphere and great pool tables. Would definitely look to go back.

I had an amazing night at the bar. The billiards area is fantastic. The tables are impeccably maintained, the lighting is just right, and the overall setup makes it a great place whether you’re playing competitively or just enjoying a relaxed game with friends. Everything feels premium and thoughtfully designed.

The cocktails are equally impressive. Each drink is beautifully presented and expertly balanced — you can really taste the quality ingredients and the skill behind the bar. From classic recipes to creative signature mixes, every cocktail feels like a crafted experience rather than just a drink.

If you’re looking for a sophisticated spot in London that combines top-tier billiards with exceptional cocktails, 1920 Bar is absolutely worth visiting. I’ll definitely be back!

Amazing host Rico to teach us the tricks of pool and great serivce  at bar.
Good has niceee variety in platter for vegan , veg and non veg.
They have brand new pool tables and have some gifts for winning team and other categories
Clean restrooms .
Can accept 2-3 large groups
Enjoyed the halloween theme and nice music selection

My happy place. The tsbles have been refurbished recently and are superfast. Staff are always amazing and the music is a nice mix. Beer selection is excellent to boot. Will be going back soon. Use the website to book rather than just turning up.

Amazing place! My friend and I went there for the first time last Friday and we had a great time. Lively burgers, nice atmosphere to play table pool and good drinks. Really good night out! Recommend this place 100%!

name: The Duke Organic
address: 30 St Peter's St, London N1 8JT, UK

reviews.text: A wonderful experience from the moment we entered the door, nice atmosphere and the food was exemplary. The best roast I’ve had in London. The starters were also wonderful. The portion sizes are generous and the staff were also very attentive. Special shout out to Gabe and Layla! The food overall is 10/10 but if you want a roast with great taste and authenticity, this is the place for you. Also a great selection of drinks too. Highly recommend

Delicious food and lovely staff!
We had the Roast Beef, which comes with tasty potatoes and vegetables.
For dessert we had the Basque Orange Cheesecake and the Montezuma Chocolate Cremeaux, both spectacular in flavour and presentation.

Didn’t get a pic of the plate of food - was too greedy… but the clear plates hopefully show… the beef was beautifully seasoned and tender (a little fatty but if you don’t mind). I had the leg of chicken… fell off the bone, skin was lovely, loved it all… the staff are the absolute sweetest… would definitely come again!
(Dog and children friendly so bring the whole family!)

Nice cosy modern looking pub with organic delicious food. Foods has an Iberian feeling. We were there on a Saturday afternoon and it was packed. I believe reservation is a must for weekends. The service was good but i believe they need more staff on busy days and hours. Our waiter was very friendly and polite but they were running around and it was not easy to get them. The Roasted Squash Soup, Sourdough was almost perfect. Delicious soup for a cold afternoon. All the food was good. We had nice an pleasant time. Thanks

Came here for a Sunday roast, thanks to a recommendation.

The food was delicious, and the service was delightful to match. The scallops are definitely a must have if you’re stopping by for a meal!

If I were to be nit picky, I would say that the absence of gravy for the roast was a bit of a surprise, but it was delicious nonetheless!

We visited this restaurant in March 2026 for a Team dinner. Table reservation is recommended. They have high chairs as well near the bar counter. The food is well done, we took the set menu. Few of them were too spicy with red chillies. Beef cheeks dish was very good. Ice cream with banana side I didn't find it good combination. Overall experience was nice. Service speed should improve.

It’s been a while…

At last, following the unfortunate fire last year, som saa has reopened.

This place remains as fantastic as it always was. Authentic Thai food, well spiced, great ingredients and very tasty. Decent, friendly service too in a chilled dining room.

A great set lunch menu for £38 per person which you could have more of if you wanted to. We had a couple of additional plates - the deep fried seabass is a ‘must-have’ and always has been.

Great to see this place back. Some of the best Thai cooking in London.

Really loved the food here - authentic Thai flavours. The sea bass and chicken laab was a phenomenal combination, and the chicken skewers with tamarind dip were mouthwatering. Would love to come back here. The som tum papaya salad could have been a bit more fresh and the palm sugar ice cream (arguably one of the only desserts on their menu) was a bit unimpressive. I gave a 4 star for atmosphere because the tables are a bit cramped and small - so when it gets busy, it can feel quite claustrophobic and we had no space for our water carafe/glasses at one point. Also the wait for a table was quite long for walk ins - we waited about an hour while we ordered some tea and snacks near the bar.

This has set a new standard for Thai food. One of those places where everything ordered was on point and better than expected. Fantastic cocktails (special shout out to the Snowglobe), and each dish of food a burst of flavour followed by depths of accompanying flavour. The chicken skewers, the sea bass and the stone bass curry were the highlights.  The staff were all friendly, knowledgeable about the menu and the level of service from both kitchen and wait staff was impeccable. A fantastic place for a great meal.
Love it! Great menu selection of all the Thai favourites with daily specials. So happy with everything that we ordered and will be back. The chicken skin and also the seabass were highlights

Good experience at The Cheshire Cheese. The atmosphere is lively and friendly, with plenty of screens to watch Premier League matches, which is a big plus. The menu offers a good variety of options. You need to grab a table first and then order at the bar, which is fine once you know how it works. I had the fish and chips, decent, but nothing outstanding. Overall, a solid pub with a great vibe for football fans.

Cheshire Cheese is a brilliant example of a traditional London free house – historic surroundings, good beer, hearty food and a lively, relaxed atmosphere. Definitely worth a visit if you’re around Fenchurch Street.

I was in town with a group of American high school students and this pub was closely located to our hotel. The friendly staff were exceptionally accommodating to our group. Food was great. Prices are very reasonable. Fun pub atmosphere with plenty of seating upstairs.

I’ve been to two other Cheshire Cheese pubs, and none of them have disappointed, this one is no exception.

I’d heard there was a Cheshire Cheese pub near Tower Bridge, but I wasn’t exactly sure where it was until I randomly stumbled upon it. From the outside, it looked inviting, with a nice seating area and the impression that it would be spacious inside. So I decided to pop in and give it a go.

When I stepped in, I noticed a bunch of screens, not just for sports, but also showing various ads and promotions. It threw me off a bit, but it also made me think this pub probably gets a lot of attention and must have a good reputation if companies are advertising here.

Inside, the pub was indeed pretty and spacious. I know there’s a second floor, but I stayed on the main floor with the main bar.

When I approached the bar, the bartender was very welcoming. I’ll be honest though, I wasn’t quite myself that day, so apologies if I didn’t respond as normally as I should have.

I ordered myself a half pint of IPA and sat inside, taking in more of the atmosphere. It was quite relaxing since it wasn’t busy at the time. I can imagine it gets much busier, judging by the amount of empty glasses outside. Ideally, the bartenders would collect them, but I understand it’s not always possible, especially since I only saw one bartender working. If they’re not allowed to leave the bar unattended, or if another staff member was on break, that would explain it.

I had a look at the food and drink prices on the menu and behind the bar, and I was honestly surprised at how cheap everything was, especially for central London. It was shocking in the best way.

I didn’t order any food, as I wasn’t hungry, and I didn’t see any being served to other customers, so I can’t comment on that.

Overall, from my short visit, I found the pub relaxing, the bartender friendly, and the atmosphere great. My only suggestion would be to clear the glasses outside when possible, if staff can leave the bar, since it’s not the nicest sight having them scattered around the ledge.
Nice little hidden pub. Great place to watch a match. Food was okay

Came here the other night, for a meal and drinks before a show with mates.

Food was amazing. We all went for the Sunday roast.. I had chicken and my mates had roast beef.

Couple of cocktails each and then a dessert.

Service was quick, efficient and friendly

Will definitely return when in the area again.  Highly recommend this place.

My second time here and can’t recommend enough! The food is unreal and our waiter Jude was so attentive and lovely! He made sure we were well looked after and has definitely made us want to come back
!!
Sirloin steak and prawns were very nice. Great service as well. Thank you and will be back.

Had a fantastic fillet steak here. Service was friendly but a bit slow as I think they were understaffed, but very professional at all times. The steak is a great price for central
London. We enjoyed the Mexican corn side, very tasty!

Bar + Block is pretty top notch.  The two for one cocktails during happy hour lasted until 8 pm, and we got our money's worth with that gimmick.
