The service was attentive, and the food was excellent.  Our large party of eight tried all the starters, which were great, then we moved on to the entrees which might have been even better.  We steered clear of the desserts this time around.

name: Barbican Bar & Grill by Searcys
address: Barbican Centre, Silk St, Barbican, London EC2Y 8DS, UK

reviews.text:
Service a bit slow.
Not a very appetising menu.
Food cooked well, except cabbage with shepherd's pie was undercooked, and the shepherd's pie was chunks of neat, instead of the usual mince.
Tiramisu was delicious.

Om Om 🙏🏼 We stopped at The Barbican Bar and Grill before Zbigniew Preisner’s 70th birthday concert. We shared an Aperol Spritz, mezze platter, and grilled halloumi — all delicious and ideally suited the occasion. The cappuccino afterwards was less convincing, but overall, it was a great pre-concert experience. We’ll happily return for drinks and snacks on future visits.
I ordered Poached salmon. It was very good. The salmon was very tender and I liked the sauce. Staffs were very kind and atmosphere was lovely.

Had a great time at Bonfire Bar & Grill by Searcys!
The food was delicious and well-prepared, with great flavors and quality ingredients.
Service was also excellent — friendly, efficient, and made us feel very welcome.

Definitely a place worth checking out if you’re in the area. Highly recommended! 🍔🍟🔥

Came to the barbican to enjoy the sunset scenery on the rooftop area. I came as a walk-in; Dorina sat me down and helped me out with a few questions I had about the drinks. She was so sweet!
I ended up ordering crispy pork bites and mashed potatoes with Harri who was a great chat and took the precautions to ask me if I had any allergies or dietary restrictions.
Welcoming and kind energy all around the workplace. It was a bit breezy so I asked to get my food reheated (I know a bit of a hassle) but Dorina was kind to do so! 🥰

Lastly Marion (my waitress) was really attentive constantly throughout my stay if I had any further enquiries. She came to ask me if im enjoying my food so far, and it was quite filling but so delicious!! If you are looking for a splendid view, you should definitely give this a try!

We came here for afternoon tea as part of a spa package at the hotel, and absolutely loved our experience! Such value for money🥰 if anything, it was probably too much food as we ended up taking back loads and were in a proper food coma! Great service, lovely lovely lovely sandwiches, scones and pastries🙏🏽 will come back again with family!

Overall, was an enjoyable experience. I ordered the fish pie which was nice although there were pools of melted butter that had collected in the dish. Possibly from the sauce.

Nice food and service and good to visit if staying at the hotel.
I thought this was a great restaurant, especially for a hotel. Sitting outside had a great ambiance with chill music. Relaxing, not too rushed, and the food was absolutely delicious.
Some of the best food we have had out in a long time, everything was delicious and the staff were so friendly. The Cheddar mash is a must by the way!

The service was perfect, the staff were welcoming and friendly. The only thing that is disappointing- very loud music. I have read the reviews before coming. There are a lot of complaints about too loud music.  It seems that management don't consider their guests' feedback. Are you playing this music to enjoy yourselves? Is this restaurant working just to please you? Why not to give your guests the opportunity to enjoy the meal and their private conversations? We were at your restaurant at 6.30 and did not expect to listen to too loud music that didn't allow us to talk to each other.

So positively surprised about this place! I booked it for my birthday and we had a great time. I even got a treat from the service for my BD.

The food and wine is a great price/quality, the Spanish reserva wine was really soooo good. I will definetly come back very often with friends, work colleagues… ABSOLUTELY RECOMMENDABLE!

I had never been to the place my aunt recommended for my boyfriend’s birthday, but it turned out to be absolutely amazing! The team was incredibly organized and professional – huge thanks to Abel, Jordi, and Turguay! I tried to book a table online but couldn’t find the option, and after talking to them, they immediately arranged one for us after the game so we could keep the party going. Everything was perfect – we had such a great time! 🎉💫

Dropped by this place for a quick dinner as we were quite tired after a long flight. The atmosphere of the bar is cosy with music playing in the background. Ordered the buttermilk chicken burger. The buttermilk chicken is slightly on the salty side, crispy but a bit hard.

It was my first time visiting this place with my work colleagues, and I was really impressed. The atmosphere was great, and the team was amazing—very welcoming and attentive. One of the waitstaff went out of her way to explain every dish that was brought to our table, which I truly appreciated. Her attention to detail made the experience even more enjoyable. We had a lot of fun, and the host was fantastic. Overall, a great experience!

The whole experience from start to finish was fantastic.  The venue could not originally accommodate my enquiry (over 80 people booking) but must have had a cancellation so they contacted me to let me know.  After booking I received regular updates via email but knew that I could have picked up the phone should I have wanted to.  On the evening the team were excellent!  I felt that it was particularly well staffed with what appeared to be a well thought out delegation of roles, each performed to perfection.  The pizza was particularly good, often it isn't outside of an actual pizza restaurant.  The staff moral and training must be very high as everyone appeared to be loving their job.  I will definitely be returning and well done team!

name: Grill Bar and Restaurant
address: 10 New Drum St, London E1 7AT, UK

reviews.text:
I rarely use such emphasis, but this was sadly by far the worse Afternoon Tea I have ever experienced. Full review as follows:

★★☆☆☆ Ambience
Less an afternoon tea venue, more a quiet sports bar vibe, which puts the staff at a huge disadvantage to start with if they are trying to serve what is traditionally a “posh” lunch.

★☆☆☆☆ Sandwiches
Seven rather slap-dash cut finger sandwiches, with little variety or flair. Seriously, did the chef only have a blunt knife to hand?
• Three ham and mustard
• One cheese and cucumber
• One cheese and tomato
• One tomato
• One salmon

★☆☆☆☆ Scones and Cream
Bland disappointingly small scones served with some kind of cream that had the consistency of a yoghurt. Whatever it was, this was not high quality clotted cream and certainly not delicious.

★☆☆☆☆ Cakes
Bland, stale cakes. No fruit at all. Descriptively tasty looking too.

★★★☆☆ Service
Service was friendly and kind, if not entirely conscientious: my tea pot was served without anything to drink it and I actually had to request a cup and saucer.

Certainly not worth £26 per person, neither half that price should you book through a third-party. It was frankly dire and they really need to invest in a higher standard of ingredients.

If you found my review or photos helpful, please leave a quick thumbs up 👍 Thank you!

Long wait after ordering. Three of the four dishes were rather carelessly prepared with obvious flaws: one side dish was too cold (possibly frozen and not heated through properly), one dish was partially burnt. Service quality was standard/average.

The staff members were really friendly! The food was really tasty and the portion was excellent. The drinks were really great also! We went on a Thursday evening and we didn't have to wait at all, the drinks came fast and we didn't have to wait long for the food either. All and all a nice restaurant with a comfy atmosphere.
The restaurant is empty and 1 hour+ waiting for this...  Worst food in my life. I do not recommend to spend money here

Basic food and cocktail menu, but decent tasting. Service needs finessing and lacks professionalism - I.e. waiter went to bring the card machine into my face when I was in the middle of a call and I haven’t even asked for it yet as if asking me to leave. Toilet limited to hotel guests only and you have to use the disabled toilets by the lifts.

Not great. Have to say I’m not coming back again.

name: The White Hart
address: 89 Whitechapel High St, London E1 7RA, UK

reviews.text:
The White Hart on Whitechapel High Street is a quintessential East End pub that manages to feel both traditional and surprisingly unique. Located just a short walk from the Aldgate East station, it serves as a reliable neighborhood local that avoids the pretension often found in more tourist-heavy parts of London.

The Atmosphere
The pub retains much of its historic charm, with dark wood accents and a layout that invites settling in for a long evening. It is a no-nonsense establishment that focuses on a great selection of craft beers and ales, frequently rotating its taps to highlight local breweries. The environment is bustling and authentic, providing a genuine snapshot of London life where workers and locals mingle in a relaxed, dimly lit setting.

The Culinary Surprise
The most notable aspect of the White Hart is its kitchen. While you might expect standard British pub fare like fish and chips or pies, the menu is actually focused on Thai food. While this is certainly unexpected for a historic London pub, the quality is actually pretty good. The dishes are flavorful, well-prepared, and provide a welcome contrast to the typical heavy snacks found in similar venues. Pairing a spicy green curry or a plate of stir-fried noodles with a cold pint of local ale turns out to be a fantastic combination.

Service and Value
The staff is efficient and friendly, handling the busy post-work rush with professional ease. Pricing is reasonable for the area, making it an excellent choice for those who want a quality meal and a few drinks without the premium price tag of more formal restaurants nearby.

Verdict: The White Hart is a hidden gem for those who appreciate a bit of the unexpected. The combination of a classic pub atmosphere and solid Thai cuisine makes it a standout choice in Whitechapel for a casual and satisfying night out.

I absolutely loved this pub

To me, it is pure nostalgia, of the pubs I used to visit when I was younger with my mum and dad

A no nonsense pub, is how I'd describe it, but I mean that with complete affection

We didnt have anything to eat here, butnit has good beers and wine, in a good location. Can't fault it!
Noon on Saturday:  London Pride with steak and ale meat pie meal …  Perfect!!  Soooo good

Walked in totally lost but by the time we left knew excalty how to get around staff friendly and helpful. Food was lovely and the pub itself is very interesting and very old
The White Hart is part of Jack The Story

The White Hart is a lovely historic pub with lots of character, but unfortunately it is not wheelchair friendly in reality despite being advertised as accessible. There is a step to get inside and a very steep ramp leading up to the seating area at the back of the pub/ the area where the toilets are. I was told on the phone that there were disabled toilets, but when I visited it was not clear whether these existed or whether they were simply not signposted. It is a real shame, as the pub itself is charming, but the accessibility information does not match the experience.

Solid ale and cider pub. Quite surprised to find one so close to Liverpool St. Good selection of real ales and proper ciders. Dart boards at the back is a nice touch and only a donation to charity is needed to get the darts. Lots of room to sit too. Enjoyed it

A nice pub with friendly staff, Sam was extremely good.  I popped in for a Sunday roast and unfortunately there was only 1 left so I settled for the lamb rather than the beef that I wanted.  The lamb was fine and my partner was okay with the beef.  I had high expectations that a Sunday roast was a big thing, but either I went to the wrong spot or my expectations were off.  Other than that, the beer was good and I enjoyed my the Williams.

Probably the best pub on this side of the City.
It offers an excellent selection of ales and ciders, all kept wonderfully fresh thanks to the constantly rotating lines, which also means there’s always something new and exciting to try. The food is very good as well — I’d recommend the fish and chips, or the rabbit or beef pie. The Scotch eggs are a great choice if you’re after a warm snack.
The customer service is consistently good, and a deserved shout-out goes to Anton and Luke.

I’ll certainly be back. Thank you!

I went here last Thursday afternoon/early evening with my better half. I had the Chicken Schnitzel with a side of Smashed fries with shallots, mushroom crackling, pesto and my wife had the steak.
The service was very good with friendly staff who were knowledgeable about the menu and whether anything was already finished (there was nothing unavailable).
Order to table time was impressive and the food was outstanding! Chicken was soft and tender and the smashed fries side was so good I would go there again just to eat that!
My wife's steak was perfectly cooked and judging by her lack of conversation was as good as it looked! (unless she doesn't actually like me!)
We will definitely be back for more!
We didn't eat food, Guinness on tap is the best and apple cider was great. Dart games and table games add to the relaxed atmosphere. Would definitely visit again.

Great experience! The dining section upstairs is a nice relief from downstairs. The food was incredible- the marmite butter was 10/10. Pie was also lovely. I will say service could’ve been better, our waiter was unsure and awkward but perhaps he was just learning!

🚇 Old Street
🍺 £6.70 Princess Pilsner

The Princess of Shoreditch sits in a quiet backstreet in Shoreditch, East London, the nearest Tube is Old Street.

Records show there’s been a pub on this site since 1742. It was rebuilt in the 19th century and started life as a Whitbread house named The Princess Royal.

This is a one-bar, two-room gastropub with an elegant understated, “less is more” feel. The bright and airy ground-floor bar features a traditional servery and an impressive bar back. There’s plenty of seating with low tables, chairs, and leather banquettes. Decorative touches include a huge mirror and a lovely old Whitbread sign above the door.

Upstairs, reached via a wrought-iron spiral staircase, is the dining room. It’s stylish with a boarded floor, fireplace, green walls, black-and-white prints of the local area, and neatly set tables and chairs.

The beer selection offers a small but varied keg lineup. Three cask pumps were present but not on when I visited. I opted for the Princess Pilsner — excellent pint, though at a slightly above-average price. The food menu is seasonal British fare, focused on local sourced ingredients. Fish and chips is £21, and I hear the sticky toffee pudding is a must.

I arrived just after 12:30pm on a mild Saturday lunchtime in October. The pub had just opened, and I was the only punter in. The atmosphere was relaxed, with a calming soundtrack setting the tone. Service was spot on — the two staff on duty were friendly, busy preparing for the day, and happy to show me around.

Sometimes the word “gastro” puts off those just after a pint, but this pub balances both worlds nicely — a bar for casual drinking and a smart space for a proper meal.

I really enjoyed my visit. The Whitbread heritage, the striking architecture, the understated decor, the spiral staircase, and a perfectly poured pint all made for a great stop.

Follow @princessofshoreditch for updates.

📅 11th October 2025

If you want to see all my pub reviews in one place, head to @londonpubmap on Instagram or Facebook. 🍻

Our first time trying a Sunday roast and it didn't disappoint! We had a beef roast which was as delicious as the reviews say. Our dining experience was made even greater because our server Christina was so warm and welcoming. She put us right at ease. Thank you so much for the amazing experience. Will definitely come again.

This was a huge disappointment given the price of the Christmas set menu. My venison main turned up not just cold but refrigerated and very dry, had to send it back. The sticky toffee pudding was clearly from a packet, dry, looked like a stale muffin. The rest of our team thought their chicken main was completely average. There were no pigs in blankets even though the menu said there would be. Staff were friendly but drinks service was comically slow. We managed to get two drinks each in the space of over two hours. At £60 per head for the set menu it was really very poor. Christmas party ruined!

Visited for a Friday night dinner with 2 friends and wow, were we impressed with the food!
We were recommended a few dishes by our waitress and the chef, which didn’t disappoint. Absolute must haves are the scotch egg (the best we have ever had), marmite glazed chicken thigh, scallops with black pudding butter, and duck breast. Leave room for dessert as they were delightful!
Service was well paced and we were well looked after. A lovely ambience with great interiors- more of a restaurant vibe than a pub. A great place for date night or for dinner with friends. Will be back soon to try the rest of the menu!

Great brewery with a brilliant atmosphere. The beer is exceptionally fresh since it’s brewed on site, and there’s a really good range to choose from, whether you like something light or more hoppy. The space has a cool, industrial feel and always feels lively without being overwhelming. Staff are friendly, knowledgeable, and happy to help you pick the right beer. The food pairs perfectly with the drinks.
A fantastic spot for a relaxed drink or a fun night out — I’ll definitely be back

Thanks Phil and Georina for amazing Beer tasting

Instagram @dininginlondon

What an excellent brewpub.

Really friendly chatty bartender's who also know their stuff for craft beer and spirits.

The brewer was out and about working hard too and you can get quite close to the open plan brewery too.

The burgers looked fantastic but decided to save that for next time despite the tempting lunch time deal.

The beers are of a wide range from honey to fruit, IPA and then Irish stout and an absolutely amazing red ale on nitro tap!

Highly recommend a visit and so close to Liverpool Street station. Basically a hidden gem.

Also untappd verified, extra points :)

Btw the wasabi peas are proper hot, lovely stuff.

Will certainly be back ❤️🍻

This pub was honestly the best pub we’ve been to in London!!! What had a flight of 6 beers… all brilliant and the most amazing hand-made stout + IPA! It was beautifully made and tasted refreshing! The Caesar salad is so so so good and the burger and fries complimented the experience. Cool vibe and again our servers, we’re the most polite and intuitive servers in London! Well done Long Arm👏

I popped in here for a drink and food earlier on today and I absolutely loved it. The venue was nice and spacious and the atmosphere was good. I throughly enjoyed the food also. What made me really want to write a review was our waiter/bartender Sean, he was lovely and really took care of us whilst in the venue!

Sean made our evening lovely today!!
He was very kind,attentive and helpful with everything we needed!! Made our evening very special with his presence 🙌🏼
we will come back again very soon!

MEXICAN DATE NIGHT 💖
📍 @zapoteshoreditch, Shoreditch
⭐️ 5/5
💸 £££
🍴If you’re looking for a romantic, cute #Valentine’s date spot, Zapote is SUCH a vibe. Dim lights, stylish interiors, perfect for sharing plates and having a long dinner with margaritas 🍸Here’s what you absolutely need to order:

1️⃣ Totopos & #Guacamole: Of course we started with this. My favourite. Fresh, creamy, perfectly seasoned. Simple but unreal.

2️⃣ Yellowfin #Tuna & Spicy Crab Tostada: Light, fresh and slightly spicy. So balanced and such a good starter to share.

3️⃣ Fillet of Beef, #Oxtail, Ancho Chilli, Avocado & Tomatillo Salsa: Rich, tender and full of flavour. The tortillas make it even better because you can build your own perfect bite.

4️⃣ Grilled #Octopus, Pasilla Chilli & Pipian Verde: Smoky, juicy and packed with flavour. One of those dishes you keep thinking about after.

5️⃣ Coal Roasted #Secreto al Pastor Skewers: Super juicy, smoky, served with guacamole and salsa roja. Bold and delicious.

Perfect for date night, anniversaries, or when you just want to impress someone with a proper #Mexican feast ❤️🌮

The food is utterly fantastic. Beautifully made and presented - you taste each individual fresh authentic ingredient’s note.

The place is very tastefully designed and decorated and the tables are well spaced to allow privacy but maintain atmosphere.

The staff are really warm, helpful and welcoming, happy to explain the menu and make you feel right at home.

Don’t miss the sea bass aguachile, crispy suckling pig, or ox tongue tacos. Honourable mention to the duck quesadillas.

Now we’ve discovered this place we’ll be back soon 😎🔥🙌🏻

We have had one of the best experiences dining here. Not only food was delicious but service was impecable (great recommendations from the Spanish lady… unfortunatelly -lucky us- it was her last day at work). The place is next level beautiful. Did I say food was amazing (every single plate!) and the Margaritas 👌🏾👌🏾👌🏾. We also felt extremely comfortable and were made feel like home. 300% recommend

I had a nice enough meal here. The service was friendly enough and the waiting staff very helpful. Unfortunately, the quality of the food didn’t really match the pricing. I realise it’s London and things are more expensive here, but honestly I expected to be blown away, and I wasn’t. It was tasty, but nothing special. The house white wine was excellent.

Having said all that, I asked for a quiet table (dining alone), and the staff were very accommodating. The restaurant itself has an excellent vibe. I would definitely visit again, but next time I’d choose other items from the menu. The bill came to £77 for three courses, water, and two glasses of wine.

Incredible food, Mexican “modern”. Everything has its own taste combinations, without overwhelming the ingredients used. Great for events or celebrations. The bigger the group, the more options you can order. Friendly staff, a bit loud environment, in a happy way

My wife and I visited Unity Diner as part of our Valentine's Day in London.
Service was prompt and the food choices were great.
We shared the mozzarella sticks and sun artichokes for starters and then I had the donee meat dirty fries and my wife had the tofu and chips. The portions sizes were huge. We ended up taking half the tofu and chips home and it still seemed like a full serving. My dirty fries were amazing but I wish I had doner meat with fries rather than fries with dinner meat - maybe next time.
Although there are steps at the front, there appears to be step-free access at the back. Toilets are clean, individual unisex cubicles.
Definitely worth visiting again to try something else.

First rime at unity diner and even with all of the hype IT DID NOT DISAPPOINT. I went on a Sunday and had the carvery! The “turkey” and all of the trimmings were so bloody delicious! I then got the chocolate torte for dessert and it was so light but chocolatey with a lovely hazelnut crunch to mix up the texture! I’ll definitely be back soon!

Amazing vegan restaurant! We had the tofish and chips, which was the main reason we came, and it was fantastic, honestly the best I have ever had. I absolutely loved the pea mash that came with it, and the fries were perfect as well. The portion size was huge. We shared one portion and both left feeling full and happy. I would honestly love to eat there every day!

Excellent service even on a busy day. Really enjoyed the innovative menu, and the food was tasty and presented really well too. I am definitely coming back to try the Wellington next time! Would definitely recommend for fellow vegans or anyone looking to try serious plant base delicacy!

We have been eating our way across vegan restaurants in London. The moment I walked in the door, I knew I had arrived. The food and vibe are amazing. The staff are super nice and we felt very welcome. If you’re coming to London or if you live in London, don’t miss your chance to come to Unity Diner where “The Future is Vegan”.

name: The Cornershop Bar
address: 123 Shoreditch High St, London E1 6JE, UK

reviews.text:
Came for the cocktails, stayed because my dog refused to leave. The Cornershop on Old Street is one of those rare Shoreditch spots that manages to be genuinely welcoming to both humans and their four-legged plus-ones — and trust me, my dog has higher standards than most critics.
The cocktails are the real headline act here. Well-made, generously poured, and priced in a way that won’t make you do a double-take when the bill arrives. Whether you’re after something classic or something with a bit more personality, the bar team clearly know what they’re doing.
The vibe is relaxed and unpretentious — exactly what you want when you’ve got a dog in tow and no patience for places that treat a golden retriever like a health and safety incident. The staff were warm, the atmosphere was buzzy without being chaotic, and the happy hour deals are genuinely happy-making.
Basically: great drinks, good energy, dog approved. What more do you need?

Had a nice time watching the final F1 race of the season here! The viewing experience was great. They had lots of screens and the volume was loud enough that you could hear the commentary and get the most out of the action, without being too loud that you couldn't talk. Didn't try the food, but the diet coke and lemonade were very sweet (as I like it) and the guiness was GREAT! It was smooth and chocolately, probably one of the closest to how it tastes in Dublin that I've had in London.

Food wasn’t great, but cocktails were awesome, service super as well, wouldn’t actually recommend for Formula 1, the sound was quite low, requested to turn up but didn’t help, plus there was only 3 TVs streaming the race, another 2/3 streaming different sport each, even thought everyone was there for the race, won’t come back for sports but maybe for drinks!
Love it here! Go often with the girls! Lovely atmosphere, nice crowd of different people every time, music is cool and nobody looks at you like you're a fool. Drinks are reasonably priced.
Very friendly staff, nice clean bar and toilets. I would come again if I'm in the area.

name: Fazenda Rodizio Bar & Grill Bishopsgate - London

reviews.text: Lovely clean and a great place to dine! Was a meal for me and my partner yesterday lunch and we loved it.. the salad counter was Devine with a good selection of salads and cheese and more.. tasted great.. the meat kept on coming through the 2 hours we were there and towards the end they asked what meat choices we would prefer.. of course the fillet and ribeye so the waiter bought me plenty of that.. left pleasantly full and the experiance was relaxed good wine and good atmosphere!

I visited Fazenda today to celebrate my birthday and it was honestly an unforgettable experience. From the moment we arrived, the scenery was absolutely gorgeous and set such a special tone for the day.

The staff were exceptional — so friendly, accommodating, and genuinely kind. As soon as they knew it was my birthday, everyone made such an effort to make me feel celebrated, constantly wishing me a happy birthday and checking that everything was perfect. That personal touch really meant a lot.

The food was outstanding. The unlimited meat service over the hour and a half was incredible — every cut was cooked to perfection, full of flavour, and beautifully presented. Everything we tried was absolutely gorgeous, with such a high standard throughout.

Overall, the atmosphere, service, and food combined made it the perfect place to celebrate a special occasion. I couldn’t have chosen a better restaurant for my birthday and will 100% be returning. Highly recommend!

Thankyou to everyone on shift on the night of 4/02/2026

Absolutely fantastic experience at Fazenda. From start to finish, everything was spot on.

We were looked after by Matias, who was incredibly friendly, attentive, and accommodating throughout the entire evening. He made sure we had everything we needed and really added to the overall experience.

The food was outstanding. There was an incredibly wide selection of meats, all brought to the table quickly and cooked to perfection. The buffet was equally impressive, with a great variety of sides, sauces, and spices to complement everything.

And don’t skip dessert, it’s a must. The tres leches cake was unbelievably moist and absolutely delicious.

Amazing service, amazing food, and a brilliant atmosphere. Can’t wait to come back!

We had visited the Edinburgh branch before and were very satisfied, so we decided to try the Fazenda here without any hesitation. There is a bar-like area on the ground floor, and we were seated upstairs for the meal. We chose the “all-inclusive” package, which includes unlimited meat service as well as access to the salad bar. The variety at the salad bar seemed slightly more limited compared to Edinburgh, but the quality of the items was still very good.

I’m a bit conflicted about the overall experience. At the beginning of our visit everything moved quickly — the different cuts of meat arrived one after another. But after a while, even though our card was left on the “keep serving” side, the pace noticeably slowed down and eventually almost stopped. Towards the end they asked if we would like grilled pineapple, which is usually served at the very end, and this made us feel as if they were subtly signaling that it was time for us to leave. At the same moment they asked if we wanted any specific cuts, which felt odd, because with an all-inclusive package we shouldn’t need to request each item individually — if that were the case, we would have ordered à la carte.

The biggest downside of the place is how extremely dark it is; it’s hard to even see the color of the meat you’re eating. The service was polite, but it felt slightly artificial — almost as if the staff were overly focused on receiving a good tip. Personally, in terms of service, atmosphere, and overall experience, I preferred the Edinburgh branch; although I have to say the quality of the meat here was better.

Everything was absolutely wonderful. We went there for our 10th anniversary, and Justlin took amazing care of us. After the meal, they made a lovely gesture by offering dessert and prosecco. The food and service were excellent. I definitely recommend it.

name: Bread Street Kitchen & Bar - The City

reviews.text: We went last night for a Beef Wellington experience, gifted to us as an engagement gift. The food, experience and service were fantastic and we thoroughly enjoyed our meal. Every course was incredible and our waiter (so sorry I cannot remember your name now!) looked after so well, we felt thoroughly spoilt. Only regret is we had to leave for a show so couldn't stay longer and were too full to finish all the food!

Absolutely loved this place 😙

In the UK so why not try the beef Wellington from Gordon Ramsay?

Tried beef Wellington at Hell’s Kitchen but this one is much bigger! You get two massive slices 🤤

It was heaven x2

We didn’t known it came with mashed potatoes so we did order Mac and cheese as a side. Honestly that was too much

The prices of the cocktails are a bit too much imo so went with non alcoholic and cider. Both great

Server was also great ✌️✌️

Overall this place os amazing, slightly over priced for a burger but it's worth it. I highly recommend it. Snow crab roles are usually a delight however this time they were a bit too cold. Almost felt frozen. Everything else was great. Its not that busy so you can just walk in .

The food was absolutely amazing , I’d recommend going as a group of 3 so you can try both the Wellington and the large cut prime rib. totally worth it.
Big thanks to Ms. Thai for the warm 5-star hospitality
Came here after getting married, food was amazing. Francisco made us feel very welcomed and special. Be prepared if coming at lunch time it will be busy with the work crowd.

Tanmay was our server. Food was delicious and plentiful. We tried some new dishes that we have never had before and we were not disappointed! Quiet when we came in but it very quickly got busy so would recommend booking. All staff were friendly and attentive. Would recommend and we would come back.
We had a lovely experience with Mack. The food was outstanding. The atmosphere was relaxed and comfortable. As an international guest - I highly recommend.

Our server Mandy was fantastic, he gave delish recommendations and we had a wonderful meal. Service was amazing, very relaxing feel. The chickpeas with spinach were a surprising standout. Lamb balti was delish. BYOB is always a plus. Thoroughly recommend
Amazing meal and service! Our waiter Tanmay was very attentive, helpful and friendly. Also they have a separate menu for vegans. Would whole heartedly recommend

Not often I rate a curry house 5★, but this place delivers some of the best curry you’ll find. The menu is extensive and they’re more than happy to cater to individual tastes.

For starters, I had the sheesh kebab, well spiced and full of flavour. For the main, I ordered the garlic chicken masala and asked for it hotter than usual; it was phenomenal. My friend ordered the chicken dopiaza, which was also top quality.

The Peshawari and garlic naans were excellent sides, and our server Farhan was attentive and friendly throughout.

The only reason for 3★ on the atmosphere was that we arrived while there was a very large, lively table in, which made conversation at our table a bit difficult — nothing negative about the venue itself.

Overall, if you’re looking for a proper curry in London, look no further.

Shah and Mushrat were the absolute best vibes they were amazing, made our night. Stellar photographers and the literally made my entire month it was so delicious and the hot sauce was freaking aMMMAZING. Staff was so so lovely. Best girl dinner ever. Will be returning ofc. This was the best night I loved it mwah 😘😘😘 chicken biryani and king prawn biryani and Dahl sambar and baingan love love love. Pls order them. Gave us free shots. Lovely environment

Came out the club at 1:45am absolutely starving.  Chips were not gonna cut it, there was 7 of us and Preem closes at 2am, we were those typical people that rock up just before closing but the staff were so nice, sat us down, got us sorted with poppadoms straight away to soak up the alcohol, food was absolutely amazing, great vegan options, highly recommend the coconut rice, best way to end a night out.
Thank you to all the guys working on Friday night, had the best time, and thank you for staying well after closing time for us, putting up with 7 very excited women and for letting us wait for our Ubers inside because it was so cold outside!

We visited Preem Brick Lane a bit close to their closing time — it was almost 1:40 PM, and they were supposed to close at 2. At first, they kindly asked if we could take the food away, which was completely understandable. But we requested to dine in since we were celebrating our best friend’s birthday. To our delight, they agreed with such warmth and a smile — and that’s where the lovely experience began.

Our food arrived within 10 minutes, and technically we had only about 10 minutes to eat, but not once did they rush us. We finished around 2:20, and the staff never made us feel uncomfortable or hurried. Instead, they made sure we felt welcome and relaxed the entire time.

And the food — what can I say — absolutely delicious! Every dish we ordered was perfectly cooked, full of flavor, and served beautifully. But beyond the food, what truly touched us was their hospitality and kindness.

We came to know that the staff were from Bangladesh — one from Rampura, Dhaka, who took our order and served us so warmly, and another from Sylhet, who first welcomed us in. Both were incredibly polite, humble, and genuinely friendly. It felt like being among our own people, far from home.

It wasn’t just about eating and paying for food — it was about being treated with care, respect, and heart. The ambience was cozy, the atmosphere filled with that authentic warmth that makes a place memorable.

We left with full hearts and happy smiles.
Definitely a 10/10 experience — both for the food and for the people.

If you’re ever around Brick Lane, do visit Preem Brick Lane. You’ll find not just great food, but also beautiful people who make you feel right at home. ❤️

I was walking down Brick Lane with a friend when we were gently (and confidently) enticed inside by the man standing out front, who promised we wouldn’t regret it.
He was right!
Preem is a prime! Bengali-owned restaurant offering Indian, Asian, Balti, and Bangladeshi dishes - and it absolutely delivers. As a Polish girl, I’ve always loved my spice, and thanks to my other best friend of 20 years being Indian, my tolerance has only grown over the years. Still, Preem impressed me.

We started with aloo chaat, extra hot, then moved on to a beautifully fiery lamb vindaloo, a rich chicken madras, fluffy pilau rice, and a stuffed paratha - with wine, of course. Everything was fresh, flavoursome, and unmistakably authentic.

I usually have the appetite of a bird, but I could’ve easily eaten another two plates -  not because the portions were small (they were huge), but because the food was just that good.

There’s something deeply comforting about a proper curry, and this was the perfect way to end a day spent wandering the vintage markets of Brick Lane.

The restaurant itself is understated and humble - and those are always the places with the best food. No distractions, no gimmicks, no style over substance. Just minimal décor, a warm ambience, and food that truly speaks for itself.

A Brick Lane classic in the making  🍛✨

Saw good reviews for this place and had to try! We really enjoyed our meal and Shah was very attentive!

Also got free shots after meal, we will be back :)

Amazing Indian food packed with flavours! Love that they use fresh curry leaves in the soft crab dish, which also came with a small spicy aromatic dip. The beef marrow biryani was the best biryani I have ever had! Everything on the menu looked delicious! Service was excellent, waiters were kind, attentive and friendly! London has many good Indian options, this is def one of my top choices for the category of food..

The place is great and can be very busy. Staff are excellent. The food was very good. The fish, sea bream, was nearly perfect but the sauce around it, not sure you call it sauce, had a little bit more salt than needed.
The juice could have had less ice. 1-2 ice cubes are fine not 5+.

While the food here was outstanding (and I mean outstanding), the service was appalling.  We had a party of four celebrating my birthday with dinner reservations at 6:30 pm.  We arrived 5 minutes prior to our reservation and were not greeted by name (as they said they would if I uploaded a photo of myself).  Not a big deal, but don't say you're going to do that and then not do it.  We were told our table wasn't quite ready yet.  Again, not a big deal.  We were asked if we wanted to grab a drink at the bar while waiting, which we all agreed to do.  So after approximately 15 minutes of having a beer we asked one of the bar tenders if they could check on our table.  He returned at the same time we were hailed for our table.  After ordering a large, multi-course offering with several starters, we were thoroughly enjoying the meal.  The server, however, was extremely quiet and difficult to hear throughout our meal.  She came to our table after the last main courses were delivered but before dessert to inform us that we had 15 minutes until we had to vacate the table as we had only 2 hours for the table.  This is the most appalling thing a restaurant could do to us given that there were open tables at the time, they were the main cause we were seated nearly 20 minutes late and they were the sole reason we had several periods where we were waiting for our next course of food.  Not to mention we were there celebrating my birthday.  If the food hadn't been so incredible, this review would've been 1 star.  Be wary of the very slow, unprofessional service here.

What a place! The atmosphere in the restaurant is very lively but at the same time extremely cosy thanks to the dim lighting and the comfortable red padded seats that make you feel like you’re sitting in a 1900s luxury train coach.

The staff is super friendly and always around to help, service is fast and precise.

And the food was just amazing: the quality and the cooking of meats like chicken is impeccable and the flavours in each dish are very well balanced but at the same time intense and leaving a long lasting impression in your taste buds.

Finally also the price is extremely competitive- in our days in London we have spent comparatively much more money in places that deserved way less than Brigadiers.

Super recommended!

We had such a great evening at Brigadiers. From the moment we sat down, the team were brilliant. Really attentive, always checking in at the right time, and genuinely warm without it ever feeling over the top.

The food was incredible. Every dish was full of flavour and beautifully cooked. Easily some of the best Indian food I have had in London. You can tell a lot of care goes into the menu. The wine was also spot on and paired really well with everything we ordered.

What made it even more fun was the atmosphere. The live trumpet performances throughout the night completely lifted the room and gave it this buzzing energy that made the whole experience feel special.

Amazing food, great service, and a lively, memorable setting. We will definitely be back.

I've tried a number of the Best of Brick Lane Indian restaurants, and this is our new favourite. a close second is Bengal Village. Booked early (6pm) on Friday and was the first table seated. Pleasant staff who were available to help, but not pushy at all. The food was delicious and (with the Fork 50%) was a fantastic deal. I also appreciated how they didn't push you for a Google review before paying - like some of the other establishments. 5 stars.

Can book for 50% off food on The Fork and think it’s now my fave brick lane place. The sizzling dishes were really good especially the prawn. They were huge and had a really nice butter bbq taste. The curries all great and the papadoms also had a coconut chutney which I’ve never seen before.

I went during the curry festival weekend. It was good to be back in Brick Lane after so long away. The food was good and excellent value.
Next year I'll go on the final day of the Curry Festival. So much more street  entertainment on that day.

Fantastic food and fantastic service, which isn't that easy to find in Brick Lane.  This is the second time that I've visited here and the high quality has been consistent. I had the Lamb Dansak, Lemon Rice and Keema Naan. Every part of my meal was perfect. This restaurant not only has an award but its this year's award. I absolutely recommend this place.

We went to this restaurant without very high expectations, thinking it might be another spot with toned-down Indian flavors tailored for a Western palate. But it completely took us by surprise—in the best way possible!

From the moment we walked in, the service felt incredibly personal and welcoming, almost like being part of a family gathering. The staff took the time to ask about our taste and spice preferences and made recommendations accordingly, which made a big difference.

The food itself was absolutely delicious—authentic, full of flavor, and truly reminded us of home-cooked Indian cuisine. It was such a happy and comforting experience, something you don’t often find, especially in the city.

Another big plus is how reasonably priced the restaurant is. It’s not another overpriced Central London spot trying to look fancy—it’s genuine good food at a fair price.

With the combination of heartfelt service and amazing food, I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for real Indian flavors and a warm dining experience.

I had a wonderful dining experience at Bahara on Brick Lane. The restaurant has a beautifulstylish décor that blends modern design with Indian cultural elements. The ambience feels warm and inviting, making it perfect for both a casual dinner and special occasions.

The food was excellent and full of authentic flavours. Every dish was well-prepared, with rich spices and great presentation. Some standout dishes included the lamb and the classic Indian curries.

The service was friendly, attentive, and professional throughout the meal. The staff made sure we were comfortable and helped with recommendations from the menu.

Overall, Bahara is a fantastic place to enjoy high-quality Indian cuisine in London. If you’re looking for flavorful food, great ambience, and welcoming service, this restaurant is definitely worth

Bahara Indian Restaurant delivers vibrant, memorable flavors. The paneer tikka was beautifully charred, smoky, and perfectly cooked, while the paneer butter masala was rich, creamy, and deeply satisfying. A standout surprise was the gajar halwa spring roll — unique, indulgent, and brilliantly paired with kulfi. A fun, flavorful experience that blends tradition with creativity.

This place is absolutely fantastic. Personally I think this place is better than Dishoom. As an Asian person who has grown up on curry’s I’m normally overly critical when going out for a curry but this place absolutely smashes it. You should totally go for the lamb chops too they are just excellent! Staff are absolutely and the value for money is incredible. 10/10 highly recommend

This is from Saudi Eats in London, with 90k+ followers across social platforms.
Instagram & Tiktok: saudieats.ksa

New Stylish modern Indian 🇮🇳 in the most iconic curry capital Bricklane, London. @baharaindiankitchen
the restaurant was buzzing. The modern, stylish interior, warm staff, and carefully curated menu of Indian classics with a twist set the tone for an amazing evening.

We tried a little bit of everything — Dahi Puri, garlic Naan, Lamb Chops, and chicken malai kebab— each dish beautifully presented and bursting with flavour. The Pani Puri was an explosion of taste, the kebab perfectly tender after a 24-hour marinade, and that chilly paneer? Huge and packed with spice!

The food came out fast, prices were fair, and every bite impressed us so much that we even grabbed a Chicken Biryani to go — still incredible at home.

I would highly recommend this venue. We attended on a first table booking and all ran smoothly. The menu choice is more limited than you’d expect for a restaurant on brick lane but this for me was a bonus! There was great range of vegetarian options and the option for sides of some of the mains was brilliant. The food was fantastic and I will definitely be back to try more of the menu.
The staff were lovely and didn’t rush us through at all.
Overall if you’re looking for a different Brick Lane experience this is the one for you!

name: Bengal Village - Best of Brick Lane

reviews.text: I dropped into Bengal Village on Brick Lane recently and found it to be a delightful experience. The food was excellent, rich flavours, beautifully cooked, and clearly made with care. The atmosphere felt cozy yet lively, with that familiar hum of voices and clinking cutlery that adds charm rather than chaos. Service was attentive and friendly throughout our meal, which made the visit even more enjoyable. In short: great food, a warm setting and really solid service. I’d definitely go back.

Chicken tikka starter 8/10- nicely marinated, very tender, and quite tasty.
Lamb shashlik balti 9/10 - very flavourful gravy, lamb was tender, not chewy. I chose medium spice and I would choose more spicy in future.
Cobra beer 6.5/10
Wonderful service, very attentive and friendly waiters.
First experience of balti curry. Definitely a flavourful choice that I enjoyed.

Came here for lunchtime following recommendation from a review from a Facebook group. My son had the vindaloo and I had the karahi chicken tikka masala with pliaw rice and a couple of garlic naans. When we arrived it was lovely and quiet and greeted by the staff. We were served by Masoom I hope I got his name right but very attentive and a very charming host. Poppadoms served before our meal. The food was absolutely delicious and will thoroughly recommend this place and we will definitely return

Had our Christmas party here (we work in hospitality we know it’s late!)
The service - amazing!
Food was even better! Honestly these guys made our night really special - thank you so much for accommodating us and the great hospitality, we will be back!!!
All the food was absolutely delicious 😋 I really enjoyed it with my buddy, and we both had a great time there alongside the friendly service!👍👍 We will definitely be back soon!

name: Mayura Barbican
address: 55 Aldersgate St, Barbican, London EC1A 4LA, UK

reviews.text: Food was amazing, really authentic flavour. Portions were not big but filling! The server let us at street level rather than going down into the restaurant (this is better for us due to mobility issues and around 25 stairs). The staff were lovely!

I only went in for one dish and one dish only but the Dum Biryani was delicious and stunning! So much I could only eat half but they packed up the rest really beautifully for me im a gorgeous bag as the decor and design is stunning! Maria my waitress couldn't be more helpful and attentive. Thank you!

We had a wonderful experience at Restaurant Mayura in Barbican! We ordered the Mixed Grill Platter and Butter Chicken — both were absolutely delicious and full of flavour. We were also celebrating my friend’s birthday, and the staffs made it extra special for us. A big thank you to Hisham for taking such great care of us — his service was warm, attentive, and professional. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for great food and a lovely dining experience!

The food at Mayura Barbican is bursting with flavor and beautifully presented. Service is flawless ,the staff make you feel truly special. A perfect dining experience from start to finish. Highly recommend! Don't forget to try there ajwani king prawns are a must try.

I recently visited Mayura Barbican and the meal was absolute perfection. The Palak Paneer is easily some of the best I've ever tasted—the spinach sauce is incredibly vibrant, smooth, and seasoned to perfection, while the paneer itself has a wonderful, melt-in-the-mouth texture. It’s clear they use high-quality, fresh ingredients.
To pair with it, the Garlic Naan was a total standout. It arrived hot and fresh from the oven, perfectly charred with a soft, pillowy interior. The garlic topping was generous and fragrant without being overpowering. It was the ideal companion for scooping up the rich, creamy sauce. If you're looking for authentic, top-tier vegetarian options, this is the place to go.

name: The India - Cannon Street
address: 21 College Hill, Cannon St, London EC4R 2RP, UK

reviews.text: We searched for a 17.30 meal in the area across the Southbank and north of the river , it's Saturday and those times seem to be reserved for theatre goers. Walking an extra 10 minutes we found this gem hidden away. They had room for 9 and an overflow room at the rear so keep that in mind if you have a suprise party 🎉. Upon entry a pleasant receptionist guides you down the stairs to some pleasent basement rooms cosy and inviting. The waiting staff immediately in attendance, we had booked but a few tables had to be rushed together to accommodate. The menu offered many dishes including Vegetarian even on the set menus which for London were well priced. Vegan! Well order some veg and no oat milk. We ordered a full mix of dishes , fish, lamb, paneer, chicken, rice and nan bread. All the food was of a high standard and good portions the meal was thoroughly enjoyed. A bottle of red wine was basic cheap but the Cobra beers were in huge bottles and ice cold. Coffee followed . The total bill for 9 with 3 fixed menus and thus 3 starters the rest were just mains and no deserts, 1 drink each. Came to £375! All in all though an enjoyable last minute feast was enjoyed with good friends and great service.

What a gem of a place. Working in the City, it can sometimes feel impossible to sit down and actually enjoy lunch. Most of the time it ends up being a quick grab-and-go from somewhere generic with a couple of chairs squeezed in. But The India is a completely different experience.

The setting alone is lovely, once you go downstairs, you’re seated in a beautiful stone-arched dining room that feels calm and a bit hidden away from the rush outside.

I tried their special lunch menu and it was both spicy and full of flavour. Salim was my waiter and made sure everything was perfect. He recommended what to order and absolutely got it right. I was also very grateful for the complimentary drink at the end, though I might keep quiet about that when explaining why I came back to the office in such a good mood 😅

I’ll definitely be returning.

This place was a hidden gem my wife and I stumbled across. When you walk in it doesn't look like much, but once you are guided to the basement where the seating area is, the restaurant transforms into a great ambient space. The food was delicious and all the staff were friendly and attentive. Our server was Salman. He answered all our questions about the menu and took good care of us. Overall we loved this restaurant and found a new place to come to everytime we visit London.

It was an amazing experience. Highly recommended if you want to experience Indian hospitality. The food was amazing, especially Kebab Anwari is a must-try; it just melts in your mouth. The biryani and dessert were great too, and again, the lamb in the biryani was mouth-watering. Special thanks to Shelim for making our experience special. His warm behavior and amazing hospitality skills made us feel at home. Because of the food and amazing hospitality, I would definitely come here more often.
The ambience was perfect! Food was smashing. Saleem is one of the most wonderful waiters I have ever met. So kind, so generous, and ever so attentive. Recommend this place 10/10 :)

name: Corimint - Bethnal Green
address: Under Railway Arches, Arch 3 Gales Gardens, London E2 0EJ, UK

reviews.text: Absolutely mouthwatering, fresh, delicious food! It was my first time hosting a group of people and Corimint came through! I am so pleased I chose Corimint for catering. Everyone was so impressed with the flavours of all the food and went for seconds! Their portions are so generous. The owners are also very polite, responsive and care about the customer. Definitely recommend 5*.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Absolutely delicious and authentic Indian food! I tried the Ghee Roast Potatoes, Paneer Tikka, Dal Makhani, Butter Paneer, and Chilli Garlic Naan — every dish was full of rich flavors, perfectly cooked, and beautifully balanced.

The dal makhani was creamy and comforting, the paneer dishes were soft and flavorful, and the naan was fresh with just the right amount of garlic and spice. You can really taste the quality ingredients and attention to detail in every bite.

Highly recommended if you’re looking for traditional Indian food in London!

I had a great experience with Corimint. The food was delicious, well prepared, and full of flavor. The quality of the ingredients and presentation were excellent. The entire order was placed online for takeaway and arrived in perfect condition.

Best butter chicken I’ve had in a long time — it pairs perfectly with the naan. The chicken biryani was equally delicious, full of flavour and beautifully presented. Generous portions too. The 2-for-1 combo and pickup discount meant I could try both, with very generous portions and high-quality ingredients. I was even invited into the kitchen by the head chef, which was such a lovely touch — the space was spotless, organised, and reflected the care they put into their food. Truly warm, genuine service from start to finish.

The food is absolutely outstanding — rich in flavour, perfectly balanced spices, and clearly prepared with fresh, high-quality ingredients. The curries are deep and aromatic, the tandoori dishes are juicy and well-marinated, and the naan and rice are cooked to perfection. Each dish tastes authentic and reminds you of real Indian home-style cooking.

name: Sheba Restaurant - Awarded Best Curry House In UK

reviews.text:
We booked Sheba two months in advance to meet a friend I hadn’t seen in a while. We both love curry and regularly eat at curry houses all over the UK, from Leeds and Bradford to London and beyond, so we know what good food looks and tastes like. Unfortunately, this was nowhere near it.

The naan breads were shockingly small, around five inches in diameter and perfectly circular. They looked more like mini supermarket flatbreads than proper restaurant naan.

For mains, we ordered a garlic chilli chicken and a lamb naga. These are two completely different styles of curry and should taste very distinct. Instead, both sauces tasted almost identical. Same base, same flavour profile, just different meat dropped in. The meat in both dishes was cut into tiny pieces and did not taste great quality.

Starters were around £10 each. We had lamb chops and half a chicken. When they arrived, they were served on tiny little four or five inch plates that genuinely looked like IKEA side plates.

The half chicken was basically one chicken leg with zero tandoori flavour, just plain chicken with a bit of salad on the side. We had specifically asked for lots of chopped green chillies. Instead, the kitchen sent out about five whole green chillies, unchopped. What exactly are you meant to do with whole chillies on top of a plain chicken leg?

The lamb chops were dry and looked like they had been sitting around for a while. They were passable, but nothing special and certainly not worth the price.

To be fair, the pints of Kingfisher were good. Fresh, cold, clean taps and reasonably priced. Drinks were the only positive.

The total bill was over £100. We paid in full, including service charge, and did not send anything back because we were hungry, but it was a huge let down, especially given the booking and the occasion.

If you are heading to Brick Lane, I would strongly recommend Bengal Village instead. Sheba was a massive disappointment and I would not return.

I want to wipe my memories from eating this food, not exactly sure how there could be disappointing. Indian food in London, had the popular dishes. Had the menthi lamb which was mediocre at best but outshone the rest, with the tandoori chicken which was super dry, the mint sauce that didn't resemble any kind of chutney I've ever seen on Earth, and the samosas which were like trader Joe's air fried pieces, and the super sweet mango lassi. and the naan was old and dry too, super disappointing but service was decent nevertheless

Came here after seeing 30% off on The Fork - get the feeling “awarded best curry house in uk” is just the full name of the restaurant rather than any kind of certificate. My local takeaway in Manchester blows this place out of the water, the cheek to call it best curry house in the UK - had the jalfrezi was underwhelming and incredibly mild, bland even - karahi was an improvement but still nothing to write home about, chapatis were beyond dry genuinely think they were made from drywall, peshwari naan was enjoyable but it’s hard to mess a peshwari naan up. Main issue was the incredibly tense aura in the restaurant, felt if i breathed too hard i’d be sentenced to death, with waiters being quite rude and disdainful that I was using a 30% off offer? which the service charge cancelled out regardless?? Would not recommend, food would be passable if the atmosphere was better, but atmosphere is so tense I cannot recommend

I had an excellent experience at Sheba Restaurant on Brick Lane. They offer a wide selection of Pakistani, Indian, and Bengali dishes, and every dish was bursting with authentic flavors. The food was fresh, well-prepared, and absolutely delicious.

The service was just as impressive – the staff were friendly, attentive, and made me feel very welcome. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, making it the perfect place to enjoy a great meal.

If you’re looking for a restaurant on Brick Lane that serves amazing South Asian food with top-notch service, I highly recommend Sheba Restaurant. I’ll definitely be visiting again!

Don’t order from this place!! Disappointed doesn’t even cover it. Ordered delivery this evening (6/12) and it was honestly the worst curry I’ve had In my life. Lamb buhna (pictured) was just oil and water and a grey colour that doesn’t give me any confidence in its safety. The other curry The Lamb ladyfinger, the sauce in that had also completely split. The whole meal was completely inedible.

Good food, very welcoming staff, food comes fast and it’s very tasty. Brick Lane is one of my favourite areas in London.
Also the prices are decent.
Will visit it again!
P.S. Loved the mango lassi
Really nice place. Had the biryani which was fantastic. Good sized portions and amazing flavours. Would recommend this. Very friends staff.

Went here for my birthday treat. I don't know the cost as my son paid. He was happy. I'm guessing reasonably priced. Food was lovely. I couldn't eat it all as portions are very generous. Staff are very welcoming. Place is clean and nicely decorated. Will definitely come back.

It was never our plan to eat whilst visiting Brick Lane but we were enticed into Eastern Eye balti house by their great " man at the door"

We ordered tandoori lamb chops, chana masala, sag aloo and 2 lots of rice.

A beautiful and spectacular meal which was generous in size. Tasty and beautifully presented.

Staff were professional, kind and helpful without being overbearing. The discount of 20% and a free drink was welcomed by us.

Absolutely can't wait to come back when we return to Brick Lane. ❤️

Amazing restaurant!
The food quality was excellent and everything tasted delicious. One of our dishes was a bit too spicy and they kindly replaced it with a milder version without any problem. Very fast service, super friendly staff, and really attentive. Highly recommend!

An absolute gem in the heart of London.
The staff welcomes every guest with warmth and lovely smiles. Great ambience, blending South India with subtle modernity. Authentic food, wide menu, great tasting finger licking food, that isn't very pricey either.
Their kufies are a must have.

Everything about our visit was fantastic - from the warm welcome to the beautifully presented dishes. Our creative starters, rich curries and perfectly balanced desserts were full of flavour and clearly made with care.

A special thank you to Sharron, who was incredibly kind and attentive throughout our meal. Her genuine hospitality made our lunch feel extra special.

Highly recommend this restaurant for anyone looking for great food, a cozy atmosphere, and outstanding service!

Had a wonderful experience here! We didn’t have a booking, but they still found us a table right away and were incredibly accommodating. It was my birthday, and they truly made the day feel special. Our server was new, but you would never have known it—she did a brilliant job and provided such warm, attentive service. Overall, the customer service was excellent and made our visit memorable. Highly recommend!
Great food. The service was great very welcoming. Nice layout and design which gave it a nice atmosphere.

Fantastic South Indian food. We were a group 8 on a Sunday night at 10pm. They had dosa, idly and biryani. The idly dosas were great. Sambar was excellent, Chutneys full of flavor. Refreshing Indian flavored drinks. Overall a great restaurant with excellent service. Highly recommend if you are in London and craving some authentic South Indian food.

name: Bombay Corner - Indian Street Food
address: Bombay Corner, 61 & 61 A Nile St, London N1 7RD, UK

reviews.text: Very cosy Indian cafe with a lovely Chicken Biryani and Masala chai. Nice staff, clean and bright. Recommend.

First of all I must say that the quality in taste of this food was amazing. I really wish as I was ordering for the first time that my custom was valued more.

It is a pity because whilst the food that I got tasted absolutely wonderful there were many issues with the order as pictured below.
1. Curry box was filled completely with rice and a small spoonful of the curry was added to the corner with 3 small cubes of chicken.
2. Sag aloo was a container filled with spinach that had 2 tiny cubes of potato buried inside.
3. Mango chutney spilt all over boxes and dried out. Easily avoided with careful packaging.

I am extremely disappointed as if not for these disappointments,  I would have become a regular customer as the food tasted brilliant, but to spend £30 on a meal and wait over an hour only to receive 3 small cubes of chicken and 2 small cubes of potato is very frustrating, real shame.

Bombay Corner is extremely close to my workplace, which makes it very convenient. I’ve always ordered either over the phone or through their website, and the order collection is quick and smooth. The food has authentic Indian street flavours and tastes just like back home. I absolutely love their vada pav, samosa pav, khaman, and masala chai. The pav bhaji is decent, and the chicken biryani has a nice taste and good quality for the price. Great prices overall.

I had the Butter Chicken with rice and it was absolutely delicious. The flavors were rich, perfectly balanced, and very authentic. The service was also excellent — the staff were friendly, attentive, and made us feel very welcome. Overall, a wonderful dining experience. I’ll definitely be coming back!

Visited Bombay Corner recently and had a fantastic experience. The food was absolutely delicious — the paneer karahi was rich, flavourful, and perfectly spiced, and the naan was soft, fresh, and the ideal pairing.
Great taste, great portions, and overall a really satisfying meal. Definitely a place I’d return to.

Visited Masala on Brick Lane and honestly, it delivered. Great atmosphere from the moment we walked in — busy but not chaotic, with friendly staff who actually seemed to care rather than just pushing people through the door.
The food was the star. The pumpkin curry was full of flavour and a brilliant vegetarian option — slightly sweet, well-spiced and properly balanced. The Bombay potatoes were spot on: soft, coated in a rich tomato and spice sauce, with enough heat to keep it interesting without overpowering everything else.
The chef’s “Bollywood Blast” definitely lived up to its name. The naga chilli gave it a distinct, lingering heat that wasn’t just spicy for the sake of it — it had depth and character.
Pilau rice was fragrant, naan was fresh and fluffy, and portions were generous.
For Brick Lane, the prices were very reasonable. Tasty food, good vibes, and we’d happily go back.

A Delightful Experience at Masala Indian Restaurant, Brick Lane!

If you’re looking for an unforgettable dining experience with exceptional service, look no further than Masala Indian Restaurant on Brick Lane. From the moment I entered, I was greeted with warmth and genuine hospitality that immediately set the tone for a wonderful evening.

The food? Absolutely stunning. Every dish was not only bursting with flavor but also beautifully presented. The attention to detail in the plating was impressive, turning each meal into a visual as well as a culinary delight. It’s clear that the chefs here take great pride in their work – the vibrant colors, aromatic spices, and perfectly balanced flavors made each dish a treat for both the eyes and the taste buds.

The staff were incredibly welcoming, making me feel like a valued guest from start to finish. Their friendly attitude and genuine care for my dining experience made the visit even more enjoyable. It’s rare to find such a combination of great food and such attentive, personable service.

Whether you’re a regular on Brick Lane or visiting for the first time, Masala Indian Restaurant delivers an exceptional experience. The flavors are bold, the presentation is gorgeous, and the staff’s warmth and kindness are the cherry on top. Highly recommend this gem – I can’t wait to return!

Came across Masala almost by accident, it was next door to our hotel! Looked it up and it had great reviews. So we booked it for our evening meal that night. A lovely and cosy well lit room. The servers were extremely helpful and polite, especially Abdul and Barry. Now the food, this was wonderful, 5/5 for every part of it. Tasty, tender, good portions etc. Me and my wife have had many curries over the years and this has to be one of the best! Perfection, a big 👏👏 to the chefs.

Came to this restaurant for my birthday dinner. Restaurant was clean, although not the usual fancy ambience which wasn't an issue. We were seated promptly and orders taken. Starters and the mains were very delicious and the flavour wasn't overpowering at all, but nonetheless amazing. The Bombay blast was amazing, as I like spicy food. Mango Lassi also tasted nice. Customer service was very good and food was reasonably priced even though we got even better value with an offer that was going on when we went. Overall, a great and authentic Indian cuisine experience.

Barry was very accomodating and helpful with the order and suggesting specialties of the house.  He was also friendly and gave a little info about the restaurant.  He gave a lemon wine on the house after the very nice meal.
The food is amazing.  Just right flavour.  The description on menu with the amount of spices helped with the choosing.  I ended up ordering more for takeaway.  Will come again.
The restaurant is newly renovated too.  So the ambiance is really good.

Gunpowder in Spitalfields is a small but nice place. It's pretty compact inside so seating is okay but not the most comfortable - though that's to be expected with the size.

Service was fine, nothing amazing but perfectly adequate. The food though? Lovely and really filling - we all left happy and satisfied!

Word of warning - definitely book in advance, especially if you're a big group. Space is limited so you don't want to risk turning up and not getting a table.

All in all we had a really good lunch and would go back 👍

Had a lovely meal, everything was delicious!! Shreya served us as she was absolutely brilliant, attentive just at the right times. Loved the Poussin especially. The lamb was also amazing, so tender and juicy. Chocolate dessert was lush !! We had a bottle of Chardonnay which married well with the meal.

Great dining experience, moderate spice levels and each dish bringing something slightly different. Paneer was possibly the best I’ve had in london. Went during the January 10-year anni so prices were a steal, definitely still worth the full price though!
Extremely good food with incredible flavours.  Would definitely return to try the other dishes, however, this branch is quite small and the tables are extremely close to one another.

We had an excellent food here. Standouts were the duck chettinad pancake and the chicken chops. Okra fries were light and delicious. The staff were informative and friendly, especially the Manager.

The restaurant is small/cosy with raised seating. Better to go in a larger group rather than a pair as we were too close to the neighbouring table.

A (hefty) service charge was added to the bill without any details as to the percentage. It was actually 15%!! It made the meal quite expensive. Just shy of £190 for two with drinks.

Go for the outstanding food but beware of the service charge.

We had a wonderful experience at Rasoi Ghar. The hospitality was excellent and truly made us feel at home.
Mr. Jasbinder Singh, the chef, was extremely helpful when we had some doubts about the food. He explained everything very clearly and ensured the dishes were prepared and served perfectly.
Mr. Abdullah served the food in a very professional and polite manner. The service was smooth and attentive throughout.
All the staff were friendly, respectful, and welcoming. The overall atmosphere felt warm and homely.
Highly recommended for great food and even better service!

One of the best Indian restaurants I’ve tried in London. The food I ordered was a lunch thali and covers everything which you could expect. I did not had rice pudding but the chef offered Besan Ladu out of courtesy, Very Kudos to Chef Mr Singh and overall it was absolutely delicious — full of flavour, perfectly spiced, and clearly made with fresh ingredients.

The service was excellent: friendly, attentive, and genuinely welcoming without being overbearing. We felt well taken care of from start to finish.

Highly recommended, and I’ll definitely be back.

Chef Jasbinder Singh has created a fantastic restaurant in the shadows of the city near Aldgate and Wapping. The menu is a delight, each dish curated by the head chef, who was vey happy to come out and talk about his created adding to the fantastic service at Rasoi Ghar. Delicious flavours and beautiful presented dishes the meal was fantastic. We’ll be back again and highly recommend to anyone looking for a deliciously authentic Indian dining experience.

This restaurant is a go to place for Indian food while visiting London's Iconic Tower Bridge and Its surrounding area.
We went during lunch time and ordered Vegetarian Thali ... The entire meal was a beautiful balance of traditional flavours and delicate touches. It’s clear that this is a kitchen that respects Indian spices while executing each dish with precision and care.🇮🇳🇮🇳
It was pleasant surprise to meet the owner and head chef, who were available to discuss any dietary or specific requirements 👌

The food here is absolutely outstanding! Every dish was bursting with authentic Indian flavors, perfectly spiced and beautifully presented. The curries were rich and aromatic, the naan was soft and fresh. The staff were warm, attentive, and made us feel truly welcome. The ambiance added to the experience, making it feel like a cozy escape. This is hands down one of the best Indian dining experiences I’ve had – highly recommend for anyone craving delicious, authentic Indian cuisine!

We had a wonderful experience dining here. The service was outstanding — the staff  Don & Joana were attentive, friendly, and made us feel genuinely welcome from start to finish. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, creating the perfect setting for a relaxed and enjoyable meal.
The food was absolutely top-notch. Every dish was beautifully presented and packed with flavour, clearly made with care and high-quality ingredients. It’s rare to find a place where the service, atmosphere, and food all come together so perfectly.
I would highly recommend this restaurant and will definitely be returning!

Thank you from Lisa  G x

Our first visit as a group to the Cinnamon Kitchen was very special. The food was exceptional and the service excellent. Ash seemed to be looking after us very well. Every one of us had a beautiful meal. We truly had the best time. Think our group of school friends will be returning. It’s not often we all agree but we’re 💯 in agreement to revisit the Cinnamon Kitchen soon

Great experience at Cinnamon Kitchen! The starters were absolutely amazing—full of flavour and beautifully presented. The only minor letdown was the lack of a chicken curry in the mains, but everything else was delicious and the ambience was lovely. Would definitely visit again!

Excellent lunch with my Mum thanks to a present from my wonderful son for Mother’s Day. Rupa looked after us (as did others who were great) and she was brilliant. Advising us on which dishes to choose, as well as making the most devine cocktails (Cinnamon Bellini and leaf). Everything was delicious, fragrant and Devine. Service was brilliant and a fantastic lunch with my mum. We had the set lunch and it was excellent. We would go back again.

We held our baby shower at Cinnamon Kitchen and were extremely happy with the experience. The decor was beautiful – we booked the upper terrace and it was covered in flowers and plants, which created a lovely atmosphere. Although it was January and the weather was cooler, the heaters and lamps kept everyone comfortable.

The food was excellent. We selected a set menu and all of our guests thoroughly enjoyed it. The staff and particularly Shatarupa was also fantastic, very friendly, attentive, and regularly checked in to see if we needed anything.

I would definitely recommend Cinnamon Kitchen for events, and I’ll absolutely be considering it again for any future celebrations.

Very tasty food. They have an entire vegan menu and were able to customise a vegetarian  dish to make it vegan. Restaurant including toilet was super clean too.
And I love that there’s no fee for BYOB

BEST FOOD IN LONDON THUS FAR! This place is excellent in every way possible. The service was impeccable & food was mindblowing. We might have to stop by for an additional experience before going home to LA. Thank you!

We had a great experience! The samosa chaat was a very generous portion, and the lamb biriyani was the highlight! The atmosphere was beautiful and the service was great, highly recommend! Food was really yummy!

I just have to give a huge shout-out to Tunu, who genuinely gave us the best customer service I’ve ever experienced. From the moment we walked in, he made us feel completely at home — so warm, kind, and sincere.

He went above and beyond in every way: made us tea, gave us chocolates, and even kindly offered us a quiet space to perform our prayers (Salah), which meant so much to us. That level of thoughtfulness and respect is rare and truly appreciated.

On top of that, the food was incredible — the butter chicken and naan were absolutely amazing. Everything about the experience felt special, and a big part of that was thanks to Tunu’s genuine care and hospitality.

We’ll definitely be coming back, and I really hope he gets the recognition he deserves. An absolute gem — big him up! 🌟

A big shout for the staff. So friendly and accommodating. The food was wonderful. Full of flavour, every bite delightfully yummy. We hqd vegan options. No compromise on taste. And ther lime pickel. I want that in a bottle to take home. They accept BYOB too.

I had a business lunch here during a conference, and the atmosphere was perfect for conversation. The food was excellent – flavorful and well-prepared. As a first-timer, I ordered the Google-recommended dishes, and they all exceeded my expectations: creamy, tasty, and fresh. Just a heads up: the dishes weren’t spicy at all 😉

Visited "The India"! The ambience is pleasant and hygienic, and the staff are warm and welcoming. They serve almost all Indian dishes, all with great taste.
