Service was prompt and attentive, making the experience even better. Overall, a delightful place to enjoy authentic flavors in a clean, comfortable setting. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a satisfying Indian meal with excellent service.

We had an amazing staff Christmas party— the food was authentic and delicious, with generous portions and lots of choice, like chicken tikka masala, lamb shank, prawn curry and garlic naan with a wide range of vegetarian options. The prices were reasonable and great value for money. The atmosphere was lovely and welcoming, and the staff were kind and attentive. Mujahid provided very good service and made the experience even better.

We had an outstanding experience here, and the food was absolutely delicious. A huge thank you to Mabz, whose attentive and professional service truly elevated our entire visit.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for great food and a welcoming friendly atmosphere!

Hussain and Pavlu are awesome attentive fabulous waiters!! They took great care of us and we enjoyed a spectacular meal of salmon tikka  and duck jalfrezi, garlic naan,  pulao rice and mango lassi! Both the duck and the salmon were cooked to perfection melt in your mouth, delicious!! The mango lassi were absolutely fabulous, too. If you ate in London, you must try this wonderful restaurant on City Road! Pavlu will give you five star service with a five star meal!

On a recent business trip and I like to venture out if the hotel and eat at a local restaurant and preferably not a chain.

Walking in solo, I think I caught the staff a bit off guard, but they soon welcomed me in.

Staff were really friendly and helpful when it came to the menu choices as again, I was solo.

Food, delicious. Those spicy poppadoms caught me off guard as I didn't realise they were SPICY! Really tasty food and well priced too.

Delicious food from decades

I have been going to this place for a very long time, and the food is absolutely delicious.

You can bring your own booze to complement the dishes

I would highly recommend this place if you love the Pakistani flavours

The lights draw you in, the curries bring you back. Amazing food, veggie curries were full of flavour and perfectly cooked. Sides were great especially the mogo chips which we'd never tried before. Lovely service with friendly staff. Joins the list of best curries in London!

The portion sizes are absolutely ridiculous. £74 for three tiny curries and four naan breads is a complete joke. This is nowhere near acceptable and is shocking value for money. I feel completely ripped off and will not be ordering again.

I dined here for the first time, very nicely decorated restaurant, open clean well lit & spacious. The staff were extremely friendly, polite & helpful. The service was really good & i though the price was reasonable. The starters, Roti, were nice. The lamb chops were ok, tasted a bit bland for a Pakistani lamp chops. the curries were well spiced if you like spicy currys but I did not enjoy the biriyani I think the type was rice they used was not to my liking.

It was my first time at this restaurant last week and I had a really lovely experience. I ordered the lamb jalfrezi, which was incredibly flavorful and perfectly cooked – rich, aromatic, and just the right level of spice. I love Indian food and following my intuition about zaffrani was the right tune.

I was very well looked after by the owner, Jack, who was warm, attentive, and made me feel truly welcome. The service overall was excellent, caring and familiar without being intrusive.

I also enjoyed a peppermint tea and tried the house specialty dessert. I don’t remember the name, but it’s the one in the picture – it was absolutely delicious and I highly recommend it without any doubts!

Everything felt fresh, comforting, and made with care. I will definitely come back and would happily recommend this place to anyone looking for great Indian food and kind Service in the area.

The food was amazing. I entered a beautiful world of spice and aroma. Akshe Tikshe in particular made me see paradise. The staff was very welcoming and professional. They made me feel at home. I finished my visit with a traditional Kerak Chai. Definitely worth a visit for everyone who appreciates South-Asian food.

Absolutely delicious experience at Zaffrani, Islington!
We came here for dinner and everything from start to finish was spot on. The food was beautifully presented and packed with flavour — the curries were rich, aromatic, and cooked to perfection. The garlic naan was soft and buttery, easily one of the best I’ve had in London. Portions were generous, and the rice came perfectly fluffy.

Service was exceptional for our family of three with a toddler. He was very on top of our needs and helped us pick off the menu. The food was exceptional, best veg samosas we’ve ever had and I enjoyed the small elegant touches to the drinks. Will come back!
Great ambiance, amazing food. Everything was perfect. Definitely worth a visit!

name: The India - Monument
address: 2 St Mary at Hill, Monument St, London EC3R 8EE, UK

reviews.text: Really friendly staff and great food. I ordered chicken tikka masala, pilau rice, cheese naan and papadums — everything was delicious and the portions were generous. Excellent balance between price and quality. Definitely my new favourite Indian place in the city, especially being so close to Monument.

The food was excellent and clearly made with care, and the service was friendly and attentive without feeling over the top. The atmosphere was warm and comfortable, which made it easy to sit back and enjoy the meal. All of our meals were delicious. Overall, a great spot with a nice balance of good food, good service, and a very pleasant vibe.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Excellent Indian food in the heart of London

We had a fantastic lunch at The India Restaurant near Monument.
The food was exceptional — rich flavours, perfectly cooked dishes, and very authentic Indian cuisine.

The service was superb: friendly, attentive, and genuinely welcoming, without being intrusive.

A big plus is the short walking distance from Tower Bridge, making it an ideal stop after sightseeing.

This place was recommended to us by ChatGPT, and it turned out to be a spot-on recommendation.

Highly recommended if you’re looking for quality Indian food in central London.

We’ll definitely return.

Shah our waiter was very friendly and responsive. We enjoyed our Chicken tikka masala, butter chicken and saag paneer. Portions were just right for two grown ups and a child. None were really spicy but we are sure they would ve made them to order if that would be our thing. Butter and garlic naan were outstanding. Lighting is rather dark, atmosphere is good and you can go without smelling like the kitchen when you leave as in other places. We can strongly recommend this place and my wife who had to travel to India for years considered it very authentic.

If there is one ask for the owners/chef: Please add palak paneer to the menue!

For an Indian restaurant in London, you have to be really good to get a 5 star! And this place is definitely worth it. The staff is friendly and accommodating. Place has a nice cozy vibe. And the food is great quality. Very authentic and reasonably priced as well. We had chicken curry, cheese naan, mushroom rice and mango delight dessert. Everything was tasty except the mango delight - this was just a frozen dessert which was difficult to eat and nothing special. Other desserts were unfortunately not available. We had a discount via fork, so we'll worth it. Reservations recommended.

name: The Monsoon - Best Indian Restaurant & Takeaway

reviews.text:
I visited Monsoon and ordered a starter followed by a fish main with rice and naan. Everything arrived without much delay and worked fine as a complete meal.

Nothing in particular stood out, but the food was decent and straightforward. We were out in the area for the evening, and it was nice walking through Brick Lane again and seeing the atmosphere outside, with different restaurants drawing people in.

Overall, it felt like an easy place to stop for a relaxed meal while spending time nearby.

They call themselves the best and I have to agree with them....

I went in on a quiet Tuesday evening and they were extremely friendly and attentive, making jokes, etc. They didn't try to push up to order more and the food came out promptly.

The food itself was delicious and fantastic for the price. I'd certainly go again and I highly recommend it 👌🏼 Main and starter each, plus shared rice and a coke each came to 25 per person.

Curries were off ⚠️☢️

I had a feeling this would happen because it’s happened at another Bangladeshi restaurant on Brick Lane. The curries (jalfrezi and vindaloo) were definitely off, and I’m pretty sure they added other ingredients to make it look or taste like it wasn’t. We are Bengali ourselves so we grew up eating a lot of different curries. Why would you serve us old and off curries when we’ve spent our hard earned money at your restaurant? And also, not even worry if we might feel ill after eating that? Which I actually did. I was also wondering if the customers dining in were served the same thing.. Anyway, I don’t recommend this place ⚠️☢️, take care.

The loveliest waiters. I arrived really early before my friends and they really looked after me so sweet and kind. I asked the head waiter to surprise me with a lamb dish and it was incredible. Food was so good. There were 7 of us and we had the best time. Everything came out so quickly. I recommend getting a lot to share as everything was so good. Can’t wait to come again

The food was fantastic. Best Indian food we’ve ever had. The server was very nice. We asked for whatever they recommend and were very happy. Definitely recommend anyone stopping by if possible. The surrounding area is nice to walk through as well.

The place was superb. I ordered Nan, lamb curry and lamb tikka (not 100% sure). The behaviors of the staff were very friendly and helpful. It took approximately 15-20 min for the order. Overall, I like the food special the curry. They provided Salad as well. However, the toilet was not up to the mark and price is little higher from my point of view.
Most of the customers were british at that time which was surprising for us. I enjoyed the atmosphere and felt the original british vibe from that place.
Overall, I enjoyed the food and the environment.

Use to go regularly years ago. Went after a year on New year's day, may Lord help them as they living in ICE AGE STILL! Still old cafe style chairs & table, old plastic menu like 1970, tables and chairs filthy had to ask them to clean, the waitress and waiters not bothered not the owner son's bothered, they really don't know what CUSTOMERS SERVICE IS! They really need training, my table didn't have cutlery, I had to ask them after serving food so imagine how bad it is. Ordered 3 lots of starters sheekh kebab (was lame no bounce to it), wings had no taste felt like baked in microwave and chicken tikka was also most probably from microwave re-heated. Chicken karahi was like a curry, meat tikka masala was full of salt with runny watery with lots of pepper's, pillaw rice was just with colouring. Nan was very small dry, no joke please VOID THIS PLACE. If you want to waste your money then go ahead. It's just running by it's old name, food is very tasteless with salt and water. How could some place treat customers with laid back attitude, no awareness of presence of their customers. Waste effort n my time and my money.

I ordered a kebab roll, and it was perfect as I was told, and it was a great meal. The people who serve just stare at our faces whilst we are eating. The decor is hideous as I feel like they don't care about it. Champions league a the background, but the tv is all fuzzy. I expected better but the food wad very good.

First time to this unassuming restaurant but won’t be the last. Fantastic lamb chops, dry meat curry and butter nan. Oh and the chicken korai went down a treat as did the mango lassi. Friendly staff and a nice relaxing atmosphere. No frills but one of the best lamb meals we’ve had.

I came with a friend on their recommendation and I loved it. It's not a fancy place though and it's popular so it does get busy and a bit noisy inside. We came on a Monday evening and we were able to get a table without waiting.

As I can't tolerate too much spice, I went for the safe option of a mild butter chicken and ordered a side of the rogni nan. The food came pretty quickly and also with a complimentary side salad.

The butter chicken tasted delicious and the rogni nan which I'd tried for the first time was the perfect accompaniment. The bread was a little thick and buttery and fairly big so it was enough to go with the curry and I didn't feel the need for any rice on top.

One thing to note is that it is a cash only establishment so do make sure you have enough cash with you.

I am still thinking of that rogni nan in particular, and I would definitely like to return.

name: The Standard Bricklane - Voted Best Indian In London 🇮🇳

reviews.text: Loved it here! Muhammed was amazing and took such good care of us, 10/10 service! I loved the curries and the portion sizes were great. Very fresh and lovely flavours, definitely recommend if you are around brick lane!

Great service by Ahmed today! 🎉

Really enjoyed our food - my favourite - Sulemani chicken with pilau rice and a cheese naan bread. 🥘

Great choice of dishes and staff is happy to help you choose your dish if you aren’t sure 🤩

Large selection for vegetarians too!

We visited this fabulous establishment this evening. From the moment we walked through the door we felt very welcome by all staff. Ahmed was simply amazing!! He made sure that everyone in our group was happy. Which was a difficult task as we had a very large group of kids & adults. He was very attentive & made sure all our needs were met. The food was just delicious, especially my jalfrezi which was made to my preferences & very spicy just how I ordered it. Thank you so much for making our family meal special. We shall definitely come back.

I have visited this amazing restaurant many times and each of my experiences have been absolutely amazing. The restaurant is very clean and tidy food is amazing so tasty and portion size is perfect
This is my go to restaurant every time!

Staff member Piash is an absolute asset to the business always very welcoming to me helpful and always has a smile on his face he goes above and beyond ❤️
Can’t wait for my next visit

I had an incredible experience at The standard bricklane restaurant — it was my first time trying Indian food in Andres, and it couldn’t have been better! The team was extremely welcoming and attentive from the moment we arrived.

They surprised us with  complimentary starters and snacks to try, which was such a thoughtful touch and made the evening even more special. Every dish was full of flavor, beautifully presented, and the service was outstanding.

It was truly a wonderful first experience with Indian cuisine — I’ll definitely be coming back! 🍛✨

Very fairly priced for brick lane and not overpriced. For 2 X people we managed to eat lunch for approx £35. Will be returning back and my expectations were exceeded. They have meat dosa’s which we ordered. Our server was really nice and kind Thank you Anisha for a pleasant experience.

Please note everything in the restaurant is made fresh and not packet made/warmed up. The chai was made on the stove and dosa was homemade. They also do NHS and student discount. The also have a BYOB option.

Had a great lunch with a chicken masala dosa that I can only recommend to try - flavours and spices are perfectly balanced here. The masala chai was also very delicious and more flavourful than I had it in other places.
Apart from that, the services was very attentive and friendly. Will be back!
I’ve been here twice and food and service is always amazing. Biriyani I always get is not oily at all and full of flavor. Have also brought family here and they loved it. Will return for sure.

Great masala dosa and egg kothu prantha

Cute cozy restaurant just off Brick lane, we could hear the chefs in the back making all the food fresh. If you’re looking for some authentic South indian food, this is it.

Fair prices and would come back again

I walked all over Brick Lane & this place stood out as I wanted a veg thali, Vada and dosa, I was hungry!

I was blown away by what I received. Everything was absolutely perfect, so well balanced with all flavour notes hitting perfectly. For the price and what I received I think it's an absolute bargain. Totally authentic, highly recommend

The Rassam and Dal recieving a special mention

name: Sripur - Indian Masterchef
address: 25 Great Tower St, London EC3R 5AQ, UK

reviews.text: I have visited this restaurant three times recently and they did not disappoint me every single time. Price is on the normal affordable side, the tandoori mixed grill is huge in portions and serve with salad. I also had the cheese naan, garlic, which is freshly made and taste amazing. Not to mention their curry, full of spices, taste very authentic. The staff is also very friendly! Will definitely visit again.

Had dinner here and the  food  was absolutely amazing! Abdul our waiter was very friendly upon arrival and the restaurant had a nice atmosphere. The food was delicious and great portions! Everything was so flavourful and left you wanting more. Ali was also very happy to serve and help us with our drink choices! The service here was amazing special shout out to Abdul, Ali and Abbas - thank you! Will be back!

Such an amazing restaurant with the most friendly and professional staff!
Layek and Abdul were so sweet and helpful.
My order was taken and in little time food was served fresh and hot with such a delightful presentation.
Every dish was wonderful but the tandoori chicken and pineapple juice were my absolute favorite.
I will definitely visit again and will always recommend! ✨✨

I went for dinner here with my friend and it was one of the best Indian restaurants I have been to. The restaurant is located near Tower Bridge and very accessible both by train and car so we found it really easy to get to. The restaurant had a cosy atmosphere and was very busy even on a weekday when we went. Also The staff were so hospitable and friendly. Abdul was our host and he made us feel at home there, explaining each dish and making recommendations for us. The food arrived very quickly and was very tasty. There was also a good selection of deserts ranging from ice creams to gulab jamun which was lovely. I highly recommend going there, the food is exceptional!

​We thoroughly enjoyed a fantastic lunch today at Sripur Restaurant. We chose the ginger chicken and the garlic lamb, complemented by sides of rice, naan bread, and a selection from the chutney tray.
​The dishes were incredibly flavorful and delicious. While we specifically avoided 'hot' preparations, the level of spice was noticeable, which may be a consideration for patrons unaccustomed to spicy food. Notably, one of the chutneys offered a fiery but ultimately savory and complex kick.
​Service was prompt and efficient, making for a truly wonderful experience overall.

Had the paneer naan taco at Naan Wrap and it was absolutely delicious—perfectly spiced, fresh, and really well put together. The flavours were spot on and genuinely memorable.
Chef Josh and Nana were there as well, and their passion and warmth made the experience even better. Amazing food and great vibes—will definitely be coming back!

Purchased the large Paneer Tikka wrap before heading to the airport tonight (03/02/26 @ 17:36) Got throught the fist half of the wrap on the train, when the Paneer at the bottom looked like it had scales... Nope metal scales/shards.

I would have taken it back but couldn't.
The food itself(before I stopped eating it was delicious) but didn't even chance the 2nd half to have metal scales in it so this got binned, which was a waste of £10.95.

No way to contact the kitchen regarding this issue. But please do a review of all your equipment used, as there is clearly an issue with something in the kitchen that has went unnoticed.

Staff were very friendly & food(from what was eaten) was delicious, just the metal scales/shards let it down.

The paneer naan wrap tasted amazing. I think about it almost weekly - despite visiting this place years ago. The balance of flavours and textures -- OMG. May have been the best thing I've ever tasted.

There was a friendly man doing tasters outside their stall in Spittalfields and I knew after taking one bite - this is where I was going to have my lunch. I'd been searching for a good place for a while and my growing appetite was making me a bit antsy. But after ordering, the food came almost instantly and I was put at sudden ease.

I sat down and ate - my oh my. How can street food get this good? Thank you naanwrap for the sensational taste experience. If you're in Spittalfields Market, I highly highly recommend naanwrap if you're a fan of Indian cuisine.

I was starving after a long day in London. Lots of the food at spittlefields market was unavaliable due to my allergies. After what seemed like forever, I found naanwrap and ordered myself a naan wrap. I am not exaggerating when I say the naan wrap was the best thing I had ever tasted.

I went here a year ago, and I still think of this naan wrap weekly. It was perfectly spiced and sweet. I'll be honest, I was expecting an average taste experience due to the fact that the exterior of the shop wasn't anything special, but I was very wrong.

If you are in Spitalfields market, please try naanwrap.

I've been ordering here a lot over the last 2 weeks and I love the food. They are also partnered with MealPal which works amazingly for me and can get you discounts too.
Would recommend, especially the Paneer Naan Wrap!

Fantastic food and even better gluten free food! The waiter and chef were both very knowledgeable in a gluten allergy. I was able to have poppadoms and most curries. Very safe, very yummy and a great atmosphere!

We came here on a Saturday night and surprised at how quiet it was. We really enjoyed the starters, onion bajhi and samosa was excellent and the sauces tasted homemade. The mains were good, not blown away but meat was nice and tender. Staff were very friendly too. The main problem is the restaurant seems to be the main access route to the pub next door so lots of people were coming in and out to smoke or to access the pub which was a little offputting. through the restaurant itself was quite quiet, which is a shame because it’s a nice place.

Poor service, food ok-ish.

Inattentive staff, waited 30mins for mains after starters with the restaurant not that busy. Mains arrived but only half our food was served and waited another 5 mins for the rest. Took my friends napkin off him to wipe the table down when they eventually cleared our plates away. Not offered desert or coffee. Left us waiting ages after mains so had to call the staff over to order a drink. The food was mixed quality, some nice dishes and some very bland. Took my friends there as a special treat on a Saturday evening but it didn’t hit the mark. Would I go back - no.

Visited tonight. As avid fan of indian restaurants must say this rates right up there. Food was very fresh, superb depth of flavours and good portions. All the staff were so friendly,helpful and chatty. Our waiter Mr.Kay was lovely person and very attentive and friendly. Will definitely be back. Thank you Dilchad for very pleasant evening.

£25 for mutton chops !!!   Been before and had a great evening, this evening was good...   but £25 for a share of mutton chops, come on !!  Prior to ordering, questioned the "lamb" chops...  not because of the price, it was more they were recommended as award winning....   ordered, arrived and.....   this was them....
Wasn't  asked throughout the meal if they were enjoyable - only once clearing the table. I noted to one of the 2 waiters who recommended them, chops - lamb ??   Award winning??   They just walked away.....    hey, food was fine, service decent......   don't order the mutton chops - not worth £25 for 4....   buy an entire mutton box for approx £65.... but decent establishment just no questions..     would i go again, yeah - no chops next time

name: INDIAN MASALA
address: 330 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E2 0AG, UK

reviews.text:
The food at Indian Masala is consistently excellent. Everything tastes fresh, authentic, and full of flavour, and you can really tell it is made with care by the original uncles themselve.

The service is always friendly, attentive, and welcoming every time we visit. A proper local gem that never disappoints.

We popped by to try them out via an app
& Were welcomed very warmly
By all the staff

It was a set menu, So we were told
To sit & Wait comfortably.

They do have a lot more to offer
Which we will be trying again,
Whenever we can

Everything was packed well
& We left as happily as we had arrived.

This was everything that we tried:

Piyaju
(Bengali mini pakoras)

Saag Aloo
Cauliflower Aloo

Tarka Dhaal
Chana Dhaal

Meat Biryani
(Had a lot of rice & A few pieces of meat)

Mix Vegetable Bazi
Aloo Bazi

We enjoyed everything
Our only feedback would be
To improve the flavour of the Aloo Bazi
& If possible make it less greasy.

The portions were a good size
2 people could happily share everything
But for those who have a bigger appetite
Maybe it would be suitable for one

We definitely recommend trying
Them out purely for their hospitality

We are sure that you will find
Something that you will like here

Our best wishes to everyone at
Indian Masala Bethnal Green.
✨
Authentic village style Bangladeshi food. Always a pleasure coming here. Reasonably priced. Good food always tastes great.
Delicious food and very friendly. We sampled a wide range of meat, fish and vegetarian dishes for dinner. Recommended.

The food here is genuinely a bangladeshi cuisine, it's Exactly like home cooked food, and the owner is amazing, I've always come here whenever I feel like eating a good home cooked meal, it's well worth the price and the perfect spot for even a quick snack.

name: Jannah Grill
address: 352 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E2 0AH, UK

reviews.text: Best food I have tasted the chicken and rice was generally the best I have had all fresh and juicy quarter chicken was lovely highly recommend and the wings where amazing fresh crispy seasoned I can’t recommend this place enough portion big and not expensive service was great too jahad was really welcoming if your near this place pop bye !!!!!!

This this on the avoid list due to the chicken being served raw. One wing, maybe but after multiple wings being received in such state; this is after complaining about them. The food had to be discarded. What a waste of money. I was also reassured they were cooked properly but the bloody chicken was tell a different story.

Really lovely place, came with daughter she got the chicken and rice and loved it - I got the lamb chop meal and it was so tasty mashallah - customer service was great too very friendly & accommodating to us - thank you Jannah grill!

Been a couple of times Alhamdulillah. Food is really nice and service from staff is good, but my only negative feedback would be the cleanliness downstairs. Tables are not clean from other customers eating so they could do with wiping and the smell from the bathroom doesn't help when your eating 🤢. There should be plenty of sauces on each table for customer's to use instead of having to go to other people's tables, can be awkward at times.

This meal was a delight! The crispy fried wings were perfectly crunchy, the chunky chips were golden and comforting, and the salad added a fresh touch. The grilled chicken, coated in a spicy, herb-infused sauce, was full of flavor and paired well with the other elements. The food is also quite affordable compared to many other grill restaurants. They accept both card and cash payments, and there’s plenty of seating available downstairs. Highly recommended!

Best curry in the area hands down. Proper depth of flavour in a pretty authentic Balti king prawn. Like properly rich and thick and luscious and brilliant. Bustling and friendly service in a small space (don’t take your cat) full of Christmas cheer. Heartily recommended.

Passed this restaurant on last visit to London and chatted briefly with the owner who was preparing menu outside (but we had already just eaten). From that moment his passion and good nature was evident so we decided to try it on our next visit. The food, atmosphere and same owners passion and attention didn't disappoint. Well worth a visit. I had the Shepard's Pie. Amazing

If I could give zero stars, I absolutely would. The experience was extremely disappointing and upsetting. The staff clearly treated customers differently based on their skin color. Some guests were served with warmth, respect, and prompt attention, while we were treated as if we didn’t matter.

Stopped in while visiting London from America. We wanted to get some curry while we were here because we had heard it's done really well in the UK. We were not disappointed. The Empress is a small but excellent place. The staff was friendly and helpful. The food was excellent. We enjoyed everything we had. We would certainly return!

A delicious meal, and the service is even better. I have dietary restrictions that make it hard to eat at an Indian restaurant. They catered to my restrictions, and we had a delicious meal. A must-visit for Whitechapel
We fid takeaway. Service was good. People friendly. Food yummy. Good vegan options.

This is the best Indian restaurant in London, actually probably one of the best in the UK.
They do the best mint sauce EVER!
Their food is simply amazing and I imagine it's the closest you'll get to authentic Indian food without actually being there. Simply amazing. I will never buy from another.

Had  chicken  tikka biriyani,portion was quite  decent but little lacking  combination  of biriyani spices, didn't  get  proper biriyani flavour,salt also lacked  too.ovarall average  quality!
Customer  service  is great(cordial & professional )
Anyways,I will try again their different  dishes.

Delicious food
Full of flavour & well cooked. I chose for collection & it was perfectly on time when I arrived.
Best Indian food I’ve had in London by far! super friendly service, good people and great food!

We tried there Morog Polau and Kacchi and both of them were tested pure Old Dhaka's teste.

If you are looking for pure Bangladeshi authentic polau, biriyani or similar kind of dishes you must try this.

They used original Kalijira rice.

Finally their Rice pudding or Firni was exceptional.

A Taste of Old Dhaka Right in Whitechapel!

This small Bangladeshi restaurant is an absolute treasure! Every dish bursts with the authentic flavors of old Dhaka, from the perfectly spiced curries to the tender meats and fragrant rice. It’s clear that everything is made with care, using traditional recipes and fresh ingredients — nothing feels watered down or “Westernized.”

The atmosphere is humble and unpretentious, but the food more than makes up for it. If you want real, home-style Bangladeshi cooking that transports you straight to the streets of Dhaka, this is the place to go. A true hidden gem for anyone who appreciates authentic South Asian cuisine!

We ordered beef tehari and beef bhuna khichuri with borhani. I don't know what made you guys think it is authentic dhakaiya tehari. It wasn't even close to the taste of a tehari. I would recommend the chef to put mustard oil instead of ghee and put spices according to the original tehari recipe as you're claiming to serve authentic one🙏. Additionally, Borhani's taste was not good either. It was bitter and old. Again follow the correct recipe please. However, staff's were good and cooperative.

Super nice customer service; the store usually closes at 11pm; we reached there around 10:57pm still they allowed us to eat there and stay till midnight to enjoy the food; we are very grateful for such service.

I would recommend the bhuna khichuri with beef as must try item; it was amazingly delicious.

We also ordered chicken biriyani that comes with gravy; the gravy was delicious but I found the chicken biriyani average.

If you have sweet tooth; must try the sweet yogurt, it was good as well.

I really wanted to give 5 stars, but unfortunately for the chicken biriyani I had to lower the rating ( it was my opinion, you may even like it)

One of the best Beef Curries I’ve ever had! The parathas were fresh and crispy – just delicious! The mashed potatoes were good and creamy, but very spicy. As for the Beef Biryani, my husband was disappointed. It was very dry and a bit tasteless. We expected more from a place that has “Biryani” in the name. Communication was a bit difficult – the person serving us didn’t speak much English, so I couldn’t find out if the juices were fresh. I asked for room temperature juice but got an extra cold bottled one with ice on the side. The Karak Chai was strong and tasty. Overall, the restaurant is spacious and very clean. There’s a large, clean bathroom downstairs in the basement.

⭐ 2/5

We arrived at 14:10 expecting the half-price offer, but ended up paying the full amount. Unfortunately, the experience was disappointing.

The hot water wasn’t turned on initially, and most of the food was cold, as if frozen. It seemed they only turned it on after a few customers arrived. The fish curry was fresh, which was the only highlight.

The dessert was not good at all. I usually buy their jalebi from outside, but this time it seemed old probably from the previous day as it had an unpleasant smell.

Overall, not the quality or service I expected.

We were initially drawn in by the outdoor fresh snacks, which were actually very delicious. So we decided to go inside and noticed they had a buffet option with a lot of variety, so we went for it.

Unfortunately, the food was definitely not fresh - it tasted like it had been sitting out for days. Everything was stale and completely tasteless. Even the bottled water we purchased tasted horrible, it was most likely tap water. They didn’t even have ice available.
I’m genuinely worried about my stomach now 😭

Food 🥘 ⭐️⭐️⭐️ - Limited options; No Prawns, Spinach, Korma. tandoori wings and fries were dry and stale. Looks appetising but food is stale and poor quality.

Atmosphere ⛲️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️ -
Dinghy, old fashioned decor.

Price 🏷️ ⭐️⭐️ I managed to get the £10.00 buffet deal but it ended up being £15 because they charged me £3.99 for a bottle of water!

Customer Service 💁‍♂️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️ -
It was ok but felt uncomfortable when staff was standing there and staring at me eating. Also they didn’t ask how I was or if I needed anything apart from the one time he tried to sell me the £4.00 bottle of water

Overall,
Poor quality food and poor customer service. On top of everything I had a really upset stomach four hours later. Had to use the toilet on SIX occasions NO JOKE. The brown coconut dessert was the only good thing there. Will probably never have a Bengali buffet again.

I called before I came the receptionist said there are more the 50 items. When we entered the shop, there were 12 items for iftar .rest you can see I shared a couple of pictures they keep the restaurant i spent £80 good for nothing.its was  🤮🤮 Disgusting

Where do I start, I decided to come here after seeing on instagram that they’re doing an offer for 50% off if you book in advance so thought let’s try it out! Usual price is £15.99 per adult and £9.99 per child
*let’s start with the positive:
the restaurant had a variety of dishes which were mostly tasty/okay like home cooked food. For starters/sides they had pakora, mini spring rolls (daal filling), tandoori wings, papadoms, small naan pieces and chips. For mains they had plain rice, pilau rice, chicken curry, meat curry, boiled egg curry, chana daal curry, meat with daal curry, regular daal curry and 2 types of fish curry. They also had several borta’s (shutki, aubergine, khudu, Aloo, mackerel, daal, tomato and green chilli). For extras they had two types of salads, sliced cucumber, green chilli’s, sliced yellow lemon and various sauces. For dessert they had jalebi, rice pudding and mishti doi (sweet yogurt). Service was also okay.
*for the negative:
The 2 fish curries and the regular daal curry was heavily watery, you couldn’t taste any flavour because of this, the fish did not smell and was soft too, which was the good thing about it. The decor is very outdated and the tables are quite close together. The women’s toilets 🤮 very dirty and the water coming out of the tap was stone cold too. They charge £4 for a large bottle of water and we purchased a jug of mango lassi which came in a 800ml Voss water bottle, it was very thick in texture and more like yogurt then a lassi. When it came to paying, they tried to charge the full price (£9.99) for my two kids (3yr old & 8 yr old) stating that the 50% off was only for the adults, but we argued that it wasn’t fair as this wasn’t stated in the offer, then they applied the 50% discount for the kids also. Generally I would say the food is quite kid friendly if your child is happy to eat Indian cuisine food, as they don’t have many western options, apart from chips. We have an energetic 3 year old who made noise from time to time which is normal for a child that age, there was a lady who was sat alone on the table next to us, we got to know later that she is part of the restaurant team (media or other), every time my daughter made a loud sound, she would look at her in an unpleasant way but would look away once I looked, this made me feel very uncomfortable and we didn’t wish to continue to dine there, we complained about this before leaving and she become highly defensive, lifted her finger up at my husband and telling him that there is a misunderstanding, and that he should calm down as she was busy looking at her phone the whole time. The other staff were very apologetic, but I don’t think we would visit the restaurant again! If you’re looking for good customer service, I would say that this isn’t the place for you.

name: Indian Greedy Cow
address: IndianGreedyCow, Favorite Cafe, 310 Hackney Rd, Bethnal Green, London E2 7SJ, UK

reviews.text:
I’m not one to leave bad reviews, I ordered chicken tikka biryani , fragrance was nice but they out shatkora or something in side it for some reason which really overpowered the flavours and taste and I could only taste bitterness , I couldn’t even tell how the rest of the food was as everything tasted bitter after the first bite, naga chicken curry fragrance was their but due to the bitterness it ruined it for me, got 2 wings and chips was their only thing as a starter I tasted which was decent. Veg curry was as expected.
Kinda disappointed honestly. Expected much more
The wings were delicious, the naga pickle added the perfect kick, and the extra fries were a nice treat! Everything was fresh, tasty, and well-packed. Will definitely order again.

I’m no Indian food expert but I really enjoy their food. Have tried the pistachio masala and pasanda both of which are great, creamy and up to my taste! Really happy for the half price deal as I now will want to try many more. The ‘boss’ who was serving me is also kind and good to talk to.

I felt very welcome from the moment I arrived. The staff were kind, patient, and gave me plenty of time to think about my order without any pressure.

The food was immaculate — beautifully presented and absolutely delicious.

The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant, making the whole experience even better.

Overall, a fantastic visit. Highly recommend!

First Indian Takeaway I’ve ordered up here so was very much going in blind. Saw the pistachio paneer masala and thought that was a bit of me.

Really, really enjoyed it. Got a couple of popadoms thrown in as well! Will definitely be returning. Cheers guys

Great Service via telephone and always amazing, top quality food. I find my food, despite being delivered and taking some time(which is understandable as I live decently far away), is always piping hot and always tastes fresh. Will be buying again. I 1000% recommend.

Nice local establishment that offers a group dining option for large single groups on a per head price point. Food was varied and we tried a number of Asian Chinese fusion dishes in addition to the usual Indian choices. All food was tasty and presented well.  Had a very enjoyable driving experience.  Owners were on hand providing great customer service.

I ordered food but chanamsala test was very disappointed. May be they make it old used check peas. I ordered chicken tikka garlic and chili. It was half of oil and chicken wasn’t Proper boiled and I pay for chicken tikka they give normal chicken. Garlic nan was more weight. But chapati is good.
I thrown the bin chanamasala💩
Plz give proper training. Thanks

Great food with refreshingly good service.

Chicken tikka main is freshly grilled and skewered with onions and peppers. I like spicy but it's mild so enjoyable for all.

Alot of vegan options as well including tofu saag and many more.

Really nice garlic rice.

Very decent sized portions and the food is not drowning in oil like a lot of takeaways.

Very good service and fast delivery.

Another plus is we received a complementary salad with our order.

Well impressed.

5 stars.

🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟
I ordered channa masala and chapathi channa is totally filled with oil not tasty and chapathi is not made by whole wheat they added white wheat flour totally disappointed

I ordered a mixed tikka kebab, and lamb dhansak as well as a chicken tikka biryanis! The tikka was just bland ! No flavour of anything! No garlic,ginger,yogurt,lemon juice! Just red dye ! And no flavour! And brown lettuce 1 slice of cucumber for salad ?! The tikka biryani wasn’t freshly cooked and the chicken tikka pieces were overcooked dry and hard.
My lamb dhansak was ok in flavour but the so called lamb! Was actually mutton meat !
Dry hard and chewy! I don’t recommend this place ! But I was fooled by the 9,999 reviews on just eat !
Never again! DONT BE FOOLED!

I ordered food today through Uber Eats and Deliveroo, and it was a complete mess.

First, the food came very late, much after the expected delivery time. When it finally arrived, it was not worth the wait at all.

The food was stale and badly cooked. The lamb pieces were hard and not cooked properly, the rice was half-boiled, and the garlic naan was so hard it was difficult to eat — and there was no garlic on it at all.

I had also ordered a paneer curry, and the box was labeled “paneer,” but inside was a non-veg curry. That’s not just careless — it’s unacceptable.

The chicken and lamb didn’t taste fresh either. Everything about this order felt wrong. Honestly, there were so many issues I can’t even list them all here.

When I tried to speak to the restaurant about it, they were very rude and didn’t care at all. They refused to accept their mistake and offered no solution.

I’m extremely disappointed. Please don’t waste your money here just trust the other negative ratings. I’ll definitely never order from or visit this place again.

I ordered x2 paneer dishes on Uber eats.
Instead of paneer tikka masala I received CHICKEN tikka masala. I only realised after biting into it.
The other dish was very good, but I just don't feel I can provide a high score given this error.

The lamb chops were horrible very smelly and clearly not fresh.
It seemed like they were 2–3 days old.

Takeaway order experience: on Just Eat they advertised 30-45 mins delivery estimate. In reality it took over 2 hours to deliver. Got a text message saying "delayed" after 50 minutes, then silence. Requested updates through site and called multiple times, they didn't answer their phone. Was beginning the complaint/cancellation process when driver arrived with no excuses. "It's a busy night". So what - if you're too busy then give an honest extimate or don't take the order. Better still, plan ahead.
Lentil dahl was bland tasteless watered-down slop, it went straight in the bin. Curries were cold & had leaked from the containers. What an unpleasant experience, and what a disgraceful way to run a business.

The mixed grill for one was enjoyable, with freshly made naan and a rich, well balanced garlic sauce, although the rice lacked flavour. The chicken dish was disappointing, lacking flavour and tasting odd. When I raised this politely, the waitress was unskilled (what shall I do about it was her reply) and the manager only offered a replacement after I confirmed I would still pay for the dish. While the prices are reasonable and some food is well prepared, the customer service let the experience down.

Today I went with my friend and I ordered grilled SeaBass with chips and my friend ordered grilled Promfet with rice. I was pleasantly surprised by the flavour of the fish. It had an amazing fusion of spices and flavour. It was flame grilled and taste was amazing. I will come back with family to try their grilled chicken in future. Service was great. Waiting for our Karak chai.

Meet up few friends and decide to have lunch there. We ordered a platter, kala bhuna dall and nan bread. Food didn’t expect our demands. The grill chicken was very tasteless, neither kala bhuna. It’s  a copy of kala bhuna, if you want to get original taste must visit Mezban .

⚠️ ⚠️  please donot waste your money here.
Terrible experience waste of money, I have ordered 2 biriani it was not even closer biriani also it was tooo much greasy as you can clearly see in the pictures.

Went here on a lovely summer evening as walk-ins. The staff were very friendly, greeted us with a smile and sat us down. Once we'd ordered our food, the service was quick and we got everything within 10-15min. We ordered the chicken shawarma (9/10), mixed grill (8/10), hyderabadi biryani (7/10), mango milkshake (9/10). It was a good experience and the prices are very reasonable. Would deffo visit again.

Do not go here!
They lied to us and hijjaked our booking from the place next door. As a large group they knew we would easily be hurried into their doors so they bare faced lied and said they were owned by the same people as Sheeba, the place we had been going for years and that my booking was for Aladin. When seated we were given approximatly 5 seconds before hounding us for our orders which made it evident they were trying to trap us in there before we could leave.
When the food came it was flavourless and expensive and far too expensive for a very sub par curry. The only saving grace was the packed atmosphere but this was probably only due to stealing customers from next door. Once we had finished our curry they tried to kick us off our table straight away, before even taking plates.

Came across this restaurant late Saturday night just before it closed. The staff was lovely and gave us a few suggestions. We ordered the chicken korma, chicken madras, lamb blast, rice, garlic nan, and popadoms with dips. I often feel that Brick Lane Indian restaurants can feel pre-cooked or reheated. This was great despite being at 11pm. It was lively and fast service. Really tasty, and perfect portion sizes. Great value for money, and received an additional 20% off.

Would not hesitate to return if in the area again.

Went here yesterday with hubby to make memories. However, unfortunately, we'd rather forget this memory.  The restaurant was loud and rowdy to say the least.  Full of people getting their drinks down them and getting rowdier as the night went on.  We were the only brown people in this restaurant which says a lot about this place (if you know, you know).  We could barely hear each other over the noise, no exaggeration.  I would have given it zero stars if I was able to. Let's put the rowdiness aside, as people are allowed to enjoy themselves, however the food was pretty awful.  Kebabs were tasteless, prawn puri had no depth.  The chicken tikka masala was full of coconut and tasted like it came out of a jar. The meat dupiaza was tough and again tasteless with onions that were barely cooked.  We returned the rice because it wasn't fresh.  Mushroom bhaji was bland and the naans were probably the only thing that was half decent.  Honestly I would love to have given this restaurant a good review, however we definitely won't be coming back here again. Awful food and a complete waste of money.

Door always open, it's quite cold inside... but disappointingly they don't sell any hot drinks. Naans are dry and not really good. Food is ok, but nothing special. And we thought we entered Aladins, but the bill says Nazrul.
Overall low quality and inauthentic Indian food. No highlights to mention. Brick Lane has a plethora of better venues….

name: DanDan Aldgate East
address: The Goodman's Field, 9 Stable Walk, London E1 8ZF, UK

reviews.text: I first discovered this on Maps and was delighted to find a Chinese restaurant with halal options near my hotel.  I ordered a sweet and sour chicken dish with fried chicken dumplings.  The food was piping hot, delicious, not too sweet, not greasy, just perfect. The vegetables that came with the sweet and sour were crispy and full of flavour. The chicken has a wonderful crispy coating too, so nice and freshly made. The service was brilliant, so friendly and respectful I came back the next day to try the garlic chili chicken and was blown away when they checked what time my fast would end so they could have the food ready in time for iftaari! Wow! Thank you to the team at DanDan!

I recently put ChatGPT to the ultimate test: "Recommend the best Chinese chicken in East London." The answer? DanDan Aldgate East came up top, and after seeing the glorious reviews, I knew I had to check it out.

I am thrilled to report that neither the AI nor the reviews disappointed!

Naturally,we went straight for the classic Dan Dan Noodles. The flavour was absolutely spot-on—a perfect, complex balance of rich, savory pork mince, beautifully textured noodles, and that signature, tingly Sichuan peppercorn heat. It was deeply satisfying and authentically spiced, making every slurp an experience. The food truly felt fresh, vibrant, and made with care.
The Gang Bao Chicken (Kung Pao): We opted for this classic to test their chicken skills, and the dish was flawless. It was a beautiful balance of sweet, sour, and savory, with perfectly roasted peanuts and a fresh crunch. It was the perfect counterpoint to the powerful spice of the noodles.

The Service: Effortless and Friendly

Beyond the incredible food, the service was seamless. The staff were friendly, efficient, and clearly passionate about their dishes, making the whole visit feel comfortable and easy. You get the quality of a highly-rated spot without any fuss.

Great value for money， 80 pounds together, at Dandan Noodles near Aldgate East! The Sichuan dishes here aren't just about being spicy - they're all about great flavour, colour, and aroma.

I ordered the beef rice noodles, and the beef brisket and stir-fried pork were both tender and tasty. The absolute classic is the Yu-Xiang shredded pork — incredibly delicious!

The service was wonderful as well. The staff even asked if I needed a fork, which was really thoughtful for anyone not tamiliar with chopsticks. Overall, an excellent experience and I'll definitely be coming back!

Authentic Sichuan restaurant just near Aldgate East. We arrived at 5:00 pm as a group of four and the place was already full, which is usually a good sign. We asked for a table and only waited about 15 minutes before being seated.
We started with dumplings, a seasoned cucumber dish, and prawn dim sum. All were fresh, well seasoned, and very well executed. For mains, we each ordered a different dish: braised beef, braised pork belly, and kung pao chicken. Every plate was balanced, flavourful, and served in generous portions.
We also had beers and tea, which paired well with the food. Overall, excellent quality, good variety on the menu, and very fair portions. Definitely worth the wait if you are looking for proper Sichuan food in the area.

Really enjoyed the food and service here. Staff were very attentive and helpful throughout the duration.

We started with some grilled pork dumplings. These had some good crisp and were good dipped in the soy and chili crisp. Chili crisp does not have too much kick in case you are wondering.

Then we got some Sichuan classic dandan noodles from the lunch menu which I believe might be a slightly smaller serving. Overall it was great but not the best dandan I have ever had. Still a good choice on a cold day like when we ate here.

Nice selection of home made noodles.  Broth was missing some umami but my wife really liked the salt and pepper (chicken base) broth.  Noodles and ingredients were excellent. Other types are dry/oil base flavoring which better than is sound.  Mind the spicy level if that concerns you. Serice was good considering how busy they were. Tables were clean and simple yet comfortable.

Visited this place recently and honestly had a really good experience overall. The restaurant was clean, nicely organised and had a really good vibe. The staff were super friendly and helpful. Ordering through their online menu was simple and smooth. I wasn’t very comfortable using chopsticks so they kindly offered me a spoon and fork which I really appreciated.

Now coming to the food, everything we ordered was served hot, fresh and full of flavour. The portion sizes were big and definitely worth the price. We tried the duck murger, Murger Han mixed salad, surf clam skewers, grilled chicken gyoza, spicy braised chicken biang biang noodles, and slow cooked lamb biang biang noodles. The duck murger was alright for me, not my favourite, but the gyoza were absolutely delicious, crispy outside and juicy inside. The noodles were the real highlight. You can tell they’re handmade because they were thick, chewy and perfectly coated in the spicy sauce. Both the chicken and lamb ones had deep flavours and the toppings like green pepper, potato, tofu and egg added a nice mix of textures.

It’s a bit on the pricey side but honestly worth it for the portion size, taste and overall experience. I’d definitely recommend this place if you want to try proper authentic Chinese food in central London.

Never disappoints! Delicious and spicy noodles. We also took the duck murger, but did not take any photos of it. It was very well seasoned and delicious. I love their barley tea as well.
I’ve always struggled with the amount of Sichuan pepper maximum Chinese restaurants put but this one is really well balanced, and it doesn’t overpower the whole dish.
Also, the service is excellent and so is the portion size!!

I’ve been visiting Murger Han City for many years, from their original menu to the updated one, and the quality has remained consistently good. Their lamb paomo is very authentic and comforting, with rich flavour that really reminds me of traditional Xi’an-style cooking.

The roujiamo is also very well done — the bread is satisfying and the meat is flavourful. I also really enjoy their liangpi and rice noodles; both are refreshing and nicely balanced, making them great side dishes to order alongside the mains.

The prices are on the higher side compared to similar places, but considering the authenticity and consistency of the food, the overall  experience is still very good.

If you’re looking for genuine Xi’an-style dishes and don’t mind paying a bit more for quality, this is definitely a place I would recommend.

Cosy spot for a comforting meal in a central location. Fresh hand-made noodles, huge portions. I really liked the bone marrow biang biang noodles. Perfect in this weather.

Would come back to try more different types of murger. Loved the crispy, flaky flatbread texture in combination with the soft duck inside.

Attentive and quick service.

We were blown away with how amazing this restaurant was. The staff were very friendly and welcoming. We were celebrating a birthday as a family and there were two babies in our group. Highchairs were provided.

The service was outstanding, with great attention to food allergies in our group and recommended dishes and guidance on the number of dishes and starters for our large group.

The starters and main dishes were served efficiently and were, without exception, delicious.

Would highly recommend this restaurant as everyone enjoyed the food and service.

Thank you for making our evening so enjoyable

Visited this place after seeing a few reviews about it on the socials as a birthday meal and also my first time having chinese food on returning from a visit to China. I feel like they did everything well but it left alot to be desired as the majority of the dishes seemed to have been really toned down in flavour and spice in order to cater to the local palate. We ordered a good variety off their menu including the half chicken and half soy duck dish, mixed pepper beef, kung po chicken, a selection of their dim sum, prawn and sesame toast, veg spring rolls, egg fried rice and morning glory. The star of the show in all of those dishes were the prawn and sesame toast which were tastefully made on slices of French baguette type bread, followed by the kung po chicken. My recommendation would be to go for the spiciest dishes on their menu to avoid any disappointment if you too like more than a spice level 2 out of 10.
The resteraunt was fairly busy on a Monday evening but there seemed to be only two waiters tending to all the tables, and so, despite their efficiency, service left a little to be desired.
The ambience of the place was nice enough, it was clean and the tables were well spaced out allowing for space to have a conversation.
There was a slight discrepancy with the bill where we seemed to have been charged twice for the same item, but this was instantly resolved when it was brought up. The dishes throughout the meal came out as they became ready and as a result some of our starters came out after the mains and vice versa.
All in all, it was a decent meal, I enjoyed the company and appreciated the fact that the place was halal. It wasnt a cheap meal but not overly expensive either.

Fully halal authentic Chinese restaurant!😍 The dim sums are a MUST try! We loved the chilli oil dumplings and the chicken & crab siu mai!🤤 The waiters are so attentive and really help you to decide on recommendations. This was my second time visiting here with my sister and will definitely be back again soon!

I have been going here for years now and the food and service have never failed me. Today in particular, I came with my mum who's a wheelchair user and Wei delivered such exceptional service. He was so accommodating and helpful. Food as usual was delicious and they also make their chilli sauce in house which was great! We tried the Monogolian beef as per Wei's recommendation, and it was truly delicious! Amazing authentic halal Cantonese food! Highly recommend :)

Our waiter was attentive, polite and gave us good suggestions on some of the food.

The actual food was soo good, I would have that sweet and sour chicken over and over again. The special fried rice and black bean chicken were solid. The dumplings were also amazing

We had an amazing dining experience here!

The food was incredibly authentic and reminded us of real home-style Chinese cooking.

Every dish was full of flavour and cooked perfectly.

The variety on the table was impressive—from fresh seafood to classic stir-fried dishes and savory braised meats. The lamb spine in a pot was beautifully cooked.

The dumplings and vegetables were also excellent, and everything tasted balanced and not overly greasy.
You can really tell the chefs know traditional Chinese flavors. The ingredients tasted fresh and the portions were generous, which made it perfect for sharing with family and friends.
If you’re looking for authentic Chinese cuisine, this place is definitely worth visiting. Highly recommended, and we will absolutely come back again!

Been a long time customer at this place and honestly never disappointed me. The food won’t blow you away but definitely hits the spot. It’s a northeastern Chinese restaurant so personally I would say it’s not exactly my flavor profile. But nonetheless, amazing stuff over here.

I no longer recommend this restaurant. I used to return for the tasty food and reasonable portions, and I accepted that service was minimal. Unfortunately, things have gone downhill. The service remains cold, but now the food is overpriced and the portions have noticeably shrunk. Rice is £3 per person, and even refills are no longer free. We ordered the spicy boiled beef, which cost £19.30. The same dish at a Sichuan restaurant near Moorgate is £15.80 (even with a 12.5% service charge, it’s still better value). Although there’s no service charge here, the food prices feel inflated to compensate. Vegetable dishes now come with half a plate. Overall, the quality just isn’t there anymore to compensate the bad service.

This place still pulls in a big crowd of Chinese students and locals, and portions remain huge. The spicy dishes can still deliver flavour when they’re on form, but my latest visit (Sunday, first customers of the day) was a real disappointment.The food:  Beef noodles and special Lo Mein were over-boiled and mushy, broths watery and oddly bland.
Lamb skewers (£2 each) and chicken wing (£2) were under-seasoned and forgettable.
It tasted nothing like previous visits either the chef has changed or standards have slipped badly.

The service:
The infamous “angry waitress” is unfortunately still there. My friend politely asked for two glasses of water and was met with a glare and an audible huff. Even her own colleagues seemed to keep their distance. The attitude was genuinely unpleasant and set a sour tone from the start. Large portions mean nothing when flavour and quality are missing. With far better options just a 5-minute walk away (Yeye’s, for one), there’s no reason to put up with sub-par cooking and hostile service.

Quite authentic Sichuan and Dongbei (north-eastern) Chinese foods. I’ve been here four or five times already.
My only complaint was that sometimes we had to wait to be seated quite long and unattended. But I think it’s fine unless you’re super sensitive to this.

name: YUE Kitchen
address: 34 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E1 6HT, UK

reviews.text:
Delicious and good quality food and friendly service.

Recommend the roast duck with rice which had a crispy delicious skin and good amount of meat (although fatty) £17 and the claypot eel rice (Japanese style unagi) which was flavourful and had the crispy caramelised bottom layer of rice (like socarrat) £16. The xiao long bao £7 was ok but nothing wow

The lemon tea was in a pint sized glass and refreshing £6.

Service was friendly. Lots of seating available. Chef wasn’t in so we couldn’t try the sesame ball dessert - will be back for this !

Absolutely loved our meal at Yue Kitchen.

Every dish came out looking beautiful and tasted even better. The crispy duck was spot on — crackly skin, juicy meat, and full of flavour. The clay pot rice dishes were comforting and rich, perfect for sharing, and the steamed dumplings were delicate and satisfying.

What I really appreciated was how balanced everything felt — bold flavours without being heavy. Drinks were great too, especially the iced tea with citrus, very refreshing.

Warm atmosphere, friendly service, and food that clearly has care and skill behind it. Will definitely be coming back (and bringing friends next time).

Highly recommend 👌

Absolutely fantastic Cantonese cuisine in London! The dim sum was incredibly fresh and flavorful, with the har gow being a particular highlight. Authentic tastes, excellent service, and a warm atmosphere. A true gem for anyone craving genuine, high-quality Chinese food. Will definitely return!

What a delightful meal! The clay pot rice is so good. Roast duck is a must have. The tofu pudding dessert is a good finish to the meal. With comfortable window seats, this is a good place to take children.

I have been here twice. A real hidden gem for Chinese food in London！ The dishes are incredibly authentic and delicious :) honestly better than most Chinese restaurants in London, and far superior to the overpriced options in Chinatown lol.
Highly recommend the claypot rice and the Zhizhi claypot. The desserts and drinks were also surprisingly good!
The vibe is warm and welcoming, and all the staff are extremely friendly. Special shout-out to the Chinese girl:) she is beautiful, smart, and genuinely kind, which made the whole experience even better.
We ordered Duck & Hainese Chicken rice and it was delicious. The veggies had a ting of salty flavour, balancing the blandness of rice. Packed neatly and easy to carry box. Good experience.

Stopped in for a quick weekend lunch recently — I wanted the crispy pork belly over rice, but seemed that they didn’t have enough for a full portion, so I ended up ordering the pork belly / char siu combo instead :)

Both cuts of pork were so delicious. I really liked how crispy the pork skin was and how nicely it complemented the various layers of lean and fatty meat. The char siu was so juicy and tender. The pak choy was a nice, lighter complement to the heavier meats, and I liked the additional plum sauce for the same reason. (Although it wasn’t initially clear to me when offered that it was £1 extra)

Only nitpick was that the rice felt a bit too oily for my taste (maybe from the pork and such) and I didn’t quite finish that part.

It was a bit busy when I visited — only a handful of seats available — but turnover was fairly quick. Service was really friendly and prompt,   just a quite lovely experience all-around. I’ll definitely be back when I’m in the neighbourhood again.

Was missing chinese food and was recommended this. Queue at 11:50am, it was already long Q but serving is fast. Roast meat taste good and its noodles is Hong Kong style. Love the environment. Will return again.

Came for dinner on a Sunday around 8pm. Arrived at a good time where tables were empty so had no wait for a group table, but soon became busy with every table getting filled.
Ordered 3 meats combo: roast duck, Hainan chicken and char sui. Sadly they had ran out of pork belly. Extra HK chilli oil.
Meats were tasty, and the sauces made them even better.

Always a delicious and hearty meal! Love that this chain of establishments have put Chinese BBQ meats on the radar to a wider audience and has made it more accessible to curb those cravings to those who have grown up with eating these dishes!

Place has quick service despite the constant queues outside the shop - it's worth the wait. Establishment is small with very limited seating so would recommend to takeaway.

name: Hong Kong Kitchen (555 Sui Mei) 香港(555)烧味茶餐厅

reviews.text: The food here is really delicious, with generous portions and comforting, authentic flavors. The spring rolls and braised meat are especially amazing. The owner is very friendly, warm and patient, which makes you feel at home. I will definitely come back next time and will recommend this place to my friends!
I would say it’s the most genuine HK food I had near this area. Really great food quality and worth the price! Almost here every week for my take away dinner and love it

The food was ok but not worth the price for sure. And it will charge 10% for eat-in but still in a takeaway box.
I swear that I spoke everything politely, but the staffs were just so rude. I entered the space and asked for the seat in English but the cashier replied in Mandarin immediately. Since it’s chilly tonight and wind kept blowing to my seat directly, before doing the order, I asked the waiter if it is possible to close the door. He said yes and then closed the door. After i finished ordering and payment, getting back to my seat, i heard the cashier asking the waiter why is the door closed, the waiter replied “that two Chinese girls said they are cold”, and I saw the cashier frown and impatiently wave his hand, saying, “Don’t mind them,” and then ask the waiter to open the door again.

I AM NOT EVEN CHINESE
And if I know that the door is not able to close before doing the order, I can choose to leave the restaurant.

Honestly, nothing worth recommending. The food was far from authentic Cantonese/Hong Kong style and quite underwhelming. The staff member taking my order was extremely rude when I simply asked a few questions.

I spoke politely, yet he raised his voice and kept pointing at the menu, insisting everything was listed there. Of course, I could see the menu, but my questions were about things not written on it!

Would not recommend – best to avoid.

This is more for a quick bite after the pub.
I had the traditional dish, duck, roast pork, barbecue pork on a bed of rice. Taste was bland more like plastic. Maybe being served on a plastic biodegradable plate doesn't help. My wife ordered chicken on rice, which they forgot. I had already finished my dinner before they realised. They then said they didn't have any chicken left 😤. She had barbecue pork on rice instead. Very disappointing.
We also had a plastic plate of green beans, not good 😐
We ate at 9pm on a Thursday evening.
Green tea served in a paper cup 🙄.
Only come here if you can't make it to Chinatown for a more authentic experience and better quality food.
We wanted to give it a try, but I wouldn't come here again.
The pictures look better than the taste! 😞🫢

I’ve been a regular Cloud Land customer on Deliveroo, and recently I finally had the chance to dine in. The taste is very close to what you get in China— 👍 for the chef(s). The bridge-crossing rice noodles was nicely presented on a small wooden ‘bridge’. I enjoyed the beef noodles a lot. They also have some authentic Yunan dishes but I could only enjoy dishes that have up to 1 chilli 🌶️. Portion is very generous, none of us ladies could finish our food. Just a small thing to note: the interior decoration needs updating probably as we are already in the year of the horse 😄 In general I’ll recommend this place.

The food here was really lovely! We shared a variety of dishes, and while I won't list them all, everything we tasted was high quality. The location is also incredibly convenient—very easy to find and just a 5-minute walk from Aldgate station.

​While the food hit the mark, the service experience was a bit mixed. We found the portions to be a little smaller than expected for the price. We also struggled with the QR code ordering system; it was unclear if our additional orders went through, and we eventually had to flag down a waiter who luckily resolved it quickly. There was a significant lag between dishes arriving, and a few items were forgotten entirely until we followed up.

​Despite the service hiccups, the flavors were great and the prices were fair. I’d definitely return, but I’ll probably skip the QR code next time and order directly with the staff.

The ingredients were served separately in small dishes —
chicken, pork loin, sliced fish, prawns, cordyceps flower, mushrooms, squid and more.

The staff then poured everything into a very hot chicken broth at the table.
The soup was genuinely hot and comforting.

I also had the freshly ground soy milk, served hot and steamy.
Overall, the meal felt clean, warming and well prepared.

His most famous dish, Crossing-the-Bridge Rice Noodles, is delicious, but definitely not cheap. Besides that, the restaurant also offers Bird Elephant Pickled Fish, various noodle soups, and snacks. Most of the food is quite good. I also recommend their plum juice and lemon tea, which are excellent value.

We came for dinner and between the two of us, we shared the yun cross bridge noodles (the broth was clean but there could have been more meat), pork belly in chilli (great flavour) and the Yunnan fried pork (good). The service was polite and efficient.

Wow, what a wonderful find this restaurant was….
Weekend in london to celebrate my wife’s birthday and meet our daughter for dinner, both who love Chinese food.
Booked for 17:00 on a damp Sunday (50% saving on food via The Fork). Greeted and served by a lovely young lady.
Excellent menu, big portions, takeaway box provided (for my daughter!), cheap drinks, and they allow you to Bring Your Own wine (with no corkage charges)
As mentioned her the sesame prawn toast and duck pancakes are to die for…. We also had the shared started, satay skewers to start. Then special fried noodles, chicken satay, chilli chicken and Cantonese duck for our main course.
All the food was hot and delicious. The slightest fault would be the noodles came 10 mins after the main courses.
All this and half a dozen cokes for £100 Inc service charge
Just a pity we were the only diners present. Though takeaways were being collected regularly.

I really enjoyed the Lantern and I think it's been one of the best Oriental restaurants where I have ever eaten! The prawn toast was proper prawn toast and it was the best one I have ever eaten. The service was really nice and everything was served very quickly. The atmosphere was quite intimate too, it was not noisy at all and the music in the background was really relaxing. I would recommend this place for a dinner date and to have tradional Chinese food, for a convenient price considering the London budget.

A bright space with friendly, if slightly awkward, service. The food was tasty, though the flavours were more familiar than I was hoping for. Portions are generous and at £27 per person for two mains, two sides and two alcohol-free beers, it’s good value for money.

The prawn toast was a standout — inventive, layered, and packed with delicious flavor. The Beijing shredded roast duck was another highlight, rich and satisfying, while the signature chicken curry was decent though less memorable compared to the other dishes.

The staff were friendly and sweet, though the service could have been faster and more attentive. For example, when we asked for plates, only one was provided for two people, and similarly with water—one jug and one glass. The restaurant wasn’t busy at the time, but they seems overwhelmed with takeaway orders.

I'd probably come back for takeaway or perhaps the lunch deal of 1 main + spring rolls + drink for £14.99 as I'd like to give this place another go and sample their Xinjiang Spicy Cumin with beef.

It's a basic canteen where the food's not bad.  I do hate it when Chinese food is served Western style without scope for sharing dishes.  The mains are served as a plate for a single diner with a neat mound of rice.  It's better suited as a lunch spot as a result.

We started with chicken popstickers which looked and tasted homemade.  They were weren't pan fried to a crisp, which is the way I like gyoza.  There was chilli oil and soy sauce on the table and the popstickers were served with a little dish of vinegar.

Our mains were beef with black bean and chicken with broccoli.  Both were served western style.  Tasty because both dishes had been wokked at a high temperature.  Good evidence of "wok hei" or the smoky charred flavour from oil droplets catching in flare ups while ingredients are tossed in the wok.  This is a flavour one can't achieve at home because a domestic stove does not get hot enough.  There was a shortage of both black beans and broccoli though.  Due to the lack of broccoli I ordered an extra side of bok choi with garlic.  This side dish was refreshingly crisp but bland and under seasoned.

They do not serve alcohol but do tolerate BYO wine.

Jason and Vitaly were a fantastic host. The food was outstanding with a great ambiance, we had our 10 month old with us and despite not having baby changing facilities they done their very best to accommodate us and make it possible. Jason was very kind. Jason was very smiley and made this place our favourite restaurant. Jason was funny and really helpful.  Helped with iPad.

I visited Fresh Feast again today and suggested it as a great option for a team-building dinner with Chinese cuisine. The restaurant has a lovely environment, and the food is well balanced to suit both Chinese and British or other foreigner, making it perfect for a group gathering with colleagues. Especially good for people who work and live in Liverpool Street Station.
For starters, we had chicken & sweet corn soup, lamb skewers, crispy aromatic duck, salt and pepper squid, and a mixed dim sum platter. The staples included fried rice and fried noodles. Main courses featured sweet and sour shredded beef, pickled cabbage fish, spicy beef brisket, crispy chicken with chili, garlic stir-fried water spinach, dry-fried green beans, and braised chicken in savory sauce. For dessert, we finished with brown sugar glutinous rice cakes.
The food was excellent, and the service was absolutely fabulous 😉. After we finished the fried rices and fried noodles, the waiter brought us free boiled rice, so we can have it with other main course. Very thoughtful.

I was so happy to try out Fresh Feast's new vegan menu in its third week. They have a new supplier that is helping them with their aim: making sure that there is a vegan equivalent of every single dish they have on their á la carte menu. I love their ambition! I was really impressed by the vegan dishes I ordered for lunch, and appreciated their friendly service. They checked in regularly to see if I was OK and for my thoughts on the plant based food, and threw in a free jasmine tea which made me feel welcome! I'd recommend all diners check out what they're trying to do here for vegans!

VEGAN MENU AVAILABLE
Generally good food but I was a bit disappointed that the special lunch menu didn't have vegan options.
The manager (Oli) said they're updating the menu and should have vegan options soon.
Free WiFi is available as mobile reception is poor inside the restaurant.
Toilets were clean and accessible.
Lots of seating, I believe they only have Ashahi on tap.
Lots of options for vegan on the separate menu and good veggie protein options.
Generally good service and helpful.

Being a Chinese, I am very picky with Chinese food. I have to say this restaurant is very authentic, with delicious food and generous portions. I will definitely come back for more. Vatalis and Jason were helpful and polite, great customer service!

This is from Saudi Eats in London, with 90k+ followers across social platforms.
Instagram & Tiktok: saudieats.ksa

This rare spot in Whitechapel, @dragonsdenkitchen , one of the very few fully Halal HMC Chinese spots, and honestly… what a discovery for the Chinese New Year 🧧

The evening began with a comforting bowl of Tom Yum King Prawn Soup, rich, fragrant, and perfectly balanced, warming the soul with every spoonful. Then came the star: Black Bean Den’s Special. Deep, bold flavours coated every bite, the kind of dish that makes you pause mid-conversation just to appreciate it. Pure comfort. Pure satisfaction.

And the chow mein? Absolute magic. Glossy, saucy noodles bursting with flavour, each strand perfectly cooked and packed with that irresistible wok-kissed taste.

For the quality, the portions, and the price — this place is a blessing. The kind of spot you bookmark in your heart and return to whenever the craving for proper Chinese hits.

With Ramadan consider this your sign, save this one for your next iftar. 🍜✨
