This was our second visit to this restaurant, and we’ll certainly be back. We enjoyed the Tom Yum soup, chicken chow mein, pad tai, prawn toast and chicken satay. Each dish was rich in flavor and well prepared. The staff were friendly, and the pricing felt reasonable. Thank you for a lovely experience.

Dragon Den is a great place for tasty food and generous portions at a very good price. The tiger prawn soup was especially delicious, and the mixed fried rice was satisfying and well cooked. Definitely worth a visit! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

First time experience went good though my entry was very last moment before closing the place. Had to rush to place the order. But it was worth taking risk to pop in a new place. Enjoyed every bite. Ordered special noodles and Dan's special with rice and prawn. Service was good even in rush closing hours. Highly recommend.
The best random spot I’ve found, food was so delicious and fresh. Fast and friendly service, well priced for taste and portion sizes. Next time I’m in London will definitely visit again.

Cool restaurant. Had a nice meal here.

Vegetarian dumplings and the beef bone soup were delicious.

The fried wings are really nice. Crispy light and are fluffy with a warm spicy coating.

The meef on the beef rib was cooked to perfection. You get a lot of meat on one of those bones. It's not cheap but definitely worth the money.

Will return.

Amazing experience! The beef noodles were absolutely delicious—rich broth, tender beef, and perfectly cooked noodles. The restaurant has a very warm and cozy atmosphere, making it a great place to relax and enjoy a meal.
A special thanks to Carina, whose service was outstanding—friendly, attentive, and very welcoming. She made our visit even more enjoyable.
Highly recommend this place if you're craving authentic and comforting Chinese food. I’ll definitely come back!

Food was really good, particularly the dumplings but I have had more flavourful noodles elsewhere. Everything was still very enjoyable and the food came out really quickly!
They don’t take bookings at this branch so we were lucky they had a table available and didn’t have to wait!

One of the best noodle soups I’ve ever had. Chewy noodles, tender beef, flavorful broth - all perfection. The dumplings are also incredible, specifically the grilled pork and chive & prawn. Very limited seating upstairs and downstairs is tight and a bit stuffy. Queues up quick during lunch time but the staff are efficient, plus your meal will be worth the wait!

Stopped by Ye Ye for a weekday dinner -- they had a nice student discount combo option available on Mondays that I was keen to take advantage of. I was dining by myself, so I got asked if I'd be OK splitting a table with another solo diner (of course!), and was able to be seated in ~5-10 minutes. It was quite busy, and the queue was still long even when I was leaving.

The combo deal comes with a bowl of noodles, an order of 4 pork dumplings (more like buns), and a drink. I chose the spicy beef soup noodles, which were quite yummy. The broth was very rich and spicier than expected, and the noodles were plentiful and had a nice, chewy texture. There was a lot of beef, and it was mostly very tender. The pork buns were a little more meh -- the filling was juicy but I felt that the bun (wrapper) was dry and somewhat bland.

Overall price point was decent. I think I'd probably just stick to the noodles next time (seems they have a lot of yummy-looking options!).

name: Xi'an BiangBiang Noodles Aldgate East Branch

reviews.text:
Super fast service, especially considering we arrived close to closing time.

It was my first time trying hand-pulled noodles and wow… the texture and consistency are unbelievable. They have such a unique bite to them, completely different from regular noodles.

I ordered the cold noodles with veg and they were absolutely delicious. The sauce was incredible, so flavourful and perfectly balanced. My mates went for the lamb noodles and loved them too.

We also shared a cucumber salad, which was super fresh, crunchy, and really tasty. A few beers alongside everything made it even better.

Very reasonable pricing, amazing quality, and impressively quick service. Definitely coming back!

Coming from the US, I wasn’t familiar with Xi’an-style noodles. But boy, was this a memorable meal? Unfussy menu, lots of options for vegetarians and reasonably priced. I ordered the ribbon noodles with the special sauce and king oyster mushrooms. What an amazing, garlicky, spicy sauce, and the freshest noodles I’ve ever had. I also ordered a few of the tofu skewers which were doused in a spicy barbecue sauce. Quick service, really helpful servers. I definitely recommend!

We had an incredible meal at Xi’an’s. The star was definitely the hand pulled biang biang noodles with beef in special sauce. The sauce was phenomenal and would definitely come back for this plate. The noodles in braised beef fell short for me, I don’t know if it was the overwhelming lemongrass taste or if it was because I ordered it less spicy so it lost flavor. Dumplings were average.

Been here twice and the food was delicious!

The cumin lamb was our favorite and the noodle dishes for us weren’t as spicy as we thought they would be.

Can get quite busy around dinner time, though service was fast!

The biang biang noodles were really good but honestly they not the best I have tried. The sauce was overly vinegary. I have had some at other venues which had a much more balanced flavour profile. The meat was tender but a bit chewy and fatty and again just not the best cut of beef I have had with these type of noodles. Just ok overall, I would try somewhere else next time. On a positive note the portion is a lot bigger than it looks in photos.

name: Golden Jade Chinese Restaurant
address: 279 New N Rd, London N1 7AA, UK

reviews.text: Half way through the Beef noodle soup when I discovered a maggot/caterpillar in my soup. Absolutely disgusting. Unacceptable. This place needs to be shut down. I will report this to relevant authorities as this VIOLATES any health standard. DO NOT go/order from here.

Absolutely awful experience.

We are currently in London on holiday with my girlfriend and ordered noodles from this restaurant via Uber Eats, paying nearly £50. As soon as the food arrived, there was a strong, unpleasant smell. The dishes were cold, the meat was extremely rubbery and completely inedible.

We also found hairs in the food, which is totally unacceptable. The egg was hard, dry and impossible to eat.

Considering the price we paid, the food quality and hygiene were deeply concerning. After reading many other similar negative reviews, I honestly don’t understand how this place is still open. Avoid at all costs.

HALAL CHICKEN OPTIONS AVAILABLE!

I ordered from here on Uber Eats, and I could not tell which dish was Halal as it does not say on the platform. I call them in advance and asked, they said only the chicken was halal and even if I select a beef dish, they can alternate it for chicken. I ordered the spicy beef noodles, and left a note to only add halal meat, I called again after I placed my order to confirm they had received it and to reiterate only Halal meat. The man on the phone told me that the noodle soup that I wanted has beef broth, so he could not change it to chicken and give in beef broth.

He was so lovely and kind, he talked me though how he can change my dish to make it halal, and still giving me what I wanted. He even suggested ways he could make it better. He was so sweet and I promised I would give him a glowing review on google. lol.

I ordered some kind of chicken noodle soup and it was delicious. I had not been feeling well, so I was looking for something warm and spicy, and this did not disappoint me.
It was honestly one of the best meals I’ve had, it felt like having home cooked food.

I cannot wait to order from here again

TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE!!
The food contained a piece of a dish sponge; the food safety and hygiene were poor.

I placed an order yesterday for a DIY Dry Hot Pot that cost me £18.71. It took about an hour to be delivered, but my selected ingredients were incomplete — there was no broccoli or lotus root included. I was very disappointed, as the delivery driver had already left when I noticed the issue.

name: Mama Li
address: 22 Great Tower St, London EC3R 5AQ, UK

reviews.text:
Environment: The restaurant itself is not big, offering ~10 seats. There are two order machines and a order status screen. which offers great convenience.
Food: The Char Siu, roast duck and Siu Yuk trio rice is among the best ones I've eaten. The portions are generous and of great value for money (~£15). However, the braised beef brisket is a little too salty, though having a very good appearance. Would definitely recommend to try the rice.

Ordered Beef Ho Fun which was very oily (though normal for this dish it was extremely oily), but was really unseasoned and lacked wok hei. It really needed more soy sauce.

The salt and pepper spare ribs looked like they were boiled and weren’t crispy at all.

Would not order from here again.

Came here for dinner. Service was quick, and the food was served fresh.
I ordered the duck and rice combo — it made me think life is worth living. The duck was tender, soft and very tasty, probably the best I’ve ever had!
The portion was generous (enough for two meals for me).

I also ordered the mango green tea with homemade grass jelly — it was very refreshing after a long day.

Great food and great service! I had the meat (soy chicken) and rice combo - it was really filling and flavourful and just what I needed after work! My friends and I also really enjoyed the music playing in the background 💃🏻

Cute little restaurant tucked away just off Tower Hill. Food is quick and filling, and fairly priced for location. Can happily recommend 3 meats combo, and pleasantly surprised by the spring rolls.

A solid choice for both a sit in lunch or a takeaway home

Ordered for takeout to add on to our lunch and thought it was pretty amazing! 👍🏻

⏰ while the collection time was delayed by over 10 minutes due to a large order of bento boxes, the lady was kind about it and mumbled something, which I found out that she added an additional dumpling to my order!

🥟 dumplings were really good, the best I have had in awhile.. fillings were generous and wasn’t very fried, yet still had that light crispiness as a gyoza should have 👍🏻

The tofu was just an additional dish since we had to meet £10 for an online order, and it was also a hit - lightly salted and came with lots of onions and bell pepper for flavours 💯

Definitely will return in future to try out their bento boxes and other dishes!

The nicest gem in the city, tucked away in an alley. There’s never a queue, a new lunch meal everyday with delicious authentic food. Would recommend to anyone who’s looking for great value and amazing food + great service ♥️

Amazing food, amazing service. The sweet lady in the front customised some of the food to make sure it suited my vegetarian diet and it was so incredibly tasty. My friend had just said he was hungry in passing and she got him a huge portion of his order. Lovely little gem!

Was feeling sick and wanted some Asian simple porridge and soup. Appalling difference between advertised ABC soup and actual soup. Not to mention the 1.5hr delivery time. Next level depression to be scammed and sick.

Maggie Yu  did a very professional acupuncture session with very helpful advice  ....
The spine massage was a new  wonderful experience and was accurate with its diagnosis .
Next time I will try the food as a lot of customers were enjoying it ... Small place have
One table  for 3 people plus  a bar for another 3..
They have Halal meals.
And a wonderful nice owner (Jane ) she did her best for me when the appointments got mixed up .

Honestly, I was disappointed. The food didn’t have much flavour at all it tasted bland and forgettable. Portion size was okay, but the taste just wasn’t there, and I expected much better. Service was fine, staff did their job, and the place itself has a decent atmosphere, but the food really let it down. But I would come back again just to get spicy fries chips though.

Absolutely Delicious!

I ordered the fried rice with egg and caramel chicken, and it was incredible! The fried rice was perfectly cooked—fluffy grains with just the right touch of seasoning and that satisfying wok flavor. The egg added a rich, velvety texture that tied everything together beautifully.

But the real standout was the caramel chicken — crispy on the outside, tender inside, with a sweet-savory glaze that hit all the right notes. It had that perfect balance of sticky, smoky, and slightly tangy that keeps you going back for more.

And I can’t forget the dumplings — soft, juicy, and packed with flavor. You can tell they’re made with care, and they paired perfectly with the rest of the meal.

Overall, every bite was bursting with flavor. Highly recommend this dish — it’s comfort food done right! 🍚🍗🥟

Nice new surroundings, easy order had deal 2 x regular box for £10 + 2 x cans £1.30 each. Very tasty food. On small side alittle greasy but food was satisfying as per cost. Cleanliness of facilities requires some attention. Friendly staff. Overall good

Great service and the food was so good. Will go again soon! The staff were friendly too and the wait wasn’t very long.

We had Create Your Own - Large
Udon Noodles
Schezuan Rice
Malaysian Chicken
Wok-Fired Beef

Second Create Your Own
Udon Noodles
Spicy Chips
Chilli Chicken
Kung Po Chicken
Went here twice now, great portions in the chow mein noodles with terikyaki chicken wings and spring rollls. It is extra spicy so if you like your  chilli with noodles or rice, its the place to be.

second time coming to this branch and i absolutely love it every time! the staff are very lovely and very attentive.

my go-to order is the braised beef noodles. it’s THE best braised beef noodles out of all the different restaurants that does it. the sauce pairs perfectly well with the noodles that have the right amount of chew. the beef is so tender and flavourful. love the pakchoi and the beansprouts (just wish there’s more beansprouts).

i always dream about this meal. i want to try the mango sago next time but we’re always too full from the noodles to try haha.

10/10 recommend ✨✨✨

This is a very tasty restaurant. All the noodles I have tried all had the right amount of chew, and the meat is flavourful. I found the spice/chili's used to be more about the flavour than just raw heat, although they can definitely get intense. The restaurant vibe and decor is all lovely too and has a good amount of seating. Typically priced for the area but not too expensive. Would happily come again.

We tried the signature beef noodle soup and the spicy beef fried rice, and both dishes were quite good. The beef was tender，and the portions were satisfying.
The restaurant itself is nicely decorated and has a pleasant atmosphere, which makes the dining experience comfortable. Overall, it’s a solid choice if you’re looking for Chinese food in the area. Would consider coming back to try other dishes.

Tender beef rib and chewy noodles - both great. However I found the flavour to be on the light side and had to ask for more chilli oil. And even then it feels like it was lacking the flavour hit I was looking for. Not opposed to trying them again. A bit pricey and there is a service fee that they add to the bill

We tried a few dishes at Noodle & Beer and overall had a mixed but mostly positive experience.

❤️The beef noodle (niu rou mian) was the standout — the beef was fantastic and very tender. Personally, I wasn’t a big fan of the heavy use of peppercorn, as the numbing effect was a bit much for my taste.

❤️The wan za mian was also good, almost like an Asian take on Bolognese — rich and comforting.

For starters,🤔 the mouth-watering chicken didn’t
really impress me and felt quite average.

On the other hand, the❤️ sao jiao pi dan was very good and definitely recommended.

The restaurant décor is nice. It is more spacious than the one in Chinatown.

One small downside: the tea ☕is quite pricey compared to the food.

The food was tasty, we might come back in a few months on a quieter day. Didn't get to try the desserts we were looking forward to.

We arrived just after opening and we're the 2nd table sat. Over the next 5-10 minutes, 3 more tables came in after us. We, and the table sat after us, weren't asked our order (despite trying to give it) until 35 minutes after after we had arrived... Which was after the 4th and 5th tables to arrive had not only ordered, but already had their food.

There were a couple who arrived after 6 who had their food before we had gotten a single dish. Those tables who arrived after us had already eaten, paid, and left by the time we got one of our dishes, and once we got the first, it was almost 20 minutes until we finally got the 3rd.

The manager took my drink off after I asked for for the service charge to be taken off, which was nice. But we still had to go get some other food on the way home after how hungry we still were.
Absolutely loved it, lived up to the hype. Unlike other reviewers we had really nice, speedy service. The scallion pancake in particular was amazing. Will definitely be back.
amazing spot. i want to try everything on the menu. i really enjoyed the dan dan noodles and chongqing cauliflower, absolutely lovely

Thanks a lot for being so welcoming and nice making the experience of having dinner more enjoyable. We loved the food so much, you can tell is made from fresh ingredients and with love. Tasting and powerful flavours. Also we loved the cocktails! We I’ll be returning for sure.

This has got to be my current fav Chinese restaurant in London! Excellent food and so much variety. Only downside is that some dishes can be oily but everything was tasty nevertheless.
Recommend the scallion pancake, crispy cauliflower, stir fry cabbage, and dan dan noodles

name: Kung Pao Panda
address: 259A Bethnal Grn Rd, London E2 6AH, UK

reviews.text:
I recently visited King Pao Panda in Bethnal Green, and the food genuinely exceeded my expectations.

I went for the egg fried rice with beef and Naga, and it was packed with flavour. The rice was fluffy and aromatic, the beef tender and generously portioned and the Naga brought that bold, unmistakable heat that makes the dish so addictive. It had just the right level of spice - enough to warm you up without overpowering the other flavours. Every mouthful felt rich, comforting and deliciously fiery.

I also tried the salt and pepper chicken wings, which were a total highlight. They came out perfectly crisp, with a golden coating that carried plenty of flavour. The mix of garlic, chillies and crunchy onions made them incredibly satisfying, and the wings were still juicy inside. It’s the kind of dish you start eating and realise you’re already planning your next visit.

The staff were friendly and the food arrived fresh and piping hot - always a good sign.

Overall, King Pao Panda is a great spot if you love bold flavours and hearty portions. I’ll definitely be back to explore more of their menu!

Very authentic flavor and big portions! I’m from Taiwan, their food definitely tastes like homemade! Namuna is very friendly and nice, offered recommendations and was very attentive and gave me a bag and plastic covers right after noticing the portions were to big for me to finish

I’ve been a regular for ages, but ever since the rebrand, they’ve really stepped up their game! From the fast service, the modern interior, and the lovely staff, they just never miss. The chicken dumplings are my all-time favourite along with the dynamite prawns and red velvet wings 🤤 Already looking forward to my next meal!!!
Had to check it out and was not disappointed. Price was alright and taste was perfect! The Singapore style rice and noodles were delicious and the dim sum was good too!

I had a fantastic experience at Kung Pao Panda on Bethnal Green Road! From the moment I walked in, the staff were welcoming and attentive — they really make you feel at home. The menu offers a great variety of authentic Chinese dishes made with fresh ingredients, and there’s something for every taste. I especially enjoyed the chicken chow mein and the chicken balls — rich flavours and perfectly cooked. The halal certification is a big plus for inclusivity, and vegetarian options didn’t disappoint either. The portion sizes were generous, and everything was served with care. Whether you’re grabbing a quick takeaway or enjoying a relaxed meal, this place is a real gem in East London. Highly recommended!

We had a very delicious meal here tonight. Highly recommended!

The staff were friendly and professional and the place was clean and had good energy.

Food was absolutely delicious. We ordered a couple of different dumplings as well as the stir fried chicken, duck rolls and the giant soup dumplings and also got some smashed cucumbers and dan dan noodles. All of which were amazing! I was a bit worried the big soup dumpling was going to be a let down but it was absolutely delicious. Lovely rich broth inside and nicely flavoured pork.

The giant dumpling was so good, in fact, that in her excitement my friend sadly dropped hers on the floor and they were kind enough to replace it for free because she was so disappointed.

All the dumplings were deliciously flavoured and we were very impressed by the noodles because they still had a good texture to them and the flavours were great.

Also, don’t miss out on the chilli oil because that was also really good.

Portions are generous and so due to the portion sizes we felt that the prices were very reasonable. You might look at the price on the dumplings and think they’re expensive but you get 10 of them not 6 like a lot of places.

For sure would come back and would recommend. I just regret not buying one of their mugs on the way out.

This is a fantastic place to try near Liverpool Street. My favourite dumpling place in London! The noodles are amazing especially the Dan Dan noodles, incredible taste and couldn’t stop eating them. All fresh hand pulled noodles and so tasty. Personal favourites:Pork w/ Chinese leaf & King Prawn dumplings. 🥟  I will be coming back and service is so lovely :)

Very decent dumplings
The service fee is around 5 pounds. I didn't notice it and also tipped, that was disappointing. Idk if it's typical for losing
Spicy pork dumplings are very nice, there's a spicy soup inside

Been here twice!! Love it!
Really authentic taste, and they have a broad selection of food/drinks/ sweet treats to choose from. Honestly, was pretty surprised when we first came as they had a few dishes that are quite hard to find in other Chinese restaurants around london.

We tried the beef and lamb dumplings and they were honestly the best dumplings I’ve ever had in London! The wonton soup was amazing, and the sweet and sour pork was absolutely incredible. Everything was delicious, can’t wait to come back!

I booked with first table on CNY and it was great dinner. Bean curd Cheng fen was delicious as was the soft shell carb. Service was so so, we had to keep asking for water. Overall great dinner for £100 for the dishes plus a bottle of wine with the discount

We visited Yauatcha City for their weekday unlimited dim sum offer (January deal, Monday–Friday, 5–8pm), which also includes a free glass of drink — good value on paper.

The ordering system is structured rather than free-flow. Each round, you can order:
One plate of baked dim sum (2 pieces)
One portion of steamed dim sum (3 pieces)
One bao
You can only order one portion of each type at a time, and the main dishes are served after you’ve finished the dim sum.

In terms of food, ❤️the steamed dim sum especially scallop dumplings were my favourite — delicate and well-balanced.
❤️The baked pastries were tasty, but quite buttery, so they can feel heavy and limit how much you want to eat.

🤔Dessert is included and listed as a soufflé pancake, but it didn’t resemble a soufflé at all — more like a standard sponge cake, which was a bit disappointing.

Service was pretty slow, and despite being a weekday, it was busy and quite noisy during the offer hours. Things noticeably calm down after 8pm once people start leaving.

Overall, a decent deal if you’re curious about the offer, but manage expectations around pace, atmosphere, and the dessert.

Celebrating Chinese New Year in London felt genuinely special at Yauatcha City. Their Year of the Horse menu blends tradition with a modern, elegant touch — from the beautifully curated space to the thoughtful dishes. The dim sum remains consistently refined, while the slow-braised duck and stir-fried beef with water chestnut felt comforting yet polished. The citrus-forward dessert was a perfect, light finish. A subtle, contemporary way to experience Chinese New Year abroad, without feeling forced or overly festive.

An amazing Cantonese restaurant located a few steps away from Liverpool Street station in a huge venue with lots of seating. We went here today for my mother’s birthday and was greeted with impeccable food and service. We were surprised on how generous the portions were especially for a top class restaurant making it quite the value for money. The Prawn and Beancurd Cheung Fun was the BEST Cheung Fun I honestly have ever had - it was perfectly balanced with amazing sweet and umami flavours with a crisp inside finish. I would also recommend the stir-fry rib eye beef which was incredibly juicy and even my father whom isn’t too keen on beef found amazing. Shout out to Alexo for his top class service who was also very patient and professional when coming to handling my allergy and his service through the night overall!! This restaurant is definitely on my recommendations list, I have yet to visit the Soho branch but will definitely be back very soon!!

For our team dinner we went with Yauatcha City and it certainly lived up to the hype. We chose the tasting menu and honestly every dish seemed to be trying to outshine the previous one. The service was warm and the setting looked stunning. It was fairly busy, although that only made us feel even more pleased with our choice. All in all, a brilliant evening and very easy to enjoy.

Ordered a takeaway to the hotel I stayed when I was in London. Food arrived after about 40minutes and hot, which was lovely. But the good things just disappeared once I stated the food, the aubergine curry was too oily, the beef in szechuan sauce was too salty. The fried rice was good however. Didn’t finish half of them. Was not a great experience I would say.

Do not order from them on Uber Eats they are complete liars. I waited over an hour and then when I called them they said they only received the order a few minutes ago and the delivery man was 10 minutes ago away and then when I ask them they told me the delivery hadn’t even been sent out yet. Absolute scammed do not order from them.
Great takeaway lunch. Tasty. Perfectly cooked veg assortment included in a chicken dish . V quick too👌🏼
i ordered from here when i stayed at a hotel in london, i really enjoyed the food but i do have to say it took some time

Ordered delivery took TWO HOURS!!! Wouldn’t cancel or refund insisted it was “on the way” for an hour and 20. Eventually got two hour old food. Way  overpriced for what you get. Might have been ok hot, but cold not so much

Disappointed. I have been recommended this restaurant for a long time and my local Asian restaurant has been unexpectedly closed, so I spent a score on some, the ribs were to fatty and lacked flavour, not dry enough. The rice was bland, so was the noodles. Couldn’t taste any seasoning and then there was no sweet and sour sauce/crackers which usually comes with the meal. This is not my first time there so maybe it was a off day but I was looking forward to some Chinese it’s a shame

I recently ordered from Chan’s Noodle Bar for a cozy night in, and overall, it was a very good experience. The food was hot and packed with flavor. We order Sweet and Sour Chicken, Special Fried Rice, Meat (Chicken) Spring Roll, Vegetable Spring Roll, and Fried Vermicelli with Vegetables.

The Sweet and Sour Chicken was well cooked, with a nice balance of tangy and sweet flavors, and the Pineapples pieces were lovely and sweet. The Fried Vermicelli with Vegetables, Chicken Spring Rolls and Special Fried Rice was delicious and not overly greasy.

The portion sizes were reasonable, and I felt the prices were fair for the quality and quantity of the food. The Vegetable Spring Rolls weren’t great but my partner enjoyed them. Personally they didn’t taste right but the Chicken Spring Rolls were amazing.

Everything was neatly packed, and the wait time was short, 10 minutes. This is the best Chinese spot I’ve ever had. Highly recommended for a reliable, quick and tasty Chinese takeaway.

Food is great. Fresh, clean. Have been the same people all these years. Same lady. I used to sit in as it was a restaurant many years ago before lockdown.  This is a no frills take away. If you want the frills, go eat a Roka in canary wharf. If you want good, clean, fast Chinese food in hackney. Come here. They also take card.

The best price to quality ratio! It was my first Chinese takeaway since I moved to London and I go there regularly. The food is like an older ford focus, not the best but will do the job well! When you have a rough day, it’s the best comfort food!

I am happy we gave this takeaway a try and we enjoyed there food .
The food was delicious and fresh.
Our food arrived on time and piping hot.

We will be calling up for a takeaway again and be recommending Chan's Noodle Bar.

They can tell you the life story of the cow and where the flour comes from, but getting decent staff seems to be outside their supply chain. Anyway, when we went, staff were rude and dismissive and made us feel like they were doing us a favour by even serving us.

I’ve been to Yeye noodles restaurant many many times, the food there is 10 Stars! I ordered the dry beef noodle and your signature pork dumplings for delivery through delivery and although tasty they’re just not the same as the restaurant! The dry noodle is close but not quite there and the dumplings were completely different!
The food is still super tasty and I would order again but it would be amazing if you guys could get the delivery food closer to what the restaurant food is like, especially the pork dumplings!

Very nice food, good depth of flavour for the beef noodle soup. We planned to pickup takeout, but changed our minds to sit in the store, and they were very nice to allow us, with friendly service. Would recommend!
Love going to Yeye at Liverpool Street. Big fan of the beef noodles and dumplings

The picture of the place belongs to their other gig, not far from this. Mainly a take-away as they only have 2 tables to sit.
I had a short eat-in. Food was great.

Came here for iftar, and was not disappointed! We had the combination starter, which had a little bit of everything. I got the Pad thai and it tasted amazing! It was perfect with the lime and crushed nuts. I also had a pinacolada mocktail, which was really tasty, had a good balance of sweet and sour. I'll definetly be coming back again with family and friends next time.

I went to Wok n Roll for my 25th birthday with my friends, long story short the food was great but the service was ridiculous and put a dampener on my night.

When we were seated they left x3 menus at the end of the table despite us being a party of 8. This pretty much set the tone for the rest of the evening. We had to ask to order drinks, ask to order food, ask for them to clear the table. It was so bad my friends started clearing the table for them as they left all our plates and then tried to bring out my cake.

We gave them a pack of candles and a ‘happy birthday’ sign for the cake which we asked them to put on the cake. They put one candle on and put it in front of the sign so it wasn’t visible. Honestly, the lack of thought and effort was palpable.

The only positives were that the food was really nice. I had a sweet icy lychee mojito with the prawn tempura and pad see ew which was hot, fresh and tasty. A good portion size for the price.

I’d say go here if you’re looking for a casual night out. Do not go here for special occasions or you’ll be disappointed.
Sooooo good food! Very nice service and good prices. We got a lot of sticky rice and couldn't eat up. As we gave them tipps, they offered another soft drink, so cute! We had a great time there!

Great Asian fusion spot in London. We had fried rice, pad thai and curry — everything was delicious, especially the fried rice.

The staff were very friendly and attentive, service was fast, and the prices were surprisingly good for London while fully matching the quality. A friend was celebrating her birthday and the team even surprised her with a strawberry drink, which was a lovely touch.

Would definitely come back and highly recommend.

Been here a few times, always order the same items and they’re always a success. It can get busy so booking in advance really helps, it’s a small restaurant so if going with a large group then definitely book in advance. The staff are always very good and take your feedback on the dishes, they have good customer service and have variety of dishes on the menu. The dragon roll is a must if you come here, love it!

Been working in the City for years and can’t believe I only just discovered Kirin. Such a hidden gem right in the heart of the financial district.

The interior really surprised me – elegant Chinese-style décor with a warm, almost candlelit atmosphere that you don’t usually see in Chinese restaurants in London. It feels spacious but still cosy, and would be perfect for group dinners or celebrations.

We tried the dim sum (all freshly handmade), Peking duck, lobster pasta and a few other dishes – everything was well presented and full of flavour. The duck was crispy and tender, and the seafood was fresh and generous.

Considering the setting and the quality, the pricing felt very reasonable compared to similar restaurants in the area. Service was friendly and welcoming too.

Definitely somewhere I’d come back to, especially for a special occasion or a group gathering. A really pleasant surprise.

Dinner was fabulous! Restaurant had a great atmosphere with traditional Chinese decorations which were certainly unique in London. Food was authentic Chinese cuisine with Cantonese (hong Kong) and Sichuan (spicy) dishes. The staff were friendly too, even let us check out the karaoke rooms, we will definitely be back for some more food and singing. I would highly recommend!

We were a walk in pair able to get a table on Saturday night. We were very surprised by this once we tasted the food - it looked and tasted absolutely beautiful. The bathrooms were clean, and the private dining rooms looked great for functions and celebratory meals. Considering the minimal customers while we were there, we felt the staff could have been a little more attentive, but nonetheless they were lovely to deal with. Would happily come back again, thank you for the delicious meal.

I've been going to Kiri during 7, 8 years. Depending on the day I went, it seems the quality of food varied sometimes significantly from being excellent to being extremely mediocre to say the most. Roast meat and aubergine were delicious sometimes.
Service from different staff also varies but overally correct. The owner is very warm.
Basic seating, reasonably quiet. They also provide private dining rooms for group event as well as karaoke.
My favourite spot for lunch before going to the Globe for an afternoon show! Lovely food and service, great atmosphere. Can’t recommend enough the aromatic duck and the mapo tofu :)

Don't do it. The food was terrible. Also, when I asked, they said the dumplings were steamed. The dumplings are fried. One of the meals was missing in my bag, but I was charged the full price. The dipping sauce for the dumplings was less than a thimbleful. The fried rice had very little meat or vegetables in it.
No idea why the reviews are so bad! This is my local and i order often, every time it never fails. It’s a classic British Chinese takeaway and everything is spot on, always!

for context: I ordered my food in-person.

They have a 15% student discount written out front. Although I was only given a 10% discount but it hadn't occured to me at the time. That's fine though, not that deep.

On the contrary to lots of the old reviews here, the food was hot and tasted decent. The portion size was quite big in one of those Satco microwave containers. I ordered the Beef Chow Mein and given my review id recommend it.

I dont know why but I was given a spoon to eat with lol. I ate the rest at home so wasn't that big of an issue. Be sure to ask them for specific cutlery if you need it.

The state of the shop itself was quite a mess. it doesn't bother me too much but something to keep in mind if you're sensitive to that. It looks like they mostly deal with deliveries anyway so probably not a priority.

To summarise:

+ Beef chow mein was nice
+ Hot food if collected or ordered in-person (no guarantees with Uber etc.)
+ Tasty
+ Option for spicy if you're like me >:)
+ Halal

- Messy shop
- Dumplings may not halal
- No indoor seating to eat
- Charged incorrectly
- Given a spoon to eat noodles

overall 4 stars as the food itself was fine, and that's the most important thing :)
Amazing food with good sizable portion. The best chinese in local.
Ordered Singapore  fried rice,its a decent portion,price also reasonable,mixture of chicken,beef & prawn but vegetables  are little less,overall good!

Okie dokie spot. small portion similar to a elevated fast food. Western pleasing Asian cuisines. it's okay like good for a small snack but wouldn't say I'd recommend for like Asian food. maybe appeasing to vegans, best thing was the sizzling tofu had a kind of chewy sweet texture that was interesting, it had the noodles which is how you expect and the dumplings which was small but not too bad

I walked in on a busy Tuesday evening without a reservation.
I always wanted to visit this place as i am passing by very often.
I was told that I will be informed as soon as the table for 2 is free.
It took around 10 minutes.
I recommend booking the table in advance.
All members of staff were amazingly helpful and friendly.
Me and my friend ordered noodles, tofu, rice and some wontons and dumplings to share.
We were given some recommendations by the staff,
Which was much appreciated.
Everything was tasty and flavoured.
I would like to try something else in the future.
Our plum juice was amazing.
The pieces are little bit above the average.
The place is very nicely decorated!
The atmosphere is nice and warm.
I recommend if you are thinking to go!
Thanks!

We’d been looking forward to trying this place for ages and finally walked in on a Sunday afternoon. Got seated straight away, and the staff were genuinely kind and helpful with suggestions. Bonus: individual rice portions come with free unlimited refills, which is always nice.Sadly, the food didn’t live up to the hype at all.  The wontons in house sauce were the only real highlight.
Everything else was surprisingly bland and under-seasoned — dishes we expected to be punchy just tasted flat.

Given the higher-than-average prices, leaving still hungry and unsatisfied felt like a real letdown. We didn’t bother ordering more because nothing excited us enough to justify spending extra. Friendly service and free rice refills are great, but the lack of flavour across most dishes means this one didn’t match the glowing reputation for us. There are better options in London for the same money.
One of the best restaurants in London, hands down. Absolutely loved every dish I’ve tried so far and the staff has always been lovely and gave us good recommendations. Insanely good.

Tofu Vegan - what a lovely experience!! The food was delicious and exciting, especially as vegetarians. All the staff were welcoming and kind, especially our server Yama, who recommended us the best dishes and treated us with so much warmth. We can’t wait to be
back!

Appalling company. Ordered from here for a special family meal via just eat and the food was over an hour late, absolutely abysmal - fried, dripping in oil and fat, and half the items barely resembled what they should have. Just deep brown shapes. The singapore noodles were atrocious, and we have had to throw it away. It is inedible .

Not to mention the VERY disrespectful way they have dealt with me on the telephone when I rang to ask where our food was.

We placed the order at 6.55pm. The just eat site said our food would arrive 740pm - 8pm. it had not arrived by 8pm, so I rang to find out where it was because it has not arrived and we couldn't track the order..  The male I spoke to was called WilmerJan was unable to speak clearly and refused to answer any questions, stating "busy busy" and he hung up on me mid conversation twice.  The next time I spoke to him he made a lot of excuses such as we were "far away" (less than 3 miles) and that they only had 1 driver and it was not his problem. When I suggested they should not have accepted our order, he then hung up on me again

I called back to find out whether our food had been cancelled by him or whether we could still expect it to arrive here, he said to complain to "just eat," because it was nothing to do with him, that he was "nothing." When I asked if that was some kind of joke he hung up on me again!

This is extremely disappointing and very rude service and I am shocked Just Eat has this company on their website.

Our food eventually arrived at 8.35pm, yet just eat sent me a message claiming the food had arrived at 825pm (it hadnt)
and due to the very rude way I have been dealt with, as well as the disgusting food, I have requested a full refund onto my payment card because this is unacceptable, disappointing and not fair.

AVOID THIS PLACE AT ALL COST.
I ordered delivery from this restaurant and it was a complete nightmare. My food never showed up—not late, not delayed, just never arrived at all. After waiting far past the estimated delivery window, I called the restaurant to figure out what was going on.

The staff couldn’t have cared less. No apology, no effort to check on the order, nothing. I was talked over, put on hold without warning, and eventually told, in the most uninterested tone possible, that they “didn’t know” what happened and that I’d have to “figure it out” with the delivery app myself. Zero responsibility, zero concern, zero customer service.

AVOID FOR YOUR OWN HEALTH
Food with visible signs of mould or decay!
Ordered few times but quality of food is got worse than ever, with taste of bad state and vegetables visibly gone bad. It’s cheap but not worth risking your health. This place should be investigated…

DO NOT ORDER FROM HERE
RUDE STAFF WHO SNAP AND SHOUT AT YOU THEN HANG UP. THEY DONT DELIVER YOUR FOOD LEAVE YOU WAITING OVER AN HOUR TELL YOU TO WAIT MORE AND THEN SHOUT AT YOU,HANG UP AND CANCEL YOUR ORDER. GLAD IN A WAY AS EVERYONE SAYS THEY ARE DISGUSTING AND WITH A HYGIENE RATING OF 3. DISGUSTING AND SHOULD BE SHUT DOWN!!!
Order never arrived but was marked as delivered. Does not answer calls either.  Terrible.

name: Yanji BBQ
address: 153 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E2 7DG, UK

reviews.text: I’m a huge fan of lamb skewers, and this place was absolutely incredible. The owner prepares all the ingredients by hand every morning - even the sauces are homemade, which really surprised me. The meat is big, super tender, and doesn’t have a strong lamb smell at all. I’m so happy to have found a proper Korean-style lamb skewer spot in London. Highly, highly recommend!

Absolutely amazing Korean food in London Zone 2 posh area. Authentic, delicious, fresh, just gorgeous! Yanji BBQ not only serves mouth-watering food but also a clean and comfortable environment. The shop owners are Korean and they made the best recommendations for my tastebuds. My friends and I, a total of 5 people had beef, lamb, pork belly with enoki mushrooms, deep fried chicken, vegetables fried noodles, all are absolutely fresh and delicious. Even though it is hot outside, the restaurant is comfortably air-conditioned, we feel good while having the skewers freshly grilled in the turning grill (actually fun to grill the skewers by ourselves). Lastly, all of us are surprised with the cold noodles- chewy Korean noodles served in cold, icy, refreshing, tasty soup with light vinegar, cucumber and radish slices. The taste is just a perfect choice for hot summer. Just can’t resist to finish the whole big bowl!

An absolute flavor explosion! This Korean
BBQ place delivered an unforgettable dining experience. The lamb skewers were tender and perfectly seasoned with a subtle smokiness that melted in our mouths. The beef skewers impressed with their juicy texture and rich marinade that balanced sweet and savory notes. Don't miss their grilled eggplant - caramelized to perfection with a delicious garlic-soy glaze that elevated this vegetable to star status. The cold noodles (naengmyeon) provided the perfect refreshing contrast, with their chewy texture and invigorating icy broth cutting through the rich meats beautifully.
Impeccable service paired with a vibrant yet cozy atmosphere made this meal truly special. Every dish arrived sizzling fresh off the grill, showcasing their commitment to quality. An essential Seoul-style BBQ experience that we'll be craving again soon!

Wow… this place is amazing!!! The best Galbi-tang we’ve ever had… even better than the ones my partner and I tried in Korea!! I was craving cold noodles for so long and I am so delighted to have finally found somewhere in the UK that serves them, they were so good too! The whole meal was amazing and the service was great, thank you to the owner who made it such a nice experience. I will definitely be back! 😊

A cosy little spot in Shoreditch serving up BBQ skewers with a twist – automated skewers over charcoal. 🔥 Perfect for beers and casual catch ups while the grill does the work for you.

Alongside the skewers, you can order some Korean classics that round out the meal nicely.

Here’s what we loved:

⭐️ Lamb and beef skewers
⭐️ Seafood Pancake

It’s not a fine dining experience, but if you’re in the area and fancy something fun, easy, and full of flavour, this is a solid pick.

We ended up at Mei Ume on a whim after being let down by the restaurant we were originally booked with. On my birthday of all days! Thankfully Mei Ume had space for the two of us. We went for the set menu and were very impressed. The food was incredible, every course blew us away. I could write a paragraph about every individual dish we ate, but I’ll spare you the details and just tell you, it was perfect. All the staff were lovely and very accommodating, I even had a small birthday treat which was a lovely surprise considering we were walk-ins and the meal hadn’t been planned in advance. We will ABSOLUTELY be back!

We searched for Mei Ume for 30 mins even though it was a 2 minutes from the hotel.
Glad we found it!!!, superb.
Can’t thank Eden enough for explaining the dishes and the wonderful service.
Very nice atmosphere, beautiful decor and exceptional service.

Amazing experience! We chose the 9 course seasonal menu and we specified halal dietary beforehand. Loved the sparking tea! We also ordered the chicken xiao long bao separately and it was delicious! Every dish was delicious, I personally didn’t like the lamb shank though, the sauce was abit weird for me but the meat texture was good and the portion was quite big… Service was excellent but the staff served us Chinese wine for the flaming snail dish lol maybe she forgot our halal dietary :) definitely will come back and try their lunch menu! Oh and the head chef came out and greet us/ the customers which I think it’s quite nice!

Restaurant Review: Mei Ume – A Mixed Experience

I had dinner at Mei Ume on March 15, 2025, eagerly anticipating a dining experience that would truly blow me away. While the service and atmosphere were outstanding, the food did not quite meet my expectations, and the long wait times were disappointing.

Upon arrival, we were warmly welcomed and seated promptly. The service was exceptional, with knowledgeable and friendly waitstaff. I asked for a dish that would truly impress me, and without hesitation, our waiter recommended the signature duck dish, which could be ordered as either half a duck (£60) or a whole duck. Another waiter also highly recommended the same dish, and we were informed that if we chose the duck pancakes, the chef would present and carve the duck tableside for a special showcase.

However, when we opted for the half duck, this promised experience did not happen. Instead, the duck arrived already sliced and was only lukewarm at best. We had to send it back to be properly reheated. While the duck itself was cooked beautifully, the crispy skin was too thin, lacking the satisfying crunch I expected. The accompanying sauce was overly thick, very sweet, and salty, which overpowered the dish and lingered on the palate.

As for the other dishes:
•	Yellowtail Carpaccio – This was my favorite dish of the night. It was light, flavorful, and delicious—a standout on the menu.
•	Soup Dumpling – We were told we could sip the soup inside the dumpling using a straw, but there was barely any soup despite its size. Disappointing.
•	Hakka Noodles – The flavors were just okay, but once again, the sauce was overpowering. It wasn’t a dish that stood out.
•	Roasted Black Cod (£42) – Delicate, fresh, and very tasty, though for the price, the portion could have been more generous.
•	Mango & Pandan Sago Dessert – A delicious and well-balanced dessert that I would definitely recommend.
•	Fresh Mint Tea – A great way to end the meal, helping with digestion.

While the service was impeccable, and the staff were friendly and knowledgeable, the food didn’t quite live up to my expectations. Some dishes were excellent, while others fell short—either due to overpowering flavors, portion sizes, or missing elements of the promised experience. Additionally, the wait times were longer than expected, which added to the overall disappointment.

Had we chosen the whole duck, perhaps we would have experienced the tableside presentation as promised. However, as it stands, I left feeling that the food didn’t quite justify the price. The manager did surprisingly take off the duck off our bill which was also very kind.

A pleasant experience overall, but not one that left me blown away.

Thank you,
Matt

An absolutely brilliant restaurant. We (two adults) had dinner at Mei Ume and enjoyed every single dish. We also enjoyed the cocktails (I had the pear one) and sparkling tea drink which was courtesy of the establishment.

Food: We were comfortable with sharing plates. We wanted to try their signature dishes. I ordered the Half Peking Duck and Lobster Two Ways served as lobster sashimi and lobster soup. We ordered the tofu from the selection of small plates. My husband also wanted the wagyu on hot stone but we will have to return for that. What we ordered was more than enough food for us. Everything was beautifully executed and that lobster sashimi was truly a treat!

Cocktails: delicious and unusual.

Dessert: Mei Miao, with a chocolate shell in the shape of the cat artwork that greets guests upon arrival. It’s delightful and light.

Ambiance: for a big hall with high ceiling, it was surprisingly not loud. Loved the plum blossom accents throughout.

Service: food and drinks arrived quickly and the staff were prompt in clearing out empty dishes afterwards. Faultless service led by a warm and personable General Manager. Thank you very much, Annie!

name: Rice Brother
address: Unit 4, The Kitchens Spitalfields Market, 16 Horner Square, London E1 6EW, UK

reviews.text:
Got the signature char Siu rice burrito

It’s a bit difficult to eat, recommend to ask them to cut it in half.

The rice is a fairly thick layer so you’ll defo be full after this! The char Siu is a bit chunky, would be even better if it was a bit more thinly sliced, so it’ll be easier to bite. It’s not the usual char Siu, more like braised pork with some teriyaki sauce.

The you tiu (fried dough) is a nice addition for texture.

Service was good.

My order was mostly rice with two little pieces of chicken. It was sad to pay 10£ for this. My friend ordered the tofu one, her one was similar and she couldn't even eat half of as it was so blunt.
I checked the previous photos reviewers uploaded and compared with my ones, it is clear that the quality dropped a lot - it seems like they used to put generous fillings but they hardly put any now.

I recently ordered the Beef and Chicken Combo from Rice Brother, and it was absolutely delicious! The beef was tender, the chicken was flavorful, and the portion size was perfect. The rice was cooked just right, and the overall meal was so satisfying. Highly recommend this place if you're in the area—definitely worth trying!

Tried the combo rice box and it absolutely delivered. Generous portions, perfectly cooked rice, and a solid mix of flavours that balance heat, savoury, and freshness really well. The proteins were juicy, the sauces tied everything together, and nothing felt sloppy or rushed. It’s the kind of comfort food that’s filling without being heavy. Ideal Spitalfields grab-and-go—fast, flavourful, and great value for money.
Super yummy chicken rice box and the tofu rice roll. I love the chill oil and ginger sauce so much. The taste is like my hometown

name: Gloria
address: 54-56 Great Eastern St, London EC2A 3QR, UK

reviews.text:
Wow! Apart from the short wait for a free table, everything was not just good – it was fantastic.
The service was extremely attentive, and both the food and the wine were absolutely heavenly.
For dessert we had the meringue tart: delicious, though very generous in size.
Highly recommended – just make sure to book in advance.

Last night, we had the pleasure of dining at Gloria’s and it was an exceptional experience. From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was inviting and warm. Our waiter, Rebecca, truly made the evening special. Brilliant Service! Definitely would go back!

I could give 10 stars if i could!
I don't know where to start. The restaurant is beautiful. From the tables to the plates and the small details that can't make you stop looking around, with the soft music at the background that gives that italian atmosphere. It's like being transported in a different era and country.
The food is to die for. We had the lunch set menu + desserts. Every single dish was an explosion of flavours. I could tell the ingredients were fresh. I've never found a restaurant that does the tiramisù as good as mine.
I've recommended it to every soul I know and I will definitely go back to taste other dishes from the menu... next time I'll make sure to book the table, because we were lucky to find 1 available. The staff is very nice. Our waiter was so lovely, checking on us but always very discreet

First time visit, impressed. Bookmarked on Google Maps to come back to. Dined this evening alone. Lovely, friendly and welcoming service by the staff, great atmosphere, tasty pizza and Tirimisu, quick arrival of food, nice interior aesthetics.

Only downside is the male toilets have no privacy. There are some ropes hanging down that separate the sinks and female toilets (closed doors), so you can see the men standing at urinals.

Overall, though, I’d recommend.

Great service and choice of food and wine. Genuine care and attention. All diners were paying by AMEX which inexplicably they dont accept. Toilets downstairs (mens) are also very strange with no real separation from the women's. Don't let this stop you from visiting though. Save room for desserts which were incredible.

name: Via Emilia by Food Roots - SHOREDITCH

reviews.text:
We booked this place for Valentine’s Day and although that time didn’t work out and we didn’t end up dining there, we were invited to come back another time - which ended up being a fantastic experience. The gentleman in charge of our table was attentive and personable, and the food was delicious and felt homemade in the best way.

Highly recommend the Gnocco Fritto bread with the spreadable cheese and charcuterie board starter.

For pastas, the cacio r Pepe was a standout but the spinach ricotta ravioli was a little dry.

I will definitely be back to try more of their dishes!

Back in November I went to dinner here with my friends, we were only in town a few days for a concert and so glad we found this place. All of the food was delicious with great presentation. I’m leaving this review now because months later we were looking back on our trip and got to talking about how great our server Janine was, she knew the menu well and gave us great recommendations, and she was extremely kind and hospitable. I hope one day we can come back.

Booked for a date night and it was incredible!
Friendly service, incredible food, lovely setting.

We had the gnocco fritto paired with cheese which is definitely a must try.

The pasta was incredible, rich, chewy and flavourful. Could not have been better.

We had the tiramisu for dessert too, once again 10/10!

Would highly recommend for romantic evening!

We stopped in for a glass of Lambrusco and some gnocco fritto, and it was an absolute dream from start to finish. Via Emilia is the perfect spot, whether you’re looking for a romantic dinner or a cozy evening with friends.

The gnocco fritto with mortadella was a delicious, and the Lambrusco was served in the traditional style (on a ceramic bowl), which made everything feel wonderfully authentic. The service was impeccable. Giulia took care of us and we couldn’t have asked for a better server, she explained the concept behind Via Emilia and its regional traditions, which made us feel more immersed in the experience. Her warmth, attentiveness, and understanding of the cuisine added a special touch to our evening. She made us feel as if we were in Italy.

We left completely happy and are looking forward to our next visit!

Wow! What an immersive and beautiful eating experience. As recommended, we started with the Gnocco Frito, with Mortadella ham. We shared two dishes of pasta however could have certainly ordered another to mix it up a little more. It was so insightful, and we learned so much about the owners past and journey from Emilia. Thank you!

Absolutely delicious food!! great little spot to go as a group — the atmosphere was perfect for a catch up with friends! great service and the pastas were perfection 🤩 we also tried the tiramisu-choux which was their take on tiramisu and choux bun — it was a nice touch but perhaps not something to die for! will definitely be going back!! •ᴗ•

We went to this restaurant for an early Saturday dinner and had a carbonara, prawn linguine and fritto misto- all delicious! Prices are very reasonable especially for central London- in fact cheaper than Italian restaurants I have been in other cities. Also very modern, pretty and ideal if you are looking for a quiet place to eat. The only downside was that the main pasta portions were small, but the low prices compensate for that. I would definitely return !

Visited Noci for brunch and was impressed by the friendly, efficient service. The pasta was fresh and full of flavour, with the beef ragu standing out as a highlight. The spritz options on the bottomless menu were enjoyable, though a touch light on alcohol for my personal taste. Overall, a pleasant experience with quality food and welcoming staff.

This is a nice restaurant with some very well cooked pasta dishes. My husband had the Carbonara which he really enjoyed but it came with a raw egg yolk on the plate which wasn't his favorite part and I had the Ragu which was extremely rich yet kind of on the sweet side and I was expecting something far more savory. The texture of the pasta was perfect and we enjoyed the flavours of the seafood in the Frito Misto.

I recently tried the carbonara and ragu pasta here, and both were absolutely delicious! The carbonara was perfectly creamy with just the right balance of richness and flavor, while the ragu had that deep, slow-cooked taste that makes every bite comforting and satisfying. But the real star of the meal was the arancini! crispy on the outside, perfectly golden, and bursting with flavor inside. It’s a must-try! If you come here, don’t leave without ordering the arancini.. you won’t regret it

name: Padella Shoreditch
address: Padella, Shoreditch, 1 Phipp St, London EC2A 4PS, UK

reviews.text:
The pasta at Padella was so good and definitely lives up to the hype! The portions are small though so worth ordering a few pastas and sharing.

The bruchetta and buratta were good too!

My only qualm was that they don’t stock coke, they have their own cola which I didn’t like - but that’s just personal preference.

The food is tasty and the portion sizes were quite generous! Definitely a bigger portion size than I expected. Between two people, 3 different pasta dishes would be a bit too much. Great value though! The starters were great and for the pasta, lots of people rave about the beef shin ragu which was tasty but didn’t blow my socks off. My favourite was probably the Gorgonzola pasta.

Great food, service and atmosphere. Couldn’t have picked a better place for lunch. The pasta was delicious. At the price, I would order 3 plates between 2 as the portions are on the smaller side. Really friendly waiters. Definitely stop by.

Sat at the counter on a busy midweek evening and watched dish after dish fly out of the kitchen, fast, focused and faultless.

Despite the pace, every plate landed with real care and precision.

The anchovies with butter and sourdough were exceptional, the tagliarini with Dorset crab beautifully balanced with just the right amount of heat, and the tiramisu a proper, no-gimmicks finish.

Confident Italian cooking done simply and exceptionally well.

Amazing food in a restaurant that has the vibe of an Osteria. Not a huge wine drinker but enjoyed the Italian white wine, but the star were of course the pasta and the burrata. Will definitely be back

Absolutely outstanding Lunch experience! The staff are wonderfully warm and make you feel instantly at home. The Lasagna Al Forno was exceptionally fresh, the Spaghetti di Mare was full of flavor, and the coffee—especially with the oat milk option—was rich and satisfying. Both the Panna Cotta and Tiramisu were perfectly done. A special shoutout to NAZ, who was incredibly welcoming, professional, friendly and attentive. Truly excellent all around!

Sandy is an absolute delight! The food was phenomenal but the service even better! Going to save as our new favourite local! Thanks so much!! And I lost my scarf and they came and found me and brought it to me - this is just amazing! Thank you again!!!
Brilliant Italian spot, excellent food and atmosphere, really cosy and welcoming. Service from everyone was 10/10, manager Sandy was lovely. Highly recommend for an Italian spot around Hackney.

Another great meal at Bella Vita in Broadway Market in Hackney. I had the vegetarian pizza pastore which includes two high-protein cheeses, making it worth the money. It was served by the friendly smiling Naz. She attended to my every need, magically only appearing just when I needed her!

Disappointed by the brunch, it looked very nice, but my eggs Benedict were quite average: too much salmon, too much sauce, and I couldn’t really taste of a real hollandaise sauce. The vegetarian English breakfast was okay. Super friendly staff and a clean restaurant though!

We came without booking at New Year’s Eve and although there were lots of reservations and people, he made an effort to welcome us and find a table. The food was amazing, unique taste of common known Italian meals. The portions are relatively small but worth trying it. Idk if it was because of that special night but we had to wait a lot for the food and even for the bill at the end- the service could have been better and more efficient but I think the staff were really trying their best that night. Overall absolutely recommended.

Terra Rossa Italian Restaurant – A Hidden Gem with Great Food

Terra Rossa is truly a hidden-place restaurant, tucked away but well worth the walk. You can easily walk there, and although cars and motorbikes can access the area, the restaurant itself gets quite crowded, especially during peak hours. If you’re visiting with a group, I’d strongly recommend making a reservation in advance. I was lucky to get a walk-in table.

The atmosphere is warm and lively, with beautiful décor and a cozy Italian feel that makes the place inviting for both families and friends.

The food choices are excellent, and instead of spending too much time on the menu, I asked the waiter for recommendations—which turned out to be a great decision. The dishes were well presented and full of flavor. My son really enjoyed the ravioli and his pizza, and the portions were perfect for him. I’m not entirely sure what my dish was called, but it was rich, comforting, and very satisfying.

One small flaw I noticed was that there were some chipped or broken dishes used on the serving table. I’m not sure if this is part of the restaurant’s style, but personally, I prefer clean, intact dishes, especially when dining with a child. For me, it’s mainly about safety and hygiene, and this is something the restaurant could easily improve.

Overall, Terra Rossa offers great food, friendly service, and a lively atmosphere. With a little more attention to tableware details, it would be an even better dining experience. I’d still happily return—and next time, I’ll be sure to book ahead.

Terra Rossa is a cozy and friendly Italian restaurant with a relaxed atmosphere. The three of us ordered carpaccio, burrata salad, a Capricciosa pizza, ravioli, and two coffees. Everything arrived quickly, and all the dishes were fresh and genuinely delicious.

We paid £85 in total, which felt like very good value for the quality and portion sizes.

A small detail that actually made us smile – some of the plates had slightly chipped edges. It didn’t bother us at all; if anything, it added a bit of rustic charm and authenticity to the experience.

Definitely a place we would return to.

Terra Rossa in London is a truly stylish Italian restaurant that delivers an exceptional dining experience from start to finish. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, infused with a delightful Italian aroma that instantly sets the stage for an evening of elegance and comfort. Their authentic pizzas are outstanding—thin, crisp, and topped with creative, flavorful combinations that showcase both tradition and innovation. The salads are equally impressive, bursting with freshness and perfectly balanced flavors that complement the meal beautifully. To end on a high note, the chocolate soufflé is simply unforgettable—light, delicate, and deeply satisfying. Paired with attentive, professional service and an intelligently curated wine selection, Terra Rossa stands out as a secret for anyone seeking a refined yet genuinely Italian culinary experience in London.

We enjoyed a wonderful dinner at Terra Rossa on 20 November. The seafood risotto was perfection, the focaccia beautifully springy, and the wine excellent. A special thank you to Marco, our waiter, who was professional and full of warmth. Someone in our group who is Italian expressed how good the food was – high praise indeed. As a lover of Italian food, it was among the best I’ve had in London, and even in Italy. The atmosphere was great too: cosy, and alive with the buzz of everyone enjoying themselves, yet never too noisy. Grazie mille – we had a fantastic time!

A restaurant rarely nails the aesthetics this well. The location, the decor, even the crockery everything is picture perfect. And the staff? So friendly and attentive and not to miss the sleeping cat 😬

The food was a bit of a surprise though. The gnudi was delicious, but both pasta dishes were under salted and we had to send the ragu back as the pasta was so overcooked it had clearly been to Italy and back. Maybe the kitchen was just having a busy day.

That said, I really liked the place. You almost forget you are in London. I will return and hopefully next time the food will be the talking point rather than the supporting cast.

Love this spot - the food is divine, the service is amazing and the vibe is cozy and homey. We loved the grilled calamari, the seafood pasta and the pasta with ragù. The tiramisu is out of this world. Lovely staff, and beautiful ambiance. Will definitely be back!

From the moment you step through the wooden doors of Campania, it feels like you’ve left London behind and walked straight into a rustic trattoria somewhere in southern Italy. The atmosphere is effortlessly charming ,warm brick walls, wooden tables, and the comforting hum of a place that feels lived in and loved.

I had the paccheri with mussels, and it was absolutely divine: the sauce rich and full of flavour, perfectly balanced with sweetness from the tomatoes and a touch of the sea from the mussels. It tasted like something your Italian nonna would make on a Sunday afternoon. Paired with a chilled glass of natural wine, it was perfection.

What makes Campania even more special is its soul, from the friendly staff to the little cat lounging quietly in a corner, every detail adds to its homely magic. It’s the kind of place that makes you slow down, savour, and smile.

If you’re looking for a spot that feels authentic, comforting, and just a little bit timeless — Campania is pure Italian poetry. 🇮🇹❤️

Super cozy spot, with amazing service, and excellent homemade food. We tried the calamari, the risotto and the ragu pasta and everything was 10/10. Staff super attentive and friendly. Would go back/recommend to anyone!

I visited with friends just before Xmas. Great atmosphere, food was ok - I had high expectations but while Ragu was very good, the pasta itself was undercooked (no, not intentionally) and the platter we ordered as a starter was just ok. They also forgot the negroni I ordered first. Still worth a visit, great atmosphere, lovely staff.

Visited on a Sunday evening and really enjoyed the atmosphere. Warm, intimate, and relaxed with no wait, though seating was limited.

The focaccia with house made ricotta was phenomenal. Very fresh and beautifully done. The steamed mussels were tender with just the right amount of kick. We also had the 3g truffle tagliatelle. Fresh pasta and well cooked, though the truffle flavour was quite delicate.

The ribeye was okay, but arrived less hot and tender than expected, and surprisingly there were no steak knives. The broccoli was a great accompaniment.

Service was fine once seated, though the host could have been more accommodating. Overall, a lovely spot with great starters, pasta, and ambiance. Would happily return.

We started with the ricotta, which was wonderfully fresh and light. The citrus and fennel notes came through beautifully. Paired with fragrant olive oil and focaccia that was crisp on the outside and soft inside, it was a simple but very satisfying opener.

The crab tonnarelli was more complex. On the first bite, the crab came across a little too fishy for my taste. But after a second bite, the dish really brings the slight acidity and peppery kick balanced the crab much better, while the rich, creamy, cheesy note

The fazzoletti with duck ragù was the standout of the evening and the one I kept thinking about afterwards. The duck flavor was deep and luxurious, with a beautiful balance between savory richness and a subtle sweetness. Comforting, elegant, and incredibly memorable.

We also ordered the Creedy Carver duck, which was another highlight. The aroma was excellent, and the slightly salty sauce worked well with the meat. The duck was remarkably tender, and what surprised me most was how generous the portion was. A very satisfying dish that felt both refined and hearty.

We were too full for dessert, but honestly, that just gives us a great reason to come back

We ordered three different pasta dishes and every single one was outstanding. Truly hard to pick a favourite. I’d highly recommend ordering a fresh salad in between as a palate resetter - it made the experience even better. The white truffle pasta was wild in the best possible way, and the ricotta was unbelievably fresh and beautifully done. Excellent wine list with great choices to match the food. The atmosphere is warm and lively, and the service was genuinely friendly and welcoming throughout. A fantastic dining experience all around - will definitely be back! Oh and nduja mussels - omg.

Very delicious! We went for dinner on a Monday night and it was packed, every seat was taken, even downstairs. We made reservations in advance thankfully. We ordered the duck liver parfait, housemade ricotta w/foccacia, fried olive, raw Artichoke salad and for pastas the crab toranelli and parpardelle. Loved everything, or fave was the duck liver! Highly recommend

We visited Manteca with my family after seeing the very positive reviews on Google. Unfortunately, I can’t say it fully lived up to our expectations.

The ricotta and artichoke starter was genuinely good and nicely prepared. However, we were quite disappointed with the cacio e pepe we ordered as a main the crab (fishy) flavour was unexpectedly strong and a bit overwhelming for us. On a more positive note, my wife really enjoyed the kale pasta she ordered.

The restaurant itself was extremely busy and quite noisy, to the point where it was difficult to have a proper conversation at the table. That said, the staff were friendly, attentive and helpful throughout our visit, which we appreciated. Pricing was also on the high end side.

Overall, it wasn’t a bad experience, but considering the hype and reviews, it didn’t quite meet our expectations.

We came across this Italian restaurant while walking through Istanbul and decided to stop by spontaneously. The concept of the restaurant is quite nice, with a pleasant atmosphere that immediately draws you in and makes you feel comfortable. The interior and overall vibe definitely set good expectations.

As I’m vegetarian, I ordered a white mushroom dish along with burrata, while my wife chose a pasta dish that included meat. Unfortunately, the food didn’t fully meet my expectations. I’m quite sensitive when it comes to smells and flavours, and my pasta was served with an egg on top. The egg aroma spread throughout the dish, which I personally didn’t enjoy at all. This is more a matter of my own taste rather than the restaurant’s fault. I also realised afterward that I may not have read the menu carefully enough, as I didn’t expect the egg to be included.

Because of this, the pasta wasn’t a “wow” experience for me, and overall I’d rate the food around three stars. That said, the quality may be perfectly fine for others with different preferences.

On a very positive note, the staff were absolutely lovely—friendly, attentive, and welcoming—which made the experience much more pleasant. For the service and ambiance, they truly deserve praise.

I visited this restaurant with a few friends, excited to try some authentic Italian food. The restaurant itself is very pretty and cozy, creating a lovely atmosphere for dinner. We booked a table in advance, which I would definitely recommend, as it was quite busy even on a Tuesday evening.

The service was attentive and friendly, checking in regularly without being intrusive. To start, we each ordered a cocktail, which was unfortunately a bit disappointing as they tasted more like fruit juice than a balanced cocktail.

For starters, we had the crispy parma parcel and some bread. Both were tasty, fresh, and clearly homemade. For mains, we shared a mix of the mushroom pasta, cacio e pepe, and amatriciana. All three dishes were delicious and full of flavour. However, the portion sizes were quite small and felt more like a primi course rather than a main dish, ideally followed by a meat/ second course.

For dessert, we tried the cheesecake and the chocolate mousse. Both were nice but not particularly memorable.

The total bill came to around £170 for three people, which included a few drinks, three mains, two starters, and two desserts. Overall, it’s not a cheap place to eat. I would come back because the food quality is good, but the portion sizes are a bit of an issue as you may need to order more, which increases the overall cost.
Food was absolutely amazing! Smaller dish size than you’d expect but perfect for us. Food was out super quick and the staff were really attentive! Highly recommend

Noci is an attractive space, but the meal felt oddly imbalanced, and the kitchen’s rigidity - including the claim that they “don’t have vegetables” - was genuinely baffling.

The endive salad was visually detailed and intriguing at first, with grape in tiny, meticulously cut pieces - seemingly just the tops. I’m not a stranger to bitterness, but here it intensified with every bite until it almost became too much.

I then ordered the sea bass with mushrooms and a celeriac purée containing dairy. I asked for the purée to be removed and replaced with any vegetables. They said they could remove it, but couldn’t replace it, because they “don’t have vegetables”.

When the fish arrived, the skin was impressively crisp, the tarragon oil was beautiful and the mushrooms were lovely. But the fish was so heavily salted that I couldn’t eat it. I ended up sitting there with an untouched plate, staring into the void, wondering what kind of restaurant can’t serve vegetables.

To the waiter’s credit, she noticed, asked if I was okay, and said no problem - she brought me a salad. It helped, but it was still added to the bill.

In the end I went home hungry and cooked dinner.

Incredible food, great atmosphere, and most importantly- out of this world service! Sara made our whole evening and really made us feel so welcome!

The food, desserts and wine were delicious! Pasta perfectly al dente with a symphony of flavour. We will definitely be coming back!!!

The restaurant is located downstairs from a hotel and has a very elegant, well-kept atmosphere. The staff were neat, well-presented, and professional.
The table setting was beautifully arranged, like something from a grand British banquet. I happened to see them preparing a reserved table for some guests, and it was impressive how carefully and precisely they did it.
Beyond the lovely setting, the food was tasty and well-made, and the staff were polite and attentive. The dessert was decent, though it could have been a bit richer in flavour.
Note that a service charge is added to the bill.
Overall, it was a pleasant dining experience in a refined and classy environment.

Last night I dined at a wonderful Italian restaurant in London. We had lasagna and Bauletti al Stracotto (beef braised in red wine). Both were superb rich, deeply flavorful, with tender beef and a luxurious sauce. The interior is beautiful stylish, warm, and inviting. It was quite busy, so the service was a bit hectic with staff constantly on the move, which faded the calm a little, but the team were exceptionally kind and attentive.
