Overall, a fantastic experience highly recommended for classic Italian cuisine in a vibrant setting.🥹

We went there to celebrate my birthday and had mixed feelings about the overall experience. The food wasn’t bad, but nothing really stood out as exceptional.

The service felt a bit slow, which was slightly disappointing. However, for my birthday, they dimmed the lights and the entire staff came over to sing Happy Birthday. It was a little embarrassing for me, but I truly appreciated the sweet gesture.

I had the gnocchi, which I would recommend.

My team and I went here for a team dinner and we had an amazing time. The host was very accommodating and greeted us with a smile. Pranil served us during our visit and he was very attentive in filling our water and polite. I had pork and it was the one of the best porks I’ve ever had. It was so tender and melts in your mouth. The tiramisu was one of the best I’ve had as well. We were very pleased with overall experience. Will highly recommend!

One of the best meals on our 16 day, five city holiday. We did not have a reservation on a Friday night, but they accommodated us anyway and seated us quickly. Outstanding service, delicious food, and friendly staff. Great wine selection. Reasonable prices. Our servers, Adi and Adi N., were both attentive and helpful. We started with the tasty Insalata allá Parmigiana and a garlic focaccia, with the exceptionally good Bauletti al Stracotto e Barolo - braised beef ravioli! Adi recommended the Panna Cotta al Pistachio, and he was not wrong. It was heavenly!

This restaurant is truly outstanding. The atmosphere is warm and cozy, very much like a traditional Italian restaurant. The staff are exceptionally kind and attentive, and the level of customer service is excellent throughout the entire experience. The owner personally took our order and was incredibly welcoming, offering thoughtful recommendations that helped us choose the best options. We ordered the spaghetti con ragù and a pizza funghi, and both dishes were exceptional. The flavors were authentic and truly reflective of genuine Italian cuisine. This is a place I would happily return to many times and confidently recommend to others. I am also very much looking forward to trying more of their dishes in the future, as the quality and authenticity of the food were truly impressive.

Well this was a pleasant surprise. From the outside it doesn’t so special, and in fact once you’re in it still doesn’t scream sexy vibes. But, the food was fantastic.

The staff don’t speak a word of English. We had to order using numbers in the menu. But they were friendly enough.

The food was super tasty, fresh and hot, everything you want from an Italian restaurant.

This place isn’t going to be earning a Michelin star but that’s OK. It does very well as a quick eatery.

Great value and good food. B+

W‏e had such a wonderful experience! The food was delicious, especially the spaghetti and the Gamberi fritti, we loved them so much that we came back for them more than once. The owner is extremely kind and so are all the staff, very polite and welcoming. The place is clean, calm, and comfortable. We’ll definitely visit again many times. Everything was excellent and we’re very satisfied with both the food and the service.

Really disappointing experience. The restaurant was nearly empty, yet we constantly had to wave the waitress down for basic service. She also gave us completely wrong information about a dish when we asked about it, which is unacceptable. The pizza was mediocre at best, the truffle mushroom pizza had no flavour, and the cacio e pepe came out plain with barely any cheese (literally no sauce whatsoever). For the prices, this was not worth it at all. It is very surprising to see that this place is rated a 4.7 out of 5 which is completely misleading.

The place was amazing.

We ordered a pizza (pepperoni campagna) to share for 2 and a main couse (spaguetti carbonara). We were not expecting both the quality and the atmosphere of this restaurant.

The pizza was so tasty, made right in the moment in a tradicional oven, and the pasta was the REAL recipe of an italian carbonara.

You will see the photos and could think that it is good, but i truly recommend to try It because It is more than perfect.

Also, It is not pricey at all and it totally worths it.

Also, i would like to highlight the attention. Everyone was so kind and respectful, and the really made it making you feel at home.

Thank you!!

Great food, I had the seafood pasta and a small pizza. Both very good. Expresso to complete a very relaxing lunch.

One good thing of note, and always a good measure of a great restaurant is that the waiter will check your wine glass for cleanliness before pouring. Also, if you have a refill of a glass of wine (house wine) the waiter will provide a new clean glass.

Fantastic! I will definitely come again.

While its menu takes a few delightful detours from strictly Apulian cuisine (the bigoli, for instance, are a Venetian treat), Apulia serves up genuinely good food. Do not miss the orecchiette with ragu—it's excellent. For dessert, the fresh zeppole and the tiramisu make for a perfect finish.

The restaurant was packed on a Tuesday night so definitely they are well known and the food was good, the starter came real quick however the mains took 25-35 minutes looks like they forgot to mains away our table which they did later after chasing the waiter, overall good experience.
Four star for food & service.

Remember the scene in Ratatouille where critic Anton Ego is transported by the taste of a simple dish? I had a similar experience at Apulia, but this time it was pizza.

The Quattro Stagioni was the perfect blend of artichokes, ham, mushrooms, and olives but it was the base that made this such a memorable meal.

The atmosphere added to an excellent evening in homely surroundings in the former Barley Mow Tavern, opposite Smithfield market.

Other highlights included exceptional wine and one of THE best cappuccinos.

As Anton said in his sign off, “I will be returning soon, hungry for more.”

While in London for a reunion, I had dinner for 1, on my own. Food and service, so professional and knowledgeable. Perfect.
So when my friends wanted a farewell lunch with 24 hrs notice on a Sunday, I tried this place. Well, it couldn't have been better. The waitress was brilliant. We could get in no problem, clear communication, confirmed booking, discussed seating time,  setting and numbers so helpful, and knew how to take a large group photo! Orders were correct delicious, all drinks, wine, not one complaint!
If you have a large group last minute, this is the place is for you. Great food, great service 👍
Didn't love the starts but the mains were delicious. We had the prawn pasta and chicken which were both really good. The wine was lovely too. And you cannot fault the service, they were excellent 👌

I recently celebrated my 30th birthday here, and I can honestly say it was one of the best experiences I could have asked for.From start to finish, everything was exceptional. The food was absolutely outstanding, beautifully presented and full of flavour, and every single guest commented on how incredible their dishes were. The service was seamless, attentive, and warm without ever feeling intrusive. The team made us feel genuinely looked after throughout the entire evening.Planning a milestone celebration can be stressful, but the staff handled everything with professionalism and care, allowing me to truly relax and enjoy the moment. The atmosphere was elegant, welcoming, and perfect for such a special occasion.Thank you for making my 30th birthday so memorable. I will always look back on that evening with so much joy, and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend this restaurant for anyone celebrating something special.

Updated: Rating Adjusted Based on Management's Excellent Follow-up

Thank you to General Manager Adam for his personal response and sincere apology. He offered no excuses for the service lapses (two water spills) and billing error, assured that the team has been briefed, and proactively arranged a refund for the overcharged £5.

While the initial experience was disappointing, a restaurant's true value is shown not only in its food but also in how it handles mistakes. Adam demonstrated top-tier customer service in damage control, and this responsible attitude is highly commendable, making me believe they are committed to improvement.

I must reiterate that the food was truly excellent, and the steak was cooked to a perfect medium-rare. In recognition of management's sincere efforts to address the issues, I have decided to raise my rating to 4 stars. I hope future guests will have a more consistently perfect experience.

Good food but Bad experience.

Spillage for once is acceptable, spillage for twice without apology is unacceptable.

First time the waitress spilled the whole glass of water on me and my crotch was all wet:) fine, it happens and I can give allowance.

Almost finish meal, nice that you top up some water but spilled on the floor with splashing to me legs you thought I didn’t know? And didn’t say anything and go away.  Then this was not so okay.  I don’t want to give you hard time so I chose to write here.

Plus the bill is not so right.  I don’t drink alcoholic drinks so I ordered mocktail, asked your colleagues if mocktail also can enjoy 50% off and he asked n came back to say yes, only except the luxury serves.  My bad i didn’t ask when receiving the bill, my passion crush is full price?

Food was really good, steak was so nice and really did it at medium rare.

But I would only rate 2 stars for the above experience

Second visit here now. The pork chop is incredible. Perfectly cooked. Juicy, lots of flavour and a big slab of meat. I had their hispi cabbage and charred broccoli on side and it compliments it beautifully. Great for a client lunch. My colleagues at my last visit really enjoyed the beef shin Ragu.
Nice Italian, and im fussy.  Very nice food, the Sommelier was quite grumpy.  Apart from them adding cheese in the kitchen rather then at the table,  my partner doest like cheese!

name: AL DENTE Monument
address: Unit 2, Providian House, 16-18 Monument St, London EC3R 8AJ, UK

reviews.text:
It’s a cute little Italian just tucked in the corner behind a pub. The staff are friendly and helpful. It has a small sit in area but is mostly used for take away, there are lots of drivers picking up food.

The food was nice filling and cheesy it just felt like it was missing a little something. We had the aubergine parmigiana and the squash parcels which were a little too salty for my taste I think from the cheese.

We had an Italian hot chocolate as well which was really nice creamy with a depth of flavour without being too sweet or heavy.

For me personally the music was a little too loud in the small space.
A really fabulous pasta bar in a great if unsophisticated location. £15 pasta and wine combo is great value. Very quick, great service, and very consistent!
This place is a gem! Amazing pasta , excellent service and great atmosphere!    Definitely the right place if you want an authentic pasta and very good on the go! Highly recommend
Lovely tiny Italian place! food was pretty good with generous serving. The server was busy but he  was still nice and polite to all guests ☺️

Small lunch place, part of wider chain. The Al Dente chain are very good for cooking GF pasta safely and with minimum risk of cross contamination.

Are at this location recently and the staff were very knowledgeable and able to provide comfort that the food would be cooked to the best of their ability without CC. As a celiac this was very helpful to have. I had a great carbonara, and will definitely be coming back again.

My only suggestion would be to include a marker for the food when it comes out to guarantee that the plate is GF. Me and my friend both got the same dish (one normal, one GF) and it was honestly very difficult to spot the difference! A flag or label would just help avoid any last minute worries.

Popped into this place last Friday (early march) and had no booking. It was bus but managed to get a seat at the bar.

I had toast with pate to start and a vegetarian main. Think it was sweet potato with pecorino over the top. Something like that. Both dishes were delicious and left me wanting more so I ordered tiramisu for dessert. Equally yummy.

The foods clearly great here but what I liked most was the atmosphere and the vibe.

It’s dimly lit and still vibrant. Noisy but in a good way. Staff are vigilant and quick.

Wine was also good!

I loved my meal here and I’m 100% going to go back. Probably more than once.

Lovely dimly lit environment in a trattoria setting and creative Italian dishes. I recommend a split and share action to try all the unique flavors. The dough balls (so simple yet a great combination) and the lenony rabbit pappardelle were musts. Don’t skip some rounds of the unbeatable 5 pound negronis and spritzes.

Went here for my mums birthday, the atmosphere and restaurant itself was lovely. The staff were super friendly, I’ve already recommended to my friends. Authentic Italian restaurant. Personally I had the Mushroom Ragu and it was loved I love how you receive your own dish of Parmesan. Can’t beat £5 negronis. Red wine was lush as well as the tiramisu.
Definitely should book in advance but I know they have space on the bar for walk ins

A birthday treat like no other, here is a wondorous place to eat, perfect setting and the young lady who served us ( Anna)  absolute respect.
So the food, a perfect range of starters with a superb menu to back it up. Each dish that arrived was perfect.
Now I'm not a big desert fan, but and its a huge one  order the tirmasu  it's bloody brilliant.
Overall this deserves to be in your book of places to eat.
Great food, brilliant staff.
Will we go back, not half.
Oh and buy the book of the recipes to.
Overall loved it. Thank you Bruto

We have wanted to try for ages and we are glad to did.
We ordered a mix of starters , pasta and mains to share.

The rabbit pappardelle and beef main were probably our favourite dishes.

Also £5 negronis are not to be missed.

I really enjoyed the vibe, even from the outside, which is what prompted me to come and try Popolo. I just walked past and thought it looked super cosy and had a great looking menu. The kitchen is right there and I really enjoyed being able to see how the staff manage to create some simple but beautiful food. Can't go wrong with any of the dishes and it all made for a very lovely evening. They recommend 5-6 of the dishes if you are sharing between 2 people, we had 5 and that was a good amount. Thank you Popolo

The space is cosy. The menu focuses on sharing plates and handmade pasta. Most of the dishes we tried were packed with flavour, simple ingredients, but done really well. Prices aren’t cheap, but the quality makes them reasonable, especially for a central London spot. Overall, it’s a great place for casual Italian food with personality. Perfect for a date night or dinner with friends if you don’t mind the lively atmosphere.

Popolo is a Shoreditch standout that delivers on every front. The food is consistently excellent, and the sharing-plate format works perfectly thanks to the well-timed pacing of the service. While there are tables, it is definitely best to sit at the bar; you get a front-row seat to watch the chefs work, yet it still feels social and intimate.

The agnolotti was the standout dish of the night—perfectly executed and a must-order. To top it off, the staff are attentive, and the drinks menu is good, featuring a nice natural wine list and tasty cocktails. Recommended for a high-quality, relaxed meal.

We went to Popolo because it was recommended in the local Michelin guide. The food and service was good, but we would not come back a second time, as we expected a bit more in this price range. Especially the size of the portions was a bit disappointing (£20 for 9 Gnocchi and £7.5 for 3 slices of Focaccia).
Our first time here. Amazing. Carr and attention taken to every dish. Very warm and welcoming. Dishes were superb.

A fantastic spot under the arches, tucked away. Cozy vibe with low lighting.
The pizzas were absolutely delicious - great portions, well prepared, and super tasty!
I chose the White Goat and couldn’t have chosen better. There’s also the option to have a gluten-free base.

The staff were incredibly friendly, accommodating, and approachable. I initially booked a table for 7 people and later had to add 3 more seats. I called in the evening, and they always answered and were happy to accommodate us. Highly recommend!

Visiting from Chicago… a pretty snobby pizza city. Excellent long fermentation sourdough pizza. We shared the Wicker Man, Green Salad, and Churros. Kernel table beer was excellent pairing. Loved the vibe of this place! Highly recommend.

I love the Sodo group. The food is always exceptional, great atmosphere whether you’re in a large group or by yourself. I had a wonderful experience last night in Bethnal Green, very relaxed. The highlight from last night was my server Greta, just made me feel welcome. Hard to find that in London when you dine on your own.

Always great pizza, it’s definitely the best in London. Gorgeous crust, lovely tomato, crisp base with fluffy crusts. You can taste it all. Perfect seasoning too.

You can always judge a place on how good the margherita is, and it’s fab!!! Lovely staff too!

Miss the salad, rain go away so it can grow!

Great food and lovely customer service. I had the white goat pizza and really enjoyed it- if you like a combination of sweet/savoury foods definitely check it out. The crust was light and the pizza was served fresh and hot. Service was quick and all the employees were very friendly and polite. The ambiance was lovely and cozy. Definitely worth a visit.

name: Luca
address: 88 St John St, London EC1M 4EH, UK

reviews.text: The parmesan fries were out of the world. We ordered 2 pastas - ravioli with prawn etc and (I think) tortelli with duck, both were amazing. Lovely vibes, helpful staffs, prices are decent for the quality in London.

An Italian gem in London!
Outstanding food!
The dining room is so beautiful particularly in the evening.
Food was superb! Parmesan fries were a delight!
We also had the John Dory which was absolutely incredible!
If you love a Lemon tart, come to Luca. The tastiest lemon tart I’ve had in a while - accompanied by the most stunning fennel ice cream!!!

We went there with my son and mum for a Birthday lunch. It was ok. It was tasty, but nothing to write home about. It was 3 of us, so we were lucky we were able to share all the dishes, as some of them were really underwhelming,  especially the bowl of pasta for a starter and the massive leaves of red cabbage that seem to appear in many dishes. Service was ok. I was surprised we weren't offered the drinks menu, untill we specifically asked for it. It was my son's birthday so we have received some extra dessert items, which was a really nice touch. The highlight was the bread with olive oil, that we order to start with, it was really delicious.
Warm and cosy vibe. Nice wait staff. Food was excellent - still thinking about those Parmesan fries. The cappelletti a highlight - would recommend - worth its star

Great foods - suggest that for a party of 2, 2 x starters and 2 x primi is sufficient. We ordered the venison as well but ended up being too much.

Service was… meh. Food came out slow and is not attentive to 1-star level.

Good atmosphere on a quiet street

🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗
Absolutely loved my experience at Piazza Italiana!

From the moment I walked in, I felt like I’d stepped right into Italy. The atmosphere is cozy and elegant, with beautiful decor and soft music that makes you want to stay all night. The staff were so welcoming and attentive — they really made me feel looked after without being overbearing.

The food was incredible. You can tell everything is made with care and top-quality ingredients. I had the truffle pasta and it was honestly one of the best I’ve ever had, and the flavours were just perfect. The tiramisu was the perfect ending — light, creamy, and absolutely delicious.

It’s rare to find a place that gets everything right — great service, amazing food, and a lovely atmosphere — but Piazza Italiana does it effortlessly. I can’t wait to go back!

Great service! Radka was really sweet, she helped us decide what drinks to choose and told us what she liked on the menu. The food was delicious and the atmosphere was really nice. There was some live music from a dj and because of the high ceilings the restaurant felt really open and comfortable. I would definitely come here again!

There are places you visit… and there are places that truly capture your heart. Piazza Italiana is the latter.

From the moment we stepped inside, we were surrounded by breathtaking architecture and the most elegant decor. The grand ceilings, the beautiful detailing, the soft lighting — everything feels romantic, luxurious, and timeless. It’s the kind of setting that makes you slow down, look around, and simply admire the beauty of the space.

The food was just as unforgettable. Every dish was crafted with such care and authenticity, full of rich Italian flavors that felt both comforting and refined. Each bite felt like a love letter to Italy.

And the service made the evening even more special — attentive, warm, and genuinely kind without ever being intrusive. We felt welcomed, valued, and completely taken care of.

Piazza Italiana isn’t just a restaurant; it’s an experience filled with beauty, flavor, and romance. I left already dreaming about my next visit.
The food was very tasty and authentic. The staff did also a great job. The interior of this place is insane. Definitely worth a visit!
Everything was perfect! The food was delicious. Our waitress Radka provided us with excellent service that was very personal and caring. The venue was also beautiful and atmospheric.

They have a couple of pasta dishes with great taste awards, a lot of options to choose from and you can change the pasta option if you don’t like the default choice.

The homemade tiramisu was so good I bought two more, one to enjoy at home and another for my friend. He couldn’t believe how good it was either 😳

The staff are super friendly and great at recommendations, Michu was lovely!

We tried a sample of the delicious fresh Pesto Rigatoni, and then had to get a full portion of pasta each. All of the pasta is excellent. We had the Tuscan Sausage Rigatoni and the Mushroom Cream Pappardelle. Both were superb - full of flavour, perfectly al dente, large portions, good prices. The fennel and rosemary came through beautifully in the Sausage Rigatoni. The mushrooms were plentiful and so delicious in the pappardelle They have several Great Taste awards, which is always a good indicator. Italian food is our favourite and we’ve spent a lot of time there having home-cooked Italian food - this was like that, but with even more sauce and portion sizes! The owner and the server were very friendly and welcoming. The owner very kindly got an extra table and chairs out to accommodate us while we ate. I highly recommend Chi Chi & The Posta Family and i look forward to returning, as I work in the area!

Tried this pasta truck at Spitalfields with a friend and it was really good. The pasta was fresh, hot, and full of flavour. I had the mushroom and cream pappardelle, and my friend got the pomodoro rigatoni, both were delicious. Quick service and really nice people too. Would definitely go again

Guys if you are in Liverpool Street please check this place in the heart of Spitalfields market. Amazing pasta dishes with great variety and delicious flavour. The almond tiramisu desert is a must to had to your meal.
Francesco de owner has a lovely personality very energetic and the passion is shown on all the dishes served.

Please check it out, you will not be disappointed!

The best pasta place in Spitalfields, absolutely full of flavour. We had the beef ragù and the creamy mushroom pasta, and both were outstanding. The service from the owner was lovely  you can really tell he’s passionate about his cooking. I’ll definitely be coming back.

name: Zia Lucia - Aldgate East
address: Unit 1a, 12 Piazza Walk, London E1 8ZH, UK

reviews.text: Outstanding, authentic Italian pizza. Our server, Ivan, was very friendly and attentive. Made great recommendations. We ordered a margarita with regular crust and one with blackened crust. Both were delicious - I especially liked blackened because of how crispy and crackery it was. Good selection of drinks, and we ordered a tiramisu for dessert which honestly was one of the best I have ever had. Highly recommend!

I visited Zia Lucia Aldgate East in September 2025 specifically looking for a vegan special I’d heard about, but unfortunately, I couldn't find it on the menu at the time.
However, it was incredibly easy to customize a plant-based meal!

I ordered the Arrabbiata Vegetariana on their famous charcoal dough, simply asking for it without mozzarella.
It was absolutely delicious, the dough is a must-try.

My only recommendation would be for them to keep a dedicated vegan special on the permanent menu to make it easier for plant-based diners. That said, the staff makes it very easy to customize, so don't let the menu stop you!

Best Special pizza of ever; delicious tiramisù; nice artisanal beer.
Pizza chefs very professional and funny.
Dayan the manager amazing person; very professional

Had a fantastic experience at Zia Lucia! The pizzas are among the best I’ve had,  the dough is incredibly fresh, and the variety of bases makes it easy to find something you’ll love. The location is great too, with a warm and inviting atmosphere. The staff were super informative and helpful, especially since it was my first visit they took the time to explain the different options. Special shoutout to Dayan for the excellent service and friendly attitude. I’ll definitely be coming back!

Good pizza but the menu didn't even indicate which pizzas were vegetarian, which made the selection more difficult than it should have been. That's quite basic, I would have thought. The charcoal vegetable pizza dough was interesting. It's a bit pricey for just pizza, but I guess that's London prices.

We found this place for our first brekkie in London and I highly recommend it. A simple menu with enough choice to suit most people and very good coffee. The service is friendly and the atmosphere is cosy and modern. There’s plenty of seating too.
Went for dinner! Nice dim-lit place with modern but classy interior. Loved the spicy margarita pizza.

Decent food although nothing special. Mussels were cooked with a lot of bacon and butter, the flavour of which overtakes the mussels. Prawns didn't taste much. The raw materials used seems of mediocre quality.
Quiet environment. Attentive staff.

Interior and ambiance of this restaurant is unmatched. You can dress up or stay smart casual - great for date night. However the starters were the best meal of the night... I had the crab pasta, feel like it was dump of spaghetti, with MICRO pieces of crab. Tasted like pasta boiled in sea water with 3 cherry tomatoes. Fettuccine would of been better suited here, but I guess that could be my personal preference. Absolutely would not recommend. The duck ragu was okay, feel like it was overloaded with meat, ragu didn't have much depth of flavour, and no parmesan cheese offered. Had a scoop of salted caramel gelato, and that was meh too. Our waitress was attentive at first, but felt as though the service was average and nothing to make the experience memorable. She also seemed to be multitasking a lot, obviously not her fault if its a busy restaurant, but more staff would help in these situations. I wish the food was better, otherwise wouldn't come back here.

39 of us headed to Cecconi’s for our work Christmas party lunch in their private room, and it was the perfect space. The table setup was beautiful, and having a cloakroom was a great touch. Stephen and the team were fantastic - attentive and professional throughout. We loved the set sharing menu, which gave us the chance to try so many different dishes. The combination of privacy, beautiful aesthetics, excellent service, and delicious food made our celebration truly special. Highly recommend booking their private room!

name: Puppa Italian Restaurant
address: 68 Whitechapel High St, London E1 7PL, UK

reviews.text:
A lovely family-run Italian restaurant with a very warm atmosphere. Their pasta is genuinely delicious, especially the seafood pasta — fresh, well-seasoned, and clearly made with care.

I’ve visited twice and unfortunately they didn’t have the lobster pasta on those occasions, which I was really hoping to try. Hopefully next time! That said, everything else was excellent, and I would still highly recommend this place if you enjoy good Italian food.

I ate here last night and the food was lovely. I had the caprese followed by the lasagne and then tiramisu to finish. The bill was under £30 which is a real bargain for London. Just a shame I was the only person dining at the time as that impacted the at atmosphere.

Food was delicious still 👌

It has nothing to do with italian cuisine. The pasta was undercooked, not aldente, but undercooked. The chicken was boiled,  not slow cooked, i ate only some boiled patatoes, tasted awful, with traces of boiled blood (see pic). And the pizza crust was like eating cartboard. The waitress included the extra tip, although there was nothing to tip for, the food was still on the plates. Definitely i do not recomand the place.

Delicious authentic Italian food with a cozy atmosphere. The pasta was fresh, i  try the burger perfectly made and surprisingly great taste   and the tiramisu was a must-try. Friendly staff and great service—highly recommend!

Tried Puppa in Aldgate East for the first time and was pleasantly surprised. The seafood spaghetti was generous with prawns, squid and mussels, and the pasta was cooked really well. The bruschetta was fresh and simple, exactly how it should be.

The service was friendly and the place has a relaxed feel. Nothing over the top, just good food done right. Nice spot to have in the area, I’ll definitely come back to try more from the menu.

name: Pizza Pilgrims Liverpool Street
address: Tower 42, 22 Old Broad St, London EC2N 1HQ, UK

reviews.text: We visited Pizza Pilgrims Liverpool Street with friends and ordered two 8 Cheese pizzas, a Margherita and a Smoky Aubergine. The pizzas were flavorful and well cooked. The place was a bit noisy, but it didn’t spoil the evening, a solid spot for a relaxed meal with friends.

I was really disappointed by my experience at Pizza Pilgrims Liverpool Street on 30/01/2026.

Despite arriving around 45 minutes before closing time, my friend and I were immediately told to order quickly because the restaurant was closing, which made us feel unwelcome from the outset. The initial table we were offered was cramped due to another customer’s luggage and the tables being quite close anyway, and although there were plenty of empty seats, asking to move was met with a visibly negative reaction from the server.

The most disappointing part was ordering. I’m lactose intolerant and asked for vegan cheese, only to be told it wasn’t available. This left me with just one option on the entire menu, a very basic cheeseless pizza. Had we been told this before sitting down and reviewing the menu, we would have gone elsewhere. By the time I realised how limited my options were, it felt too late to leave. Poor stock control really impacts the customer experience.

When I raised this and asked if there was any flexibility or goodwill, I was told there was nothing that could be done, and that other customers that day who were vegan had “just taken the vegan pizza.” This response felt so dismissive and lacking in customer care.

To make matters worse, I paid extra to add anchovies to my pizza, but they were barely present at all (check the photo, spotting them is genuinely a challenge).

After all this, paying almost £50 for two pizzas and two drinks felt like very poor value. Overall, the experience left me feeling disappointed and disrespected. I’ve had better experiences with this brand elsewhere, but sadly this visit fell far far short.

Came here today to try the bottomless payday pizza party. We had the absolute best experience! There was more pizza than it’s possible to eat, and every one was as delicious as the next. The bottomless drinks came quickly, we were constantly topped up. The service was top notch in every way, we were served by Iris who was friendly, attentive and swift at all times. We were also given a couple of little extras on the house. A 10/10 experience, we will be back for more.
Amazing pizza, food came in 10 minutes and the cocktails were lush! Devon was so lovely and couldn't have asked for a better dining out experience'

Pizza Pilgrims was fantastic. The pizzas were absolutely delicious, with great flavor and perfectly cooked dough. The service was also excellent and the whole experience exceeded our expectations.
Special shout out to Iris, who took care of us. She was super friendly. Everything she suggested was spot on. We’ll definitely be back.

name: ALFI Italian Cocktail Bar & Restaurant Spitalfields

reviews.text:
We had lunch today at ALFI and chose the Slow Sundays menu.

The portions were generous, the focaccia was absolutely incredible, and both the location and overall atmosphere were on point.

A special thank you to Beth, who served us and truly made the experience even more lovely with her attentive and warm service.

Highly recommend , we’ll definitely be back ✨

Had a wonderful Sunday lunch with my cousin! The food was so delicious, but honestly, the service is what made the experience so memorable. We didn’t get the name of the lovely lady who served us, but she was truly 11/10. From helping us choose our mocktails, guiding us through the menu and checking in on us throughout our visit. Thank you for such wonderful hospitality! Also an honourable mention to Rodrigo, who looked after us too - thank you so much!

A thoroughly enjoyable meal with the best customer service in London! Beth was energetic, friendly and had great recommendations. The pizzas are standout, I could easily have been somewhere on the Italian coast. The tiramisu was TO DIE FOR, would come back for that alone.

visited this restaurant for the first time after reading several positive reviews. Overall, the experience was pleasant, though it didn’t fully meet our expectations.

The drinks were good, and we really enjoyed the starters — the tartare and the focaccia, which were both well prepared and flavorful.

Unfortunately, the pasta dishes were less impressive. The crab pasta and the ragù were decent but not particularly memorable, and the ragù could have used a bit more sauce. We also found the portion sizes on the smaller side, and we were still a little hungry by the end of the meal.

The pricing is fairly typical for London, but considering the overall experience, there may be other options in the area that offer slightly better value.

Honestly one of the best meals I’ve been to in ages. We couldn’t decide on a main so we ordered all starters and they were all delicious. Our server server Beth was fab, she was super lovely and funny and really made the meal for us. Would definitely reccomend the meatballs from the starters. Also we never took part in wine Wednesdays but seemed super popular and fun!

name: OMBRA
address: 1 Vyner St, Bethnal Green, London E2 9DG, UK

reviews.text:
We had the most wonderful Sunday lunch at Ombra. From the first snack through to dessert, every dish was authentic, beautifully prepared, and bursting with flavour — true Italian cooking at its best. The girolle mushroom tagliolini was delicate and full of depth, the monkfish main was perfectly cooked and full of flavour, and the apricot, mint and yoghurt dessert was a refreshing finish. Compliments to Chef Alessandro, whose skill and passion really shone through in every plate.
For drinks, we trusted our waiter Red, who paired each dish with the perfect wine recommendation. Each glass lifted the food even further, and it made the whole meal feel carefully curated.
We enjoyed it all out on the sunny terrace, where the relaxed, welcoming atmosphere made it a truly memorable family lunch. Ombra delivered on every level — excellent food, thoughtful service, and a beautiful setting. We’ll definitely be back!

I’ve been here a couple of times before but this was the first time in a few years even if I’ve eaten my body weight in maritozzi and semolina sourdough in their bakery opposite, Forno.

The whole afternoon was honestly lovely: plate after plate arrived and everything was exquisite: courgette flowers, prosciutto, aubergine caponata, the ravioli, the tagliatelli with girolles, etc. The marzipan semifreddo was genius and the only thing in the whole meal that didn’t quite hit the spot for us was the panna cotta which seemed heavier than I’m used to.

Service was super attentive throughout, requests for wine recommendations stayed at the top of the list rather than heading to the bottom and the interior is quirky and welcoming. Although by mid-October the canal is no longer that draw that it would be in June, it’s a great location.

In a city with a never ending supply of restaurants, all four of us agreed we’d be delighted to return here. Such good food, such lovely heart. 🥰 Thanks, all.

I took my parents here for lunch , it was their first time and only my second time. Absolutely impeccable! We had the chef’s menu for 3 with wine pairing. Big shoutout to Phil (certified sommelier) for perfectly pairing every unique dish.

**Oysters with blood orange and olive oil
**Olive oil, lemon mussels with fennel
**Grilled White asparagus with sardines
**Gnocco fritto (house staple!)
**Lamb’s heart on whipped feta (!!)
**Fresh pasta (made daily on-site) with beef shin ragù
**Basil & raspberry cake (mind-blowing flavourrrr)
**Tiramisu (rightly praised as London’s best.  My mum demolished it solo!)

The team at Ombra just get it- full of heart, bold flavours, and warming energy.

P.s.: the chefs menu changes with season as they source the freshest ingredients! worth going back!

(To the tune of oompa loompa)

Ombra loompa I am now fat
We got lots of plates now can you top that!!

Ombra loompa doo pa de de
We had a great time now listen to me!!

So myself and my wife came in as she had seen this spot when she visited the last Tuesday society. And oh how pleased I am she saw it.

Tonight we had the chefs menu and it was not only incredible value but an immersive culinary experience. The staff were very knowledgeable and very attentive but the food really was the winner of the evening. I never knew asparagus could taste soo good!!

The tasting menu allowed us to try food we would never usually choose such as the lambs heart but honestly it’s worth every bite.
Great Sunday lunch plenty of delicious and unusual dishes, lovely combination of flavours and attentive service, a must try.

name: GUSTO - MODERN ITALIAN RESTAURANT
address: 3-5 Goswell Rd., Barbican, London EC1M 7AH, UK

reviews.text:
£45 for two pizzas and a glass of wine. We were expecting something good for that price. But we were left surprised. And not in a good way.

On arrival our waitress told us to choose a table on the other side of the restaurant. She failed to seat us, offer menus, talk through the specials or even inform us of what was unavailable on the menu.

I realised there was a specials board so walked round to the other side of the restaurant to see it - where the waitress intercepted me and told me to go back to the table where she would inform me of the specials. Shame she did this as she was taking my order. And when I did get the chance to order, she only told me that she had run out of my preferred choice once after I had perused the menu for 10 minutes. They also ran out of my second choice. This was at the start of dinner service at 6pm on a Saturday night.

She took my alternative order, but failed to ask if anyone on our table had any allergies. Bit slap dash if you ask me.

When our pizzas finally arrived they came with a monstrous mountain of stringy, moist and greasy mozzarella cheese on top of them. I was on a date and found myself lady and the tramping - not with my partner, but with the cheese. I had one slice and concluded it was inedible.

The base of the pizza did not cook properly because of the thick layer of cheese. Once the cheese cooled it turned into what seemed like a thick, wet layer of dairy cement. The chorizo was too salty and oily. On the other pizza, it seemed as though the toppings were uncooked and added as an afterthought.

And to make matters worse, not only was there a lack of seasoning on the pizza, but there wasn’t even a proper grinder for fresh pepper in sight.

When I swiftly asked for the bill after sampling one slice of pizza, I had to tell the waitress that it was not to my preference. She offered to make me another, but I politely declined as didn’t want to be put through the experience again.

What I will say is that the wine was lovely. Sadly, not lovely enough to redeem the evening.
Amazing little Italian. Had the handmade Gnocchi with sausage and blue cheese, little pillows bursting with  flavour. Will definitely come again.

Do you ever find yourself hungry, late of an evening in a very damp, dark part of London and crave some traditional authentic Italian food and are confused by the array of options on offer?

Not if you’re in or around the Barbican as there is only one place to head to,

Gusto, located at 5 Goswell Road, EC1M 7AH London.

On entering the restaurant, you feel immediately transported to a quiet country eatery located in Tuscany or the outskirts of Rimini. The restaurant is immaculately decked out, Italian music floats over the sound system and the smell inspires the tastebuds.

The menu is composed of classic Italian dishes. In addition to homemade pasta and pizza, you can choose from mouthwatering mains such as:

Parmigiana (GF, V / VG option) Fried Aubergine, tomato sauce, Parmigiano cheese. A classic Italian favourite, 16.95

Sea Bass with Silky Red Cabbage Purée (GF)  Sea bass fillet with red cabbage cream, lime, pistachios, pomegranate, 22.95

Lamb Rack (GF) Lamb rack, mint sauce, grilled vegetables, and roasted potatoes (or skin on fries) £35

Dry-Aged Ribeye Grilled vegetables, and roasted potatoes served with freshly made chimichurri (300/400/500g) £45/60/75.

I opted for the pork belly with baked potato, braised fennel, 21.95. Each ingredient was cooked to perfection. The pork belly was tender and mouthwatering. The portions of each ingredient generous and succulent.

The service was attentive and non-intrusive. The head chef, Ilenia Lucarelli, came and out and checked with the customers that everything was alright with the food. All of the diners around, myself included, reported complete satisfaction with every aspect of this restaurant experience.

I shall return frequently and sample every item on the menu. A truly 5-star experience.

And if you write a review, you will get a free Limoncello!

Very close to the Barbican centre. The black squid ink prawn risotto was delicious! The shrimps were perfectly cooked and the rice was buttery and the crunch from the pistachios was very interesting.
The chicken salad was also pretty good.

Went with some friends for an early dinner before a show. The four of us cleared our plates completely! Everything was truly delicious. We had the cappelacci with ragu, the parmigiana and the mushroom risotto. Each of us ordered a different wine and were also very pleased wih the quality. My friends shared the pistachio cheescake for dessert and also spoke highly of it!

name: Lina Stores Broadgate Circle - Italian Restaurant
address: Unit G02, Upper Circle, Broadgate, London EC2M 2QS, UK

reviews.text: Had an amazing dinner at Lina Stores! First time trying it and it totally delivered. We kicked things off with olives, focaccia, and tuna crudo everything was so good. The fresh pasta was spot on. The service was super friendly and helpful too — big thanks to Leandro for making our night so great. Can’t wait to go back and try more!

Great dinner. First time trying Lina Stores and it did not disappoint. Started with the olives, focaccia, and tuna crudo - everything was delicious but the tuna was the standout - really fresh and tasty. We followed with crab linguine and lamb ragu pappardelle (forgot to take pics of these dishes as was too excited to try the food). Hard to choose which was our favourite as both were exceptional and the fresh handmade pasta was great in both dishes. The service was attentive, friendly and helpful, and we would like to thank Lucia for this as it made our evening. We will be returning again as there are lots of other dishes we’re keen to try!

Came here for my birthday with my friend and the service by Valerie and Leo was outstanding!! I had the truffle pasta and it was everything I was expecting and more 😍. They surprised me with a birthday ice cream and a candle which was so sweet of them!!!!

Went to Lina with a friend for a few drinks and was it was a lovely experience. Pedro who was behind the bar recommended me a really nice brandy, the orange brandy was very nice. He was very friendly and has a lovely accent. It was fun chatting to him about different drinks. The environment was very nice and chilled I got catch up with my friend without the music being too loud.

This place has exceeded my expectations. We went for the tasting menu and everything was delicious although quite a bit too much... The starters were great and the pasta was delightful. We enjoyed the truffle one and ravioli the most. Prawns were also excellent. Tiramisu could be a tiny bit less sweet, but still yummy. I would definitely recommend and will happily come again!

name: Lina Stores Shoreditch - Italian Restaurant & Bar
address: 180 Shoreditch High St, London E1 6HY, UK

reviews.text: We went here for a late valentines meal after hearing rave reviews and we were both disappointed. In terms of service we felt rushed - we did 3 courses and drinks in around 45 minutes which is great for a quick work lunch but definitely not for a romantic date night. The food was mediocre, not bad but certainly not worth the hype the place has been given. I did like the decor with all the wine bottles which was very quirky.

My friend and I visited Lina Bar and absolutely loved it. The atmosphere is intimate and cosy—perfect for a date night or just a quick cocktail, or as they say in Italian, an “aperitivo.”

We tried the mango margarita, spicy mezcal margarita, and a dirty vodka martini, and every drink was excellent. The service was amazing too—water, crisps, and olives were brought to the table as soon as we arrived, which really made us feel like we were in Italy.

Giacomo took care of us and was incredibly knowledgeable, friendly, and helpful when choosing cocktails. I would definitely recommend Lina Bar and can’t wait to go back!

From the second we sat down all the waiters were highly attentive. Not too overbearing and exactly what one needs during a dining experience. Friendly, caring and respectful. The portions were just perfect - in fact I cousins finish all of my food ! Reasonable prices and lovely atmosphere. Would definitely recommend.
Everything tasted really fresh, and large portions. Really beautiful setting / interiors and reasonble set menu pricing. Bonus points for the tiramisu!

I stopped here impromptu on my way elsewhere and was so pleasantly surprised by the level of authenticity in the food and outstanding service.  I haven't had Italian food this wonderful since Italy. Smaller (right-size) portions, a wonderful wine selection, really kind attentive service. This place should not be missed.

Great little tucked away Italian - pizza was freshly made and really really good. Staff are super friendly I would highly recommend and will be back.

Also super good value!!

Hands down one of the worst pizzas I’ve eaten in London as an Italian. This is not authentic Italian pizza. I ate it because I was hungry but it was watery and all the toppings came off as soon as you lifted a slice. Genuinely horrendous. The place has an offputting smell and the service was not good either (they brought me the pizza without cutlery, one napkin, and no glass for the drink).

Tre Colori is a hidden gem for anyone who loves truly authentic Italian pizza. From the moment you walk in, you’re welcomed with warm hospitality and the comforting aroma of fresh dough and herbs. The pizzas are absolutely top-notch – thin, crispy crusts with rich tomato sauce, melty mozzarella, and fresh, high-quality toppings that taste like they came straight from Italy.

Whether you’re going for a classic Margherita or something more adventurous like their truffle mushroom special, you can taste the care and tradition in every bite. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, perfect for a casual night out or a family dinner.

The tiramisu at Tre Colori is an absolute dream! Light, creamy, and perfectly balanced between the rich espresso-soaked layers and the smooth mascarpone filling. It’s not overly sweet, which makes each bite even more indulgent. You can really taste the love and tradition behind it. Easily one of the best I’ve had – a must-try if you visit!

If you’re craving a genuine Italian pizza experience, Tre Colori is the place to go. Highly recommended!

We went out quite late looking for a decent bite to eat , looking at the prices I wasn't expecting too much but with the family style service, to the decent portion size I really appreciate this pizza place. Pizza was nice and wet ( I got the carbonara) where they didn't skimp out on the toppings. Lovely experience ☺️
Excelente customer service & food quality it’s just great, authentic pizza.

I visited Cecconi’s Sunday Feast and was extremely excited, especially since you have to book well in advance to secure a table.

The setting is beautiful, and the atmosphere was wonderful. A live singer was also present, which added a really special ambience to the experience.

We decided to go for the free-flowing champagne option, and our glasses were truly never empty. Ronaldo looked after us in the best possible way, he is an absolute gem and a real asset to Cecconi’s. I sincerely hope the restaurant knows what an enrichment he is.

The buffet was presented in the most beautiful way, with everything you could possibly ask for: delicious meats, fresh salads, lobster, seafood, charcuterie, you name it. Quality-wise, it is very hard to complain about anything. The food was always topped up and looked incredibly tasty and appealing throughout.

That being said, the two-hour time limit feels quite short for the price. You are paying a lot for the variety and abundance of food, but there is only so much you can enjoy within that timeframe. It makes the experience feel slightly rushed, as you want to make the most of what is offered. Extending it to three hours would make it much more relaxed and enjoyable.

I was a little disappointed by the cheese selection. Additionally, since I am not a huge fan of sweet desserts, that part was less exciting for me, though that is purely personal preference and honestly complaining on a very high level.

Overall, my highlights were the beautifully presented and delicious food, Ronaldo’s extremely attentive service, and the wonderful atmosphere.

Lovely lunch at Cecconi’s, ideally located in The Ned. The service was impeccable and attentive throughout. The food was very good overall :  the steak tartare wasn’t a standout, but the salmon was excellent.  A lovely spot for a relaxed meal in a beautiful setting with very attentive service. Highly recommended.
Beautiful seating area and delicious food. Lots of gluten free options, pasta and pizza options. And our server was very attentive to my allergy. The live music was a major plus!

I celebrated my leaving party at Cecconi’s at The Ned London, and I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. A special thank you to Mourad, who truly made the evening unforgettable and absolutely perfect.

He was incredibly kind, friendly, and welcoming from the very beginning. His positive energy and warm personality created the perfect atmosphere for such a special occasion. He made us feel comfortable, well looked after, and genuinely cared for throughout the whole night.

Mourad went above and beyond to make sure everything ran smoothly, and thanks to him, the celebration felt even more meaningful and joyful. He is a real asset to the restaurant, and I’m so grateful he was there to make my leaving party so special.

Thank you again for an amazing evening — it was truly fantastic!
Good ambience for the occasion (I went for valentines) however the food was okay. There are very few vegetarian options. I am sure that other food options would be more popular!

name: Pizza East - Shoreditch
address: 56 Shoreditch High St, London E1 6JJ, UK

reviews.text:
We had such a lovely time at this restaurant. Food was delicious and the drinks were really good too!
Flaviya was an absolute star - we didn’t have a booking but she squeezed us in on such a busy night. She ensured we were well looked after and she was so lovely to talk to. Thank you for a wonderful Saturday night. Definitely be coming bak thanks to Flaviya!

We enjoyed their Michelin starred popup from LA - Pastabar. Menu is £59pp. You get starter each, share 2 mains (pizza, pasta) and dessert each. The lobster pasta was one of the best pastas of my life. The bone marrow and anchovy pizza was different but it worked so well together.
I’d prefer a more traditional dessert than granita but it was refreshing. The cocktails from this menu weren’t strong. I’d prefer quieter ambiance for this special menu but otherwise good.

I went to Pizza East for their famous Lasagne. I thought it was lovely but it did miss something, more spice and more heat, the middle was not as hot as the edges and a spicey kick would have gave it the 5 stars. The server was brilliant, dressed very well, energetic and even gave me recommendations. The atmosphere was mellow, good music almost comfortable enough for me to undo my belt and kick off my shoes. Great experience! I recommend.

One of the best pizzas I’ve had. I went for the San Daniele with tomato sauce. The base was perfectly thin and crispy, and the tomato sauce was fresh and light. We also ordered Calabrian fried potato’s, which were very nice, and calamari, which tasted fresh but we felt the pieces were very small. We were attended to by 3 staff members; two of who were lovely , but we were not impressed with the other. They appeared to have a cold and really shouldn’t have been at work. All in all, I would defo back.

Thank you Flavia for serving all of us tonight, even tho we were a large table she made sure to take care of us. Genuinely never seen a more happy server. Made our night, definitely recommend to everyone pizzaeast is lovely.

My Super Fast pizza only took over 25 minutes to complete. More super SLOW! Could have gone and bought ingredients and cooked quicker myself. Never anyone the till, very poor. Would never go there again tbh. It’s pathetic to advertise a Suoer Fast pizza. Absolutely Useless! I went for dinner but it could have been supper. not even Bang average at best!

3.5 stars. Only offer very thin crust 12” pizza. Meant for 1 person. Good variety on “personal pizza” , limited quantity of , for example basil, . That being said said it okay if you like thin crust. As always, post where ever your nose takes you.

Cheap but incredibly tasty pizza at Pizza Union Aldgate. The pizza is baked with a wood fire, which gives a crunchy bottom yet fluffy texture. And all the ingredients are fresh and very high quality. 🍕 The prices are very reasonable and if you like high energy and a bit of background noise of a busy restaurant - then this place is perfect for a Friday or Saturday evening!

With a casual and trendy vibe, Pizza Union Aldgate is popular for its lightning-fast service and consistently tasty pizzas,perfect for lunch, dinner, or a late-night bite. The restaurant welcomes groups, college students, and solo diners alike, and offers flexible options including dine-in, takeout, and outdoor seating. Its cozy atmosphere, accessible entrance, and broad menu with vegan and vegetarian choices set it apart from typical fast-food pizza spots in the area.

Unfortunately didn’t get to try my pizza due to poor hygiene by the staff. The presentation of the pizza as well is not great as I asked for ham, some spinach and rocket. I didn’t get any ham (even though I paid extra for it), and got a whole bag of spinach and rocket instead. The staff member was on her phone while the pizzas were cooking then got them out and used her hands to put toppings on mine and other peoples pizza without washing her hands. I was really looking forward to this pizza from the reviews but because of poor hygiene and a whole bag of salad dumped on the pizza I was unable to eat the pizza.

name: Zizzi - Tower Hill
address: Plaza Level, West, Tower Place, London EC3R 5BU, UK

reviews.text: I had a good experience at Zizi. The exterior is really attractive and the view over the Thames is absolutely beautiful ,it adds so much to the atmosphere. The food is good for the price, with decent portions and nice flavours. Cocktails were delicious, tiramisu was good and salmon risotto was flavoursome.The staff were also very helpful and made the visit feel relaxed and welcoming. Overall, a great spot for a pleasant meal with a wonderful riverside setting.

As an American in England, I was craving real Italian food—and this place delivered! The dishes were flavorful and hot, not the usual "English Italian" version. The restaurant was clean, quiet, and comfortable—perfect for a relaxing meal. Our waiter Danny was super sweet, funny, and incredibly hospitable. He made the whole experience even better. Highly recommend!

Really amazing service from all the staff and truly delicious authentic italian food, it was my first time but I really enjoyed everything! Thank you to the team for giving us a great experience tonight ❤️
Very nice place for lunch right near the Tower of London service was very fast and efficient and the food was outstanding. We will come back, definitely. Spicy prawn pasta was awesome.

We had a great lunch here before visiting the Tower of London.
We were seated comfortably and served fast. The food was delicious and the staff were very welcoming.
10% service charge is added to the bill.
I would recommend this place for a lunch or dinner while out in the city.

The pizza was genuinely impressive. The base had that perfect balance crisp on the outside and soft inside, which tells you it was baked properly and not rushed. The sauce tasted fresh, not overly sweet, and the chicken + mushroom toppings were generous without turning the slice into a soggy mess. The cheese pull was exactly what you hope for when you lift a slice. The chilly sauce on top was the best if you like spicy.

What stood out just as much was the service. The staff were attentive without hovering, quick to check in, and clearly knew their menu. The ambience was relaxed and comfortable, with warm lighting and enough space between tables to actually enjoy a conversation. It felt like a place you would return to, not just for the food, but for the overall experience.

Such a hidden gem in the middle of the city, tucked away in a cozy alley. The service was excellent and the food was authentically Italian, made with fresh ingredients. I highly recommend Linguine alla Cefalú - ‘pistachio’ cream pasta with king prawns that absolutely blew my mind.

Restaurant with nice atmosphere, but INCREDIBLY hot. There was a vegan starter of lentil soup, which was very tasty. The vegan main was a very uninteresting (and undercooked) penne pasta with tomato sauce and vegetables (not shown on the menu). Very poor offering, and definitely need to do better.

This is the surprise of the year. The food here was immense!

I had the prawn linguine and it was sensational. Such a good balance with the garlic and the dill made it pop. My colleague had a gluten free pasta and said it probably one of the best he’s eaten in his life.

The pizza was also highly rated. The photos of this food will not do it justice.

There were five of us and we hadn’t booked and they were accommodating. Service was great and it was well priced.

Massive fan of this place tucked away in an alleyway.

Will 100% go back there. The food was delicious.

We had high expectations based on the reviews, but our experience actually exceeded them. The food was fantastic – both the calzone and pizza were amazing, and everything arrived surprisingly quickly. What really made the experience special, though, was the service. Our waitress, Estela, was friendly and attentive, and made the whole visit even more enjoyable. A perfect way to spend a Friday afternoon. My wife and I will definitely be coming back!

name: Satyrio- Italian Restaurant & Wine Merchants
address: 49 Aldgate High St, London EC3N 1AL, UK

reviews.text:
If you're looking for an authentic Italian restaurant and wine bar, look no further than this place. I didn't eat here, but I did have a glass of white wine which was absolutely delicious.
The staff spoke Italian which adds to the authenticity and I responded with the Italian that I know.
Saryrio is a small and cute place. It's so warm and lovely, I spent 2 hours here enjoying the space.
When I was here there was a wine tasting event so this place has that going for it. I'll definitely come back again to have some food and wine.
If you're looking for something authentic where the staff will look after you, then look no further than this Italian restaurant 😊

A lovely place to stop off and have lunch. We had pizza and pasta options in our group and all were delicious. I did find the pasta dishes to be a little small but I was really hungry at the time. Friendly staff and reasonable prices.

It's a very pleasant and welcoming Italian restaurant with an extensive wine list. Our food was delicious and flavourful and even bread and butter were freshly made. Our waiter made us feel like long missing friends.
Excellent wine collections, the owner is really into Italian wine. Food is excellent. Had a great lunch.

Right in the city is this amazing traditional Italian restaurant. The menu is limited but everything we had was amazing!

We had a big group so made a booking in advance. The a staff were lovely. The is all at the back of the restaurant and so no views but if you are in a group or don’t mind it’s worth coming here.

The polenta chips, burrata and calamari were amazing. With the main course being limited to just 4 pastas and 4 mains, all that change regularly. The Veal ragu and tonarelli were great along with the Gnocchi with was lovely too.

Tiramisu desert was great and different.

Not a cheap place to eat but worth it.

name: GUSTO - Wine Bar & Restaurant
address: 3 Goswell Rd., Barbican, London EC1M 7AH, UK

reviews.text:
Went to Gusto for dinner on a weekend. The place is small- divided in two parts. It was neat and clean.
Coming to food- we were a large group of 7- and almost everything we ordered was bland, and tasteless. I had ordered the Ortolana pizza- which has a pesto base. It was absolutely horrific- with no a bland taste of grilled vegetables. Upon enquiring, the waitress completely refused the blunder- and then brought me watery pesto in case I wanted to add it ‘on’.
Not happy at all- and I recommend checking other restaurants in the Barbican for a decent place to eat.

This Italian restaurant is a true gem. The food is incredibly flavorful and authentic, the atmosphere warm and elegant, and the service friendly and attentive. Its location is perfect—just steps from the Tube, making it very easy to reach. They also often host live jazz events, adding an extra touch of charm to the evening. A must-try for anyone craving real Italian cuisine in London!

The food was ok, the atmosphere ok and the service good. The factor that means I will not return was the service / gratuity charges. 13% added to the bill, fair enough. When the card machine was presented it came with the usual buttons requesting an additional gratuity. This has really annoyed me and I will vote with my feet. Shame really, thought it might be a useful place to stop for a quick dinner.

Lovely local Italian just by Barbican tube. Great service. Really warm atmosphere. Chef cooked us home made pasta with delicious sauce. Wine list excellent. And then a treat of melon cello for digestif! Can’t fault it and will be coming back soon. Thanks!
Very good little Italian independent bistro with home cooked style food. Good happy service and fresh eats.

name: Cityroy London
address: 1 Royal Exchange, Threadneedle St, London EC3V 3LL, UK

reviews.text: Arancini not good at all. only one waiter was working, so we had to wait a bit before ordering.  I only recommend you to drink.  after a while there was not even a waiter, the cleaning lady and the chef  served the tables.  3 stars only for the sympathy and kindness of the chef and the woman.

Absolutely superb! Served the best lasagne I have ever tasted. The staff were so kind (letting us eat late on a Saturday night when most other diners were nearly finished). Brilliant overall service and very reasonably priced. Thanks so much for making our night - we will definitely visit again next time we are in London.
sat outside on a sunny day for breakfast and green tea. Gluten free toast avocado and poached eggs. Well presented and good presentation. Green tea fine. Service good.
Great food, cosy place, and Amit literally made my day by providing excellent service. One of best places around, defo recommended if you’d want a bit of red carpet service in undoubtably Italian way

I highly recommend this place! Great food, great wine and amazing service. Also, they prepared the meals with extra caution for my husband's food allergy. Truly appreciate it. Thank you so much Youssef!

name: Franco Manca Broadgate Circle
address: Unit T2, 32 Broadgate, London EC2M 2QS, UK

reviews.text:
I organized a surprise Baby Shower for our friend, and it was truly an absolutely wonderful experience! We had no problem bringing our own balloons and decorations, which made the preparations so much easier for us.The service was incredible - warm, attentive, and genuinely helpful. They kindly took group photos for us with such friendliness, which we really appreciated. The food was delicious, and the atmosphere together with the beautiful location created the perfect setting for such a special day.

Special thanks to Mateusz, who made sure we felt taken care of the entire time. On top of that, my friends secretly arranged a birthday cake for me during the same party, and Mat joined them in singing “Happy Birthday.” It was such a touching and unforgettable moment!

Once again, a huge THANK YOU to the whole team - you are truly amazing. I wholeheartedly recommend this place 🤍🎂 xx

At this particular location you should definitely make a reservation to avoid an attitude but without one, we were sat fairly quick. It was a good time to go though (4pm). In fairness, we loved the pizzas we chose (number 12 & 5) so we went to another location and the staff was still rude… so just keep in mind the service is catered to hopefully being (at the very least) professional not hospitable or even friendly. The tables are way too close together as well, I actually got an elbow to the head by a server who barely extended any sympathy. The pizzas are good and a decent size although toppings are consistently unevenly distributed.

Really busy place but I had an amazing pizza in here recently! The best Franco Manca special I’m yet to have. The service was fantastic and fast, despite it being packed with office groups. They really made a great effort to accommodate me! I will be using this place again when catching trains from Liverpool Street

We came in and the staff were really welcoming. We placed our orders which included two drinks, an orange juice and house lemonade. When they arrived they looked like a child’s portion and not even filled to the top. For £3.50 for such a small drink - it’s not worth it. We told the waitress immediately that for £3.50 the lemonade was not worth it and didn’t even drink it, we asked for the orange juice to be filled to the top. Her face seemed very annoyed and it looked like she took it personal. She kept saying that any Franco Manco would give you this much. I explained that I didn’t know the portions were going to be this small and that I didn’t want the Lemonade then. Her expression over this transaction made us feel unwelcome. The pizza and dessert was delicious but this interaction made me not want to go back. There is no shortage of pizza restaurants in the area and most of them give a better service and value for money drinks.

Absolutely incredible pizza! The crust was perfectly crispy, the sauce rich and flavorful, and the toppings fresh and generous. The staff was friendly and the service was quick. Easily one of the best pizza places I’ve ever been to. Highly recommend
Thanks for all Cemal 😊😊😊

If you are looking for fresh and yummy south italian food by Napolitan‘s, then you are just right here. The fresh Linguini with the perfect tomato sauce and the delicious polpettine (meatballs) were stunningly good. The bread was assume too. The nice white table cloths and setting in the upper Floor was very nice and uplifting the atmosphere as the ceiling windows and side windows needed some cleaning or nice curtains ☺️.

Rucoletta is a fantastic little Italian spot tucked just behind St Paul’s Cathedral. I went in without much expectation and left genuinely impressed. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, and the staff are super friendly and attentive.

I had a prawn pasta dish (can’t remember the exact name!) — it came with giant, juicy prawns in a beautifully balanced, light sauce. The pasta was perfectly cooked and soaked up the flavours so well. You could tell the ingredients were really fresh. It was one of those dishes you don’t want to end.

The service was quick even though the place was quite busy. The warm bread with olive oil they bring out is a nice touch, and overall, the prices are very fair for central London — especially for the quality you’re getting.

It’s one of those rare places that feels like a local secret. No gimmicks, just really good food and genuine hospitality. Highly recommend if you’re in the area and craving proper Italian!

I recently discovered this restaurant. The experience was great from start to finish. The food was both authentic and well prepared, with the pasta cooked to perfection.

It is increasingly difficult to find truly authentic Italian cuisine in London, as many establishments attempt to overcomplicate traditional dishes and lose sight of the fundamentals. Rucoletta, however, delivers exactly what one hopes for - simple, high-quality Italian food executed exceptionally well. The pasta in particular was outstanding: elegant, balanced, and prepared with care. No unnecessary embellishments, just genuine Italian cooking done properly.

A special thank you to Alessandro and Kittu for their warm and attentive service throughout the evening. Their hospitality added greatly to the overall experience.

I would certainly return and recommend this restaurant to others.

Warm welcome, informed and fun service accompanying the authentic food. 4 of us all very much enjoyed our food.  In fact, our vegetarian friend said "This is the best arrabbiata I have enjoyed in my 60yrs."

The veal was superb, subtle flavours, light breading.

The salmon piece as a main was large and done to perfection (not overcooked as it often can be).

The gluten free pasta (penne) portion was large and done very well.

When in this neighborhood again, we'll return to try some of their other options.

We sat upstairs, it's cozy, comfortable and the glass ceiling added to the ambience

I had the pappardelle ragu pasta today and it was super delicious!
The boar is cooked to perfection and the dish overall was very flavourful. The pasta is cooked al dente and served fresh and hot.
Jojo is amazing! She gave me menu recommendations and was very warm and welcoming. I had a tasty limoncello on the house after a wonderful dinner.

It is one of the best Italian places I tried in London!

name: Vecchio Parioli
address: 129 Aldersgate St, Barbican, London EC1A 4JQ, UK

reviews.text: The staff were genuinely lovely and the wine was fairly priced but most of the food was forgettable. The chicken livers were a bright spot. I won’t be back, but if you’re passing by, it’s harmless enough to try once.

Lovely authentic Italian restaurant near to Barbican. Delicious fillet steaks cooked to perfection. Cauliflower cheese was very well made,, a pleasant surprise!  Service all good, would recommend booking a table to avoid disappointment.

A classic Italian neighbourhood resturant. Small menu but with all the classic dishes. The calamari, veal escalope, spaghetti al vongole were all good, not great but very tasty and good portion size.

The perfect restaurant for a low key good value dinner or a small group of friends. I will definitely be heading back there

Lovely cozy restaurant with classic dishes done simple and delicious without too much fuss, just non complicated and executed beautifully. Cooked with love with recipes passed down from generations. The baked aubergine (eggplant parmigiana) was exquisite as the eggplant was lightly fried, and the sauce you can tell is very light and homemade. Just a hint of basil and garlic. Lovely. The clams with linguini was just right. Reminded me of my Mama Rosaria's dish she made during Christmas eve.
They give you bread and olives too. Nice gesture. Also wonderful feature that some dishes have option for starter or main dish portions. I really appreciated that feature.
A real Italian restaurant with an amazing old school ascetic. Staff were super friendly and took us in for a last minute dinner. Thank you for your hospitality.

Lovely little find in Leadenhall market - the food was flavourful and filling. Also had a cheeky Aperol Spritz and they make it very well!
The atmosphere is warm and welcoming and the staff were smiley and provided prompt service.
We booked through the Fork so enjoyed 30% off!
Such a wonderful warm and friendly host, and the food is really delicious. The pastas are quite light so recommend to get some starters. The burrata was amazing.

I visited this place with a friend. We each had a couple of drinks and shared two appetizers, a pasta dish, and a tiramisu.
The food and drinks were excellent, and everything was served quickly, which was fantastic.
The staff were also very friendly. I love wine but don’t really know much about it, so they helped me choose a glass of white wine based on my preferences.
I’ll definitely come back to try more dishes and the other wine they recommended!

Fantastic authentic Italian experience. The entrance is hidden between two pubs in the market and looks a bit shady. However don't let this deter you from getting up the stairs. The service, food and interior is truly fantastic. I've now been here twice and will certainly come back for more. A reservation is recommended although definitely worth a try for a walk in.

Delicious food, we had a varity of 4 dishes. The Sea Bass and the Tagliatelle with prawns and peas were really delicious. This place is a no brainer if you want honest Italian made comfort food. Also try the Tiramisu. This was so good. We ate with 4 adults.

Enoteca da Luca in the St Paul’s area is a fantastic spot for both great food and a welcoming atmosphere. I visited with two colleagues, and we had such a lovely experience from start to finish. The team was incredibly friendly and accommodating...they kindly changed our table when we asked for a nicer spot, which we really appreciated.

The service throughout the evening was warm, attentive, and genuinely helpful, especially when it came to recommendations. The vibe is relaxed yet lively, making it perfect for a casual business dinner or a catch-up with friends. The food was amazing, and the wine selection was equally impressive. We’ll definitely be back!

I had a wonderful experience at Enoteca da Luca. The food was absolutely fantastic - fresh, full of flavour, and genuinely memorable. I had their fresh pasta with crab in a rich, creamy saffron-style sauce. I also enjoyed the pâté served with caramelised onions and toasted bread, which made for a delicious super yummie starter.

The ambience is warm, cosy, with warm Italian elements and a charming and stylish rustic décor. It’s intimate, inviting, and full of character.

The staff were incredibly friendly, attentive, and welcoming, which really added to the experience.

Highly recommended if you're looking for delicious Italian food and a cosy environment to relax in.

My friends and I will be making more trips here!
The wine card was extensive and with selections that I haven’t seen in other Italian restaurants.
The ambiance felt private despite of a the large room, whether it was the light, the dispositivos of the room or the staff but it was comfortable.
They offer a variety of cold cuts and cheeses which will go perfect with the wine and there are some mains as options as well. I had both options and it was all good the cuts were taste and the cheese as well no overfreezed as some time happens to make them last they were fresh and delicious.

I came here with my partner for dinner. We shared the carpaccio to start which was very tasy and fresh. The portion was perfect for sharing with plenty on the plate. For mains we both had the Devon white crab pasta. Beautiful plate of pasta, cooked to perfection. It had a nice tomato, creamy, bisque like sauce and I would definitely recommend this dish if you go here. We both had cocktails thay were well made with nice sharp flavours and I had decent americano after dinner. Overall, I would absolutely come back, next time I am in London, and highly recommend to anyone looking for a nice but casual spot for an authentic Otalian dinner!!

Loredana is just wonderful! She has the kind of energy that instantly puts you at ease, warm, positive, and so genuine. You can feel the good vibe she brings the moment she walks in, it makes the whole experience so much better. I honestly couldn’t recommend her enough, she’s amazing at what she does and such a lovely person overall. If you get the chance to book with Loredana, do it, you’ll leave feeling happy and cared for! 🌸
Amazing little gem in St Pauls! Extremely fresh handmade pasta for a decent price. I had the regular sized cappellacci with tomato and pesto sauce. Very kind staff as well.

We just wanted to stop somewhere for quick bite before entering the cathedral.

The ravioli here is amazing, we had the butter and truffle sauce which was really good.
Lovely pasta, very quick and delicious. Ate outside At Paul's. So so tasty!
Really delicious! We loved it. And easily able to get at a table inside which was great. Lovely experience, thank you so much.
