If full price i think it would be in the expensive category in terms if price:quality ratio.

Visited as a party of two for lunch. Was pleased to see they had an extensive lunch menu + an ala carte, so something to suit everyone! We both started with edamame, which you cannot really get wrong. The for mains, I had the sea bass with rice, whilst my friend had the omakase sushi. Both were accompanied with a tasty portion of miso soup, pickles and something else (i am unsure what it was). The food was all tasty and in sensible portions - it would not weigh you down if you are returning to work after a business lunch. We finished with a tea each also. Nice simple decor in the japanese style, and great attentive service without being intrusive. Was very busy for the lunch rush (no tables for walk in at 1pm) but substantially quieter by 2pm. Good location near Liverpool street station, but a little confusing to get to via google maps, which sent me around the broadgate shopping centre for 10 mins! However, once you are out at the right end, the premises is impossible to miss 😅

Highly recommend the sushi brunch. From the options on the mains, go for the salmon, the chicken is pretty basic. The shrimp, which attracts a supplement charge is great too. Friendly and efficient service.

Had a great meal here with colleagues on a Thursday night.

We had chicken wings and prawn katsu for starters and then most people had ramen and I had more starters with bang bang style cauliflower.

Service was excellent. We were served by Maryan who was friendly and helpful throughout and served with a smile which was nice.

The food came out relatively quick (but it was passed the evening rush) and the food was both tasty and hot. I’d say pretty standard in terms of its flavouring which is why I gave it an overall four stars. It just wasn’t fine dining but it was very good.

Portions were hearty but everyone finished theirs. Shows they are thinking about things like that.

The place has great decor. We were in a booth. Was comfy.

I would definitely go again. Service was strong and the food was decent.

It’s a nice place with really nice staff. The food could be a little bit better (I ordered Christmas menu 3 courses for £30) - kimchi particularly tasted like sauerkraut with a little bit of chili and sesame. Tonkotsu itself was phenomenal and the main factor why I gave 4/5 - it was the star of the show. I wouldn’t recommend any other dessert than chocolate sorbet though - I tried a little bit from my husband and it was far better than mine miso salted caramel and chocolate.

Overall it’s a nice place for ramen, but definitely desserts and starters can be easily skipped.

Stopped in for a late-ish Saturday dinner — I didn’t have a reservation, but I was dining alone, so they were able to find me a cosy spot at the end of the bar. (Was occasionally a tad difficult to flag down a server, but I enjoyed watching the cooks prepare dishes in front of me.)

I ordered the (classic) tonkotsu ramen, which was really good. The noodles were authentically chewy, and the broth was very rich and savoury without being too heavy or oily. The sliced chashu was tender and juicy.

Portion size was healthy and I think reasonable for the price point.

I would be keen to come back to try some of their other dishes (the katsu curry looked very tasty). Would definitely recommend!

I sat at the bar next to the kitchen. Got to chat football a bit with Miguel and Carl while they made delicious Ramen! Went for the holiday duck special. Super tender duck, super tasty. Marianne was a ton of fun. Good vibes, good laughs, good ramen! 😋
went for a solo dinner - vegan chilli tofu ramen is so filling I almost had no space for dessert. Glad I tried it!!! SO GOOD. Very nice service from Giovanni and Maryan

We had a fantastic meal at Tonkotsu East - Ramya and the whole team were so friendly and accommodating, happy to make small adjustments to make our meal perfect. Every dish was exquisite, we had 3 different ramen broths between us, and each was phenomenal, along with the chicken karaage and panko prawns. The ramen noodles are made fresh on site, and they were magnificent!
We were delighted with the quality and variety in our meal, and we will absolutely be back! Thank you for an exceptional first visit 🍜🍜🍜

We had a wonderful dinner at Tonkotsu Duston St.! The food was absolutely amazing — big thanks to the kitchen team for such delicious dishes. We had the chicken ramen and karaage starters, and everyone loved them. The service was also really friendly and attentive. My friend and I had a great time, and we’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend!
One of my go-to ramen places in London. Love the Tonkotsu and the weekday £10 lunch deal. There are lighter options for others too! Vitalii served me and everything was quick and easy.

First time eating here at Tonkotsu. We just accidentally passed by the street and this place is a really good find! Ramen tastes good and not so overwhelming. The karaage and chicken katsu is amazing too! Our food was served hot and fresh. Vitalli and the staff are very accommodating and friendly. The place is cozy and such a chill place to just have a good time with loved ones. Totally recommend!

unexpectedly delicious restaurant, had tonkatsu ramen and the chicken katsu curry, along with beer gravity cider, and their yuzu house soda and everything was just like bang on delicious. I'm caught you had this like a aromatic flavors to it with a thin perfect noodles and warmth, and the takata had a perfect crisp along with the savory curry and greens that make it fresh. would definitely come back until this hidden nestled spot
edit: returned from lunch special and relaized its a chain but they the lunch ramesn are just the right amount perhaps a bit smaller but had the chicken chilli and the tokyo with gyozas, the chicken chilli had great flavors and the tokyo needed the chili garlic, tonkatsu was better but still lovely environment and good service and they gave me ramen bucks to spend when back, overall recommended

Dog friendly, and especially welcoming staff! Offered water and plain rice for my puppy, which was so sweet of them. Great food, had to order a second dish because it was so good. Not the hugest portion sizes but generally very well cooked, healthy and good amount of food. Informal and casual atmosphere, lovely Japanese music and interior! Overall amazing, so pleased it was dog friendly, wasn’t sure initially so I messaged them on Instagram and they got back to me very quickly! Thanks and will definitely come again!
Authentic Gyudon (Japanese Beef rice in bowl). Good service with Japanese-English speaking staff. Reservation recommended for 2+ people after 18:30 on weeknight

Loving their Gyudon!!! Decent amount of absolutely delicious beef slices served on top of rice, definitely great value for money. The Ikura Gyudon was amazing - the salmon fish roe and the pickled ginger on top made the whole thing taste refreshing yet comforting, very balanced flavor.

The place is not too far away from Liverpool Street Station and Bank, and you can easily have a decent meal for £15 or less. Think I will probably go back for a quick lunch with colleagues during the weekdays sometime in the near future.

Small price
Excellent food
Kind staff
Good atmosphere (tasteful music and not too loud)

Could hardly ask for more. Ideal for a quick lunch / diner.

Lovely lunch for 4 of us at Negi and Nori. We had the mushroom ramen without the egg- (lovely broth), chicken poke ( I would have liked more chicken because it was delicious!), the spicy tuna poke which was really good, super crunchy salmon futomaki, chicken yaki soba noodles, a bao bun and an extra portion of karage ( which probably didn’t live upto expectations). Generous portions. Quick service. Clean toilet.
The food was delicious and the staff very friendly and accommodating.  We arrived at 3:30 pm and they hadn’t started serving mocktails at that point but made a kind exception.  Would highly recommend

"I had an incredible dining experience at negi & nori last night. We started with the nigiri platter, salmon sashimi salad and the chicken karage was perfectly cooked and tender, with just the right amount of glaze. For the main course, I ordered the Miso chicken Ramen, and it was the star of the show. The broth was deep and complex, with a savory richness that wasn't overly salty. The noodles had a perfect springy chew. The server was attentive and had great recommendations. I can't wait to go back and try their tokiyo roll and dragon roll next!"

We went at a  quiet time during the day so there was no atmosphere and it was very quiet.

The menu was extensive and we enjoyed everything we ordered especially the chicken wings. The place is good value for money and was halal. Would recommend to others. 7/10

Very impressed with the freshly made food!
Will highly recommend!

name: Shoryu Ramen Shoreditch
address: 45 Great Eastern St, London EC2A 3HP, UK

reviews.text:
Had an incredible dinner here tonight! It was my first time trying Sake, and I’m officially a fan. The staff was super helpful in recommending one that balanced perfectly with the meal—smooth, crisp, and served at just the right temperature.
The Ramen was the star of the show, though. The broth was rich and savory, and the noodles had that perfect "snap." You can tell they put a lot of heart into their traditional recipes. Between the cozy atmosphere and the delicious food, this is easily a new favorite spot
Visiting on a Saturday around 3.00pm, the restaurant was not too busy, quiet atmosphere with dim lighting. The service was good. Food also good, the waiting time was not too long. Reasonable price.

Ramen here was hearty and warm on a very cold day in London! Gyozas were perfectly crispy on the outside with juicy fillings on the inside. It’s located in a nice area with lots of foot traffic in Shoreditch on a weekday. We enjoyed sitting by the window while having our food! Tiny bonus as they also played one of Fujii Kaze’s songs while we were there. Highly recommend! :)

pretty classic descent ramen spot in London, has all the familiar tastes, had gotten there just in time for the lunch special which provides a kariage bun and a matcha latte along with the waifu ramen, also had the hakata more classic shoyu ramen, would say a good pick-me-up spot and had the cute Japanese drama along with the bidet in the bathroom. so nice. touches everywhere and pretty chill relaxed environment

We came here to eat dessert. And the matcha roll cake didn’t disappoint us at all. The filling and the cake both were soft and delicious. I highly recommend the Rollcake. I’ll definitely comeback for it.

Really enjoyed this ramen.🍜🎉

The broth was rich and full of flavour without being overly salty. You can tell it’s been properly simmered – there’s depth to it. Slightly spicy miso notes with a comforting pork base.

The chashu slices were thick and tender, with a good balance of fat and lean. The soft-boiled egg was perfect – jammy yolk that mixed beautifully into the soup.
Noodles had a nice bite and held the broth well.

Overall, a very satisfying bowl of ramen. One of the better spots I’ve tried in London – would definitely come back.

ps：I went for the super spicy option and it was properly spicy. If you’re a chilli lover, you’ll definitely want to finish every drop of the broth.

Possibly the silkiest and yummiest pork I've ever eaten, absolutely delicious! Came here with three friends for dinner, and all of us had such a great meal. The staff here are lovely, they communicated with us really well about waiting times as well as the fact that as a group of four we may need to sit separated or we could sit together along one bench. I really thoroughly enjoyed my meal here, would highly recommend!

Hands down the absolute best ramen place in London. Extremely authentic from the taste of the ramen to the vibe of the place, while you're inside you instantly get transported to a small eatery in Tokio where the staff greet you with Irasshaimase and send you off with Arigatō. Shout out to Rob for being such a welcoming host 🙏🏻

Abura soupless soba is so good. I didn't realise you had to mix it as there's a tiny bit of soup at the bottom but once you do it's amazing. +£1 for extra large portion. Has the vibe of a Japanese ramen place with counter seating and quick service.

I was missing Japan and heard good things about this place so I decided to try it, and so glad I did! I’m vegetarian so I got the vegan tantanmen and it was delicious. Portion was great - I came in super hungry but struggled to finish even the regular size. Everyone working there was also super nice!

I would love to see more vegetarian and/or vegan options come to this restaurant, since there’s only one at the moment. Looking forward to coming back :)

name: Sushi Show Shoreditch
address: 136 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E2 6DG, UK

reviews.text:
You wouldn’t believe from outside that this simple restaurant offers one of the most authentic Japanese food experience in London.
The fish is amazingly fresh, and there’s a high variety of options as well. In addition to typical Japanese dishes, there’s also some ‘a la carte’ addition that represents typical side dish that you can find there (the boiled yellowtail with daikon is super tasty)

It might not be the coziest place but you won’t be disappointed by your plate!

Sushi Show in Shoreditch was decent overall—prices were reasonable, though the rice on the nigiri felt a touch light, and it took 40 minutes to an hour for the food to arrive without any heads-up.

That said, the fish was nicely fresh, and the wasabi was the real thing. Service was a bit spotty; no one walked me through the menu, which left me a little puzzled at first.

I’d heard positive buzz. The staff are authentically Japanese, which brought a genuine vibe to the place. It wasn’t amazing, but it wasn’t bad either.

One of the most disappointing experiences ever, and ruined a night with friends too. I feel horrible because the staff were really nice, but the reality is that the quality here isn't there (at least for my experience).

Paid around £70 between three people for roughly 20 odd pieces of sushi, featuring a mix of unagi, egg, salmon and fatty tuna.

Genuinely not even considering the price, I feel that itsu sushi discounted 30 mins before closing tastes better. Tuna was worse than the salmon.

The unagi (eel) and egg were alright, which might make the 1 star for food seem excessive, but for a shop that specialises in sourcing seafood, I think the difference in expectation + price with what was offered is very disappointing.

It’s as authentic as it gets for Japanese food in London. It’s not only the fresh fish, but equally important, freshly prepared good quality rice, that makes for superior taste. Often times it’s the rice that sets apart the average sushi (like Taro) from the good, like Sushi Show. The lighting and interior could really do with a makeover, it comes across as cheap, too bright, not intimate. It doesn’t do justice to the great food. But it’s the food we came for. And it’s the food we come back for.
Gyudon does taste good, but I can’t believe I paid £9.20 for this. The meat can’t even cover half of the rice. Compared to meal deal snack size, the portion is very poor.

name: Marugame (Liverpool Street) - Japanese Udon Noodles & Tempura (丸亀製麺)

reviews.text:
The food is fresh, delicious and filling. You get a big portion even with the regular sized meal and might have some to still takeaway. What makes this place stand out is the quality of food and the attentiveness of the restaurant to anticipated customer needs at their add on station with sauces and other herbs as well as takeaway boxes. Bathrooms were also clean upon my visit to this branch.

Would definitely recommend!

When I heard about this place through halal friendly I thought why not. I’ve actually been lucky enough to try katsu curry from Japan, only it was the airport variant so safe to say it wasn’t the greatest experience…

Overall it was well cooked and flavoursome, I went for the large portion which was more large in the sense that the udon was in high supply - would have liked to have had some more chicken.

Decent experience, pricey but what you’d expect in central London.

Essentially it's a 'fast food' restaurant to me,  reasonably priced and cleaned in the area and plenty of spaces in the restaurant, food was okay but the toilet, the time I was visiting the cubicle was blocked. I appreciate they served food quick but the staff seems rushing to hit the target serving it and dropping food there and here on the serving counter and not seem friendly.
I know these restaurant chain very well I first time I tried there this branch it was plenty sitting area stuff very fast. Food was nice and it was really nice and clean. Definitely recommended
For fast food this is great. My friends weren’t so impressed. But I was glad to be able to get sometime tasty and quick after a few pints in the area.

Really lovely staff and amazing food.

We came while staying in a nearby hotel and loved it so much we had dinner twice in a row.

I’m not sure if it’s “authentic” Japanese food but it is really lovely and fresh. All the ingredients taste amazing and the dishes are brought out promptly. The service is amazing and the staff is so friendly and lovely.

As of February 2026, everything on the menu is also halal :)

Loved it here. Greeted with a warm and friendly welcome. Delicious sushi, beautifully made and well priced. Seafood Ramen was good but could be a bit more to my liking - noodles were too soft for me-but still tasty and warming. Will Come again and try the beef ramen and rest of the menu -  and for sure more Sushi!

Staff were really attentive. Got a table downstairs right by the stairs so we could here footsteps coming up and down by our table throughout. They had a fan to get some air circulation but it made it feel a little weird. Food was very disappointing though. The karaage was alright but it was just standard fried chicken, nothing like a Japanese karaage we were expecting. The sushi rice however, was the greatest disappointment. It was overcooked and mushy, almost like rice porridge wrapped in seaweed. Sushi rice also did not taste seasoned at all. The duck in the crispy duck baos were also not crispy in the least bit. More chewy if anything but had good flavour. Overall it was alright, just disappointing.

I had an incredible experience at Tataki near Aldgate East! The food was absolutely delicious it was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The service was attentive and friendly, and the staff especially prativa made me feel really welcome from start to finish. The atmosphere is warm, stylish, and relaxing — perfect for both casual dining and special occasions. Everything about this place was spot on. Highly recommend if you’re in the area!
An amazing find round the corner from our hotel. We enjoyed sushi, noodles, bao buns and poke bowls. The staff are lovely and it was very reasonably priced for high quality food.

e had an amazing experience at Sushi Samba London. The atmosphere was incredible, the food was outstanding, and the service made the night even more special. Sameera was absolutely fantastic — she was friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was perfect for us throughout the evening. Her warm personality and great recommendations really enhanced our visit. Thank you, Sameera, for making our time at Sushi Samba such a memorable one. We will definitely be back!

I took a friend, my nephew and 2 of my nieces here on a visit to the UK as an opportunity to spend time with them, enjoy some food and a birthday celebration.

The location is really wonderful on the 39th floor (enjoy the glass-walled elevator rides) of a London skyscraper and we were fortunate to be there on a beautiful early Spring evening with clear views across the city.

My guests enjoyed sake, wine and a lychee-elderflower cocktail while we all attacked some edamame. Then we enjoyed the Japanese Eggplant tempura, taquitos (lobster and tuna) before some ngiri, sashimi, steak, black cod and sushi rolls.

Desserts of Japanese crumble, banana-chocolate pie and mochi disappeared quickly.

Service was very good and attentive; a couple of drinks and one dish didn't arrive but were brought promptly when we reminded the waiter. The ambience is good: buzzy, not loud but a good background level. We could all chat and hear one another easily. Fantastic views and an interesting arbor-like frame arches above the tables.

We all really enjoyed ourselves!

Went for valentines lunch and view was nice but definitely better in the evening. We had the special valentines cocktails but we didn’t drink as we didn’t like them! But the Polaroids they did was cute although only one was clear. Staff were super friendly and helpful with gluten free and dairy free choices and black cod was epic, sushi average and samba salad was also divine. For £165 for 2 it was overpriced for us

Good quality food and beautiful view. Only negative you have 2h and have to leave.

We arrived bit late and I felt rushed to eat my food and make sure I try dessert too as it was my first time over there.

The money you pay for the food and service should let you stay longer.

Waitresses didn’t seem very happy, probably overworked and underpaid.

Had our mum's 60th birthday meal here and food was as always good, but the Churrasco Rio Grande was overall better last time we had it here compared to now, maybe it was the seasoning. Samba rolls are amazing though. We ordered desserts and when they arrived, one had a candle with it and given to the birthday celebrant. It wasn't complimentary, it was included in the bill.
The noodles are tasty and were freshly prepared by the owner.  I wanted a quick easy takeaway after staying over in nearby hotel on business.  Reasonable prices too.

Best service I’ve had in a while. Felt like home, and the chef made it a very personalised experience.

Had the salmon set box, fresh and prepped on the spot.

Will come back for sure.

Well ....ignore the branded chain that sits up on the corner.  Wall past and around to Karuga Sushi.  This is very fine sushi!   We had California Roll with blue fin Tuna,  tempura prawn. Roll and a chicken with avocado.   Very fresh, made for you not stashed in some fridge.   Sticky rice,  fresh fish and crispy batters.

A smaller more intimate space quiet for what we wanted.   Please give these guys a try.  They are genuinely very sweet people!!

This is a very simple place with a very tasty food. Everything freshly made as you order (the sizes are small so you might need to order more as we did, but that was fine) and you could taste how fresh the fish was (we tried salmon and tuna). It was great and fast service.
Amazing sushi, great quality and very chill atmosphere, the staff were fun and personable. Will definitely make a regular stop for sushi! Thanks for the amazing meal!

Right. The food is spectacular. If you can, try and sit at the bar where amazing Fatou is a waitress. She made genuinely stonkingly good recommendations that were perfect in terms of what we were looking for at lunch. She also looked after us so well.

Wagyu gyoza (prepare to fight whoever you’re with for them), snow crab (my wife loved), JFC (my fave, get the spicy version).

The chocolate and citrus mizumono dessert is also very special. My Mrs isn’t bothered about anything chocolate-y but thought it was great. I’m a choco-holic and agreed.

PS - Electric Diner (just across the room) is great too. Chicken Waffles in on Friday ace.

PPS - Stick around and go to the main Ned bar. They play really great live music in the evenings, on the stage (see pics).

Kaia, located inside the iconic The Ned in the heart of London’s City, is an excellent option for those looking for a quick yet satisfying lunch without sacrificing quality or atmosphere.

The concept is modern pan-Asian, with influences spanning Japan, Hawaii, and the broader Asia-Pacific region. The menu focuses on poke bowls, sushi, sashimi, and grilled dishes, making it lighter and more contemporary than a traditional Japanese restaurant, while still delivering bold, clean flavours.

What makes Kaia stand out is its efficiency and accessibility, especially for the City crowd. Service is fast, the format is informal, and the open-kitchen setting fits perfectly with a business-district lunch schedule. Despite being inside a luxury venue like The Ned, the experience feels approachable rather than overly formal.

From a food perspective, the quality of ingredients is consistently solid, particularly the raw fish, which is fresh and well-handled. Dishes are well-balanced, flavourful, and thoughtfully assembled, without unnecessary complexity. Portions are generous enough to be filling, yet light enough to avoid the typical “post-lunch slowdown.”

Importantly, Kaia offers a very good value for money, especially considering its prime location and prestigious setting. Prices remain reasonable for the City, making it a smart alternative to more expensive sit-down restaurants or uninspiring takeaway options nearby.

In summary:
Kaia is an excellent idea for a quick lunch in the City — a tasty pan-Asian experience with a strong quality-to-price ratio. It may not aim for haute cuisine, but it delivers exactly what it promises: fresh food, efficient service, and a stylish yet relaxed environment, ideal for both business lunches and casual midweek dining

The hospitality and service are truly exceptional… and did I mention the fabulous food? Every detail is thoughtfully done, making the entire experience outstanding. Highly recommended. A special mention to the Kaia manager, Lucy, who is truly one of a kind and makes you feel genuinely welcomed from start to finish.

One of my favorites, and I love the atmosphere in The Ned with live music.

The semi-fatty tuna is one of the best cuts of fish I've ever had. Every dish was solid.

Definitely recommend this place!
Delicious sushi, sashimi and unique dishes. Excellent service, and a great vibe in an astonishing architectural hotel.

name: Sticks'n'Sushi Shoreditch
address: 100 Shoreditch High St, London E1 6JQ, UK

reviews.text:
Loved everything about this place! From the shout outs when you walk in to the lush food!

The service was exceptional. Our waiter gave strong recommendations and was very attentive. He brought over some glasses of water as he anticipated we might be thirsty!

I liked that you could order bits and pieces of everything on the menu, from sushi rolls, to sashimi, sticks and salad. Everything was delicious and so well presented.

I was most impressed by the desert. In fact I was pleasantly surprised. I am not a big fan of dark chocolate, but this fondue with matcha filling was divine. It was a perfect balance of sweet and bitter, with a delightful green matcha oozing from the warm centre (image below)!

I wish they had one of these down in the south west - maybe open one up in Exeter or Torquay please ??! ☺️

A very pleasant, atmospheric place. Delicious food, the best sushi I've ever had. Thomas gave excellent advice on choosing dishes from the menu and selecting wine. I was surprised by the level of care given to my 2-year-old son, who was given a special menu, crayons and delicious lemonade. A great experience that I would love to repeat!

We visited for the ‘all you can sip’ bottomless brunch. Firstly the thing that really let this restaurant down for us was the service, when you are offering a bottomless menu, you need to make sure you are attentive at filling people’s glasses up. Unfortunately we were made to wait 15 minutes until someone acknowledged us and explained the menu. I also had to ask multiple times for a refill. The restaurant wasn’t busy but the servers didn’t seem to be paying attention to our drinks glasses.
The food on the other hand was outstanding and there was plenty of it. We really enjoyed the concept of the menu and you do get to try a lot of dishes.
I unfortunately wouldn’t recommend this restaurant for a bottomless, as there are plenty of other restaurants in London that are more attentive in regards to the bottomless drinks and cheaper. However I would definitely recommend if you were to go here and order from the standard menu as the food is definitely worth it.

I had a much better experience than I expected. The food was very tasty and well-prepared, and the sushi in particular was fresh and full of flavor. The staff were welcoming, attentive, and made us feel very comfortable throughout the evening. The highlight for me was definitely the dessert – even better than the main courses and the perfect way to end the meal. Overall, a great place to enjoy good food with a warm atmosphere. I would definitely recommend it and look forward to coming back.

The bottomless brunch is a must-try.
We were seated immediately but it took 15 minutes to have our first order taken. Luckily this wasn’t a representation of the speed for the rest of our booking as the waiting staff became very attentive from then on. They were very helpful and explained the menu in detail. The food was incredible and the drinks kept flowing! Worth every penny and will definitely return

Had such a fantastic chill night out here with my girlfriend! The whole experience was truly amazing from start to finish.

The food was absolutely delicious. The presentation is beautiful, especially the spicy tuna roll with the chili threads and the dumpling platter (loved trying the different toppings!). The tuna hand roll was generous with the fish, and the eel roll was super fresh. We also shared the udon noodle soup, which came piping hot in an iron pot and was pure comfort food.

The atmosphere was awesome, and a special shoutout to the servers who were amazing and took great care of us. Highly recommend for a date night!

This place deserves all the love. We recently moved from Toronto and have very high standards for Japanese cuisine. We were blown away by the kindness, service, and quality of the food. It has been our favourite meal in London since moving here. This place feels family fun and authentic, cozy, a place I would happily bring my Japanese parents to. We shared Udon and sushi. The Udon was the best I’ve ever had and the salmon sushi was great. The quality of the fish was standout. To top it all off, the service was attentive but not overbearing, you could tell the warm people who run this place are grateful to have you there. Could not recommend enough and we are SO grateful to have found such a hidden gem in our new neighbourhood.  Thank you zen modo!

I would argue this is the absolute best sushi you’ll get in Angel (and possibly London)! I have been coming here regularly for the last few years and I have never been disappointed. The quality of food, service, and atmosphere has been consistently excellent!

Very delicious and authentic food.
Love the curry buns in the afternoon! They are lovely! The dinner menu has a lot of choices as well. From tempura to sushi to udon and noodles.
Great, cosy place!
Loved everything we had today!! A truly hidden gem, best Japanese food I’ve had, highly recommended 5 ⭐️

We have been ordering for a while
But haven’t had a chance to pop by
Last night we did & It was great.

We were greeted by the friendly staff
And given plenty of time to choose
What we wanted to order

Our normal go to order is
Curry sauce & Chips
And various donburis

But this time we opted to be
A little more experimental.

We ordered Duck baos,
Beef & Cheese corn dog
And Chicken Katsu buldak burger

The server Zaki was kind enough
To give us a discount too
As well us banana ketchup
And sweet chilli sauce.

Everything tasted unique
Our only feedback would be

To make the hoisin sauce a little
Lighter in the duck baos
As one had too much sauce.

We will definitely be back
Whenever we can
And we recommend trying
Nasi Isda, If you still haven’t

Best wishes, Always
-✨

This place looks expensive from the outside, but the prices are very low.  The corn dogs tasted very good.  They have selection of juices, carbonated drinks, boba tea and Ramune drinks too.  Very clean place and the young guy serving us today (16/02/26) was very friendly and nice.  And you can eat in.

Finally managed to experience some items at Nasi Isda on New Road, closer to Whitechapel Market than Aldgate East. No exaggeration when I say I will be back as there's so much more left on the menu to try. I absolutely loved the bao buns, inari packets (messy to eat), sticky fried rice and the udon beef noodles. The Korean bbq flavour is sweet while the Bulgori is spicy. Wash your food down with a selection of drinks and fruit teas - the litchi fruit tea was delicious. I appreciate how clean and calm the interior is as I am not a fan of busy hectic environments. The staff were quiet but professional. Also, the shop has some steps leading up to it, and there's  seating available outside. Not forgetting to mention  the whole menu is Halal and there's no alcohol served in the premise nor is it a BYOB establishment. I will be recommending this shop to my family and friends and hope you all will also give it a try.

I ordered the beef donburi and cheese corndog. I enjoyed the corndog, it was freshly made. The cheese was melted all the way through. I didn’t enjoy the taste and consistency of the donburi. I will order something else next time. Staff were really friendly. I had a question about the ingredients and the staff member serving me assured me the donburi sauce was made in house with no mirin.
Food was great. Price snd portion translated well. The chef was very kind. The boba was also great. A good place to sit and eat with a unique and fresh menu.

I have visited this place twice now. The food was delicious both times. Probably one of the best checken buns I’ve tried so far.. so fluffy. The Katsu  was also very tasty and the portion size was big. I went in my lunch break and the atmosphere was very relaxing with dim lighting and quiet music, and the service was super friendly. The second time I went I ordered the kimchi rice and forgot to take a picture but it was maybe even better than the katsu.

A lovely, chilled, and quiet restaurant amid the busyness of Liverpool Street. I’ve been to this place a few times since 2020, and every visit has been a great experience. The menu is varied, and everything I’ve tried has been delicious. The service is efficient and friendly, and the prices are super affordable. Highly recommend — it’s a little hidden gem.

Great food and service! My favorite were the fried pancakes , so delicious !
Little comment: FRiED tofu bibimbap would be a great veggie option to have !

We had a great time at this restaurant with my family. The staff were very friendly and welcoming, and the atmosphere was warm and comfortable.
The food was delicious and everyone enjoyed their meal. The service was quick and efficient.
I would definitely recommend this place for a family dinner!
Delicious food. I loved the flavor and how tasty it was. Highly recommended! 🤩
Lovely staff, I am so happy to have a place like this serving sashimi in my area.   The chicken Karan curry is a huge portion and well priced!  Whenever u feel like sushi, I’ll be coming here.

This restaurant might be the best kept secret in London, I’ll would definitely advise to go there for lunch, supper or midnight-snack! Especially with kids. They are very kind and can tailor the  meal just the way your kids like it 👌🏻  ⭐ ⭐ 🌟 ⭐ ⭐
Best place for HALAL sushi. Their food is amazing and the staff are so friendly. 💯

Had to grab a quick dinner and this place did not disappoint, East Asian soul food hit the spot, the ramen soup was delicious.

Service is great, boss man was very professional and disciplined in his craft and provided excellent customer service.

Tried this place recently and was pleasantly surprised! The sushi roll was beautifully plated with a nice crunch from the crispy topping, and the wasabi and pickled ginger were fresh. The presentation had that upscale feel without being over the top. The dumplings were the star for me though—soft, juicy, and paired perfectly with the spicy red sauce in the center. Flavors were well-balanced, and everything tasted freshly made.

name: Pham Sushi
address: The Heron, 5 Moor Ln, London EC2Y 9AP, UK

reviews.text:
Really high quality sushi at very reasonable prices. I've been visiting one branch or another of Pham Sushi for over 20 years. It's the place where I fell in love with sushi and its standards have not dropped.

I usually order for delivery now but visited here a couple of months ago and really enjoyed the experience. The service is polite and knowledgeable and the restaurant looks good.

We had a combination of sushi and saahimi6 and tempura and EVERYTHING was perfect. I'd keep returning as long as they keep doing what they do so well.

Highly Recommend!
Superb service from start to finish. Bibek and Radha was looking after us very well! Thank you.
The food was fresh, delicious, and beautifully presented. Cocktails were spot on — especially the margarita with a twist! Can’t wait to come back.

Amazing sushi and atmosphere! We came here after the Barbican and we were so impressed with the high quality food and service. Everyone was absolutely lovely (Bibek is a legend), the crunchy tuna roll is unreal and the mango margarita was amazing. They even do a happy hour! Deffo rec for anyone pre or post Barbican visit :)

Fine sushi place but service needs serious improvement.

Would not recommend the escolar appetizer since the tasty mashrooms completely overpower the sushi.

The spicy salmon Truffle is a good choice. Pham special, mid.

Service : slow, inaccurate - had to come back multiple time to correct order because drinks and food choices were not available, and forgetful, not all the dishes made it.

I really really hesitate to leave this review because I want to keep this secret to myself but people should know that, in my humble opinion, out of all the sushi places I have been to in London, this is the best sushi place in London. A hidden gem. Unpretentious, no photos in the menu,, no Michelin stars, it’s just great quality fish that melts in your mouth, beautifully prepared and a great tempura ice cream to finish. A lovely little sake menu too with friendly staff.

Gourmet sushi has lost my business. I order from Gourmet sushi regularly - it's my favourite sushi place in London. You can see from my order history that I mainly order from them only. Bear in mind that my partner also orders through his account as well.

Today, I ordered 4 rolls through uber eats. When my driver turned up, only two rolls had arrived and they were the wrong ones. THEY SENT ME SOMEONE ELSE'S ORDER.

We called the restaurant and asked them to resend the order and they refused. Our driver had also offered to go back to the restaurant and redeliver it to us and they refused. They were rude and condescending over the phone and at one point, said "All you are saying is blah, blah, blah". They refused to refund us and wanted us to order with them AGAIN so that they could send the food with another courier. I don't understand why I have to pay EXTRA FOR YOU TO SEND ME THE RIGHT FOOD.

What a shame. Shameful customer service, shameful etiquette.

SHAME SHAME SHAME.

To the lady who answered the phone at 8:15pm on 8/3/26 - I hope the owner reads this review and talks to you about your attitude. Even if you did send the food, I would be scared to eat the food after how you talked to me on the phone.

I have ordered MANY TIMES with Gourmet sushi and I am so disappointed. You will never get my money again and I will make sure my friends and family also do not order from you again.

I visited Gourmet Sushi last Saturday and had a really great experience. The food was absolutely delicious, but what truly made the visit stand out was the service.
Sangita, who served me, was incredibly polite, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. She really went the extra mile to make sure everything was perfect, and I felt like a truly valued customer throughout the evening.
In a city like London where there are many places to get good sushi, it’s the service that makes the real difference. Because of Sangita’s professionalism and warm attitude, this visit felt special. I will definitely be coming back.
Thank you for such a lovely experience.

Very nice service and great sushi! The location is convenient, not far from the main center and streets. Inside, there's a place to sit and take a break. The ingredients complement each other well. The service was excellent. 👌🏻🍱
Amazing sushi place! The food is so fresh and delicious. Very generous portion sizes too and amazing takeaway packaging

A small restaurant with very limited seating but had enough availability when I visited. The staff was very friendly and helpful. The vegan sushi box and aloe vera drink were excellent.
They're currently offering discounted prices to walk in customers.

I had a wonderful experience at Itsu, and I especially want to appreciate Mubin for his outstanding hospitality.
From the moment I walked in, he was polite, welcoming, and very professional. He made sure everything was perfect and helped with a genuine smile. His positive attitude and excellent customer service really made my visit special.
It’s staff members like Mubin who make customers want to come back again. Thank you for such amazing service!
Highly recommended!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Thanks to Rajiv for special service.
Had an amazing visit last week. Food was fresh, tasty, and served quickly.
The team were welcoming, helpful, and made the experience even better. Clean, calm atmosphere with great customer service.
Highly recommend and will definitely be back again!

Absolutely fantastic experience at itsu Aldgate! I ordered salmon full house and chicken teriyaki and That was incredibly fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. Every dish tasted clean and perfectly balanced — you can really tell they use high-quality ingredients. The sushi was fresh, the hot dishes were delicious, and everything felt light yet satisfying. And specially thanks to RAJIV.

Jari provided the best customer service known to mankind. When you have tears in your eyes and require some extra sauce on your sushi, he can magically create this situation. May his pillow always be cool and the promotions arrive QUICKLY!

Maybe it is healthy but the hard undercooked rice and unpleasant taste of my chicken rice bowl meant I did not actually enjoy my meal at all, I just ate it to avoid wasting the money I had paid for it. Dumplings were better. Not in a hurry to go back there.

name: So Japanese Private Dining
address: So Japanese, 5 Middlesex St, London E1 7AA, UK

reviews.text: A rare taste of Japan in London, paired with that hard-to-find Japanese warmth and hospitality. The perfectly grilled unagi don—every bite reminded me of Kyoto: sweet, smoky, melt-in-the-mouth goodness. The photos speak for themselves. Thank you, So, for such a delicious weekend 🍱🤍

One of the best meals I’ve eaten! I ordered cod and it was divine!😍 Definitely will come back. Also, great staff and atmosphere. If you want a calm, relaxing evening with a very tasty food you should definitely visit this place.

For my birthday, I decided to try Japanese cuisine for the very first time in a non-westernised, non-commercialised restaurant in which a true taste of Japan could be properly experienced. Their menu was limited but with good reason as they perfected what they served, embodying the phrase ‘less is more.’ I am beyond happy to say that the So restaurant in London delivered every part of my culinary desires combined with friendly and attentive customer service!

Upon arrival with my dad and brother, we were welcomed with all the kind hospitality needed to warm us up on a chilly autumn’s evening. The staff were few but exceptionally gifted in their dedication to every customer, always smiling and happy to serve, creating a tranquil atmosphere that put us at ease immediately. They were very understanding of our lack of experience with Japanese cuisine and patiently explained their menu to us in detail. I was deeply interested in their Unagi Kabayaki (grilled eel with a sweet savoury glaze) ever since I saw it in a food show based in Japan. I never thought you could find such a specialty dish in England and was drawn to the So restaurant for this specific reason. They served it to me in an Una Ju form (grilled eel served on top of rice in a rice box) and it did not disappoint! The texture of the rice was fluffy and creamy, combining with the flavours of the grilled eel perfectly. It was cooked beautifully with a slightly charred skin concealing within a white, buttery meat that melted in my mouth. I highly recommend this dish to anyone visiting. We also tried the sushi (Nigiri), including the bluefin tuna, yellowtail, and salmon, all of which were clean tasting and rich in texture. The bluefin tuna and salmon were the highlights for me. Finally, we finished the meal with an assortment of desserts, including the matcha chocolate cake and hojicha terrine, delightfully recommended to us by the lovely lady serving us. She surprised me with a happy birthday message and song along with all the other staff! They also generously blessed us with one dessert and some genmaicha (roasted brown rice green tea) on the house as a most welcome surprise.

I was truly comforted and satisfied by the end of my visit and can honestly say that coming to the So restaurant was the highlight of my birthday. It was worth every penny spent! My only regret is that I did not get to thank the lovely lady who served us with such heartfelt warmth for the incredible meal - If you’re reading this, thank you so much for making my birthday an extra special one! Your kindness completed our experience with you. After all, what is a beautifully crafted meal if not united with all the warmth and hospitality you showed toward us on such a special day?

I will definitely be visiting again in the near future.

The best Japanese meal I have ever eaten!
The food was absolutely delicious and so carefully prepared. The staff were so welcoming and lovely. I can’t recommend this beautiful restaurant enough! Will definitely be back :)

The best Unagi rice that I have had in London 😋highly recommended👍🏻will come back for that again.

Hojicha Terrine is also very yummy, good for 2 people to share.

Dashimaki ommelette was a bit different from the one that I tried in Japan, the taste is not bad.

Good environment and nice staff, have a great time there.

name: Bamboo Sushi
address: 149a Cannon St Rd, London E1 2LX, UK

reviews.text:
Tried the chicken katsu curry and prawn sushi here and both were honestly great. The katsu curry came out piping hot, with crispy chicken that was still soft inside and a rich curry sauce that hit just right. It had a nice balance of sweetness and spice, and the rice soaked it up perfectly. The portion was solid too, filling but not heavy.

The prawn sushi was fresh and clean tasting. The rice had the perfect texture and just the right amount of vinegar, and the prawns were sweet and tender. You can tell they take care with how they prepare and plate things because everything looked neat and appetising.

Staff were friendly and checked in without hovering, which I appreciated. The place itself felt calm, tidy and relaxed, a good spot for lunch or a casual dinner. Prices were fair for the quality you get.

If you like Japanese food or just want something comforting and well made, I’d definitely recommend this place. The katsu curry is proper comfort food and the prawn sushi was a nice surprise. I’ll definitely be coming back.

We were looking forward to trying
Sushi from Bamboo Sushi for a while
As we had only heard good things

We ordered online & Everything arrived
Well packaged & Presented.

But the chicken katsu uramaki
Tasted strange & Unpleasant

Everything else was good
We passed on the feedback
& Hope that our future experiences
Are much more positive

Best wishes to everyone at
Bamboo Sushi
-✨

We visited the Beckton branch on new years eve. The sushi here is out of this world, service is amazing. Especially from Abdul, he was so polite and very accommodating to helping us order! Glad we were able to start the new years with the best sushi ever! Very pleasant experience and i would recommend this place for everyone! :)

Ordered via uber eats -

They didnt pack the drink well and it leaked. The bag ripped and everything fell through and onto the floor, as you can see from the picture.

Won't be ordering from them again

Bamboo Sushi is an absolute gem. The food is consistently excellent, and the katsu curry is really, really yummy — rich, comforting, and perfectly balanced every single time. It’s one of those dishes you keep coming back for because it never disappoints.

What truly elevates the experience, though, is the service. Jumma is always so welcoming, friendly, and attentive. She remembers you, makes you feel genuinely looked after, and brings such a warm, positive energy to the place.

Great food, great atmosphere, and outstanding service — Bamboo Sushi never misses. Highly recommended.

Yuzu Restaurant is an absolute gem and an experience I can’t recommend highly enough!
The standout of the evening was undoubtedly the exceptional service provided by the  young waitress, MAISHA. She was warm, attentive, and genuinely passionate about making our dining experience memorable. Her professionalism combined with a friendly, welcoming demeanor made me and my partner feel truly taken care of. If I could rate her service 100/100, I certainly would!! she went above and beyond in every possible way.
As for the food—wow. The Yuzu sushi set was nothing short of spectacular. Each piece was beautifully presented, incredibly fresh, and bursting with flavor. Every bite was mouth-watering and perfectly balanced, washed down with 2 pints of  cold Asahi!!
Yuzu Japanese Restaurant delivers excellence on every level, outstanding food, a wonderful atmosphere, and truly top-tier service. Thanks to Maisha and the incredible kitchen team, this was a dining experience I’ll be thinking about for a long time and one I’ll definitely be returning for.

Yuzu was a great restaurant and I loved my experience there. Went on a Thursday after work with no reservation and managed to get a seat facing the chefs. The waitresses were super lovely and the chefs were so nice! The selection of food was great, but what was the best was the FRESH and DELICIOUS sushi!!! I cannot explain but it just hit different from take away / store sushi. We had the seared sea bass (melted in your mouth), sushi set and the crunchy crab sushi. All was absolutely delicious and filled me up. If you do there, the sushi sets are really worth it as everything else is a bit pricy but still all VERY YUMMY!!

Disappointing overall. Whilst the waiter was lovely and the interior was clean and stylish, the food was mediocre at best at a very high price.

Nigiri were quite small and the fish was okay. The eel rice was just disappointing as it was from a packet and served in a tiny bowl of rice for £10.50.

Not worth the money

The service at this restaurant truly stands out. The young, beautiful waitresses were exceptionally attentive, friendly, and professional, adding a warm, personal touch that made our visit feel genuinely special. Their dedication elevated the entire dining experience. On top of that, the food was absolutely incredible—every dish was bursting with flavour and expertly prepared. I highly recommend this restaurant for its top-notch service and delicious cuisine!

Paper thin sashimi.. I’ve never had such thin slices of sashimi in my life, £16 for 5 super thin slices of sashimi is absurd. Even Sushi Samba is cheaper than that. It tasted nice though the price is not justified. The toilet design was also weird, you could peak into the women’s toilet because there are cracks on the door. The waitress also made a mistake on our bill, charged a pint when we ordered half a pint.

Ordered through Uber Eats where it has lots of good reviews - all the fish was mushy and tasted the same. Some of the sushi pieces were just not right and had to be spat out. There was weird stringy white stuff in the tuna. Imagine it's made in a factory off-site with supermarket sushi, not on site, tasted like it. Not sure why it had Shoreditch in the title, it's nowhere near it.
Customer service is exceptionally friendly. The sushi was fresh, prepared well and just gorgeous :)

Have been ordering from here for about a year now. My go to sushi place, even though we were living quite far. Great quality, tasty, cutest packaging. I only order Special sushi, as they are the best value/quality/price product. Recommend to everyone!

Genuinely no idea how this place has decent reviews, this is singlehandedly the worst ramen I have ever eaten. It’s not even ramen, it’s actually udon with horrible broth and unseasoned vegetables. Maybe this is just how food in the uk is but my god it’s horrendous I wouldn’t even pay one pound.
Got a takeaway from here today, was so lovely. The packaging is so cute and the size of all the fish was lovely thick and big.

Hands down one of the best food stall in Brick Lane. Good value for money, delicious food and friendly, efficient service. Chicken Katsu, pumpkin koroke Katsu and sushi are all delicious. I always order extra to take home. Highly recommend!

Very delicious food(chicken and prawn Katsu curry, Ramen, pumkin Katsu curry, chicken and prawn Katsu rice, selection of delicious fresh sushi, with watering mixed gyozas), smily service and diffn drink (aloevera juice, coconut water, sparkling water) apart from other cold drinks.

well , This is my first time visit in brick lane market with  my friends  on Sunday and I ordered Ramen soup my friends ordered Chicken katsu curry and and another one pick the sushi box. Everything we ordered mix and match. This was one of the amazing meal that me and my friends took. we all are very satisfied. The meal was fresh and delicious. Now we will go once in a week to eat meal after class finished. final part i love the way of served meal with smile face.
The best sushi in East London! I love these guys. No other sushi compares. This is my weekend treat. They are always friendly and the selection is great.
Super super delicious chicken katsu - always very tasty! The guy who owns the stall is very lovely too! Always friendly!

You can never go wrong with jollof rice, plantain, and chicken - a big portion for £8 only! Beautiful and delicious, the plantains by themselves would be £2. The owner was super nice and friendly.

It’s a little tight inside to walk around, but very cosy!
JOLLOF & BEEF WAS AMAZING! Service quick and easy and even came out to my car when it was ready. Thank you. They are so kind and flavours were 10/10
First time trying this place and it was delicious! The lady at the front was lovely and helped me choose a great meal. Will definitely be back
SOOOOO TASTY！highly recommend

Was unsure about trying this place but I am happy I did. Jollof was delicious cooked perfectly, pounded yam and pepper soup was great too. I think it is a decent price for what it is, great portions and the meat is actually meat pieces rather than grissle. Will definitely be ordering again!
I came here with my husband to eat their dibi west african food I also ate the nems fataya I appreciated the atmosphere it was fantastic, we will definitely come back with our friends

name: Enish Shoreditch
address: 1c, Unit 5 Cremer St, London E2 8GX, UK

reviews.text:
Friendly hospitality from the staff who treated us plantain chips with hummus.

The dishes had very nice presentation too.

However, most of the dishes were overly salty. The pork belly dish had a rather porky taste.

The music was very loud, making it a bit hard to have a conversation. The lighting was very bright and white, so the ambience wasn’t really the best either.

Stopped by for a quick lunch. Had jollof rice with assorted meats, and a side of fried plantain. Food was flavorful, meat was tender, though it was surprisingly spicy, something to take note. We got surprised with some puff puff on the house at the end, which we really enjoyed.

Music was a bit loud for our liking but I think that's the vibe they're going for. Nora was great on service, friendly and helpful.

We had an awesome time at the Shoreditch branch Nora and Feyi were incredible and our food was spectacular. It came out so quickly and the portion size was a lot more than I expected. Would defo recommend and will be back!

The restaurant is a bit tuck away and difficult to see from the street but is worth a visit. Very nice and attentive staff who was great at recommendations and listening to our needs. The food was delicious, especially the plantain based brownie which was to die for. Amazing mocktails with a great selection to choose from. Lovely music, just a tiny bit loud but the staff kindly put the volume slightly down. Would recommend!

Ivory Seasons Restaurant and Lounge by Enish is the go-to place in London. Love how welcoming the place is, the presentation and quality of  food served, thus the refreshed decor adds a premium touch to my whole experience. Highly recommended, 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟.

suya jerks in aldgate is hand down the best suya i’ve had in a while. Vibes in there are immaculate from the music to staff. my friend and i were served by an amazing bartender called Ernest who was attentive and friendly. presentation did not disappoint! of course my camera had to eat first🤪.
I live the food here, it’s a great vibe, great customer service from Ernest, he is the best and knows how to make great cocktails

Firstly, the Restaurant was so small! I’m downstairs wasn’t opened to customers as There was a private event going on, knowing this information, I’m not sure why the restaurant lets so many people in the small seating area upstairs, Making it so cramped.  I’m downstairs wasn’t opened to customers as I was a private event going onEnded up having people standing over me when I’m trying to eat at my table and people tripping over my chair.  Slowest service I’ve ever received, The cocktails were horrible. I got the five for £10 cocktails, We are expected to receive different drinks each time but three of them were the same one. The other two were the same, they couldn’t even make five different cocktails. They all tasted like medicine. It was definitely the worst cocktails I’ve ever had. We requested different drinks when we noticed we were receiving the same thing, but The end of the day when you receive two types of cocktails As ignored the request. The wait time between each drink was over 30 minutes. And upon arrival, we waited 50 minutes to be served to start with. I will definitely not be coming back. The only good thing I’ll say, is that the Main was decent and so was One on the DJs, Sandy B.👍 But the desert tasted like cheap chocolate cake, Bear in mind we ordered brownies But received a slice of chocolate cake-.  Also in terms of the starters, those were bad lacking seasoning and the wings were dry. Overall I wouldn’t recommend it, might as well get food somewhere else , Or if you happen to be passing by you can just get the mains.
Ernest was extremely attentive to my friends and I while we were there. We had such a lovely time and can’t wait to be back soon!
Service was good. Really nice Smokey Jollof and beautiful tender suya. Mac and cheese was fluffy and cheesy. The chapman was delicious I had three.

Came here based off positive reviews but wasn't entirely blown away. Food tasted alright and smelled like a lot of liquid smoke was used to give it a smokey Jollof feel. Had it with beef which was nice and tender. The food was not entirely what I anticipated. Server was nice.
the food was so good i genuinely loved it like best food there, if I lived in London i think i would go here every day. I hope you lot one day come to cambridge so you can sell the “love of lagos”

Best jollof rice I've ever had. The flavour balance is everything with a lovely spicy kick to it. Supper chuffed that they offered vegan options with spinach and fried plantain. Ever since I've visited at the market I think about it every day. One of the best meals I've ever had and a huge portion too!
Easy to locate using my Google map, very large portion of meal, and the meal was so sumptuous. I was fortunate to add the plantain and beef 🤭. Overall, I will visit again when next I visit London.

The Jollof rice tasted like it came straight from a packet. It was quite smoky, a bit too much for my liking. You only got one or two pieces of plantain, and the chicken was quite dry inside. If you’re looking for authentic African food, this probably isn’t the place. However, if you’re looking for something quick, this might be for you. I came on my lunch, so maybe that’s why it wasn’t up to standard.

name: The Jollof Man
address: Upmarket, 83 Brick Ln, London E1 6QR, UK

reviews.text:
I like african food, and this west african streetfood restaurant is very good place to discover when you are nearby this market place.

The staff was very nice and food tasted awesome. I really liked that it was possible to choose combination of multiple options.

They have meat and vegan food as well. And incredible tasty plantains. It is bit spicy, but not too hot (including jollof rice).
There are many tables to sit. I would definitely come again when I am back in London.

Absolutely fantastic Senegalese food with bold, comforting flavours. The jollof rice is rich, smoky, and perfectly spiced; clearly cooked with care and tradition. Portions are generous, ingredients taste fresh, and every bite feels soulful and satisfying.

The chicken is tender and well-seasoned, and the sauces bring real depth without overpowering the dish. You can tell this is proper West African cooking, not watered down for convenience.

Great value for money, friendly service, and food that genuinely makes you want to come back. If you’re into African cuisine or just want something different from the usual options, this is a must-try. Highly recommended. 🔥🍚🇸🇳
Incredible food with both vegan and meat options. Great portion size for the price and the owner is so nice and friendly! 10/10 recommend this if you are visiting London !

I visited today with my daughter and we both loved the food! We had the Maafe with jollof rice, salad and plantain which was hearty, filling and had an amazing flavour. My daughter even went back to get some more plantain as it was so good!
The Jollof Man was very friendly and clearly has a passion for cooking. Overall lovely food 😋

Went for lunch twice, both times the guys were so nice and friendly :)))) food was DELISH and well portioned; I felt very full after and fair for the price. Rice, stew, salad and plantain all in one meal. And no wait since it’s in the food market

The food was delicious and you can get a good portion for less than £10. This place is a great choice if you want something warm, affordable, tasty and made with love in the Old Street.

Joy, the Nigerian lady who serves the food, is absolutely delightful and so welcoming. She has the kindest heart and the warmest smile which brightens up your day.

The City Jollof Old St is just a small street stall and the food is affordable, so it’s worth supporting a small business owner if you can! Joy seems like such a good person, you won’t regret it!

It's small food stall which deserves more recognition.

Lady serving food there is great: smiling and polite, you can have a small convo with her. Seems she is happy.

Food was very good, full of varied flavours, generous portion too. Bit spicy, what I liked. Rice was a bit dry but overall it was yummy meal, highly recommend.

Delicious food with generous servings. The service here is always so friendly. Would recommend anyone to get a meal here. The jollof is seasoned perfectly, and the plantain was cooked slightly more to preference.

Great beef jollof, with salad, plantain and homemade chilli sauce.
Seems like a family run place and relatively new (owner mentioned they'd been going for four months which explains the lack of reviews)
Had the beef Jollof today. Good portions. Great price. Fresh tasting food. Need to come back!

The £8 Jollof with lamb has good flavour however the portion size of the lamb has become unacceptable. £5 for Jollof rice and an extra £3 for lamb. You now get 3 pieces so £1 each. On this occasion, they were very chewable and I’d say only 60% of the lamb was inedible, either chewy/boney/fatty. I don’t think I’ll be coming back as it has been the second time.

Great food and fast service. Tried veg/vegan and chicken jollof rice with plantain. Jollof was perfectly seasoned, plantain was sweet and juicy, and topped it with tomato and spicy sauce which were excellent additions!

Overall a good portion, tasty and fresh.
However found the jollof to be a bit starchy in flavour and not quite soft enough. Like the quality of rice wasn't amazing.Flavour was more tangy than rounded, depends on your preference but I prefer a rounded deep flavour. Chicken was well cooked and tender.

Inconsistencies with the toppings, they ran out of a few things and served it as is rather than restocking.

Service moved quite slow compared to other vendors in the area.

From the moment I walked into Jollof Kingdom, I knew I was in for something special. The aroma alone was enough to get my mouth watering. The staff were warm, welcoming, and genuinely passionate about the food they serve — and it shows in every bite.

I had the classic jollof rice with spicy grilled chicken, and it was hands down the best I’ve ever tasted. Perfectly cooked rice with just the right amount of spice, rich tomato flavor, and that unmistakable smoky undertone that sets authentic jollof apart. The chicken was juicy, flavorful, and fell right off the bone.

The portions were generous, the presentation was spot-on, and the vibe in the restaurant was vibrant and inviting. Whether you’re already a fan of West African cuisine or trying it for the first time, Jollof Kingdom is a must-visit. You can tell they put love into every dish.

Five stars all the way — I’ll definitely be back!

Warm and hearty West African food. Auntie serving the food had a smile that would light up any room. The food didn't just feed my stomach, but also my soul. Great spot tucked away in front of a Sainsburys, and next to the O2 Academy.

We orderd last night for a group of 5 adults and 2 children (6 portions of lamb shoulder with rice) for iftar.
We would have loved to have rated this restaurant 5 stars but unfortunately the lamb shoulder disappointed us. We have had better tasting lamb from other Somali restaurants in the local area. It wasn't bad but it lacked marination / flavourings. The rice itself was fine and the green sauce was very spicy but also seemed to lack flavour slightly. Perhaps it was just a bad day for this restaurant but as all adults agreed the taste of the lamb shoulder wasn't on par with the other Somali restaurants we have tried, it put us off from ordering here again. I hope my feedback helps to improve the quality of the taste. The service we had no complaints about. Our order arrived early and there were no problems with the Uber driver finding our house.

Just grabbed a takeaway for iftar with my family—everything was delicious! The lamb was incredibly tender, falling right off the bone. We had both the pasta and rice platters, and they did not disappoint. Definitely coming back soon!

They only sent 1 beef suqaar instead of 3, and 1 chicken suqaar that I never ordered. They didn't send any chicken steak either. So one wrong meal and 2 missing meals.
Deliveroo refused to refund.
I spent £73.
Shameful.

Went for Sunday Jamaican Brunch and Bottomless Booze - SHOREDITCH.

Good food, good service, good music! Value for money

Location easy to find. Friendly, polite, accommodating staff - Kamar was a great host. Everything we had tasted good, food came in good timing, cups kept full. Gluten free options. Would definitely return.

Free parking on Boot street on Sundays, 3min walk away

We ate at Ma Petite Jamaica last night and it was genuinely one of the best meals we’ve had in London.

From the moment we walked in, the service was impeccable. The host, Kamahl, was hilarious and made the whole experience even better. You felt welcomed, looked after, and like the night actually mattered.

The food was on another level. The spice, the depth of flavour, everything was perfectly balanced. It honestly felt like a religious experience. And the jerked chicken… holy phuck. 🔥🔥🔥

Easy 5 out of 5. We’ll absolutely be back.

Cannot fault a single thing, so glad we made the decision to call in after passing and viewing the menu! Food was incredible staff so friendly and welcoming, if we lived locally this would definitely be a regular of ours. Cannot recommend it more!

The food was so delicious. Really good portion sizes left very full. Service was nice and friendly staff all around. Enjoyed the music it was at a good volume to where you can hear it and boogie but not too loud you can’t hear each other talk. Toilets were also clean. Will definitely be returning again!
Delicious food and lovely atmosphere. Staff are friendly and helpful. The manager is humourous and chatting but some customers might find some of his humour cheeky or slightly insulting

The Cottons Club team went above and beyond to make our cousin's wedding reception a roaring success. The food was absolutely outstanding and the Manager allowed us to add 6 extra guests at the last minute. We were able to use their PA system for the speeches and music. The interior design looks great in our photos and the bar staff were very friendly. Can't recommend this place highly enough. Thank you so much

I had a really wonderful experience here. Coming from New York and having visited Jamaica, I’ve had quite a bit of experience tasting Jamaican food and I have to say- this place makes great food and prepares great drinks. I ordered a 2 for 1 rum punch which was tasty with a nice kick from the rum. I was accidentally brought the oxtails, I can’t comment on how it tastes but it looks great. I ordered the mixed jerk platter for 1 which I enjoyed, I also had a slice of macaroni pie. I typically don’t enjoy rice but I really enjoyed their rice and peas, you can really taste the coconut flavor from the coconut milk which I loved. The jerked meats were prepared very nicely, you can tell that the food has been marinated properly, everything was tender and falling right off the bone. The chicken was very juicy and the plantains were fresh and crunchy. It was very nice that one of the staff members overheard that it was my birthday and brought me out two shots. I look forward to returning here if I have another chance on my trip, highly recommended. 5 ⭐️ indoor and outdoor seating available.

Went to the bottomless brunch at Cottons Shoreditch with a friend and honestly had such a great time! The food was delicious – the jerk chicken was the highlight for me, packed with flavour. Drinks were strong, generous, and kept flowing the whole time (let’s just say I didn’t leave walking straight 🤣). The atmosphere was lively, with everyone around clearly having a good time. Perfect spot if you want good vibes, tasty food, and plenty of drinks

Fantastic drinks and vibe. I had a spiced roots which was 10/10. Perfect place for drinks after dinner, good chill/rnb music. Drinks menu well curated around rum. Jeremy gave us perfect service, served us beautiful drinks, and was very sweet even though we were a rowdy group. Thank you very much!

If you haven’t been here you are missing out. Genuinely one of the BEST meals I’ve had in a long time. We ordered the Salmon and Mutton main dishes with the Halloumi and jerk chicken spring rolls. We kept humming to the food and I’m a good cook but I cannot make this food at home it is THAT GOOD. The only thing better was Shaq and Andy who made our experience amazing! It felt like having a personal chef recommend the best dishes, and tweak their existing dishes to our taste. Their knowledge and charisma blew me away, the service is unrivalled and the attention to detail is next to none. They have won themselves a regular, thank you so so much!

Been here multiple times in the last couple months, the portions are perfect, the Jerk Chicken, rice, peas and veg are soo good together with the sauce they use. Owner is very cool and helpful and the music just adds to the atmosphere you'd expect at a quality spot like this. Definitely give them a try.

Amazing food! Lovely service! Very friendly. Had curry goat was 10/10 also Jerk chicken; was superb, and the beef stew was amazing too. Their homemade chilli sauce was amazing, very spicy! Halal food loved it.

Amazing new addition to the area. Amazing food. I loved it and the owners are super lovely. I love the jerk chicken, rice and peas, plantain and coleslaw. The sauce on the chicken was really good too. Definitely come back.

Nice spot for some Jamaican food. The food was delicious ! I had really tender curry goat and my boyfriend had the jerk chicken. Also, the rice and peas was so tasty and comforting. The ambiance is casual, but the service is kind and friendly.  Thanks again !
Amazing food with authentic Caribbean flavours, and the hospitality was beyond exceptional. The staff were warm, welcoming, and made the whole experience memorable. Highly recommended!

name: Dub Pan (Boxpark Shoreditch)
address: 2-10 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E1 6GY, UK

reviews.text: The food was really enjoyable and was great value for the money spent. I enjoyed my meal but my company was not fond of the rice. The rum cocktail was a standout as it really caught us by surprise with how good/strong it was. The atmosphere was pretty loud, as you’d expect from a place like this, but it added to the vibe. Definitely enjoyed the visit and would go again if I’m in the area.

Incredible experience, food and drinks weee great! Rima was incredibly knowledgable of the menu for both food and drinks; providing both great knowledge and service. Most likely The best service I’ve received in a long time, would definitely recommend to those visiting box park in Shoreditch!

It looks like carribean food but that’s as far as it goes. The two stars are because the plantain was decent but let’s be honest if you can’t fry plain rain the world has gone crazy.

Curry goat was too salty and full of bones. Festival was too oily and not fresh.

It’s a nice spot but I am guessing change of ownership and kitchen because the food was poor.
Not complaints. Some of best jerk I’ve had. Jerk chicken sandwich was good. Tasty sauce. Spicy but not too spicy. Rice was kinda dry tbh though. But good service. Alcohol drink they had was very
Food was so delicious and Robyn the server, was lovely, explained the menu and made sure we enjoyed our late lunch. Definitely recommend. :)

Being a seasoned food blogger, I try my best to promote black businesses which is why I occasionally buy patties from here on the way home from work. Everytime I go, the service is always terrible. No eye contact , uninterested, attitude, almost like they are working against their will. Even if you come in cheerful.
I always ask if they have any patties that have just come out of the oven, response you get is , "they all came out at the same time" unhelpful information. Today I proceeded to get one but why is it being put in the microwave to reheat and also with the paper around. When I got the patty,  it was still cold and I took it back and said I didnt want it, the staff member collected it and threw it away. I came back asking to have a new one, she said I had to pay again , I asked for a lesser priced item , she still said I needed to pay. I didnt make a fuss and left.
Will I be going back any time soon, definitely not. The food when done right is okay but after this, I wouldn't be recommending to anyone

4.0 | the patty shops in London so far have been deeply disappointing. mostly because folks are heating up patties in a microwave in a BAKERY, and accepting this blasphemy. I have gone to a few that come highly recommended and as a Jamaican who has grown up on patty my whole life, I died a little inside when offered microwaved patty. although I was asked at this location as well, I made a note to request whatever patty had just come out the oven because they were actively baking behind the counter. lucky for me that was the curry goat patty and I am so glad I tried it. it was flaky, though the crust also has a soft inside. I was happy to experience a patty that almost burned my tongue, because that’s what should happen! they are bringing back the bake in bakery. happy to have spotted this place on my last visit and come back now living here and still enjoy it!

As a Black woman, I really appreciate finding places that serve authentic, flavourful Caribbean food, and Jamaican Patty & Co did not disappoint. The patties were fresh, flavourful, and packed with proper Jamaican seasoning that tastes like home. The staff are welcoming and friendly — I met an employee called Destinee during my visit and she was an angel! Meeting her made my experience even nicer. It’s definitely one of my favourite spots for a comforting, delicious meal.

flaky, well-seasoned, and full of flavour — the spicy beef patty  and jerk chicken meal are standouts. Good value for money and nice vegan options too. Service is always great. Would definitely come back.

Had such a lovely experience at Jamaican Patty Co at Liverpool Street thanks to the young girls serving today. They were incredibly friendly, polite and patient, with a really positive attitude that instantly makes you feel welcome. They took the time to help, handled everything efficiently, and did it all with a genuine smile. Service like that honestly makes such a difference — they’re a real credit to the team. And of course, the patties were delicious too. Will definitely be back!

Wow! We were absolutely blown away by the phenomenal food. While the incredibly generous portions meant we were satisfyingly full quite quickly, every single bite was a taste sensation. We happily packed up five containers of the amazing dishes we couldn't quite finish - a testament to how much we enjoyed it! The steak, lamb chops, and tandoori chicken were all cooked beautifully, and the chips and sauces were the perfect accompaniment. Saurav, our server, was fantastic - so attentive and helpful, making our meal even more memorable. Highly recommend!"
Only issue was chicken pamrasean was bit dry. Not sure why. Otherwise service and wings was great.

The food combines South Asian, Caribbean and African in a novel and interesting way, and the decor and vibe is great.  We went mid afternoon and the place was empty so didn’t have the vibe we’ve noticed a previous visit.  But the service was good and the helpings were generous.

The staff were very rude. I asked to speak to the manager, they directed me towards a guy in the kitchen. He was also very rude. I told them my food is very salty, exceeding the recommended salt intake, possibly a health risk too in a single intake. But the staff responded with "thats not our problem". They started shouting at me, worst restaurant experience ever. They are charging premium prices for food that poses very high health risks.
