They didn't show any level of customer service and didn’t take my feedback on board.

Had a similar experience to the previous comment. Ordered some takeaway and the next morning my family member who had the food experienced hurt burns. Also, the customer service was below standards, one of the worse around. When I called them on the phone for some questions they said something like "We cannot look this for you". I thought they must be super busy because of Ramadan and I didn't think much of it but when I went there it was completely empty with maybe 2 people sitting at the top floor. When collecting the food I asked if they made the food based on my notes but the lady was not even interested, as if she was serving 20 people.
Rarely write negative reviews but this was a must because beside the poor customer service no food should cause hurt burn or feeling sick the next morning.

name: Belly's Taste of Jamaica
address: 291 Hoxton St, Whitmore Estate, London N1 5JX, UK

reviews.text:
The food is good but £18.50 for oxtail and rice is extortionate. That’s the price you would pay for a nice meal in a restaurant, not at a takeaway shop in Hoxton.

It’s a shame because we used to come here weekly but for £40 just for 1 meal each, we’d rather eat out at a restaurant or buy raw oxtail ourselves (£15 from Dalston for a bigger portion) & cook it.

I think this is the last time we will be getting Belly’s.

The food has lost its touch. Used to be really good and worth the drive. Their prices have risen drastically and do not feel you get value for money. Its a shame as I really use to love eating fom here.

absolutely amazing!!! Put in a 70 person catering order of Curry Goat, Jerk Chicken with sauce/gravy, Rice and Peas, Fried Fish, Stew Chicken,Coleslaw and all of it was delicious. there was enough to feed 100+ people at a wedding venue. we were taken very good care of and was even provided extras in terms of dumpling, Plantain and vegetables. food was freshly cooked ON THE DAY and arrived to the venue still warm and would highly recommend to anyone whether they simply want a quick meal for themselves or if they are looking to cater for a larger function. 11/10

I had a delivery thought id try somewhere else and support, well worst meal I've had in a long time n I order n eat out a lot.
Oxtail- mashed up like mince meat, nothing on the bone over cooked and slightly burnt no taste or gravy.
Rice- Dry dry n dry
Coleslaw- too much onions
Plantain- oily, over fried, thick n limp.

OVER PRICE FOR WHAT YOU GET!

Will never order from you again, you could see that oxtail wasn't good.

I’ve just received my order which was curry goat with rice & peas with fried dumpling. The food always taste good & portions are on point too so no complaints here however it’s been few times now that the dumplings are not eatable guys!
They’re hard like a rock! I literally can’t even break it in half by hand let alone bite into it. I was thinking to drive to you to give it back but itd cost more than a dumpling itself so no point but it’d be nice if the dumplings were made fresh.

Delicious food, but the service let it down.
The woman serving me was unexpectedly rude when I asked if I could order. She’s in the photo smiling at other customers, so I’m not sure why her attitude towards me was different. She said she was serving someone else, but that customer had already ordered. When he confirmed this, she replied “yeah well I’m serving him”, then walked off to the kitchen, leaving me confused and unattended for minutes.

Usually kiosks take and prepare orders in sequence, rather than finishing one person’s food before even taking the next order.

Thankfully, another young girl took my order shortly after and was lovely. My jerk chicken with rice & peas was absolutely delicious, and the portion was generous. It cost £12 for the meal pictured.

I’d definitely return for the food, but I’d be hesitant in case I’m served by that hostile woman again.

I had a great experience at Café Caribbean in Spitalfields Market. The jerk chicken is halal and absolutely delicious. The food was full of flavour and very satisfying. Highly recommend for anyone looking for tasty halal Caribbean food.”

We took a little break for lunch and decided to treat ourselves to some Caribbean food. Wow, it was amazing! The portions were generous, and everything tasted so delicious. We enjoyed the lamb patties, rice and peas, and curry mutton—yum! I loved it so much that I decided to grab some curry mutton to take home for dinner so I could savour it again later. I highly recommend this place! 👌

We used Cafe Caribbean to cater for an office lunch raising awareness for Windrush Day. Safe to say our team demolished the food. Everything in the order was complete and the Cafe Caribbean team were so helpful keeping everything organised. 10000% recommend them and their food. Thank you guys!!!

Unlike the other stalls at the market, there was no queue here. But there was great Caribbean music playing in the background - that immediately caught my attention. The service was quick and friendly, and the food was really delicious! You can taste the good mood of the people there. A visit is highly recommended!

name: Caribbean-Kitchen
address: Caribbean Kitchen, 67 Mare St, London E8 4RG, UK

reviews.text: My go-to spot in hackney. Easily one of the best caribbean restaurants in London. Lovely people as well! Every dish is 11/10.

It is always good to discover a new neighbourhood favourite, and Caribbean Kitchen know good food! We got a few different things to share take away - jerk chicken, jerk pork, and a goat curry. They were all delicious, even the rice was deeply flavourful. While we didn’t order them, they had plenty of vego options too. Generous large serves that are enough to keep you going all day and lovely service to top it off :-)
Food is always on point. You'll be sure to have your Oxtail so soft it falls off of the bone. They serve a stellar Guinness Punch too. No complaints! Be sure to try everything.

Went there last week based on a friend recommendation and was not disaapointed. the lovely lady behind the counter was super helpful and accomodating. The menu is simple and easy to understand and the portion sizes are very good. Will definitely return. 5 stars from me!!

⭐☆☆☆☆

I recently purchased a bag from Too Good To Go, expecting to receive surplus food that was still good to eat. Unfortunately, this was my third attempt at this particular store, and I was deeply disappointed again. The items I received were burnt and of poor quality, which is not what I anticipated. I understand the mission behind reducing food waste, but the condition of the food was unacceptable. I won’t be returning to this store again, as it seems they are not meeting the standard expected from the Too Good To Go service.

We found this place by luck after a long day
The portions are generally generous
Elegant tablets chairs plates etc
Clean toilets with faculties for Muslims
Waiters very polite and quick service
I rate the atmosphere as 4 as service  alcohol

This branch is extremely overpriced. We got the platter and the portions are way smaller than other places. The prices on their menu online is different than the prices on their menu in the restaurant so prepare for much higher prices once you get there if you’re one to check prices beforehand. The service is okay, I had to prompt the servers for bread. I guess the decor is nice though.

We visited this restaurant and had a wonderful experience. The place is very elegant and beautifully designed, with a warm and stylish atmosphere. The food was absolutely delicious – authentic Turkish flavors, prepared with real care and love. The service was excellent: friendly, attentive and professional.
We also loved that you can purchase traditional Turkish products on site to take home. There is also a spacious and comfortable hall downstairs, perfect for larger gatherings or special occasions.
A truly refined restaurant made with taste, passion and attention to detail. Highly recommended.
Had lunch there yesterday with my colleagues. Food and service was great. Really lovely decor. Will come back again.

I had an amazing time dining at Efes and truly enjoyed the whole experience. From the moment we arrived, the atmosphere was vibrant and welcoming. The belly dance performance added so much energy to the evening and made it feel like more than just a dinne. IEveryone was having fun, and it created such a lively, joyful vibe.

The food was absolutely delicious and clearly prepared with care. My favourite dish was the Chicken Shish . It was tender, juicy, and full of flavour. Every bite was enjoyable. The salad also really stood out; it was fresh, well-seasoned, and complemented the meal perfectly. Overall, everything from the food to the entertainment made the night memorable. I would definitely recommend Efes to anyone looking for great food and a fun dining experience.

Amazing Turkish restaurant in Islington! The Sunday brunch was outstanding — such an impressive food display with a great variety of delicious dishes. The location is beautiful, and the atmosphere is warm and lively. The staff were so friendly and attentive, making the whole experience even better. Definitely one of the best spots on Upper Street!

We managed to get a walk in table here as a group of 8 for a Saturday lunch and it could not have been more perfect! The food was delicious, great service and a lovely interior on such a great road for restaurants! The lunchtime deals were great, 2 courses for £16, and plenty of choice! 10/10, highly recommend 🙌🏻

The food here is absolutely delicious, the cocktails are spot-on, and the staff are so kind and welcoming. The künefe is honestly the best I’ve ever had, a real must-try! The atmosphere is lovely too, with really sweet and friendly clients around. This was my second visit, and just like the first time, I left so happy. Never disappointed. I am already looking forward to coming back!

The open buffet breakfast was absolutely amazing. The flavors are hard to describe — you really have to go and experience it yourself.

The staff were incredibly helpful; it felt like they knew what you wanted before you even asked. Truly excellent service.

After breakfast, I stayed for hours just sipping tea — the seating area was very comfortable.

The place was cool inside, but sunlight streaming through the upper windows created a warm, pleasant atmosphere.

The tea was delicious.

The music selection was great — not too quiet, not too loud, just the right mood.

Overall, I highly recommend this place. You won’t regret it!
Amazing meal for our new year's eve celebrations. The waitress fit us in at short notice, the food & drink did not disappoint. Very generous portion sizes and just so yummy. Will definitely be back!

Food was amazing, we got the chicken/rice + salad & sauce it was sooooo tasty & the portions were really big. Price is so good for the size of the meal. Staff were so friendly too & the place was super clean, loved it
The food is cheap and delicious. The staffs there are so friendly! When I am hesitating not sure what should I order they introduce the food in a funny way! And the store is so new and clean.
Really great atmosphere, kind people abs large portions, and decently priced items! Will definitely visit again
Had the large classic doner with a friend and we wolfed it down. Sauce was great and service matched. Really friendly team. If you need a doner it's an easy yes.

One of the best kebab spots in the East End. The kebab is genuinely authentic, and the chicken is incredibly tender, juicy, and full of flavour — clearly well-marinated and freshly cooked. Great food, great service, and definitely worth coming back again. The staff here are known for their warm and welcoming service — whether you’re popping in for a quick takeaway or staying to eat, you’re greeted with a smile and treated like a regular from the first visit.

Booked this for a large Sunday lunch gathering and the timing worked in our favour - the place was quiet compared to the usual weekday rush, which made for a genuinely relaxed atmosphere. The space itself is lovely: modern, airy, and they'd done a nice job with the festive decorations.

The service was attentive throughout. Drinks arrived quickly, and when we asked to see the à la carte alongside the Christmas menu (we were initially offered only the latter), they accommodated without fuss.
Some of our group went festive, others picked individual dishes—it all flowed smoothly.

Food was fresh and well-presented.
The meats were excellent—perfectly cooked and tender. Where I found myself wanting more was in the classics: my tabbouleh needed more lemon and olive oil to lift it, the hummus was a bit too thick for my taste, and the prawns and calamari were fine but nothing special.
It's a polished, modern take on Turkish dining, which looks beautiful but means it lacks that generous, punchy character you get at more traditional places.

The sticking point for me is the price. For what you're paying, I'd want something that sets it apart from the competition—and I didn't quite find that here.
A solid spot for a relaxed meal with good service, but not sure I'd rush back to compared to other Turkish options in town that deliver (much) more bang or flavour for your buck.

The food was absolutely delicious. The all-day meze was a really good size for two and could easily be a whole meal for one but I wanted to taste everything as an appetiser and the flavours were amazing. For main course, I had the lamb tagine. I’m very picky about lamb as it can be so fatty or very chewy in some places. This was so tender and delicious. Couldn’t fault it in any respect. Everything was exceptionally well-priced, service was excellent, and ambience was great. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend and will definitely be back.
The food and atmosphere was beautiful.   The service was tip tier and I really enjoyed my time. I ordered the meze all day and the sword fish with spiced potato's and the mint and cucumber salad.

Absolutely delicious. Came for lunch with the team and had a great experience. Food was very good and on point, the service was very quick and effective. I’d give it 9 out of 10. I might rate it higher or lower if I experienced the full menu (entry, main, and dessert). Nonetheless, I was very pleased with everything for a simple lunch. The staff were very friendly as well! Highly recommended.
Amazing mezzes and grilled meat 10/10. The atmosphere is nice. I recommend (+ it’s not pricey)

name: Mehmet Efendi
address: 71 Whitechapel High St, London E1 7PL, UK

reviews.text: This place is literally divine! A little slice of heaven tucked into Whitechapel Road. It’s so pretty, like a Turkish Laduree! It’s near my office and I had never popped in but I went in this morning and it’s a real treasure. The sweets are a feast for the eyes and they have a great Turkish breakfast menu but also beautiful take away coffee! I was so excited the gentlemen gave me free Baklava to try for my breakfast and it’s the most delicious Baklava I have ever had! I bought some cute little Valentines gifts for my colleuages I have an awayday with. It will definitely be a regular haunt of mine now!

Had a fantastic experience at Mehmet Efendi. The tea is absolutely delicious and pairs perfectly with the baklava, which is packed with high-quality pistachios. We also tried the künefe—it was good, though definitely on the sweeter side compared to others I’ve had, so it’s perfect if you have a real sweet tooth! A special shoutout to Ali, who is an amazing person and a truly great host. He made us feel right at home. Highly recommend!

The kunefe is the smallest I ate ever. It taste good by is tiny and just one size 13.45£, in other places they do different sizes. The pistachio 3 leches it was super tasty. Staff overall 5/10, not a warm approach and need to improve attention at tables.

A small, welcoming coffee shop specialising in Turkish pastries. We only tried the baklava to take away, but it was excellent. Very soft, rich, and generously filled with pistachio. Sweet without being overwhelming, with a fresh, well-balanced syrup. Definitely a place worth stopping by if you enjoy traditional Turkish desserts.

Had an amazing dessert experience at Mehmet Éfendi in London. The San Sebastián cheesecake was out of this world; soft, fluffy, and perfectly balanced. The baklava was rich and absolutely delightful. Big thanks to MEHDI and YOUNUS for their warm welcome and great recommendations. If you love dessert, this is the place to go! ✨

I’d always seen this place busy and had been wanting to try it — and it was absolutely worth the visit. The food was incredibly delicious. We ordered the mixed grill and the vegetable moussaka as our mains, and everything was wonderful. The lamb köfte, in particular, was outstanding, and I’m already looking forward to coming back for it again.
It was a pity that the kazandibi dessert was sold out this time, but that just gives us something to look forward to on our next visit! Instead, we had the crème brûlée, which was beautifully soft, almost like a soufflé, and the baklava, which had a rich pistachio flavor — both were excellent.
Both the espresso and the Americano had a pleasant Turkish-coffee-like taste that paired really well with the desserts.
Also, our server Salih was very kind and gentlemanly. Thank you! We’ll definitely be back🥰

Came in for some late dinner and pleased with this chicken dish that I ordered. The flavours were nice, love that subtle kick, and the vegetables are delicious as well. Overall pleased with this choice.
Tad bit pricey. No queue when I went.

I was here for a private booking for a friends birthday dinner. The selection of starters they had on our table were soo good. One that stood out was the calamari - it’s a must try! For the mains, I had the Iskender - the flavours were amazing and the portion size was very generous. Also, all of the staff were very friendly and bubbly, their service was 10/10!

​We visited Haz Restaurant on Finsbury Square for a late-night dinner. The location and atmosphere were great, and the staff was friendly and attentive. However, the experience was ultimately disappointing due to the food and an unexpected charge on the bill.

​My wife, who was recovering from a toothache, ordered the lamb kofte kebab. Unfortunately, it was incredibly tough and difficult to chew—even for me. Having recently traveled to Dubai and Istanbul, I have a good idea of how kofte should taste, and this was a huge miss. I would rate it 0/10.

​I ordered the lamb gravy, which was very good, and we ended up sharing it since it was too late to order anything else.
​To top it all off, when I reviewed the bill the next day, I noticed a £4 "cover charge" in addition to the VAT and service charge. For a simple meal of two mains and two Cokes, this felt completely unnecessary and left a bad taste in our mouths. We will not be returning.
We had the private dining room for my sisters birthday , the service was exceptional and the staff have gone above and beyond

Sad to say.. I will NOT be returning anytime soon..!!
My family & I have dined here multiple of times, I’ve always spoken very highly of this place & recommended it to many people…
Aesthetically pleasing with all its decor..

Tonight, on Valentine’s Day standards were dropped, HARD!
Was only seated with two Valentine’s “Special” menu rather than the standard menu’s nor did we receive any drinks or cocktail menu’s until we got the attention of KiKi whom was very attentive & helpful despite the overall bad experience from everyone else..

Our mains arrived before the starter, the lamb chops were Luke warm & “Mediterranean Veg” was just Aubergine with Gratin on the side.. the waiter took it back after two bites & it was reheated, between my wife & I we have over a decade of catering experience and never have I ever reheated somebody’s EATEN food,
you simply just make a fresh portion….
The absolute deal breaker was the fly in our Prawn Cocktail salad which may I add looked like a toddler slapped it together on playtime…
The Mai Tai barely had any alcohol,
came more like a mocktail…
Despite the special occasion, no restaurant should ever have the audacity to charge people whilst offering poor service; it is absolutely appalling!!
Unorganised Chaos, was not even busy, clear to see poor management as not one host // server had their own dedicated section…

I hope this serves as constructive feedback for the entire team & you all learn a lesson or two in customer service & dining experiences.

We recently hosted a bridal shower in the private room at this Mediterranean restaurant, and I can’t say enough wonderful things about our experience. From the moment we arrived, the staff treated us with warmth, attentiveness, and genuine hospitality. They made the celebration feel special in every way.

The private room itself was absolutely beautiful—elegantly decorated, spacious, and filled with natural light. It struck the perfect balance between intimate and festive, creating a stunning backdrop for photos and making our bride-to-be feel truly celebrated.

The food was outstanding. Every dish—whether it was the fresh mezze, perfectly seasoned kebabs, or vibrant salads—was full of flavor and beautifully presented. Our guests were raving about the hummus, the lamb, and especially the baklava. Portions were generous, and everything tasted incredibly fresh.

What really elevated the experience, though, was the service. The staff was attentive without being intrusive, quick to refill drinks, accommodate dietary needs, and ensure the event flowed smoothly. They made us feel completely taken care of, which allowed us to relax and enjoy the celebration.

Overall, this restaurant exceeded every expectation. If you’re looking for a gorgeous venue with delicious Mediterranean cuisine and exceptional service, I can’t recommend it enough—especially for hosting a special event like a bridal shower. It truly made the day unforgettable.

I am always treated like VIP whenever I go to this gorgeous treasure spot. The food, ambience and service are⁶ premium. The wide variety of dishes means there is something for everyone snd the food arrives fresh and well presented! This year I decided to have my Christmas day lunch at Mem & Laz and booked an early time to accommodate my mobility challenge. Sonia  ,the manager, booked me in and asked me what I needed to br safe and comfortable.. My family and I were taken good  care of and it was quite a busy despite being Christmas Day!

I celebrated my bridal party at Mem & Laz, and it truly felt like a fairy tale. The atmosphere, food, and service were all perfect. A special thank you to Sonnur Abla for her incredible effort and kindness—she made the night unforgettable. Highly recommended.

I went here for dinner and was very happy. The staff are incredibly welcoming and friendly. We came with a large party and the food once we ordered came very quickly which was very nice. My food was cooked perfectly and was incredibly tasty. Prices were also quite reasonable. I was also impressed with the large selection of wines and cocktails. All in all I would definitely recommend going here and will hopefully return again.

Private Hall Hire above the restaurant. This is a really nice hall, nothing over the top but perfect for a small function (small wedding event). There were around 90 people which just about fitted in. Not sure what their overall capacity is. There is a set menu to choose from and depending on what you go for the price represents that. The hall hire is separate to food charge. The food was good, the chicken tikka starter, the chicken/meat currys were particularly good. Service was good, staff gave were they could extra food. Would of been nice to have zero sugar drinks. Overall very good.

I attended a wedding here at maedah restaurant so I didn’t have a menu. Everything was already catered before hand for £19 a head.

I was in their banqueting hall, which is an average adequate space. I believe they can sit around 150-200 people.

The stage design is also quite nice. It’s elegant and simple as well as minimalistic.

The starters, I didn’t try the spring rolls or somasos but the chicken they served was a STRAIGHT 8/10. The seasoning as well as the texture on the chicken was perfect.
We have asked for seconds and thirds for the starters that’s how good they were.

The mains - chicken curry - lamb curry - daal.

Chicken curry - 8/10. It had a nice sweet taste the chicken. It was different from your other curries you could taste the quality with every bite. It was full of flavour .

Meat curry - 10/10.  The meat was tender, soft, dissolved in your mouth and the sauce that accompanied it was just mouthwatering.

Daal - I personally didn’t try it but my uncle said he was disappointed.

We asked for 4 more meat curries. It was genuinely that delicious.

The service was top notch, waiters on standby everywhere, checking if we have enough - enough water - enough drinks.
Can’t complain.

The only reason it’s a 4 star from me is because they properly rationed that starters and when we asked for more, they said no. Didn’t provide reasoning

The 4 of us visited for the second night of Ramadan 2026. IWhile the new atmosphere and seating are a definite improvement—the shop is smaller but feels much better—the food was a major disappointment especially iftar platter.
​Despite arriving on time, the quality didn't justify tag. We were served old biryani with only one piece of meat, and my friends' portions had black bones and were excessively greasy. Only the wings and kebabs were decent. As people who have worked in the industry (including a professional chef), we can tell the freshness isn't there anymore. It’s a shame because it was amazing last year. Please fix the food quality!

At first was surprised that we got a table so quick. Now I understand.
Would not recommend this place. After waiting an age, was served with terrible food and a side order of bad attitude.
Ordered a chicken burger meal, which was a dehydrated patty inside untoasted cheap bun. Asked for medium well steaks, got given rubber and silicone on a plate. When I tried to quietly ask what had happened and give some constructive criticism. Feedback was 'that's how we make it'. Was then surrounded by three waiters trying to intimidate me and my family. When I gave a little push back they got a little louder then walked off. Other customers approached my table to fight my corner.
Theres also a creepy guy sitting at a back table. Staring at us from when we got in, just with a small tea in his hand. Either a manager or owner, not too sure. Saw him behind the counter also.
My bill came to £82 or so, which I was more than willing to pay. (My money was already on the table). Another waiter asked them to give me a discount. After taking a few minutes having a meeting, they offered me a discount.
I didn't eat my food as you'll see in one of the pictures.
Overall, terrible experience, horrible food and despicable staff.
Definitely not returning and will be telling all my own people to avoid.

Food: 5/5*****
All the dishes we ordered were delicious, with the meats especially succulent. We went for the mix grill for three, wraps, and fish fingers & chips for our son. Everything was cooked to perfection and full of flavor.

Service: 4/5****
The staff were friendly and attentive, though we had to call them over a couple of times—first for extra menus and later to place our order. However, once the order was placed, the food arrived promptly.

Atmosphere: 5/5*****
For a Sunday evening, it was fairly quiet, but we appreciated the calm. We reserved a private booth, which added to the experience, and were even able to use one of the rooms to pray, making the evening even more convenient and enjoyable.

name: Le Bab St. Paul's
address: One New Change, London EC4M 9AF, UK

reviews.text: Amazing selection of Halal, vegetarian & vegan dishes. Fresh, good quality ingredients! Definitely worth a visit
Excellent!! Had the fried chicken and the legendary paneer kebab. Will be back
Delicious fried chicken and fries
Perfect kebabs!
Great kebabs!
Ordered from Just Eat, platter for 3, for £40. The rice was missing. Wings were only 6 instead of 7. Chips were so dry. Small portion. Not worth the price.

The guy was very nice, came here on a whim after starving and the food was scrumptious. Man was nice and let us use the sink in the back and offered tissue after. Decently priced food, good quality and nice tasting. Highly recommend!!
Very tasty shawarma like it even my friends love it too 11/10 💯 100% I will recommend this place very tasty food
Not even gonna lie this place is really so good highly recommend at any time of the day
Good food. Bread could’ve been better if it was fresh. Price to food ratio 6,5/10.

amazing experience! The food is incredibly fresh and flavorful, especially the mezze and grilled dishes. The service is fast, friendly, and very accommodating. The restaurant has a comfortable and welcoming atmosphere, making you feel like you’re right in the heart of Lebanon. Prices are reasonable considering the quality and portion sizes. I will definitely be coming back and highly recommend it to anyone who loves authentic Lebanese cuisine.

Popped into this place for some late night eats. The guys running this place are very nice and friendly. They were even nice enough to give us extra bread for our labneh. The lamb shawarma wrap was absolutely delicious. The place was also quite clean and had plenty of seating despite being a smaller place. Would definitely recommend!

This restaurant is a hidden gem! The food is fresh, flavorful, and authentic—especially the chicken shawarma and cheese rolls. Each dish bursts with traditional spices and feels homemade. The staff is warm and very welcoming. A must-visit spot for anyone craving real Lebanese cuisine.

Got take out and seriously delicious!!!
The whole chicken was perfectly juicy and everything tastes so fresh. Everything was amazing and gotta note that the fries are so perfectly crunchy. My new Lebanese spot in this area 🙌🏻🙌🏻🙌🏻

A Fresh Take on Lebanese Cuisine

Tucked away in the heart of Hoxton, Liban Eats is a relatively new kid on the block, having only opened its doors three months ago. Despite its short tenure, it's already making waves with its fresh, flavorful, and affordable Lebanese cuisine.

Getting There

The nearest tube station is Old Street (Northern Line + Overground), while bus routes 141, 242, 394, and 476 stop nearby.

A Warm Welcome and Delicious Eats

From the moment you step inside, you're greeted with a warm welcome and impeccable service. The staff is friendly, knowledgeable, and more than happy to accommodate special requests. I was particularly impressed with their willingness to create a bespoke Chicken Kofte & Shawarma Wrap, which was a delightful fusion of flavors.

The star of the show, however, is the quality of the ingredients. Every bite is a testament to their commitment to freshness. From the succulent meats to the crisp vegetables, everything is prepared with care. Even their in-house condiments—the creamy tahini, fiery chili sauce, and garlicky garlic sauce—are made with the finest ingredients.

To top off the meal, I was treated to a complimentary Baklava. The almond one was particularly delicious, though it's worth noting that these aren't made in-house.

Clean and Inviting

The restaurant itself is clean, modern, and inviting. It's the perfect spot for a quick, tasty meal or a leisurely lunch.

Why You Should Try It

If you're looking for a fresh, affordable, and delicious Lebanese meal in Hoxton, Liban Eats is a must-try. Don't be afraid to ask for off-menu items—the staff is more than happy to accommodate your requests. Shout out to Adam & Co. 🙌✌️

I walked away from the City looking for a nice independent place to eat and found Rose's. The staff were charming and friendly. I hadn't eaten gozleme before but with haloumi, chicken and their spicy sauce, it was lovely. Recommended.

The food is exquisite, and the staff couldn't be friendlier. The flavors are very authentic, and they recommend excellent combinations. They have vegetarian, vegan, and meat-eater options. The coffee has also a really good taste. A place to recommend!

Very nice food. Honestly one of the tastiest salads I’ve ever had and price was £10. The service was amazing the people are so nice they also offered me a free herbal tea which I thought was lovely. Would definitely come back here!

Absolutely fantastic lunch spot! I’ve been coming here nearly every day and I’m never disappointed. The gözleme is delicious and The salads boxes are always fresh.  the service is warm and welcoming, which makes eating here a genuine pleasure. Highly recommend Rose’s to anyone looking for delicious, high-quality food in a friendly atmosphere, especially for lunch!

From beckoning us into the cafe from the cold rain outside to the amazing hospitality inside Rose’s warmth and passion flows through into the fantastic yummy food.
Great atmosphere and great food - give it a try!

name: Meshwi
address: 329 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E2 6AH, UK

reviews.text:
The food was delicious with a good portion sizes. We shared the Meshwi Family Platter and I thoroughly enjoyed the lamb shish and grilled meats.

The restaurant was quite cold, so we kept our coats on. We visited during lunchtime on a weekday, and the only hot drink available was Turkish tea, as they chose not to turn on the coffee machine despite asking.

I ordered the mixed grill during my visit, and the whole experience turned out far better than I expected. The meal started with the chicken boneless grill, which was cooked with real care. It was soft, juicy, and had a nice balance of seasoning that made each bite worth it. Chicken often ends up dry or bland in many places, but here it tasted tender, full of flavour, and clearly freshly prepared.

The cheese chips were simple but surprisingly satisfying. The chips were crisp on the outside and soft on the inside, and the melted cheese on top was just the right amount. It did not feel heavy, and it was the kind of side you keep reaching for without thinking.

The lamb shawarma became another highlight of the meal. It had a rich warm flavour without being oily or overpowering. The seasoning was spot on, and the meat tasted fresh and well marinated.

I also have to mention the Adana kebab because it was absolutely extraordinary. It had a depth of flavour that stood out from everything else and made the whole meal even more memorable.

Overall, the food felt thoughtfully prepared and very satisfying. The portions were generous, everything arrived warm, and you could taste the care in each item. I would happily return and recommend this place to anyone who enjoys good quality grilled food.

This was my first visit to this restaurant on Bethnal Green Road. I ordered the mixed platter for two people. Unfortunately, the food was quite average I’d rate it 5/10. The kebab in the platter didn’t taste great, and the sauce wasn’t very appealing either. Portion sizes were small and didn’t feel like good value for money.

The drinking glasses could have been cleaner, but I must say the staff were very polite, welcoming, and attentive, which made the experience more pleasant.

As a fan of Turkish cuisine, I’ve definitely had better elsewhere. However, because of the lovely service, I might consider returning one day to try some of their other dishes if I’m around Bethnal Green.

The food had no taste they didn’t give me any sauce at all everything was dry I ordered a lamb shawarma wrap it had No flavour the meat had no seasoning this place is expensive and the food is not even good the fries were not fresh they had no salt the mixed hot meze platter was rubbish too barely any taste for a Lebanese  restaurant you would think the food would taste better i ordered online and i paid almost £5 for delivery and around an additional £2-3 for service Absolutely Ridiculous prices will stick to the Arab food in my own area which I know is amazing wanted to try something new don’t bother ! Try Edgware Road they have all sorts of Arab restaurants the best !!

We had a lovely time with the family at the restaurant. The staff was really friendly and the food was on point. The salad with the bread was really nice and we loved all the sauces. The main mix family platter was so delicious and the meat was so succulent. The wings and the chicken was so tender, overall everything that was served on the mix grill was really tasty.

I was walking along old street last weekend about midnight and the shop was closing, I said to the fella that I'm homeless and hungry, he turned back on the grill and made me the loveliest chicken kebab I've had in a long time, our communities need more people like this, go and have some food here it was delicious. 😋

The lamb kebab was decent in flavour but the portions was comparable to a World War Two ration hardly any meat to feed an ant colony !! the meat looked as if it was thrown in the container and was launched across the room and the driver was catching it as if it was a game of swing ball. As for the chips and cheese they could not bother to fill the container as if there was a potato shortage I would not recommend if ur looking to fill urself up.

Yes Turkish Kebab Restaurant,
Old Street,
first impressions I noticed a digital menu nicely refurbished noticed a seating area flat television screen, and was informed they show big sporting events, my son was peckish and asked if he could have a doner kebab large, the kebab was amazingly fresh cut in front of us, my boy wanted it take away, the 3 staff that served us was super friendly & very engaging talked about Turkey & Turkish cuisine he responded to my request of having the pita nan bread separately, the salad selection was so good, he gave us cucumber, tomatoes, lettuce, red cabbage, onion, yellow pepper chilli, which I love, so he gave us extra, & also gave us tomato based fresh chilli sauce, not to spicy & yogurt & minty sauce, the kebab portion was amazingly generous, and tasty combination and ranked highly with my son.
Who enjoyed & ate all his salad, and kebab and said he would love to go back and order eat in and watch the football whilst eating, and I noticed so much more specialty on the menu Will definitely return staff friendly and attentive.
Great place, very polite staff. Very good kebab. Good amount of meat done crispy and with a good portion of fresh veg. Price is a little high and could do with more bread but otherwise no issues.

I always visit this fantastic Turkish restaurant, and it never disappoints! The staff are really friendly and always make me feel welcome. The food is amazing—full of flavour and made with fresh ingredients. Plus, it’s great value for money! If you’re looking for a lovely Turkish meal, this place is definitely worth a visit!

K-FOOD FIX 🔥🇰🇷
📍 @onthebab, Shoreditch
⭐️ 5/5
💸 ££
🍴A friend from work recommended On The Bab to me, and now I honestly can’t stop going to this #Korean foodie heaven. It’s one of those places you try once and immediately add to your regular rotation.

🥢 #Toppoki with Cheese: Hands down the best toppoki with cheese I’ve tried. Chewy rice cakes, spicy sauce, loads of melted cheese… proper comfort food. I could eat this every week.

🍗 Korean Fried #Chicken: We ordered the medium portion (10 pieces, £10) with soy ginger and sweet spicy. Super crispy, juicy inside, and both sauces were unreal. The soy ginger was savoury and addictive, while the sweet spicy had just the right kick.

🔥 #Kimchi on the Side: Always a yes. Fresh, tangy, and the perfect balance to all the cheesy and fried goodness.

🍤 #Prawn Buns: Soft, fluffy buns with juicy prawns inside. Simple but so good, and a nice way to mix things up.

If you’re in #Shoreditch and craving Korean food that’s comforting, flavour-packed, and easy to love, On The Bab is a no-brainer. Big thanks to my friend for the recommendation, I’m officially hooked 🤍🔥

Having lived in Incheon in Korea , we were curious to have a Korean meal. Though this is more street food. The spicy rice cake starter is a must have. The Bibimbab is worth a try. The service is excellent!

Very authentic and delicious Korean food!
Highly recommend the chill fried chicken and pork and kimchi rice! The flavour was insaneeeee😍
Big portion
Staff was all very friendly and nice

Great food and soju - keep coming back to this place each year. What would make a real difference though is if tables weren't so close to each other and if they were higher - it feels like it was designed/measured for children. Also, keep in mind that if someone is sitting nearby it's the same as if they were at your table, as you hear everyone's conversations and need to squeeze through them if you want to leave your seat. So maybe not a place for a date or deep conversations if you're looking for a bit more privacy 😊 But definitely at least try their food as takeaway!

Delicious Korean food. Just walked by randomly and got attracted by the vibe.

The menu looks great, variety of choices and food was amazing. Really love the rice cake, the balance between sweet and spicy was just right. Texture of the rice cake was cooked to perfection as well.

The grassnoodles was really good too, flavourful and not too expensive. Portion is really big. Price is reasonable. Definitely recommended!

name: DOPI 도피소
address: 142 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E2 6DG, UK

reviews.text: Hidden gem in Brick Lane! The food was incredibly authentic and full of flavour — especially the tteokbokki, bulgogi, and Korean fried chicken. Everything tasted homemade and fresh. The staff were also very friendly and welcoming. Definitely one of the best Korean restaurant I’ve tried in London. Will come back again!

Love the aesthetic of the restaurant! Friendly service, booking was made through Instagram DM though response was prompt and friendly so not a problem. Sweet and spicy chicken, galbitang and pajeon were lovely. Personally also enjoyed the gochu mayo chicken a lot but some found the wasabi a bit too intense so perhaps a more adventurous choice for some.

Kimchi jeon was decent but have had better. Having said that I would love to visit again to try out other dishes!

Every single aspect of dining here was impeccable.
Amazingly friendly staff willing to help with everything and anything, very attentive and caring. The food arrived fast, the taste was great with portion sizes really worth the money. The atmosphere was cosy and cool.

Best Korean restaurant for miles.

Such a cool restaurant!!! The vibe is so chill it’s easy to spend many hours here (which we did lol). We got the two person set and the jjimdak was especially good. It’s fun to try the set for the first visit to see what you like and try different dishes. Looking forward to visiting again!

Another grey and damp weekend, and what better way to bring some cheer than to have some Korean Food. We found this place as we scrolled through Google maps to inspire us on what to try and eat and came across Dopa. Really like the ambience and 1970's vibe of the place. Everything was clean, spacious and well organised and what you would expected. Ordering was efficient and done via the table terminal and the service was efficient and friendly. The food was delicious, healthy portions and plenty for two people. We ordered from the lunch menu and supplemented it with some refreshing lemonade. Would we come again, the answer is YES.. please go and check it and  enjoy the food with excellent 1970,s sound track.

Overall: Worth a revisit, reasonable price, food is freshly made, but sadly the location is not very convenient.
Seafood pancake is a must try. It is crispy on the outside with rich fillings. We are impressed by the texture and the thickness, which exceed our expectation.
Bulgogi is also highly recommended. It pairs perfectly with the veg, and seasoning is just right.
Other dishes are also above average, though not as outstanding as the two dishes mentioned above.
What a great place!!!! The portions were huge. We ordered the seafood pancake and the galbi set and both were so good.

Was taken here by friends and completely taken aback at the quality of the food.

It was quiet, perhaps down to the location/decor but each dish was delicious, the value superb and the staff warm and friendly.

Best fried chicken/glass noodles I’ve had in London.

Such a brilliant Korean restaurant! Try it.
Stopped in for dinner week s work colleague. Amazing beef, Bibimbap and Seafood Noodles. Will be back soon👍🙏😉

Came here on my own for lunch as my office is nearby.
Would recommend this place for a treat, as food is good and healthy too.
But portion sizes are small and expensive for what it is.
Bimbimbap not served in hot stone, was a bit disappointed, but the colourful rice was really yummy and felt very healthy.
I would say it is authentic.

Update: had a wonderful dinner here.
Had one of the best japchaes here the other day. There was so much beef, and the flavours were even throughout. The noodles were a lovely soft, chewy texture. The flavours were a great balance between sweetness and saltiness.

They had recently added hotpot to their menu, and their budae jjigae wasn’t too spicy, wasn’t too much or too heavy.

The kimchi volcano rice was delicious. More to the sweet side which is great to order with the hotpot which was a bit spicy. I love cheese a lot, so this dish was great!

The Korean fried chicken, with sweet and spicy sauce was crispy, not too much batter and the portion size was good for the price. Adding deep fried rice cakes to the dish was an added bonus!

Overall, highly recommend this restaurant if you’re in the area! Food is delicious! And not too expensive. It’s not a busy area, so it’s not chaotic like some hot spot locations.

Miga has been the best restaurant ive been to all year. I knew the place was good but didnt expect for it to blow me away. Every meal I had was flavourful- how can the next bite be better than the one before? Thats exactly how it was. The staff were warm and inviting- you can tell they all have great chemistry together in service. Intimate space but doesnt make you feel claustrophobic. I recommended the place as soon as I got into my uber home. If you have an hesitations, I assure you dont. Thank you Miga. Cant wait to come again.

I mean, I know the restaurant is in Hackney but in my 33 years of adult life I have never been welcomed at a restaurant with a locked front door, most odd! 😉

This was our first experience of a full Korean meal and all the dishes we tried were absolutely delicious, the one slight disappointment was that the karage chicken was not very crispy and a little greasy. The tartare, short rib and pork dish were particularly delicious.

Outstanding Korean cuisine in a casual setting solely focussed on sensational taste of the dishes.
The beef short-rib is glazed in a sweetish sauce and melts in your mouth, 10/10.
The kimchi is flavourful, punchy, crunchy, and very fermented - just the way it should be.
The sauce for the fish salad was spicy and a great addition which pulled it together.

The place is run authentically, have an open grill, and the wait times on food are not long.

It is a popular place, book well ahead and expect to be ushered out when your time runs out.

Such a great modern Korean place in Hackney. The food is authentic, but the vibe is really modern. Highly recommended if you’re trying Korean food for the first time, or as a spot for a first or second date

추천메뉴는 회무침, 강된장입니다

Had a delicious meal here on Friday. Have heard nothing but good things about it and it exceeded expectations.

We tried a range of dishes - all absolutely delicious but the stand out was the beef tartare.

The house wine was also delicious and well priced

Service was impeccable - attentive, friendly staff and the minimal but well finished and quality decor made the dishes (presented beautifully) even more stand out.

Would definitely go back to try the rest of the menu - their take on Korean cuisine is so interesting and everything on the menu sounded delectable.

name: Jang Restaurant
address: The Mezzanine, First Floor, Royal Exchange, London EC3V 3LQ, UK

reviews.text:
I had a fantastic experience at Jang in London. The food was absolutely delicious, beautifully presented and full of bold, well-balanced flavours. The atmosphere is stylish yet comfortable, making it perfect for both special occasions and relaxed dining.

A special mention to Brayan and Nada, who were outstanding. They were friendly, attentive, and made us feel genuinely welcome throughout the evening. Their service truly elevated the whole experience. Highly recommend! ⭐️

I had a lovely dinner here with my friends and we all genuinely enjoyed the experience and food.
A special mention has to go to Giuliana, who provided outstanding service throughout the night. She was professional, attentive, and explained the menu with real enthusiasm, making everything sound incredibly appealing. Her recommendations were spot on and she made us feel very well looked after without ever being intrusive.

Awesome food in an amazing setting with super friendly staff. What a lovely way to spend Valentines, girlfriend loved it too. Very high quality food in a high quality setting where every effort was made to make us feel welcome. Clearly very high quality ingredients used and well trained chefs. All of the food was great, the sushi is superb, seafood rice very flavoursome, the Korean barbecue is great and a good wine list reasonably priced. Will definitely be back soon.

I came for dinner at Jang London and was attended by Juliana.

The service was truly exceptional from start to finish. Her attention to detail, professionalism and warm attitude made the entire experience outstanding.

She anticipated needs before we even had to ask and ensured everything was perfectly executed.

It’s rare to receive such genuinely attentive and polished service. Juliana is a real asset to the team.

Thank you for such a memorable evening.

This was an amazing experience with top quality food.
We were served by Rebecca, Neda and Jose who where all very welcoming and helpful.
The restaurant is beautiful and nice and relaxing atmosphere. They even kindly changed the chair for me to fit my preference.
We had the sushi to start which was the best sushi I've ever had. I then had the lobster which was tender and flavorful in a delicious creamy broth with noodles and a side of kimchi which tasted really authentic. One of us had the duck which was cooked medium rare as requested and the broccoli which was seasoned really nicely. And lastly 2 of us had the sharing platter and added wagyu. All the meats where cooked to our preference and seasoned well and it came with lots of sides my favourite was the seaweed salad and loads of sauces to try with the meats as well as some rise.
We also had some lovely cocktails presented very nicely as well as a lovely birthday suprise.
Definitely worth a visit couldn't recommend enough hopefully we'll get to go back soon.

Getting away from all the buzz and the crowds in central London, this restaurant was a lovely change of pace with a really nice intimate atmosphere.The staff were also very kind and polite, warmly welcoming me and my friend and giving some recommendations on what to order from the menu.

Me and my friend had the Kimichi Jjigae, Japchae and rice which were SO flavourful and well seasoned.This was my first time trying these dishes, so i was pleasantly surprised to find the kimchi soup had the perfect amount of spice, not too spicy but instead had a balanced kick to it.The pork and the tofu inside the soup also tasted great and complemented the overall taste of the broth.

The Japchae was also very nice with a savoury sweet sauce that accompanied the garnishes and noodles.Both the noodles and the soup tasted great when eaten together with rice so i'd recommend getting the rice to accompany your meal.Not to mention that both dishes were very filling so your going to get your money's worth because i was stuffed by the end of the night .(happily, it was super good!!!!)

We also got some Citron tea alongside our meal and it was a nice palate cleanser between the dishes we ate.

The only negative thing I can say about the experience is that I couldn't try more dishes from the menu!! ( I was stuffed 😆)

Overall if you're looking for a change in pace from a busy night out I'd highly recommend coming here as my friend and I had a great time and would definitely come back again!!

An excellent restaurant in London. The food was really good and full of flavor, and the service was great especially thanks to a very helpful waitress.

The dishes are quite spicy, so if you’re not a fan of spice, be careful when ordering. For me it was slightly too spicy, but still excellent. A very good spot for a quick lunch or dinner. Highly recommended.

So glad I came across this little restaurant. Lovely welcome with fast service. I had their signature Korean Fried Chicken with a lemon salad. Delicious. And washed down with a tasty Korean ginger tea.
Stopped here for dinner as I was overnight for work. The food was amazing and the place is super cute. I had their Korean Fried Chicken (KFC) and it was so good!
The food here was delicious. Everything looked great, well presented and tasted amazing, and would definitely visit again.

Went for Iftar, they gave us 2 dates and water to break our fast. We got the BBQ set for 2, portions were really good, food tasted amazing, definitely good value for money. The meat was really tender and juicy. Defo recommend! Everything was halal!

We had an exceptional meal at Korean BBQ House. The food was delicious and the service was outstanding. The staff left us to grill our own meat which was lovely. The mojitos were delicious. Also we needed to pray, so the staff provided us with a prayer mat and let us pray downstairs which was so kind of them. I would highly recommend! We spent around £150 for 4 people which is a fair price for the great food we had.

Finally, a fully halal Korean BBQ spot!

There are plenty of places in London that claim to be halal but still serve pork, so finding this place was a relief.

We had a great time here and left completely full and satisfied. The meat was tender, juicy, and packed with flavour. We even tried the dessert, which was absolutely delicious!

The staff were incredibly kind and accommodating, they allowed me to pray in their downstairs seating area since it wasn’t open yet and provided a prayer mat to do so. May God bless them for that!

We booked in advance (which I definitely recommend, as it gets quite busy), and overall, it was a wonderful experience. I’ll definitely be coming back with friends!

Overall, it’s a decent Korean restaurant. The bibimbap and japchae were really good and well-prepared. It’s also a halal place, so you won’t find pork dishes that are usually common in Korean restaurants. However, the BBQ meat was a bit disappointing. Most likely this was due to the restaurant’s rule of grilling the meat on paper rather than directly on the grill surface. As a result, the meat felt more stewed than grilled, which took away from the whole BBQ experience.

Excellent restaurant!
Amazing food! Great and friendly staff! Gorgeous decoration!
Really really loved it!
Everything is so delicious ( and Halal )
I strongly recommend

First time customer here and I had to come in after passing the shop lately and smelling the lovely food.

I must say the lady on the till/also prepared the order was kind and knowledgeable, recommended the Gangjung which was really nice. Fresh garlic, ginger flavours

Had the Chicken Mandoo / dumplings which were some of the best I've had. Can't wait to try something new

Thank you to the kind and warm staff who introduced me to my first taste of Korean cuisine, will see you again soon 💙
Very delicious food and kind staff, the portions are big and we were so full ;)

I live very close to Jijigo so frequently try their menu and I’ve been impressed with everything I’ve ordered. Personal favourites are the katsu curry (far better than wagamamas), the dakgalbi and the Ssambap. Portions are always really generous, especially with the protein. service always friendly, highly recommend!
This place is a hidden gem! The Korean Corn Dogs are amazing! Crispy and delicious. Highly recommend getting it with spicy Mayo and ketchup + sugar. We have been back 3 days in a row!

The corndog tasted quite plain and it didn't hit like corndogs from Bunsik. It would be good if they had more option for sauces and fillings. I can't say anything about the main meals as I haven't tried them yet.

They also have no seating and you can't eat at the counter which is frustrating.

name: Korean Taste & More
address: 183 Cannon St Rd, London E1 2LX, UK

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Tried the Chicken Galbi here and it was absolutely delicious! The chicken was tender, juicy, and perfectly coated in a rich, spicy-sweet sauce, served sizzling hot with fresh vegetables. Paired with fluffy rice and tasty side dishes, everything was full of flavour and really satisfying.

The atmosphere is comfortable and the staff are friendly, making the whole experience even better. If you’re craving tasty Korean food, I highly recommend coming here. They are new restaurant but definitely worth a visit! 😊🍗🇰🇷

The food was honestly amazing, we had bibimbap, a bubbling Korean stew, and Korean fried chicken and every dish was full of flavour, fresh. The service was outstanding, the staff were so friendly and even made an exception by letting us take mochi as takeaway even though it’s usually eat-in only, which we really appreciated. The only downside was the seating layout because the chairs are placed a bit awkwardly and it’s easy to trip when walking past, but overall the food and service made it a great experience and I’d definitely go back.

We didn’t expect much from a newly opened restaurant but the food and atmosphere was amazing. The chef has been making korean dishes for 9 years, me and my friend ordered bibimbap, seafood pancake and the tofu stew, all of it was delicious and authentic. The place even uses traditional clay pots, and the overall vibe was so homey and cute. The staff was friendly too. Come before it gets too popular!

This place was lovely and prices were reasonable! I ordered the budae jjigae (army stew) and the flavours were really nice and not too spicy. Staff were friendly however I do think the chairs do not fit the tables as they were quite easy to trip up on.
Absolutely amazing food!! And such a lovely staff!! Must place to go if you are in East London.

name: YOKI Korean Soul food @boxpark shoreditch
address: Unit 42, 2-10 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E1 6GY, UK

reviews.text:
Had a great experiencing YOKI in boxpark Shoreditch. They have a lunch deal where you can get Korean fried chicken, fries and a can of a fizzy drink lunchbox for just £10! I really enjoyed thier sweet and spicy kfc, which was served hot and tasted authentic.

I highly recommend coming here for tasty Korean dishes.

I had an amazing experience at this Korean restaurant! I ordered the fried chicken and spicy pork, and both dishes were absolutely delicious. The fried chicken was crispy and flavorful, and the spicy pork had just the right amount of heat and richness. Everything was cooked perfectly and tasted so fresh. The staff was friendly and attentive, and the atmosphere was warm and welcoming. I’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend to anyone craving authentic and tasty Korean food!

The staffs were very friendly and nice. The foods were authentic - approved as a Korean myself and outstandingly delicious. I would like to revisit again. The atmosphere is also very nice in the dining area.
Had the bibimbap, one of the best ive tried in London so far. Staff were very friendly also. Highly recommended
Good portion size but sorry to say very bland and personally found it not worth consuming after spending £13.50 - got the garlic soy

name: Bari Bari
address: 24 White Church Ln, London E1 7QR, UK

reviews.text:
Reserved a table for a large group and I was grateful that the restaurant was patient with us when a few of us arrived late. We ended up all ordering at about 3:50 and one of the later guests ordered at 4pm. Within 30 mins, 7/9 of us had received our dishes. After 50 mins of ordering, the 8th person had received their food.  The person who ordered at 4pm didn’t receive her food till 5:12 which was shocking for a vegetarian bibimbap, considering one of the people to first receive their food ordered beef bibimbap, so you’d think the vegetarian one would arrive faster. We asked waiters about 3 times and none of them had a concrete answer. They were also not very kind, had frowns on their face the whole time and didn’t even try to be polite with us. We’d prefer if they would’ve told us that dish would come so late so that person could’ve ordered something else as by the time their food had arrived, we had all eaten. To compensate, we asked to get the service charge removed to which the server looked confused but we were luckily able to to take that off as other reviews said otherwise.

On the positive side, my spicy beef stew photographed was lovely tasting and fairly priced. It wasn’t filling on its own though so needed to order steamed rice on the side. The ambience was lovely as well with nice lighting and decorations.

Food was nice but service would have to improve for me to return.

Nice food, but quite a small restaurant!

Not really buggy friendly but still doable.

Language was a barrier. As a novice to this cuisine, we were trying to ask about the menu options and we got the completely wrong things as they did not explain it properly. Considering the clientele they must deal with not sure why they are not better equipped to help out diners.
We also got a huge volume of food ordered because of this!

Really expensive for what it is.
Serves halal food.

Wonderful, authentic delicious Korean food at very reasonable prices. Top quality and generous portions too. Had fish stew, which I loved. Friendly welcoming staff and vibrant atmosphere. Recommended!

⭐ Constructive Review for Bari Bari Restaurant

I’ve visited Bari Bari a few times now because it’s close by and I often crave (rice) Asian food, Unfortunately, the waiting times have been consistently disappointing.

On my recent visit, I waited 47 minutes for a simple set lunch — even though the restaurant was only half full. I noticed several tables were also waiting, and no one acknowledged the long delay.

This wasn’t the first time I encountered this issue. On a previous visit with my husband, his sweet & sour chicken arrived after about 25 minutes, but my meal took almost an hour(Galbitang). He finished eating and had to leave for work while my dish still hadn’t been served, aside from a bowl of rice left getting cold on the table. That experience was already upsetting, but I wanted to give the restaurant the benefit of the doubt.

Today, however, I noticed a group of three guests — who seemed to know the owner — being served quickly despite arriving after several other customers, myself included. This added to the frustration and made the wait feel even more unfair. They left the restaurant while I’m still waiting for my food.

For a casual restaurant offering simple dishes, a 10–20 minute wait is reasonable. 30 minutes starts to feel excessive, and 47 minutes without any communication or apology is quite disrespectful to customers’ time.

The food itself is fairly basic and not particularly authentic, so waiting this long makes the overall experience feel even less worthwhile. I hope the restaurant improves its service flow and consistency, because at the moment, the delays overshadow everything else.

I went to eat with my boyfriend for the first time.

❶ Sizzling Bulgogi Set  10.8

Special lunch set before 3pm on working days

This is very suitable for office workers. There are many office buildings nearby.

When I went there, there was a table with Korean men in suits for dinner.

One set for each person

❷Galbitang (short rib stew) Beef Rib Soup 12.5

It's most comfortable to have some warm soup in winter.

The rice written in the menu is not included

I don't know if I ordered the wrong set meal that day.

Or because I actually gave side and rice at noon.

❸cold noodle cold noodles 14.5

In fact, this is more than enough for two people.

But I really wanted to eat cold noodles that day.

Add white vinegar and cold noodles and dip a little hot sauce. It's so delicious.

The second time was on Christmas Day. Their house was still open.

I called an hour in advance to reserve a seat.

This time it's with a little sister. She is very knowledgable about Korean food. Take her to have a taste.

❹ kimchi pancake kimchi pancake 10.5

This is the starter, but it's the last one. It's very slow.

It feels like it's done now.

But my friend certified it was delicious! She has eaten it all. Highly recommended.

❺Galbi jjim (braised beef ribs) braised beef ribs 18.9

The beef ribs are still soft and delicious.

I highly recommend it to friends who like to eat meat.

❻Spicy Kimchi stew Spicy Cabbage Soup 10.8

My friend likes to eat kimchi very much.

So there are both kimchi cakes and kimchi soup.

According to the comments provided by her, the pickles in this house are light.

It should be to reconcile the regional taste.

It can't be said that it's not authentic, but it's really less delicious.

The shop is full of brown-black waiters with no Asian faces.

But I specially watched the kitchen, haha

As long as the chef is from Korea~

A small cookie was also given on Christmas Day.

So heartfelt

Bari Bari

Business hours 11:30-23:00 (closed on Sundays

📍24 White Church Ln, London E1 7QR

#British International Students #London Korean Food #London Korean Food #London Life #London Food #London Store Visit #London #London Koreatown #East London #White Church

I visited for the second time after sharing feedback about my previous experience, and I truly appreciated how the staff handled it. They were very friendly, sincerely apologised, and made an effort to ensure my meal was much better this time, which showed that they genuinely care about customer satisfaction.

During my first visit, I had the tofu kimchi soup, which was disappointing. The portion felt quite small, with only a couple of slices of tofu and mostly leafy vegetables, making it feel overpriced for what was offered.

Overall, I’m glad I gave them another chance, as the service on my second visit was noticeably improved and left a much better impression.

Fantastic hidden gem among the Liverpool Steet skyscrapers!

It was a little bit on the pricey side, however it was absolutely delicious, and most things are 20% off after 2PM!

Ordered a K-BBQ pork Bimibap with glass noodles and it was the perfect portion for lunch! Great spice level without destroy flavour, and there was plenty of ingredient variety! Would also recommend ordering "Love" on the self check-out touch pads!

Plenty of seating upstairs, free hot sauce stations, great k-pop music, self-checkout pads, and you can even buy bottles of soju at the counter!

Authentic, delicious, great value Korean food. The staff are so friendly and kind.

We came here for dinner, it was empty but I loved sitting in. The were clearly so popular with takeaway food !

A wide menu with great options that remind me of my trips to Seoul !
Ordered the beef BBQ bulgogi via pick up and thought it was delicious! Well seasoned served on time and the staff were super friendly. Will be ordering again!

Tried Bento Bab after spotting it on IG. Crispy chicken, fresh kimbap, and perfectly spicy tteokbokki that tasted just like the food I had in South Korea. Friendly staff and chilled vibes. I’ll be back for the stew!

name: MoMo's Japanese & Korean Street Food Farringdon
address: 67 Long Ln, Barbican, London EC1A 9RQ, UK

reviews.text: Went into the new Momo is to try it just after it recently opened and haven’t stopped going back. The food is outstanding. The service is amazing. Solomon is 10 out of 10 for customer service. I will keep on using momo’s whenever I’m in the area

Went on opening day and had a great experience. The food was fresh, flavorful, and came out pretty quickly considering it was their first day. You can tell a lot of effort went into the menu and presentation. Staff were friendly and welcoming, and the vibe was nice and lively. Definitely a great new spot for Japanese/Korean street food looking forward to coming back and trying more items

I came here with my husband and children on their opening day. The staff were kind and friendly and the food was really tasty. My daughter enjoyed a side of Mac & Cheese and my son enjoyed the Korean fried chicken and plain noodles. We would recommend this place if you are looking for a good bite to eat in the Farringdon area, just opposite the Barbican exit of Farringdon station.

Amazing experience at MoMo's in Farringdon! The Japanese and Korean street food is delicious, and the service was incredibly fast. Even with a big order, the staff went above and beyond to get everything ready quickly. Excellent quality and a great spot for a quick, tasty meal. Highly recommended!

Loved the food here! It was fresh, flavourful and perfectly cooked, with great dipping sauces.
Friendly service and a cozy vibe, definitely a great new spot worth visiting!

Huong Viet Restaurant on Curtain Road in Shoreditch is always one of the best places for comfort food. The pho is exceptionally delicious rich, flavorful, and truly satisfying. The vermicelli beef salad bowl was fresh, light, and very refreshing.

The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, and the whole restaurant feels clean and well cared for, which makes the dining experience even more enjoyable. I always leave feeling happy and satisfied. Highly recommended for anyone looking for authentic and comforting Vietnamese food.

Overall was a lovely place to have Vietnamese Pho. I ordered a lunch deal that came with spring rolls and a bowl of pho. I got the chicken and prawn spring rolls and despite having a really fishy taste they were amazing and the sauce made it even better.

As for the pho itself, the broth was great (would’ve been better with maybe a chilli sauce) but I definitely think there could’ve been more noodles especially as I usually leave a pho spot feeling really full. The egg fried rice was so flavourful I think I may have enjoyed that more than the pho, we split it between my group and we kept going back for more. The mocktails were great and really refreshing after the hot bowl of pho.

Staff were okay. Was a bit annoying that sauces like hoisin and chilly were extra. These are usually a standard and are already on the table so was annoying that we had to pay for them. It was also super cold on this day so having the door to the back constantly open due to deliveries coming in was really inconvenient. I understand deliveries must come through but the drivers/staff should’ve made an effort to keep the door shut.

All in all, it was a decent halal pho spot which earned it 3 stars but wouldn’t see myself coming again unless it was for the egg fried rice.

I have eaten at a lot of Vietnamese places and this place is the best tasting one for me by far. Their soup broths are very clean tasting, clear and fresh with lots of depth, and all their dishes are cooked really well and full of flavour and served out very quickly. Plus I know that the food is always consistently good and as I stop there to grab lunch at work often so I know it’s not a one off experience. They have very good cocktails too. No oily spring rolls either.

Nice cosy place, good meet and vegetarian food choices, delicious dishes and soups. One thing to be awear of bathroom is downstairs with very very steep stairs if you elderly or less able not sure how mean to get down there. Friendly and profesional staff.

We came during lunch time, ordered their Pho Tai (rare beef) and vermicelli salad bowl with beef as our main and also got a grilled beef in betel leaf. The food came very fast and staff were friendly. Our mains were amazing maybe if there was more sauce provided for the vermicelli salad bowl then it would be even better as it lacked flavour but there was sriracha sauce provided on table so it helped with the flavouring. We didn’t really enjoy the grilled beef in betel leaf as much because the beef inside was kind of dry for us, it lacked flavour even though we dipped in the sauce provided. Their ice Vietnamese coffee had too much ice not much liquid and their ice was very small so everytime we were sipping the drink from the straw  the ice was coming up with the liquid. I wish their was less ice rather than the ice filled to the top of the cup and more liquid please as we didn’t even drink that much the coffee was almost gone all there was left was ice filled to the top of the cup. Their banh mi seems quite nice would come back and try that.

Highly recommend if you’re trying to decide between all the Vietnamese restaurants in the area. The staff are incredibly friendly and helpful. We ordered the banh xeo and banh mi which were both delicious, the Vietnamese iced coffee is also excellent!
Probably the best Vietnamese restaurant I’ve ever been to in London? And I have been to a dozen of them I reckon. Food is great and environment is clean and classy.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Went here for dinner with three friends and it turned out to be a really lovely find. The food was fresh, comforting and full of flavour. Proper Vietnamese cooking rather than the overly westernised versions you sometimes get in London. The place itself is small but cosy, with a relaxed atmosphere. Everything arrived quickly and the staff were polite and attentive without being over the top. Great little spot on Kingsland Road for a laid back meal

Came into this place based on reviews and am very very happy with the whole experience.
The attentiveness of service was exceptional. The staff are genuinely engaged and curious which makes for such a great experience - vs forced niceness which you can feel through. The staff are amazing and hat off to the chef also because the food was divine.
I will be back for the amazing food service and feel.
Thanks Bep house
Had the sharing platter. Everything really good and will definitely come back to try other dishes. The spring/summer roll that came as part of the platter is a highlight, but everything was good.

Comforting bowls of northern Vietnamese food. Very quick service if you need something fast, and lovely staff. They have chilli sauce and pickled garlic on the side. Super reasonable price and now my new go too because Slurp across the road is relatively overpriced.
Huge bowl of vegan pho an absolute must especially as we enter the winter months. Very speedy service, friendly people and the condiments on the table are fantastic. Thank you.

Huge bowl of delicious pho with so much meat - I think the reviews saying the portions are small are fake as that’s just not true.
The service was super friendly, the aunty from the kitchen even came out and offered to hold our baby whilst we ate.
Definitely recommend if you want a quick, casual and tasty dinner or lunch.

Wouldn’t recommend. The waitress is always at the till with AirPods on. No response to your requests at all. Service is rather bad. Food is blow the average of viet food in London, but Price is above the average

Oh my god… oh my god… it’s a must-try food shop! My friends suggested the food to me. I’ve tried a few dishes, but the beef pho stir-fried rice noodles—waaah! My new favorite!

And the portions are generous, with great service! It’s pet-friendly, wheelchair accessible, and the staff is super friendly.

The fish starter was really good. Definitely worth a try if you are 3 or more. And the pho was so flavourful. It’s rare to get pho this good that’s not just full of msg after taste.

Would definitely go back !

Awesome experience dining here, felt like home! Authentic Vietnamese pho tucked away by old street. The service is attentive and so polite! We ordered the chicken mango salad and beef BBH, both impeccable and portions was healthy to say the least. Would recommend if you’re in the area craving a hearty food fix 🇻🇳

Very happy with my experience at Com Pho. The service was efficient, the food came very quickly and it was delicious. There are still many other options in the menu I want to try. Definitely recommend.
Yummy Vietnamese food in London! We ordered noodles and fried seabass which were superb. Recommend the fish particularly.

The noodles and the fried rice were good but the grilled chicken was amazing. The spring rolls were highly recommended and were okay. Overall I really enjoyed the meal and would love to explore the menu.

Down to earth, relaxed, casual diner atmosphere.

Went with friends because this place was recommended.

Lovely.

Tried several different dishes and enjoyed everything.

Good quality food.
One of the best Vietnamese food we had so far. Small place but quiet. Food was tasty and delicious. Service was fast.

We got a Deliveroo tonight.  We have eaten here in the past and thought it was terrific.  They do the best pho broth of all of the Vietnamese places near us.
We ordered quite simply,  We shared a pho with rare beef, some papaya salad and a starter of honey chicken wings.
The pho was very good but arrived with most of the broth spilled and wasted.  Not sure if this was the fault of packaging or our Deliveroo driver.  Beef was tender.  Garnishes were a wedge of lime, and a scant quantity of bean sprouts and mint.  No little tubs of hoisin or sriracha so you need to have that in the pantry if you are going to order a delivery.
The starter of wings were good.  Roasted rather than fried and a nice sauce that was sweet but not cloying.  The papaya salad was a disappointment.  There were plenty of prawns but the nuoc cham dressing was used too sparingly.
I think I enjoyed 3 Mien better during restaurant visits than as a takeaway.

I’ve had a recommendation to try this place for lunch and it was a very good ideea.
The food was delicios, the service was fast and the atmosphere was pure Vietnamese with Vietnamese music.
Best special beef pho i’ve eat.
I would totally recomand this place for a delicios Vietnamese food. I would definitely come back.

Amazing portions, flavour and prices. We got the fried chicken curry, pork bun cha and iced tea which came to only £30. The meats were smoky, and came with delicious sauces and fresh vegetables, the curry was quite spicy. Service was quick and friendly too. Beautiful hand painted walls and pleasant music. Highly recommend!

A recent article in The Guardian reckoned this spot has the best pho this side of Hanoi, and I have to say I agree! It also said it was worryingly quiet during the week, but that’s not what I found on a Tuesday night when I had to queue for half an hour to get a table. It was worth the wait though. The menu is small, but that’s the point, the focus is on the pho. I had summer rolls and then the rare steak pho and it was absolutely delicious, really flavourful, but with a kick. Lovely staff, a relaxed vibe and great value too - I’ll be back.
