This is one of the best authentic Vietnamese restaurant I’ve been too, I loved the food here! The food was fresh, and flavours was perfectly balanced. Everything tasted homemade and thoughtfully prepared. Portions were generous. This place truly captures the essence of Vietnamese cuisine. I’ll definitely be coming back and recommending it to friends!

Absolutely amazing food—everything was so tasty and full of flavor. The lamb chops, chicken, and tofu were all delicious. Lovely bar too, and hands down the best spicy marg I’ve ever had. Would be back in a flash! Great service too :)
Compared to the other Vietnamese restaurants in the area, this was setup quite nice. Food was good although paying 2.50 pounds for fried egg for the com suan seem a bit steep. Service was fine.

We recently had lunch here because I was craving Asian comfort food.

The food is good — especially the lemongrass chicken with rice, which is a standout. It has a legit Asian flavour, tastes fresh, and is nicely presented.

The drinks are a bit expensive for what they are — £5 for a small glass that’s mostly ice (we tried the calamansi juice and lemongrass juice).

Service-wise, our food came about 10 minutes apart. That’s not ideal, because by the time my dish arrived, my husband was already finishing his. If he had waited for me, his food would’ve gone cold. That said, I’m giving them some grace since they’ve only just opened and are probably still working out their kitchen timing and coordination.

Overall, I enjoyed the food and would come back.

Haven't been to this place in years. But visited today with some family friends. We are Vietnamese and this is certainly a more high end establishment. This is reflected in the price being slightly higher than your typical Vietnamese restaurants but the quality and quantity of the food is certainly higher also. I was pleasantly surprised on my return and had a most enjoyable meal. We had the banh cuon, banh uot, goi, cha gio, bun bo hue, bun cha hanoi, and com ga. All items were excellent and very authentic. To top it all off, after discussing among ourselves how delicious the chili sauce is, we ended up having a lovely nice chat with the manager too.

The food at Viet Grill was excellent. We shared a mix of meat, fish, and vegetarian starters, all of which were delicious. The bone marrow pho was unlike any pho I have had before and very tasty. There was also a good range of non-alcoholic drink options. I especially enjoyed the sour plum tonic, unusual flavours but really enjoyable.

Service was a bit mixed. Our mains took quite a while to arrive, and one member of staff came across as slightly surly, though others were friendly and helpful. The music was also far too loud for my liking.

Viet Grill is the favourite spot on the Kingsland Road strip of a Vietnamese girlfriend of mine.  I like the food but my enthusiasm is dimmed by the fact that it is 30% to 40% more expensive than their competitors on Kingsland Road.  The extra dosh does buy you a nice decor, and romantic dim lighting.  Somewhere you could take a date.  Unlike their competitors that mostly offer a canteen atmosphere.

Our server advised us well on how much to order for a non ravenous table of 5.  From the starters section we had Hanoi style Banh Cuon, fish sauce caramel chicken wings,  grilled aubergine with minced pork, salt and pepper squid.  All were good.  The salt and pepper squid was served a little differently than in other restaurants on the strip, in that squid was first deep fried and then stir fried with some onion and peppers.  Banh cuon is served by some other restaurants nearby, but not all.  It is similar to Chinese cheun fun.  Viet Grill offer three regional variations of this less commonly available dish.

From the mains we had the sizzling mixed seafood stir fry, which was the only disappointing dish, being characterless and a little bland.   Stir fried morning glory was dependable if unremarkable.  Beef stew redolent with cinnamon and lemongrass was tender and delicious.  The best of our mains was the claypot catfish, stewed in the same fish sauce caramel that coated the chicken wing starter.  This is a somewhat uncommon dish not available in every Kingsland Rd restaurant. We needed three servings of plain rice for the 5 of us.

I did like the food but questioned the pricing compared to nearby competitors.   That said, the decor and atmosphere is much better than the other Kingsland Rd restaurants.  I would recommend Viet Grill for a romantic date, or when taking out an elderly relative who is put off by the basic canteen-like atmosphere of most of the other Vietnamese offerings on Kingsland Road.

Looking for value for money come here.
We had a group of 10 and had the set meal 2 which worked out £22 a head. Free to bring in outside drinks too. Unreal and left feeling very full
Fantastic experience and there are some fun unique dishes offered here that we recommend you try, especially the rice paper crepes!

Delicious and authentic Vietnamese food at a reasonable price. The Hu Tieu noodle soup is excellent, with a light, clear, and savory broth made from simmering pork bones. It’s the perfect comfort on a chilly day. The lunch deal is a great bargain, and they don’t skimp on portions. Service is prompt and friendly. Highly recommend!"

Excellent restaurant, with a diverse menu beyond just normal pho. If you’re not a first timer, this is great to expand your palette.

Note that the restaurant does not take booking so it is first come first serve. We were there between 1pm and 2pm, and it was very crowded.

Note that the food portions are enormous, so you might just be full with a single main menu item. We ordered a starter to share and a main meal each, and we did not even finish everything.

Wall decoration tries to immitate the wars in Vietnam so it’s an interesting experience. Staff was very efficient and delivery takes normal time (~10-15min depending on how crowded it is).

Nice and cosy Vietnamese restaurant. I ordered a chả cá Lã Vọng and my boyfriend ordered the duck noodles. Portion was good and the service was really nice. The waitress with the nice ribbons on her ponytail (idk her name) was very helpful. Just a note that it will be better for the restaurant to have the ingredients on the menu :) there was pork in the duck noodles and we only found out later.
lunch menu was very affordable and extremely filling - highly recommend the chicken curry! Cant go wrong at all for 15 quid, this place will definitely be my go to for Vietnamese in Dalston

I don't remember this dish name as I asked the staff to choose for me! It was rice with stir-fried meat something, but it was literally so hot and warmed my soul on a cold night out!
the display and quality did not disappoint either

Some of the most authentic pho I’ve had in London. The Saigon sate pho was delicious with a savory, peanuty broth that had a nice, rich beef flavor without being salty. The perfectly cooked rice noodles were a hearty portion and had just enough beef. Will definitely be back!

I’m very fussy when it comes to Vietnamese food as a I’ve eaten great quality in Vietnam. The chicken pho had generous portions of chicken and the soup was very tasty. The papaya salad was light and moorish and the chicken wings appetising. Put this on your favourite list!

Had the classic beef pho and split a Banh Mi with a friend.  Was very impressed with the flavors, good balance here of bone broth and herbs.  Very exciting menu, a lot of interesting dishes here to try, there was a lamb curry dish in the menu that caught my eye.  Definitely some authentic flavors and a very welcoming and relaxed atmosphere.
So delicious! Crispy pork belly rice bowl and papaya salad were honestly really great. Had a lot of Vietnamese in London and this one is really up there. Such good value also
Amazing beef pho. Best I’ve ever had. Great portion sizes aswell. Great price. Will be coming back here for sure!

First visit I ordered pork with rice and vietnamese coffee.
The dish was nice and generous portion.
Coffee was also nice.

Second visit I got beef pho, the broth was tasty. The beef was soft.

I also like the way they packed the takeaways.
I havent dined in the restaurant yet,  its always busy when I visited.
The staffs were nice and friendly

Went here for a late lunch and we ordered some chicken pho and spring roll bowl.
It was super delicious and freshly prepared.
Spring rolls were super crisp with rice paper wrappers like made from home, not store bought.
Pho was very savory and had a very own taste. Very Hanoi like.

It is very close to Liverpool street station.

You can order fully by Web/QR code to your table. Small menu but very versatile. Also very affordable and not overpriced.

Tasty & affordable Vietnamese cuisine.

I came here for lunch and tried the Beef Phở and Pork Bánh Mì. Both were tasty.

Nice interior & very clean.

Beef pho was really good, definitely recommend! I think I’ll be coming here quite often. Make sure to order the spring rolls as well – the sauce was delicious. Came on a Monday evening and it was already quite busy. Staff were very friendly and welcoming. Not noisy at all, so it felt comfortable to have dinner.

Also had the winter melon milk tea – really tasty. Would recommend! 👌

Bit of a way to go for these guys, given the number of Vietnamese restaurants in the area.

Price is good at £10 for a bowl of pho

Taste was pretty bland, broth was lukewarm. There was only sriracha sauce available to taste, no hoisin or soy which was really disappointing - it’s basic stuff.

Everything served in cardboard or temporary containers too despite eating in. Needless waste.

Overall this is just touching 5/10, as if I wanted a takeaway, I could have gone to the 5 Vietnamese food stalls within 10 minutes of the restaurant.

Great food and quite busy!

My recommendation would be the fish (sea bass) with mango sauce, so fresh and yum!

I noticed this high street has multiple Vietnamese restaurants, landed on this one due to the great reviews and am not disappointed!

Service was good, especially considering how busy the place was. Food was fast!

Paid in cash.

Overall great experience and would recommend it!

I left Vietnam 6 years ago, and was transported back with the atmosphere, the friendly service and the authentic Northern Bun Cha Hà Nội flavours. Just a shame there was no Huda bia!

I’ll definitely be coming back to taste more options.

Cảm ơn nhiều, hẹn gặp lại!

Charming restaurant with excellent service and bold flavours. I thought the lemon and kumquat kombucha was excellent! Very zesty. 😋
We enjoyed the spicy shiitake mushrooms and tofu aubergine curry the most, but everything was delicious and I hope to return again soon.
Me and my friend went to try Nem Nem randomly as we were walking by. What a fresh bowl of delight. Really tasty food, lovely atmosphere and service. Highly recommend

Second visit and was better than the first. The golden pancake is devine and the vegan spring rolls out of this world. Service is great and super reasonable. One of the best restaurants on upper street. Go try you wont be disappointed.   Lovely vibe too it’s actually atmospheric not just bright light.

name: Pho 101
address: 259 Hoxton St, Whitmore Estate, London N1 5LG, UK

reviews.text: Ate here last weekend - food was so yummy and such good value for money! Definitely will be back. Staff were so lovely too, go support your local!

PHO VIET 101 is the first time I tried in Hoxton, and I must say, WOW. "I dare you to try out, delicious traditional Vietnamese food, damm, you won't be disappointed. Especially when they recommend YOU something from the menu, take it you won't be disappointed. I RECOMMEND IT

The food is realllllllly good 👍 😋 👌 😌 😍 🙌  all the above
Great new spot for Vietnamese in Hoxton. The pho was one of the best I’ve had, very reasonably priced and large portion! Can’t wait to come back and try other things on the menu.
Really good food and we were well received by the staff

The ingredients are very fresh, the food tastes great and quite authentic (I was in Vietnam recently). incredibly good!
The staff is also super nice ♥️

Highly recommended.

My friend and I went here and both got pho. She got the spicy beef which she loved. I got the veggie pho (pho chay), which was perfect. Exactly what we needed on a cold London day. Portions were HUGE. We got regular and neither of us finished the bowl. Then my friend got  the coffee with the jelly bits and it was so good. I am not a coffee girl but I do have a love for Vietnamese coffee and this definitely hit the spot.
Overall a great place with food that transported us back to one of our favourite countries

For pho, I’d likely choose another spot. The food was great and arrived quickly, which we appreciated. Service started off friendly but became less attentive sadly. Drinks and starters were forgotten, a dish was incorrect, and there was some confusion around dietary requirements. It may not be the best option for those with specific needs

Stopped at Delicious Pho for dinner, had a prawn pad thai and lime soda, both were great.  Food in general is nice and authentic.

From the street, the restaurant itself doesn't look busy and looked to have little ambience but once inside people are sat further in and is spacious.

Stumbled across this gem on a random evening. We didn’t intend to dine in however the aroma caught up  to us we simply couldn’t resist lol Tried 4 various bowl all served  deliciously fresh. Will highly recommend anyone to try short ribs set x

Excellent food, very delicious and authentic. We had a Kids Pad Thai too and it was a bit pricey including a drink £12 but I have to say it was plenty. Chicken wings with fish sauce super tasty too as well as the Papaya salad. Overall a great experience

The lemon-cured beef salad was incredible. Then we hesitated about the Pho. We asked our waiter, Diego, who gave an excellent recommendation with the garlicky pho. We had never tatsted this kîd of Pho before and it was a really good surprise. The atmosphere of the restaurant is nice, not too crowded (friday night around 8pm) and the staff was lovely! Thank you Diego, we'll be back!

super Vietnamese authentic restaurant. love the local chains in London and this is added to my favorites list, had the bunbo hue which is super authentic and had all the meats along with the pho which was good. I think it was pretty decent but the bunbo hue overshown, and had the crispy crab parcel which was so delicious and like tasty from the first bite to the end and had the right sauce and crabbyness to it would definitely come back

I’ve been coming here for over 20 years as I work just around the corner. The menu has only ever become more interesting and the food better and better in that time. Today I had the £19:95 set lunch menu with the ‘piggy’ aubergine starter and Spring Bowl as a main course. The latter was improved over last time I had it, with lots of fresh raw herbs and greens and excellent crispy rolls on top. I really recommend Cay Tre for lunch: the service is brisk, the food is fresh, and very delicious.

Amazing experience. Foods are wholesome and absolutely delectable. I tried the shrimp spring rolls and grilled pork vermicelli, both were flavorful and satisfying.
The staff are friendly, especially Jules, who made a delicious drink and provided excellent service. The restaurant is clean, neat, and incredibly cozy.
I highly recommend stopping by if you’re looking for an authentic taste of Vietnamese cuisine.

As a Vietnamese living in London, Cay Tre is one of my top favourite Vietnamese restaurants. They have a wide ranges of Vietnamese food, the quality is really good and some dishes are close to home. The Cay Tre at Hoxton is smaller than the one in Soho, but still quite cosy vibe and good quality, albeit smaller menu than the other branch. I’d always recommend friends to visit at least once!

Love this place. The food is amazing specially the Banh Mi they serve, as well as the papaya salad. The ice coffee is just perfect.

Nice and attentive staff.

In this location the space is small so a quick grab and go place. We went during the weekend so not too crowded and can get busy depending the date and time.

This is the best bánh mì shop I’ve come across! The food is amazing and truly authentic Vietnamese cuisine. I’ve become a regular because everything is consistently delicious. The rice dishes are lovely, the Char Sui has become my absolute favourite. A special shout out to the summer rolls they’re incredible- light and refreshing, yet flavourful. The staff are always so pleasant and respectful which makes every visit even better.

Fantastic banh mi - super fresh bread, perfect mix of herbs and veg and the fillings were delicious and well portioned. Drinks were great too, the Vietnamese iced coffee was banging.
Would 100% return.

Food here is great I’ve been ordering for years. This week I ordered 3 times. One of which I ordered 15 banh mi.  Always been happy with this place. In fact on the receipt it says I’m a regular, I’ve made 29 orders most of which are big orders. But the last time. Order #0911 on 27 November 16.07. My noodle soup was missing soup. I complained to Deliveroo and they said Keu will make a decision. And it’s days later still nothing. So I guess they ignore me. Probably one of their most regular customer. I didn’t want to leave 1 star cos I’ve been happy in the past but here’s a 3 star hope owner can read this and give me an answer. Don’t even care about the money but the principle of waiting over an hour for your food, a noodle soup, without soup….. just ruined my whole dinner.

Really great Banh Mi near Old Street/ Shoreditch.
A little on the pricier side, but the size totally makes up for that.
You get a big sandwich, and it’s stuffed with fillings.
The bread is a little more baguette like than traditional Hoi An Banh mi, but otherwise i can’t fault it.
At lunchtime during peak hours you might be waiting a little longer.

Also recommend the cafe sua da, or iced vietnamese coffee.
Super yum

The food was fast,fresh and seriously delicious, good value for money and i wish there was a branch near me.
100% will come again and will recommend it too to everyone
Had the surf and turf.

Stumbled across this little gem on my way back to my hotel! I’m so glad I did. I opted for the Bun bo nuong with added veg spring rolls. It came with a pot of fish sauce and a crunchy Vietnamese salad. It was all so tasty and fresh - delicious and so much flavour. I marked 3 stars on atmosphere because I feel that it’s predominantly a takeaway, with added table and chairs as an afterthought and not much thought has gone into the decor/ambience, however, it wouldn’t put me off going again! I’d really like to try more dishes!! (The picture doesn’t do it justice). Great value for money too!! 👌
Oh my goodness. The food was delicious! The flavours were just right. It's so refreshing to be able to have great food at a very reasonable price. I am so coming back to try the rest of the food! 😁

Been coming here since they’ve opened, an extention of their Surrey Quays branch. Honestly amazing food every single time, I’ve recommended this place to all my friends and family and they all say the same! I get the Surf and Turf with fries or garlic noodle usually, beef is so tender and flavoursome, vietnamese flavours done beautifully. This time i got the Duck loaded fries and it was so delicious, hightly recommend! Staff are very helpful in terms of helping with options and also very warm and welcoming. Definitely recommend to anyone who has yet to pay Nam Nam a visit. Also! This branch in particular is Halal so thats a bonus!

Lovely local luscious lucky and licenced liquor !

I don't get visit as much as I should as every time I go and get a take away here I'm overjoyed with the food.

On my last visit, I got a portion of chicken wings and a soft crab noodle box with sirachia mayo.  The portion of crab was plentiful,  the nudial, delicate and everything wonderfully flavoured, while the chicken wings had just the right bite of spice to put a smile on my face.

Didn't take longer than 10 minutes to cook, right? In front of me and topped it off with a tiger.Beer which went down smoothly. Next time, i'm trying some of the ube coffee too.

Forget all the local kebab, houses and cafes and gets a decent food here people.

I had an absolutely fantastic experience at Pho Spitalfields. From start to finish, everything was exceptional. I ordered the hot and spicy chicken noodle soup along with the regular chicken noodle soup, and both dishes were outstanding. The preparation was clearly done with care and attention to detail. The hot and spicy chicken soup had the perfect balance of heat and flavour rich, aromatic, and incredibly satisfying without overpowering the taste of the broth. The regular chicken noodle soup was just as impressive comforting, fresh, and beautifully seasoned. The presentation of both dishes was excellent. Everything looked fresh, vibrant, and thoughtfully arranged, which made the whole dining experience even more enjoyable. You can really tell that quality and authenticity matter here. The staff were extremely friendly, welcoming, and attentive throughout my visit. They made me feel comfortable and well looked after. On top of that, the restaurant itself was very clean and tidy, creating a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere. Overall, an amazing experience with delicious food, fantastic service, and a spotless environment. I would highly recommend Pho Spitalfields to anyone looking for high-quality Vietnamese cuisine in London. I’ll definitely be coming back!

Great experience!

The food was lovely. The pho was amazing. Tasted rich and worked really well with the extra sauce. I also got the Vietnamese curry and for a specialized Pho restaurant, it was very good. It's competing for my favorite dish against the Pho.

The interior decoration is really neat and feels homey and all the staff is very friendly and attentive. I was served by a waiter called William. He gave such good recommendations and was very attentive.

Would definitely recommend and I would go again.

The whole menu is Gluten Free! First occasion where I could share with a friend who also had allergies. Delicious wings! Dishes full of hearty flavour! Generous portions! We got so excited we ordered too much! Excellent customer service! Highly recommended!

A lovely experience thanks to Louis (or Lewis I’m sorry I didn’t ask how to spell your name) and Chinny, who were so kind and very attentive to my needs !
I was seated very fast and didn’t wait too long for my food. The food was very good, really hit the spot on such a cold winter day. I had one of their Spicy green pho and the Crispy spring rolls. Fairly priced as well for Central London. I think the chicken is halal but you might want to check again with the staff.

Absolute fave Restaurant. Both my starter, Summer Rolls and Main, chicken Vietnamese Salad were amazing and full of flavour.

Shout out to Leo who looked after us brilliantly..what a ray of sunshine.. thanks Leo.

A real Asian gem that stands up to gentrification.  It's exactly what you need to escape! Feint Asia pop and the whimsically Viet decor is the perfect setting to unwind while you slurp the tangy fish noodle soup.   I kid you not, this actually feels like you're there!   Don't bother looking for company just go!!  Everything is simple and done with the kind of flair your mum throws down on a rainy Sunday.

I noticed this place had newly open and was curious about "Japanese fusion" - but the menu is entirely Vietnamese.

I ordered the bún chả cá (sour fish noodle soup). The flavour was pleasant but rather mild and the noodles were overcooked. At least they weren't stingy with the fish and fish cakes.

I appreciated having condiments available on the table to adjust for the mildness - although there were no spoons, and I had to borrow one from another table as my server wasn’t around. The herb plate that came with the dish was a bit of a joke as it just had a small piece of lemon, shredded iceberg lettuce and ONE sad limp piece of coriander!

Service could be improved. Despite being the only customer at the time, the food took over 20 minutes to arrive. I wasn't asked how the meal was, and at the end I was just given the card machine rather than a bill or receipt. The advertised 20% discount wasn’t applied until I queried it - even then it was done with reluctance. The most bizarre thing was that I asked if Amex was OK and got told yes, then after I tapped it I was told I shouldn't have as it "costs them a lot" - this was awkward!

I know it's a new business and reviews are important, but the point of leaving honest reviews is so others know what to expect. Hopefully these teething issues get resolved soon as there are many other Vietnamese restaurants in close proximity!

I ordered the fried rice and honestly it was amazing. The rice was nicely seasoned, not oily, and packed with flavour. The vegetables were fresh and the crispy fried onions on top added a perfect crunch. Great presentation as well. A really nice fusion dish — I will definitely come again.
The vegetarian & chicken spring rolls are phenomenal, the rice paper was super crispy !! The best I’ve had in london, not kidding. You’ll love all the food 👌✨

I had chicken spring rolls (which were the best I ever had…sooo tasty ) and salt and pepper squid washed down with a glass of Viognier wine which complimented the spice in the dishes perfectly. I never knew that was the perfect compliment to Vietnamese food before and I’ve never seen it on a Viet wine list until now. . I used to have Chardonnay . Never again . I will be bringing my family here next Sunday . They have a secluded VIP room for parties of 6 or more.

Cute little place selling delicious vegan Vietnamese dishes. My 16 year old daughter who was very resistant at first seemed to enjoy the food. I think the overall cleanliness was satisfactory but could be improved. I had a bout of diarrhoea the night after eating there so not sure if this was related or not. Despite this, I would eat there again as the food was delicious, fresh and well presented. The staff were friendly, albeit a little shy, but no problems with order and time for food to arrive. Nice little new year display by the door. The starter platter was the favourite, I would have that again.

FANTASTIC VEGAN PLACE!

The absolute highlights for me were:
1. 15C Bun Cha President- I asked the lovely waiter for a recommendation and he suggested this one. It was superb 10/10!
2. Crispy Pancake- The filling combined with the light, crunchy pancake was incredible. Highly recommend this!
3. Fried Rice (side) I saw a previous review mention how good this was so I had to try it. They were right, it’s super flavoursome- I ate it on its own!
4. Sierra Yogurt Smoothie was my favourite drink of the night. Creamy, refreshing and delicious.

Honestly, everything I tried was great, but these are my must haves! The food is fresh and satisfying, you leave feeling full but not heavy.
I’ll definitely be coming back again and again!

I love the food here so much!! Everything tastes authentic and so glad it's all Vegan and cruelty free 💚 We got Banh Cuon, Banana Flower salad, Banh Xeo, Spring Rolls and for the mains Classic Pho, The caramel banana vegan 'fish' with rice. For dessert we had Mango Spring Rolls Coconut Black Rice Yoghurt 😍  Everything was delicious and amazing as always.
We've been to lots of great restaurants in London over the past few weeks, but this has been our favorite. Every dish was fantastic. Looking forward to returning.

Had an amazing lunch here. All the dishes we had were top notch. Served quickly and with a smile. Love this place.

Recommend the pho and the tofu and lemongrass dish.

Also does a 15% discount at lunchtimes (Mon to Fri).

I ordered the tofu banh mi (it’s kind of like a baguette sandwich, with tofu and salad inside) costing £8 as of now. I highly recommend using the available sauces on it, tastes even better! The tofu’s texture was so satisfying, it was fried very well in my opinion.

I do think the price could be lowered for this specific option though, or at least offer some student discounts. Either way, I did not regret purchasing the delicious banhi mi!

The decorations of the shop were beautiful, my friends and I really admired it. It’s quite cosy, with comfortable seatings in my opinion - although I assume it may get full easily during peak times, as it does feel a little cramped (in a cosy way).

The server was super nice, thank you for serving me and my friends today! I will definitely be wanting to come back here again.

As a Vietnamese, it has been a long time since I tasted such good authentic Vietnamese food. We ordered spring rolls, spicy noodle soup, bun BBQ, and everything was wonderful. Highly recommend, the owner is also very friendly.

I'm visiting UK for couple weeks

Eat here twice. I love Pho here which is tast authentic. Delicious

Would recommend spicy noodles soup with beef for the one who love a bit taste of spicy

Everything is great here if i come back UK for the next time i would definitely come back here ☺️

Very kind guy at the bar, I think he’s the cook as well. But the environment of the shop was too humid for me plus the beef brisket pho was quite chewy, not the type of meat I’m used to having with pho. Soup was solid, but pho noodles itself and the meat was nothing to write home about.

Ordered a beef brisket pho, which is tasty and the portion is very decent. The owner was very friendly. He speaks limited English but we communicated through Google Translate without any issue. Would definitely come back to try other dishes.

Food was good but service below par on this occasion. Took a long time waiting for the bill and then had to go up and ask to pay. If someone tells you the service wasn’t good you should also offer to take the service charge off the bill.

This is my favorite Vietnamese restaurant. The food here was amazing, very cheap price compared to other Vietnamese restaurants I used to eat. The handsome waiter explained how to eat them properly really well to me. Especially beef pho and Hue beef noodle soup here are really excellent compared to Green Papaya restaurant. I will definitely come back in the future. A great experience.

We had a quick dinner on a Tuesday before going to a gig in the nearby Moth club. It was quite, only a few customers . The atmosphere was somewhat unremarkable, with a generic interior that lacked character, but the dining experience was still pleasant, and the food was delicious. We tried the pork skewers with satay sauce , the prawn spring rolls, and the special noodles. The skewers took 10 minutes to arrive, but they were cooked to perfection. The spring rolls were bursting with flavour, filled with succulent prawns and fresh vegetables. These two dishes overshadowed the noodles, which didn't seem as flavorful. Generally, Hanoi pho was a pleasant surprise.  I will definitely revisit and get some more of their skewers.  The service was excellent, attentive, and polite throughout.

This is my new favourite place for Vietnamese in London!!! No frills, lovely service and absolutely delicious, authentic food.  The beef stew was gelatinous, hearty and super aromatic.  The pork & spring roll bun was the best I’ve had, with lots of herbs snd pickled veg.

I usually hate writing reviews…but this place really deserves it.  I’ve been to
SO many more average Vietnamese in the area who have much higher ratings.  Come here - it really is the best!!!

We’ll be back very soon!

Thank you 🙏

Best affordable and authentic Vietnamese food. A bowl of pho is only roughly £10 which is v cheap for what you get. Great service with v charismatic waiter! I come here regularly and would say it's the best food compared to its competitors on mare street. Fyi, the pho has more Northern tastes (less sweet than Southern).
Unmissable papaya salad, most welcoming and friendly staff, will come again

name: Banh Mi Aha! Farringdon
address: 86 St John St, London EC1M 4EH, UK

reviews.text: This place does lovely banh mis! The aha banh mi is definitely the best and tastes the most traditional. The chicken banh mi (as pictured) is also nice but slightly dry… needed some sauce!
Cute little restaurant tacked away in Farringdon. Nice service and super delicious flavourful food. Recommend to vegetarian too. I will come back for sure!💕
Ordered takeaway and the bahn mi was excellent. Exactly what I wanted. They were prompt and packaged well for travel. Next time I’m in the area I hope I can stay in for a meal:)

For opening week, no discount. Even charged service charge to dine in when the atmosphere dictates a 'take away' store.
The place should say if they are charging extra to eat in - just courtesy to do so.
Dine in was like an extra 20% more for.. little service.

Food on a plate did not look that much different from a takeaway, just on a plate. I've just seen the place post a few pictures of the same thing I had - it definitely does NOT look like what the 'restaurant' posted: Had the three meats and it tasted good, but the condiment supplied was only 20% sauce in a bowl.. the impression seemed like they were savvy in giving enough sauce at the beginning. Asked for extra, the second bowl maybe 35% full.
See image and compare it for yourself. Better still, you are more than welcome to dine in at the risk of your own cash.

No prawn crackers, do let customers know when you have sold out of something, it helps to decide what to eat next.

Ice coffee could do with a bit more sweetness and less ice. It was pretty much 60% ice, one could argue I ordered ice with a hint of coffee.

Overall, bit pricey for the whole meal especially for lunch.

May be its because its opening week and the restaurant is still learning which is fine. But just remember customer experience is also important.
Came for a quick lunch. The bun bo hue was generously portioned, the service was quick and the price was reasonable. I’d happily return.

name: Hohaki
address: Aldgate House, 68 Middlesex St, London E1 7EZ, UK

reviews.text: The food was exceptional - really enjoyed the Ribs and the Noodle soup. Top tier.
I had vermicelli noodles with grilled pork. The dish was nice overall, but the portion was quite small, and the pork was over-grilled with some burnt parts, which wasn’t pleasant experience
So glad I found this authentic Vietnamese restaurant, the food here is amazing, except for pho, the hohaki chicken rice is a must try! Thanks to the kindly staffs, will come here again!

Goodness gracious the char and marinade on the grilled pork bun at Hohaki guarantees a one way trip to flavor town. Had I known I would be cruising down tasty street I wouldnt have worn my white shirt cos that flavor be slapping.

Update: Came back twice for the grilled chicken, healed my soul.

The banh mi is not authentic though. Its a denser crusty french baguette that takes away some of the flavor from the delicious grilled filling.

**Editing to add that they have now refunded me for the incorrect dish. I do hope the service will improve next time I visit. Thank you.

Original post:
Incredibly upset to get home after the longest day and see my rice order was rice noodles instead. I didn’t even realise until I started dishing out my food at home. The First Lady who served me was nice and friendly but the other lady seemed distracted. I also asked before leaving that my order was correct, and I was the only person in the restaurant as it was close to closing time (around 8.30pm on Tuesday). Please reach out or send a number to escalate this because the number on Google is not working as I mentioned to the First Lady who attended to me.

name: Santo Remedio Taqueria, Shoreditch
address: 55 Great Eastern St, London EC2A 3HP, UK

reviews.text:
In conjunction with National Margarita Day, I was invited to some seriously tasty Mexican fun at Santo Remedio in Shoreditch

The venue itself is small but cosy, and from start to finish the service was absolutely spot on.

We began by sharing the Cured Seabass Ceviche and Sashimi Grade Tuna Tostadas — generous portions (thankfully!) and both packed with flavour. I’m a big fan of dishes like these and the tuna was definitely a highlight for me.

Next up were the Grilled Chicken Al Pastor Tacos followed by the Prawn Tacos. Both were delicious in their own way and, luckily for me, nothing was too spicy. I genuinely can’t decide which I preferred.

To finish, we had the Seasonal Tres Leches and the Mexican Dark Chocolate Ganache. The ganache was a little too rich for my taste — thankfully it wasn’t my pick!

And of course, it wouldn’t be National Margarita Day without a margarita (or two). I tried the Margarita de la Casa and the Coconut Margarita — both dangerously good

What I really appreciated was that we weren’t rushed at all. Each course arrived separately at the perfect pace, which made the whole experience feel relaxed and indulgent.

I felt incredibly privileged and blessed to have been invited. Just a slight shame we got on the wrong bus on the way home and arrived back 1.5 hours later… but honestly, after margaritas, that one’s on us

Amazing experience at Santo Remedio Mexicano in Shoreditch!

We had such a wonderful time here today. From the moment we arrived, the service was outstanding. Our waitress, Jessica, was incredibly kind, attentive and always checking if we needed anything. She gave us great recommendations too — the Spiced Mango Margarita was absolutely delicious, and for my daughter she suggested the Hibiscus Agua Fresca, which was fresh, tasty and very refreshing.

We ordered several dishes, all beautifully prepared with fresh ingredients. We had the Cruded seabass Ceviche, the Sashimi grade Tuna Tostadas, and the Chorizo Quesadilla — all of them full of flavour. The quesadilla was perfectly melted and not spicy, while the ceviche and the tuna tostada had a nice little kick. We also tried the Baja Style Fish Taco, which was crispy on the outside, soft and juicy on the inside — simply delicious.

They welcomed us with fresh corn tortilla chips and homemade guacamole, along with flavourful salsas that complemented every dish. My 10-year-old daughter loved her grilled chicken al pastor taco, which they kindly prepared non-spicy for her. I tried the spicy version that the chef made for me, and it was excellent.

The atmosphere was relaxed and comfortable — perfect for having conversations, enjoying some family time, and listening to Latin music in the background. The whole staff, including the chef, were friendly and very professional.

Me and a group of friends came for the bottomless brunch. We are a little bit particular (lol) but the staff were very accommodating. Tanika our waitress was exceptional. Extremely knowledgable and helpful. We all had our margaritas slightly different, and we all said how perfect they were. The food was 10/10 - amazing. Everything was perfect. 100% recommend and will return. Thankyou for a lovely afternoon!

We had a wonderful time dining at Santo Remedio Mexicano at Shoreditch. The service was exceptional from start to finish, and our waitress Jessica truly made the experience memorable. She was friendly, attentive, and always checking in to make sure we had everything we needed. Her drink recommendations were perfect — the Spiced Mango Margarita was outstanding, and the Hibiscus Agua Fresca was refreshing and full of flavour, ideal for my daughter.

For food, we tried the Sashimi Grilled Tuna Tostadas and the Prawn Taco, both beautifully prepared with fresh ingredients and full of vibrant flavours. The tuna had a slight spicy kick, while the prawn taco was juicy, tasty and perfectly balanced. Everything felt fresh and thoughtfully made.

We were also served warm corn tortilla chips with homemade guacamole and delicious salsas — a great start to the meal. My 10-year-old daughter loved her non-spicy al pastor taco, which was prepared specially for her, and I enjoyed my spicier version as well.

The atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming, with Latin music in the background that created a warm and enjoyable vibe. We were able to talk, play and enjoy our time together comfortably.

Everything we tried was insanely good! A bit pricey, but totally worth it. I would recommend getting the tuna tostadas if you go, I could have eaten 20 of those. It was a shame they didn’t have some of the items on the menu on a Saturday lunch which we would have liked to try. We wanted to try the chocolate and rum pie but they didn’t have it and ended up ordering the chocolate ganache which was a bit hard and not enjoyable. But overall, I would still give them 5 stars for the tacos and would certainly go back to try more flavours and hopefully the desserts we couldn’t try. The drinks were also amazing!!! 🤩

The decor is amazing in Los Mochis and the views aren't too bad either. They have an extensive cocktail list and we sampled several. The best being a wasabi, litchi one.  Highly recommended. We stuck with the Mexican fusion as they wife doesn't eat fish. We ordered several dishes all absolutely delicious. My favourite was steak tacos and the duck salad. We will definitely be coming back.

very nice place, it s jap/mex fusion the ambient is very modern elegant and charming. there is music in the background that is not disturbig. quality of food is very good we took siffetent samplers more on the fish side. guacamole is remarkable. service is fast accurate and rhey provided lot of tips. great discovery here in london will come back and it s recommended

WOW! It's not often I'm blown away by a restaurant but I honestly have not one bad thing to say about this place. The decor, the service & the food was all 10/10 amazing! I've been to quite a few restaurants in London and this has become my top tier restaurant! I will definitely be returning.

We ordered:
- Edamame
- Bang Bang cauliflower tacos
- Flank steak tacos
- Chicken teriyaki skewers
- Pato on crispy rice

Desserts
- Chocolate fondant
- El Coco

This was a fantastic restaurant. I love the Mexican/Japanese Combo Theme and everything I ordered was amazing. Kim was a wonderful server and recommended the Dynamite Prawn tacos which were incredible. Would definitely come back and highly recommend. Thank you Kim and the wonderful staff at Los Mochis for a great dinner.

One of the best dining experiences we've had in London. We were well looked after by the staff who dealt well with our various dietary requirements and requests. We loved the decor and had a fantastic view from our table on the roof terrace. We started with some cocktails. The lychee wasabi margarita was a perfect mix of sweet and spice. The food was delicious and well presented. We delighted in how well the Japanese - Mexican fusion worked making this such a unique dining experience. Between the four of us we had the tasting menu for two plus a few extra dishes from the a la carte. Highlights included the Gringo lobster tacos, the blue fin tuna sashimi, black cod volcano, socal fish tacos. We had an excellent wine recommended - Oremus Mandolas Fermint - which paired well with all the dishes.The baked alaska and panna cotta were a fantastic way to end the meal with a nice glass of port.

name: Caldera
address: Unit 8, Monohaus, 143 Mare St, London E8 3FW, UK

reviews.text:
Had a lovely time with my friends! The food was not too heavy but still filling. The mushroom tacos were really good, would definitely recommend.
Mar provided really good service and the ambient is perfect for a relaxing lunch

Really good food and great vibes. The pork tacos were amazing and the cocktails were on point. Big shout-out to the staff, especially Fra, who made the experience even better. Will definitely be back!

Food is great. Pork croquettes, pork tacos were good. Slow cooked rib was amazing, but the burrito was below average. Very poor service but I dont blame the stewardess since I believe that it is a managerial flop.  Only one staff was serving to 5 tables at the same time. She was also preparing the take away orders too. What is she? Superwoman.? Come on....!!!!

small portions, one prawn per taco? The sauce was spicy and a bit too much, took over the flavour palette and overwhelmed the tase of the black pepper prawn and guacamole. Otherwise okay. We came before 6 without reservations and were told we only had 30 minutes to eat. At that time restaurant was fully empty so I guess it fills up a little later. Great ambience. Got wings also, pretty great but one was rather burnt. Food is decent but portion sizes are relatively small for the price. The meat tacos are more generous but could have used more sauce.
reviews.author_name: Ngai Ning Yu - Fine Art Painter

reviews.text:
Francesca is bloody fantastic service she had great recommendations

Tacos are lovely

The dry age beef were so good we ordered twice

Will we be back Forsure

We have been looking for a source of edgy fusion tacos ever since our favourite  DF Tacos went defunct.  Breddos comes close though their flavours are not quite as bold and bright.  Also Breddos is expensive for what it is.  Wine was a total rip off at £38 a bottle for something that came from a vat and served in a decanter.

We started with tuna tostada which was very good.  Raw tuna, cabbage moistened with ponzu, crispy fried onions on top and a slather of avocado at the bottom.  Only a single tostada for £9.  The other tacos were two each.  Baja fish included a generous chunk of deep fried cod but but otherwise not exciting.  I liked the addition of tart pomegranate seeds  and salty grilled halloumi in the vegetarian  smoked aubergine but the tacos didn't really exude smokiness. All the masa harina tortillas were impressively thin.

Of the rest of our order, elotes had been coated in a pleasant sauce but could have been more charred for my taste.  I didn't like the churros which were very greasy and served with a pallid toffee sauce instead of more compex dulce de leche.

Dinner for two came to £98 including a bottle of wine.  Lights are dim enough for me to need a flashlight app on my phone.  Acoustics are not great so the place can get noisy.

Incredible mexican food. Service was impeccable, staff was super friendly and recommended some dishes. The crushed potatoes and chicken wings as started were delicious, tasty and full of flavour. And tacos were another level! If you are looking to try mexican food, this is the place. We definitely coming back for more.

Incredible food, lovely staff, speedy service.
Was seated immediately, server was polite and friendly. Expressed our intention to have a fast dinner, after our order was taken we received our ceviche starter in 3 mins.
We had the baja cod, the birria, and the larger pork taco. Every bite was exceptional, perfectly spiced, flavours spoke for themselves, homemade tortillas were amazing. We couldn’t recommend this restaurant more, will be returning.

Love breddos, couldn't wait to come visit again and so glad we booked a reservation. Love the food, tried some new dishes and some faves from our last visit and definitely didn't disappoint. Such great flavours and combo. One of my favourites which sounds so simple is the rice and beans. Also tried the papas and they had a delicious dipping sauce and with honey, such a good combo.
Had the masa fried chicken tacos again and as good as we remembered. Tuna tostada was delish and a good mountain of flavez.

Found the team behind Breddos all so friendly and welcoming, loved the chilled and laid back vibes, such a nice place for intimidate dining. Couldn't believe how quick the food came out as well, the staff were also very relaxed even when we had finished all our food. It has become a personal favourite place of mine and can't wait for another visit soon!
100% recommend. Great tacos, great cocktails, good friendly service and atmosphere. Perfect Thursday night to decompress from a hell of a week.

name: Los Gordos x BoxPark
address: Unit 60, BOXPARK Shoredictch, 2-10 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E1 6GY, UK

reviews.text: Really good nachos would 100% recommend
Delicious food, friendly staff! Always come back and follow them wherever they go!
Brilliant opening party with a Mariachi band
Had the beef and the plantain! Great deal
Coming back everyday😍😍 outstanding

That really hit the spot! It can be difficult to find great Mexican food around London but I was really blown away by this place. The nachos were spectacular and probably should have stopped there but had tacos and spice bag with my friend. Went home satisfied and stuffed.

These might just be the best tacos in London. Loved everything we ordered, especially their take on a spice bag (perfectly named the Sex Mex), the carne asada tacos, and the campechano taco. The Mexican-inspired spice bag was huge, great for two people but could have easily fed a few more, and well worth the money. The best part of Thrift Taco, aside from the incredible food and their cozy pub spot at The Howl, is the people behind it. Jillian and Bryn know exactly what they’re doing - amazing people who are clearly passionate about food, hospitality, and creating a great experience. Highly recommended

After being blown away by Thrift Taco’s menu at Doña in Stoke Newington, I just had to follow them to Howl at the Moon to try their current menu. Absolutely the best tacos I’ve had in London, the carne asada tacos are absolutely to die for and their loaded nachos are delicious, so indulgent and exactly what you’re craving after a pint or three. You can tell they put so much thought and precision into everything they serve and are innovative in the best way possible. If you like spice like me you won’t be disappointed by their handcrafted hot sauces either. Just phenomenal all round. Howl at the Moon also has such a fun atmosphere, lovely staff and invitingly cheap pints so you absolutely can’t go wrong.

Finally! An amazing taco in London! Have been looking for a decent taco for awhile and these were wonderfully delicious: spicy, messy, with a perfect corn tortilla - as the taco gods intended! Tried all varieties and each is uniquely tasty - favs are definitely the pork and the sweet potato. Can't wait to go back and stuff myself with tacos ... again.

Outstanding taco goodness! I got the pork which was so juicy and perfectly seasoned. However I swapped with one of my friends to try the sweet potato which surprised me by being my absolute favourite. The flavoured blended so well with phenomenal mouthfeel. The photo definitely doesn't do it justice. Can't wait to try the chicken next!

Been here on a Saturday afternoon for lunch. It was not busy, restaurant has a nice relaxed atmosphere, waiters were all nice/friendly. Food and drinks served quickly. Had a portion of nachos which was great, loved the toppings, a lot of variety. Also had grilled chicken, buttermilk chicken, pork, fish tacos. They all tasted great, I m not usually a fan of pork flavour but these were cooked in a nice way and really liked them. My favourite were the grilled chicken tacos. I also liked that different tacos are served with different types of tortillas.

Joao D was our waiter and he was absolutely wonderful! He presented the menu really well, suggested sides that would go well with the dishes we ordered. The food was so delicious as well and the waiter also handled my partners allergy with such care and consideration. Everything from beginning to end was effortless and the team are so lovely. Will absolutely be back!

We had an amazing dinner experience! We ordered Tacos (grilled chicken&avocado, beef gringa), quesadillas (brinsdisa chorizo) and for sides the sweet potato and sweet potato bravas. The food was delicious with the perfect spice level, truly the moneys worth. The service was amazing and all the servers were super kind and considerate. We had a really great time here. In addition: The music was chefs kiss!! Highly recommended if you’re a fan of latino vibes:))

I would not normally order plantain tacos, but these were a perfect compliment to the special - pork belly skewers. Many wonderful yet delicate flavors. Finished my meal with churros and coffee. My server Joao was a delight and gave detailed recommendations. I wasn’t expecting a detour to Oaxaca while in London, but I am very glad I did.

Such a delight!! So much vegetarian items on there.. delicious and the ingredients were so fresh. Quick service and the staff was very friendly. If you looking for mexican food you must absolutely go there.
The vibe is so good. The tables are well spaced which gives privacy and the cocktail menu is good as well!

It's a cute little place with amazing food! Limited options with amazing quality of food. We tried the Mr Bean (not Rowan Atkinson) tacos and it was just super delicious. Not only did we order more but also ordered for a take away!
The spicy salsa was fab.. The owners are super passionate, friendly and lively brothers, whom we had a brilliant conversation with. The staff are very friendly and efficient.
Limited seating but they are beside a bar where the food can be taken to as well. They had a few brilliant bands playing when we went, which you can find on Dice app.
The place is located at a few minutes walk from Hoxton station. There are buses as well, making it an easy commute.
Well well well. Mind blowing i love to have there tacos again . Unbelievable i did tried in different place but there one is awesome. Deffo  i m ordering again

Had a great experience at Taco Collective! The food was fresh, flavorful, and well worth it. Special thanks to Paresh for the excellent service — friendly, attentive, very knowledgeable about menus and made the visit even better. Will definitely be back!

Not the first time I've been but not the last either. Food was fantastic and the prawn tacos are not to be slept on.

I'll be returning when I'm next in the area for sure.

Thank you all,
Love this spot, the service was really good and the staff were super helpful. There are also great vegetarian options, which I really appreciated. Would definitely recommend and will be back again!

name: Little Fires
address: 125-127 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E2 7DG, UK

reviews.text: As a Mexican, I absolutely loved the molotes! The taco selection they had from Hungry Taco was amazing and delicious. We also tried some seafood Mexican dishes paired with cocktails with dragon fruit and hibiscus that really made my day. Highly recommend!

The guys couldn't have made our private event any better. Completely supportive from start to finish and an unforgettable evening. Incredible food and drink and a brilliant venue for hire downstairs with great sound system and privacy. Couldnt recommend the team, the venue and the fun had more highly!

Absolutely loved this place and had the BEST time here! The space is beautifully designed too,  vibrant main dining rooms upstairs and a more intimate, cosy setup in the basement which was perfect for drinks, so you get to experience both things!

Also we had the best time trying the drinks, all so good! the hibiscus sour was a standout (beautifully balanced)!

Already planned the next visit :)) 100% recommend it!

I had an extremely poor and deeply frustrating experience with Little Fires, and I would strongly advise against using this venue for any organised event.

I booked Little Fires for my company’s End of Year event and was let down at almost every stage of the process.
To begin with, my original booking date was double-booked by the venue, forcing me to move the event from a Thursday to a Friday. While this change fortunately worked on my end, it should never have happened in the first place.

Even more concerning was that prior to being informed of the double booking, the events team completely ignored repeated calls and emails requesting updates. There was no communication, no acknowledgement, and no professionalism.
Once I eventually made contact, the situation did not improve.

Organising even basic details became unnecessarily difficult. Responses were slow or non-existent, and information had to be chased constantly. This complete lack of communication caused significant stress and anxiety, as I was left in the dark with an event approaching and no confirmed plans.

Astonishingly, in the week of the event, I still did not have confirmation of:
The food menu
The DJ
Any form of event schedule or planning documentation

At this point I had no choice but to repeatedly call Christian, the owner. I finally reached him the day before the event. Instead of offering support or taking responsibility, he spoke to me rudely and dismissively, showing no concern for the disorganisation or stress caused.

He attempted to justify the lack of communication by stating they were “busy,” which is entirely unacceptable when you are hosting a paid corporate event. His tone was unprofessional and confrontational, and he made me feel as though I was at fault for simply trying to ensure my event went ahead.

The issues continued on the night itself. I paid £500 for canapés for 40 guests, and when the food arrived, it was genuinely shocking. There was nowhere near enough food at best, it would have fed 15–18 people, not 40. As a result, I was forced to order pizzas in at the event because staff were hungry, which was embarrassing, entirely avoidable, and should never happen at a catered corporate function.

The most outrageous issue occurred when I ordered additional platters of scallops and prawns on the night. Christian personally gestured with his hands to indicate the size of the platters and stated they would cost £180 each. While expensive, I agreed based on the size described and purchased two. What arrived from the kitchen was appalling. The plates were tiny, barely enough for one person, let alone a large group. In total, there were approximately 12 prawns and 10 scallops across both platters, yet I was charged £360. This felt like nothing short of a scam. I have attached photographic evidence for reference.

The only positive aspect of the entire experience was the front-of-house staff. The waiters and bartenders were polite, hardworking, and clearly doing their best under extremely poor management. Several even expressed shock at the lack of food and the disorganisation. The drinks service was good, and the staff on the night tried to salvage what they could of an otherwise disastrous event.

In summary, this venue demonstrated:
- Poor planning
- Non-existent communication
- Dishonest portion representation
- Unacceptable value for money
- Rude and dismissive management

This was meant to be a professional work celebration and instead became a stressful, embarrassing, and costly ordeal. I would never return and strongly recommend others look elsewhere for events of any kind.

We attended a private event here. A shout out to Brendon who made the most amazing cocktails! I tried the Hibiscus sour both alcoholic and non-alcoholic (equally good!!) and a Picante.
Truly some of the best cocktails I've had! Thanks!

Delicious! Super fresh burritos and bowls. Really enjoyed my chicken burrito bowl with guac. Service was kind and friendly. Prices reasonable. Just know, this is a takeout only restaurant. You’ll have to find a place to sit somewhere in the park/market across the street. Otherwise, highly recommend this place.

A fantastic service all round and a real credit to the staff, Gemson and  Teja! Highly recommended.

Excellent service from start to finish. The staff were professional, friendly, and incredibly attentive, making the whole experience both comfortable and enjoyable. They were very knowledgeable about the food they offer, happy to explain menu items, and able to make helpful recommendations with confidence.

The hygiene standards were clearly very high; everything was clean, well organised, and well maintained, which added to the overall reassurance and quality of the experience. What really stood out was the team’s genuine care and willingness to go the extra mile.

Went in for my lunch break, was served by two lovely gentlemen. I didn’t catch the first one’s name but Gem was an absolute star. They served me with precision and care. The food is amazing and I’m happily satisfied. As I work in the area, I will be back!

I’ve ordered from this place through Uber Eats multiple times, and they have gotten my order wrong every single time. It’s honestly unbelievable how the same mistakes keep happening. This last order cost me a lot of money because Uber Eats refused to refund me, and the restaurant’s carelessness is the reason why.

What makes it even worse is that they sent beef, which is completely unacceptable in my culture. This isn’t a small mistake it shows a total lack of respect and attention to customers’ dietary needs and instructions. When people trust you with their food, the least you can do is read the order correctly.

They seriously need to fix their process at the counter and improve quality control, because customers should not be paying for their errors. At this point, I can’t recommend this restaurant at all.

This is my second account from google to complain about the same issue in the same branch, they better fix this issue seems like the staff are purposely sabotaging food of regulars who post comments. i’m not ordering anymore due to the fear of them next up spitting on my food before sending it it’s a real possibility. if you’re interested please visit the other branches this is a horrible branch visit the ones in other areas. the other ones always get the order right and send additional note with thankyou which is insane given how many times this branch messes up.

I’m genuinely concerned about the level of negligence at this branch. Just yesterday, I watched a friend receive a beef burrito bowl that was completely wrong and he was so frustrated he threw it out right in front of me. It really makes me question whether the staff are getting orders right every time. Do customers seriously need to open their burritos to check if the correct meat is inside? That’s a basic health and safety issue, and it’s unacceptable.

What’s worse is that I noticed two reviews from the same person reporting the exact same problem, which tells me this isn’t an isolated mistake. It shows a lack of accountability and a lack of willingness to fix recurring issues. Honestly, it’s disappointing and embarrassing, especially when other Tortilla branches maintain far better standards. Management needs to physically go to the store and check what’s happening. Because if they’re running out of beef or chicken and quietly replacing it with something else, that’s a serious breach of customer trust. Overall, the behaviour here feels cheap, careless, and far below what the brand should represent.

Absolutely sad to see this. If my friend hadn’t thrown it out right there, I probably wouldn’t have taken the time to write this. But it happened in a student accommodation, and everyone who saw it was genuinely disgusted by the level of negligence. We fully support him and we won’t be buying from this branch anymore

name: Tortilla Liverpool Street Station
address: Liverpool Street Station, London EC2M 7PY, UK

reviews.text: Great spot for a quick, tasty bite near Liverpool Street! Fresh ingredients, generous portions, and friendly staff. Always hits the spot when you’re in a rush but still want proper food.

I’ve been a regular here for years, but today’s service was unacceptable. Some at store charged me full price (and then some) for a meal, then served me a tiny portion because he "couldn't wrap" a full-sized burrito. Instead of finding a solution, he just gave me less food for more money. Truly zero customer care. Disappointing to see such a decline in standards

Similar to other reviews the portion sizes are minuscule. When the owner was not present the staff said it was due to it being a franchise branch, so they are extremely cheap. Just to note there is nothing wrong with the food itself it’s fine plus the staff are okay and the restaurant is usually clean. But with the appalling portion sizes definitely give it a miss as there is another Tortilla near spitalfields market (2 min walk) which give better portion sizes, accommodations/amendments to meals and also take the loyalty card. Considering the repetition of the portion sizes complaints the owner of the store should take the feedback onboard.
The food and service are expected. We was slightly disappointed though that the Tortilla Club isn't accepted at this location.

Very disappointed with my visit. The portion size was extremely small — I was given literally two pieces of chicken. On top of that, the employee kept pushing me to upgrade to a larger size and add extra toppings even after I repeatedly said no, which felt uncomfortable and unnecessary. For the price, I expected much better value and service.

name: Crudo Shoreditch
address: Retail, Unit D, 211C Old St, London EC1V 9NR, UK

reviews.text: The ceviche is fresh and delicious. The tacos are creative and delicious. And the service is incredibly kind and helpful recommending dishes. 10/10 I will go back.

I would say it’s one of best restaurants in London, and the bartenders are so kind. Highly recommending the tuna dish, tacos and Mixto ceviche sea food dish. They are literally the best sea food I’ve had in London.

This was my fourth or fifth visit. It has never disappointed this time. I took my little dog and they even brought her treats and a water bowl. The staff have been different every time but absolutely fantastic. Every time I’ve gotten the set menu it has been brilliant but I also get the tuna to start every time too. Nothing here is bad food quality service vibes value for money all excellent!

This was a somewhat last minute decision for a late dinner after a long day and wow it did not disappoint. Every single item was fresh, flavorful and beautifully plated. I came right before close and Jose graciously seated me, treated me to a few little extras, and brought my day to an end in a lovely way. Cannot recommend this hidden gem in the Shoreditch area enough!

Incredible dining experience, excellent fresh seviche and tacos, topped off by outstanding warm service from the host and chef. Lovely atmosphere in a warm and cosy restaurant. Hoping to visit again soon.

name: Benito's
address: Benitos, UNIT C, 5-7, Devonshire Row, London EC2M 4UJ, UK

reviews.text:
Cannot rate this place higher! I went here for a 'Too good to go' order i had placed earlier and when I got there a bit early, the lovely lady serving offered to make it FRESH, there and then! Insanely polite and amazing service! Great music and very clean! Loved my entire experience here and I will more than likely be going here more regularly!

Food was also amazing! Fresh, succulent spices and meats along with the rice and the veg!
Thoroughly enjoyed my lunch experience. The music transports you. The personal welcome is genuine. The freshness and the taste exceptional. Relaxed atmosphere. 5 stars!

Got  take  away. first time / last time.
Flavourless, bland, and very bad value  for over £11.00 - pure rip off. Try to compete with other places round here? good  luck.
tasted like a rice and citrus sauce Wra; Boring ..And no Guacamole as ordered. Maybe they shud double check orders before they send stuff out at these prices.   pretty much a average/ bad experience.. DREADFUL VALUE/BORING/ TASTELESS
It’s a really friendly and welcoming shop . Food is tasty and well spiced. Staff are friendly and helpful. Especially Viki and Jass. Thank you ✨🍸
Terrible food, burritos are flavourless and they put hardly any meat inside and they forgot to put sauce in it. It was cold and the service was horrible.

name: Barrio - Shoreditch
address: 141-143 Shoreditch High St, London E1 6JE, UK

reviews.text:
I walked in because the place looks really nicely decorated inside and, let’s be honest, tacos and a cold beer always sound like a good idea. Or so I thought.
The food was disappointing. No, wait… tragic.
I honestly don’t think I’ve ever eaten at a “Mexican” place with so little Mexican about it. Wheat tortillas instead of corn. No coriander. No lime. Jarred guacamole making a very sad appearance. Jalapeños were there… but nobody knows why.
Everything was so bland that I asked for a hot sauce. I was handed a bottle of Cholula. When I asked if they had anything spicier, I was told that was the only option. End of the culinary journey.
The menu is extremely basic: seven types of tacos, guacamole and fries. You’d think that with such a short menu they would at least get the basics right. Spoiler: they don’t. The tacos arrived cold. And the place was almost empty, so no excuses.
Their “Mexican” beer of choice is Madri. Very authentic.
And to top it all off: a 12.5% discretionary service charge for bringing four tacos to the table (I collected the beers myself from the bar). Impressive.
Nice decor, great first impression… and a huge letdown.
Won’t be coming back.

£29 Burro Reggaeton vs R&B Brunch 🎶🍹

I attended the 4–6 brunch sitting and it did not disappoint.

From the moment we arrived, the service stood out. Our server Barbara stood out she  was incredibly friendly and calm  the kind of person you just know won’t be in that role for long because she’s clearly moving on up. Professional, warm, and completely unflustered even when it got busy.

The hostess running the bingo games was an absolute star. She came around explaining how everything worked, brought high energy, and was a proper hype woman. You could tell she genuinely enjoyed what she was doing, and that makes all the difference to an event like this.

We had:
•	Cheerios
•	Quesadillas
•	Nachos

Everything was tasty and well presented. Perfect brunch vibe food.

Drinks included Prosecco , cocktail jugs and beer flowing nicely and keeping the atmosphere lively.

Music was amazing to the theme 100%

Bonus point:
While waiting for my (late!) family to arrive, I ordered a margarita from the bar. Amanda makes a serious margarita. I’ve had many in my time and hers is a solid 10/10. Balanced, strong, smooth exactly how it should be. Will 100% come back for her margaritas.

We came here to celebrate my daughter’s 18th birthday before heading off to a brunch I had already booked, and it was the perfect way to start the day. I’ve been here a few times now, and it never disappoints. The drinks are always well made, the snack foods are great for sharing, and the atmosphere is consistently lively and welcoming. The music is always spot on, which really adds to the overall vibe and makes it feel like a special place to relax and enjoy the moment. It’s somewhere I’m always happy to return to, whether for a quick stop or a special occasion. Highly recommend for great drinks, good energy, and an all-around enjoyable experience.

Came to my favourite spot with my girl, Jess made us feel so welcome , managed to squeeze us in as it was lovely and busy with their reggaeton / rnb brunch. Jess served us and food came quickly , will defo be booking the brunch next time 🤩

Visited last weekend for my birthday and opted for a Bottomless Brunch. Probably the best overall package I've ever experienced, from the price to service. The staff attending to our table (group of 13 people) were attentive and kept our drinks topped up for the duration.

The Mexican-style food was superb.

Highly recommend to anyone looking for a Brunch in Shoreditch or London in general.

name: Bad Manners
address: Shoreditch Church, 119 Shoreditch High St, London E1 6JN, UK

reviews.text:
Absolutely loved this place! One of the best Mexican breakfast spots in London – their breakfast burritos are incredible and the flavours feel really authentic.
I had the Egg & Bean (V) with slow-braised beans, soft omelette, crispy tater tots, cheddar, pico de gallo and salsa verde – seriously delicious.
Plus, the location is super cool, right on a church square with a nice food truck vibe. Perfect spot for a chill morning! 🌮☀️
The burritos live up to the hype. Great place to grab a hearty breakfast when the weather is nice. They have ample seating, plus a few standing tables.
The sausage breakfast burrito was the best breakfast burrito I've ever had. Absolutely spot on 🤌🏼 I will be going back soon to try the others!

I was excited to try the burritos, as i am a fan of said staple.  With that said, i dropped by to take-away a barbacoa almost coming back from a spot of shopping.

Overall, for the price of £12.50 i was underwhelmed. The meat was the dominant flavour, had junks of fat and was semi indigestible.  Half of the burrito was rice and overall if it had been stuffed with salad and other goodness might have had more complexity of flavour and a better opportunity to cut through the fat.

I hate to say it but even chipotle would be a better all rounder at a better price.

In competition with the gyros shop across the road they are definitely better, but is not exactly the choice you want in the first place.

Delicious egg and bean breakfast burrito, served fast and friendly.

The homemade tortilla definitely makes a difference - not your typical thin and fragile burrito chain style that falls apart at the end. The weather wasn't the best when we went, but on a sunny day the churchyard seating would be really nice vibes.

Definitely recommend for an early morning breakfast or lunch while exploring Shoreditch 👌

One of my friends recommended this place, and I’m really glad I tried it. I’m usually not a big fan of Italian-style pizza, but this place completely changed my mind. Unlike many other Italian pizza spots in London where the pizza can be quite tasteless, the pizza here was excellent, with great-quality ingredients and really nice dough.
The salad was also fresh and tasty, and the desserts were absolutely delicious. The staff were friendly and attentive, which made the experience even better. If you’re planning to visit and have a sweet tooth like me, I highly recommend trying the cookie sandwich — it was amazing.

Thank you so much for a beautiful lunch. My best friend and I came here with our small babies after visiting the Young V&A. We were made to feel so welcome on arrival, and the staff were so friendly and attentive. They helped us with high chairs, even cut our pizzas into slices so we could eat one handed with our babies! The pizzas were delicious - everything about our meal was excellent. I’d been worried about finding somewhere nice to eat after visiting the Young V&A, but now I know we can sit down for fab pizza right around the corner. Huge thanks!

I travel the world sampling local and heritage cuisine. This is a great little spot under the train tracks in Bethal Green. A low rumble of the train crossing overhead mixed with the quiet mix of eclectic music all awhile gazing into the open kitchen creates a quaint and lively atmosphere.   All of this before the dough is freshly made and tossed just before being married with the toppings of menu proven pies or whatever your hearts desires. The house pies are artisan crafted by expert peal shiffflers. The wait staf is attentive (which is rare in London) and very accommodating.   Do not sleep on or pass on “Fatto A Mano”.   I will be attempting to recreate their pies!!!   Come get some -Str8

It never disappoints, interesting winter specials at £19, big cornicione, thin base, pizza is larger than at other chains. Good fried lasagna bites too. Prices slightly above average but reflecting generous portions.
We had a very good time at the restaurant and food was so good! The service was great definitely Will come back again 好吃！

If you’re a pizza lover like I am, I 100% recomand this place. Best pizza I had in London so far.
Been here on a Sunday afternoon, place was not busy at all, fairly quiet, staff are nice, service was nice and quick.
I had the Ancozzese and the triple pepperoni pizzas. Both were very very tasty, the dough was perfect, soft, thin, perfectly cooked. Also really good quality pizza toppings. Also had a berry spritz which was light and refreshing and a really good quality coffee. Didn’t have dessert, but they have a panna cotta cheesecake on the menu which was really tempting.

Stopped by for a late weekday dinner -- I had a reservation for 8pm and it was definitely needed, since the place was still packed and bustling by then. I was able to get seated immediately, but (understandably given the busy-ness) it took a bit of time to get some water and order.

Following a friend's suggestion, I ordered the triple pepperoni pizza, which was a great choice. I loved the touches of stracciatella throughout -- really fresh and a lovely, lighter contrast to the richer flavours of the pepperoni slices. The pizza is really sooo large, but I forced myself to finish it all because of how delicious it was :) It's not too oily or too heavy at all, and the overall balanced flavour profile of the fresh tomatoes, savoury cheese, and tasty pizza base/crush was just perfect.

Really couldn't recommend this place any more strongly -- I'd love to come back to try some of their other pizza options soon!

Pizza was amazing, kind staff and quick service. Went couple of time and I enjoyed both.
Price it’s a bit high they could lower few pounds they should engage more clients, just £2 £3 per pizza and will be right priced.
Estimate £20 -£30 because two drinks, two pizza and one starter you are already at £50 bill.
As I said food delicious and nice experience.

2nd Rudys but different location.
Pizza just as good here as central London.
There was a super loud baby crying and we were seated away in a little booth which was lovely.
Had the Nduja pizza and one with rocket and pancetta I think.
All very nice.

Yes, yes and again yes! By far, the best pizza in Uk, as texture and taste. After visiting Naples, Italy just reset my all tastes regarding pizzas. In the last 3 years, the best pizza in Uk, I could find it in Ipswich, Storico Restaurant, but now, I’ve just discovered these guys and I can say the pizza was the best ever. I bought Igor’s Blue and my wife Doppia Mozzarella. Both very tasty and pretty big both of them.

name: Rudy's Pizza Napoletana - Shoreditch
address: 183 Shoreditch High St, London E1 6HU, UK

reviews.text:
Rudy’s Pizza was amazing from start to finish. I’ve only ever been to the Leeds branch, so I was really excited to see them open in London, and it definitely lived up to my expectations. The pizza was just as good as I remembered—fresh, full of flavour, and perfectly cooked with that classic Rudy’s quality.

The guy that served us was really friendly and welcoming, which made the whole experience even better and more relaxed. Service felt genuine rather than rushed. A special mention has to go to the garlic bread, which was absolutely unreal and easily one of the best I’ve had. Overall, a brilliant experience and I’ll definitely be coming back. 🍕

I received a smashing lunch and terrific, attentive service last weekend - much needed following a long walk through London. Great value for money too. It was my first time at a Rudy's branch, and I'd definitely go again 🙂

Would order the triple pepperoni pizza with burrata and hot honey every time. Had to wait for a table for about 25 minutes but we were a walk-in group of 6 so very understandable. Recommend booking in advance.

Walked in fairly late (9ish) on a Saturday night. Loads of tables but still a good atmosphere.
