Had the special (can’t remember the name but the bottom one with ragu/aunergine/ricotta) basically a lasagne on pizza and it was absolutely unreal. Waiter was really nice too, and the pale ale is delish. Highly recommend as all Rudy’s!

I just had an outstanding meal and I can't stop raving about it! The Cinghiale pizza was the best I've ever had, and the Triple Pepperoni was a total winner too. Daisy, our server, was lovely and made the evening even better by checking in with us and sharing her recommendations. Everything from the food to the atmosphere was spot on, and I left feeling really happy. Highly recommend for anyone craving great pizza and fantastic service!

I had the double cheeseburger meal and it was honestly spot on. The burger was fresh, juicy, and perfectly cooked. The cheese was nicely melted, the buns were soft, and everything tasted well balanced — not dry at all. The fries were hot and crispy, and the drink was ice cold which just completed the meal properly.

On top of that, the customer service was excellent. The staff were polite, welcoming, and served the food quickly without rushing me. You can tell they actually care about their customers.

Definitely coming back again. Great food and great service all around!

Such a cozy and relaxing place! 🕯️✨ We had the Margherita pizza and it was perfectly baked, fresh, and super cheesy 🍕🤍 Simple yet delicious. The Masala Chai was absolutely amazing ☕️🌿 Strong, aromatic, and really comforting. The warm atmosphere made everything even better, perfect for sitting, chatting, and enjoying good food. Totally loved the vibe and the experience! 😍🙌
The food is delicious, the portions are generous, and it's worth the money. The owner is a very nice and pleasant person. I highly recommend this place.

This is my regular comfort food place near our London office. The main food choices are Italian but with fusion options. Usually I have the spicy bolognaise, which seems to have chilli in, and a karak chai. This is good value (under £10) and works as my main meal for the day. It is a nice place to sit, not too busy and has the conservatory at the back.

A new shop in old street pasta e pizza Italiana
omg the pizza and pasta taste
It’s beyond that.

I ate everywhere in Italy and I felt like I got the same taste in London.

Heads off to the chef effort the way they take care us and make the moment memorable.

name: World Famous Gordos
address: 13, Unit C, 23 Westgate St, London E8 3RL, UK

reviews.text: Flavours were incredible. Held in a cool outdoor venue, but the star of the show for its taste & range of options.

One of the best pizza spots in London. An incredibly tasty and concise menu at a great price. The everything bagel crust is to die for and the service is always 100%, the guys are super friendly and always have a smile on their face. Couldn’t recommend these guys enough.

Heard the hype so had to check it out! It didn’t disappoint- the two lads running the place were great, the pizza was top notch & Mola Cola is unreal! I had the chef spesh & Pep, some of the best pizza I’ve had in London! Will be back!
best pizza by the slice in london!!! looooove the sesame crust
Delicious pizza. Quality ingredients. The crust was a highlight, they made it like a New York style everything bagel with sesames and about 5 other seasonings. Slices under £5 as well!

Beautiful pizza! It’s much better fresh off the oven if you can dine in. The atmosphere is relaxed and no fuss. You’d be extremely
hard pressed to find anything better for £7.50 or less.
Very friendly service, good Italian pizza. The value for money is spot on. If you're looking for a classic pizza, this is the place to go. I'll definitely be back.
Always a delight going here. The quick service and the affordable combo is great. This pizza is a Giardino with extra jalapeños. They have a good range of pizza toppings available!

Union Pizza Hoxton is a fantastic spot. The pizza is excellent with a perfectly thin crust , great selections of pizza and toppings to choose from.
The staff are super friendly and welcoming, and the prices are very affordable for the quality you get.

I also loved the atmosphere — it’s great open plan space with a pizza oven as a main focus.  I like to watch how the pizza is made - quite a skill and those guys are so quick. This place is always super busy. And let’s not forget the delicious cocktails, which are the perfect addition to the meal.

Would definitely recommend!

Been Pizza Union a few times and 4 of us went here recently for dinner around 5pm on a weekday. Very tasty pizzas for quite a cheap price compared to other sit in pizza restaurants. Very relaxed chilled atmosphere. Only fault for me personally is the lack of garlic bread on the menu.

name: Vincenzo's Pizza
address: 122 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E2 6DG, UK

reviews.text: I’ve been to the Vincenzo’s in Bushey but this is a bit closer for me. At least as good but I think probably better - either that or it was the antiproton of having it again. Super flavourful base, zero flop and massive pies. We had the Marg and the amazing spanakopita, which I’ve never even thought of as a pizza (maybe with the option of an egg on next time?). Along with beer from the bar next door (Tennant’s, lol) this was pretty close to a perfect 45-minutes of my life. 😂 Go there and enjoy it.

Pizza is yummy yummy yummy yummy!!!! So delicious cheese pizza and the staff is so nice. They work very hard to get your pizza out quick despite the long lines. Not much seating inside so you might have to grab and go. Will be returning asap!

Spanokopita was great. Burrata felt like too much tomato. The squares are decent but surprisingly filling. Bases all around were good. Would definitely go back for a quick slice. All the staff are such lovely people and keen to help.

A very good pizza. Not quite exceptional on this occasion but they have the building blocks in place for it. The engineering is clearly good, it’s maybe the design that was missing by a little something…the whole didn’t quite come together. I will most certainly visit again though. Vodka sauce and the square.
Absolutely banging pizza slices! Reminded me of the ones I used to have when in US. The sauce is perfect, crust is beautifully charred. Can’t wait to go back & try all the options.

name: Gordon Ramsay Street Pizza - St Paul's
address: Ground Floor, 10 Bread St, London EC4M 9AJ, UK

reviews.text: Team event - with ample of food and friendly service. We had a team dinner with about 30 people. They cleared the ground floor and served food as finger food. Good style for networking and talk with many others without being forced to sit at a table. Calling out Rakhesh, who served the bottomless drinks and ensured our well being.

Met up with a friend for a pre-Christmas get together. Was looking for something casual but nice. Most bottomless deals are for drinks, which isn’t ideal when you are driving so bottomless pizza feels genius! Even better if you are indecisive and always want to try a little bit of everything 😂

The staff were really lovely too! Will definitely e back

I came with my partner for the bottomless pizza, we were greeted and served by Debby. She was very attentive kind and catered the pizzas to our preferences. She made our experience much better. Definitely recommend for a nice chill place to eat good varied pizza.

We really enjoyed our visit here.

The staff were absolutely fantastic and the food was beyond excellent. They really are attentive to your preferences and mix things up beautifully.

We got a booking as part of a package deal with a trip up The Shard.

The cost for the food was low by any measure, let alone for notoriously expensive London. It's all you can eat as well, so don't worry about going hungry.

This is a something of a "hidden treasure" and is absolutely worth a visit if you're in the area.

I hope Gordon doesn't shout at these guys and girls, they're a credit to his name!

I had a great experience at Street Pizza by Gordon Ramsay! The food was absolutely delicious — fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared. I would especially like to mention Tina, who made our visit even more enjoyable. She was very polite, friendly, and had excellent manners. Her positive attitude and professional service really stood out. She made us feel welcome and comfortable from the moment we arrived.Thank you, Tina, for your outstanding service! I will definitely come back again.

name: 081 Pizzeria Shoreditch
address: 46 Great Eastern St, London EC2A 3EP, UK

reviews.text:
I'd say it takes 20 mins or so walking fron Aldgate although it's definitely worth the walk.

Food was marvelous, really tasty and the tiramisu we had for dessert was just pure fantasy. Furthermore, the crust was the best I've had in a while and all the other ingredientes were also fresh and really tasty.

I'd go more frecuently if I were fron London. Finally, I wanted to meantion Giovanni, the worker who took our order, because he was fast, efficient and specially kind to us.

I’m not someone who eats pizza very often in fact, it’s not usually my go-to food. But whenever I do crave pizza, this is the place I come to. I’ve been here many times, and every single visit has been consistently fantastic.

The food is simply outstanding—full of flavor, always fresh, and cooked to perfection. The starters are a great way to kick off the meal (see my attached photo), and the mains never disappoint. Whether it’s the pizza itself or other dishes on the menu, everything I’ve tried has been delicious and clearly made with care.

What keeps me coming back is not just the taste but also the overall quality. It’s rare for me to say this about pizza, but this place has truly won me over. Highly recommended!

Wow! Friendly staff, trendy and fitting decor. Extremely attentive service, and a plethora of delicious dishes to choose from.

My family and I opted for two pizzas and the arancini. The arancini were different to ones I have previously tried, but were absolutely delicious. The tomato sauce was extremely flavourful!

I tried one of the cocktails, it was a take on the classic espresso martini, with a mascarpone foam that made the cocktail taste like a tiramisu. One note of improvement is that the top of it is sprinkled with ground coffee, which isn’t the most pleasant texture.

The pizzas were incredible. A proper Neapolitan style pizza with fluffy dough that gets a char on the bottom and is well seasoned! The Margarita was delicious and allowed for all ingredients to shine. The Pistachiosa was on another level. The mixture of textures and the mortadella were pure heaven!

Certainly recommend this place if you are in the area and in the mood for some delicious pizza! It is a top 50 spot in Europe for a reason!

Amazing Neapolitan pizzeria!
The food is absolutely delicious, made with high-quality ingredients and great attention to detail.

The service provided by Giovanni was excellent: friendly, attentive, and made the whole experience even better.

Highly recommended!! We will definitely come back!

The Montanara classical bun was delicious. Lobster croquettes from the tapas menu held their own too: crisp, creamy, and indulgent.

Cocktails were a standout. I had the Zabba Espresso and the L’Artigiano—both solid, but the espresso martini stole the show with its creative twist.

Pizzas landed well across the table. The Parmigiana (aubergine) was a hit, and the Black truffle and honey, was masterfully balanced—with mozzarella, gorgonzola, truffle, honey and hazelnut crumble completing and not overpowering each other.

Service was uneven. Long stretches of waiting and flagging down staff who seemed stretched thin between dine-in and takeaway orders and a lack of being kept appraised of the delay in us receiving our food. But when present, the team brought warmth and passion—especially the Limoncello toast to close the evening, which added a lovely finish.

name: story deli
address: 515 Cambridge Heath Rd, London E2 9BU, UK

reviews.text: Definitely one of the best pizzas I’ve ever had, maybe the best. Loved the crust and the texture of the pizzas, and the seasoning was just amazing. We had the Florentine, prawn, and Hackney Hoo, and honestly each one had its own unique seasoning and personality. The prawn pizza was my favourite, especially the mix of a little spice and vinegar, absolutely incredible. The lemon cheesecake was also unreal, loved the texture and the combo of lemon, ice cream (maybe?) and a bit of yogurt. Honestly, just speechless. Will definitely be back for more. The owners are super friendly and funny, a 12 out of 10 experience!😍

I think this might be my favourite find in London! Not only was the food incredible (and definitely recommend the coffee cheesecake), but the hosts were so lovely and the atmosphere and interior just felt really authentic and tranquil - the shared table vibe is really lovely. And can’t not mention Dottie and Freckle, the most gorgeous mummy and baby beagle duo! Will definitely be back!

Had an absolutely incredible experience at story deli. The cozy restaurant has caught our eyes every time we walk by on Cambridge Heath. We were not disappointed when we finally stopped in. Our hosts were so welcoming, the adorable dog sleeping on the sofa was so charming, and they went out of their way to make us feel at home. The pizzas we're delicious and so unique combinations of flavors. Must try.

Their precious takeaway packages was also charming, truly every moment with this place was a delight.

Such a unique experience in a quirky, crafty place. It felt like you were at a dining room of a country cottage, where vintage, handmade items were dotted around the space in poetic randomness. The owners were hospitable and friendly, the food was organic, beautiful, fresh and tasty, and the beagle was a plus. Even the leftover was packed like a gift. We were lucky to be the only guests for the whole evening. Will 10/10 be back when the fabled tiramisu is back on the menu!

Such a cute lil dreamy place and the pizza is sensational. You can taste the love from the owners Chris and his beautiful wife. The vibe, the food, the atmosphere and the warm welcoming from Chris literally soothed my day 🥹💕 10/10 recommended

name: Bad Boy Pizza Society | Bad Boy Pizzeria
address: 419 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E2 0AN, UK

reviews.text: First time trying this place and it did not disappoint! We got half ‘Marks Pep’ and half ‘Vodka Roni’ which tasted delicious, especially with the garlic and honey dips. You can see the pizza is fresh as it’s made and cooked at the front of the store. The pizza is massive but you can also buy individual slices too.Halal and vegetarian options were available. The staff that worked there was really accommodating and lovely to speak to, you can see he was passionate about his work. The only downside about the place is that it felt a bit cheap that it was served with paper plates and plastic cups, the interior seemed really nice and trendy so the paper plates took away from that. There were no signs for the toilet either.

Good pizza. They only 18inch pizzas and offer the option to go half and half on toppings.

The quality of the pizza was great.

I really enjoyed the Marks pep, sweet but not hot (despite calling it hot honey ) and flavourful. Halal Pepperoni was good quality but not the best I’ve had.

The white pie was also nice, but not for me, the cheese was quite pungent and the caramelised onions added a little too much sweetness for my liking. If you like really sweet favours then I’d recommend. Also we added extra pepperoni to it, doesn’t come as default.

Both pizzas held up, mostly good structure, a little floppy, prefer mine a tad thinner but overall pretty good.

Stopped in for a slice.... ended up having three. Amazing pizza.
Must try slice - Caesar. So so good. Now I want to see this on every pizza menu. Vodka-roni  topped with fresh basil and freshly grated parmesan is a solid pie.
Cant not mention the decor. Love the old school pizza place vibes (check the vid).
Definitely a place I look forward to returning to. Well done boys!!!

Ok this now moves to the top of my pizza slice leaderboard. Vodka sauce here is that sweet orange goodness, base superbly crispy but with a lovely flavour.
On the day the grandma slice with vodka sauce and stracciatella fresh from the oven was the perfect ratio of fluff to crisp.

They also do a full GF menu made from the owners bases if you need that sort of thing.

Have been here like 5x times and everything is amazing. Such a good crunch on the pizza and as an American that is what we like to see. Vodka roni is prolly my favorite but also love the pepperoni and cannot go wrong with just a cheese slice too. Only feedback would be on the ranch which tastes a bit more like tzatziki than the actual thing, but it’s still good nonetheless.

Great pizza as always, went for a different way to my normal margherita and had the curried lamb on half and aubergine on other half. A different experience, but delightful nonetheless.

Think the aubergine with cauliflower cheese base just won the contest, but both halves great. Base of the pizza really good.

Massive place in central London I thought, with good view of the pizza oven.

Great experience overall. Thank you

The pizza was impressively large and nicely presented, though the flavor was just okay. The service, while clearly well intentioned, felt a bit too persistent, staff checked in repeatedly within very short intervals, which made it difficult to relax and enjoy the meal. Overall, the experience was fine, but not one I would be eager to repeat.

Easily my favourite pizza restaurant in London 🍕🍕🍕
The Corn, Chorizo and Coriander pizza is my favourite. They also offer vegan chorizo on the pizza which is delicious.
The Wagyu pizza is also delicious.
I can’t recommend this place more. I love this place.
The mushroom slice was incredible as was the garlic chive dip that complemented it, Maya looked after me and was extremely helpful making my experience that much better! :) thank you!

Loved Homeslice! Great atmosphere with modern seating overlooking the city, spacious layout, and lovely vibes. The giant 20" pizzas are fun to share, and the no-cutlery policy adds to the casual vibe. Service was absolutely smashing – genuinely one of the best I've experienced recently. Really laid-back, friendly staff who made the whole experience. The drinks and the garlic sauce were spot on too.
The only minor note would be that a couple of the toppings I tried (lamb and mushroom) could have used a bit more seasoning to really stand out. But overall, a fabulous spot; will definitely be back!

Lovely local gem near Old Street with the loveliest owner.

Stumbled into this cozy café and was pleasantly surprised. I had the chicken ciabatta sandwich - freshly toasted, generous portion, and unbelievable value at just £6.95. Much better (and cheaper!) than a Pret sandwich.

The owner is incredibly friendly and seems to make everything in-house. The fresh juices are shockingly(!) affordable and really refreshing, and the coffee is solid and fairly priced.

There’s Wi-Fi, around 4–6 small tables for two, plus a little nook that can fit a bigger group (around 8–10 people). Opening hours are long, and it’s perfect if you’re staying at the nearby Holiday Inn or working around Shoreditch / Old Street.

Would definitely come back to try the pizza.

I recently tried the oven-baked fresh pizzas, at Delizie which also offers a great selection of bakery treats, teas, coffees & other warm drinks. The pizzas were full of flavour and made in front of you with fresh ingredients, freshly baked out of the oven, to your plate.
The English Breakfast Pizza was the standout, such a unique twist to any other traditional pizza we’ve tried! The first store to implement a classic English brekky onto a pizza which was definitely worth trying. The Veggie Pizza had really tasty toppings, with vibrant colours and good flavour, whilst the Margherita, a classic pizza done right - was simple, fresh, and delicious.
The bases of the pizzas had a nice crispiness to the thin crust.
Overall, a great spot if you’re looking for something freshly baked, a bit different, and full of flavour. Perfect for a relaxed lunch or a quick coffee catch-up.

Ordered pizzas today with my friends and honestly, everything was spot on. The quality, the flavours, and the freshness were next level. You can tell real care goes into the food. Chef Hakim knows exactly what he’s doing … easily one of the best pizzas I’ve had in a long time. Will 100% be ordering again.
Lovely little spot for lunch. Pizza's were delicious with light bases and fresh ingredients. Really enjoyed the blended fruit juice too. Would recommend.

Absolutely lovely experience. We went there for the typical English breakfast and it was really good for a friendly price. The place was really cozy and the owner was the nicest person ever. Highly recommend visiting.

Walked half an hour and came here 20 mins before closing just to get the Dishoom pizza and they managed to make us the last one of the day so last minute. With the garlic bread too!! Such great late night service.

Dishoom pizza was so flavourful and filling. The Garlic bread was not so special, but that Dishoom sauce was amazing. If you like spicy sauce you’ll love that.

Delicious vegan pies!

Loved that we were able to get crisp crust and some nice bubbles!

Was super impressed with the creative flavors, and the sauces are not lacking! Was surprised they went as far as using real vegan yoghurt for the vegan garlic and herb dip!

My partner and I come every month for their special. I sadly can’t have dairy but he can and the lovely people who work here go out of their way to give us the pizzas we want but halved with dairy / dairy-free cheese.

Today we went a step further and  combined this with 2 of the specials on one single pizza and they actually did it! Amazing.

This has become a tradition of ours to come here and it never disappoints.
Absolutely amazing pizza, very welcoming and pleasant staff....

Best takeaway pizza in London and a Superstar team here at yardsale Pizza!
My go to's are the new porker and the holy pepperoni, but the specials are always ace too! They had a recent haggis one for burns night that I really enjoyed.

name: Sleazy Pizza
address: The Old Truman Brewery, Unit 3 Dray Walk, London E1 6QL, UK

reviews.text:
Sleazy Pizza is a cute little pizzeria just off Brick Lane with a very tongue in cheek, sex themed aesthetic that knows exactly what it is doing. It is playful, a bit cheeky, and clearly not taking itself too seriously, which works in its favour. The atmosphere is fun and relaxed, making it an easy spot to drop into rather than a destination you need to overthink.
The dough is good and clearly well made, though I would personally have liked the pizza cooked just a touch longer for a bit more crisp and depth of flavour. That said, it is still enjoyable and better than most quick grab places in the area.
Overall, it is a nice little place with personality. Not perfect, but charming, confident, and worth a visit if you are nearby and in the mood for pizza with attitude.

Such a lovely place to eat, it has a really cozy vibe to it, and especially since the people working here are so friendly. We got margarita pizzas and they were absolutely delicious! Definitely some of the best in London :)

I was to wait two minutes for my order to be taken. Granted it was a very busy evening I was fine with that. Whilst I was standing by the till another customer was served before me by a staff member. The staff member who’d asked me to wait quietly murmured a “sorry” but didn’t step in. Later, that same staff member brought one pizza to our table next door, said she’d return with the other, and left. The second pizza was eventually delivered by a tap room staff member, who also kindly brought napkins.
The pizza itself was decent and fresh, although the cheese cooled quickly and separated slightly from the base. Unfortunately, the overall service left me feeling diminished and unseen, and it’s not somewhere I’d return despite the food being okay.

Such a cosy, vibrant and fun little place with a great vibe and even greater pizza! Have almost tried every pizza on the menu and they are delicious, hit the spot every single time. Staff are welcoming, chefs are super friendly! Would recommend to everyone visiting the area ☺️

Great spot for a pizza. The staff were very friendly. Pizza was delish. Tried the devil and one with anchovies. Both were good. Love that each pizza comes with a dip of your choice for the crusts. Garlic & herb was delish. Very garlicky. Dough was chewy and cooked well. Love the chilli oil as well. Super fragrant and the kick comes a bit later. They have indoor and outdoor seating. Prices are good for the area.

name: Franco Manca St. Paul's
address: 2 St. Paul's Churchyard, London EC4M 8AP, UK

reviews.text:
During our first visit to London, we discovered Franco Manca near St. Paul’s Cathedral and were immediately impressed. Even though the restaurant was busy and we didn’t have a reservation, we were seated quickly, which already made a great first impression.

The menu is intentionally simple, with a clear focus on quality. The pizza is honestly among the best I have ever had. The dough is excellent, the flavours are rich, and everything tastes fresh and authentic. The price-performance ratio is also very strong for London standards and considering the quality, it almost feels inexpensive.

Since then, Franco Manca has become a must-visit spot for us on every London trip. Anyone looking for authentic pizza and great flavour should definitely give it a try.

We booked for a large group and the service was great. From several changes to number of guests to being served, those we spoke to were really patient and we were looked after at the venue.
All the food from starter to dessert was enjoyed by all (shame some of the desserts weren't available though). The venue was clean and comfortable without being too busy, and better than others that we'd been to.
We've always enjoyed the food and lovely sourdough pizzas at this chain but this has definitely gone up a notch!

Did an 8km slice route for the Map My Pizza Run promotion and immediately followed it with a delicious Tre Porcellini (the #9). Let me tell, it was delicious and it absolutely hit the spot!

Huge shoutout to the manager and our waitress for being super friendly and helpful. Our pizzas also arrived incredibly fast (thank goodness - we were all so hungry when we arrived 😂)

Fabulous place, had the 3 course Xmas deal, booked early so got free drink on arrival. All three courses were great, the tiramisu was to die for! Used the Black Friday deal as well and got 25% off. Definitely would return, cheers

Food was amazing very well made. The service itself was incredible, our server Tariq made us feel at home and helped when choose between different items on the menu. Would recommend to try if you are ever in London.
Lots of pizza variety, the one that I had was really good! I picked the pizza and the waiting time wasn’t long, they were super friendly! And it’s very good quality for the cost 😊 delicious.
Really lovely customer service and food. Will definitely be visiting again!
Great experience! Good food :)
Great place and love the management
I found the idea of pizza buns so unique, My personal favourite was the crispy chicken bun. Delicious and quickly prepared!

The pizza at Sud Italia was great! It was hot and fresh with a soft, pillowy dough. Service was speedy and the staff were super friendly (& had great banter!). Highly recommend you check it out for a casual pizza spot.
Food here was great - the pizza was amazing probably the best pizza in London! The amount of cheese and tomatoes in it made it pure perfection😊 We got 2 of these Portofoglios for less than £7!!! 🤯 🙌🏼

Sud Italia is hands down one of the best takeaways I’ve tried! Full of flavour, always fresh, and you can really taste the quality in every bite. The pizzas are incredible – proper authentic taste with the perfect crust – and the portions are generous too.

Even though it’s a takeaway, the service feels personal and friendly, which makes all the difference. You can tell they put care and passion into what they make.

If you’re looking for proper Italian food to enjoy at home, this is the place to go. Definitely my go-to takeaway now – highly recommended!

“I came all the way from KSA to London for the love of pizza—and Sud Italia didn’t disappoint! 🍕 Run by Italian brothers in the kitchen with their brother-in-law up front welcoming guests and translating, the whole experience feels authentic, warm, and family-driven. The pizza itself? Pure Neapolitan perfection—charred crust, fresh toppings, and unbeatable flavor. Truly one of the best pizza spots in London

Absolutely love this place! You cannot go wrong with anything on the menu. Food is fresh and delicious. Expect wait times at peak hours and difficult to find place to sit. Highly recommend to try, pretty good veg options as well.

This establishment offers exceptional value for high-quality pizza and outstanding service. Each visit to London invariably includes an immediate return to this restaurant with my family. It is a remarkably beautiful venue, ideal for families and those seeking an affordable dining experience. A meal for three, including beverages, at £24.95 is truly impressive.

We extend our gratitude and anticipate our next visit.

The pizzas are always incredibly delicious, the place has a great vibe, and the staff are very friendly and welcoming. Every visit feels easy and enjoyable thanks to the smiling team. I come here regularly, and it’s definitely a place I’ll keep coming back to. Highly recommended!

Hands down one of the best pizza spots in London!
The pizza was absolutely yummy and fresh.
If you’re in Spitalfields, this is a must-visit. Five stars all the way

It was a nice surprise to find this place :) the pizza was delicious! And the treatment from the staff deserves a five stars! 🤍 and also the prices are really good! :) don’t miss the chance to visit and grab something to eat here :)

Very good team.
They work in equipe efficiently.
Affordable to request clients and customers.
Location cleaned.
Ahmed is a wonderful person, we loved the chicken burger, the samoussa and the desserts, really tasty. Highly recommend :)

I am not usually a pizza lover, but the one I had tonight was absolutely mouthwatering! I almost went back for another 😅. I’ll definitely be recommending this place and becoming a regular. The pizza was fantastic, but the customer service was even better—so generous, kind, and friendly.
If you want real Italian pizza test go to this place. The uncle was super friendly and polite. Will surely go back! 👍🏽
Mr Nazrul is the nice person here who served  us and there pizza are really nice and tasty
very nice pizza , polite man .really love this place .

name: Grano Tenero Pizzeria Napoletana Shoreditch
address: 2-10 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E1 6GY, UK

reviews.text:
Honestly, good pizza. Was pleasantly surprised. Will come again.

Dough texture is good, I would prefer slightly more sour. Perhaps longer ferment. But don't expect that from a shipping container.

"Deliciously fresh, perfectly cheesy, and full of flavor – best pizza experience!" 🍕.
Thanks to chef Venkanna.
Delicious pizza, best pizza this side of Napoli. Venkanna is a lovely fella who makes some magic in the oven.

£15 for a pizza that’s not napolitan at all!
Dough was not cooked properly, neither was the tomato sauce and the mushrooms.
Very disappointing.
I ordered pizza margherita and was incredibly tasty , napolitaner style with a juicy tomato sauce and really good mozzarella . Highly recommended

Delicious New York style pizza. Crispy, thin pizza base with just the right amount of toppings.

Their ‘NYC slices’ are the main event. If you buy a single slice it’s enough pizza for a decent lunch or a modest dinner. If you’re feeling a bit hungrier you get the best value if you order a ‘whole pie’.

Their ‘signature squares’ are great if you want a thicker, doughier base. From what I’ve seen you can’t buy a whole square pizza, only by the slice.

We had the ranch dip which was delicious, and a perfect accompaniment for the pizza crust.

They have Modelo beer on tap and a small selection of bottled beers available.

There’s not much seating inside but it’s a cozy atmosphere. If you don’t finish off a whole pizza they’ll give you a box to take it home.

Recommend if you’re in the area!

We went for the classic NYC Classic cheese 18” (Margherita without basil) - keeping toppings, sauces, and dips minimal so you can really taste the bread and the base itself. Overall, we enjoyed it quite a bit, though it’s definitely a heavy pizza. There’s a generous amount of sauce, which actually works in its favour - the sauce itself is really tasty and well-balanced.

It held together beautifully with zero flop, which is always a win for NYC-style. That said, the crust felt denser than ideal; it seemed like a lot of the air had been knocked out during proofing or shaping, so it didn’t have that light, airy interior rise you sometimes get in the best New York versions. It’s substantial and filling, more so than some other spots in London (no names mentioned).

It makes sense that the owner - known for his excellent Detroit-style pizza - leans into a thicker, heartier dough; that thickness suits Detroit pies perfectly. Still, for pure NYC style, it comes across as heavier by comparison.

These are minor nitpicks, though. The quality is solid, the flavors are on point, and it’s legitimately one of the closer approximations to proper New York pizza you’ll find in London. It’s not necessarily the absolute best in the city (tastes vary), but Paulie’s is absolutely on the map and worth seeking out if you’re craving that classic foldable slice. We left happy and satisfied.

Finally there’s proper pizza in the UK. Paulie’s is people from New York so it’s authentic and I love New York pizza. This is the first time since visiting there that the pizza has been worthy of the name.
I highly recommend this place if you want to see what the fuss is about NY pizza. Try the classic NYC slice. That’s the best way to check how good a place is - the more basic ingredients.
As a bonus they have really nice chewy cookies there too. The people are very friendly there and seem to have a great pride in providing quality food.

Really gorgeous spot for some delicious NYC style pizzas in the heart of London!! they have some delicious flavours with such generous portions (we were absolutely stuffed) and a great vibe!
Definitely recommend the buratta and Caio e Pepe slices with a drizzle of hot honey!!
Missed out on trying the chocolate chip cookie which looked fab so will definitely be back soon •ᴗ•

Highly recommend for some yummy pizza

Some of the best pizza I have had in a while.  Truly lived up to the hype. Was my first time trying new York style pizza and I loved it. The Paulie's pie was so good. The pepperoni and hot honey worked together so well. Will definitely be having that again.  The classic new York pizza was surprisingly very light almost felt like an appetiser. The atmosphere was good.  We didn't have a booking and went during an off peak time for dinner. It quickly filled up but the atmosphere was really good.  The staff are attentive and service is quick.

name: Pizza Social Club
address: 2-10 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E1 6GY, UK

reviews.text:
Really light, airy pizza pie. Not at all greasy and a good sized amount. The cheesy crust was delicious! Staff so friendly.
Shame it is in boxpark which is often way too loud and busy with huge parties as it was today.

The order arrived very quickly and hot, especially since I live nearby. I tried the pepperoni, halal pepperoni, and margarita pizzas, as well as the crispy chicken. The pizzas were delicious; crispy crusts and soft, fluffy centers. The crispy chicken was amazing – the taste, texture, and portion size were fantastic, even better than most pizza places. For those who don't know, they make Detroit-style pizza, a rectangular shape. I definitely recommend trying the pepperoni and crispy chicken.

Delicious Detroit-style pizza! We got the chef’s monthly special at the recommendation of the friendly server (which was a chicken gyro style pizza). The curly fries were also seasoned well. We recommend!
Great pizza if you're look for the Detroit style. One pizza can serve two people easily! The potato wedges were regular tho

Incredible pizza - a sleeping giant!

Never liked deep dish until I tried this which has absolutely incredible flavour.

Sarvs slice and pizza social club both great!

Thank you Shahmim for the great service to my family! It’s our fifth time ordering from here, and the food never disappoints. The pizza was so good and such great quality. The chicken tasted fresh with no smell at all, and the spicy sauce you gave us was amazing — full of flavour and hit our spice level perfectly! Also, make sure to try their chicken burgers as a meal — sooo good!! 🍕🔥🍔

Really impressed with this place — the pizza tastes fresh and amazing, and the prices are very fair. You get proper quality without spending a lot. Friendly staff and a cosy atmosphere make it even better. Definitely worth every penny!
For just £6.99, you can get a 15” pizza great value for money! The Loaded Meat and Margherita pizzas are my favourites here. It’s mainly a takeaway place.

You are only allowed to sit there if you order above then £10.
We order pizza that was not cooked properly.
They were rude and their hospitalability was zero.

Brick Lane pizza …. The secret thing is that they sell Burgers and wraps as well. Yesterday I went there I have tried Cheese burger Meal …it was really a delicious and tasty burger I ever had. … highly recommended…

name: Franco Manca Bishopsgate
address: 119, 121 Middlesex St, Bishopsgate, London E1 7JF, UK

reviews.text: The restaurant was empty when we arrived. Only one table in. The door was locked at 12.23pm on a Sunday. But a cook was behind the counter. We knocked and she came and opened , puzzled at why was the door locked. There was one waiter only. By the time we left there were good 7-8 tables being served. The salad was okay, it would have benefited from better presentation for sure. The cheesecake was not very fresh. Somehow I found it hardened from an open stay in a fridge. But tasted good still. The student discount didn’t  work at the till a few times,  but the waiter honoured the discount.

Very nice staff! A shoutout to Denis for being so nice and friendly:))))

I got the special pizza (crispy pancetta on amatriciana sauce) and it was AMAZING!!!! It should be on the regular menu!! Literally the best combo i have ever had

Lat stop before catching the train to Stansted airport and I have to say that this was one of best choices. Pizza was amazing the dough was out of this world. If you have to catch your train and want to eat before doing so this is a the spot!

I loved it!  They had a gluten free and vegan option for me which was a lovely surprise for me at a pizza place. I enjoyed the atmosphere and the waitress Dina was helpful and kind. Thank you very much

We had a delightful dinner. From the moment we walked in, we felt incredibly well looked after. The service is friendly but very professional—nothing was too much trouble for them.The menu isn't massive, which is usually a good sign, and the quality of the cooking confirmed it. The flavours were balanced beautifully. I must mention the desserts as well—the Tiramisu was lush, not too heavy, just right.It’s a small venue with a lovely, calm ambience, perfect for a nice chat over a bottle of wine. It felt authentic and miles apart from the busy waterfront places. A solid five stars from us.

name: PizzaLuxe Pizza Restaurant & Bar Principal Place
address: Principal Pl, Worship St, London EC2A 2FA, UK

reviews.text: I booked a last minute meal for my son and I via The Fork app and this place is highly recommended!!! The pizza was amazing, I loved the flavours and the dough was delicious. We are due to return again!! The chef was very attentive to my dietary and was happy to make adjustments with no stress. The day I visited  Susan, Kyle and Bryan were working. They were attentive, helpful, friendly and great with my son. That's always important to me.

Was excited about my Cacio e Pepe garlic bread, and whereas the topping was fine, it was a little doughy and looked a little undercooked in the middle.

Update: I did go back to this place, and had the dough balls, and a pizza. Both were excellent.

The Pizza was fairly average - but the chicken was really bad, we left half of them as they seemed old, and were flavourless too. I saw the staff picking them out of a box where it must have been half cooked, they were not looking appealing but I thought it may have been marinate and gave the benefit of the doubt. But when they arrived, the inside of really off putting, they were just smothered in sauce. Not to mention we paid over £20 for 12 chicken wings, it was quite expensive. Also the homemade lemonade was like water too

Lovely people (thank you Susan and Mary!).

Warm and thoughtful service,excellent food and able to accommodate vegan and gluten free needs.  This place is a gem!!
What a lovely place! Popped in yesterday during my lunch hour and tried the funghi pizza. Was beautiful and the service was 10/10 will definitely be back!!

Lauretta’s Pizzeria sets the gold standard for authentic, handcrafted pizza - the taste is on another level.
Staff were welcoming, friendly, and clearly passionate about what they do.

We had a table of six and ordered the Margherita, Double Pepperoni, Spicy Roni, and Calabrian Supreme with the Hot Honey and House Garlic dip.

I was lucky enough to sample a slice of each - every one was absolutely delicious.
If I’d had room, I’d have ordered more, but that just gives me the perfect excuse to come back and try the rest!

Lauretta’s is a lovely addition to Columbia Road. Great atmosphere inside, and even better pizza. We’ve been here a couple times now and we are always just blown away by how good it is. The vodka margarita is very tasty but I think the Calabrian supreme takes the golden spot for me. Do yourself a favour and get a garlic dip on the side. This is a pizza you won’t want to share because it’s just that good!!

Thank you Lauretta’s,
We will be back ❤️

Okay so, here we are. London, the new pizza scene. A few new places on the scene. But one place has emerged the best. Out of the fire of the hype of Crisp and Vincenzo’s (truly deserved) I’m sat in this neighbourhood pizza place marvelling at the pie put down in front of me.

Absolutely perfect crispy base and chewy crust, a vodka pie with a pesto swirl. I’m showing it off in pride to my friends at the table with me. Every slice I invite my fellow guests to try a bite despite forgetting they’ve ordered the same thing as me.

The staff are super friendly and easy, nothing is a problem. The rest of the guests are enjoying their evening with nowhere else to be. I’m very happy to sit here the rest of my night.

Service was brilliant, great vibes, exceptional exceptional pizza. I would highly recommend going and we will be back soon. So crisp and brilliant fresh ingredients. 10/10.

We’ve been to a lot of the top rated London pizza houses, Crisp, doughhands, graceys etc - Lauretta’s was on par if not better.

Definitely worth the trip.

One of my favourite pizzas in London. Went on opening night and have been back countless times. Rivals Crip easily and prefer to dough hands, though that is great too!

Easy 5*

I just had a fantastic breakfast; honestly, the portion was perfectly balanced, the cappuccino was delicious, you can tell the team has a lot of experience. I even got to chat with the owner, who was very friendly and passionate about his work. Thank you so much, I'll definitely be back every time I'm in London.

Locally vocal about this socially open favourite.
I love a place that's open to everyone from the school mums to the seniors from the couples to the students.  This place is welcoming to everyone.
Oh and the food is always on point.  They've never failed to help me impress visitors.

Keep It Up Barrel !

Is this the best pizza you will ever have? Probably not. But it did what it needed to do, so no complaints here. They have a big variety of options to choose from, and at the low prices they offer, I think you get what you pay for. It's a very relaxed atmosphere and a nice chill place to hang out. There was only one member of staff who I believe was the owner, and he was doing it all! But his customer care was impeccable, and it felt like he was welcoming you to dine at his house! This made everything taste better lol
I would eat here again!

A gem of a place! Recommended by my hotel and it doesn’t disappoint. Run by a brother called Raf, a gentleman and very welcoming. A propa’ local cafe and then some!

Oh and the coffee and food were delicious!

Highly recommend as it was for me!

Thank you

So far impressed!

This beautiful atmospheric cafe has an array of beautiful cakes, pastries and does an amazing deal of pizzas for under £5 I believe before 4 pm!

Very community-focused cafe with beautiful understated interiors but gorgeous terrazzo tiles to spice up the mood.

Very delicious panini and filled savoury toasts. Will be here again for the pizza deal!

*UPDATE*

OK fell for the pizza deal and very impressed! Great pizzas starting at £4.98. They also have a good selection of vegan pizzas. Grab one before 4 pm when the kitchen closes!

As a dessert the red velvet cake and the chocolate swirl cheesecake have been good. Not overly sweet but very fresh and good quality.

name: Sir Sydney Smith
address: 22 Dock St, Tower Hill, London E1 8JP, UK

reviews.text: This is a lovely little pub with great food, friendly staff and a good atmosphere and convenient if you are going to Wilton's Music Hall. All food is freshly cooked and very good value. You can phone up and book a table too which is handy as it gets pretty busy with darts players and people having a drink after work.
The food here is amazing. I really loved it. We played darts and kicked back with pizza and a burger, both with great flavor profiles. It's not real busy, so it might just be a hidden gem....

Chanced upon this pub after taking a stroll along the River Thames. Great selection of beers and ales on tap, coupled with an amazing selection of food. The peri peri wings and pizza are good, I would recommended it.

P.S. Learnt something too, just google who is Sir Sydney Smith. Go on, try it.
Great pub! Cask ale was on point..and nice nice local atmosphere. I’ve been out on mini pub crawl on my own tonight and this is the  best one by far ..

Brilliant little pub. Cask beer well kept.
Food excellent. Freshly baked pizza. House wine also very good and all reasonably priced. Staff very friendly. I spent a very happy couple of hours here.

I recently visited Pizza Para and tried their pizza with cured salmon – and wow, it absolutely lived up to the hype! It’s the chef’s favorite for a reason. The combination of perfectly cured salmon on that delicious ricotta base was fresh, flavourful, and surprisingly balanced – not your typical pizza, but in the best way possible. Every bite felt like a treat, and it was worth every single penny.
What really sets Pizza Para apart is the unique experience they offer. If you’re looking for something different from the usual pepperoni or margherita, this is the place. The staff is super friendly and happy to help you create your own custom pizza and you can start building one for just £9! In an area where prices can add up quickly, their affordability stands out without skimping on quality or creativity.
Highly recommend heading to Pizza Para if you want an affordable, one-of-a-kind pizza adventure. I’ll definitely be back to experiment with more toppings next time! 🍕🐟

New kid on the block and already stealing hearts since the soft opening last week 🍕

Welcome to the neighbourhood, Pizza Pãrã!
From the moment you step inside, you notice it is different from classic pizza places, a contemporary feeling with art on the walls, creating a warm, creative, and inviting atmosphere. Even better, the artwork isn’t just for show, you can actually purchase pieces you love while you dine.

But the real star? The food!!! Delicious, well crafted pizzas and more that taste as good as the place looks. You can tell care goes into every bite.

Always a joy to see new local spots bringing fresh energy to the area.
Support local, eat local and definitely give Pizza Pãrã a visit 😉
Maybe afterwards just pop in to next door, Map Maison, for a 🥃🍸🍹

Absolutely loved this spot! We tried several different pizzas and every single one was a hit, but the beef pizza was the absolute standout—perfectly seasoned and delicious. Don't skip the charcuterie board either; the homemade breadsticks and chutney with it the perfect way to start the meal. Great vibes and even better food

We did the cooking pizza masterclass. It was FANTASTIC!!. Pyash, the chef, is an incredible passionate teacher. Explained a lot about Pizza’s history, then taught us how to make authentic pizza napoletana. Da italiano, Pizza Para is one of the best I’ve had.

Went there with some friends. The pizza was really good I was pleasantly surprised. It was real Italian dough and topings were good and well balanced. I think it’s the first time I’ve ever like eating Arancini.
The baked good at the entrance are quite technical and with a deep flavour profile which is not so easy to find in London.

name: Perfetto Pizza ( Bethnal Green )
address: 391 Cambridge Heath Rd, London E2 9RA, UK

reviews.text:
I am genuinely surprised how good the quality has been and also the consistency of it.

Before this review, I ordered 3 seperate times before my verdict.

The foremost issue for me over the past few years has been the dough the shops use. More often then not, it givrs me a lot of trouble to digest and feels like a rubber ball in my stomach. However, these gents, have successfully prevented that from happening to me. I think they roll their own dough, old-skool style. Their crust is also not uniform and a bit jaggedy which I love and tells me they do not use a machine.

The base sauce is delicious! The BBQ has been such a hit in my house where I am typically the only BBQ lover. Now there are 4 of us! The BBQ is not over the top sweet, it has just enough smokiness to counter it.

Finally, they do not cheap out with their base sauce, toppings, and cheese.

Please keep up the good work and don't get greedy!
It’s was a phenomenal bite! Taste of their pizza 9/10 really good pizza chef here and their service is friendly as always highly recommended ⚡️👌
These guys redeemed themselves food got way better and customer service is a lot better. I take back everything I siad before. Marshallah brothers. Just please keep it up

I’m usually a big fan of Perfetto, the Pizza is delicious imo, and I’ve been regular customer for a year now. Would be a 5 Star.
But, it doesn't taste as good when it's cold and over an hour late. This is 2nd time there's been a problem with delivery here recently, but the Pizza is so good I’ll give it last chance. Hope they pay attention and sort it out.

Not only our food was neglected while we sat there for ages wondering where the food is at, the food quality really was terrible and the chicken smelled rotten. I had a terrible stomach pain afterwards. Evert time i remember this experience i feel sick

name: PizzaExpress
address: Condor House, 5-10 St. Paul's Churchyard, London EC4M 8AY, UK

reviews.text:
My recent visit to PizzaExpress in London was absolutely unforgettable. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was warm, stylish, and inviting — the perfect blend of Italian charm and modern London energy.
I ordered the Calabrian Festival pizza, and it completely exceeded my expectations. The flavors were bold and beautifully balanced — a perfect harmony of spice, rich tomato sauce, creamy cheese, and high-quality toppings. Every bite felt like a celebration of authentic Italian cuisine with a creative twist. The crust was perfectly baked: crisp on the outside, soft and airy on the inside.
The Caesar salad was equally impressive — fresh, crunchy, and generously coated in a creamy, flavorful dressing. The parmesan and croutons added the perfect texture and depth, making it far more than just a side dish.
To complete the experience, I enjoyed a cold Italian Peroni beer from Peroni. It paired beautifully with the pizza — light, refreshing, and the ideal complement to the rich flavors of the meal.
Overall, it was an outstanding dining experience. Exceptional food, great ambiance, and impeccable taste in every detail. I can’t wait to return!
Amazing service and smiles from Sophie and her team. Got my fave pizza just the way I like it! (Pollo ad Astra on a classic base, no tomato sauce - replaced with green pesto instead… delicious!).

We had a fantastic experience at this pizza place. The food was absolutely delicious. What made the evening truly special, though, was our waitress, Daiva. She was incredibly friendly, attentive, and professional. She made excellent recommendations, checked in at just right times, and made us feel genuinely welcome. Her positive attitude and great sense of humor really elevated our dining experience. We will definitely be coming back!

We visited on a busy evening and the restaurant was absolutely packed. The team managed to squeeze us in at a small table near the kitchen, which we were just happy to have! The manager was clearly leading by example, with her 'sleeves rolled up' helping the team take orders.

What really stood out was the proactive service. The manager noticed a more spacious table opened up and immediately offered to move us, which made a huge difference to our evening. Despite the rush, we were served by the manager and two different waiters, all of whom were attentive, friendly, and seamless in their service. Even the team member who originally seated us came by to check we were settled in our new spot.

The food was excellent as always, but this was easily one of the best Pizza Express experiences we’ve had because of the people. It is wonderful to see such a cohesive team working so well together. I thanked the manager on the night, but wanted to put this in writing too. Thank you for a lovely evening!

The restaurant uses the same pizza oven as the Kebab store on my street. When we ordered a pizza Bianco, we got served a regular one - the answer of the waiter was that "it tastes better". Pizzas are small, thin, and unimpressive. The prize is outrageous for the quality. Mac and cheese sauce was runny and tasted bland. All in all, a really bad experience for a high price.

Business meal for 150 GBP for 5 people. Good and tasty food, excellent service and able to talk without too much noise.
They have several dishes and even daily menu for 29 GBP with starter, main course and dessert.
Good, cheap and quick option.
Very attentive service and the food arrived surprisingly quickly despite it being very busy. Everything tasted great.

Delicious pizza — thin crust, great ingredients, honestly even tastier than in Italy! The atmosphere is lovely, and the service is fast and friendly. The only thing — the name ‘Pizza Express’ doesn’t do it justice, it sounds too simple for such high-quality food!
Pizza express has the shittest pizzas ever. Flavourless expensive dog shit. Don’t waste your money. I’m pissed. £20 for a pizza and I’m still hungry. All these toppings and still trash.

I bought the “elderflower and mint sparkle” for £4.95 and was given a Bottle Green elderflower bottle with a single sprig of mint. this is misleading - if you’re going to serve a branded item you should write that on the menu. it’s written as if you make it homemade!! and it didn’t have any mint flavour at all. also the fudge cake was cold which should be written on the menu too. if you’re serving a “freshly baked” cake with ice cream i expect it to be warm. also had to call service multiple times - very long waits.

name: Maa Pizza & Bar
address: 300 Cambridge Heath Rd, London E2 9HA, UK

reviews.text: Lovely cosy Italian spot with friendly service and really impressive food. The pasta was exceptional — fresh, flavourful, and cooked perfectly. I also had a chai latte which was surprisingly delicious. Great atmosphere, great staff, and very reasonable prices. Definitely worth a visit!

We came here for a friend’s birthday and were welcomed with open arms. The service answered questions with patience and dealt with personal requests with grace.

The food itself: Faultless. Well made pizza, nice thin crust, generous toppings. Delicious pasta sauces with decent portions of pasta.

Will be coming back because Thomas made us feel very welcome.

One of those places where the decor is lowkey because the food is priority.

We were given a very warm welcome straight out the gate. The service was very kind!

The food was very tasty and extremely competitively priced. The drinks were priced a bit higher than I'd have liked, but that was made up for by the lower food price.

It's a bit hidden but extremely cosy. We were there during a really quiet evening and the atmosphere was stellar.

Food so good I had to go 2 days in a row! I really really recommend the seafood pasta, it was absolutely delicious.

The service was also amazing - super kind staff that recognised us when we came again and made really friendly conversation. Will be going as often as possible!

Maa Pizza & Bar is a really friendly, family run Italian-themed restaurant with delicious hot food and warm service. The fact that the restaurant is dog friendly, our little Jack Russel was been made very welcome!

The location is very good and handy for Cambridge Heath train station. The front facing exterior is a legacy of the railway arch setting and definitely worth making the steps across the decking to this almost hidden gem.

The kitchen team food is authentic Italian showing a love for Mediterranean cuisine. We have gone along to Maa for special occasions and when family have been visiting. We have always been delighted with the food and service and the prices are definitely value for money. We love it and looking forward dining there again! ❤️

The food came out fairly quickly and you could tell it was freshly made. Amazing service, all the staffs are helpful and friendly :)
The food was good value for its price too.

We enjoyed everything we ordered, but my favourite were salmon tataki.
Miso soup was surprisingly very good as well.
Can’t wait to go back again!

Excellent dining experience with a particular highlight being the boa bun.
The menu offers an impressive range of choices, ensuring there's something for everyone. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, making it an ideal setting for social gatherings or business meetings.

I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone seeking quality food and a pleasant ambiance.

Excellent dining experience with a particular highlight being the boa bun.
The menu offers an impressive range of choices, ensuring there's something for everyone. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, making it an ideal setting for social gatherings or business meetings.

I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone seeking quality food and a pleasant ambiance.

🍣🍛🍱Great experience eating here! The sushi was fresh and really tasty, everything we ordered was delicious. The restaurant’s design is modern and has a really nice atmosphere, making it a great place to sit and enjoy a meal. The staff were friendly and quick as well. I’ve already tried the Waterloo and Notting Hill locations, which is why I wanted to check out this newly opened restaurant too — and I wasn’t disappointed. I’ll definitely be coming back! 🍣🍛🍱

Amazing dishes that are value for money and great service for dine in. Prawn tempura was crunchy and very tasty and salmon with rice was really good as well. Menu is quite varied with great lunch deals.
The male server was very polite and helpful when asked to help with choosing dishes from the menu. Cute decor and nice setting overall. Highly recommended

This is hands down the best sushi I’ve had so far. Everything is made fresh after you order, and you can really taste the quality in every bite.

The owner is SO kind 🥹 I was feeling a bit cold and he even brought a heater over to sit next to me. That level of care really made my day. The service is incredibly warm and welcoming — I genuinely don’t understand why there isn’t a queue yet because this place is a true hidden gem.

The restaurant is small and cozy, with a clear view of the kitchen, which makes it feel very clean and well taken care of. Definitely a case of don’t judge a book by its cover.

Prices are also very reasonable for the quality you get.
I’ll 100% be coming back again and again 🍣🤍

Incredible sushi.
We made a request for two set menus and spicy tuna gunkan.
I cannot fault a single thing.
Staff was lovely and helpful when we requested a little adjustment.
Food was prepared fresh for us.
There are only 2 tables and a bar with two seats, but they prepare for take away too.
Whenever we are back in London we will definitely repeat.

I had such a great experience here! The sushi was fresh and delicious! The owner was incredibly warm and very attentive, which made the whole visit feel personal and welcoming. You can really tell he cares about both the food and the people who walk through the door. I’ll definitely be coming back! 🍣✨

I recently dining at this spot, and it was an experience worth talking about. If you love sushi or are even just curious to try it, this place is absolutely worth a visit. Fresh, flavorful, clean, reasonable price and truly memorable. Definitely coming back. 😊

We were welcomed by the delightful staff & Were told to sit & wait as they prepared
Our order completely fresh.

They gave us a generous amount of sushi
Which was very well presented

Everything tasted delicious

We definitely recommend trying
Them out as everything is fresh
& Consistently tasty.

We once again want to thank everyone at
Kuuki Sushi 9 for the pleasant experience

And look forward to trying more items
From their menu

-✨

I went on a late afternoon, so it was quiet and service was fast.
I got the salmon sushi, it was nice but I wish they put more sauce to add flavour.
Will visit again

Came to SushiDog Bishopsgate yesterday and when I tell you it was a 10/10 experience! Both Hamida and Kate were so lovely and got my very picky order spot on. Amazing service and even better food will definitely be back

One of my favourite work lunch spots in the city. They’re always absolutely delicious with generous portions of protein and fresh, flavourful toppings. I’d definitely recommend getting their sushi dog - essentially a large sushi burrito - as it allows you to have each ingredient and sauce all together in one yummy bite. This is a great spot to try Japanese flavours you’d expect from sushi but in a completely customisable way. Not too pricey too - usually under £10 but can go up another £3 for double protein (which I recommend!). Overall, always delicious and will definitely be coming back.
Came twice and really enjoyed the food . Big portion and good price; very fresh and healthy ingredients

The food was DELICIOUS. My favourite sushi restaurant in all of London. My tastebuds were in heaven and the team is so friendly. I will definitely come back and make another purchase. I will like to do a special shoutout to Raheem as he took his time to cater to my dietary needs. What a lovely young man :)

Amazing food and booked with thefork got 50% off bill. Food was fresh and delicious! The place looked a bit run down and could do with some music on. But apart from that it was great! Defo would go back
This is a fab little independent local find. Have bought from here a number of times & sampled both hot dishes and sushi - everything was fresh & flavoursome. Lovely friendly service too.

❌❌ First time ordering from them through UberEat.. and the Sushi came with rotten Avocado omg that's seriously a food safety and could cause a sickness or poisoning who knows... disgusting! It's unbelievable how a person who would make it can see the rotten avocado and still use it for costumers ❌❌  all to the bin 🚮
I had an amazing experience at Atlantic Sushi. The sushi was super fresh, full of flavour, and beautifully presented. The service was friendly and quick, and the place was clean and comfortable.
The salmon was so creamy and the Salmon box meal deal even came with veg, a drink and dessert

Just ordered my meal last night Sushi plus for the 1st time and were highly impressed. The atmosphere was buzzing, the service top notch, especially from the lovely Verity. But most importantly the food was excellent. The fish was fresh and very tasty, presentation was superb and the portions very good value.

Me and my boyfriend ordered food from this restaurant on Deliveroo and honestly this is literally the worst Japanese food we ever had. The sushi and sashimi (SASHIMI???) were so bland. The Agedashi Tofu tasted really sour as if the tofu has gone bad. Miso soup was really bland, the tofu was sour and even the seaweed in it didn't taste of anything (how is that even possible). Everything just tasted bland/sour/off and it gave both of us a really bad stomachache (personally made me feel insanely nauseous).

Shame I cannot give this 0 stars because they don't deserve even 1 star. Have no idea how it's possible that this place has 4.9 rating on Deliveroo. Always a good lesson to check the rating of the restaurant on Google first because people do not lie here.

No exaggeration: this has the distinction of being the absolute worst sushi I've had in my life so far (and I've eaten quite a lot). Ordered several types of sushi as well as curry, and all were entirely devoid of flavor.
I don't understand how they made even sashimi so completely bland; How can a restaurant take the flavor out of a fish? I'm honestly baffled.

Amazing place to get sushi takeaway if you really like fresh sushi this is the right place. i ordered in deliveroo the food came really fast and it was so fresh. i definitely will ask in this place again and  I recommend it to everyone.

Came across this sushi place on the off chance of driving past it and feeling very hungry. Looked like it was being re branded, but the kitchen, counter was very disorganized. Ordered a veg yaki soba and it was extremely salty. Looked like a place where they think making Japanese food is easy, so why not open a takeaway, ran by Indians and not Japanese. Very disappointing.

The manager was so rude for no reason, and the fish wasn’t fresh, plus we got the hot meal also the chicken was so chewy it was lik is from yesterday, just because is Located in a busy area doesn’t mean you can lose your quality.
Shame on the Managers.

Chicken katsu curry, chicken was so tough it must have been under a heat lamp for days, rice was cold, sauce was lukewarm. You're paying £8-9 for a disgusting reheat of one of their supermarket ready meals.
They gave me used napkins

Good for a fast food chain. However flavours are adjusted to meet the "white" market. Tried today their Thai curry, it was not spicy as you would expect from green curry. It was just slightly tingling the lips. Other issue I have is amount of teriyaki sauce on the chicken katsu when one on top have a bit of it, where the second piece has almost non. Sushi are fine, rice not overly frozen. Prices are getting more expensive, there is less and less meat in lunch boxes. I wish there will be more sauce and veggies, not predominately rice.
Had the ramen noodles. Absolute delicious. Nice array of other choice meals. Will definitely be back

It was fun watching sushi going around on the belt conveyor. The restaurant has table service downstairs and a take away section at the entrance as well as the belt conveyor counter.
Sushi and other dishes are on the different colour plates indicating it's prices.
Orange £3.50
Red £3.90
Green £4.50
Blue £4.90
Pink £5.50
Yellow £5.90
Most cooked dishes from the kitchen were on the yellow plates and I thought they were good value as long as you pick them up while it's still hot.
Most dishes including sushi are on the belt without top covers for the first few rounds, and I found them unhygienic.

Sushi chefs in the corner were friendly, though they are very busy making all sushi for takeaway, downstairs tables as well as the belt conveyor counter.

You'll get your bill from a staff, and pay at the till by the entrance.

Be aware that the service charge is astonishingly high even for the city standards.
It is 20%!
For pick up by yourself sushi and pay at the till, I think it is outrageous.
I don't think bringing a drink and counting the plates and writing it down isn't worth 20%. Or am I mean to think that way.

Prawn tempura was good, machareal sushi was good, others I had weren't.

One experience was enough for me.

Their miso soup is a bit sweet, same goes with the Katsu Don.

I would like to try their Katsu curry next time.

The ground level is more like a takeaway place and also for conveyor belt sushi

The sunken table area is quite cool downstairs but we sat at a normal table. The atmosphere was super off with it being dead quiet with no music. Just an awkward atmosphere. The salmon sashimi was really good, super fresh! I had a rice bowl with steak as my main and it was just okay- it was pretty bland and could’ve done with a sauce, there was just so so much pickled ginger as well, it would’ve been nice to have some other veg.

The waitress was amazing, super lovely and she was concerned when we left loads of food at the end but we were just so full!

Re: Friday 4th August evening

Food was good and I feel the pricing was fair for a central London restaurant.

Seating was downstairs. A little too cozy. It's nice they give you the option to sit at the tables or on the sunken floor area that requires slippers.

The waitress was fantastic and did a great job working by herself, tending to all tables and checking in on us. They are lucky to have her! Bad look to see who I got the impression of the owner sitting at a table drinking and looking unfriendly or helpful.

Unfortunately, the condition of the one toilet available was atrocious. For this reason we will not come back.  I forgot to take an image of the sink- it would be impossible to wash hands if someone were to use the urinal which is in front of it. I do not think I would feel comfortable bringing children into that toilet without waiting for them.

There is no excuse to have it in the condition it is and this could be renovated over a weekend. They are closed on the weekends so that baffles me even more.  The majority of the floor tiles are loose.

Additionally, the amount of fruit flies in the toilet and restaurant needs to be addressed.

I'm sure this goes against many H&S standards.

Disappointed to say the least.

First time sushi for me so I cannot compare, but I did enjoy it. Tried salmon, tuna, and eel as well as some beef on rice and vegetables. Really tasty! I even liked the Wasabi. Prices are fine for dinner in London. The staff was nice as well. Just one thing, downstairs is limited mobile reception and we couldn't find wifi.
Helpful staff, the restaurant wasn’t the best but the food was nice, I had no issues with it. Thank you 🍱🍣🍣
One of the best crunchy katsu chicken rolls I’ve had in a while
The price is cheap, but it is not enough to create good memories.

name: Burger & Beyond - Shoreditch
address: 147 Shoreditch High St, London E1 6JE, UK

reviews.text: A burger tryst lives up to its name! Bougie burger is indeed bougie. They truly know how to indulge the best possible way - look the cheese amount. Truffle trot is my favourite! Highly recommend for everyone to try out.

Burger and Beyond in Shoreditch is absolutely amazing! Not only are the burgers insanely good, but the service from Sandra and Michael was outstanding. A special shoutout to Michael for being so friendly and helpful—he gave great recommendations, and the Bougie Burger was a must-try! Sandra’s warm and sweet smile made the whole dining experience even better. The burgers are juicy, with perfectly melted cheese, and the Signature Tots were crispy on the outside and soft on the inside—so delicious! The atmosphere is also fantastic. Highly recommend this spot!🔥🍔

I ordered delivery, the crispy chicken burger was one of the best I’ve had, buns are slightly sweet like brioche, chicken has a crispy coating and the ranch sauce and pickles gives different texture when you take a bite.

The signature tots were a bit sour, I’m not a fan of vinegar on chips so didn’t like the seasoning as much. Other than that, the tots were very soft on the inside, bits of meat and cheese, very satisfying to eat, would like to try the truffle tots.

Great burgers with high-quality ingredients. The meat was juicy, the bun was soft, and everything tasted well balanced. Friendly service and a relaxed atmosphere — definitely a place I’d come back to.

Food - delicious 5/5 although super greasy for my own liking but that’s just my personal preference.

Service - very accommodating and quick.

Atmosphere - lovely and music volume is just right, you can have a conversation across the table easily!

food came fast, and tasted 10/10.  every bite i took felt like heaven it was SO good. i don’t know why the shop was empty it needs to be packed with customers with their food tasting THIS good. would 100% recommend and would 100% go again. gonna tell my family to buy it as well cos it’s tewwww good. oh and also the music was good too which is a plus.

Ghost burgers was a great experience. Best spot to take a lunch break peacefully. I had lunch offer ghost burger and sticky wings, both were fresh, flavorful, and cooked perfectly.. The taste is on the spot and loved their signature house sauce. The strawberry mojito was refreshing and balanced, a perfect pairing with the food. Service was quick, portions were solid, and the vibe was chill. Definitely worth stopping by and I’d come back again.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Absolutely Incredible — Ghost Burger Hoxton is a Hidden Gem!

From the moment you walk into Ghost Burger Hoxton, you know you’re in for something special. The vibe is effortlessly cool — neon lights, hip-hop beats, and that perfect Hoxton edge that makes you feel like you’ve discovered London’s best-kept secret.

But let’s talk about the food… WOW.
The burgers are next-level — juicy, smoky, perfectly seasoned, and stacked just right. You can tell they use top-quality ingredients because every bite bursts with flavour. The signature Ghost Burger is a masterpiece — the kind of burger that actually makes you pause mid-bite just to appreciate what’s happening. The smashed patties have that perfect crispy edge, and the sauces? Unreal. Whoever created those flavour combos deserves a medal.

The fries are golden perfection, the loaded sides are dangerously addictive, and the milkshakes? Straight-up dessert heaven. Thick, creamy, and beautifully presented.

The staff were genuinely friendly and clearly passionate about what they do. You can feel that energy from the kitchen to the counter — everyone’s just proud to be part of something great.

Whether you’re a burger lover, foodie, or just someone who appreciates quality done right, Ghost Burger Hoxton is an absolute must-visit. I’ve eaten burgers all over London, and this one easily makes the Top 3 — maybe even No.1.

🔥 Final verdict: Ghost Burger Hoxton isn’t just good… it’s legendary.
You don’t just eat here — you experience it.

Overall, it’s very expensive for what you get. Burgers start at around £12 without fries, and if you want a menu with fries and a drink, it’s an extra £5, which feels steep considering the taste and price are better at other burger spots nearby.

I tried the Mac & Cheese (from the secret menu), which was okay but very oily. The sides are small, yet again priced at a premium for what is essentially a standard portion elsewhere.

Atmosphere: Nothing special. The air conditioning wasn’t working (or wasn’t on), making it uncomfortably warm inside. You have to get up to order at the counter, and there’s no QR code ordering option, which felt a bit behind for a casual burger place. On the plus side, the food arrived promptly.

Other notes: The merchandise wasn’t fully stocked at the Shoreditch location, and it’s not something you’d go out of your way to buy anyway.

Overall, Ghost Burgers is nothing you’d miss if you skipped it. Decent enough if you’re desperate for a burger, but for the price, you’ll get better quality, portions, and comfort elsewhere.

The food was absolutely amazing, but what really stood out was the samir who served us. he was incredibly polite, attentive and friendly throughout our visit. He made sure we were comfortable and took great care of everything without us having to ask. His positive attitude truly enhanced our dining experience. Excellent service like this makes a big difference highly appreciated!!!

name: Mo's Shack
address: 130 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E2 6DG, UK

reviews.text: First time visit last night, had the loaded box for £10.99, with 20% off from that too! This place is a hidden gem! Food was as it should be, fresh, tasty, seasoned well, big portions. Compared to places in east London charging nearly double for the same grub (lesser portions). This is a must try. Recommended, and will be returning in shaa Allah.

Clean place with good food! Service was good too. Looking forward to popping in again soon and trying the rest of the menu! I like my buffalo wings to be saucy and asked for more sauce! Graciously complied. Chips were crispy and fresh!

Very good burgers at very reasonable prices.
A great variety of drinks.
Fast service and nice staff.
Few downsides however - chips weren’t great, they were cold and didn’t taste fresh. The restaurant itself is quite small without heating or toilets so better suited for takeaways.

Edit:
Revisited today and chips have definitely been improved! They were hot, fresh and tasted great. Chicken tenders and wings were great and burgers as good as always. Steak and chips was also a hit.
Service still very good.
The food was super good.We took smash burgers they were great.That was 9£

Mo's Shack in Bethnal Green is honestly a hidden gem! I tried the Mo's Smash + Loaded Smash Fries and on my second visit, the Mo's Mexicana with fries and massive tenders, and hands down, they’re some of the best smash burgers and food I’ve ever had. The flavors were spot on, the patties were juicy, and every bite had that perfect balance of ingredients. The wings and other items on their menu are just as good, but those burgers truly stood out.

What’s even better is the portion sizes for the price—absolutely unreal. In a time when most places are cutting corners, Mo's Shack goes the extra mile. You get generous portions that feel like a steal for what they’re charging. Honestly, it’s worth more than what you pay, especially in today’s economy.
