The service is top-notch too. The staff are super friendly and make you feel welcome, plus they think of the little things like giving wet wipes and sauces without you having to ask—something you rarely see these days. It’s small touches like this that make the experience even better.

If you’re after great halal food that’s both quality and value for money, Mo's Shack is the place to go. You won’t regret it! Ignore any negative reviews—those people must be trolling because this place is a solid 10/10.

Highly recommended!

This is our local Honest Burgers joint in the area. The eatery was packed with various offers & incentives for customers. Burgers were actually decent & as expected. We also got some free onion rings as advertised. But ambience inside seemed a tad cold. Perhaps it was due to the time of day, but I must say service was not exactly memorable.
The Honest Burger and Festive Menu were really good. Our staff member was very friendly too. Place had also a cute set-up. Check it out for yourself, if you like burgers with a good side of fries:)

Love the honest burger.
I have to say It has the most delicious onion rings in the world
Most consistent burger chain in London. Never been disappointed and in my opinion they have the best patties in terms of flavour. Can never go wrong here after a heavy night on the beers 🍻

Nestled near Old Street, Honest Burger offers a casual dining experience with a focus on quality ingredients.

On my recent visit, I was excited to try their Halal options, specifically the chicken tenders. These crispy bites were nothing short of delicious, perfectly seasoned and fried to golden perfection.

However, my excitement waned when I sampled the Honest Fried Chicken Burger. While it boasted a juicy chicken breast, American cheese, and a medley of toppings like ranch mayo, lettuce, and pickles, I found it lacked the punch I was hoping for. The buffalo sauce was barely noticeable, leaving the burger feeling a tad underwhelming.

On a brighter note, the mint lemonade stole the show! It was incredibly refreshing, striking the perfect balance of sweetness and zest.

Overall, while the chicken tenders were a standout, the burger didn’t quite hit the mark for me. I’ll definitely return for that mint lemonade, but I might explore other options next time. If you’re in the area, give their tenders a try!

name: The Burger Firm Whitechapel
address: 7 Mile End Rd, Bethnal Green, London E1 4TP, UK

reviews.text:
If you’re a real burger lover, this place needs to be on your list. I came here because everyone was talking about it—and honestly, I’m still questioning if these were the best burgers I’ve had all year.

The menu is stacked, so choosing wasn’t easy. I started with the Loaded Box and was already hooked—crispy fries, juicy beef, crispy chicken, and sauces that just work. The mac and cheese bites were insane too.

Now let’s talk burgers. The double smashed cheeseburger was juicy, cheesy, and perfectly cooked. The 4-patty smash was indulgent but worth it. The Eggslut with the fried egg added a whole new level of richness. But the star of the show was the Thanos burger—double smashed patty, crispy chicken, turkey rashers, fried egg, and halloumi. I didn’t know what to expect, but every bite was unreal.

Dessert didn’t disappoint either—the Dubai chocolate croffle was rich and indulgent, and the strawberry cheesecake milkshake was the perfect way to end the meal.

This place really puts their money where their mouth is. A must-try for burger fans.

👉 Follow nellysworldoftaste on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube for the full review and more food content. 🍔🔥

Hunted this place down after seeing it score highly on a burger review on YouTube. It about a 2 minute walk from Whitechapel station. Keep an eye ln your phones and avoid the stranger locals.

First impressions are that the place is small, just one row of seating along the side and I noticed the dusting standard did not match Five Guys. Staff are friendly and it overall it clearly well run. It was cold when I went in with a couple of heaters which did not make much of a dent. It is popular; most people doing takeaway and plenty of Deliveroos on a Saturday evening.

We had the Fry’d Box which is a decent portion of crinkle fries as the base and an entire crispy chicken burger cut up and scattered on top with a bunch of sauces. It is really fun and beats the pathetic loaded fries that Five Guys have just come up with by 100 miles, al though it’s not cheap. I’d say you get what you pay for, but the Five Guys loaded fries are a rip off, particular compared to The Burger Firm. The most amazing thing is that the fries stay really crispy considering the chicken and sauce on top. It’s clear that crispy fries are a priority in the place and I salute that.

I went for the 4x4 which is the go-to option if you want a really decent beef hit. The smash burgers were cooked perfectly in my opinion with a slight crust to the edges which spill outside of the bun, but nothing burned. Again, high culinary values showing through here. My initial flavour impression was very impressive with a strong fat percentage driving home that beef hit. After the initial wow waned slightly about halfway through I did sense the meat wasn’t top quality, but 75th percentile I’d say. Easy to finish if you’re hungry and a very decent burger.

My partner had the Pandemic burger which is a smash and also a crispy chicken which was also a fun concept. It was decent, but I prefer one or the other. Chicken in the burger and on the fries was the same thing. Quality is good rather than excellent in my opinion and didn’t match the succulence you get at Thunderbird for example.

There was also a burger which featured mac and cheese crispy triangles and you can see the real packs or Oreo’s and Diam bars neatly stacked in the counter that they use to make the shakes. For vision and inventiveness, I don’t think there is anywhere better in London.

The burger was crazy good! I ordered The Good Burger, and it came with perfectly smashed meat — crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside. Plus points for the well-seasoned crinkle-cut fries — it’s rare to find good ones, but I loved theirs. definitely worth the price. We also tried the croffle (croissant waffle) topped with Nutella, Lotus Biscoff, and ice cream. Super recommended! It’s the perfect combination of crispy, sweet, and warm. You should try it!

After seeing a few reviews about this place I added it to my “London Eats” list, but in the end, I was left disappointed. I got “The Good Burger” and while appearance-wise, it looked like a nice, smash burger, the taste was not very good in my opinion. The meat tasted like low-quality beef and I found certain parts of the patty hard to chew. The gherkin sauce didn’t really have many gherkin pieces in it. Finally, the restaurant is not really set up in way for one to eat comfortably. It is very cramped inside and there are only two trays available for use.
One of the BEST burgers I had since moved to London! Chicken was so juicy and the flavours were giving!

A very pleasant and atmospheric place. The staff is friendly and helpful.
This was our third time there and we were pleased again. All the food was delicious and freshly prepared. We were a large group, and everything was served at the same time and kept hot.
There's an excellent selection of juicy burgers and a variety of sets. The portions are really large, which justifies the prices. The meat mix was simply amazing, delicious, and melts in your mouth. To make eating the hearty burgers more comfortable, everyone is given a decent-sized cloth napkin, which is really convenient.
On one of our visits, there was a live Latin American band playing, which really set the festive mood for the day.
We've definitely become regulars.
Thank you so much!

I ordered the Doomsday Device burger/sandwich which tasted pretty good but the over-the-top greasiness ruined the experience for me, unfortunately. Loved the fries and the Chocolate Malt Shake though.

The service was super slow and we were a big group and had to wait for over 30 minutes to finally place our orders. We sat outside and the ambience was very good with the outside heating on.

I came here with a bigger group, and even though we were polite and easy customers, the staff were just straight-up rude, shouting across the place and making the whole atmosphere unpleasant. It was too loud to have a proper chat, and the place was so cramped you couldn’t even put your bag down without being told off.

The food was just as bad. I ordered a spicy burger, which came covered in a ridiculous amount of jalapeños and habaneros. I usually handle spicy food with no problem, but this one made me feel actually unwell. My stomach and throat were burning, and I even felt sick the next day. Safe to say this completely destroyed my appetite.

Overall, really not worth it. Unfriendly staff, uncomfortable setting, and overpriced food. Wouldn’t recommend at all.

On trend Mid-Western / Southern American food joint in Hoxton Square, Old Street. Plays some country music and a relaxed welcoming atompshere. The burgers are huge and dirty (in a good way). About the right price point. Service was good, maybe not the warmest, but perfectly fine. One of the better and more bankable food options in that area

It's dude food.  We ended up here accidentally because Odyssey on the other side of the square cancelled our reservation at the last minute because I am on crutches so couldn't  make it down the stairs to a basement table.
Staff are all very kind and helpful but professionalism and knowledge about the menu varies.  We both got baskets where I got the platter with wings and my companion got the smoked brisket.  Proteins were all well executed.  My wings were deep fried but not greasy, the brisket was tasty and tender.  However I hated the accompaniments like greasy chips, and slaw smothered in copious amounts of mayo.  I didn't even try the greasy looking Texas toast.
If I ever come back I will order a starter of wings and a side caesar to avoid all the greasy accompaniments.

Excellent burgers and very kind and polite people working there. The cake is also very home made and delicious, I was going there every night during my stay in London especially for the cake! Everything is very fresh and well prepared, the prices are excellent and my 2 kids also loved the fish fingers and the nuggets! I myself could see (while waiting) how they are careful showing each delivery guy how they should carry each package in order to not let it get messy inside. Definitely a place we will return when we visit England again!

The new clucking cow combo smash burger cook with Irish Angus beef & spicy chicken burger caramelised onion, cheese, gherkin, lettuce & special sauce very juicy tender succulent very tasty. Smokin smash cooked with Irish Angus beef , turkey rashers, onion rings, lettuce, cheese, bbq sauce full of flavour tender juicy burger nicely cooked taste was bangin.Big Cheesy cooked with Irish Angus beef patty, cheese very cheesy juicy tender soft succulent tasty smash burger. Miami heat chicken dip buttermilk chicken spicy dipped in spicy Miami sauce very tasty nice flavour.loaded buttermilk fries & Miami bite was awesome.

This place is absolutely rubbish, I wish I could leave zero stars. I rarely leave any negative reviews and I’ll never berate a local business, but this place is an absolute waste of your money. I ordered a double smash burger, it was so tiny, I could have finished it in 2 bites, it was tiny! It’s supposed to be a “double” smash burger. The burger also stank of peanuts for some reason. There is no customer experience or care here, the portions and food is rubbish. Don’t even waste your time or money here, they are absolutely rubbish. The chicken strips I ordered on the side, it was one of those disgusting ultra processed ones you get in a cash and carry, I thought they’d be proper chicken strips, and it’s £4.99 for a portion I think. The only good thing was the drink, and that’s because they don’t make it. This was my first and last time here, that was a complete waste of £12, honestly, if you want smash burgers Amigos is a literal 1-min walk from where they are, their burgers and food is so much better. I never do this after eating out somewhere, but I genuinely feel like going back and getting a refund. It’s an absolute joke of a burger takeway.
Placed the food over the phone for collection. The burger was piping hot, and just perfect. Absolutely delicious smash burger… craving it right now.

Heard alot of hype from this place so thought I'd try it out. Customer service isn't so great. Staff aren't very welcoming and it felt quite awkward.

The food is overpriced and not even value for money. One of the burgers we had the lettuce was gone off. Absolutely disgusting how they included that knowing its gone off. We opted in for cheese in our wrap. The wrap was loaded with cheese which made the wrap sickening, there was more cheese than chicken.

Don't recommend this place and don't see myself returning here. Food quality needs to improve especially with the prices their selling at.

name: Crispies Tower Hill
address: 2 Tower Hl Ter, London EC3N 4EE, UK

reviews.text: Lovely place for a pitstop after our normal Monday walks. Very nice and clean place tucked around the corner from Tower of London and Tower Bridge. A wide range of menu on offer from burgers, wings, wraps and drinks. We went for the  chicken and wings meal. Price was ok fair for the location. The staff at front counter were friendly and polite and very helpful in terms of what the different meal options were and the various flavours. I opted for the Korean flavoured burger and wings. My colleague Abdal chose lemon and herb flavour. The restaurant is very modern, clean, lots of seating downstairs and upstairs. We didn’t have to wait long for food. The food was well presented. Chip portion was very large, comes with sauced etc on the house no extra. The burgers and wings were well flavoured, well cooked and tasted delicious after a long walk. A great place to go if you’re looking for halal food and quick simple food near the Tower of London at a good fair price as well.

We paid £23.80 for two crispy chicken burger meals, but were disappointed. The chicken fillets were not soft or tender, and the chips were not tasty either.

Also, the toilets need improvement, they were very smelly and there was no handwashing available. Overall, not worth the price.

Food: Overcooked and smelled burnt. I ordered a plant-based burger, and it was clearly overdone with a strong burnt smell. When I mentioned this, the boy at the till responded rudely and said, “We have a timer; it’s not burnt,” instead of checking or offering any help.

Service: Very disappointing. The same staff member ignored our greeting and gave off an attitude like we were bothering him just by ordering.

Atmosphere: Average, but the poor service and burnt food really ruined the experience.

Not worth visiting again unless they seriously improve their food quality and customer service.

Good portion sizes and decent chicken tenders with a nice selection of sauces. The fries were average. Dining in is disappointing—the seating area is above the kitchen, so you leave smelling like fried chicken.

We were looking for a burger place around the Bank area, and saw that Crispies had 4.7 out of 5 here in Google. London has a very good burger scene, so we were really looking forward to this. However, we were sorely disappointed.

The staff were unhelpful. When I warned them that there weren't any forks left in the cutlery boxes, and asked for one, they just ignored me.

The place was empty when we arrived. We ordered two burger meals, but when we got them they were cold. I gather the burgers and fries had been sitting in the kitchen for a while.

Overall, a mediocre overpriced burger, with unattentive/lazy staff. Do yourself a favour and go somewhere else.

Visited for the first time today i decided order the hot chick with the help of an amazing employee called talal. The staff were so friendly and patient as its my first time and i wasn’t sure how to navigate the menu. The open kitchen was clean and i observed high food handling standards. Can’t wait to try the burger! Mahdi another employee worked fast to make sure my food was hot and aesthetic

This is from Saudi Eats in London, with 80k+ followers across social platforms.
Instagram & Tiktok: saudieats.ksa

@bronsonsburgers is East London’s best kept secret ;). Bronson’s Burger has truly set a new standard for burger joints with their latest dine-in restaurant.

If you’re craving a top-tier burger with patties so juicy they’ll have you coming back for more, this is the spot to be. With 10 locations across the UK, Bronson’s doesn’t just serve burgers—they elevate them into an art.

The burgers here are really good – juicy and flavorful. However, it’s a shame they don’t serve proper cola, only something called ‘premium cola,’ which tastes quite different. The paprika chips are surprisingly spicy and feel more like chili chips than paprika.

Unfortunately, the atmosphere is lacking. The place feels empty, and nobody seems to eat in, which makes it less inviting.

I love smash burgers! I ordered a couple of these double cheeseburgers with sauce and salad and pickles. The buns are soft and fresh and good size of patties that aren’t smashed too thin , like some places do. The quality of beef was better than average. But not as good as burgers I’ve had elsewhere! But for double this price.
I ordered a chocolate milkshake! Which was ok  ! Nothing to brag about. The staff were extremely busy, because of 50% price reduction on opening. So service was a little rushed and hastily done. Not a problem. Only problem was the atmosphere was far too loud !! With extremely loud music!! More like a night club than a burger outlet! Probably because of the new opening! I think !
I’ll definitely be coming back for more of these tasty burgers! But only if their music is much less noisy. 09/02/25 ordered 2 more of these great smash burgers, and 2 fries . 1 paprika as usual & 1 cheese fries !
The cheese fries are the only dissatisfying disappointment from this place. The cheese was just melted cheese sauce ! Should be stated on the menu! But worse still it wasn’t served separately in a tub .
But poured all over un caringly ! All over the sides of the box ! And the fries were literally mush ! Mush ! I hope the owner reads this ! And serves the sauce separately! I’m deducting 1 star for this reason. And won’t order the cheese fries.

I don't often leave average reviews, see my history. I also recognise that this place is known for burgers and I did not order a burger so I will give it a second chance, also this was the soft opening so I leave this feedback hoping it helps them to improve.

I was glad to see this place open given I had seen their truck nearby for ages and seen their good reviews in the past.

I ordered cheesy fries and the tenders.

The quality of the potato chips are very good but the cheese is terrible, American style cheese sauce, just gloop, not for me. The chips could be seasoned with more salt, or at least ask.

The tenders are poor. A lot of batter very little chicken. The batter lacks seasoning, it's just crispy flour. You'll do better in well known chicken places.

It took about 15 mins to get this order even though there was only one other customer there during that time, this may have been because of the recent opening but I worry if it was a  busy night.

Finally, I wasn't too impressed to see one of the chefs vaping in the kitchen.

We booked via First Table for an early reservation prior to a gig. Staff were really friendly, but drinks were very slow to arrive (especially as when we first arrived there was only one other table seated). Food was tasty - the sauces tasting superb and the chicken seasoned well.  Cocktails were nice (when they did arrive) but would probably be reluctant to return given that even with the 50% first table discount, have had better food/drinks for less.

Came here for my birthday and they were amazing! Gave us a nice booth and a free dessert! Amazing staff, GREAT food, and great vibes! (Game board friendly on a quiet night with not too many people but maybe not if they are too busy) Definitely coming again.

Visited MEATLiquor N1 today and had such a great experience. It’s incredibly dog-friendly — water and treats for the pups arrived even faster than the menus, which set the tone perfectly! 🐾

The food came out super quickly and the service throughout was excellent — genuinely couldn’t fault it. The only small downside (for me personally) was the overall saltiness of the food. I usually prefer dishes unsalted so I can season to taste, but I realise that’s more down to personal habits than the cooking itself.

All in all, my friend, our doggies, and I had an amazing time. We’ll definitely be back!

Really nice place. We had the dead hippie burger and it was absolutely lovely. The sauce is literally Macdonald's big Mac sauce but the burger is 100X better. It's like how the big Mac SHOULD be. The wings were great fries, nice staff. Absolutely nothing to complain about. Oh, and they played guns and roses "civil war" and Rolling stones "sympathy for the devil". Top place. Will return.

I had high hopes for this place, but the Food and Service was really poor 👎👎
The GOOD 👍: it has really cool decor, with lots of seating inside and out, it's easy to get to being just off Islington's main High Street
The BAD👎: Food isn't great, poor quality and cold Burgers, poor Service, mistakes with Orders👎
In DETAIL🔎: Four of us called in for Dinner one Monday night, the Restaurant had decent reviews, so we thought we'd give it a try.  It was pretty quiet, maybe 5 or 6 Tables with Customers eating.
We ordered drinks (just simple Beers) somehow they got the Order mixed up😯
We then ordered some burgers and Fries, what turned up looked good, though strangely it was delivered on two big Trays (no Plates or Cutlery??🤔).  We began to eat and found some of the Burgers were cold 🤢 The onion Rings were good👍 The various 'loaded Fries' were a mixed bag, some good, some quite bad 🤢
Halfway through eating, the Waitress turns up with Plates and Cutlery 👎😯
More Drinks Orders were made and either forgotten by the Barman, or messed up👎  I could understand if it was busy, but the place was empty!🫤
We left most of the food, it was just awful 🤢
Price wise I'd say it is expensive for they offer 👎  They also add 12.5% Service Charge by default, so take note when you pay.
Overall, I wouldn't go there again👎

name: Honest Burgers Bank
address: 4, off Change Alley, Lombard St, London EC3V 9AZ, UK

reviews.text: Honest Burgers in Change Alley is exactly what you want when life’s too short to count calories. Yes, it’s a burger—calories included—but how can you resist that juicy patty? The buns practically beg you to indulge, and those rosemary chips? Pure happiness on the side. It’s the kind of place where diets take a back seat, and the only math you need is how many bites until the next one. Perfect for anyone who believes life’s about enjoyment, not restrictions.

Lovely smashburger to take away as always, and lovely staff. But 21 mins for a take away at 2.45pm is too long on Friday in the City guys, ( checked the order time on ticket), makes it hard to decide to nip out from work on spec to grab a take away and make it back in 1/2 an hour... Yummy though, dunked it in a cheese fondue at my place...

Nice burger but slightly on the expensive side. Fries are decent.chicken wings are nice too! But more than £1 for 1 wing. Also a jug of lemonade cause almost £10, very expensive but food quality overall are good.

Great service! You won’t go wrong with honest burger. The burger is really awesome, we went for the tribute, Patty to be medium well. It’s so juicy! but the onion rings really nothing too special. If you download the honest app, you get a free onion rings for the first time too. Chilled place to drink and relax. ☺️

I had an amazing experience at this restaurant! The burgers were absolutely delicious!!  juicy, full of flavour, and perfectly cooked. You can really taste the quality of the ingredients.
I especially want to thank Michael for his outstanding service. He was friendly, attentive, and made us feel very welcome from the moment we arrived. He checked on us regularly and made sure everything was perfect. His positive attitude really made our visit even more enjoyable.
Thank you to the whole team for such a great experience. We will definitely be coming back soon!! 😄

Had a great time here! and it was reasonable priced as well and not too expensive which is rare to find nowadays! The Rosemary chips are delicious and come with burger, I had the buffalo burger and you get quite a big sized fried chicken burger, also the chicken tenders are massive ( that's what she said 🫢) between 2 people with drinks, tenders, burgers and chips £22.50 each! Bargain and would come again, oh also our food came out mega fast ( and was hot) like within 10 mins of our order! Good stuff
The burgers are of a high quality and are exceptionally juicy. The staff is exceptionally helpful and gracious. The ambiance is quite comfortable.

One of my favourite places for veggie burgers! Food was hot and came out quickly, the service was a little manic though and it looked like they were understaffed perhaps. Everyone was super friendly despite this.

Good food, slightly cramped and the table sizes are small, service was decent, floors were slightly sticky and the decor was nothing special, had to wait a while to be seen for a table, seemed slightly understaffed
Wonderful experience with this smashed burger with bacon 🥓 buffalo wings. Thumbs up. Try it and you will know how good it is!
Banging burger and the Skins were super tasty too 👌
Was a great burger service was great. It gave he’s the black bear burger a run for its money
Made with love. Best burger in town.
This burger was one of the best I’ve had
Benjis burgers were the best thing I’ve ever had. Anyone who is in the UK needs to try his meat

The problem with my family is that we eat quickly and tend not to take the time to enjoy the atmosphere of a restaurant or the quality of the food.

It was my eldest's 15th birthday and, no, we didn't do anything different. But we did point out the fact that the service was swift, very professional, friendly and understanding.

We also enjoyed the food immensely, half the party having lobster, whilst the other two had different burgers. All the plates were finished (lobster casings aside) and we actually said how nice the restaurant was.

The Combo for Two at Burger & Lobster – Bread Street delivered an experience that feels indulgent yet comforting. The dishes arrive beautifully presented: half lobster portions with delicately sweet meat, perfectly cooked and paired with a velvety butter sauce that enhances every bite. The classic burger is surprisingly well-balanced—juicy, smoky, and rich—standing confidently beside the seafood instead of being overshadowed. The fries offer satisfying crispness, while the fresh salad adds brightness and balance to the plate.

The ambiance of the restaurant is warm and relaxed, with spacious leather seating and soft lighting that creates a cozy dining rhythm. Service is friendly and attentive, making the meal feel unrushed and genuinely enjoyable. Ending with a smooth hot chocolate and a crème brûlée topped with a caramelized crust was a delightful finale—simple but deeply satisfying.

Overall, this combo is a celebration of generous portions, quality ingredients, and thoughtful preparation. It’s a dining experience that makes you want to return, both for the flavors and for the inviting atmosphere.

This is my favourite Burger & Lobster in London! We've been to many of the locations around the city, but the food and service are just the best at this one. It's less busy on the weekends at this location, which is actually perfect. We brought our family here for our dad's birthday. Our server, Max, was always very friendly and helpful (he was also very patient every time we asked him to help us take photos haha). The manager, Gaetano, also came to check on us often, very thoughtful service, and was very pleasant to speak with. You can really tell when people actually enjoy their customer-facing roles, and it really makes the entire experience so much better. And of course the food - everything was delicious! Highly recommend this specific location, especially for any special occasions :) You'll be taken care of very well!

Such a lovely atmosphere!! I got the lobster croquettes and they were stunning! My partner said the wayyy smash burger was amazing too. The whole vibe and atmosphere was amazing including our server sonia!

This place was great.  We dropped in for a quick dinner and we're seated quickly.  A recommendation of the combo (burger and lobster roll), with a swap to the smash burger was perfect.  Lobster roll was very good, with nice chunks of lobster and not too much sauce.  The lemon butter sauce was good enough to drink on its own. The smashburger was perfectly seasoned.   I tried the truffle Mac and cheese but while it was good, wasn't my favorite.  My Mac and cheese search continues!

Postscript. Liked it enough that we came back the next night!  Tried the lobster ravioli which was great (I would have appreciated some red Chile or calabrian Chile flakes tonampt the flavor an bit).  My wife went for the lobster roll and lobster combo which was as good as the previous day!

Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
​The Gourmet Hut is the real deal! Me and my brothers went recently and were blown away. The beef burgers are genuinely amazing and scrumptious, and the chicken burgers are just as good it’s rare to find a place that does both perfectly. To top it off, the customer service was amazing.  Highly recommend!

Had a great experience at The Gourmet Hut. The Smokin’ Ribs were perfectly cooked — tender, full of flavour, and falling off the bone. Tried the Hut Wings in Killa Katsu and they were something different, really tasty, and the wings were huge.

The Pulled It Off Burger was a standout — juicy beef patty topped with slow-roasted pulled beef, cheese, onions, and rich gravy. Chips were crispy on the outside, fluffy inside, and tasted properly homemade.

Great value for money — definitely worth a visit.

My wife and I stumbled into The Gourmet Hut late at night during our travels, and it ended up being one of those unforgettable food moments. We were actually the only customers in the shop, but the owner treated us like VIPs. Such a genuinely great guy — he went out of his way to make sure everything was cooked absolutely to perfection.

We ordered the hot dog and the burger, and wow… I still drool just thinking about them. Simple items done exceptionally well, packed with flavor, and made with real care. You can tell this is someone who truly loves what he does.

The hospitality was just as amazing as the food, which made the whole experience even more special. This is the kind of place you remember long after the trip is over. Thank you for the incredible food and warmth — we can’t wait to come back next time we’re in London. 🌭🍔

Had a wonderful Iftar experience at The Gourmet Hut in 2026. The burger was absolutely delicious—juicy, flavourful, and perfectly cooked. The chips were fresh, crispy, and complemented the meal really well after a long fast.

What truly made the visit special was the service. Our waiter, Sumaiya, was extremely polite, attentive, and welcoming, making sure everything was just right. Her friendly attitude added a personal touch to the whole experience.

A perfect place for a satisfying Iftar meal. Highly recommended, and I’ll definitely be visiting again!

They’ve just dropped a new menu and it’s AMAZING. The Set Meal is such a bargain, only £15 for a burger, muddy fries, 3 wings AND tempura prawns, so worth it!!

The Bang Bang Prawns were seriously addictive - flavoursome and spicy. So moreish!

The Smokin Ribs were cooked to perfection, the meat literally fell off the bone.

The Killa Katsu Chips were delicious. The flavours worked so well together.

And the cheese sauce with that burger was amazing! I already love their burgers, this was just incredibly tasty.

We dined at Burger & Lobster Threadneedle Street on Friday evening, two adults and two children, and had a genuinely fantastic experience.

The food, drinks and atmosphere were all excellent, but what really stood out was the service from our waiter, Yohann.

From the moment he came to the table, he engaged brilliantly with our children while remaining completely professional and polished. He struck that rare balance between being attentive without ever being intrusive. When our food was slightly delayed due to a large order, he immediately recognised that it was getting a little late for younger diners and brought out some fries as a thoughtful stopgap. It completely maintained the positive energy at the table.

It is increasingly rare to find genuinely great service in restaurants, but Yohann delivered exactly that. Friendly, intuitive, professional and fun in equal measure. Genuinely brilliant!

We would absolutely recommend this venue and will definitely be returning.

We had an amazing dining experience here! The lobster was absolutely delicious and cooked to perfection. Carlos was incredibly friendly, attentive, and provided excellent service throughout our meal. Our whole family enjoyed it so much that we came back again soon after. Highly recommend this restaurant!

Carlos was my waitress today and he made us have the most amazing experience ever! I’ve been to all the other branches from B&L but this one is just the most beautiful one, the charm of the building, the atmosphere, food and service are just incomparable.

Carlos literally went beyond the normal service that you would get anywhere, from amazing recommendations, fast service, and the wonderful Latin American charm ✨

Very good, tasty.
Maybe expensive but I think the food taste and the quality worth the price.
Also very unique lobster roll.
But if the chips can be 100% potatoes not mix with four would be awesome.

Burger & Lobster on Threadneedle Street in downtown City of London is a fabulous choice for dining out. I came here at dusk with the lit skyscrapers towering above setting the stage for the early evening. The restaurant is quite large with plenty of seating options. It’s absolutely gorgeous in there. The amazingly delicious food, tasty and effective drinks, friendly and attentive service and buzzing atmosphere are all top notch. I would rate this place with six stars if it were possible. First came the Smoky Sunset Fizz to settle in. Then for dinner I had a Wagyu Smash Burger and the Dry Aged British Beef Ribs. Everything was prepared to perfection. The Ribs were out of this world. Highly recommended.

name: Honest Smash + Grab Liverpool St
address: 81-82 Old Broad St, London EC2M 1PR, UK

reviews.text:
Great spot for a bite to eat, with ample seating downstairs and an open kitchen. We visited on a Friday evening, and it was surprisingly quiet.

We enjoyed the Smash Plant: with Symplicity plant-based burger, vegan cheese, vegan burger sauce, homemade pickles, and diced onions. On this occasion, Honest Smash’d their veggie patties quite thin, making the edges almost too crispy to enjoy. Next up, Loaded Chips: Honest’s signature rosemary chips, with 5-cheese sauce, cajun spice, and spring onions. They had good flavour, but I had hoped for more depth in the 5-cheese sauce! All washed down with a creamy chocolate shake.

With the Smash Plant being the only vegan option, as well as the only veggie burger option, I’d love to see more offerings on the menu for non-meat eaters. Flavour combos such as BBQ, chipotle, or truffle — the menu already has these additional sauces for their meat offerings, it would make sense to use them to expand their veggie offering too.

For a fast food burger franchise, these are really nice burgers. Of course, if you want a restaurant experience, this is not it. But as an alternative to other Fast Good Chains this is great. Ordering is easy via screens or at the counter. There is some seating upstairs and a lot more downstairs. The toilets were clean.

The burgers are very juicy and filling. The fries with rosemary where so good. There is ketchup and mayo as much as you want for free, but do try the chipotle mayo. You can also refill your drink if you want. The chicken tenders were so soft and also crunchy. We went here twice during our holiday for a quick bite and it was good both times. Prices are decent for being right next to Liverpool Street Station.

It is great being able to pick up Honest Burger as fast food - I was served within 5 minutes of ordering. The staff were helpful and very kind. The place is kept clean. I paid £11.25 for a refillable drink, single patty smash burger and rosemary fries. The only downside was the burger was not as hot as the fries which were fresh out of the fryer.

I've heard a lot about this franchise.
Wanted to see what the fuss was about.
Upon entering its quite dark, with a red glowing appearance.

Super clean, I was impressed. Tables were spotless and no sign of rubbish anywhere!
Ordered a few meals and they were ready in around 15 minutes.

Packaging focused on recycling, which I can appreciate.

My tribute burger was average, thus the reason I gave three stars. I found it quite oily, the patty had some harder pieces which I could taste throughout the burger. It was medium well and that's how I like it.

Fries were fresh, I'm not a big fan of rosemary on fries, so that's a personal preference.

On a whole I would say the beef has room for improvement. I have had better quality beef patties for less.

The chicken tenders were a force to be reckoned with! Juicy meat with a crunchy outer skin.

Tried this place for lunch and really liked it. The Hot Bun burger was great, not greasy at all, and the shoestring fries inside were super crunchy, which made it even better. Service was fast and the place felt clean. Definitely I’ll go back.

I’d never been to Smashio before but I visited with my friends and we all thought the smash burgers were the best we’ve ever tasted! They were cooked perfectly and tasted delicious. Chetana and Vivek the chef were very friendly and welcoming and gave us all great service. 10/10 would definitely comeback here. I would strongly recommend this restaurant for an inexpensive and delicious meal.

Absolutely disgusting avoid for hygiene reasons, I called about multiple long strands of hair sandwiched in the burger and they hung up on me without any response. I wonder what’s going on in that kitchen. Honestly no words.

Burger was very disappointing. I saw them prepare it and they just took the patty out the freezer. I asked for more lettuce because my lettuce was completely soggy and they charged me £1 and I asked for just one slice of cheese because you’d expect a double hamburger would have 2 slices of cheese right? They also charged me £1 for the cheese. They could be really good if they made it fresh and weren’t stingey on their toppings. Shake shack is miles better sorry to say.

Loaded fries were so disappointing, it was some cheesy sauce and fried onions on top of chips.
Mac & cheese bites were decent but the chicken tenders were the best thing I tried which isn’t really great when it’s supposed to be a place that specialises in smash burgers.
The double smash burger was beyond terrible, the flavour wasn’t good at all, would not get this ever again.
Great place with great value for money, Chicken buttermilk burger is a must try!!!

so this is another tricky one.
i wasnt sure how i would rate jupiter burger but i decided to give them 5 stars.
the ingredients are fresh and tasty.
the thing that made me think was the right meat-to-everything-else ratio in the burger.
i tried a single jupiter burger and a double cheese burger.
i think i did it the wrong way and you should probably switch it around.
since the jupiter burger is loaded with salad and a tomato you really need a second meat patty. (i personally think it should come as a double)
the cheese burger is simpler and there a single is enough.
the fries are great. probably need a bit more salt.

Visited tonight and was met with friendly and responsive service. Patty is super juicy with the crispy edges an added bonus. Rated the addition of tomato and lettuce for some freshness, chips also hit the spot. One of the best value burgers deals  in London

8/25:
Amended from a 5* review, because of how atrocious my visit today was. First off - the hygiene. Or utter lack thereof. The staff member was eating on the bar, dropping crumbs and spittle into the open containers of lettuce and tomato as flies buzzed around. He later sprayed disinfectant not only on the counter where his half eaten meal had been, but across the buns toasting on the griddle and the containers of lettuce/ tomato. Whilst I tried ordering, he then proceeded to sneeze over the buns toasting on the grill. The chips that were so amazingly good before, were already premade and left sitting out, and were served reheated yet luke warm and soggy. Unfortunately, I had already paid, so I was stuck with my meal; and when I questioned it, he made a passive aggressive remark about me already being lucky to eat.

The hair in my chips was the icing on the proverbial cake. 😔

Am so bummed because I truly loved this place, and had already recommended it to a number of friends. However, after today I CANNOT recommend, and will be reporting to the appropriate hygiene controls.

6/25:
If I could give more than 5* I would. The cheeseburger + fries was SO GOOD. Patties hand smashed to order. Brioche bun lightly toasted before the toppings are added. And the fries !!!! Hand cut and fried to order. They taste like 🇺🇸. ❤️ paired with their Housemade Jupiter sauce, words cannot describe. The quality of each and every ingredient is out of this world. Such a great addition to Netil Market !! I will definitely be back !!

Jupiter Burger – London Fields Review

Hype & Expectations (4/5)
Jupiter Burger is an Instagram favourite, With the buzz and the branding, expectations were naturally high. I made the journey across London anticipating a long wait, but the queue moved quickly—from arrival to first bite took around 20–30 minutes, maybe less.

The Burger Experience (3.5/5)
I went for the Jupiter Burger, their premium option featuring a smash patty, sweet onions, iceberg lettuce, and tomato—no fries, which brought it to £10.
•	The first bite hit the spot: the crispy, caramelised smash edges and the sweet onions worked beautifully, delivering that classic American-style burger flavour.
•	The bun was spot on—authentic, soft, and ideal for soaking up all that juicy goodness.
•	But as I got through it, the lettuce and tomato began to get in the way, muting the flavour of the patty and adding extra moisture that made the burger a bit soggy. I found myself rushing through it rather than savouring each bite.

In hindsight, I wish I’d gone for the standard cheeseburger—which seems more focused and likely delivers the cleaner, meat-forward experience I was craving.

Value for Money (4/5)
At £10 without fries, the Jupiter Burger is fairly priced for a London street-style burger, especially given the quality of the ingredients. But as their premium burger, I expected a bit more finesse and clarity of flavour.

Overall Rating: 3.5/5
Jupiter Burger delivers good ingredients and a strong first impression, but the Jupiter itself felt a little over-complicated. The veg dulled the flavour of what could have been a stand-out burger.

Would I return? Yes—but next time, I’m going straight for the standard cheeseburger, which I suspect is the real star of the show.

Is it worth the hype? Almost, there are others out there that are equally as good if not better.

Excellent Smash Burger by the chef from Doms Subs.

Quality smash, good fries and friendly service. I always sit at the counter and have a chat.

Food was good, 4 patty burger was tasty and juicy but missed two important items and only realised when I got home, the caramelised onions and maple bacon! But still had good flavour. Blazing bird was okay, there was something missing and would have made it 5 outta 5, but still okay. Mango habanero tenders were very good and portion was decent, bbq wings were okay, bbq sauce needs to be a bit more sticky. Chicken loaded fries was the best ordered item for me, very tasty. Service wasn’t slow, it’s a new business, they’re having a lot of customers and the opening week offer can delay some food (which they are honest about at the counter). Seen some comments flying around about timing and customer service, don’t always believe what you read. It’s a 4 outta 5, but everyone has different taste buds so it’s defo worth a visit and hopefully next visit will take this to a 5!

We ordered the Classic Smash, Truffle Akh and Garlic Truffle and Parmesan wings. First of all if there’s smash burgers ALWAYS order the smash burgers, stop ordering chicken.
The smash burgers were good and nothing to fault, great taste and juicy.
The wings on the other hand had a weird bitter after taste which I didn’t like.

The service was non existent, bad communication and the customers not knowing where to wait for their orders.
We ordered our food for eat in, we asked do we wait at the tables upstairs where the man taking the order just looked at us blankly not answering the question.
We ended up going upstairs to wait for our order as downstairs was very tight and busy. Noticed a worker coming once in a while with customer orders in takeaway bags. Later we found out is you have to collect your food from downstairs near the takeaway “window”.
Very confusing experience.
Tables were not clean when sat down but later a worker was walking around emptying tables with a black bin bag being dragged along.

Atmosphere was nothing special, had decent decoration but meh

I probably wouldn’t come back here as down the road you have Simply Smashed which is much better in every way. The restaurant is in a prime location so needs to fix up

I saw an advert for this burger shop online and thought I’d give it a go. The location is really close to Whitechapel station. When I went, it was quite busy ,I waited roughly 10 minutes in the queue to order and about 20 minutes to get my food. The burger was fantastic value for money ,really tasty! Plus, they had a range of sauces available for everyone to help themselves to. All in all, a great little spot if you don’t mind a bit of a wait!

this is lowkey disappointing as i’ve heard a lot about here, im sure the other branches are up to standard as the reviews are a lot better but my experience wasn’t great, all the food was extremely cold and oily and sickly, especially the ‘MEGA’ loaded fries which was just about a medium although id call it a small and the box wasn’t even filled! For the price point this was not it! save your money i really hope five akhis can redeem themselves because this should not be the standard in london and im sure this is a staff problem and not a manager problem and you wouldn’t want to see your staff ruining your own business! this should really be taken into consideration, i also ordered because my microwave was broken and did not expect more cold food 😡

As someone who was an early supporter after first having tasted thier food, whenever I was done in MK for business, I was glad they opened up in East London.

Surprised by some comments, as I have done food reviews for nearly 10yrs.

Service was good, but I am all about taste. Go for the classic and the Mango wings, whilst my mates had others on the menu, I stuck to what I like and the quality is that same. Still one of the best burgers by far.

Brother Joshua knows service...I only showed him my 8m views as I walked out, as I wanted to compliment how he was handling things and why I was loyal.

The food was amazing. The fries tasted good, and I loved the onion rings.

The burger tasted amazing, with many flavours. Everything was cooked well.

The nacho sauce was good as well.

However I thought the burger would look bigger as in the picture, but it was all good anyway my stomach was full after the meal.

Completely happy with the food was clean cooked well hygiene was amazing at 100%.

Going to order from here again next time.😊

Took around 30 minutes to get here.
The burger was the worst thing I’ve ever had. It was extremely spicy, the chicken was bad, and the burger bun immediately became soggy and fell apart I threw it in the trash immediately.

Despite being a bit far from me it always arrives nice and warm , i ordered the double cheesed up and man this burgers were incredibly delicious, one thing which impressed me the most was the soft perfect buns , it’s like you bite a whole one thing unlike other burgers where the bun texture kills the experience.
Ina addition the cheese fries which were soft and perfectly made with a generous amount of cheese (one thing I’d prefer if they’d be freshly cut potato fries instead of frozen .. but the burger and the cheese quality compensates for it )
10/10 for me hope they keep up making these amazing food!

The WORST burgers in London!
I’ve ordered my burger a fries at 6:20pm… it arrived COLD at 8pm.
The cheesy burger is SUPER  SPICY 🌶️!!!
I HATE spicy food and it doesn’t say ANYWHERE on their menu their burger is spicy!! NOWHERE!!!
The food was COLD!!
Super SPICY!!
Gave me stomach aches and diarrhoea!!
Dirty and smelly!!
AVOID! AVOID! AVOID!!
Disappointed. Ordered nashville wings, original smashed burger and chips. Wings were tiny, more bread in burger and even chips were lame. It was £15 for that and I don't think it was worth it

Lucky Chip has been one of my very favourite burger offerings for years and would say it has been ahead of its time when looking at the burger scene now, thanks to awesome founder Ben Denner.

The ‘El Chappo’ is certainly one of my favourite burgers of all time, with its aged beef patty, bacon, spicy jalapeño juiciness, aioli and blue cheese, that is just so simple and much loved by many burger maestros alike. Luckily by being with my partner, we got to also enjoy a double house burger whammy, sporting bacon, American cheese, pickles and a devilish portion of BBQ tater tots with chipotle mayo, cheddar and cream soda BBQ sauce on the side… or rather sandwiched between us both that we enjoyed like a box of popcorn at the cinema. If balls of potato bliss scare you, then the chips are ace as you’d expect with the name ‘Lucky Chip’.

Whether it’s The Old Queens Head, Netil Market or Folkestone, I suggest you respect your elders/legends when it comes to the best of burgers out there and go have a Lucky Chip. Thanks as always Ben and team from a long time fan here!

Staying and the Travel Lodge around the corner and wondered in for dinner - Saturday night, 5pm, was empty - fairy lights and candles, lovely setting. Me, my partner and our 2 kids (5 and 7)… menu not vast - burgers/loaded fries… food was really lovely and the staff were so so friendly - chilled and not too busy - would recommend - thank you Lucky Chip!
The staff is so lovely and the atmosphere was different definitely, not an ordinary pub! The hamburger was a bit too fatty for my taste but I’d come again here for a drink
Burgers were great!! Tasty, juicy, tender, filling but you don't feel heavy after having one as it happens with some burger joints. They were also quite fast.
This was the last of Time Outs top 10 burger joints in London... Easily the best burger I've had out of them all! The tater tots were the big winner for me! Good quality, and lots of quantity

name: Five Guys Burgers and Fries Liverpool Street

reviews.text: I got a little bacon cheeseburger which has one beef patty, compared to the normal one that has two, a very generous portion of fries and a peanut butter shake which i cannot recommend enough! The food portion was great and you can choose whatever toppings to add to your burger and make it as you like. The staff was very friendly, eager to help and make recommendations about the food. The place was also pretty clean (for a fast food restaurant) and had two floors so plenty of tables to sit and people watch from any floor as you eat. Overall, a positive experience!

Five Guys – A Standout in Fast Food Excellence

Five Guys consistently ranks among the top fast-food chains, excelling in both customer service and food quality. Every visit delivers the same high standard prompt, friendly staff and meticulously prepared meals.The retro 80s-inspired interior red-and-white checkerboard tiles, wooden benches, and an open kitchen creates a simple yet instantly recognizable vibe. Watching burgers assemble in real time builds anticipation and underscores the freshness.

Food highlights:

Burgers: Premium beef patties, soft absorbent buns, generous melted cheese, and deeply caramelized grilled onions that add rich savoriness.

Fries: Hand-cut, perfectly crisp outside, fluffy inside, and dusted with signature seasoning.

Sauces: Distinctive house blends that elevate every bite.

Portions are generous, ingredients feel premium, and the attention to detail is unmatched in the category.Five Guys is the rare brand I’ve voluntarily promoted in my own time because the experience genuinely earns it. Strongly recommended to anyone seeking fast food done right.

Great food! Real bacon in the bacon milkshake. A huge portion of fries that were delicious. We got complementary peanuts and a great selection of beverages. You can customize the food, to be allergy friendly. I'm  gluten and dairy free and I ate here no problem.

Five Guys near Liverpool Street Station is one of the best locations, conveniently situated just outside the underground station, with the bus station right at your doorstep. The place is clean and calm, and the service was good overall. Staff clearly guide customers to retrieve the receipt, which is required to get the code for accessing the washroom, making the experience smooth and well managed.

It's Mc Donald's 10 years ago.

Over priced.

We have chosen to be seated, see the pack and french fries inside....

What a pity 😞

name: FOODEEZ
address: 355 Cambridge Heath Rd, London E2 9RA, UK

reviews.text:
I recently visited Foodez and I can confidently say it was one of the best dining experiences I’ve had. The shawarma was absolutely outstanding  easily the best I’ve ever tried. The flavors were perfectly balanced, and there was something about it that truly sets it apart.

I also ordered a smash burger and a cheeseburger and both were excellent. The quality of the ingredients and the flavor in every bite were impressive. You can really tell they put care into their food.

On top of that, the customer service was exceptional. The staff was friendly welcoming and attentive which made the experience even better.

I highly recommend Foodez to anyone looking for great food and great service. It’s definitely worth a visit!

I have eaten at Foodeez many times and would definitely recommend!
The quality of the food is exceptional, I am really impressed with the smash burgers and buttermilk chicken burger.
There’s a wide variety of items on the menu so something for everyone!
The staff are really nice and friendly and which makes the experience even better, they tell you how long the food will take to be served and provide excellent service. I really liked how the shop only stocks genocide free brands.
Do go and try if you have not already!

Amazing food!
I ordered the buttermilk chicken burger with only a little salad. I usually don't fancy a lot of salad on my burger because it's not always fresh but this salad was crunchy and exceeded my expectation. The burger was moist and flavourful. The thick cut chips were a perfect match and I also really enjoyed the various sauces they had. I took my order with a Lemonade.

We had a smash burger, buttermilk burger and 2 kids meals. The burgers weren’t too bad but we ate in and had the misfortune of witnessing a food delivery of frozen chicken and a huge vat of mayonnaise, that was filthy and it put me off my food instantly. The kids meals were awful and not edible, chicken strips and nuggets were dry and tasted really odd. Chips seemed to be cooked in old oil and were not seasoned so had a bitter cardboard taste. I had to buy my kids snacks from the garage next door to sustain them until dinner so basically a massive waste of money and food

Smash burgers are good. Some people might find it a little spicy, but I do like it that way. The wings are great, works well with the chilli and the red sauce, which they usually offer. Always fresh chips are served. Chicken burgers are great, the buttermilk and the spicy one. Different patties. If you want a halal replacement for the cheeseburger and double cheeseburger they offer that here, only thing I think they can improve on is to not overcook the patty on the cheeseburger/ double cheeseburger. Other than that they're generous on the toppings on the burger which evens that out.

Arbaz was very hospitable to us. While it was raining we was looking for somewhere to sit and enjoy our food as the other spot was closed he offered us shelter from the rain. The drinks here are good aswell

Amazing service! The staff are so kind and the food is  very fresh and so good. The waiting time on food is so short too :)

I strongly recommend this to everyone!!
Incredible burger for an insane price! We had the combo deal for two which was just shy of £20. Would 100% recommend it!
Food was pretty good. Had 3 Layer beef burger and a drink. A bit pricey..
Really tasty smash burger, they wrap in foil so it travels well too. 10/10 for taste would go again

name: Gourmet Burger Kitchen
address: Unit 4, Condor House, St. Paul's Churchyard, London EC4M 8AL, UK

reviews.text: This place is the best! We ate here three times while staying at a nearby Premier Inn. The burgers are fresh and delicious and there are loads of sides to choose from. I love that you order and pay in the app. The restaurant has lots of comfy tables and views of St Paul’s Cathedral. Staff are awesome too.

This GB burger is the best! Cooked perfection juicy burger. It’s probably the beef and brisket combo in the burger. So yummy . Must have a shake here. I recommend the vanilla shake because it’s thick delicious and full of wonderful Madagascar vanilla you can see the grind little black flakes in there. You have to know this is authentic. !! we also had crispy delicious sweet potato fries, and chose the satay sauce.. but mustard honey sauce would be bit better. Love it here I would come again. You make your order at the table and they know exactly where to take it. Fast service too! Not that we needed it, but it was a pleasure.

I hadn’t visited in years, so I decided it was time to give it another try. The burger was of good quality, and the restaurant was spacious with friendly staff. It’s a bit pricey for lunch, but overall I’d rate it 7.5/10

Lovely atmosphere, great location 👍 service with a smile and the food was on point! Was asked if we had any dietary requirements before ordering too so a bonus from me! Quick and efficient. The habenero jam sauce had a gorgeous kick too it too so if you like a little spice I would absolutely recommend it on the side or even to chuck inside one of their juicy burgers! 😉 we then went back a few weeks later and unfortunately ordered the same thing again and one of the burgers was raw even though we asked for well done... a little annoying as it meant we didn't eat together... seems to happen when particular staff are working.

This place caught my eye after a long morning of touring. It was pretty crowded which was a good sign. I was greeted and taken to my seat and very hastily advised how to order-download the app and order with table number or go up to counter. As my internet would not load the app I had to pick up my gear as I could not see the counter and order that way as I was not going to leave belongings. Food was served within 15 minutes and while tasty seemed liked it had been waiting to be served for a while. The chips were not all that exciting. Other than that a good meal

name: Premier Inn London City (Old Street) hotel

reviews.text:
I would say that breakfast was a bit chaotic, so make sure you're up and about in good time - and paid in advance - but otherwise we found the staff to be extremely helpful.  They were good with our son, and it was the wife's birthday whilst we were there so they sorted her out with a cocktail.

And I don't know if this is because it was the half-term holiday, but every day there were new things for the kids to colour in (all topical as well - Ramadan, Chinese New Year, Valentine's Day) complete with crayons... and there was often an inflatable character for photo opportunities!

Theres a million hotels but the only hotel where I know regardless of where it is, I’ll get a good nights sleep and a nice powerful shower. I just love how premier inn is so reliable and constant. The beds are the comfiest. The shower is warm and pressure good. The breakfast is yummy. That’s all someone needs really, the basics. It’s not fancy or posh but it doesn’t advertise as that and it doesn’t need to be. It’s all you need.

We stayed unexpectedly here as my wifes surgery at Moorfields kept getting delayed. So, in the end, we stayed for 3nights.
The staff here gave above and beyond for us under the circumstances. We were obviously really stressed but they made us feel at ease. They helped with late checkout, storing bags, organising our last night in the same room as we had before, even though we checked out 6 hours before.
They served us symathetically during dinner and were always on hand for us.
Nothing was too much trouble.
Big shout out to Elly, Naim and Daria who made this all happen with no added stress. Thank you guys. You made a dreadful situation more bearable. You guys will never knowhow much you helped us.

editing as I don’t understand why Google is refusing to publish my review after staying at this hotel! Everybody should know that the hygiene at this place was appalling. I have proof that I stayed at this hotel, not just photos, but also a receipt and booking confirmation. It is a shame that only good reviews are allowed.

I gave one star for the room due to the extremely poor first impression. We stayed in the Premier rooms on the higher floors, which are significantly more expensive, yet the condition was completely unacceptable.

As soon as we stepped out of the elevator, the corridor was visibly filthy. The carpets looked as though they hadn’t been vacuumed or deep-cleaned for months, with stains and dirt throughout. Unfortunately, the same was true inside our room: the carpet was dirty, and the wall was chipped.

The worst part was the bathroom. There was a clump of old hair in the sink drain, the shower tray did not drain properly ( I didn’t dare to look what was blocking it!), the shower head had visible mould, and there was also black mould around the shower screen frame. This level of hygiene is simply unacceptable.

Being a three star hotel does not excuse a lack of cleanliness. I fully understand that furnishings don’t need to be brand new, but I do expect a spotless, hygienic room regardless of star rating.

At least the reception was friendly, but that’s all.

Decent hotel in a useful (for me) location that might not suit everyone - at the northern perimeter of the Square Mile. Easy walk down to Guildhall, Bank, Royal Exchange and the Thames and Borough Market. A nice stroll north takes you to vibrant Islington over the Regent Canal. Premier Inns are a reliable and comfortable standard with our Premier Plus room being on a quiet floor with marginally improved space and facilities including a fridge, coffee pod machine and complimentary bottled water. I'd hope for slightly better maintenance - part of our shower was loose and damaged. Housekeeping is hit & miss - only one set of towels was provided for a booking of two people and the hand-wash was empty. A word with the duty manager got it sorted. Staff are very friendly & helpful but as always with Premier, too few in number to cope at busy times.

name: South Place Hotel | Luxury Stay in the Heart of London

reviews.text:
This hotel is listed as 5-star, but our 1-night stay didn’t really feel like it.

The staff were fine, and the rooms are beautiful, despite the peeling wood at the bottom of the doors and drawers.

The biggest issue was the AC. We arrived after midnight, and the room was absolutely freezing — as cold as outside. The AC was set to 15.5°C, so we turned it up to the highest possible temp, 27.5°C expecting it to get warmer… but it didn’t. It just kept blowing cold air. There was no way to change it from AC to heating mode.

We called reception and they offered a small Dyson heater quite quickly, which made us feel like they probably expected this. The problem was, the AC was still blowing cold air into the room at the same time. We had turned it off before the staff member even arrived, but it continued running and blowing cold air for a long time after. So we had this tiny heater trying to warm the room while cold air was actively being pumped in. It made no sense.

There was no option to switch the system to an actual heating mode — you could only increase the temperature of the aircon, which still blew cold. In the end, we were moved to a smaller room, which was half the size of the room he paid for, which isn’t very fair. The system there also didn’t produce heat, but at least when we turned it off, it actually turned off, which made it more bearable.

For a 5-star hotel in London in winter, not having a working heating system — or even a proper heating setting — is pretty surprising. Even travelodge or premier inn have heating u can regulate…

On top of that, there were moths in the room. One flew out of the wardrobe when I opened it for a robe, and they were on the walls. The robes themselves felt have never seen fabric softener in their lives. They were crunchy and FILLED the room with dust.

Overall, it looked nice, but not quite the five-star experience we expected. My boyfriend booked it as a valentines suprise, and all this faffing interrupted the valentines romance a bit.

Excellent high-end hotel nestled in Liverpool St area of London. With the Broadgate Circle development there’s loads to do (restaurants, bars, shops) within a few minutes, as well as everything the City and Shoreditch has to offer. The room was very comfortable, with an excellent bed, good lighting, mini bar (incl. good teabgs!) and a well-equipped bathroom. I also enjoyed the spaces downstairs, including some fabulous cocktails in the bar, and a delicious duck salad for lunch. Staff were helpful and professional throughout. My husband stayed here on another occasion and rated it highly too.

There’s only one downside for which I have deducted one star: I was disappointed at check-out to discover SPH have adopted the practice of adding an “optional” service charge. I paid it, but I would much prefer the hotel incorporate it into advertised rates. Paying staff properly isn’t optional, and responsibility for this shouldn’t transferred to guests. Staff’s take-home pay ought to be consistent, and not dependent on the generosity of guests in any particular month.

Always a lovely experience coming here, the pancake breakfast is amazing!  Great service with very friendly staff. Touch controls in the room are not always intuitive and the design of the shower in the bath means there can be quite a lot of water outside the bathtub when you've finished. Minor issues really, although one plug for the kettle and coffee machine is a bit tight - mind you don't scold yourself when plugging and unplugging...
Very close to Northern and District line tubes, great to explore any part of London from.

Stayed at South Place Hotel and was genuinely impressed. The rooms are spacious and well-appointed witb good wifi and making it a comfortable base for London.
Location is spot-on—just steps from the Liverpool street station you are basically connected to all parts of the city and the suburbs., plus some great restaurants at the hotel and some good ones within walking distance. For shopping, leisure and other spots its a great location . But what really stood out was the team’s warm, smiling service every single day.

I stayed at this hotel back in 2022. The hotel itself was fine; the rooms, location, and overall experience were good. Unfortunately, things behind the scenes are really not in order.

At check-in, I was asked to leave a deposit of £250, which already felt strange for a five-star hotel. Still, I agreed. When I tried to pay the deposit with my bank card, it didn’t work with the normal payment terminal, so they brought one from the restaurant instead, and I paid that way.

After my stay, I tried to contact the hotel several times to get my deposit refunded, but it was incredibly difficult. Even after all this time, they still haven’t refunded me. I’ve been patient for long enough, and that’s why I’m finally writing this review.

So please, future guests, be careful if you stay here. They simply keep your money and never refund the deposit.

Beautiful room, tastefully decorated, muted pastel colours, cool pictures, very stylish - not the bland unimaginative shades of grey you get in lots of modern hotels. Pretty lighting. A lot of thought and consideration has gone into the interior design of the rooms. Extremely clean. Lovely, comfortable firm bed. Nice selection of teas and coffees and fresh milk in the fridge. One of the nicest London hotels we've stayed at in a while. Really impressed. Nice welcome drink at the bar and friendly staff. We haven't had breakfast yet but feel compelled to write this review because we're really happy here.

This was good for an overnight stay. We had a room on the 1st floor - don't expect a view unless you choose as terrace room. The beds are comfy but the bathroom is really only big enough for one person at a time.
The staff were friendly and helpful both at reception and at breakfast. Breakfast was disappointing, with the cooked breakfast tepid at best. The coffee wasn't great.

Charming Stay, but minor Improvements Needed for a Five Star Experience
​The Chamberlain Hotel is a genuinely lovely establishment with fantastic potential. We truly loved the ambiance and the incredible quality of the bed, it provided a truly beautiful night's sleep. The staff were also wonderful and helpful! ​However, I felt the website's portrayal gave an expectation of a more luxurious execution than the reality of the room quality. Areas for Improvement i'd say for noise & privacy: The walls are quite thin. We could easily hear people talking and walking as they passed our room. The door frame was noticeably ill-fitted (light from the hallway was visible), which contributed to the sound issues. Bathroom: The lack of soundproofing in the bathroom compromises privacy significantly. ​Cleanliness: While generally clean, a more thorough dusting is required, especially on the walls and wood furniture. We were disappointed to find we only had a shower, as our booking confirmation and the website stated we would have a bathtub. Overall, it's a very charming hotel that I truly enjoyed, but addressing these small maintenance and quality issues would elevate it to the websites quality experience its excellent location and bedding promise.

Absolutely loved this hotel! The rooms were clean and had airconditioning & a fridge. We could store our luggage free if charge. Staff were all super friendly and helpful! Location is superb next to the Aldgate & Tower Hill tube stations. Enough power plugs in the room. Beds are soft and very comfortable (although a little high!). Cannot recommend this enough.

Rooms small but adequate.

Bed wasn’t the most comfortable. Shower was good. Toiletries could’ve been better.

Quiet location. Close to amenities.

Breakfast was average.

The Corner London City
I recently stayed at this hotel and I was really impressed! The atmosphere is super cute and cozy, and the location is incredibly convenient for exploring the city. Plus, the hotel is spotlessly clean, which I really appreciated.
The breakfast was very good and gave me the perfect start to the day. I also highly recommend the restaurant: after a long day of walking around London, it was so nice to have dinner right there without having to head out again. The menu is very varied and the food quality is excellent.
A special shout-out to the staff—everyone was so lovely, especially Adnana. Her kindness and friendly personality made my stay even better!
I also really appreciated their eco-friendly philosophy. It’s a truly "green" hotel that genuinely cares about the environment, which is a huge plus these days.

Everything was perfect! The room was spacious and the bathroom was quite good (though the shower could have had a handheld showerhead). The room cleanliness was excellent, and the breakfast was quite nice—we were completely satisfied. Also, the location was flawless, with the metro station right next to us."

I had a fantastic stay at The Corner London City! From the moment I arrived, I was impressed by the hotel’s warm atmosphere and smart, modern design. What truly stood out, however, was their strong commitment to sustainability. Every detail — from the eco-friendly amenities to their clever energy-saving features — made me feel that I was staying somewhere that genuinely cares about its environmental impact.

The room was comfortable, spotless and thoughtfully arranged, and the staff were incredibly friendly and helpful throughout my stay. The location is also perfect, with easy access to public transport and plenty of great places to explore nearby.

I genuinely loved my experience here and truly appreciate the hotel’s dedication to being both stylish and environmentally conscious. I would absolutely stay again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting London!

This hotel is one of the cleanest and most affordable we could find in this area. I always stay here whenever I come to London. It's a few stops from Liverpool Street station. On my previous visits I was single, but this time I came with my husband and baby. I had requested a crib for the baby, and they prepared the room accordingly. Adnan at reception was wonderful and kind, he treated us very friendly. As a Muslim, I found the breakfast adequate, but of course it depends on what you expect from a breakfast. Everything was great, I would recommend it to anyone coming to London.

I have just returned from our “One Night in Rila” production and script read through meeting we held at the Corner Hotel on Adler street. We had booked The Gallery function room.
Adnana looked after us all day making sure we had sufficient refreshments available to all of us and ensuring we had reserved tables so we could enjoy our cold-buffet lunch uninterrupted.
The service was excellent, the venue for meetings was perfect and Adnana was outstanding- thank you !
We would be delighted to hold any future production meetings here .

Visited to try the new Christmas cocktails in the seasonal yurt and loved every minute! The firepits and fairy lights make the yurt so warm and cosy, perfect for a casual Christmassy date night. The biscotti sour and snowjito were our favourites. @nottinghillfoodie_

Went for a drag show, really liked the place. Would love to go back to check the roof top and the upper floor just for a drink.
To be honest, my favourite thing about the place was the ladies loo- probably the coolest WC in London. 👑

It's like a TARDIS when you walk inside and the rooftop bar is truly stunning. The basement club is a decent enough size if you like a genuinely intimate but not claustrophobic experience with basic seating near the stage and adequate sound system and lighting. Staff seem cheerful and friendly.

Really not happy with my experience. I was out for a friends birthday and asked the supposed “manager” to put my phone on charge in which she said yes. After about 10 minutes i asked for my phone back then she proceeded to tell me i never gave it to her, it was only when i told the other members of staff they got my phone back straight away after i told the manager i will write a bad review on her and she panicked . Wish i could remember the names of the staff who helped me as they was lovely and im very greatful for them helping me!
Please be careful of the “manager”

2nd time here and each time it’s more disappointing. Awful music, no atmosphere, rude staff.
Came for a comedy evening and Eventbrite had only issued 1 barcode for our tickets (a simple error I’m sure) but despite showing all of the confirmation emails they said we needed to buy another ticket at double the online price. Would not listen to reason or take into account the paper trail.
I’d advise you to swerve Queen of Hoxton and go to any of the other great venues close by.

I love All Star Lanes! I was excited to visit this branch when visiting the area, I would go all the time if I lived nearer. They always have a cool retro vibe and I enjoy the more boutique setting, it makes a change from large loud bowling alleys. Plus you can stop for a bite to eat in their restaurant area or enjoy a cocktail in their swanky bar space. A perfect place for a date actually. On my visit, the staff were friendly and went out of their way to make my day. Excellent service ✨!

Booked in Karoake. The floors were very sticky which is quite annoying, it would have been good if they kept the floor clean. Lots of options for songs and was fun. Wish it was a bit brighter in the room

PSA: they will contact you and promise a response within 3 days and not answer after 10 days and still counting. This is extremely poor. Not even a phone number to chase this up. Avoid and take your money elsewhere.

Original review as follows.
Went for Karaoke, arrived around 20mins early and was told to come back closer to booking, so we went and got a drink which was decent price and was of good quality. Once in the room, it was not properly cleaned / sanitised as we went in immediately after another group with no time in-between for a reset for example so this was a concern. Once in the room, the song choice was lacking. Halfway through, the TV screen used turned off and we had to waste paid booking time to resolve this and was not offered extra time after a mistake that was out of our control. One of the microphones also stopped working halfway through which was due to the battery dying which again we had to leave through our paid time and was not resolved as it still kept on dying. This overall a mid experience, and I would not recommend or consider visiting again. Please can this feedback be taken onboard and I would like to request compensation for this poor experience.

Terrible shady looking street with some vintage shops, food on the street isn’t tasty except 1-2 restaurants. Worth mentioning a hidden gem - a handmade chocolates and very tasty hot chocolate served in a chocolate shop. Its the only one on the street.

We visited on Sunday around lunchtime, and the place wasn’t busy, making for a really relaxed atmosphere.

They use a string pin system that just worked; we had zero technical issues.
